chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Vala amehlo akho bese ubona ngeso lengqondo udonga lwezitini. Iyini isisekelo sokwakha lolo donga? Isitini esisodwa, vele. Njengodonga lwezitini, umzimba wakho wakhiwe ngamabhlogo okwakha ayisisekelo abizwa ngokuthi amaseli.”

 Umzimba wakho unezinhlobo eziningi zamaseli, ngalinye likhethekile ngenhloso ethile. Njengoba nje ikhaya lenziwe ngezinto zokwakha ezahlukahlukene, umzimba womuntu wakhiwe ngezinhlobo eziningi zamaseli. Isibonelo, amaseli e-epithelial avikela ubuso bomzimba futhi amboze izitho kanye nemigodi yomzimba ngaphakathi. Amaseli ethambo asiza ukusekela nokuvikela umzimba. Amaseli esistimu yomzimba alwa namagciwane ahlaselayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaseli egazi athwala izakhamzimba nomoya-mpilo kuwo wonke umzimba ngenkathi esusa i-carbon dioxide kanye neminye imfucuza. Uhlobo ngalunye lwamaseli ludlala indima ebalulekile ngesikhathi sokukhula, ukuthuthukiswa, kanye nokugcinwa okuqhubekayo komzimba. Nokho, naphezu kokuhlukahluka kwawo okukhulu, amaseli avela kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo—ngisho nezinto eziphilayo ezahlukahlukene njengebhaktheriya, u-anyanisi, kanye nabantu—abelana ngezici ezithile eziyisisekelo.

 Kubantu, ngaphambi kokuba iseli likhule libe uhlobo lwalo olukhethekile, libizwa ngokuthi iseli eliyisisekelo. Iseli eliyisisekelo liseli elingakaze lishintshe okuhilelekile ekukhetheni. Kulesi simo, lingahluka libe elinye lamaseli amaningi akhethekile, futhi lingahlukana ukuze likhiqize amaseli amaningi ayisisekelo. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezivamile, uma iseli selikhethekile, lihlala ngaleyo ndlela. Kodwa-ke, ososayensi bebesebenza ekukhuthazeni amaseli okuqala elabhorethri ukuba abe yingcweti ethile. Isibonelo, ososayensi eCincinnati Children's Hospital Medical Center bafunde ukusebenzisa amaseli okuqala ukukhulisa izicubu zesisu ezitsheni zepulasitiki zamangqamuzana kanye nezitsha zokukhulisa izicubu. Lokhu kufezwa kuzokwenza abacwaningi bakwazi ukutadisha izifo zabantu zesisu, njengomdlavuza wesisu. Bheka Umfanekiso 4.1
question1: Yisiphi isifaniso esichaza kahle indima yamaseli emzimbeni womuntu?
answer1: Amaseli ayizakhi eziyisisekelo zomzimba, njengezitini ziyizakhi eziyisisekelo zodonga
distractor1a: Amaseli ayimihlobiso yesikhashana engezwa emzimbeni, njengopende odongeni
distractor1b: Amaseli ayizikhala ezingenalutho phakathi kwezingxenye zomzimba, njengezikhala phakathi kwezitini
distractor1c: Amaseli ayizimbozo zangaphandle ezivikelayo kuphela futhi awakhi izicubu zangaphakathi
question2: Kungani umzimba womuntu uqukethe izinhlobo eziningi ezahlukene zamaseli?
answer2: Izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli zikhethekile ukwenza imisebenzi ehlukene
distractor2a: Wonke amaseli enza umsebenzi ofanayo kuzo zonke izicubu
distractor2b: Amaseli ahlukene akhona kuphela ngoba awanawo ama-DNA
distractor2c: Amaseli ashintsha ngokungahleliwe nsuku zonke ngaphandle kwenhloso ethile

answer3: Amaseli egazi athwala umoya-mpilo nezakhamzimba emzimbeni wonke
question4: Uyini umsebenzi omkhulu wamaseli e-epithelial?
answer4: Zivikela izindawo zomzimba futhi zimboze izitho zomzimba kanye nemigodi yomzimba
question5: Yiluphi uhlobo lweseli oluhileleke kakhulu ekusekeleni nasekuvikeleni umzimba?

answer6: Amaseli omzimba
distractor6c: Amaseli e-stem kuphela ngemva kokuba esephenduke izitini
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono iseli eliyinhloko?
answer7: Iseli elingakacaci futhi elingaba izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli
distractor7a: Iseli esevele seliwuhlobo olulodwa lokugcina olukhethekile futhi elingakwazi ukuhlukanisa
distractor7b: Iseli elitholakala kubhaktheriya kuphela hhayi kubantu
distractor7c: Iseli elingenalo ikhono lokukhiqiza amangqamuzana amaningi

answer8: Ishintsha ibe uhlobo lweseli olukhethekile olunomsebenzi othize
distractor8b: Ilahlekelwa yizo zonke izakhiwo zamaseli unomphela
distractor8c: Iba yinto efanayo nawo wonke amanye amaseli emzimbeni
question9: Ngaphansi kwezimo ezivamile, kwenzekani ngokuvamile ngemva kokuba iseli selikhetheke ngokukhethekile?
answer9: Ngokuvamile ihlala ikhethekile kulowo msebenzi
question10: Kungani ososayensi benesithakazelo ekukhuthazeni amaseli okuqala ukuba abe izinhlobo ezithile zamaseli elabhorethri?
answer10: Bangakha izicubu ezikhethekile zokufunda izifo kanye nentuthuko
distractor10a: Zingaguqula amangqamuzana abe izinto zokwakha ezingaphili
distractor10c: Zingenza zonke izinto eziphilayo zibe nohlobo olufanayo lweseli
question11: Kungani ukukhulisa izicubu zesisu kusuka kumaseli okuqala kuwusizo kubacwaningi?
answer11: Ivumela ososayensi ukuthi bafunde ngezifo zesisu zabantu ezimweni zelebhu
distractor11a: Kufakazela ukuthi izicubu zesisu azakhiwe ngamaseli
distractor11b: Kuthatha indawo yesidingo sokutadisha izinhlelo eziphilayo ngobufakazi
distractor11c: Kubonisa ukuthi amabhaktheriya, u-anyanisi, kanye nabantu abanazo izinto ezifanayo zamaseli
question12: Yini izinto eziphilayo ezihlukile njengamabhaktheriya, izitshalo zika-anyanisi, kanye nabantu ezifanayo?
distractor12b: Zonke ziqukethe amangqamuzana ethambo negazi kuphela

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.1 Ukufunda Amaseli | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.1 Ukufunda Amaseli | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Iseli liyunithi encane kakhulu yento ephilayo. Into ephilayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yenziwe ngeseli elilodwa (njengamabhaktheriya) noma amaseli amaningi (njengomuntu), ibizwa ngokuthi isidalwa. Ngakho-ke, amaseli ayizakhi eziyisisekelo zazo zonke izinto eziphilayo.

 Amaseli amaningana ohlobo olulodwa axhumana futhi enze umsebenzi ohlanganyelwe akha izicubu; izicubu eziningana ziyahlangana ukuze zakhe isitho (isisu sakho, inhliziyo, noma ubuchopho), kanti izitho eziningana zakha uhlelo lwesitho (njengesistimu yokugaya ukudla, uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi, noma uhlelo lwezinzwa). Izinhlelo eziningana ezisebenza ndawonye zakha isitho (njengomuntu). Lapha, sizohlola isakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi wamaseli.

 Kunezinhlobo eziningi zamaseli, wonke aqoqwe ngesinye sezigaba ezimbili ezibanzi: i-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic. Isibonelo, womabili amaseli ezilwane nezitshalo ahlukaniswa njengamaseli e-eukaryotic, kanti amaseli ebhaktheriya ahlukaniswa njenge-prokaryotic. Ngaphambi kokuxoxa ngezinqubo zokunquma ukuthi iseli liyi-prokaryotic noma i-eukaryotic, ake siqale sihlole ukuthi izazi zezinto eziphilayo zifunda kanjani amaseli

answer6: Iseli → Izicubu → Isitho → Uhlelo Lwezitho → Isitho

answer8: Igciwane

answer9: Amaseli e-Eukaryotic

answer10: Zenziwe ngeseli elilodwa noma ngaphezulu
question11: Usosayensi ufunda iseli lebhaktheriya. Leli seli liyingxenye yasiphi isigaba esibanzi?

answer12: Zimelela izigaba ezimbili eziyisisekelo zokuhleleka kwamaseli
distractor12a: Isigaba esisodwa siqukethe amaseli afile kuphela

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.1 Ukufunda Amaseli | I-Microscopy
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.1 Ukufunda Amaseli | I-Microscopy
chapterContent:
Amaseli ayahlukahluka ngobukhulu. Ngaphandle kwezimbalwa, amaseli ngamanye awakwazi ukubonwa ngeso lenyama, ngakho ososayensi basebenzisa ama-microscope (micro- = small”; -scope = ukubuka”) ukuze bawafunde. I-microscope iyithuluzi elikhulisa into. Izithombe eziningi zamaseli zithathwa nge-microscope, futhi lezi zithombe zingabizwa nangokuthi ama-micrograph.

 Ama-optics amalensi e-microscope ahlanganisiwe ashintsha ukuma kwesithombe umsebenzisi asibonayo. Isampula engakwesokudla phezulu futhi ibheke kwesokudla ku-slide ye-microscope izovela ibheke phansi futhi ibheke ngakwesobunxele uma ibukwa nge-microscope, futhi ngokuphambene nalokho. Ngokufanayo, uma i-slide ihanjiswa ngakwesobunxele ngenkathi ibheka nge-microscope, izobonakala ihamba ngakwesokudla, futhi uma ihanjiswa phansi, izobonakala ihambela phezulu. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba ama-microscope asebenzisa amasethi amabili amalensi ukukhulisa isithombe. Ngenxa yendlela ukukhanya okudlula ngayo kumalensi, lolu hlelo lwamalensi amabili lukhiqiza isithombe esiphendukezelwe (ama-binocular, noma ama-dissecting microscope, asebenza ngendlela efanayo, kodwa afaka uhlelo olwengeziwe lokukhulisa olwenza isithombe sokugcina sibonakale siqondile)

answer1: Iningi lamaseli ngamanye mancane kakhulu ukuthi angabonakala ngeso lenyama
distractor1a: Amaseli akhipha ukukhanya okungatholakala kuphela ngama-microscope
distractor1b: Ama-microscope avumela ososayensi ukudala amangqamuzana amasha
distractor1c: Amaseli awabonakali lapho esuswa ezintweni eziphilayo

answer2: Ukukhulisa izinto ukuze zibonwe ngemininingwane eminingi
distractor2b: Ukushintsha amangqamuzana aphilayo abe amangqamuzana afile

question4: Uma ibukwa nge-microscope ehlanganisiwe, kuzovela isampula engakwesokudla phezulu:
answer4: Kuphendukezelwe phansi futhi kubuyiselwe emuva kusuka kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla

answer6: Phezulu

answer7: Ngoba ukukhanya kudlula kumaqoqo amabili amalensi aguqula isithombe
distractor7b: Ngoba amandla adonsela phansi adonsela isithombe phansi
distractor7c: Ngoba amangqamuzana ngokwemvelo abonakala ebheke phansi
question8: Umfundi ufuna ukuhambisa isithombe seseli aye enkabeni yensimu yokubuka. Isithombe sibonakala sikude kakhulu ngakwesokudla. Yiliphi isiqondiso umfundi okufanele asihambise kuso isilayidi?
answer8: Ngakwesokudla

answer9: Amaseli ayahlukahluka ngobukhulu, kodwa amaningi mancane kakhulu ukuba angabonakala ngaphandle kokukhulisa
question10: Yisiphi isici se-microscope esenza kube lula ukubona izakhiwo ezincane?
answer10: Ukukhulisa

answer12: Lawula kahle amaslayidi e-microscope ngenkathi ubheka amasampula

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.1 Ukufunda Amaseli | I-Microscopy | Ama-Microscope Akhanyayo
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.1 Ukufunda Amaseli | I-Microscopy | Ama-Microscope Akhanyayo
chapterContent:
Ukuze sikunike umuzwa wobukhulu beseli, iseli elibomvu legazi lomuntu elijwayelekile lingaba yizigidi eziyisishiyagalombili zemitha noma ama-micro ayisishiyagalombili amamitha (afingqiwe ngokuthi ama-μm ayisishiyagalombili) ububanzi; ikhanda lephini lingaba yizinkulungwane ezimbili zemitha (ama-mm amabili) ububanzi. Lokho kusho ukuthi cishe amangqamuzana abomvu egazi angu-250 angangena ekhanda lephini.

 Ama-microscope amaningi abafundi ahlukaniswa njengama-microscope akhanyayo (Isithombe 4.2.a). Ukukhanya okubonakalayo kudlula futhi kugobe ohlelweni lwelensi ukuze umsebenzisi abone isampula. Ama-microscope akhanyayo awusizo ekubukeni izinto eziphilayo, kodwa njengoba amangqamuzana ngamanye ngokuvamile ebonakala, izingxenye zawo azihlukaniseki ngaphandle kokuthi zifakwe imibala ekhethekile. Nokho, ukudaya, kuvame ukubulala amangqamuzana.

 Ama-microscope akhanyayo avame ukusetshenziswa elabhorethri yasekolishi le-undergraduate ukukhuliswa kuze kube izikhathi ezingaba ngu-400. Ama-para amamitha amabili abalulekile kuma-microscopy ukukhuliswa kanye namandla okuxazulula. Ukukhuliswa inqubo yokukhulisa into ngokubukeka. Amandla okuxazulula yikhono le-microscope lokuhlukanisa izakhiwo ezimbili eziseduze njengezihlukene: uma isinqumo siphakeme, kulapho kucaca khona kanye nemininingwane yesithombe. Lapho amalensi okucwilisa uwoyela esetshenziswa ekufundweni kwezinto ezincane, ukukhulisa ngokuvamile kukhushulwa kube izikhathi eziyi-1,000. Ukuze bathole ukuqonda okungcono ngesakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi weseli, ososayensi bavame ukusebenzisa ama-microscope e-electron.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.1 Ukufunda Amaseli | I-Microscopy | Ama-Microscope E-Electron
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.1 Ukufunda Amaseli | I-Microscopy | Ama-Microscope E-Electron
chapterContent:
Ngokungafani nama-microscope akhanyayo, ama-microscope e-electron (Isithombe 4.2.b) asebenzisa umsebe wama-electron esikhundleni somsebe wokukhanya. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuvumela ukukhuliswa okuphezulu, ngakho-ke, imininingwane eyengeziwe (Isithombe 4.3), futhi kunikeza amandla aphezulu okuxazulula. Indlela esetshenziswa ukulungiselela isampula ukuze ibukwe nge-microscope ye-electron ibulala isampula. Ama-electron anama-wavelength amafushane (amafushane kune-photon) ahamba kahle kakhulu endaweni engenalutho, ngakho-ke amangqamuzana aphilayo awakwazi ukubukwa nge-microscope ye-electron.

 Ku-microscope ye-electron yokuskena, umsebe wama-electron uhamba uye emuva naphambili ebusweni beseli, udala imininingwane yezimpawu zobuso beseli. Ku-microscope ye-electron yokudlulisa, umsebe wama-electron ungena esiseleni futhi unikeze imininingwane yezakhiwo zangaphakathi zeseli. Njengoba ungase ucabange, ama-microscope e-electron makhulu kakhulu futhi ayabiza kakhulu kune-microscope ekhanyayo.
question1: Uyini umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwama-microscope e-electron nama-microscope alula?
answer1: Ama-microscope e-electron asebenzisa umsebe wama-electron esikhundleni sokukhanya okubonakalayo
distractor1a: Ama-microscope e-electron asebenzisa ukukhanya kwe-ultraviolet esikhundleni sokukhanya okubonakalayo
distractor1b: Ama-microscope e-electron asebenzisa amaza omsindo ukudala izithombe
distractor1c: Ama-microscope e-electron asebenzisa amalensi engilazi aqinile kodwa asathembele ekukhanyeni okubonakalayo
question2: Kungani ama-microscope e-electron ekwazi ukukhiqiza izithombe ezinemininingwane eminingi kune-microscope elula?
answer2: Ama-electron ane-wavelength emfushane kakhulu, okuvumela ukukhuliswa okukhulu namandla okuxazulula
distractor2b: Ama-microscope e-electron ahlala esebenzisa amabala anombala
question3: Kungani amangqamuzana aphilayo engakwazi ukubonwa nge-microscope ye-electron?
answer3: Ukulungiswa kwesampula kubulala amangqamuzana, futhi ama-electron ahamba kahle kakhulu endaweni engenalutho
distractor3a: Amaseli aphilayo mancane kakhulu ukuba angatholwa ama-electron
distractor3b: Amangqamuzana aphilayo amunca wonke ama-electron ngaphambi kokuba isithombe sakheke
distractor3c: Ama-microscope e-electron asebenza kuphela namaseli ezitshalo
question4: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-scanning electron microscope (SEM)?

question5: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-transmission electron microscope (TEM)?

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.1 Ukufunda Amaseli | Ithiyori Yeseli
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.1 Ukufunda Amaseli | Ithiyori Yeseli
chapterContent:
Ama-microscope esiwasebenzisa namuhla ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunalawo asetshenziswa ngawo-1600 ngu-Antony van Leeuwenhoek, umninisitolo waseDashi owayenekhono elikhulu ekwenzeni amalensi. Naphezu kokulinganiselwa kwamalensi akhe asendulo manje, u-van Leeuwenhoek waqaphela ukunyakaza kwezinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa, azibiza ngokuthi ama-animalcule.”

 Encwadini ka-1665 ebizwa ngokuthi i-Micrographia, usosayensi wokuhlola uRobert Hooke waqamba igama elithi iseli” lezakhiwo ezifana nebhokisi ayezibona lapho ebuka izicubu ze-cork ngelensi. Ngawo-1670, u-van Leeuwenhoek wathola amabhaktheriya kanye ne-protozoa. Intuthuko yakamuva kumalensi, ukwakhiwa kwama-microscope, kanye namasu okufaka imibala kwenza abanye ososayensi bakwazi ukubona ezinye izingxenye ngaphakathi kwamaseli.

 Ngasekupheleni kwawo-1830, isazi sezitshalo uMatthias Schleiden kanye nesazi sezilwane uTheodor Schwann babefunda izicubu futhi baphakamisa inkolelo-mbono yeseli elihlanganisiwe, ethi zonke izinto eziphilayo zakhiwe yiseli elilodwa noma ngaphezulu, iseli liyiyunithi eyisisekelo yokuphila, futhi amaseli amasha avela kumaseli akhona. Kamuva uRudolf Virchow wenza iminikelo ebalulekile kulo mbono.

 Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi
Isazi se-Cytotechnologist
Wake wezwa ngokuhlolwa kwezokwelapha okubizwa ngokuthi i-Pap smear (Isithombe 4.4)? Kulolu vivinyo, udokotela uthatha isampula encane yamaseli avela emlonyeni wesibeletho sesiguli bese eyithumela elabhorethri yezokwelapha lapho isazi se-cytotechnologist singcolisa amaseli futhi siwahlole ukuze sibone noma yiziphi izinguquko ezingabonisa ukukhula kweseli okungavamile noma ukutheleleka kwamagciwane.

 Ochwepheshe be-cytotechnologists (cyto- = cell”) bangochwepheshe abafunda amaseli ngokuhlolwa kwe-microscopic kanye nezinye izivivinyo zelebhu. Baqeqeshwe ukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izinguquko zamaseli ezingaphakathi kwemingcele evamile nokuthi yiziphi ezingavamile. Ukugxila kwabo akugcini emangqamuzaneni omlomo wesibeletho; bafunda amasampula amaseli avela kuzo zonke izitho zomzimba. Uma bebona ukukhubazeka, baxhumana nodokotela wezifo, ongudokotela wezokwelapha ongenza ukuxilongwa kwezokwelapha.

 Ochwepheshe be-cytotechnologists badlala indima ebalulekile ekusindiseni izimpilo zabantu. Lapho ukukhubazeka kutholakala kusenesikhathi, ukwelashwa kwesiguli kungaqala ngokushesha, okuvame ukwandisa amathuba omphumela ophumelelayo.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.2 Amaseli e-Prokaryotic | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.2 Amaseli e-Prokaryotic | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ngokusho kwenkolelo-mbono yamaseli, zonke izinto eziphilayo, kusukela kubhaktheriya kuya kubantu, zakhiwe ngamaseli, amayunithi amancane kakhulu ezinto eziphilayo. Ngokuvamile amancane kakhulu ukuba angabonwa ngaphandle kwe-microscope, amaseli eza ngobukhulu nobukhulu, futhi ubukhulu bawo obuncane buvumela isilinganiso esikhulu sendawo ebusweni kuya kuvolumu esivumela ukushintshaniswa okuphumelelayo kwezakhamzimba kanye nokungcola nendawo ezungezile.

 Kunezinhlobo ezintathu eziyisisekelo zamaseli: i-archaea, amabhaktheriya, nama-eukaryotes. Zombili i-archaea nama-bacteria zihlukaniswa njenge-prokaryotes, kanti amaseli ezilwane, izitshalo, isikhunta, nama-protists angama-eukaryotes. I-Archaea iyiqembu elihlukile lezinto eziphilayo futhi cishe lavela ezimweni ezinzima zoMhlaba wokuqala futhi lisasakazeka nanamuhla ezindaweni ezimbi kakhulu, njengeziphethu ezishisayo nezifunda ezisemaphethelweni. Wonke amaseli abelana ngezici ezibonisa ukuvela kwawo kukhokho ofanayo; lezi zici ziyi-1) ulwelwesi lwe-plasma oluhlukanisa iseli nendawo yalo; 2) i-cytoplasm equkethe i-cytosol efana ne-jelly ngaphakathi kweseli; 3) ama-ribosome abalulekile ekwakhiweni kwamaprotheni, kanye 4) i-DNA yokugcina nokudlulisa ulwazi oluzuzwe njengefa.

 Ama-Prokaryotes angaba nodonga lweseli olusebenza njengengqimba eyengeziwe yokuvikela endaweni engaphandle. Igama elithi prokaryote “lisho ngaphambi kwe-nucleus,” futhi ama-prokaryotes awanawo ama-nuclei. Kunalokho, i-DNA yawo ikhona njenge-chromosome eyodwa eyindilinga engxenyeni ephakathi yeseli ebizwa ngokuthi i-nucleoid. Amanye amangqamuzana ebhaktheriya nawo ane-plasmid ye-DNA eyindilinga evame ukuthwala izakhi zofuzo zokumelana nama-antibiotic (Isahluko 17). Ezinye izici ezivamile zamaseli e-prokaryotic zifaka phakathi i-flagella ne-pili.

 Okuqukethwe okuvezwe kulesi sigaba kusekela izinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 1 kanye ne-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® zihlanganisa okuqukethwe kolwazi olubalulekile nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yeSayensi eyisikhombisa. Lezi zinhloso zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho kwelebhu okusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.D

6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwe ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.7 Umfundi uzokwazi ukuchaza ukuthi ubukhulu bamaseli kanye nokwakheka kwawo kuthinta kanjani izinga lokudla kwezakhamzimba kanye nezinga lokususwa kwemfucuza.

 Amaseli awela kwesinye sezigaba ezimbili ezibanzi: i-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic. Izidalwa eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa kuphela ezitholakala ezindaweni ezithile. Ama-Bacteria kanye ne-Archaea ahlukaniswa njengama-prokaryotes (pro- = ngaphambi”; -kary- = nucleus). Amaseli ezilwane, izitshalo, isikhunta, kanye nama-protist wonke angama-eukaryotes (eu- = true”) futhi ane-nucleus.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.2 Amaseli e-Prokaryotic | Izingxenye Zamaseli e-Prokaryotic
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.2 Amaseli e-Prokaryotic | Izingxenye Zamaseli e-Prokaryotic
chapterContent:
Wonke amaseli abelana ngezingxenye ezine ezifanayo: 1) i-plasma membrane, isembozo sangaphandle esihlukanisa ingaphakathi leseli nendawo elizungezile; 2) i-cytoplasm, equkethe i-cytosol efana ne-jelly ngaphakathi kweseli lapho kutholakala khona ezinye izingxenye zamaseli; 3) i-DNA, izinto zofuzo zeseli; kanye no-4) ama-ribosome, akhiqiza amaprotheni. Kodwa-ke, ama-prokaryotes ahlukile kumaseli e-eukaryotic ngezindlela eziningana.

 I-prokaryote iyisidalwa esilula, esineseli elilodwa (iseli elilodwa) esingenayo i-nucleus, noma enye i-organelle eboshwe yi-membrane. Sizobona maduze ukuthi lokhu kuhluke kakhulu kuma-eukaryotes. I-Prokaryotic DNA itholakala engxenyeni ephakathi yeseli: i-nucleoid (Isithombe 4.5).

 Amabhaktheriya amaningi anodonga lweseli le-peptidoglycan futhi amaningi ane-capsule ye-polysaccharide (Isithombe 4.5). Udonga lweseli lusebenza njengengqimba eyengeziwe yokuvikela, lusiza iseli ukugcina isimo salo, futhi luvimbele ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni. I-capsule ivumela iseli ukuthi linamathele ezindaweni ezikuyo. Amanye ama-prokaryotes ane-flagella, i-pili, noma i-fimbriae. Ama-flagella asetshenziselwa ukuhamba. Ama-Pili asetshenziselwa ukushintshanisa izinto zofuzo ngesikhathi sohlobo lokuzala olubizwa ngokuthi i-conjugation. Ama-Fimbriae asetshenziswa amabhaktheriya ukunamathela kuseli eliyibambayo.

 Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi
Isazi sezinto ezincane kakhulu
Isenzo esiphumelela kakhulu umuntu angasithatha ukuvimbela ukusabalala kwezifo ezithelelanayo ukugeza izandla zakhe. Kungani? Ngoba amagciwane (izinto eziphilayo ezincane kakhulu kangangokuthi zingabonakala kuphela ngama-microscope) atholakala yonke indawo. Ahlala ngezibambo zomnyango, imali, izandla zakho, nezinye izindawo eziningi. Uma othile ethimula esandleni sakhe futhi athinte isibambo somnyango, bese kuthi ngemva kwalokho uthinte leso sibambo somnyango esifanayo, amagciwane avela ku-mucus womuntu othimulayo asesezandleni zakho. Uma uthinta izandla zakho emlonyeni, ekhaleni, noma emehlweni, lawo magciwane angangena emzimbeni wakho futhi angakwenza ugule.

 Kodwa-ke, akuwona wonke amagciwane (abizwa nangokuthi ama-microorganism) abangela izifo; iningi lawo empeleni linenzuzo. Une-microorganism emathunjini akho enza i-vitamin K.

 I-Microbiologists ingososayensi abafunda amagciwane. I-Microbiologists ingaphishekela imisebenzi eminingana. Abasebenzi embonini yokudla kuphela, basebenza nasemkhakheni wezilwane kanye nezokwelapha. Bangasebenza emkhakheni wezokwelapha, befeza izindima ezibalulekile ocwaningweni nasekuthuthukisweni ngokuhlonza imithombo emisha yama-antibiotic angasetshenziswa ukwelapha izifo zamagciwane.

 I-Microbiologists yemvelo ingafuna izindlela ezintsha zokusebenzisa amagciwane akhethwe ngokukhethekile noma athuthukiswe ngofuzo ukuze kususwe ukungcola emhlabathini noma emanzini angaphansi komhlaba, kanye nezinto eziyingozi ezindaweni ezingcolile. Lokhu kusetshenziswa kwamagciwane kubizwa ngokuthi ubuchwepheshe bokulungisa izifo. I-Microbiologists ingasebenza futhi emkhakheni we-bioinformatics, inikeze ulwazi olukhethekile kanye nokuqonda kokuklama, ukuthuthukiswa, kanye nokucaciswa kwamamodeli ekhompyutha, isibonelo, ubhubhane lwamagciwane.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.2 Amaseli e-Prokaryotic | Izingxenye Zamaseli e-Prokaryotic | Usayizi Weseli
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.2 Amaseli e-Prokaryotic | Izingxenye Zamaseli e-Prokaryotic | Usayizi Weseli
chapterContent:
Njengoba enobubanzi obungu-0.1 kuya ku-5.0 μm, amaseli e-prokaryotic mancane kakhulu kunamaseli e-eukaryotic, anama-dia amamitha asukela ku-10 kuya ku-100 μm (Isithombe 4.6). Usayizi omncane wama-prokaryotes uvumela ama-ion nama-molecule e-organic angena kuwo ukuthi asakazeke ngokushesha kwezinye izingxenye zeseli. Ngokufanayo, noma yikuphi ukungcola okukhiqizwa ngaphakathi kweseli le-prokaryotic kungasakazeka ngokushesha. Lokhu akunjalo kumaseli e-eukaryotic, athuthukise ukuguquguquka okuhlukile kwesakhiwo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthwa kwangaphakathi kweseli.

 Usayizi omncane, ngokuvamile, uyadingeka kuwo wonke amaseli, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yi-prokaryotic noma i-eukaryotic. Ake sihlole ukuthi kungani kunjalo. Okokuqala, sizocabangela indawo kanye nomthamo weseli elijwayelekile. Akuwona wonke amaseli anesimo esiyindilinga, kodwa amaningi avame ukulinganisa i-sphere. Ungase ukhumbule enkambweni yakho yejiyometri yesikole samabanga aphezulu ukuthi ifomula yendawo engaphezulu yesphere ingu-4πr2, kuyilapho ifomula yevolumu yayo ingu-4πr3/3. Ngakho-ke, njengoba i-radius yeseli ikhula, indawo yayo ebusweni iyanda njengesikwele se-radius yayo, kodwa ivolumu yayo iyanda njenge-cube ye-radius yayo (ngokushesha okukhulu). Ngakho-ke, njengoba iseli likhula ngobukhulu, isilinganiso sayo sendawo ebusweni kuya ku-volume siyancipha. Lesi simiso esifanayo singasebenza uma iseli linesimo se-cube (bheka lesi sithombe). Uma iseli likhula kakhulu, i-plasma membrane ngeke ibe nendawo eyanele ebusweni ukusekela izinga lokusabalala elidingekayo ukuze kube nevolumu ekhuphukile. Ngamanye amazwi, njengoba iseli likhula, liba lingasebenzi kahle. Enye indlela yokusebenza kahle kakhulu ukuhlukanisa. Ezinye izindlela ukwandisa indawo ebusweni ngokugoqa i-membrane yeseli, libe yi-flat noma libe lincane futhi lide, noma lithuthukise ama-organelle enza imisebenzi ethile. Lokhu kuguquguquka kuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwamaseli ayinkimbinkimbi abizwa ngokuthi amaseli e-eukaryotic.

 Ngaphandle kwevolumu yeseli, ubukhulu beseli bubalulekile nasekusindeni. Njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, amaseli amaningi acishe abe yindilinga ngesimo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi i-sphere iyisimo esinesilinganiso esincane kakhulu sendawo ebusweni kuya ku-volume. Njengoba izakhamzimba zisakazeka zingena esitokisini, imbulunga iwumumo lapho izakhamzimba kuzodingeka zihambe ibanga elincane ukuze zifike enkabeni. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izakhamzimba kanye nokungcola kuhlala kushintshaniswa emngceleni weseli. Uma ibanga lezi zakhamzimba kanye nokungcola kufanele lihambe lifushane, kulapho ukushintshana kwalezi zinhlayiya kushesha khona.

Amaseli e-Eukaryotic anezici eziningi ezingenazo amaseli e-prokaryotic, okuhlanganisa i-nucleus ene-membrane ephindwe kabili ehlanganisa i-DNA. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaseli e-eukaryotic avame ukuba makhulu futhi anezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-organelle aboshwe yi-membrane enza imisebenzi ethile, ehlukaniswe ngezigaba. Ubufakazi busekela umbono wokuthi amaseli e-eukaryotic kungenzeka ukuthi avele kokhokho be-prokaryotic; isibonelo, ama-mitochondria nama-chloroplast anezici zama-prokaryotes aphila ngokuzimela. Amaseli e-Eukaryotic afika ngazo zonke izinhlobo, ubukhulu, nezinhlobo (isib. amaseli ezilwane, amaseli ezitshalo, nezinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli emzimbeni). (Icebiso: Lesi yisibonelo esingavamile lapho kufanele udale uhlu lwama-organelle nemisebenzi yawo ngoba kamuva uzogxila endleleni ama-organelle ahlukahlukene asebenza ngayo ndawonye, njengoba izitho zomzimba wakho zisebenza ndawonye ukuze uhlale uphilile.) Njengama-prokaryotes, wonke amaseli e-eukaryotic ane-membrane ye-plasma, i-cytoplasm, i-ribosomes, ne-DNA. Ama-organelle amaningi aboshwe yizinhlayiya ezakhiwe yizingqimba ze-phospholipid ezifakwe amaprotheni ukuze zihlukanise imisebenzi efana nokugcinwa kwama-enzyme e-hydrolytic kanye nokwakheka kwamaprotheni. I-nucleus igcina i-DNA, kanti i-nucleolus engaphakathi kwe-nucleus iyindawo yokuhlangana kwe-ribosome. Ama-ribosome asebenzayo atholakala ekhululekile kwi-cytoplasm noma enamathele kwi-rough endoplasmic reticulum lapho enza khona ukwakheka kwamaprotheni. I-Golgi apparatus ithola, iguqule, futhi ipakishe ama-molecule amancane afana nama-lipid namaprotheni ukuze asatshalaliswe. Ama-Mitochondria nama-chloroplast ahlanganyela ekubanjweni kwamandla mahhala futhi adlulisele ezinqubweni zokuphefumula kwamaseli kanye ne-photosynthesis, ngokulandelana. Ama-Peroxisomes axuba ama-fatty acid nama-amino acid, futhi ahlonyiselwe ukuphula i-hydrogen peroxide eyakhiwe kulezi zindlela ngaphandle kokuyivumela ingene kwi-cytoplasm lapho ingabangela khona umonakalo. Ama-Vesicles nama-vacuoles agcina izinto, futhi kumaseli ezitshalo, i-central vacuole igcina imibala, usawoti, amaminerali, izakhamzimba, amaprotheni, nama-enzyme okubola futhi isiza ukugcina ukuqina. Ngokuphambene nalokho, amangqamuzana ezilwane anama-centrosome nama-lysosome kodwa awanazo izindonga zamaseli.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 1, Big Idea 2, kanye no-Big Idea 4 wohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi olusekelwe ebholeni lokucwaninga, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

Inhloso Enkulu 4

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A

 Wake wezwa ifomu lesisho lilandela umsebenzi?” Kuyifilosofi esetshenziswa ezimbonini eziningi. Ekwakhiweni kwezakhiwo, lokhu kusho ukuthi izakhiwo kufanele zakhiwe ukuze kusekelwe imisebenzi ezokwenziwa ngaphakathi kwazo. Isibonelo, i-skyscraper kufanele yakhiwe ngamabhange amaningana e-lifti; isibhedlela kufanele sakhiwe ukuze igumbi laso eliphuthumayo lifinyeleleke kalula.

 Umhlaba wethu wemvelo uphinde usebenzise isimiso somsebenzi olandela ifomu, ikakhulukazi ku-biology yamaseli, futhi lokhu kuzocaca njengoba sihlola amaseli e-eukaryotic (Isithombe 4.8). Ngokungafani namaseli e-prokaryotic, amaseli e-eukaryotic ana: 1) i-nucleus eboshwe yi-membrane; 2) ama-organelle amaningi aboshwe yi-membrane njenge-endoplasmic reticulum, i-Golgi apparatus, ama-chloroplast, i-mitochondria, nezinye; kanye no-3) ama-chromosome amaningana, anomumo wenduku. Ngenxa yokuthi i-nucleus yeseli le-eukaryotic izungezwe yi-membrane, kuvame ukuthiwa ine-nucleus yangempela.” Igama elithi organelle “lisho isitho esincane,” futhi, njengoba sekushiwo kakade, ama-organelle anemisebenzi yamaseli ekhethekile, njengoba nje izitho zomzimba wakho zinemisebenzi ekhethekile.

 Kuleli qophelo, kufanele kucace kuwe ukuthi amangqamuzana e-eukaryotic anesakhiwo esiyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunamaseli e-prokaryotic. Ama-organelle avumela imisebenzi ehlukene ukuthi ihlukaniswe ezindaweni ezahlukene zeseli. Ngaphambi kokuphendukela kuma-organelle, ake siqale sihlole izingxenye ezimbili ezibalulekile zeseli: i-plasma membrane kanye ne-cytoplasm

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.3 Amaseli E-Eukaryotic | I-Plasma Membrane
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.3 Amaseli E-Eukaryotic | I-Plasma Membrane
chapterContent:
Njengama-prokaryotes, amangqamuzana e-eukaryotic ane-membrane ye-plasma (Isithombe 4.9), ungqimba lwe-phospholipid olune-protein ehlanganisiwe ehlukanisa okuqukethwe kwangaphakathi kweseli endaweni ezungezile. I-phospholipid iyi-molecule ye-lipid enezintambo ezimbili ze-fatty acid kanye neqembu eliqukethe i-phosphate. I-membrane ye-plasma ilawula ukudlula kwama-molecule e-organic, ama-ion, amanzi, kanye nomoya-mpilo angene futhi aphume eseli. Imfucuza (njenge-carbon dioxide ne-ammonia) nayo iphuma eseli ngokudlula e-membrane ye-plasma.

 Ama-membrane e-plasma amangqamuzana akhethekile ekumunceni ahlanganiswa abe yizici ezifana neminwe ezibizwa ngokuthi i-microvilli (isinye = i-microvillus); (Isithombe 4.10). Amangqamuzana anjalo avame ukutholakala egunjini elincane, isitho esimunca izakhamzimba ekudleni okugayiwe. Lesi yisibonelo esihle kakhulu somsebenzi wokulandela ifomu. Abantu abanesifo se-celiac banempendulo yamasosha omzimba ku-gluten, okuyiprotheni etholakala kukolweni, ibhali, kanye ne-rye. Impendulo yamasosha omzimba ilimaza i-microvilli, ngakho-ke, abantu abahluphekile abakwazi ukumunca izakhamzimba. Lokhu kuholela ekungondleki kahle, ukuqaqamba kwamalunga, kanye nesifo sohudo. Iziguli ezinesifo se-celiac kumele zilandele ukudla okungenagluten

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.3 Amaseli e-Eukaryotic | I-Cytoplasm
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.3 Amaseli e-Eukaryotic | I-Cytoplasm
chapterContent: I-cytoplasm iyisifunda sonke seseli esiphakathi kwe-plasma membrane kanye ne-nuclear envelope (isakhiwo esizoxoxwa ngaso kafushane). Yakhiwe ama-organelle alenga ku-cytosol efana nejeli, i-cytoskeleton, kanye namakhemikhali ahlukahlukene (Isithombe 4.8). Ngisho noma i-cytoplasm inamanzi angamaphesenti angu-70 kuya kwangu-80, inokuvumelana okuqinile, okuvela kumaprotheni angaphakathi kwayo. Kodwa-ke, amaprotheni akuwona wodwa ama-molecule e-organic atholakala ku-cytoplasm. I-glucose kanye nezinye ushukela ezilula, ama-polysaccharides, ama-amino acid, ama-nucleic acid, ama-fatty acid, kanye nama-derivatives e-glycerol nawo atholakala lapho. Ama-ion e-sodium, i-potassium, i-calcium, nezinye izinto eziningi nawo ayancibilika ku-cytoplasm. Ukusabela okuningi kwe-metabolic, okuhlanganisa ukwakheka kwamaprotheni, kwenzeka ku-cytoplasm

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.3 Amaseli E-Eukaryotic | I-Nucleus
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.3 Amaseli E-Eukaryotic | I-Nucleus
chapterContent:
Ngokuvamile, i-nucleus iyi-organelle evelele kakhulu esitokisini (Isithombe 4.8). I-nucleus (ubuningi = i-nuclei) igcina i-DNA yeseli futhi iqondisa ukwenziwa kwama-ribosome namaprotheni. Ake sikubheke ngokuningiliziwe (Isithombe 4.11).

 I-Nuclear Envelope
I-nuclear envelope iyisakhiwo esine-membrane ephindwe kabili esakha ingxenye engaphandle kakhulu ye-nucleus (Isithombe 4.11). Kokubili i-membrane yangaphakathi neyangaphandle ye-nuclear envelope iyizingqimba ezimbili ze-phospholipid.

 I-nuclear envelope inezimbobo ezilawula ukudlula kwama-ion, ama-molecule, kanye ne-RNA phakathi kwe-nucleoplasm kanye ne-cytoplasm. I-nucleoplasm iwuketshezi oluqinile ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus, lapho sithola khona i-chromatin kanye ne-nucleolus.
I-Chromatin kanye ne-Chromosomes
Ukuze uqonde i-chromatin, kuyasiza ukucabanga ngama-chromosome kuqala. Ama-chromosome ayizakhiwo ezingaphakathi kwe-nucleus ezakhiwe yi-DNA, izinto ezizuzwa njengefa. Ungase ukhumbule ukuthi kuma-prokaryotes, i-DNA ihlelwe yaba yi-chromosome eyodwa eyindilinga. Kuma-eukaryotes, ama-chromosome ayizakhiwo eziqondile. Zonke izinhlobo ze-eukaryotic zinenani elithile lama-chromosome ku-nucleus yeseli ngayinye. Isibonelo, kubantu, inombolo ye-chromosome ingu-46, kanti ezimpukaneni zezithelo, iyisishiyagalombili. Ama-chromosome abonakala kuphela futhi ahlukaniswa omunye komunye lapho iseli lilungiselela ukuhlukana. Lapho iseli lisesigabeni sokukhula nokugcinwa komjikelezo walo wokuphila, amaprotheni anamathela kuma-chromosome, futhi afana neqembu lezintambo ezingahlanganisiwe, ezihlanganisiwe. Lezi zinhlobo ze-protein-chromosome ezingahlanganisiwe zibizwa ngokuthi i-chromatin (Isithombe 4.12); i-chromatin ichaza izinto ezakha ama-chromosome kokubili lapho zifingqiwe futhi zisusiwe.

 I-Nucleolus
Sesivele sazi ukuthi i-nucleus iqondisa ukwenziwa kwama-ribosome, kodwa ikwenza kanjani lokhu? Amanye ama-chromosome anezingxenye ze-DNA ezifaka i-ribosomal RNA. Indawo emnyama ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus ebizwa ngokuthi i-nucleolus (ubuningi = i-nucleoli) ihlanganisa i-ribosomal RNA namaprotheni ahlobene ukuze kuhlanganiswe ama-subunit e-ribosomal abese ethuthwa ngemigodi ekwi-nuclear envelope aye kwi-cytoplasm.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.3 Amaseli e-Eukaryotic | Ama-Ribosome
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.3 Amaseli e-Eukaryotic | Ama-Ribosome
chapterContent:
Ama-Ribosome ayizakhiwo zamaseli ezibangela ukwakheka kwamaprotheni. Uma ebhekwa nge-microscope yama-electron, ama-ribosome avela njengamaqoqo (ama-polyribosome) noma amachashazi amancane ahamba ngokukhululeka ku-cytoplasm. Angase anamathele ohlangothini lwe-cytoplasmic lwe-plasma membrane noma ohlangothini lwe-cytoplasmic lwe-endoplasmic reticulum kanye nolwelwesi lwangaphandle lwe-nuclear envelope (Isithombe 4.8). I-electron microscopy isibonisile ukuthi ama-ribosome, ayizinhlanganisela ezinkulu zeprotheyini ne-RNA, aqukethe ama-subunit amabili, abizwa ngokufanele ngokuthi amakhulu namancane (Isithombe 4.13). Ama-Ribosome athola ama-oda awo” okwenziwa kwamaprotheni kusuka ku-nucleus lapho i-DNA iguqulwa khona ibe yi-messenger RNA (mRNA). I-mRNA iya kuma-ribosome, ahumusha ikhodi enikezwa ukulandelana kwezisekelo ze-nitrogenous ku-mRNA ibe uhlelo oluthile lwama-amino acid kuprotheni. Ama-amino acid ayizakhi zokwakha amaprotheni.

 Ngenxa yokuthi ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni kuwumsebenzi obalulekile wawo wonke amaseli (kufaka phakathi ama-enzyme, ama-hormone, ama-antibodies, ama-pigment, izingxenye zesakhiwo, kanye nama-surface receptors), ama-ribosome atholakala cishe kuwo wonke amaseli. Ama-Ribosome atholakala kakhulu kumaseli akhiqiza inani elikhulu lamaprotheni. Isibonelo, i-pancreas inesibopho sokudala ama-enzyme amaningana okugaya ukudla futhi amaseli akhiqiza la ma-enzyme aqukethe ama-ribosome amaningi. Ngakho-ke, sibona esinye isibonelo somsebenzi olandela ifomu.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.3 Amaseli e-Eukaryotic | I-Mitochondria
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.3 Amaseli e-Eukaryotic | I-Mitochondria
chapterContent:
I-Mitochondria (eyodwa = i-mitochondrion) ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "izindawo zamandla"noma izimboni zamandla "zamangqamuzana ezitshalo nezilwane ngoba zinesibopho sokwenza i-adenosine triphosphate (ATP), i-molecule eyinhloko ethwala amandla yeseli. I-ATP imelela amandla agcinwe isikhathi esifushane eseli. Ukuphefumula kwamaseli yinqubo yokwenza i-ATP kusetshenziswa amandla amakhemikhali atholakala ku-glucose nakwezinye izakhamzimba. Ku-mitochondria, le nqubo isebenzisa umoya-mpilo futhi ikhiqiza i-carbon dioxide njengomkhiqizo ongcolile. Eqinisweni, i-carbon dioxide oyikhipha ngokuphefumula ngakunye ivela ekuphenduleni kwamaseli okukhiqiza i-carbon dioxide njengomkhiqizo olandelanayo.

 Ngokuhambisana nesihloko sethu somsebenzi olandela ifomu, kubalulekile ukuveza ukuthi amaseli emisipha anokuhlushwa okuphezulu kakhulu kwe-mitochondria okukhiqiza i-ATP. Amaseli akho emisipha adinga amandla amaningi ukugcina umzimba wakho uhamba. Uma amaseli akho engatholi umoya-mpilo owanele, awakhi i-ATP eningi. Esikhundleni salokho, inani elincane le-ATP alenzayo lapho kungekho umoya-mpilo lihambisana nokukhiqizwa kwe-lactic acid.

 Ama-Mitochondria angama-organelle amise okweqanda, ane-membrane ephindwe kabili (Isithombe 4.14) anama-ribosome awo kanye ne-DNA. I-membrane ngayinye iyi-phospholipid bilayer ehlanganiswe namaprotheni. Ingqimba yangaphakathi inama-fold abizwa ngokuthi ama-cristae. Indawo ezungezwe ama-fold ibizwa ngokuthi i-mitochondrial matrix. I-cristae kanye ne-matrix zinendima ezahlukene ekuphefumuleni kwamaseli.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.3 Amaseli E-Eukaryotic | Amaseli Ezilwane Uma kuqhathaniswa namaseli Ezitshalo
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.3 Amaseli E-Eukaryotic | Amaseli Ezilwane Uma kuqhathaniswa namaseli Ezitshalo
chapterContent:
Kuleli qophelo, uyazi ukuthi iseli ngalinye le-eukaryotic line-plasma membrane, i-cytoplasm, i-nucleus, ama-ribosome, i-mitochondria, ama-peroxisome, kanti kwamanye, ama-vacuole, kodwa kukhona umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwamaseli ezilwane nezitshalo. Ngenkathi womabili amaseli ezilwane nezitshalo enezikhungo zokuhlela ama-microtubule (ama-MTOC), amaseli ezilwane nawo ane-centrioles ahlotshaniswa ne-MTOC: i-complex ebizwa ngokuthi i-centrosome. Amaseli ezilwane ngalinye line-centrosome kanye ne-lysosomes, kanti iningi lamaseli ezitshalo alinawo. Amaseli ezitshalo anodonga lweseli, ama-chloroplast kanye namanye ama-plastid akhethekile, kanye ne-vacuole enkulu ephakathi, kanti amaseli ezilwane awanawo.

 I-Centrosome
I-centrosome iyisikhungo sokuhlela ama-microtubule esitholakala eduze kwe-nuclei yamaseli ezilwane. Iqukethe ama-centrioles amabili, izakhiwo ezimbili eziqondene (Isithombe 4.15). I-centriole ngayinye iyisilinda sama-microtubule amathathu ayisishiyagalolunye.

 I-centrosome (i-organelle lapho wonke ama-microtubule avela khona) iyaziphindaphinda ngaphambi kokuba iseli lihlukane, futhi ama-centrioles abonakala enendima ethile ekudonseni ama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe emaphethelweni ahlukene eseli elihlukanisayo. Kodwa-ke, umsebenzi oqondile wama-centrioles ekuhlukanisweni kweseli awucaci, ngoba amaseli asuswe i-centrosome asengahlukana, kanti amaseli ezitshalo, angenayo ama-centrosome, ayakwazi ukuhlukana kweseli.

 Ama-Lysosome
 Amaseli ezilwane anelinye isethi lama-organelle angatholakali kumaseli amaningi ezitshalo: ama-lysosome. Ama-lysosome ayizindawo zokulahla udoti zeseli. Kumaseli ezitshalo, izinqubo zokugaya ukudla zenzeka kuma-vacuoles. Ama-enzyme angaphakathi kwama-lysosome asiza ukuwohloka kwamaprotheni, ama-polysaccharides, ama-lipid, ama-nucleic acid, ngisho nama-organelle agugile. Lawa ma-enzyme asebenza nge-pH ephansi kakhulu kuneye-cytoplasm. Ngakho-ke, i-pH engaphakathi kwama-lysosomes ine-acid kakhulu kune-pH ye-cytoplasm. Ukusabela okuningi okwenzeka ku-cytoplasm akunakwenzeka nge-pH ephansi, ngakho-ke futhi, inzuzo yokuhlukanisa iseli le-eukaryotic libe ama-organelle iyabonakala.

 Udonga Lweseli
Uma uhlola Umfanekiso 4.8b, umdwebo weseli lesitshalo, uzobona isakhiwo esingaphandle kwe-plasma membrane esibizwa ngokuthi udonga lweseli. Udonga lweseli luyisimbozo esiqinile esivikela iseli, sinikeze ukwesekwa kwesakhiwo, futhi sinikeze iseli ukuma. Amaseli e-fungal kanye nama-protistan nawo anezindonga zeseli. Ngenkathi ingxenye eyinhloko yezindonga zeseli le-prokaryotic yi-peptidoglycan, i-molecule enkulu ye-organic odongeni lweseli lesitshalo yi-cellulose (Isithombe 4.16), i-polysaccharide eyakhiwe ngamayunithi e-glucose. Wake waphawula ukuthi uma uluma imifino eluhlaza, njenge-celery, iyaklwebheka? Lokho kungenxa yokuthi udabula izindonga zamaseli eziqinile zamaseli e-celery ngamazinyo akho.

 Ama-Chloroplast
Njenge-mitochondria, ama-chloroplast ane-DNA nama-ribosome awo, kodwa ama-chloroplast anomsebenzi ohluke ngokuphelele. Ama-chloroplast angama-organelles eseli lesitshalo enza i-photosynthesis. I-Photosynthesis uchungechunge lwezindlela zokusabela ezisebenzisa i-carbon dioxide, amanzi, namandla okukhanya ukwenza i-glucose nomoya-mpilo. Lona umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwezitshalo nezilwane; izitshalo (ama-autotrophs) ziyakwazi ukuzenzela ukudla kwazo, njengoshukela osetshenziswa ekuphefumuleni kwamaseli ukuhlinzeka ngamandla e-ATP akhiqizwa kwi-mitochondria yesitshalo. Izilwane (ama-heterotrophs) kumele zidle ukudla kwazo.

 Njenge-mitochondria, ama-chloroplast anezingqimba zangaphandle nezangaphakathi, kodwa ngaphakathi kwesikhala esivalwe yi-membrane yangaphakathi ye-chloroplast kukhona isethi ye-membrane exhunyiwe futhi ehlanganisiwe egcwele uketshezi. amasaka abizwa ngokuthi ama-thylakoids (Isithombe 4.17). Inqwaba ngayinye yama-thylakoids ibizwa ngokuthi i-granum (ubuningi = i-grana). Uketshezi oluvalwe yi-membrane yangaphakathi ezungeze i-grana lubizwa ngokuthi i-stroma.

 Ama-chloroplast aqukethe i-pigment eluhlaza ebizwa ngokuthi i-chlorophyll, ebamba amandla okukhanya aqhuba ukusabela kwe-photosynthesis. Njengamaseli ezitshalo, ama-photosynthetic protists nawo anama-chloroplast. Amanye amabhaktheriya enza i-photosynthesis, kodwa i-chlorophyll yawo ayifakwanga ku-organelle.

 Ukuxhumana Kwezimo Eziphilayo
I-Endosymbiosis
Sishilo ukuthi kokubili ama-mitochondria nama-chloroplast aqukethe i-DNA nama-ribosome. Wake wazibuza ukuthi kungani? Ubufakazi obuqinile bukhomba i-endosymbiosis njengencazelo.

 I-Symbiosis yinoma yiluphi uhlobo lobuhlobo obuseduze nobesikhathi eside phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezimbili ezivela ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene ezincike komunye nomunye ukuze zisinde. Kwezinye izimo zombili izinto eziphilayo ziyazuza ebuhlotsheni. I-Endosymbiosis (endo- = ngaphakathi") iyi- ubudlelwano obuzuzisayo obubili lapho into eyodwa ihlala khona ngaphakathi kwenye. Ubudlelwano be-endosymbiotic buningi emvelweni. Sesivele sishilo ukuthi amagciwane akhiqiza i-vitamin K ahlala ngaphakathi kwamathumbu omuntu. Lobu budlelwano buyasiza kithi ngoba asikwazi ukukhiqiza i-vitamin K. Busiza futhi kumagciwane ngoba avikelwe kwezinye izinto eziphilayo futhi ekomeni, futhi athola ukudla okuningi okuvela endaweni yamathumbu amakhulu.

 Ososayensi sebenesikhathi eside beqaphela ukuthi amagciwane, i-mitochondria, nama-chloroplast afana ngobukhulu. Siyazi futhi ukuthi amagciwane ane-DNA nama-ribosome, njengoba nje kwenza i-mitochondria nama-chloroplast. Ososayensi bakholelwa ukuthi amangqamuzana amukelayo namabhaktheriya akha ubudlelwano be-endosymbiotic lapho amangqamuzana amukelayo edla amagciwane e-aerobic kanye ne-autotrophic (cyanobacteria) kodwa awazange awabhubhise. Eminyakeni eyizigidi eziningi yokuziphendukela kwemvelo, la mabhaktheriya amukelayo aba ngochwepheshe emisebenzini yawo, lapho amagciwane e-aerobic eba yi-mitochondria kanti amagciwane e-autotrophic aba yi-chloroplasts.

 I-Central Vacuole
Ngaphambilini, sikhulume ngama-vacuole njengezingxenye ezibalulekile zamaseli ezitshalo. Uma ubheka uMfanekiso 4.8b, uzobona ukuthi amangqamuzana ezitshalo ngalinye ane-vacuole enkulu ephakathi ethatha iningi lamangqamuzana. I-vacuole ephakathi idlala indima ebalulekile ekulawuleni ukuhlushwa kwamanzi kweseli ezimweni zemvelo ezishintshayo. Wake waphawula ukuthi uma ukhohlwa ukunisela isitshalo izinsuku ezimbalwa, siyabuna? Lokho kungenxa yokuthi njengoba ukuhlushwa kwamanzi enhlabathini kuba phansi kunokuhlushwa kwamanzi esitshalweni, amanzi ayaphuma kuma-vacuole aphakathi kanye ne-cytoplasm. Njengoba i-vacuole ephakathi incipha, ishiya udonga lweseli lungasekelwa. Lokhu kulahlekelwa ukwesekwa ezindongeni zeseli zamaseli ezitshalo kuholela ekubukekeni okubunayo kwesitshalo.

 I-vacuole ephakathi nayo isekela ukwanda kweseli. Lapho i-vacuole ephakathi ibamba amanzi amaningi, iseli liyakhula ngaphandle kokutshala amandla amaningi ekwakheni i-cytoplasm entsha.

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.4 Uhlelo Lwe-Endomembrane Namaprotheni | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ngaphezu kokuba khona kwama-nuclei, amaseli e-eukaryotic ahlukaniswa ngohlelo lwe-endomembrane oluhlanganisa i-plasma membrane, i-nuclear envelope, ama-lysosome, ama-vesicle, i-endoplasmic reticulum, kanye ne-Golgi apparatus. Lezi zingxenye ezingaphansi kweseli zisebenza ndawonye ukuguqula, ukufaka amathegi, ukupakisha, kanye nokuthutha amaprotheni nama-lipid. I-rough endoplasmic reticulum (RER) enama-ribosome ayo anamathiselwe yindawo yokwenziwa nokuguqulwa kwamaprotheni. I-smooth endoplasmic reticulum (SER) ihlanganisa ama-carbohydrate, ama-lipid afaka phakathi ama-phospholipid kanye ne-cholesterol, kanye nama-steroid hormone; ihileleka ekususeni ubuthi emithini kanye nobuthi; futhi igcina ama-calcium ions. Ama-Lysosome agaya ama-macromolecule, aphinde asebenzise ama-organelle agugile, futhi abhubhise amagciwane. Njengoba nje umzimba wakho usebenzisa izitho ezahlukene ezisebenza ndawonye, amaseli asebenzisa la ma-organelle asebenzisana ukwenza imisebenzi ethile. Isibonelo, amaprotheni akhiqizwa ku-RER abese ehamba aye ku-Golgi apparatus ukuze aguqulwe futhi apakishwe ukuze agcinwe noma athuthwe. Uma lawa maprotheni angama-enzyme e-hydrolytic, angagcinwa kuma-lysosome. Ama-Mitochondria akhiqiza amandla adingekayo kulezi zinqubo. Lokhu kugeleza okusebenzayo kuma-organelle amaningana, inqubo encike emandleni akhiqizwa enye i-organelle, kusebenza njengomfanekiso ophawulekayo wokuthembela okuyinkimbinkimbi kweseli, okuxhumene kuma-organelle alo.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni imiqondo yokusekela kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye no-Big Idea 4 wohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso Enkulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo wokwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.B
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla kudinga ukuthi amaseli adale futhi alondoloze izindawo zangaphakathi ezihlukile ezindaweni zawo zangaphandle.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.B.3 Amaseli e-Eukaryotic agcina ulwelwesi lwangaphakathi oluhlukanisa iseli ezindaweni ezikhethekile.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.13 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi ulwelwesi lwangaphakathi kanye nama-organelles anikela kanjani emisebenzini yamaseli.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

4.A.2 Isakhiwo nomsebenzi wezingxenye ezingaphansi kweseli, kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo, kuhlinzeka ngezinqubo ezibalulekile zamaseli.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.4 Uhlelo Lwe-Endomembrane Namaprotheni | I-Endoplasmic Reticulum
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.4 Uhlelo Lwe-Endomembrane Namaprotheni | I-Endoplasmic Reticulum
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lwe-endomembrane (endo = ngaphakathi”) luyiqembu lama-membrane nama-organelle (Isithombe 4.18) kumaseli e-eukaryotic asebenza ndawonye ukuguqula, ukupakisha, nokuthutha ama-lipid namaprotheni. Luhlanganisa i-nuclear envelope, ama-lysosome, nama-vesicle, esesivele siwashilo, kanye ne-endoplasmic reticulum kanye ne-Golgi apparatus, esizoyixoxa maduze. Nakuba ingekho ngaphakathi kweseli, i-plasma membrane ifakiwe ohlelweni lwe-endomembrane ngoba, njengoba uzobona, isebenzisana namanye ama-organelle e-endomembrane. Uhlelo lwe-endomembrane alufaki ama-membrane e-mitochondria noma ama-chloroplast.

 I-endoplasmic reticulum (ER) (Isithombe 4.18) uchungechunge lwama-membrane sacs nama-tubules axhumene aguqula amaprotheni futhi ahlanganise ama-lipid. Kodwa-ke, le misebenzi emibili yenziwa ezindaweni ezihlukene ze-ER: i-rough ER kanye ne-smooth ER, ngokulandelana.

 Ingxenye engenalutho yama-tubules e-ER ibizwa ngokuthi i-lumen noma isikhala se-cineral. I-membrane ye-ER, okuyi-bilayer ye-phospholipid ehlanganiswe namaprotheni, iqhubeka ne-nuclear envelope.

 I-Rough ER
I-rough endoplasmic reticulum (RER) ibizwa kanjalo ngoba ama-ribosome anamathele ebusweni bayo be-cytoplasmic ayinika ukubukeka okugcwele lapho ibukwa nge-electron microscope (Isithombe 4.19).

 Ama-Ribosome adlulisela amaprotheni awo asanda kuhlanganiswa ku-lumen ye-RER lapho eguqulwa khona ngokwesakhiwo, njengokugoqwa noma ukutholwa kwamaketanga aseceleni. Lawa maprotheni aguquliwe azofakwa kuma-membrane eseli—i-membrane ye-ER noma yamanye ama-organelle—noma akhishwe esitokisini (njengama-hormone e-protein, ama-enzyme). I-RER iphinde yenze ama-phospholipid ama-membrane eseli.

 Uma ama-phospholipid noma amaprotheni aguquliwe engekho Njengoba zihloselwe ukuhlala ku-RER, zizofika lapho ziya khona ngama-vesicle okuthutha ahluma kusuka kulwelwesi lwe-RER (Isithombe 4.18).

 Njengoba i-RER ibandakanyeka ekuguquleni amaprotheni (njenge-enzyme, isibonelo) azokhishwa esitokisini, ubungaba ulungile uma ucabanga ukuthi i-RER inamangqamuzana amaningi akhipha amaprotheni. Lokhu kunjalo ngamaseli esibindi, isibonelo.

 I-Smooth ER
I-smooth endoplasmic reticulum (SER) iyaqhubeka ne-RER kodwa inama-ribosome ambalwa noma awanawo nhlobo ebusweni bayo be-cytoplasmic (Isithombe 4.18). Imisebenzi ye-SER ifaka phakathi ukwenziwa kwama-carbohydrate, ama-lipid, nama-hormone e-steroid; ukukhishwa kwemithi kanye nobuthi; kanye nokugcinwa kwama-ion e-calcium.

 Emaseli emisipha, i-SER ekhethekile ebizwa ngokuthi i-sarcoplasmic reticulum inesibopho sokugcina ama-ion e-calcium adingekayo ukuze kuqale ukufinyela okuhlelekile kwemisipha. amaseli.

 Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi
Udokotela Wenhliziyo
Isifo senhliziyo siyimbangela ehamba phambili yokufa e-United States. Lokhu kungenxa kakhulu yokuphila kwethu kokungahlali phansi kanye nokudla kwethu okunamafutha amaningi.

 Ukwehluleka kwenhliziyo kungenye yezinkinga eziningi zenhliziyo ezikhubazayo. Ukwehluleka kwenhliziyo akusho ukuthi inhliziyo iyeke ukusebenza. Kunalokho, kusho ukuthi inhliziyo ayikwazi ukupompa ngamandla anele ukuthutha igazi elinomoya-mpilo kuzo zonke izitho ezibalulekile. Uma kungalashwa, ukwehluleka kwenhliziyo kungaholela ekuhlulekeni kwezinso kanye nokwehluleka kwezinye izitho.

 Udonga lwenhliziyo lwakhiwe izicubu zemisipha yenhliziyo. Ukwehluleka kwenhliziyo kwenzeka lapho i-endoplasmic reticula yamaseli emisipha yenhliziyo ingasebenzi kahle. Ngenxa yalokho, inani elanele lama-calcium ion atholakalayo ukuze kubangele amandla anele okubopha.

 Odokotela benhliziyo (inhliziyo- = inhliziyo”; -udokotela = umuntu ofundayo”) bangodokotela abangochwepheshe ekwelapheni izifo zenhliziyo, okuhlanganisa nokwehluleka kwenhliziyo. Odokotela benhliziyo bangenza ukuxilongwa kokwehluleka kwenhliziyo ngokomzimba ukuhlolwa, imiphumela ye-electrocardiogram (ECG, ukuhlolwa okulinganisa umsebenzi kagesi wenhliziyo), i-X-ray yesifuba ukuze kubonakale ukuthi inhliziyo ikhulisiwe yini, kanye nezinye izivivinyo. Uma kutholakala ukuthi inhliziyo ayisebenzi kahle, udokotela wenhliziyo uzovame ukunikeza imithi efanele futhi ancome ukunciphisa usawoti odliwayo etafuleni kanye nohlelo lokuzivocavoca oluqondisiwe.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.4 Uhlelo Lwe-Endomembrane Namaprotheni | I-Golgi Apparatus
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Ukwakheka Kweseli | 4.4 Uhlelo Lwe-Endomembrane Namaprotheni | I-Golgi Apparatus
chapterContent:
Sesivele sishilo ukuthi ama-vesicle angahluma kusuka ku-ER futhi athuthe okuqukethwe kwawo kwenye indawo, kodwa ayaphi ama-vesicle? Ngaphambi kokufika lapho eya khona ekugcineni, ama-lipid noma amaprotheni angaphakathi kwama-vesicle okuthutha kusadingeka ahlungwe, apakishwe, futhi afakwe amathegi ukuze agcine endaweni efanele. Ukuhlunga, ukumaka, ukupakisha, kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwama-lipid namaprotheni kwenzeka ku-Golgi apparatus (ebizwa nangokuthi umzimba we-Golgi), uchungechunge lwama-membrane acwebezelayo (Isithombe 4.20).

 Uhlangothi olwamukelayo lwe-Golgi apparatus lubizwa ngokuthi ubuso be-cis. Uhlangothi oluphambene lubizwa ngokuthi ubuso be-trans. Ama-vesicle okuthutha akhiwe kusuka ku-ER aya ebusweni be-cis, ahlangane nawo, futhi athulule okuqukethwe kwawo ku-lumen ye-Golgi apparatus. Njengoba amaprotheni nama-lipid ehamba nge-Golgi, enza izinguquko ezengeziwe ezivumela ukuthi ahlungwe. Ukuguqulwa okuvame kakhulu ukwengezwa kwamaketanga amafushane ama-molecule kashukela. Lawa maprotheni nama-lipid asanda kuguqulwa abese ebekwa amathegi ngamaqembu e-phosphate noma amanye ama-molecule amancane ukuze akwazi ukuyiswa ezindaweni zawo ezifanele.

 Okokugcina, amaprotheni aguquliwe futhi abekwe amathegi afakwa kuma-vesicle ayimfihlo ahluma ebusweni be-trans ye-Golgi. Ngenkathi amanye ala ma-vesicle efaka okuqukethwe kwawo kwezinye izingxenye zeseli lapho azosetshenziswa khona, amanye ama-vesicle ayimfihlo ahlangana ne-plasma membrane futhi akhiphe okuqukethwe kwawo ngaphandle kweseli.

 Kwesinye isibonelo somsebenzi olandela ifomu, amangqamuzana ahlanganyela emsebenzini omkhulu wobumfihlo (njengamaseli ezindlala zamathe akhipha ama-enzyme okugaya ukudla noma amangqamuzana esimiso somzimba sokuzivikela akhipha ama-antibodies) anenqwaba ye-Golgi.

 Emaseli ezitshalo, idivayisi ye-Golgi inendima eyengeziwe yokwenza ama-polysaccharides, amanye awo afakwa odongeni lweseli kanti amanye awo asetshenziswa kwezinye izingxenye zeseli.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.4 Uhlelo Lwe-Endomembrane Namaprotheni | Ama-Lysosome
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.4 Uhlelo Lwe-Endomembrane Namaprotheni | Ama-Lysosome
chapterContent: Ngaphezu kwendima yawo njengengxenye yokugaya ukudla kanye nesikhungo sokuvuselela amaseli ezilwane, ama-lysosome abhekwa njengezingxenye zesistimu ye-endomembrane. Ama-lysosome asebenzisa nama-enzyme awo e-hydrolytic ukubhubhisa amagciwane (izinto eziphilayo ezibangela izifo) ezingase zingene esitokisini. Isibonelo esihle salokhu senzeka eqenjini lamangqamuzana amhlophe egazi abizwa ngokuthi ama-macrophage, ayingxenye yesistimu yomzimba wakho yokuzivikela. Enqubweni eyaziwa ngokuthi i-phagocytosis noma i-endocytosis, ingxenye ye-plasma membrane ye-macrophage iyangena (igoqeka) bese igwinya i-pathogen. Ingxenye engene ngaphakathi, ene-pathogen ngaphakathi, bese izincinza kusuka ku-plasma membrane bese iba yi-vesicle. I-vesicle ihlangana ne-lysosome. Ama-enzyme e-hydrolytic e-lysosome abe esebhubhisa i-pathogen (Isithombe 4.21)

distractor1b: Bakhiqiza i-ATP ukuze banike amandla amangqamuzana omzimba
distractor1c: Bafaka ama-pathogen ukuze akhishwe ngaphandle kweseli

distractor3c: Idivayisi yeGolgi iguqula igciwane libe amaprotheni

answer5: Ziyi-organelles eziboshwe nge-membrane ezisebenzisana nama-vesicles ukuze zigaye izinto futhi ziphinde zisebenzise izingxenye zamaseli
distractor5a: Ziqukethe i-DNA kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwamaprotheni okuqondile

answer6: I-vesicle eboshwe nge-membrane equkethe i-pathogen

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.5 I-Cytoskeleton | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.5 I-Cytoskeleton | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Wonke amaseli, kusukela kubhaktheriya olula kuya kuma-eukaryotes ayinkimbinkimbi, ane-cytoskeleton eyakhiwe ngezinhlobo ezahlukene zezinto zamaprotheni, okuhlanganisa ama-microfilaments, ama-filaments aphakathi nendawo, nama-microtubules. I-cytoskeleton isebenza ngezinhloso ezahlukahlukene: inikeza ukuqina kanye nesimo kuseli, yenza kube lula ukunyakaza kweseli, iqinise i-nucleus kanye nezinye i-organelles endaweni yayo, ihambisa ama-vesicles kuseli, futhi idonsa ama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe ezigxotsheni zeseli elihlukanisayo. Lezi zinto zamaprotheni nazo zibalulekile ekuhambeni kwama-centrioles, i-flagella, kanye ne-cilia.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 1 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP Biology, njengoba kuboniswe kuthebula elingezansi.

 Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa ye-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka kanye nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.B
Izinto eziphilayo zixhunyaniswe yimigqa yokuzalwa okuvela kubazali abavamile

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.B.1 Izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezinqubo eziningi eziyinhloko ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezavela futhi zasakazeka kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo namuhla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezizinda ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuqhubekayo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza izibonelo ezithile zezinqubo zezinto eziphilayo ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezabiwe yizo zonke izizinda noma ngaphakathi kwesizinda esisodwa sokuphila nokuthi lezi zinqubo ezihlanganisiwe, ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezisekelwe kanjani umqondo wobukhokho obuvamile bazo zonke izinto eziphilayo

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.5 I-Cytoskeleton | Ama-Microfilaments
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.5 I-Cytoskeleton | Ama-Microfilaments
chapterContent:
Uma ubungasusa wonke ama-organelle esitokisini, ingabe i-plasma membrane kanye ne-cytoplasm kuzoba yizona kuphela izingxenye ezisele? Cha. Ngaphakathi kwe-cytoplasm, bekuzoba nama-ion nama-molecule e-organic, kanye nenethiwekhi yama-protein fibers asiza ukugcina isimo seseli, ukuvikela amanye ama-organelle ezindaweni ezithile, ukuvumela i-cytoplasm nama-vesicles ukuthi ahambe ngaphakathi kweseli, futhi enze amaseli ngaphakathi kwezinto eziphilayo eziningi ukuthi ahambe. Ngokubambisana, le nethiwekhi yama-protein fibers yaziwa ngokuthi i-cytoskeleton. Kunezinhlobo ezintathu zama-fibers ngaphakathi kwe-cytoskeleton: ama-microfilaments, ama-intermediate filaments, nama-microtubules (Isithombe 4.22). Lapha, sizohlola ngayinye.

 Ezinhlotsheni ezintathu zama-protein fibers ku-cytoskeleton, ama-microfilaments yiwona amancane kakhulu. Asebenza ekunyakazeni kwamaseli, anobubanzi obungaba ngu-7 nm, futhi enziwe ngemicu emibili ehlangene ye-globular protein ebizwa ngokuthi i-actin (Isithombe 4.23). Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, ama-microfilaments aziwa nangokuthi ama-actin filaments.

 I-Actin inikwe amandla yi-ATP ukuhlanganisa isimo sayo se-filamentous, esisebenza njengendlela yokuhamba kweprotheni ye-motor ebizwa ngokuthi i-myosin. Lokhu kwenza i-actin ikwazi ukuzibandakanya ezenzakalweni zamaseli ezidinga ukunyakaza, njengokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kumaseli e-eukaryotic kanye nokusakazwa kwe-cytoplasmic, okuwukunyakaza okujikelezayo kwe-cytoplasm yeseli kumaseli ezitshalo. I-Actin ne-myosin ziningi kumaseli emisipha. Lapho imicu yakho ye-actin ne-myosin ishelelana, imisipha yakho iyafinyela.

 Ama-microfilament nawo anikeza ukuqina kanye nesimo esithile kuseli. Angasusa i-polymer (ahlukanise) futhi aguquke ngokushesha, ngaleyo ndlela enze iseli lishintshe isimo salo futhi lihambe. Amaseli amhlophe egazi (amaseli omzimba wakho alwa nokutheleleka) asebenzisa kahle leli khono. Angathuthela endaweni yokutheleleka futhi aqede i-pathogen

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.5 I-Cytoskeleton | Amafilamenti Aphakathi
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.5 I-Cytoskeleton | Amafilamenti Aphakathi
chapterContent:
Izintambo eziphakathi zenziwe ngemicu eminingana yamaprotheni ane-fibrous ahlanganiswe ndawonye (Isithombe 4.24). Lezi zakhi ze-cytoskeleton zithola igama lazo ngenxa yokuthi ububanzi bazo, obungu-8 kuya ku-10 nm, buphakathi kwalezo ze-microfilaments nama-microtubules.

 Izintambo eziphakathi azinandima ekunyakazeni kweseli. Umsebenzi wazo ungowokwakheka kuphela. Zithwala ukucindezelwa, ngaleyo ndlela zigcina isimo seseli, futhi ziqinise i-nucleus nezinye i-organelles endaweni yazo. Isithombe 4.22 sibonisa ukuthi izintambo eziphakathi zidala kanjani isikafu esisekelayo ngaphakathi kweseli.

 Izintambo eziphakathi ziyiqembu elihluke kakhulu lezinto ze-cytoskeletal. Izinhlobo eziningana zamaprotheni ane-fibrous zitholakala kuzintambo eziphakathi. Cishe ujwayelene kakhulu ne-keratin, iphrotheni ene-fibrous eqinisa izinwele zakho, izinzipho, kanye ne-epidermis yesikhumba.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.5 I-Cytoskeleton | Ama-Microtubules
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.5 I-Cytoskeleton | Ama-Microtubules
chapterContent:
Njengoba igama lawo lisho, ama-microtubules angamashubhu amancane angenalutho. Izindonga ze-microtubule zenziwe ngama-dimer e-polymerized e-α-tubulin kanye ne-β-tubulin, amaprotheni amabili agcwele (Isithombe 4.25). Njengoba enobubanzi obungaba ngu-25 nm, ama-microtubules ayizingxenye ezibanzi kakhulu ze-cytoskeleton. Asiza iseli ukumelana nokucindezelwa, ahlinzeke ngomzila lapho ama-vesicles ahamba khona ngeseli, futhi adonse ama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe emaphethelweni aphambene eseli elihlukanisayo. Njenge-microfilaments, ama-microtubules angahlakazeka futhi aguquke ngokushesha.

 Ama-Microtubules nawo ayizakhi zesakhiwo se-flagella, i-cilia, kanye ne-centrioles (ezokugcina ziyimizimba emibili eqondile ye-centrosome). Eqinisweni, kumaseli ezilwane, i-centrosome iyisikhungo sokuhlela i-microtubule. Kumaseli e-eukaryotic, i-flagella kanye ne-cilia zihluke kakhulu ngokwesakhiwo kontanga bazo kuma-prokaryotes, njengoba kuxoxwe ngezansi.

 I-Flagella ne-Cilia
Ukuze uvuselele inkumbulo yakho, i-flagella (isinye = i-flagellum) yizakhiwo ezinde, ezifana nezinwele ezisuka kulwelwesi lwe-plasma futhi zisetshenziselwa ukuhambisa iseli lonke (isibonelo, isidoda, i-Euglena). Uma ikhona, iseli line-flagellum eyodwa noma i-flagella embalwa. Uma i-cilia (isinye = i-cilium) ikhona, nokho, eziningi zazo zinwebeka kulo lonke ubuso belwelwesi lwe-plasma. Ziyizakhiwo ezimfushane, ezifana nezinwele ezisetshenziselwa ukuhambisa amaseli aphelele (njenge-paramecia) noma izinto ezingaphandle kweseli (isibonelo, i-cilia yamaseli amboze amashubhu e-Fallopian ahambisa iqanda esibelethweni, noma i-cilia emboze amaseli omgudu wokuphefumula abamba izinto ezincane bese bezihambisa emakhaleni akho.)

 Naphezu kokungafani kwazo ngobude nenani, i-flagella ne-cilia zabelana ngesakhiwo esifanayo sama-microtubules abizwa ngokuthi i-9 + 2 array.” Leli igama elifanele ngoba i-flagellum noma i-cilium eyodwa yenziwe ngendandatho yama-microtubule doublet ayisishiyagalolunye, azungeze i-microtubule doublet eyodwa phakathi nendawo (Isithombe 4.26)

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.6 Ukuxhumana Phakathi Kwamaseli Nemisebenzi Yeseli | I-Extracellular Matrix Yamaseli Ezilwane
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.6 Ukuxhumana Phakathi Kwamaseli Nemisebenzi Yeseli | I-Extracellular Matrix Yamaseli Ezilwane
chapterContent:
Iningi lamaseli ezilwane likhipha izinto ezisetshenziswayo esikhaleni esingaphandle kweseli. Izingxenye eziyinhloko zalezi zinto zingamaprotheni, kanti iphrotheni eningi kakhulu yi-collagen. Imicu ye-Collagen ihlanganiswe nama-molecule amaprotheni aqukethe ama-carbohydrate abizwa ngokuthi ama-proteoglycans. Ngokubambisana, lezi zinto zibizwa ngokuthi i-extracellular matrix (Isithombe 4.27). I-extracellular matrix ayigcini nje ngokubamba amaseli ndawonye ukuze akhe izicubu, kodwa futhi ivumela amaseli angaphakathi kwezicubu ukuthi axhumane. Lokhu kungenzeka kanjani?

 Amaseli ane-protein receptors ezindaweni ezingaphandle kweseli zama-membrane awo e-plasma. Lapho i-molecule ngaphakathi kwe-matrix ibopha kwi-receptor, ishintsha isakhiwo sama-molecule se-receptor. I-receptor, nayo, ishintsha ukwakheka kwama-microfilaments abekwe ngaphakathi kwe-plasma membrane. Lezi zinguquko zokwakheka zibangela izimpawu zamakhemikhali ngaphakathi kweseli ezifika ku-nucleus bese zivula noma zivala ukuqoshwa kwezingxenye ezithile ze-DNA, okuthinta ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni ahlobene, ngaleyo ndlela kushintsha imisebenzi ngaphakathi kweseli.

 Ukugoqa kwegazi kunikeza isibonelo sendima ye-extracellular matrix ekuxhumaneni kweseli. Uma amaseli amboze umthambo wegazi onakele, abonisa i-protein receptor ebizwa ngokuthi i-tissue factor. Uma i-tissue factor ibopha nenye i-factor ku-extracellular matrix, ibangela ukuthi ama-platelet anamathele odongeni lomthambo wegazi owonakele, ivuselele amaseli emisipha ebushelelezi eduze komthambo wegazi ukuthi anciphe (ngaleyo ndlela inciphise umthambo wegazi), futhi iqalise uchungechunge lwezinyathelo ezivuselela ama-platelet ukuthi akhiqize izinto eziqinisa ama-clotting.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.6 Ukuxhumana Phakathi Kwamaseli Nemisebenzi Yeseli | Ukuhlangana Kwamaseli
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.6 Ukuxhumana Phakathi Kwamaseli Nemisebenzi Yeseli | Ukuhlangana Kwamaseli
chapterContent:
Amaseli angaxhumana futhi ngokuxhumana okuqondile, okubizwa ngokuthi ama-intercellular junctions. Kunezinhlobo ezithile zomehluko ezindleleni amaseli ezitshalo nezilwane akwenza ngazo lokhu. Ama-Plasmodesmata ayizihlanganisi phakathi kwamaseli ezitshalo, kanti ukuxhumana kwamaseli ezilwane kuhlanganisa izihlanganisi eziqinile, izihlanganisi zegebe, kanye nama-desmosomes.

 Ama-Plasmodesmata
Ngokuvamile, ukunwebeka okude kwe-plasma membranes yamaseli ezitshalo angomakhelwane akukwazi ukuthintana ngoba ahlukaniswe udonga lweseli oluzungeze iseli ngalinye (Isithombe 4.8b). Pho-ke, isitshalo singadlulisela kanjani amanzi nezinye izakhamzimba zomhlabathi kusuka ezimpandeni zaso, ngeziqu zaso, kanye namaqabunga aso? Ukuthutha okunjalo kusebenzisa izicubu zemithambo yegazi (i-xylem kanye ne-phloem) ngokuyinhloko. Kukhona futhi ukuguqulwa kwesakhiwo okubizwa ngokuthi i-plasmodesmata (isinye = i-plasmodesma), iziteshi eziningi ezidlula phakathi kwezindonga zamaseli zamaseli ezitshalo aseduze, zixhuma i-cytoplasm yazo, futhi zenze izinto zithuthwe zisuka esitokisini ziye esitokisini, futhi ngaleyo ndlela zingene kuso sonke isitshalo (Isithombe 4.28).

 Ukuhlangana Okuqinile
Ukuhlangana okuqinile kuyisici esingenamanzi phakathi kwamaseli amabili ezilwane aseduze (Isithombe 4.29). Amaseli abambene ngokuqinile ngamaphrotheni (ikakhulukazi amaprotheni amabili abizwa ngokuthi ama-claudins nama-occludins).

 Lokhu kunamathela okuqinile kuvimbela izinto ekuvuzeni phakathi kwamaseli; ukuhlangana okuqinile kuvame ukutholakala ezicutshini ze-epithelial ezihlanganisa izitho zangaphakathi kanye nemigodi, futhi zakha iningi lesikhumba. Isibonelo, ukuhlangana okuqinile kwamaseli e-epithelial amboze isinyi sakho somchamo kuvimbela umchamo ukuthi ungaphumi uye esikhaleni esingaphandle.

 Ama-Desmosomes
Okunye okutholakala kumaseli ezilwane kuphela ama-desmosomes, asebenza njenge-spot welds phakathi kwamaseli e-epithelial aseduze (Isithombe 4.30). Amaphrotheni amafushane abizwa ngokuthi ama-cadherins ku-plasma membrane axhuma kuma-filaments aphakathi ukuze adale ama-desmosomes. Ama-cadherin ahlanganisa amaseli amabili aseduze futhi agcina amaseli ekwakhekeni okufana neshidi ezithweni nasezicutshini ezinwebekayo, njengesikhumba, inhliziyo, kanye nemisipha.

 Ama-Gap Junctions
Ama-gap junctions kumaseli ezilwane afana ne-plasmodesmata kumaseli ezitshalo ngoba ayiziteshi phakathi kwamaseli aseduze avumela ukuthuthwa kwama-ion, izakhamzimba, nezinye izinto ezivumela amaseli ukuxhumana (Isithombe 4.31). Nokho, ngokwesakhiwo, ama-gap junctions kanye ne-plasmodesmata kuyahluka.

 Ama-gap junctions akhula lapho isethi yamaprotheni ayisithupha (abizwa ngokuthi ama-connexins) ku-plasma membrane ehlela ngokwawo ngendlela ende efana ne-donut ebizwa ngokuthi i-connexon. Lapho ama-pores (imigodi ye-donut) yama-connexons kumaseli ezilwane aseduze ehlangana, kwakheka isiteshi phakathi kwamaseli amabili. Ama-gap junctions abaluleke kakhulu emisipheni yenhliziyo: Isignali kagesi yokuthi imisipha ifinyele idluliswa kahle ngama-gap junctions, okuvumela amaseli emisipha yenhliziyo ukuthi afinyele ndawonye

inkolelo-mbono yeseli
bheka inkolelo-mbono yeseli elihlanganisiwe

 udonga lweseli
isembozo seseli esiqinile esenziwe ngama-molecule ahlukahlukene avikela iseli, anikeze ukwesekwa kwesakhiwo, futhi anikeze iseli ukuma

 i-vacuole ephakathi
i-organelle enkulu yeseli yesitshalo elawula indawo yokugcina iseli, ebamba amanzi, futhi edlala indima ebalulekile ekukhuleni kweseli njengendawo yokuwohloka kwe-macromolecule

 i-centrosome
indawo emaseli ezilwaneni enziwe ngama-centrioles amabili

 i-chlorophyll
umbala oluhlaza obamba amandla okukhanya aqhuba ukusabela kokukhanya kwe-photosynthesis

 i-chloroplast
i-organelle yeseli yesitshalo eqhuba i-photosynthesis

 i-chromatin
i-protein-DNA complex esebenza njengezinto zokwakha zama-chromosome

 i-chromosome
isakhiwo ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus esakhiwe yi-chromatin equkethe i-DNA, izinto ezizuzwe njengefa

 cilium
(ubuningi = cilia) isakhiwo esifushane, esifana nezinwele esisuka ku-plasma membrane ngobuningi futhi sisetshenziselwa ukuhambisa iseli lonke noma ukuhambisa izinto ebusweni bangaphandle beseli

 i-cytoplasm
sonke isifunda esiphakathi kwe-plasma membrane kanye ne-nuclear envelope, equkethe ama-organelle alengiswe ku-cytosol efana nejeli, i-cytoskeleton, kanye namakhemikhali ahlukahlukene

 i-cytoskeleton
inethiwekhi yemicu yamaprotheni egcina ukuma kweseli ndawonye, ivikele amanye ama-organelle ezindaweni ezithile, ivumela i-cytoplasm nama-vesicles ukuthi ahambe ngaphakathi kweseli, futhi enze izinto eziphilayo zeseli elilodwa zihambe ngokuzimela

 i-cytosol
izinto ezifana nejeli ze-cytoplasm lapho izakhiwo zeseli zilengiswe khona

 i-desmosome
ukuxhumana phakathi kwamaseli e-epithelial aseduze okwakheka lapho ama-cadherins ku-plasma membrane enamathela kuma-filaments aphakathi

 i-electron microscope
ithuluzi elikhulisa into esebenzisa umsebe wama-electron adlulisiwe futhi agobile ohlelweni lwelensi ukuze abone ngeso lengqondo isampula

 uhlelo lwe-endomembrane
iqembu lama-organelles nama-membrane kumaseli e-eukaryotic asebenza ndawonye ekuguquleni, ekupakisheni, nasekuthutheni ama-lipid namaprotheni

 i-endoplasmic reticulum (ER)
uchungechunge lwezakhiwo ze-membrane ezixhumene ngaphakathi kwamaseli e-eukaryotic eziguqula ndawonye amaprotheni futhi zenze ama-lipid

 iseli le-eukaryotic
iseli eline-nucleus eboshwe yi-membrane kanye nezinye izingxenye eziningana noma ama-sacs aboshwe yi-membrane

 i-extracellular matrix
izinto (ikakhulukazi i-collagen, ama-glycoprotein, nama-proteoglycans) ezikhishwa emaseli ezilwane ezihlinzeka ngokuvikelwa komshini kanye nokubambelela kwamaseli ezicutshini

i-flagellum
 (ubuningi = i-flagella) isakhiwo eside, esifana nezinwele esisuka ku-plasma membrane futhi sisetshenziselwa ukuhambisa iseli

igebe lokuhlangana
 isiteshi phakathi kwamaseli ezilwane amabili aseduze esivumela ama-ion, izakhamzimba, kanye nezinto ezinesisindo esiphansi sama-molecule ukuthi zidlule phakathi kwamaseli, okuvumela amaseli ukuthi axhumane

I-Golgi apparatus
 i-eukaryotic organelle eyenziwe uchungechunge lwe-stacked membranes ehlela, imaka, futhi ipakishe ama-lipid namaprotheni ukuze asakazwe

i-filament ephakathi
 ingxenye ye-cytoskeletal, eyakhiwe ngemicu eminingana ehlangene yeprotheyini ye-fibrous, ethwala ukungezwani, isekela i-cell-cell junctions, futhi iqinisa amaseli ezakhiweni zangaphandle

i-microscope ekhanyayo
 ithuluzi elikhulisa into kusetshenziswa ukukhanya okubonakalayo okudlula futhi kugobe ohlelweni lwelensi ukuze kubonwe isampula

 i-lysosome
i-organelle esitokisini sesilwane esisebenza njengengxenye yokugaya yeseli; liphula amaprotheni, ama-polysaccharides, ama-lipid, ama-nucleic acid, ngisho nama-organelle agugile

 i-microfilament
isici esincane kakhulu sohlelo lwe-cytoskeleton; linikeza ukuqina nesimo kuseli futhi livumela ukunyakaza kwamaseli

 i-microscope
ithuluzi elikhulisa into

 i-microtubule
isici esibanzi kakhulu sohlelo lwe-cytoskeleton; lisiza iseli ukumelana nokucindezelwa, linikeza umzila lapho ama-vesicles ahamba khona esitokisini, lidonsa ama-chromosome aphindaphindwayo aye emaphethelweni ahlukene esitokisini esihlukanisayo, futhi liyisici sesakhiwo sama-centrioles, i-flagella, kanye ne-cilia

 i-mitochondria
(isinye = i-mitochondrion) ama-organelle eseli abhekene nokwenza ukuphefumula kwamaseli, okuholela ekukhiqizweni kwe-ATP, i-molecule eyinhloko yeseli ethwala amandla

 i-nuclear envelope
isakhiwo se-membrane esiphindwe kabili esakha ingxenye engaphandle kakhulu ye-nucleus

 i-nucleoid
ingxenye ephakathi yeseli le-prokaryotic lapho kutholakala khona i-chromosome

 i-nucleolus
umzimba onamabala amnyama ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus obhekene nokuhlanganisa ama-subunit ama-ribosome

 i-nucleoplasm
uketshezi oluqinile ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus equkethe i-chromatin ne-nucleolus
i-nucleus
i-organelle yeseli egcina i-DNA yeseli futhi iqondise ukwenziwa kwama-ribosome namaprotheni

 i-organelle
ingxenye noma isikhwama ngaphakathi kweseli

i-peroxisome
 i-organelle encane, eyindilinga equkethe i-hydrogen peroxide, i-oxidizes fatty acids nama-amino acid, futhi isuse ubuthi obuningi

i-plasma membrane
 i-phospholipid bilayer enamaprotheni ahlanganisiwe (ahlanganisiwe) noma anamathiselwe (angaphandle), ahlukanisa okuqukethwe kwangaphakathi kweseli endaweni ezungezile

i-plasmodesma
 (ubuningi = i-plasmodesmata) isiteshi esidlula phakathi kwezindonga zeseli zamaseli ezitshalo aseduze, sixhumanise i-cytoplasm yazo, futhi sivumele izinto ukuthi zithuthwe kusuka kuseli kuya kuseli

i-prokaryote
 i-unicellular organism engenawo i-nucleus noma enye i-membrane-bound organelle

i-ribosome
 isakhiwo seseli esenza ukwakheka kwamaprotheni

i-rough endoplasmic reticulum (RER)
isifunda se-endoplasmic reticulum esigcwele ama-ribosome futhi sihileleka ekuguqulweni kwamaprotheni kanye nokwakheka kwe-phospholipid

i-endoplasmic reticulum ebushelelezi (i-SER)
isifunda se-endoplasmic reticulum esine-ribosomes ezimbalwa noma ezingenazo nhlobo ebusweni bayo be-cytoplasmic futhi sakha ama-carbohydrate, ama-lipids, nama-hormone e-steroid; sikhipha ubuthi kumakhemikhali athile (njengezibulala-zinambuzane, izithasiselo, imithi, kanye nokungcola kwemvelo), futhi sigcina ama-ion e-calcium

 ukuhlangana okuqinile
uphawu oluqinile phakathi kwamaseli amabili ezilwane aseduze adalwe ukunamathela kwamaprotheni

 inkolelo-mbono yeseli elihlanganisiwe
umqondo webhayoloji othi zonke izinto eziphilayo zakhiwe iseli elilodwa noma ngaphezulu; iseli liyunithi eyisisekelo yokuphila; futhi amaseli amasha avela kumaseli akhona

 i-vacuole
isikhwama esiboshwe nge-membrane, esikhulu kancane kune-vesicle, esisebenza ekugcinweni nasekuthuthweni kwamaseli

 i-vesicle
isikhwama esincane, esiboshwe yi-membrane esisebenza ekugcinweni nasekuthuthweni kwamaseli; i-membrane yaso iyakwazi ukuhlangana ne-plasma membrane kanye ne-membrane ye-endoplasmic reticulum kanye ne-Golgi apparatus
