chapterName: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.8 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 4. Isakhiwo Seseli | 4.8 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
4.1 Ukufunda Amaseli
Iseli liyunithi encane kakhulu yokuphila. Amaseli amaningi mancane kakhulu kangangokuthi awakwazi ukubonwa ngamehlo enyama. Ngakho-ke, ososayensi basebenzisa ama-microscope ukutadisha amaseli. Ama-microscope e-electron anikeza ukukhulisa okuphezulu, isinqumo esiphezulu, kanye nemininingwane eminingi kune-microscopes yokukhanya. Ithiyori yeseli elihlanganisiwe ithi zonke izinto eziphilayo zakhiwe yiseli elilodwa noma ngaphezulu, iseli liyunithi eyisisekelo yokuphila, futhi amaseli amasha avela kumaseli akhona.

 4.2 Amaseli e-Prokaryotic
Ama-Prokaryotes yizinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa zezizinda ze-Bacteria ne-Archaea. Wonke ama-prokaryotes ane-plasma membranes, i-cytoplasm, i-ribosomes, kanye ne-DNA engaboshiwe yi-membrane. Iningi lawo linezindonga zamaseli e-peptidoglycan futhi amaningi anama-capsule e-polysaccharide. Amaseli e-Prokaryotic ahluka ngobubanzi kusukela ku-0.1 kuya ku-5.0 μm.

 Njengoba iseli likhula ngobukhulu, isilinganiso salo sendawo-kuya-ivolumu siyancipha. Uma iseli likhula kakhulu, ulwelwesi lwe-plasma ngeke lube nendawo eyanele yokusekela izinga lokusabalala elidingekayo ukuze kube nomthamo owandisiwe.

 4.3 Amaseli e-Eukaryotic
Njengeseli le-prokaryotic, iseli le-eukaryotic line-plasma membrane, i-cytoplasm, kanye ne-ribosomes, kodwa iseli le-eukaryotic ngokuvamile likhulu kuneseli le-prokaryotic, line-nucleus yangempela (okusho ukuthi i-DNA yalo izungezwe ulwelwesi), futhi linamanye ama-organelle aboshwe ulwelwesi avumela ukuhlukaniswa kwemisebenzi. Ulwelwesi lwe-plasma luyi-phospholipid bilayer ehlanganiswe namaprotheni. I-nucleolus ye-nucleus iyindawo yokuhlangana kwe-ribosome. Ama-Ribosome atholakala ku-cytoplasm noma anamathele ohlangothini lwe-cytoplasmic lwe-plasma membrane noma i-endoplasmic reticulum. Enza ukwakheka kwamaprotheni. Ama-Mitochondria ahlanganyela ekuphefumuleni kwamaseli; anesibopho se-ATP eningi ekhiqizwa kuseli. Ama-Peroxisomes afaka i-hydrolyze fatty acids, ama-amino acids, kanye nobuthi obuthile. Ama-Vesicle nama-vacuole ayizindawo zokugcina nokuthutha. Kumaseli ezitshalo, ama-vacuole nawo asiza ekuhlukaniseni ama-macromolecule.

 Amaseli ezilwane nawo ane-centrosome nama-lysosome. I-centrosome inemizimba emibili eqonde komunye nomunye, ama-centrioles, futhi inenjongo engaziwa ekuhlukanisweni kwamaseli. Ama-Lysosome ayizitho zokugaya ukudla zamaseli ezilwane.

 Amaseli ezitshalo namaseli afana nezitshalo ngalinye linodonga lweseli, ama-chloroplast, kanye ne-vacuole ephakathi. Udonga lweseli lesitshalo, oluyingxenye yalo eyinhloko yi-cellulose, luvikela iseli, lunikeza ukwesekwa kwesakhiwo, futhi lunikeza iseli ukuma. I-Photosynthesis yenzeka kuma-chloroplast. I-vacuole ephakathi inganda ngaphandle kokukhiqiza i-cytoplasm eyengeziwe.

 4.4 Uhlelo lwe-Endomembrane namaProtheyini
Uhlelo lwe-endomembrane luhlanganisa i-nuclear envelope, ama-lysosome, ama-vesicle, i-ER, kanye ne-Golgi apparatus, kanye ne-plasma membrane. Lezi zingxenye zamaseli zisebenza ndawonye ukuguqula, ukupakisha, ukufaka amathegi, kanye nokuthutha amaprotheni nama-lipid akha ama-membrane.

 I-RER iguqula amaprotheni futhi ihlanganise ama-phospholipid asetshenziswa kuma-membrane amaseli. I-SER ihlanganisa ama-carbohydrate, ama-lipid, nama-hormone e-steroid; ihileleka ekususeni ubuthi emithini kanye nobuthi; futhi igcina ama-ion e-calcium. Ukuhlunga, ukufaka amathegi, ukupakisha, kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwama-lipid namaprotheni kwenzeka ku-apparatus ye-Golgi. Ama-Lysosome adalwa ngokuhluma kwama-membrane e-RER ne-Golgi. Ama-Lysosome agaya ama-macromolecule, aphinde asebenzise ama-organelle agugile, futhi abhubhise amagciwane.

 4.5 I-Cytoskeleton
I-cytoskeleton inezinhlobo ezintathu ezahlukene zezakhi zamaphrotheni. Kusukela kokuncane kuya kokubanzi, yi-microfilaments (i-actin filaments), i-filaments ephakathi, kanye ne-microtubules. I-Microfilaments ivame ukuhlotshaniswa ne-myosin. Ihlinzeka ngokuqina kanye nesimo kuseli futhi ikhuthaza ukunyakaza kweseli. I-filaments ephakathi ithwala ukucindezelwa futhi iqinise i-nucleus kanye nezinye i-organelles endaweni. I-Microtubules isiza iseli ukumelana nokucindezelwa, isebenza njengemizila yamaprotheni emoto ahambisa ama-vesicles kuseli, futhi idonsa ama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe emaphethelweni aphambene eseli elihlukanisayo. Futhi iyisici sesakhiwo sama-centrioles, i-flagella, kanye ne-cilia.

 4.6 Ukuxhumana Phakathi Kwamaseli Nemisebenzi Yamaselula
Amaseli ezilwane axhumana ngama-matrices awo angaphandle futhi axhumene komunye nomunye ngama-junctions aqinile, ama-desmosomes, kanye nama-gap junctions. Amaseli ezitshalo axhunyiwe futhi axhumana nomunye nomunye nge-plasmodesmata.

 Lapho ama-receptor amaprotheni ebusweni be-plasma membrane yeseli yesilwane ebopha into ethile ku-extracellular matrix, kuqala uchungechunge lwezimo ezishintsha imisebenzi eyenzeka ngaphakathi kweseli. Ama-Plasmodesmata ayiziteshi phakathi kwamaseli ezitshalo aseduze, kuyilapho izixhumo zezikhala ziyiziteshi phakathi kwamaseli ezilwane aseduze. Kodwa-ke, izakhiwo zawo zihlukile kakhulu. I-tight junction iyisivikelo esingangeni manzi phakathi kwamaseli amabili aseduze, kuyilapho i-desmosome isebenza njenge-spot weld

question53: Yiziphi izinzuzo kanye nokungalungi kwama-microscope akhanyayo? Yiziphi izinzuzo kanye nokungalungi kwama-microscope e-electron?

question57: Yini enquma umkhawulo ophezulu wosayizi weseli?
answer57: Isilinganiso sendawo ebusweni kuya kumthamo. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo, njengezikhunta ze-slime, zidlula kulokhu esikhundleni sokuba namaseli ahlukene ane-cytoplasm ehlanganisa amagatsha enesilinganiso sendawo ebusweni kuya kumthamo.

distractor57b: Amandla e-van Der Walls awanele ukubamba ndawonye ulwelwesi lwamaseli olungaphezu kwama-microns angu-500 ububanzi. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo, njengezikhunta ze-slime, zidlula lokhu ngokufaka amaprotheni e-G kulwelwesi lwe-plasma.
distractor57c: Ngenxa yamandla adonsela phansi amanzi, ingxenye eyinhloko ye-cytosol, iseli elingaphezu kwama-micron angu-500 ububanzi lizowa ngokwalo emoyeni, kanti iseli elingaphezu kwama-micron angu-300 ububanzi lizowa ngokwalo ngaphansi kwamanzi.

question59: Ama-bacteria awanawo ama-organelle; noma kunjalo, ukusabela okufanayo okwenzeka kulwelwesi lwangaphakathi lwe-mitochondria, i-phosphorylation ye-ADP ku-ATP, kanye nama-chloroplast, i-photosynthesis, kwenzeka kuma-bacteria. Lokhu kusabela kwenzeka kuphi?

question60: Yikuphi ukufana kanye nomehluko phakathi kwe-mitochondria nama-chloroplast ngokwesakhiwo nokusebenza?
answer60: Ukufana: ulwelwesi oluphindwe kabili, isikhala esiphakathi kwe-membrane, ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP, kuqukethe i-DNA. Umehluko: i-mitochondria inezimbobo zangaphakathi ezibizwa ngokuthi i-cristae, i-chloroplast iqukethe imibala engeziwe kuma-thylakoids, akha i-grana kanye ne-stroma
distractor60a: Ukufana: I-DNA, isikhala esiphakathi kwe-membrane, ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP, kanye ne-chlorophyll. Umehluko: i-mitochondria ine-matrix kanye ne-inner folds ebizwa ngokuthi i-cristae; i-chloroplast iqukethe ama-pigment angeziwe kuma-thylakoids, akha i-grana kanye ne-stroma.
distractor60b: Ukufana: ulwelwesi oluphindwe kabili kanye nokukhiqizwa kwe-ATP. Umehluko: i-mitochondria inesikhala esiphakathi kwe-membrane kanye nokugoba kwangaphakathi okubizwa ngokuthi i-cristae; i-chloroplast iqukethe imibala engeziwe kuma-thylakoids, akha i-grana kanye ne-stroma
distractor60c: Ukufana: ulwelwesi oluphindwe kabili kanye nokukhiqizwa kwe-ATP. Umehluko: i-mitochondria inesikhala esiphakathi kwe-membrane, ukugoqa kwangaphakathi okubizwa ngokuthi i-cristae, i-ATP synthase yokwenziwa kwe-ATP, kanye ne-DNA; i-chloroplast iqukethe ama-pigment angeziwe kuma-thylakoids, akha i-grana kanye ne-stroma.
question61: Ingabe ulwelwesi lwenuzi luyingxenye yesistimu ye-endomembrane? Kungani noma kungani kungenjalo?

question64: Izithibi zokuhlanganiswa kwe-microtubule, isibonelo, i-vinblastine, zisetshenziselwa ukwelashwa ngamakhemikhali omdlavuza. Isivimbeli sokuhlanganiswa kwe-microtubule siwathinta kanjani amangqamuzana anomdlavuza?

question67: Uma kukhona ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ze-collagen, njengaleyo ehilelekile ku-Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, bese umuntu ekhiqiza i-collagen enesici, ingabe lokho kungathinta ukuqina kwe-coagulation? Kungani noma kungani kungenjalo?

question68: Isakhiwo se-plasmodesma sihluke kanjani kwese-gap junction?

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
I-plasma membrane, ebizwa nangokuthi i-cell membrane, inemisebenzi eminingi; kodwa, eyisisekelo kakhulu ukuchaza imingcele nokusebenza njengomlindi wesango leseli. I-plasma membrane ingena kalula, okusho ukuthi amanye ama-molecule angangena noma aphume ngokukhululeka esitokisini. Amanye adinga usizo oluvela ezakhiweni ezikhethekile, amanye ama-molecule, noma adinga amandla ukuze awele. Isibonelo esisodwa se-molecule esiza amanye ama-molecule ngaphesheya kwe-plasma membrane yi-protein ebizwa nge-NPC1. Le protein ihilelekile ekuhambiseni i-cholesterol nezinye izinhlobo zamafutha ngaphesheya kwe-plasma membrane. Abanye abantu banesimo sofuzo esiholela ekusebenzeni kabi kwe-NPC1. Ngenxa yalokho, i-cholesterol eningi iqoqana ngaphakathi kwamaseli okubangela isimo esibizwa ngokuthi i-NPC Disease.

 Ososayensi abavela e-Albert Einstein College of Medicine, eHarvard Medical School, kanye ne-Whitehead Institute for Biomedical Research bathole ukuthi igciwane le-Ebola lisebenzisa ne-NPC1 ukuze lingene emaselini futhi liphindaphindeke. Ososayensi basebenzisa amagundane ayengenayo i-NPC1 protein ukuhlola lo mbono. Lapho ososayensi bezama ukuthelela la magundane nge-Ebola, akekho noyedwa owagula. Base bezama ukuthelela amagundane nge-NPC1 esebenza kancane futhi bathola ukuthi agula, kodwa awafanga. Ngamanye amazwi, ngaphandle kwe-NPC1 esebenza kahle, igciwane le-Ebola alikwazi ukuthelela igundane. Uma leli phethini likhona nakubantu, kusho ukuthi noma ubani onesifo se-NPC kanye nenkinga yaso elandelayo nge-cholesterol ephezulu angavikelwa ku-Ebola.

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.1 Izingxenye kanye Nesakhiwo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njenge-art mosaic, i-plasma membrane yakhiwe yizingxenye eziningana ezahlukene. Ama-Phospholipid (esifunde ngawo ngaphambilini) akha ungqimba oluyi-bilayer; imisila ye-hydrophobic, fatty acid iyathintana futhi izingxenye ze-hydrophilic ze-phospholipids ziqondiswe ezindaweni zangaphakathi nezangaphandle zamanzi. Izinhlobo eziningana zamaprotheni anemisebenzi ehlukene ziqinisa i-membrane. Amaprotheni ahlanganisiwe avame ukuzungeza i-membrane futhi angathutha izinto zingene noma ziphume emaseli; lawa maprotheni ahlanganisiwe angaba hydrophilic noma hydrophobic, kuye ngokuthi abekwe kuphi ngaphakathi kwe-membrane. Amaprotheni angaphandle nangaphakathi atholakala ebusweni bangaphandle nangaphakathi be-membrane angasebenza njengama-enzyme, izinamathiselo zesakhiwo semicu ye-cytoskeleton, kanye nengxenye yezindawo zokuqashelwa kweseli. Lawa maprotheni aqondene neseli adlala indima ebalulekile ekusebenzeni komzimba; enza amaseli ohlobo oluthile (isib., amangqamuzana esibindi) akwazi ukubonana lapho enza izicubu; futhi avumela ama-hormone namanye ama-molecule ukuthi aqaphele amaseli aqondiwe. Lawa maprotheni antanta” kulo lonke i-membrane, ehlala eshintshashintsha.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.B
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla kudinga ukuthi amaseli adale futhi alondoloze izindawo zangaphakathi ezihlukile ezindaweni zawo zangaphandle.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.11 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha amamodeli axhumanisa ukunyakaza kwama-molecule ku-membrane nesakhiwo se-membrane kanye nomsebenzi.

 I-plasma membrane yeseli ichaza iseli, ichaza imingcele yalo, futhi inqume uhlobo lokuxhumana kwayo nendawo ezungezile (bheka uMfanekiso 5.2 ukuze uthole isifinyezo). Amaseli awafaki ezinye izinto, angene kwezinye, futhi akhiphe ezinye, konke ngobuningi obulawulwayo. I-plasma membrane kumele iguquguquke kakhulu ukuvumela amaseli athile, njengamaseli abomvu egazi namaseli amhlophe egazi, ukuthi ashintshe isimo njengoba edlula kuma-capillaries amancane. Lena imisebenzi esobala kakhulu ye-plasma membrane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuso be-plasma membrane buphethe izimpawu ezivumela amaseli ukuthi azane, okubalulekile ekwakhekeni kwezicubu nezitho ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kwasekuqaleni, futhi kamuva okudlala indima ekuhlukaniseni impendulo yomzimba ngokumelene ne-non-self.

 Phakathi kwemisebenzi eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu ye-plasma membrane yikhono lokudlulisa izimpawu ngokusebenzisa amaprotheni ayinkimbinkimbi, ahlanganisiwe aziwa ngokuthi ama-receptors. Lawa maprotheni asebenza kokubili njengabamukeli bokufakwayo kwangaphandle kanye nanjengeziqalisi zezinqubo zangaphakathi kweseli. Lawa ma-receptor e-membrane ahlinzeka ngezindawo zokunamathisela zangaphandle kwama-effectors afana nama-hormone nezinto zokukhula, futhi avuselela ama-cascade okusabela kwangaphakathi kweseli lapho ama-effectors awo eboshiwe. Ngezinye izikhathi, ama-receptor athunjwa amagciwane awasebenzisa ukungena kumaseli, futhi ngezinye izikhathi, ama-gene ekhodi ama-receptor ayashintsha, okwenza inqubo yokudluliselwa kwesignali ingasebenzi kahle nemiphumela emibi.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.1 Izingxenye kanye Nesakhiwo | Imodeli Ye-Fluid Mosaic
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.1 Izingxenye kanye Nesakhiwo | Imodeli Ye-Fluid Mosaic
chapterContent:
Ukuba khona kwe-plasma membrane kwatholakala ngawo-1890, futhi izingxenye zayo zamakhemikhali zatholakala ngo-1915. Izingxenye eziyinhloko ezatholakala ngaleso sikhathi kwakungamafutha namaprotheni. Imodeli yokuqala eyamukelwa kabanzi yesakhiwo se-plasma membrane yaphakanyiswa ngo-1935 nguHugh Davson noJames Danielli; kwakusekelwe ekubonakaleni komzila wesitimela we-plasma membrane kuma-electron micrograph okuqala. Bathi isakhiwo se-plasma membrane sifana nesandwich, iphrotheni ifana nesinkwa, kanti amafutha afana nokugcwaliswa. Ngawo-1950, intuthuko ye-microscopy, ikakhulukazi i-transmission electron microscopy (TEM), yavumela abacwaningi ukuthi babone ukuthi umongo we-plasma membrane wawunesendlalelo esiphindwe kabili, hhayi esisodwa. Imodeli entsha echaza kangcono kokubili ukubonwa kwe-microscopic kanye nomsebenzi waleyo plasma membrane yaphakanyiswa ngu-S.J. Singer noGarth L. Nicolson ngo-1972.

 Incazelo ephakanyiswe ngu-Singer no-Nicolson ibizwa ngokuthi i-fluid mosaic model. Imodeli ishintshe kancane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kodwa isachaza kangcono isakhiwo kanye nemisebenzi ye-plasma membrane njengoba sesiyiqonda manje. Imodeli ye-fluid mosaic ichaza isakhiwo se-plasma membrane njenge-mosaic yezingxenye—kufaka phakathi ama-phospholipid, i-cholesterol, amaprotheni, nama-carbohydrate—enikeza i-membrane uhlamvu loketshezi. Ama-plasma membrane asukela ku-5 kuya ku- Ubukhulu obuyi-10 nm. Uma uqhathanisa, amangqamuzana abomvu egazi lomuntu, abonakala nge-microscopy ekhanyayo, angaba ngu-8 μm ububanzi, noma cishe ngokuphindwe kayi-1,000 kunolwelwesi lwe-plasma. Ulwelwesi lubukeka njengesandwich (Isithombe 5.2).

 Izingxenye eziyinhloko zolwelwesi lwe-plasma ama-lipid (ama-phospholipid ne-cholesterol), amaprotheni, nama-carbohydrate anamathele kwamanye ama-lipid kanye namanye amaprotheni. I-phospholipid iyi-molecule equkethe i-glycerol, ama-fatty acid amabili, kanye neqembu lekhanda elixhunywe yi-phosphate. I-cholesterol, elinye i-lipid elakhiwe ngamasongo amane e-carbon ahlanganisiwe, itholakala eceleni kwama-phospholipid enkabeni yolwelwesi. Izilinganiso zamaprotheni, ama-lipid, nama-carbohydrate elwelwesini lwe-plasma ziyahlukahluka ngohlobo lweseli, kodwa kuseli lomuntu elijwayelekile, iphrotheni ibala cishe amaphesenti angama-50 okwakheka ngobuningi, ama-lipid (azo zonke izinhlobo) abala cishe amaphesenti angama-40 okwakheka ngobuningi, kanti amaphesenti ayi-10 asele okwakheka ngobuningi angama-carbohydrate. Kodwa-ke, Ukuhlushwa kwamaprotheni nama-lipid kuyahlukahluka ngezindwangu zamaseli ezahlukene. Isibonelo, i-myelin, ukukhula kwendwangu yamaseli akhethekile okuvikela ama-axons ezinzwa zangaphakathi, iqukethe amaprotheni angu-18% kuphela kanye nama-lipid angu-76%. Indwangu yangaphakathi ye-mitochondrial iqukethe amaprotheni angu-76% kanye nama-lipid angu-24% kuphela. Indwangu ye-plasma yamaseli abomvu egazi lomuntu ingu-lipid angu-30%. Ama-carbohydrate akhona kuphela ebusweni bangaphandle bendwangu ye-plasma futhi anamathele kumaprotheni, akha ama-glycoprotein, noma anamathele kuma-lipid, akha ama-glycolipid.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.1 Izingxenye kanye Nesakhiwo | Imodeli Ye-Fluid Mosaic | Ama-Phospholipid
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.1 Izingxenye kanye Nesakhiwo | Imodeli Ye-Fluid Mosaic | Ama-Phospholipid
chapterContent:
Indwangu eyinhloko yolwelwesi yakhiwe ngama-molecule e-phospholipid ahlala emanzini angaphandle. Izindawo ezithanda amanzi noma ezithanda amanzi zala ma-molecule (ezibukeka njengeqoqo lamabhola embukisweni womculi wemodeli) (Isithombe 5.2) zithintana noketshezi olumanzi ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli. Ama-molecule angathandi amanzi, noma angathandi amanzi, avame ukuba angabi ngama-polar. Asebenzisana namanye ama-molecule angewona ama-polar ekuphenduleni kwamakhemikhali, kodwa ngokuvamile awasebenzisani nama-molecule angama-polar. Uma efakwa emanzini, ama-molecule angathandi amanzi avame ukwakha ibhola noma iqoqo. Izindawo ezithanda amanzi zama-phospholipid zivame ukwakha izibopho ze-hydrogen namanzi kanye namanye ama-molecule angama-polar kokubili ngaphandle nangaphakathi kweseli. Ngakho-ke, ubuso be-membrane obubhekene nengaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli buthanda amanzi. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ingaphakathi le-membrane yeseli lithanda amanzi futhi ngeke lisebenzisane namanzi. Ngakho-ke, ama-phospholipid akha i-membrane yeseli enhle kakhulu enezingqimba ezimbili ehlukanisa uketshezi ngaphakathi kweseli noketshezi olungaphandle kweseli.

 I-molecule ye-phospholipid (Isithombe 5.3) yakhiwa umgogodla we-glycerol one-carbon ezintathu onezimbili ama-molecule e-fatty acid anamathele kuma-carbon 1 no-2, kanye neqembu eliqukethe i-phosphate elinamathele ku-carbon yesithathu. Lokhu kuhlelwa kunikeza i-molecule iyonke indawo echazwa njengekhanda layo (iqembu eliqukethe i-phosphate), elinophawu lwe-polar noma i-negative charge, kanye nendawo ebizwa ngokuthi umsila (ama-fatty acid), engenawo amandla. Ikhanda lingakha izibopho ze-hydrogen, kodwa umsila awukwazi. I-molecule enalolu hlelo lwendawo ekhokhiswe kahle noma engalungile kanye nendawo engakhokhisiwe, noma engekho-polar, ibizwa ngokuthi i-amphiphilic noma i-dual-loving.”

 Lesi sici sibalulekile ekwakhiweni kwe-plasma membrane ngoba, emanzini, ama-phospholipid avame ukuhlelwa ngemisila yawo e-hydrophobic ibhekene futhi amakhanda awo e-hydrophilic ebheke ngaphandle. Ngale ndlela, akha i-lipid bilayer—isithiyo esakhiwe ungqimba oluphindwe kabili lwama-phospholipid ahlukanisa amanzi nezinye izinto ngakolunye uhlangothi lwesithiyo emanzini nezinye izinto ngakolunye uhlangothi. Eqinisweni, ama-phospholipid ashiswa yisisombululo samanzi avame ukwakha ngokuzenzakalelayo ama-sphere amancane noma amaconsi (abizwa ngokuthi ama-micelles noma ama-liposome), lapho amakhanda awo athanda amanzi akha ingaphandle kanye nemisila yawo ethanda amanzi ngaphakathi (Isithombe 5.4)

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.1 Izingxenye kanye Nesakhiwo | Imodeli KaMoseki Ewuketshezi | Amaprotheni
chapterContent:
Amaprotheni akha ingxenye yesibili enkulu yama-plasma membrane. Amaprotheni ahlanganisiwe (ezinye izinhlobo ezikhethekile zibizwa ngokuthi ama-integrins), njengoba igama lawo lisho, ahlanganiswe ngokuphelele esakhiweni se-membrane, futhi izindawo zawo ezihlanganisa i-hydrophobic membrane-spanning zihlangana nesifunda esingenamanzi se-phospholipid bilayer (Isithombe 5.2). Amaprotheni e-single-pass integral membrane avame ukuba ne-hydrophobic transmembrane segment equkethe ama-amino acid angu-20-25. Amanye ahlanganisa ingxenye kuphela ye-membrane—ehambisana nesendlalelo esisodwa—kanti amanye anwebeka kusukela kolunye uhlangothi lwe-membrane aye kolunye, futhi abonakala kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi. Amanye amaprotheni ayinkimbinkimbi akhiwa izingxenye ezifika ku-12 zeprotheni eyodwa, ezigoqwe kakhulu futhi zifakwe ku-membrane (Isithombe 5.5). Lolu hlobo lweprotheni lunesifunda noma izifunda ezihlala emanzini, kanye nesifunda esisodwa noma eziningana ezihlala emanzini. Lokhu kuhlelwa kwezindawo zeprotheyini kuvame ukuqondisa iphrotheyini eceleni kwama-phospholipid, lapho indawo yeprotheyini engathandi amanzi iseduze nemisila yama-phospholipid kanye nendawo ye-hydrophilic noma izindawo zeprotheyini eziphuma olwelwesini futhi zithintana ne-cytosol noma uketshezi olungaphandle.

 Amaprotheni angaphandle atholakala ezindaweni zangaphandle nezangaphakathi ze-membrane, anamathele kumaprotheni ahlanganisiwe noma kuma-phospholipid. Amaprotheni angaphandle, kanye namaprotheni ahlanganisiwe, angasebenza njengama-enzyme, njengezinamathiselo zesakhiwo semicu ye-cytoskeleton, noma njengengxenye yezindawo zokuqashelwa kweseli. Ngezinye izikhathi lezi zibizwa ngokuthi amaprotheni athile eseli. Umzimba uyawabona amaprotheni awo futhi uhlasela amaprotheni angaphandle ahlobene namagciwane ahlaselayo.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.1 Izakhi kanye Nesakhiwo | Imodeli Ye-Fluid Mosaic | Ama-carbohydrate
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.1 Izakhi kanye Nesakhiwo | Imodeli Ye-Fluid Mosaic | Ama-carbohydrate
chapterContent:
Ama-carbohydrate ayingxenye yesithathu enkulu yama-plasma membranes. Ahlala etholakala ebusweni bangaphandle bamaseli futhi aboshwe kumaprotheni (akha ama-glycoprotein) noma ku-lipids (akha ama-glycolipids) (Isithombe 5.2). Lawa maketanga ama-carbohydrate angaba namayunithi angu-2-60 e-monosaccharide futhi angaba aqondile noma ahlukaniswe. Kanye namaprotheni angaphandle, ama-carbohydrate akha izindawo ezikhethekile ebusweni bamaseli ezivumela amaseli ukuthi aqaphele omunye nomunye. Lezi zindawo zinamaphethini ahlukile avumela iseli ukuthi liqapheleke, ngendlela izici zobuso ezihlukile kumuntu ngamunye ezimvumela ngayo ukuthi aqapheleke. Lo msebenzi wokuqaphela ubaluleke kakhulu kumaseli, njengoba uvumela uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba ukuthi luhlukanise phakathi kwamaseli omzimba (abizwa ngokuthi wona uqobo) namaseli noma izicubu zangaphandle (abizwa ngokuthi awekho uqobo). Izinhlobo ezifanayo zama-glycoprotein nama-glycolipids zitholakala ebusweni bamagciwane futhi zingashintsha njalo, zivimbele amaseli omzimba ukuthi awabone futhi awahlasele.

 Lawa ma-carbohydrate angaphandle kweseli—izingxenye zama-carbohydrate zama-glycoprotein nama-glycolipid—abizwa ngokuthi yi-glycocalyx (okusho ukumbozwa ushukela). I-glycocalyx ithanda kakhulu amanzi futhi idonsela amanzi amaningi ebusweni beseli. Lokhu kusiza ekusebenzisaneni kweseli nendawo yalo enamanzi kanye nekhono leseli lokuthola izinto ezincibilikisiwe emanzini. Njengoba kuxoxwe ngenhla, i-glycocalyx ibalulekile futhi ekuhlonzeni iseli, ekuzinqumeni/ekungazisunguli, kanye nasekuthuthukisweni kombungu, futhi isetshenziswa ekunamathiselweni kweseli-seli ukwakha izicubu.

 Ukuxhumana Kokuziphendukela Kwemvelo
Indlela Amagciwane Athelela Ngayo Izitho Ezithile
Amaphethini e-Glycoprotein nama-glycolipid ebusweni bamaseli anikeza amagciwane amaningi ithuba lokutheleleka. Amagciwane e-HIV ne-hepatitis athelela kuphela izitho noma amaseli athile emzimbeni womuntu. I-HIV iyakwazi ukungena ezingxeni ze-plasma ze-subtype yama-lymphocyte abizwa ngokuthi amaseli e-T-helper, kanye namanye ama-monocyte namaseli esistimu yezinzwa ephakathi. Igciwane le-hepatitis lihlasela amaseli esibindi.

 Lawa magciwane ziyakwazi ukuhlasela la maseli, ngoba amaseli anezindawo zokubopha ebusweni bawo eziqondene futhi ezihambisana namagciwane athile (Isithombe 5.6). Ezinye izindawo zokuqaphela ebusweni begciwane zixhumana nesistimu yomzimba yomuntu, okwenza umzimba ukhiqize ama-antibodies. Ama-antibodies enziwa ngokuphendula ama-antigen noma amaprotheni ahlotshaniswa namagciwane ahlaselayo, noma ngokuphendula amaseli angaphandle, njengalawo angase avele ngokufakelwa isitho. Lezi zindawo ezifanayo zisebenza njengezindawo lapho ama-antibodies enamathela futhi abhubhise noma avimbele umsebenzi wegciwane. Ngeshwa, lezi zindawo zokuqaphela kwi-HIV ziyashintsha ngesivinini esikhulu ngenxa yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, okwenza ukukhiqizwa komjovo osebenzayo wokulwa negciwane kube nzima kakhulu, njengoba igciwane lishintsha futhi lizivumelanisa nezimo. Umuntu onegciwane le-HIV uzokhula ngokushesha izinhlobo ezahlukene zegciwane, noma izinhlobo, zegciwane ezihlukaniswa ngomehluko kulezi zindawo zokuqaphela. Lokhu kushintsha okusheshayo kwezimpawu zobuso kunciphisa ukusebenza kahle kwesistimu yomzimba yomuntu ekuhlaseleni igciwane, ngoba ama-antibodies ngeke aqaphele ukuhlukahluka okusha kwamaphethini obuso. Endabeni ye-HIV, inkinga ikhuliswa iqiniso lokuthi igciwane lithelela futhi libhubhise amaseli ahilelekile ekuphenduleni komzimba, okwenza kube nzima nakakhulu umbungazi

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.1 Izingxenye kanye Nesakhiwo | Ukugeleza Kwezingqimba
chapterContent:
Isici se-mosaic se-membrane, esichazwe kumodeli ye-mosaic ewuketshezi, sisiza ukubonisa uhlobo lwayo. Amaprotheni ahlanganisiwe nama-lipid akhona ku-membrane njengama-molecule ahlukene kodwa anamathele kancane. Lawa afana namathayili ahlukene, anemibala eminingi esithombeni se-mosaic, futhi ayantanta, ehamba kancane maqondana nomunye nomunye. Nokho, i-membrane ayifani nebhaluni elingakhula futhi linciphe; kunalokho, liqinile futhi lingaqhuma uma lingena noma uma iseli lithatha amanzi amaningi kakhulu. Kodwa-ke, ngenxa yemvelo yalo ye-mosaic, inaliti encane kakhulu ingangena kalula ku-membrane ye-plasma ngaphandle kokubangela ukuba iqhume, futhi i-membrane izogeleza futhi izivale lapho inaliti ikhishwa.

 Izici ze-mosaic ze-membrane zichaza okunye kodwa hhayi konke ukugeleza kwayo. Kunezinye izici ezimbili ezisiza ukugcina lesi sici soketshezi. Esinye isici uhlobo lwama-phospholipid ngokwawo. Ngendlela yawo egcwele, ama-fatty acid emisileni ye-phospholipid agcwele ama-athomu e-hydrogen aboshwe. Azikho izibopho ezimbili phakathi kwama-athomu e-carbon aseduze. Lokhu kuphumela emisileni eqondile. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ama-fatty acid angagcwalisiwe awaqukethe inani elikhulu lama-athomu e-hydrogen, kodwa aqukethe izibopho eziphindwe kabili phakathi kwama-athomu e-carbon aseduze; isibopho esiphindwe kabili siphumela ekugobeni kwentambo yama-carbons cishe angama-degrees angu-30 (Isithombe 5.3).

 Ngakho-ke, uma ama-fatty acid agcwele, anemisila yawo eqondile, ecindezelwa amazinga okushisa anciphayo, ayacindezelana, enze ulwelwesi oluqinile noluqinile. Uma ama-fatty acid angagcwali ecindezelwa, ama-kink” emisileni yawo adonsela indololwane eduze kwama-molecule e-phospholipid kude, okugcina isikhala phakathi kwama-molecule e-phospholipid. Leli gumbi lendololwane” lisiza ukugcina uketshezi kulwelwesi emazingeni okushisa lapho ulwelwesi olunemisila ye-fatty acid egcwalisiwe kuma-phospholipid awo luzoqina noma luqine. Ukugeleza okuhlobene kwelwelwesi kubaluleke kakhulu endaweni ebandayo. Indawo ebandayo ivame ukucindezela ulwelwesi olwakhiwe kakhulu ngama-fatty acid agcwalisiwe, okwenza lube luncane uketshezi futhi lube sengozini yokuqhekeka. Izinto eziphilayo eziningi (izinhlanzi ziyisibonelo esisodwa) ziyakwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ezibandayo ngokushintsha isilinganiso sama-fatty acid angagcwali ezilwelweni zazo ngenxa yokwehla kwezinga lokushisa.

 Izilwane zinolwelwesi olwengeziwe olusiza ekugcineni uketshezi. I-cholesterol, elele eceleni kwama-phospholipid kulwelwesi, ivame ukunciphisa imiphumela yokushisa kulwelwesi. Ngakho-ke, leli lipid lisebenza njenge-buffer, livimbela amazinga okushisa aphansi ekuvimbeleni uketshezi futhi livimbele amazinga okushisa aphezulu ekwandiseni uketshezi kakhulu. Ngakho-ke, i-cholesterol inwebeka, kuzo zombili izinhlangothi, ububanzi izinga lokushisa lapho i-membrane igeleza khona ngendlela efanele futhi ngenxa yalokho isebenza kahle. I-cholesterol iphinde isebenze eminye imisebenzi, njengokuhlela amaqoqo amaprotheni e-transmembrane abe yi-lipid rafts.

 Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi
Isazi Sokuzivikela Emzimbeni
Ukwehluka kwamaprotheni angaphandle nama-carbohydrate athinta izindawo zokuqashelwa kweseli kuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu ku-immunology. Lezi zinguquko zicatshangelwa ekuthuthukisweni kwemithi yokugoma. Izifo eziningi ezithelelanayo, njenge-smallpox, i-polio, i-diphtheria, kanye ne-tetanus, zanqotshwa ukusetshenziswa kwemijovo.

 Ososayensi Bokuzivikela Emzimbeni bangodokotela nososayensi abacwaninga futhi bathuthukise imithi yokugoma, kanye nokwelapha nokutadisha ukungezwani komzimba noma ezinye izinkinga zokuzivikela komzimba. Abanye ososayensi bokuzivikela emzimbeni bafunda futhi baphathe izinkinga zokuzivikela komzimba (izifo lapho isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela somzimba somuntu sihlasela khona amangqamuzana noma izicubu zakhe, njenge-lupus) kanye nokuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kutholakale (ngegciwane, isibonelo) noma kuzuze ngefa (njengokuntuleka kwamasosha omzimba okuhlanganisiwe, noma i-SCID). Ososayensi Bokuzivikela Emzimbeni babizwa ukusiza ukwelapha iziguli ezifakelwa izitho zomzimba, okumele amasosha omzimba azo acindezelwe ukuze imizimba yazo ingalahli isitho esifakelwe esinye. Abanye ochwepheshe bezifo zomzimba basebenza ukuze baqonde ukuzivikela kwemvelo kanye nemiphumela yendawo yomuntu kuyo. Abanye basebenza ngemibuzo mayelana nokuthi isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela sithinta kanjani ukuthuthukiswa kwezifo ezithile ezingamahlalakhona.

 Ukuze usebenze njengochwepheshe wezifo zomzimba, kudingeka i-PhD noma i-MD. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ochwepheshe bezifo zomzimba baqeqeshwa okungenani iminyaka emi-2-3 ohlelweni olugunyaziwe futhi kumele baphumelele ukuhlolwa okunikezwa yi-American Board of Allergy and Immunology. Ochwepheshe bezifo zomzimba kumele babe nolwazi ngemisebenzi yomzimba womuntu njengoba ihlobene nezinkinga ezingaphezu kokugonywa, kanye nolwazi lwe-pharmacology kanye nobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha, njengemithi, ukwelashwa, izinto zokuhlola, kanye nezinqubo zokuhlinzwa.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthutha Okungashintshi | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthutha Okungashintshi | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukuvimbela ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni kubalulekile kokubili ezitshalweni nasezilwaneni. Amanzi ahamba phezu kwe-plasma membranes ngohlobo oluthile lokusabalala olubizwa ngokuthi i-osmosis. Ukuphakama kwamanzi phezu kwe-membrane kuhambelana ngokuphambene nokuhlushwa kwe-solutes; okungukuthi, amanzi ahamba ngamaprotheni esiteshi abizwa ngokuthi ama-aquaporins kusukela ekuhlushweni kwamanzi aphezulu kuya ekuhlushweni kwamanzi okuphansi. Ukuhlushwa kwe-solute ngaphandle nangaphakathi kweseli kuthonya izinga le-osmosis. I-Tonicity ichaza ukuthi ukuhlushwa kwe-extracellular kwe-solutes kungashintsha kanjani ivolumu yeseli ngokuthinta i-osmosis, evame ukuhambisana ne-osmolarity yesisombululo, okungukuthi, ukuhlushwa okuphelele kwesisombululo. Esimweni se-hypotonic, ngoba uketshezi lwe-extracellular lunokuhlushwa okuphansi kwe-solutes (i-osmolarity ephansi) kunoketshezi olungaphakathi kweseli, amanzi angena esitokisini, okwenza ukuthi luvuvuke futhi mhlawumbe luqhume. Izindonga zeseli zezitshalo ziyawavimbela ekuqhumeni, kodwa amangqamuzana ezilwane, njengamaseli abomvu egazi, angancipha. Uma iseli lifakwa esixazululweni se-hypertonic, amanzi aphuma esiseleni ngoba iseli linamandla aphezulu amanzi kunesixazululo se-extracellular. Uma amazinga e-solute elingana kuzo zombili izinhlangothi ze-membrane (isotonic), akukho ukunyakaza kwamanzi okungenayo noma okuphumayo esiseleni okwenzekayo. Izinto eziphilayo ziye zashintsha izindlela ezahlukene zokugcina ibhalansi ye-osmotic; isibonelo, izinhlanzi zasolwandle zikhipha usawoti omningi ngama-gill ukuze zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Ze-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Ama-membrane e-plasma kumele avumele izinto ezithile ukuthi zingene futhi ziphume eseli, futhi avimbele ezinye izinto eziyingozi ukuthi zingangeni kanye nezinye izinto ezibalulekile ukuthi zingaphumi. Ngamanye amazwi, ama-membrane e-plasma angena ngokukhetha— (angangeni kancane) avumela ezinye izinto ukuthi zidlule, kodwa hhayi ezinye. Uma bezolahlekelwa yilokhu kukhetha, iseli ngeke lisakwazi ukuziphilisa, futhi lizobhujiswa. Amanye amangqamuzana adinga inani elikhulu lezinto ezithile kunamanye amangqamuzana; kumele abe nendlela yokuthola lezi zinto kusuka kuketshezi olungaphandle kweseli. Lokhu kungenzeka ngokunganaki, njengoba izinto ezithile zihamba ziye phambili naphambili, noma iseli lingase libe nezindlela ezikhethekile ezenza kube lula ukuthutha. Ezinye izinto zibaluleke kakhulu kuseli kangangokuthi lisebenzisa amanye amandla alo, lifaka i-hydrolyzing adenosine triphosphate (ATP), ukuthola lezi zinto. Amangqamuzana abomvu egazi asebenzisa amanye amandla awo enza lokho kanye. Amangqamuzana amaningi asebenzisa iningi lamandla awo ukugcina ukungalingani kwama-ion e-sodium ne-potassium phakathi kwangaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli.

 Izindlela eziqondile kakhulu zokuthutha kwe-membrane azinawo amandla. Ukuthutha okunganaki kuyinto eyenzeka ngokwemvelo futhi akudingi ukuthi iseli lisebenzise noma yimaphi amandla alo ukuze lifeze ukunyakaza. Ekuthuthweni okunganaki, izinto zihamba zisuka endaweni yokuhlushwa okuphezulu ziye endaweni yokuhlushwa okuphansi. Isikhala esibonakalayo lapho kukhona ububanzi bokuhlushwa kwento eyodwa kuthiwa sine-gradient yokuhlushwa.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthuthwa Okungenamsebenzi | Ukuvunyelwa Okukhethiwe
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthuthwa Okungenamsebenzi | Ukuvunyelwa Okukhethiwe
chapterContent:
Ama-membrane e-plasma awalingani: ingaphakathi le-membrane alifani nengaphandle le-membrane. Eqinisweni, kunomehluko omkhulu phakathi kweqoqo lama-phospholipid namaprotheni phakathi kwamapheshana amabili akha i-membrane. Ingaphakathi le-membrane, amanye amaprotheni asebenza ukunamathelisa i-membrane kuma-fiber e-cytoskeleton. Kukhona amaprotheni angaphandle kwe-membrane ahlanganisa izakhi ze-extracellular matrix. Ama-carbohydrate, anamathele kuma-lipid noma amaprotheni, atholakala nangaphandle kwe-plasma membrane. Lawa ma-carbohydrate complexes asiza iseli ukubopha izinto ezidingwa yiseli ku-extracellular fluid. Lokhu kunezela kakhulu emvelweni wokukhetha wama-plasma membrane (Isithombe 5.7).

 Khumbula ukuthi ama-plasma membrane ahlala emanzini amaningi: Anezindawo ezihlala emanzini amaningi kanye nezindawo ezihlala emanzini amaningi. Lesi sici sisiza ukunyakaza kwezinye izinto nge-membrane futhi sivimbela ukunyakaza kwezinye. Izinto ezincibilikayo ngama-lipid ezinesisindo esincane sama-molecule zingadlula kalula ngaphakathi kwe-hydrophobic lipid core ye-membrane. Izinto ezifana namavithamini A, D, E, kanye no-K ancibilika kalula zidlula emangqamuzaneni e-plasma emgudwini wokugaya ukudla nakwezinye izicubu. Izidakamizwa nama-hormone ancibilika kalula nawo angena kalula emaseli futhi athuthwa kalula ezicutshini nasezithweni zomzimba. Ngokufanayo, ama-molecule e-oxygen kanye ne-carbon dioxide awanayo imali ngakho-ke adlula emangqamuzaneni ngokusabalala okulula.

 Izinto ezi-polar ziletha izinkinga engqamuzaneni. Ngenkathi amanye ama-molecule e-polar exhumana kalula nengaphandle leseli, awakwazi ukudlula kalula enkabeni ye-lipid yengqamuzana le-plasma. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngenkathi ama-ion amancane engangena kalula ezikhaleni eziku-mosaic yengqamuzana, imali yawo iyawavimbela ekwenzeni lokho. Ama-ion anjenge-sodium, i-potassium, i-calcium, ne-chloride kumele abe nezindlela ezikhethekile zokungena emangqamuzaneni e-plasma. Ushukela olula kanye nama-amino acid nawo adinga usizo ngokuthutha emangqamuzaneni e-plasma, atholakala ngamaprotheni ahlukahlukene e-transmembrane (iziteshi)

distractor15a: Wonke ama-molecule awela ulwelwesi ngamazinga alinganayo

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthuthwa Okungenamsebenzi | Ukusabalala
chapterContent:
Ukusabalala kuyinqubo yokuthutha engenzi lutho. Into eyodwa ivame ukuhamba isuka endaweni enokugxila okuphezulu iye endaweni enokugxila okuphansi kuze kube yilapho ukugxilisa kufana phakathi kwesikhala. Ujwayelene nokusabalala kwezinto emoyeni. Isibonelo, cabanga ngomuntu ovula ibhodlela le-ammonia ekamelweni eligcwele abantu. Igesi le-ammonia lisezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu ebhodleleni; ukugxilisa kwalo okuphansi kakhulu kusezinqeni zegumbi. Umhwamuko we-ammonia uzosabalala, noma usakazeke, ebhodleleni, futhi kancane kancane, abantu abaningi bazohogela i-ammonia njengoba isakazeka. Izinto zihamba ngaphakathi kwe-cytosol yeseli ngokusabalala, kanti izinto ezithile zihamba nge-plasma membrane ngokusabalala (Isithombe 5.8). Ukusabalala akusebenzisi amandla. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ukugqama kwe-concentration kuyindlela yamandla angaba khona, ahlakazeka njengoba ukugqama kususwa.

 Into ngayinye ehlukile endaweni, njengoketshezi olungaphandle kwe-extracellular, ine-concentration gradient yayo, engancikile ku-concentration gradients yezinye izinto. Ngaphezu kwalokho, into ngayinye izosabalala ngokusho kwaleyo gradient. Ngaphakathi kohlelo, kuzoba namazinga ahlukene okusabalala kwezinto ezahlukene endaweni

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthuthwa Okungashukumi | Ukusabalala | Izici Ezithinta Ukusabalala
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthuthwa Okungashukumi | Ukusabalala | Izici Ezithinta Ukusabalala
chapterContent:
Ama-molecule ahamba njalo ngendlela engahleliwe, ngesivinini esincike ebunzimeni bawo, endaweni akuyo, kanye nenani lamandla okushisa anawo, okuwumsebenzi wokushisa. Lokhu kuhamba kubangela ukusabalala kwama-molecule nganoma iyiphi indlela atholakala kuyo. Into izovame ukuhamba iye kunoma iyiphi indawo etholakalayo kuze kube yilapho isatshalaliswa ngokulinganayo kuyo yonke indawo. Ngemva kokuba into isisabalale ngokuphelele esikhaleni, isusa i-gradient yayo yokuhlushwa, ama-molecule azoqhubeka ehambahamba esikhaleni, kodwa ngeke kube khona ukunyakaza okunetha kwenani lama-molecule ukusuka endaweni eyodwa kuya kwenye. Lokhu kuntuleka kwe-gradient yokuhlushwa lapho kungekho ukunyakaza okunetha kwento kwaziwa ngokuthi i-dynamic equilibrium. Ngenkathi ukusabalala kuzoqhubeka lapho kukhona i-gradient yokuhlushwa kwento, izici eziningana zithinta izinga lokusabalala.

 Izinga le-gradient yokuhlushwa: Lapho umehluko omkhulu ekuhlushweni, kulapho ukusabalala kushesha khona. Lapho ukusatshalaliswa kwezinto kusondela ekulinganisweni, izinga lokusabalala liba lincane.
Isisindo sama-molecule asakazeka: Ama-molecule asindayo ahamba kancane; Ngakho-ke, ziyasabalala kancane. Okuphambene nalokho kuyiqiniso ngama-molecule alula.
Izinga lokushisa: Amazinga okushisa aphezulu andisa amandla ngakho-ke ukunyakaza kwama-molecule, okwandisa izinga lokusabalalisa. Amazinga okushisa aphansi anciphisa amandla ama-molecule, ngaleyo ndlela anciphise izinga lokusabalalisa.
Ubuningi be-solvent: Njengoba ubuningi be-solvent bukhula, izinga lokusabalalisa liyancipha. Ama-molecule ayancipha ngoba anenkinga enkulu yokudlula endaweni exinene kakhulu. Uma indawo ehlanganisiwe incane kakhulu, ukusabalalisa kuyanda. Ngenxa yokuthi amaseli asebenzisa kakhulu ukusabalalisa ukuhambisa izinto ngaphakathi kwe-cytoplasm, noma yikuphi ukwanda kobuningi be-cytoplasm kuzovimbela ukunyakaza kwezinto. Isibonelo salokhu umuntu ohlangabezana nokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni. Njengoba amaseli omzimba elahlekelwa amanzi, izinga lokusabalalisa liyancipha kwi-cytoplasm, futhi imisebenzi yamaseli iyawohloka. Ama-neurons avame ukuzwela kakhulu kulo mphumela. Ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni kuvame ukuholela ekungazini futhi mhlawumbe e-coma ngenxa yokwehla kwesilinganiso sokusabalalisa ngaphakathi kwamaseli.
Ukuncibilika: Njengoba kuxoxwe ngakho ngaphambili, izinto ezingezona ezomhlaba noma ezincibilika ngama-lipid zidlula kalula kuma-membrane e-plasma kunezinto ezimbozwe ngama-polar, okuvumela izinga lokusabalala okusheshayo.
Indawo yobuso kanye nobukhulu be-membrane ye-plasma: Indawo yobuso ekhulayo yandisa izinga lokusabalala, kanti i-membrane ebanzi iyayinciphisa.
Ibanga elihanjwayo: Uma ibanga elikhulu okumele lihanjwe yinto, izinga lokusabalala liyancipha. Lokhu kubeka umkhawulo ophezulu ngobukhulu beseli. Iseli elikhulu, eliyindilinga lizofa ngoba izakhamzimba noma imfucuza ayikwazi ukufinyelela noma ukuphuma enkabeni yeseli, ngokulandelana. Ngakho-ke, amaseli kumele abe mancane ngobukhulu, njengasendabeni yama-prokaryote amaningi, noma acwebezelwe, njengase-eukaryote amaningi aneseli elilodwa.
Ukwehlukahluka kokusabalala yinqubo yokuhlunga. Ekuhlungeni, izinto zihamba ngokwe-gradient yazo yokuhlushwa nge-membrane; ngezinye izikhathi izinga lokusabalala likhuliswa yingcindezi, okubangela ukuthi izinto zihlunge ngokushesha. Lokhu kwenzeka ezinso, lapho umfutho wegazi uphoqa khona amanzi amaningi nezinto ezincibilikile ezihambisana nawo, noma izixazululo, ukuphuma egazini ziye kuma-tubules ezinso. Izinga lokusabalala kwaleli gciwane kulesi simo cishe lincike ngokuphelele ekucindezelweni. Omunye wemiphumela yomfutho wegazi ophezulu ukuvela kwephrotheni emchameni, ecindezelwa "yingcindezi ephezulu ngendlela engavamile".

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthutha Okungashintshi | Ukuthutha okulula
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthutha Okungashintshi | Ukuthutha okulula
chapterContent:
Ekuthuthweni okulula, okubizwa nangokuthi ukusabalala okulula, izinto ziyasabalala kulo lonke ulwelwesi lwe-plasma ngosizo lwamaprotheni e-membrane. Kukhona i-gradient yokuhlushwa evumela lezi zinto ukuba zisabalale esitokisini ngaphandle kokusebenzisa amandla eseli. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinto zingama-molecule e-polar axoshwa yizingxenye ze-hydrophobic ze-membrane yeseli. Amaprotheni okuthutha okulula avikela lezi zinto emandleni okuxosha e-membrane, okuzivumela ukuthi zisabalale esitokisini.

 Izinto ezithuthwayo ziqala zixhunywe kuma-receptor e-protein noma e-glycoprotein ebusweni bangaphandle be-membrane ye-plasma. Lokhu kuvumela ukuthi izinto ezidingwa yiseli zisuswe ku-extracellular fluid. Izinto zibe sezidluliselwa kuma-protein athile ahlanganisiwe enza kube lula ukudlula kwawo. Amanye ala ma-protein ahlanganisiwe ayiqoqo lamashidi e-beta pleated akha imbobo noma isiteshi nge-phospholipid bilayer. Amanye angama-protein athwalayo abopha into futhi asize ukusabalala kwayo nge-membrane.

 Iziteshi
Amaprotheni ahlanganisiwe ahilelekile ekuthuthweni okulula abizwa ngokuthi amaprotheni okuthutha, futhi asebenza njengeziteshi zezinto noma abathwali. Kuzo zombili izimo, angamaprotheni e-transmembrane. Iziteshi zikhethekile ngento ethuthwayo. Amaprotheni eziteshi anezindawo ezisebenzisa amanzi agelezayo ezivezwe oketshezini lwangaphakathi nolwangaphandle; futhi anesiteshi esisebenzisa amanzi agelezayo esiphakathi kwawo esihlinzeka ngokuvulwa okumanzi ngezingqimba ze-membrane (Isithombe 5.9). Ukudlula esikhaleni kuvumela i-polar com amakhilogremu ukugwema ungqimba oluphakathi olungeyona i-polar lwe-plasma membrane obekunganciphisa noma kuvimbele ukungena kwawo esitokisini. Ama-aquaporin angamaprotheni eziteshi avumela amanzi ukuba adlule esikhaleni ngesivinini esikhulu kakhulu.

 Amaprotheni eziteshi avulekile ngaso sonke isikhathi noma avikelwe ngesango,” okulawula ukuvulwa kwesiteshi. Ukunamatheliswa kwe-ion ethile kuphrotheni yesiteshi kungalawula ukuvulwa, noma ezinye izindlela noma izinto zingase zihileleke. Kwezinye izicubu, ama-ion e-sodium ne-chloride adlula ngokukhululeka eziteshini ezivulekile, kanti kwezinye izicubu isango kumele livulwe ukuze kuvunyelwe ukudlula. Isibonelo salokhu senzeka ezinso, lapho zombili izinhlobo zeziteshi zitholakala ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zama-tubules ezinso. Amaseli ahilelekile ekudlulisweni kwemizwa kagesi, njengamaseli ezinzwa nemisipha, aneziteshi ezivikelwe ngesango ze-sodium, i-potassium, ne-calcium ezingxenyeni zawo. Ukuvulwa nokuvalwa kwalezi ziteshi kushintsha ukugxila okuhlobene ezinhlangothini eziphikisanayo ze-membrane yalezi ion, okuholela ekwenzeni kube lula ukudluliselwa kukagesi ezingxenyeni (esimweni samaseli ezinzwa) noma ekucindezelweni kwemisipha (esimweni samaseli emisipha).

 Amaphrotheni Okuthwala
Olunye uhlobo lwephrotheni olufakwe ku-membrane ye-plasma yiphrotheni yokuthwala. Le phrotheni eqanjwe ngokufanele ibopha into ethile futhi, ngokwenza kanjalo, ibangela ushintsho lwesimo sayo, ihambisa i-molecule eboshiwe isuka ngaphandle kwe iseli liye ngaphakathi kwalo (Isithombe 5.10); kuye ngokuthi i-gradient ingakanani, izinto zingase zihambe ziye kolunye uhlangothi. Amaprotheni abathwali ngokuvamile aqondene nento eyodwa. Lokhu kukhetha kunezela ekukhetheni okuphelele kwe-plasma membrane. Indlela eqondile yokushintsha kwesimo ayiqondwa kahle. Amaprotheni angashintsha isimo lapho izibopho zawo ze-hydrogen zithinteka, kodwa lokhu kungase kungayichazi ngokugcwele le ndlela. Iphrotheni ngayinye ethwala iqondene nento eyodwa, futhi kunenani elilinganiselwe lala maprotheni kunoma yiluphi ulwelwesi. Lokhu kungabangela izinkinga ekuthuthweni okwanele kwezinto ukuze iseli lisebenze kahle. Lapho wonke amaprotheni eboshelwe kuma-ligand awo, ayagcwala futhi izinga lokuthuthwa liphezulu kakhulu. Ukwandisa i-gradient yokuhlushwa kuleli qophelo ngeke kuholele ekwandeni kwesivinini sokuthuthwa.

 Isibonelo sale nqubo senzeka ezinso. I-glucose, amanzi, usawoti, ama-ion, nama-amino acid adingekayo emzimbeni ahlungwa engxenyeni eyodwa yezinso. Lokhu kuhlunga, okuhlanganisa i-glucose, bese kuthathwa kwenye ingxenye yezinso. Ngoba kunenombolo elinganiselwe kuphela amaprotheni athwala i-glucose, uma kukhona i-glucose eningi kunaleyo amaprotheni angayisebenzisa, okungaphezulu akuthuthwa futhi kukhishwa emzimbeni ngomchamo. Kumuntu onesifo sikashukela, lokhu kuchazwa njengokuchitha i-glucose emchameni.” Iqembu elihlukile lamaprotheni athwala i-glucose abizwa ngokuthi amaprotheni okuthutha i-glucose, noma ama-GLUT, ahilelekile ekuthuthweni kwe-glucose kanye noshukela we-hexose nge-plasma membranes emzimbeni.

 Amaprotheni esiteshi kanye namaprotheni athwala i-transport ngezinto ezihlukene. Amaprotheni esiteshi athwala ngokushesha kakhulu kunamaprotheni athwala i-transporter. Amaprotheni esiteshi enza kube lula ukusabalala ngesivinini sama-molecule angamashumi ezigidi ngomzuzwana, kanti amaprotheni athwala asebenza ngesivinini sama-molecule ayinkulungwane kuya kwesigidi ngomzuzwana.

chapterContent:
I-Osmosis ukuhamba kwama-molecule amanzi akhululekile nge-membrane engangenisi amanzi ngokwe-gradient yokugcwala kwamanzi kulo lonke ulwelwesi, okulingana ngokuphambene nokugcwala kwama-solutes. Ngenkathi ukusabalala kuthutha izinto ezidlula kuma-membrane nangaphakathi kwamaseli, i-osmosis ithwala amanzi kuphela kulo ulwelwesi futhi ulwelwesi lukhawulela ukusabalala kwama-solutes emanzini. Akumangazi ukuthi ama-aquaporin alula ukuhamba kwamanzi adlala indima enkulu ku-osmosis, ikakhulukazi kumaseli abomvu egazi kanye nama-membrane ama-renal tubules.

 Indlela
I-Osmosis iyicala elikhethekile lokusabalala. Amanzi, njengezinye izinto, asuka endaweni enama-molecule amanzi akhululekile aphezulu aye kwenye enama-molecule amanzi akhululekile aphansi. Umbuzo osobala uthi yini eyenza amanzi ahambe? Cabanga nge-beaker ene-membrane engangenisi amanzi ehlukanisa izinhlangothi ezimbili noma izingxenye (Isithombe 5.11). Kuzo zombili izinhlangothi ze-membrane izinga lamanzi liyafana, kodwa kunezinhlayiya ezahlukene zento encibilikisiwe, noma i-solute, engenakuwela i-membrane (ngaphandle kwalokho izinhlayiya ohlangothini ngalunye zizolinganiswa yi-solute ewela i-membrane). Uma ivolumu yesisombululo kuzo zombili izinhlangothi ze-membrane ifana, kodwa izinhlayiya ze-solute zihlukile, khona-ke kunezinhlayiya ezahlukene zamanzi, i-solvent, kuzo zombili izinhlangothi ze-membrane.

 Ukuze ubonise lokhu, cabanga ngezingilazi ezimbili ezigcwele zamanzi. Enye inethisipuni elilodwa likashukela kuyo, kanti eyesibili inekomishi eyodwa kwezine kashukela. Uma ivolumu iyonke yezixazululo kuzo zombili izinkomishi ifana, iyiphi inkomishi equkethe amanzi amaningi? Ngoba inani elikhulu likashukela enkomishini yesibili lithatha isikhala esikhulu kunethisipuni likashukela enkomishini yokuqala, inkomishi yokuqala inamanzi amaningi kuyo.

 Uma sibuyela esibonelweni se-beaker, khumbula ukuthi inengxube yezinhlayiya kuzo zombili izinhlangothi ze-membrane. Isimiso sokusabalala ukuthi ama-molecule ahambahambe futhi azosabalala ngokulinganayo kuyo yonke indawo uma ekwazi. Kodwa-ke, izinto ezikwazi ukungena nge-membrane kuphela ezizosabalala ngayo. Kulesi sibonelo, i-solute ayikwazi ukusabalala nge-membrane, kodwa amanzi angakwazi. Amanzi ane-gradient yokuhlushwa kulolu hlelo. Ngakho-ke, amanzi azosabalala phansi kwe-gradient yawo yokuhlushwa, ewela i-membrane aye ohlangothini lapho ingagxilile khona kakhulu. Lokhu kusabalala kwamanzi nge-membrane—i-osmosis—kuzoqhubeka kuze kube yilapho i-gradient yokuhlushwa kwamanzi iye ku-zero noma kuze kube yilapho ingcindezi ye-hydrostatic yamanzi ilinganisela ingcindezi ye-osmotic. I-Osmosis iqhubeka njalo ezinhlelweni eziphilayo.

 Isibonelo se-beaker lapha senzeka ohlelweni oluvulekile lapho umthamo woketshezi unganda futhi wehle ngokukhululeka. Amaseli, ngakolunye uhlangothi, akhiwa amaprotheni nezinye izinto ezifakwe ku-aqueous cytoplasm. Lezi zinto zingabhekwa njengezi-solutes ngenhloso yokubikezela i-osmosis. I-membrane yeseli igcina iningi lamaprotheni nezinye izinto ngaphakathi kweseli, okwenza iseli libe ne-osmolarity ephezulu kunamanzi ahlanzekile.

 Ake sithi wenza ucwaningo lapho ubeka khona amangqamuzana abomvu egazi endaweni enamanzi ahlanzekile. Ucabanga ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngamaseli? Ngenxa yokuthi ukugcwala kwe-solute kuphakeme kakhulu kuseli elibomvu legazi kunasebhekheni, amanzi angangena ngokushesha kuseli elibomvu legazi. Ucabanga ukuthi kuzokwenzekani kuseli elibomvu legazi, njengoba ulwelwesi lwalo lweseli lwakhiwe indawo engaphezulu eqondile? Kungenzeka ukuthi iseli elibomvu legazi lizodlula i-hemolysis, lapho livuvukala khona ngamanzi bese liqhuma. Nokho, kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi amangqamuzana amaningi anezindlela zokuwavimbela ekuthatheni amanzi amaningi. Kodwa-ke, amangqamuzana abomvu egazi awanazo lezi zilawuli, okwenza afanelekele izifundo ze-osmolarity.

 Lokhu kuyinto ebalulekile okufanele icatshangelwe odokotela abahambisa imithi ngemithambo yegazi. Umuthi kufanele wakhiwe kanjani, ngokwe-osmolarity, ukuze kuvinjelwe amangqamuzana abomvu egazi ukuthi adlule i-hemolysis? Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukwakheka kwe-hemolysis yamaseli abomvu egazini, izidakamizwa zivame ukwakheka ngesisombululo se-isotonic negazi ukuze kulondolozwe i-osmolarity.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthutha Okungashukumi | I-Tonicity
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthutha Okungashukumi | I-Tonicity
chapterContent:
I-Tonicity ichaza indlela isixazululo esingaphandle kweseli esingashintsha ngayo ivolumu yeseli ngokuthinta i-osmosis. I-tonicity yesisombululo ivame ukuhlobana ngqo ne-osmolarity yesisombululo. I-Osmolarity ichaza ukuhlushwa okuphelele kwesisombululo. Isixazululo esine-osmolarity ephansi sinenani elikhulu lama-molecule amanzi uma kuqhathaniswa nenani lezinhlayiya ezincibilikayo; isixazululo esine-osmolarity ephezulu sinama-molecule amanzi ambalwa maqondana nezinhlayiya ezincibilikayo. Esimweni lapho izixazululo zama-osmolarities amabili ahlukene zihlukaniswa yi-membrane engenela emanzini, nakuba ingeyona i-solute, amanzi azohamba esuka ohlangothini lwe-membrane ene-osmolarity ephansi (namanzi amaningi) aye ohlangothini olune-osmolarity ephezulu (namanzi amancane). Lo mphumela unengqondo uma ukhumbula ukuthi i-solute ayikwazi ukuhamba ngaphesheya kwe-membrane, ngakho-ke ingxenye kuphela ohlelweni engahamba—amanzi—ihamba ngokwe-gradient yayo yokuhlushwa. Umehluko obalulekile ophathelene nezinhlelo eziphilayo ukuthi i-osmolarity ilinganisa inani lezinhlayiya (okungaba ama-molecule) kusisombululo. Ngakho-ke, isixazululo esinamafu ngamaseli singaba ne-osmolarity ephansi kunesisombululo esicacile, uma isixazululo sesibili siqukethe ama-molecule amaningi ancibilikile kunamaseli.

 Izixazululo ze-Hypotonic
Amagama amathathu—i-hypotonic, i-isotonic, kanye ne-hypertonic—asetshenziswa ukuhlobanisa i-osmolarity yeseli ne-osmolarity yoketshezi olungaphandle kweseli oluqukethe amaseli. Esimweni se-hypotonic, uketshezi olungaphandle kweseli lune-osmolarity ephansi kunoketshezi olungaphakathi kweseli, futhi amanzi angena esitokisini. (Ezinhlelweni eziphilayo, iphuzu lokubhekisela lihlala liyi-cytoplasm, ngakho-ke isiqalo i-hypo- sisho ukuthi uketshezi olungaphandle kweseli lune-concentration ephansi yama-solutes, noma i-osmolarity ephansi, kune-cytoplasm yeseli.) Kusho nokuthi uketshezi olungaphandle kweseli lune-concentration ephezulu yamanzi esixazululweni kuneseli. Kulesi simo, amanzi azolandela i-concentration gradient yawo futhi angene esitokisini.

 Izixazululo ze-Hypertonic
Ngokuphathelene nesixazululo se-hypertonic, isiqalo esithi hyper- sibhekisela kuketshezi olungaphandle kweseli olune-osmolarity ephezulu kune-cytoplasm yeseli; ngakho-ke, uketshezi luqukethe amanzi amancane kunalawo akhona kuseli. Ngenxa yokuthi iseli linomthamo wamanzi ophakeme, amanzi azophuma kuseli.

 Izixazululo ze-Isotonic
Esixazululweni se-isotonic, uketshezi olungaphandle kweseli lune-osmolarity efanayo neseli. Uma i-osmolarity yeseli ifana noketshezi olungaphandle kweseli, ngeke kube khona ukunyakaza kwamanzi angene noma aphume kuseli, yize amanzi esazoqhubeka nokungena nokuphuma. Amaseli egazi namaseli ezitshalo kuzixazululo ze-hypertonic, isotonic, kanye ne-hypotonic athatha ukubukeka okuphawulekayo (Isithombe 5.12)

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezinhlayiya Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthutha Okungenamsebenzi | Ukuqina Kwezinhlelo Zokuphila
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezinhlayiya Ze-Plasma | 5.2 Ukuthutha Okungenamsebenzi | Ukuqina Kwezinhlelo Zokuphila
chapterContent:
Endaweni engaphansi kwe-hypotonic, amanzi angena esitokisini, bese iseli liyakhukhumala. Esimweni se-isotonic, amazinga ahlobene e-solute kanye ne-solvent ayalingana kuzo zombili izinhlangothi ze-membrane. Akukho ukunyakaza kwamanzi okuhlanzekile; ngakho-ke, akukho ushintsho ngobukhulu beseli. Esixazululweni se-hypertonic, amanzi ashiya iseli bese iseli liyakhukhumala. Uma noma yikuphi isimo se-hypo- noma se-hyper- siba ngaphezulu, imisebenzi yeseli iyaphazamiseka, futhi iseli lingabhujiswa.

 Iseli elibomvu legazi lizoqhuma, noma liqhume, lapho likhukhumala ngaphezu kwamandla e-plasma membrane okukhula. Khumbula, i-membrane ifana ne-mosaic, enezikhala ezihlukene phakathi kwama-molecule ayidalayo. Uma iseli likhukhumala, futhi izikhala eziphakathi kwama-lipids namaprotheni ziba zikhulu kakhulu, iseli lizoqhekeka.

 Ngokuphambene nalokho, lapho amanzi amaningi kakhulu eshiya iseli elibomvu legazi, iseli liyakhukhumala, noma liqhume. Lokhu kunomphumela wokugxila kwe-solutes eseleyo esitokisini, okwenza i-cytosol ibe nkulu futhi kuphazamise ukusabalala ngaphakathi esitokisini. Amandla eseli okusebenza azophazamiseka futhi angase abangele ukufa kweseli.

 Izinto eziphilayo ezahlukahlukene zinezindlela zokulawula imiphumela ye-osmosis—indlela ebizwa ngokuthi i-osmoregulation. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo, njengezitshalo, isikhunta, amabhaktheriya, kanye nabanye abaphrotheyini, zinezindonga zamaseli ezizungeze ulwelwesi lwe-plasma futhi zivimbele i-cell lysis kusisombululo se-hypotonic. Ulwelwesi lwe-plasma lungakhula kuphela kuze kube semkhawulweni wodonga lweseli, ngakho-ke iseli ngeke linciphe. Eqinisweni, i-cytoplasm ezitshalweni ihlala i-hypertonic kancane endaweni yeselula, futhi amanzi azohlala engena esitokisini uma amanzi etholakala. Lokhu kungena kwamanzi kukhiqiza ingcindezi ye-turgor, eqinisa izindonga zamaseli zesitshalo (Isithombe 5.13). Ezitshalweni ezingezona izinkuni, ingcindezi ye-turgor isekela isitshalo. Ngokuphambene nalokho, uma isitshalo singaniselwa, uketshezi olungaphandle luzoba yi-hypertonic, okubangela amanzi ukuba aphume esitokisini. Kulesi simo, iseli alinciphi ngoba udonga lweseli aluguquguquki. Kodwa-ke, ulwelwesi lweseli luyasuka odongeni bese lucindezela i-cytoplasm. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-plasmolysis. Izitshalo zilahlekelwa yingcindezi ye-turgor kulesi simo futhi ziyabuna (Isithombe 5.14).

 I-Tonicity iyinkinga yazo zonke izinto eziphilayo. Isibonelo, ama-paramecia nama-amoeba, angama-protist angenazo izindonga zeseli, ane-contractile vacuoles. Le vesicle iqoqa amanzi angaphezulu esitokisini bese iwakhipha, igcina iseli lingangeni njengoba lithatha amanzi endaweni yalo (Isithombe 5.15).

 Izilwane eziningi ezingenamgogodla zasolwandle zinamazinga kasawoti angaphakathi ahambisana nendawo yazo, okwenza zibe yi-isotonic namanzi ezihlala kuwo. Nokho, izinhlanzi kumele zichithe cishe amaphesenti amahlanu amandla azo okusebenza komzimba zigcina i-osmotic homeostasis. Izinhlanzi zamanzi ahlanzekile zihlala endaweni engathandeki kumaseli azo. Lezi zinhlanzi zithatha usawoti ngenkuthalo ngama-gill azo bese zikhipha umchamo oxutshwe ukuze zikhiphe amanzi angaphezulu. Izinhlanzi zasemanzini anosawoti zihlala endaweni ephambene, okuyinto ethinta kakhulu amangqamuzana azo, futhi zikhipha usawoti ngama-gill azo bese zikhipha umchamo ogxile kakhulu.

 Ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla, izinso zilawula inani lamanzi emzimbeni. Ama-Osmoreceptors angamaseli akhethekile ebuchosheni aqapha ukuhlushwa kwama-solutes egazini. Uma amazinga ama-solutes enyuka ngaphezu kwebanga elithile, kukhishwa i-hormone ebambezela ukulahleka kwamanzi ngezinso futhi inciphise igazi liye emazingeni aphephile. Izilwane nazo zinezinga eliphezulu le-albumin, elikhiqizwa yisibindi, egazini lazo. Le phrotheni inkulu kakhulu ukuba ingadlula kalula kuma-membrane e-plasma futhi iyisici esiyinhloko ekulawuleni ukucindezeleka kwe-osmotic okusetshenziswa ezicutshini.

chapterContent:
Uma into ethile kumele ingene esitokisini ngokumelene ne-gradient yayo yokuhlushwa, iseli kumele lisebenzise amandla amahhala, avame ukuhlinzekwa yi-ATP, kanye namaprotheni okuthwala asebenza njengamaphampu ukuhambisa into. Izinto ezihamba phezu kwama-membrane ngale ndlela, inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-active transport, zifaka phakathi ama-ion, njenge-Na+ kanye ne-K+. Ama-gradient ahlanganisiwe athinta ukunyakaza kwe-ion yi-gradient yayo yokuhlushwa kanye ne-gradient yayo kagesi (umehluko ekushayweni kulo lonke ulwelwesi); ndawonye la ma-gradient abizwa ngokuthi i-gradient ye-electrochemical. Ukuhambisa izinto ngokumelene ne-gradient ye-electrochemical kudinga amandla amahhala. Iphampu ye-sodium-potassium, egcina ama-gradient e-electrochemical kuwo wonke ama-membrane wamaseli ezinzwa ezilwaneni, iyisibonelo sokuthutha okusebenzayo okuyinhloko. Ukwakheka kwama-gradient e-H+ ngokuthutha okusebenzayo kwesibili (co-transport) kubalulekile ekuphefumuleni kwamaseli kanye ne-photosynthesis kanye nokuhambisa i-glucose emaseli.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe ku-Curriculum Framework zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa (SP).

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.B
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla kudinga ukuthi amaseli adale futhi alondoloze izindawo zangaphakathi ezihlukile ezindaweni zawo zangaphandle.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.B.2 Ukukhula kanye ne-homeostasis enamandla kugcinwa ukunyakaza okuqhubekayo kwama-molecule kuwo wonke ama-membrane.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.12 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi ukuze ahlole ukuthi i-homeostasis enamandla igcinwa yini ukunyakaza okusebenzayo kwama-molecule kuwo wonke ama-membrane.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Isayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:

 Izindlela zokuthutha ezisebenzayo zidinga ukusetshenziswa kwamandla eseli, ngokuvamile ngesimo se-adenosine triphosphate (ATP). Uma into kufanele ingene esitokisini ngokumelene ne-gradient yayo yokuhlushwa—okungukuthi, uma ukuhlushwa kwento ngaphakathi esitokisini kukhulu kunokuhlushwa kwayo kuketshezi olungaphandle kweseli (futhi okuphambene nalokho)—iseli kumele lisebenzise amandla ukuhambisa into. Ezinye izindlela zokuthutha ezisebenzayo zihambisa izinto ezincane zesisindo sama-molecule, njenge-ion, nge-membrane. Ezinye izindlela zithutha ama-molecule amakhulu kakhulu

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.3 Ukuthutha Okusebenzayo | I-Electrochemical Gradient
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.3 Ukuthutha Okusebenzayo | I-Electrochemical Gradient
chapterContent: Sixoxe nge-gradients elula yokuhlushwa—ukuhlushwa okuhlukile kwento esikhaleni noma ulwelwesi—kodwa ezinhlelweni eziphilayo, ama-gradients ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-ion angena futhi aphuma emaselini futhi ngenxa yokuthi amaseli aqukethe amaprotheni angahambi ngaphesheya kolwelwesi futhi ikakhulukazi ashajwe kabi, kukhona futhi i-gradient kagesi, umehluko wokushaja, kulo lonke ulwelwesi lwe-plasma. Ingaphakathi lamaseli aphilayo alinawo ugesi maqondana nolwelwesi olungaphandle kwamangqamuzana lapho agezwa khona, futhi ngesikhathi esifanayo, amaseli anamazinga aphezulu e-potassium (K+) kanye namazinga aphansi e-sodium (Na+) kunolwelwesi olungaphandle kwamangqamuzana. Ngakho-ke esitokisini esiphilayo, i-gradient yokuhlushwa ye-Na+ ivame ukuyiqhubela esitokisini, kanti i-gradient kagesi ye-Na+ (i-ion enhle) nayo ivame ukuyiqhubela ngaphakathi ngaphakathi eshajwe kabi. Nokho, isimo siyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kwezinye izinto ezifana ne-potassium. I-gradient kagesi ye-K+, i-ion enhle, nayo ivame ukuyiqhubela esitokisini, kodwa i-gradient yokuhlushwa ye-K+ ivame ukuqhubela i-K+ ngaphandle kweseli (Isithombe 5.16). I-gradient ehlanganisiwe yokuhlushwa kanye nokushaja kukagesi okuthinta i-ion ibizwa ngokuthi i-gradient yayo ye-electrochemical

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.3 Ukuthutha Okusebenzayo | Ukubhekana Ne-Gradient
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.3 Ukuthutha Okusebenzayo | Ukubhekana Ne-Gradient
chapterContent:
Ukuze kushukunyiswe izinto ngokumelene nokuhlushwa noma i-gradient ye-electrochemical, iseli kumele lisebenzise amandla. Lawa mandla aqoqwa ku-ATP akhiqizwa ngokusebenzisa i-metabolism yeseli. Izindlela zokuthutha ezisebenzayo, ezibizwa ngokuthi amaphampu, zisebenza ngokumelene ne-gradient ye-electrochemical. Izinto ezincane zihlala zidlula kuma-membrane e-plasma. I-Active Transport igcina ukuhlushwa kwama-ion nezinye izinto ezidingwa amaseli aphilayo lapho ebhekene nalezi zinyathelo ezingasebenzi. Iningi lamandla okusebenza kweseli angasetshenziswa ekulondolozeni lezi zinqubo. (Iningi lamandla okusebenza kweseli elibomvu lisetshenziselwa ukugcina ukungalingani phakathi kwamazinga e-sodium ne-potassium angaphandle nangaphakathi adingwa yiseli.) Ngenxa yokuthi izindlela zokuthutha ezisebenzayo zincike ekusetshenzisweni kweseli ukuze kutholakale amandla, zizwela ubuthi obuningi be-metabolic obuphazamisa ukunikezwa kwe-ATP.

 Kunezindlela ezimbili zokuthuthwa kwezinto ezincane ezinesisindo sama-molecule kanye nama-molecule amancane. I-primary active transport ihambisa ama-ion ngaphesheya kwe-membrane futhi idala umehluko ekushayweni kuleyo membrane, encike ngqo ku-ATP. I-Secondary active transport ichaza ukuhamba kwezinto ezibangelwa i-electrochemical gradient esungulwe yi-primary active transport engadingi i-ATP ngqo.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.3 Ukuthutha Okusebenzayo | Amaprotheni Okuthwala Ezokuthutha Okusebenzayo
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.3 Ukuthutha Okusebenzayo | Amaprotheni Okuthwala Ezokuthutha Okusebenzayo
chapterContent:
Ukulungiswa okubalulekile kwe-membrane yokuthutha okusebenzayo ukuba khona kwamaprotheni noma amaphampu athile okuthwala ukuze kube lula ukunyakaza: kunezinhlobo ezintathu zalawa maprotheni noma ama-transporter (Isithombe 5.17). I-uniporter ithwala i-ion noma i-molecule eyodwa ethile. I-symporter ithwala ama-ion noma ama-molecule amabili ahlukene, womabili aqonde ohlangothini olufanayo. I-antiporter ithwala nama-ion noma ama-molecule amabili ahlukene, kodwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Wonke lawa ma-transporter angathutha nama-molecule amancane, angashajwanga njenge-glucose. Lezi zinhlobo ezintathu zamaprotheni okuthwala nazo zitholakala ekusakazweni okulula, kodwa azidingi i-ATP ukuthi isebenze kuleyo nqubo. Ezinye izibonelo zamaphampu okuthutha okusebenzayo yi-Na+-K+ ATPase, ethwala ama-ion e-sodium ne-potassium, kanye ne-H+-K+ ATPase, ethwala ama-ion e-hydrogen ne-potassium. Womabili lawa ngamaprotheni okuthwala ama-antiporter. Amanye amaprotheni amabili okuthwala yi-Ca2+ ATPase kanye ne-H+ ATPase, athwala i-calcium kuphela kanye nama-ion e-hydrogen kuphela, ngokulandelana. Womabili angamaphampu.

 Ukuxhumeka Kwansuku Zonke Kwezifundo ze-AP®
Ukuthutha okusebenzayo okuyinhloko okusebenza nokuthutha okusebenzayo kwe-sodium ne-potassium kuvumela ukuthutha okusebenzayo kwesibili ukuba kwenzeke. Indlela yesibili yokuthutha isabhekwa njengesebenzayo ngoba incike ekusetshenzisweni kwamandla njengoba kwenza ukuthutha okuyinhloko (Isithombe 5.18).

 Enye yamaphampu abaluleke kakhulu kumaseli ezilwane yiphampu ye-sodium-potassium (Na+-K+ ATPase), egcina i-gradient ye-electrochemical (kanye nokuhlushwa okufanele kwe-Na+ ne-K+) kumaseli aphilayo. Iphampu ye-sodium-potassium ihambisa i-K+ esitokisini ngenkathi ihambisa i-Na+ ngaphandle ngesikhathi esifanayo, ngesilinganiso se-Na+ ezintathu kuwo wonke ama-ion amabili e-K+ angenisiwe. I-Na+-K+ ATPase ikhona ngezindlela ezimbili, kuye ngokuthi iqonde kanjani ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kweseli kanye nokusondelana kwayo nama-ion e-sodium noma e-potassium. Le nqubo iqukethe izinyathelo eziyisithupha ezilandelayo:

 Njengoba i-enzyme iqondiswe ngaphakathi kweseli, isithwali sinokusondelana okuphezulu kwama-ion e-sodium. Ama-ion amathathu abopha iphrotheni.
Isithwali samaprotheni sifaka i-hydrolyze ku-ATP bese iqembu le-phosphate elinamandla aphansi linamathela kuyo.
Ngenxa yalokho, isithwali sishintsha isimo futhi siziqondise kabusha ngaphandle kwe-membrane. Ukusondelana kweprotheni ne-sodium kuyancipha futhi ama-ion amathathu e-sodium ashiya isithwali.
Ukushintsha kwesimo kwandisa ukusondelana kwesithwali nama-ion e-potassium, futhi ama-ion amabili anjalo anamathela kuprotheni. Ngemva kwalokho, iqembu le-phosphate elinamandla aphansi liyahlukana nesithwali.
Njengoba iqembu le-phosphate lisusiwe futhi ama-ion e-potassium enamathiselwe, iphrotheni yesithwali iyazibeka kabusha ngaphakathi kweseli.
Iphrotheni yesithwali, esimweni sayo esisha, inokusondelana okunciphile kwe-potassium, futhi ama-ion amabili akhishwa kwi-cytoplasm. Iphrotheni manje inokusondelana okuphezulu kwama-ion e-sodium, futhi inqubo iqala futhi.
Kunezinto eziningana ezenzekile ngenxa yale nqubo. Kuleli qophelo, kune-ion e-sodium eningi ngaphandle kweseli kunangaphakathi kanye nama-ion e-potassium eningi ngaphakathi kunangaphandle. Kuwo wonke ama-ion amathathu e-sodium aphumayo, ama-ion amabili e-potassium ayangena. Lokhu kuphumela ekutheni ingaphakathi libe ne-negative kancane uma kuqhathaniswa nengaphandle. Lo mehluko ekushajweni ubalulekile ekudaleni izimo ezidingekayo enkambisweni yesibili. Ngakho-ke, iphampu ye-sodium-potassium iyiphampu ye-electrogenic (iphampu edala ukungalingani kweshaja) enegalelo emandleni e-membrane.

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.3 Ukuthuthwa Okusebenzayo | Ukuthuthwa Kwesibili Okusebenzayo (Ukuthutha Okuhlangene)
chapterContent: Ukuthutha okusebenzayo kwesibili kusebenzisa amandla e-kinetic ama-ion e-sodium ukuletha amanye ama-com amakhilogremu, ngokumelene ne-gradient yawo yokuhlushwa esitokisini. Njengoba amazinga e-ion e-sodium akha ngaphandle kwe-plasma membrane ngenxa yenqubo yokuqala yokuthutha okusebenzayo, lokhu kudala i-gradient ye-electrochemical. Uma iphrotheni yesiteshi ikhona futhi ivulekile, ama-ion e-sodium azohamba phansi kwe-gradient yawo yokuhlushwa e-membrane. Lokhu kuhamba kuthutha ezinye izinto okumele zixhunywe kuphrotheni efanayo yokuthutha ukuze ama-ion e-sodium ahambe ngaphesheya kwe-membrane (Isithombe 5.19). Ama-amino acid amaningi, kanye ne-glucose, angena esitokisini ngale ndlela. Le nqubo yesibili isetshenziselwa futhi ukugcina ama-ion e-hydrogen anamandla aphezulu ku-mitochondria yamaseli ezitshalo nezilwane ukuze kukhiqizwe i-ATP. Amandla angaba khona aqongelela kuma-ion e-hydrogen agciniwe ahunyushwa abe amandla e-kinetic njengoba ama-ion edlula ngeprotheni yesiteshi i-ATP synthase, futhi lawo mandla asetshenziselwa ukuguqula i-ADP ibe yi-ATP

chapterContent:
Ukusabalala, i-osmosis, kanye nokuhamba okusebenzayo kusetshenziselwa ukuthutha ama-molecule amancane kakhulu kuwo wonke ama-membrane eseli le-plasma. Kodwa-ke, ngezinye izikhathi izinhlayiya ezinkulu, njenge-macromolecules, izingxenye zamaseli, noma ngisho nama-microorganisms e-unicellular, zingagwinywa amanye amaseli enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-phagocytosis noma ukudla kwamaseli.” Kulolu hlobo lwe-endocytosis, i-membrane yeseli izungeza inhlayiya, inciphe, bese iletha inhlayiya esitokisini. Isibonelo, lapho amabhaktheriya ehlasela umzimba womuntu, uhlobo lweseli elimhlophe legazi elibizwa ngokuthi i-neutrophil luzosusa abahlaseli ngale nqubo. Ngokufanayo, ku-pinocytosis noma ekuphuzeni kwamaseli,” iseli lithatha amaconsi oketshezi. Ku-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor, ukuthathwa kwezinto yiseli kuqondiswe ohlotsheni olulodwa lwento ebopha iphrotheni ethile ye-receptor ebusweni bangaphandle be-membrane yeseli (isb., ama-hormone namaseli abo aqondiwe) ngaphambi kokuba i-endocytosis. Ezinye izifo zabantu, njenge-hypercholesterolemia yomndeni, zibangelwa ukwehluleka kwe-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor. I-Exocytosis inqubo yokukhipha izinto ngaphandle kweseli; Ama-vesicle aqukethe izinto ahlangana ne-plasma membrane bese okuqukethwe kukhishwa ngaphandle kweseli. Ukukhiqizwa kwama-neurotransmitters kuma-synapses phakathi kwama-neurons kuyisibonelo se-exocytosis.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.4 Ukuthuthwa Okukhulu | I-Endocytosis
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.4 Ukuthuthwa Okukhulu | I-Endocytosis
chapterContent:
I-Endocytosis uhlobo lokuhamba okusebenzayo oluhambisa izinhlayiya, njengama-molecule amakhulu, izingxenye zamaseli, ngisho namaseli aphelele, ziye esitokisini. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-endocytosis, kodwa zonke zinezici ezifanayo: Ulwelwesi lwe-plasma lweseli luyangena, lwakha isikhwama esizungeze inhlayiya eqondiwe. Isikhwama siyancinza, okuholela ekutheni inhlayiya iqukethwe ku-vesicle esanda kudalwa yangaphakathi kweseli eyakhiwe kusuka kulwelwesi lwe-plasma.

 I-Phagocytosis
I-Phagocytosis (isimo sokudla kwamaseli) inqubo lapho izinhlayiya ezinkulu, njengamaseli noma izinhlayiya ezinkulu, zithathwa yiseli. Isibonelo, lapho ama-microorganism ehlasela umzimba womuntu, uhlobo lweseli elimhlophe legazi elibizwa ngokuthi i-neutrophil luzosusa abahlaseli ngale nqubo, luzungeze futhi lugubungele i-microorganism, bese ibhujiswa yi-neutrophil (Isithombe 5.20).

 Ukulungiselela i-phagocytosis, ingxenye yobuso obubheke ngaphakathi kwe-plasma membrane imbozwa ngephrotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-clathrin, eqinisa lesi sigaba se-membrane. Ingxenye emboziwe ye-membrane isuka emzimbeni weseli futhi izungeze i-particle, ekugcineni iyivale. Uma i-vesicle equkethe i-particle ivalelwe ngaphakathi kweseli, i-clathrin iyaphuma ku-membrane bese i-vesicle ihlangana ne-lysosome ukuze kuqhekeke izinto eziku-compartment entsha eyakhiwe (i-endosome). Lapho izakhamzimba ezitholakala kalula ezivela ekuwohlokeni kokuqukethwe kwe-vesicular sezikhishwe, i-endosome entsha eyakhiwe ihlangana ne-plasma membrane bese ikhipha okuqukethwe kwayo ku-extracellular fluid. I-endosomal membrane iphinde ibe yingxenye ye-plasma membrane.

 I-Pinocytosis
Ukwehlukahlukana kwe-endocytosis kubizwa ngokuthi i-pinocytosis. Lokhu kusho ukuphuza iseli” futhi kwaqanjwa ngesikhathi lapho kwakucatshangwa ukuthi iseli lalithatha ngamabomu uketshezi olungaphandle kweseli. Eqinisweni, lena inqubo ethatha ama-molecule, okuhlanganisa namanzi, adingwa yiseli ku-extracellular fluid. I-Pinocytosis ibangela i-vesicle encane kakhulu kune-phagocytosis, futhi i-vesicle ayidingi ukuhlangana ne-lysosome (Isithombe 5.21).

 Ukwehlukahlukana kwe-pinocytosis kubizwa ngokuthi i-potocytosis. Le nqubo isebenzisa iphrotheni yokumboza, ebizwa ngokuthi i-caveolin, ohlangothini lwe-cytoplasmic lwe-plasma membrane, eyenza umsebenzi ofanayo ne-clathrin. Izimbobo eziku-plasma membrane ezakha ama-vacuole zine-membrane receptors kanye nama-lipid rafts ngaphezu kwe-caveolin. Ama-vacuole noma ama-vesicle akhiwe ku-caveolae (i-caveola eyodwa) mancane kunalawo aku-pinocytosis. I-Potocytosis isetshenziselwa ukuletha ama-molecule amancane esitokisini nokuthutha la ma-molecule ngeseli ukuze akhululwe kolunye uhlangothi lweseli, inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-transcytosis. Kwezinye izimo, ama-caveolae aletha umthwalo wawo kuma-organelle e-membranous njenge-ER.

 I-Endocytosis eqondiswa yi-Receptor
 Ukwehlukahluka okuqondiwe kwe-endocytosis kusebenzisa amaprotheni e-receptor ku-membrane ye-plasma anobuhlobo obuthile bokubopha izinto ezithile (Isithombe 5.22).

 Ku-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor, njengaku-phagocytosis, i-clathrin inamathele ohlangothini lwe-cytoplasmic lwe-membrane ye-plasma. Uma ukumuncwa kwe-compound kuncike ku-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor futhi inqubo ingasebenzi, izinto ngeke zisuswe oketshezini lwezicubu noma egazini. Esikhundleni salokho, zizohlala kulezo ziketshezi futhi zande ekugxilweni. Ezinye izifo zabantu zibangelwa ukwehluleka kwe-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor. Isibonelo, uhlobo lwe-cholesterol olubizwa ngokuthi i-low-density lipoprotein noma i-LDL (ebizwa nangokuthi i-cholesterol embi) lususwa egazini nge-receptor-mediated endocytosis. Esifweni sofuzo somuntu i-hypercholesterolemia yomndeni, ama-receptor e-LDL anephutha noma awatholakali ngokuphelele. Abantu abanalesi simo banamazinga e-cholesterol asongela ukuphila egazini labo, ngoba amaseli abo awakwazi ukususa izinhlayiya ze-LDL egazini labo.

 Nakuba i-receptor-mediated endocytosis iklanyelwe ukuletha izinto ezithile ezivame ukutholakala oketshezini olungaphandle kweseli, ezinye izinto zingangena esitokisini endaweni efanayo. Amagciwane omkhuhlane, i-diphtheria, kanye nobuthi be-cholera konke kunezindawo ezihlangana nezindawo ezivamile zokubopha ama-receptor futhi zingene emaseli.

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.4 Ukuthuthwa Okukhulu | I-Exocytosis
chapterContent:
Inqubo ephambene yokuhambisa izinto ziye esitokisini inqubo ye-exocytosis. I-Exocytosis iphambene nezinqubo okuxoxwe ngazo ngenhla ngoba inhloso yayo ukukhipha izinto esitokisini ziye oketshezini olungaphandle kweseli. Izinto ezilahliwe zimbozwe ulwelwesi futhi zihlangana nengaphakathi le-plasma membrane. Lokhu kuhlangana kuvula i-membrane envelope engaphandle kweseli, bese izinto ezilahliwe zikhishwa esikhaleni esingaphandle kweseli (Isithombe 5.23). Ezinye izibonelo zamaseli akhipha ama-molecule nge-exocytosis zifaka phakathi ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni e-extracellular matrix kanye nokukhiqizwa kwama-neurotransmitters ku-synaptic cleft ngama-synaptic vesicles.
