chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 5. Isakhiwo kanye Nomsebenzi Wezingqimba Ze-Plasma | 5.6 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
5.1 Izingxenye kanye Nesakhiwo
Ukuqonda kwanamuhla kwe-plasma membrane kubizwa ngokuthi imodeli ye-fluid mosaic. I-plasma membrane yakhiwe ungqimba lwama-phospholipid, anemisila yawo ye-hydrophobic, fatty acid exhumana. Indawo ye-membrane igcwele amaprotheni, amanye awo ahlanganisa i-membrane. Amanye ala maprotheni asebenza ukuthutha izinto zingene noma ziphume eseli. Ama-carbohydrate anamathele kwamanye amaprotheni nama-lipid ebusweni obungaphandle be-membrane, akha ama-complexes asebenza ukuhlonza iseli kwamanye amangqamuzana. Uhlobo lwe-fluid lwe-membrane lubangelwa izinga lokushisa, ukwakheka kwemisila ye-fatty acid (eminye ihlanganiswe yizibopho ezimbili), ukuba khona kwe-cholesterol efakwe ku-membrane, kanye nohlobo lwe-mosaic lwamaprotheni kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwamaprotheni nama-carbohydrate, okungagxilile endaweni. Ama-plasma membrane ahlanganisa futhi achaze imingcele yamaseli, kodwa kunokuba abe yisikhwama esingaguquki, ayashintshashintsha futhi ahlala eshintshashintsha.

 5.2 Passive Transport
Izinhlobo zokuthutha ezingasebenzi, ukusabalala kanye ne-osmosis, zithutha izinto ezinesisindo esincane sama-molecule kuwo wonke ama-membrane. Izinto ziyasabalala kusukela ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphezulu ziye ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphansi, futhi le nqubo iyaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho into isatshalaliswa ngokulinganayo ohlelweni. Ezixazululweni eziqukethe izinto ezingaphezu kweyodwa, uhlobo ngalunye lwe-molecule luyasabalala ngokwe-gradient yalo yokuhlushwa, ngaphandle kokusabalala kwezinye izinto. Izici eziningi zingathinta izinga lokusabalala, okuhlanganisa i-gradient yokuhlushwa, ubukhulu bezinhlayiya ezisabalala, izinga lokushisa lohlelo, njalo njalo.

 Ezinhlelweni eziphilayo, ukusabalala kwezinto zingene futhi ziphume emangqamuzaneni kulawulwa yi-plasma membrane. Ezinye izinto ziyasabalala kalula nge-membrane, kodwa ezinye ziyavinjelwa, futhi ukudlula kwazo kwenziwa kube nokwenzeka ngamaprotheni akhethekile, njengeziteshi kanye nabathuthi. I-chemistry yezinto eziphilayo yenzeka ezixazululweni zamanzi, futhi ukulinganisa amazinga alezo zixazululo kuyinkinga eqhubekayo. Ezinhlelweni eziphilayo, ukusabalala kwezinye izinto kungaba kancane noma kube nzima ngaphandle kwamaprotheni e-membrane enza kube lula ukuthuthwa.

 5.3 I-Active Transport
I-gradient ehlanganisiwe ethinta i-ion ifaka phakathi i-gradient yayo yokuhlushwa kanye ne-gradient yayo kagesi. I-ion enhle, isibonelo, ingase ithambekele ekusabalaleni endaweni entsha, yehle nge-gradient yayo yokuhlushwa, kodwa uma isabalale endaweni ye-net positive charge, ukusabalala kwayo kuzophazanyiswa yi-gradient yayo kagesi. Lapho kubhekene nama-ion ezixazululweni zamanzi, inhlanganisela ye-electrochemical kanye ne-gradient yokuhlushwa, kunokuba kube yi-gradient yokuhlushwa kuphela, kumele icatshangelwe. Amaseli aphilayo adinga izinto ezithile ezikhona ngaphakathi kweseli ngamanani amakhulu kunalawo akhona esikhaleni esingaphandle. Ukuhambisa izinto phezulu kwama-gradient azo e-electrochemical kudinga amandla avela kuseli. Ukuthutha okusebenzayo kusebenzisa amandla agcinwe ku-ATP ukuze kufake amandla lokhu kuthutha. Ukuthutha okusebenzayo kwezinto ezincane ezinobukhulu bama-molecule kusebenzisa amaprotheni ahlanganisiwe ku-membrane yeseli ukuhambisa izinto: Lawa maprotheni afana namaphampu. Amanye amaphampu, enza ukuthutha okusebenzayo okuyinhloko, ahlangana ngqo ne-ATP ukuze aqhube isenzo sawo. Ekuthuthweni ngokubambisana (noma ekuthuthweni okusebenzayo kwesibili), amandla avela ekuthuthweni okuyinhloko angasetshenziswa ukuhambisa enye into esiseleni kanye nokukhulisa i-gradient yayo yokuhlushwa.

 5.4 Ukuthutha Okukhulu
Izindlela zokuthutha ezisebenzayo zidinga ukusetshenziswa ngqo kwe-ATP ukuze kufakwe amandla okuthutha. Izinhlayiya ezinkulu, njenge-macromolecules, izingxenye zamaseli, noma amaseli aphelele, zingagwinywa amanye amaseli enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-phagocytosis. Ku-phagocytosis, ingxenye yolwelwesi iyangena futhi igeleze izungeze inhlayiya, ekugcineni inciphe bese ishiya inhlayiya ivalwe ngokuphelele yimvilophu yolwelwesi lwe-plasma. Okuqukethwe yi-vesicle kuhlukaniswa yiseli, kanti izinhlayiya zisetshenziswa njengokudla noma zithunyelwe. I-Pinocytosis inqubo efanayo ngesilinganiso esincane. Ulwelwesi lwe-plasma luyangena futhi lunciphe, lukhiqize imvilophu encane yolwelwesi oluvela ngaphandle kweseli. I-Pinocytosis ingenisa izinto ezidingwa yiseli kusuka olwelwesini olungaphandle kweseli. Iseli likhipha imfucuza ngendlela efanayo kodwa ephambene: lisunduza i-vacuole yolwelwesi kuyi-plasma membrane, livumela i-vacuole ukuthi ihlangane nolwelwesi futhi izihlanganise nesakhiwo solwelwesi, ikhulule okuqukethwe kwayo ngaphandle.

question11: Iyini inhloso ye-exocytosis?

question28: Kungani ama-phospholipid evame ukuziqondisa ngokuzenzakalelayo abe yinto efana ne-membrane efana ne-lipid-bilayer sphere, i-single-layer lipid sphere, kanye ne-lipid-bilayer sheet (Isithombe 5.26)?
answer28: Ama-phospholipids angama-molecule ahlala emanzini. Ikhanda elisezindaweni eziphansi libheke emanzini kanti imisila ye-fatty acid engeyona eyezimpondo ibheke eminye imisila ye-fatty acid.
distractor28a: Ama-phospholipids angama-molecule e-lipophilic. Ikhanda elise-polar libheke emanzini kanti imisila ye-nonpolar fatty acid ibheke eminye imisila ye-fatty acid.
distractor28b: Ama-phospholipids angama-molecule ahlala emanzini. Ikhanda elingeyona i-polar libheke kweminye imisila ye-fatty acid kanti imisila ye-polar fatty acid ibheke emanzini.
distractor28c: Ama-phospholipids angama-molecule athanda amanzi. Ikhanda elisezindaweni eziphansi libheke emanzini kanti imisila ye-fatty acid engeyona eyezimpondo ibheke eminye imisila ye-fatty acid.
question29: Imodeli ye-mosaic ewuketshezi ichaze i-plasma membrane, ebonakala lapha, njenge-mosaic yezingxenye. Kungani kunenzuzo ukuthi i-plasma membrane ibe uketshezi ngokwemvelo (Isithombe 5.27)?

distractor29b: Ukugeleza kwamanzi kusiza ekugcineni i-pH yoketshezi olungaphakathi kweseli, futhi kusiza ekugcineni i-pH yomzimba weseli.
distractor29c: Ukugeleza kwamanzi kusiza ekuhlinzekeni amandla okusebenza kulwelwesi lwe-plasma
question30: Bhala izingxenye ezine ze-plasma membrane bese uchaza umsebenzi wazo
answer30: Ama-phospholipid: akha i-bilayer; Ama-carbohydrate: asiza ekunamatheleni; I-cholesterol: inikeza ukuguquguquka; Amaprotheni ahlanganisiwe: akha abathuthi; Amaprotheni aseceleni: ingxenye yezindawo zokuqaphela iseli

distractor30b: Ama-phospholipid: akha ungqimba oluyi-bilayer; Ama-carbohydrate: ingxenye yezindawo zokuqaphela iseli; I-cholesterol: inikeza ukuguquguquka kolwelwesi; Amaprotheni ahlanganisiwe: abumba abathuthi; Izintambo eziphakathi: ziyasiza ekunamatheleni

question31: Iyiphi incazelo ekhomba ukuthi okulandelayo kuthinta kanjani izinga lokusabalala: usayizi wama-molecule, izinga lokushisa, ubuningi besisombululo, kanye nebanga okumele lihanjwe?
answer31: Ama-molecule amakhulu ahamba kancane kunama-molecule alula. Ukwanda noma ukwehla kwezinga lokushisa kwandisa noma kunciphisa amandla endaweni ephakathi, okuthinta ukunyakaza kwama-molecule. Ubuningi buhambisana nokunyakaza kwama-molecule. Ibanga elikhulu linciphisa ukusabalala
distractor31a: Ama-molecule amakhulu ahamba ngokushesha kunama-molecule alula. Izinga lokushisa lithinta ukunyakaza kwama-molecule. Ubuningi buhambisana ngqo nokunyakaza kwama-molecule. Ibanga elikhulu linciphisa ukusabalala
distractor31b: Ama-molecule amakhulu ahamba kancane kunama-molecule alula. Izinga lokushisa alithinti izinga lokusabalala. Ubuningi buhambisana nokunyakaza kwama-molecule. Ibanga elikhulu lisheshisa ukusabalala
distractor31c: Ama-molecule amakhulu ahamba kancane kunama-molecule alula. Ukwanda noma ukwehla kwezinga lokushisa kwandisa noma kunciphisa amandla endaweni ephakathi, okuthinta ukunyakaza kwama-molecule. Ubuningi buhambisana nokunyakaza kwama-molecule. Ibanga elikhulu lisheshisa ukusabalala
question32: Zombili izixazululo ezivamile ezifakwa ngemithambo yegazi kwezokwelapha, i-saline evamile kanye ne-Ringer’s solution elactated, ziyi-isotonic, njengoba kuboniswe esithombeni esiphakathi lapha. Kungani lokhu kubalulekile (Isithombe 5.28)?

distractor32b: Izixazululo ze-Isotonic zandisa i-pH yegazi futhi zivumela ukumuncwa okungcono kwe-saline egazini
distractor32c: Izixazululo ze-Isotonic zehlisa i-pH yegazi futhi zigwema ukushintshaniswa kwezinto eziya noma ezivela egazini.
question33: Uma udokotela ejova isiguli ngalokho okwakubhalwe ukuthi isisombululo se-isotonic saline, kodwa isiguli sife, bese kuhlolwa isidumbu sembula ukuthi amangqamuzana egazi abomvu amaningana eziguli aqhumile, njengasesithombeni esingakwesokudla, kungaba yiqiniso yini ukuthi isisombululo esijovwe ngempela sasiyi-isotonic? question34: Iphampu ye-sodium-potassium ifaka kanjani isandla ekushajeni okungalungile kwangaphakathi kweseli?

question35: I-Potassium iyisakhi esidingekayo ukuze kugcinwe ukusebenza kwamaseli ethu. Yini engenzeka kumuntu ontula i-potassium?

question36: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza izinqubo ze-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor, i-exocytosis, kanye nezinguquko enhlanganweni ye-membrane ezihilelekile kuzo zonke?
answer36: I-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor ihilela ukubopha kwe-ligand ku-receptor yayo, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwe-vesicle eboshwe nge-clathrin engena esitokisini. Ku-exocytosis, izinto ezilahliwe zimbozwe yi-vesicle ehlangana nengaphakathi le-plasma membrane ngamaprotheni okunamathisela.
distractor36a: Ku-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor, imfucuza imbozwe ulwelwesi oluhlangana nengaphakathi lolwelwesi lwe-plasma ngamaprotheni okunamathisela. I-Exocytosis ihilela ukuhlanganiswa kwe-receptor kanye ne-ligand yayo kuma-vesicles ambozwe yi-clathrin.
distractor36b: Ku-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor, imfucuza imbozwe ulwelwesi oluhlangana nengaphakathi lolwelwesi lwe-plasma ngamaprotheni okunamathisela. I-Exocytosis ihilela ukuhlanganiswa kwe-receptor kanye ne-ligand yayo kuma-vesicles ambozwe nge-caveolae.
distractor36c: I-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor ihilela i-opsonization ye-receptor kanye ne-ligand yayo kuma-vesicles ambozwe yi-clathrin. Ku-exocytosis, imfucuza imbozwe ulwelwesi oluhlangana nengaphandle lolwelwesi lwe-plasma ngamaprotheni okunamathisela.
question37: Chaza inqubo ye-potocytosis. Ihluke kanjani ku-pinocytosis?
answer37: I-Potocytosis uhlobo lwe-endocytosis oluqondiswa yi-receptor lapho ama-molecule ethuthwa khona ngama-vesicles ambozwe nge-caveolae. I-Pinocytosis uhlobo lwe-endocytosis olusetshenziselwa ukumunca uketshezi olungaphandle kweseli.
distractor37a: I-Potocytosis uhlobo lwe-endocytosis oluqondiswa yi-receptor lapho ama-molecule ethuthwa khona ngama-vesicles ambozwe nge-caveolae. I-Pinocytosis uhlobo lwe-exocytosis olusetshenziselwa ukukhipha amanzi amaningi
distractor37b: I-Potocytosis uhlobo lwe-exocytosis lapho ama-molecule ethuthwa khona ngama-vesicles ambozwe yi-clathrin. I-Pinocytosis uhlobo lwe-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor esetshenziselwa ukukhipha amanzi amaningi.
distractor37c: I-Potocytosis uhlobo lwe-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor esetshenziselwa ukumunca amanzi
question38: Bheka Umfanekiso 5.29. Iphampu ye-sodium-potassium (Na+/K+) isebenza njenge-antiporter ethutha i-Na+ ne-K+ kuwo wonke ama-membrane isebenzisa i-ATP. Le phrotheni ihlanganisa i-membrane ngezizinda zangaphakathi kweseli kanye nezangaphandle. Inendawo yokubopha i-Na+, K+, kanye ne-ATP. Amaseli okwenziwa adalwe futhi afakwa kuma-buffer aqukethe i-ATP, i-ouabain, i-Na+, kanye ne-K+ ngokuhlanganiswa okuhlukahlukene ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli njengoba kuboniswe eshadini. Ukuthuthwa kwe-Na+ kanye ne-K+ kwalinganiswa ukuze kunqunywe umsebenzi wephampu ye-Na+/K+. Yisiphi seziphetho ezilandelayo esisekelwa yidatha?
answer38: Indawo yokubopha i-ATP yephampu ye-Na+/K+ itholakala endaweni yangaphakathi kweseli yephampu.
distractor38a: I-Ouabain ayiphazamisi ukubopha kwe-ATP kuphampu ye-Na+/K+
distractor38b: I-ATP iyadingeka ekuthuthweni kwe-Na+ hhayi ekuthuthweni kwe-K+
distractor38c: Indawo yokubopha i-ATP yephampu ye-Na+/K+ itholakala endaweni yangaphandle yephampu.
question39: Bheka uMfanekiso 5.30. Ama-Paramecia angama-protist e-unicellular anama-vacuole akhipha amanzi angaphezulu kwamangqamuzana. Ocwaningweni lokuhlola, ama-Paramecia afakwa ezixazululweni zikasawoti ezikhulisa i-osmolarity. Izinga lapho i-Parameciums contractile vacuole ithola khona amandla okukhipha amanzi angaphezulu lanqunywa futhi labekwa ngokumelene ne-osmolarity yezixazululo. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyincazelo efanele yedatha?
answer39: Izinga lokufinyela liyanda njengoba i-osmolarity incipha ngoba inani lamanzi angena ku-Paramecium nge-osmosis liyanda.
distractor39a: Uma i-osmolarity iphezulu, amazinga aphansi okufinyela ayadingeka ngoba usawoti omningi uyasakazeka ku-Paramecium
distractor39b: Esixazululweni sikasawoti se-isosmotic, akukho ukusabalala kwamanzi angene noma aphume ku-Paramecium, ngakho-ke izinga lokufinyela lingu-zero
distractor39c: I-vacuole evuvukalayo ayisebenzi kahle ezixazululweni ze-osmolarity ephezulu ngenxa yenani eliphansi le-ATP elikhiqizwa ngokuphefumula kwamaseli.
question40: Bheka uMfanekiso 5.31. Yini engenzeka kakhulu uma i-Paramecia isuswa esixazululweni se-hypertonic iye ezixazululweni ze-osmolarity enciphayo?
answer40: Izinga lokufinyela lingakhula ngokuncipha kwe-osmolarity ngoba amanzi amaningi ayasakazeka ku-Paramecium
distractor40a: Izinga lokufinyela lizoncipha ngokuncipha kwe-osmolarity ngoba amanzi amaningi ayasakazeka ku-Paramecium
distractor40b: Izinga lokufinyela lingakhula ngokuncipha kwe-osmolarity ngoba usawoti omningi usakazeka ku-Paramecium
distractor40c: Izinga lokufinyela lizoncipha ngokuncipha kwe-osmolarity ngoba usawoti omningi uyasakazeka ku-Paramecium
question41: Bheka uMfanekiso 5.29. Chaza iphampu ye-Na+/K+, ubhale izindawo zokubopha ze-Na+, K+, kanye ne-ATP. Chaza ukuthi idatha ikhombisa kanjani indawo yezindawo zokubopha ze-Na+ kanye ne-K+ ephampuni. Ngokusekelwe kudatha, yisiphi isitatimende esichaza indawo yezindawo zokubopha ze-Na+ kanye ne-K+ ephampuni?
answer41: Ukubopha kwe-K+ kwenzeka ebusweni bangaphandle beseli, njengoba ukuthuthwa kwayo kuvinjiwe lapho i-ouabain ikhona ngaphandle kweseli. Ukubopha kwe-Na+ kwenzeka ebusweni bangaphakathi beseli futhi ukuthuthwa kwayo kuvinjiwe ukuba khona kwe-ouabain.
distractor41a: Ukubopha kwe-Na+ kwenzeka ebusweni bangaphandle beseli, njengoba ukuthuthwa kwayo kungathinteki ukuba khona kwe-ouabain. Ukubopha kwe-K+ kwenzeka ebusweni bangaphakathi beseli, njengoba ukuthuthwa kwayo kuvinjiwe lapho i-ouabain ikhona ngaphakathi beseli.
distractor41b: Ukubopha kwe-K+ kwenzeka ebusweni bangaphandle bese kuthi ukubopha kwe-Na+ kwenzeke ebusweni bangaphakathi beseli, njengoba kungathuthwa uma i-ATP ingekho.
distractor41c: Ukubopha kwe-Na+ kwenzeka ebusweni bangaphandle bese kuthi ukubopha kwe-K+ kwenzeke ebusweni bangaphakathi beseli, njengoba kungathuthwa uma i-ATP ingekho.
question42: Bheka uMfanekiso 5.32. Isikhwama sepayipi le-dialysis esine-lactose engu-5% kanye ne-fructose engu-5% safakwa ebhodleleni lamanzi acwecwe. Ngemva kwamahora amane, i-fructose itholakala emanzini acwecwe ngaphandle kwesikhwama sepayipi le-dialysis, kodwa i-lactose ayitholakali. Yiziphi iziphetho ezingase zenziwe mayelana nokuhamba kwama-molecule kulolu cwaningo?
answer42: I-Fructose, eyi-monosaccharide, isakazeka ngesikhwama se-dialysis iye emanzini acwengekile. Kodwa-ke, i-lactose, njengoba iyi-disaccharide, ayikwazanga ukusakazeka ngesikhwama se-dialysis.
distractor42a: I-Fructose yaguqulwa yaba yi-lactose, okuvumela i-fructose ukuthi isakazeke ngesikhwama se-dialysis iye emanzini acwengekile. I-Lactose ayiguqulwa yaba yi-homogenized, ngakho-ke yayingeke idlule ngesikhwama se-dialysis.
distractor42b: I-Fructose ne-lactose zishaja ngendlela ephikisanayo futhi zihlukaniswe ngenxa yamandla okuxosha.
distractor42c: I-Fructose isakazeka ngenxa yokwakheka kwembobo ye-membrane engangeniswa yi-semi-permeable, hhayi ngenxa yokuphakama kwayo kokuhlushwa.
question43: Bheka uMfanekiso 5.33. Lesi yisakhiwo se-clathrin esingu-3D, esine-subunit eyodwa egqanyiswe ngombala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Iyini imbangela esebenzayo yalesi sakhiwo?
answer43: I-Clathrin iqinisa ingxenye yolwelwesi oludala i-vesicle
distractor43b: Ama-subunit e-clathrin axhumene ahlinzeka ngesakhiwo seseli esiqinile
question44: Yisiphi kulezi zitatimende ezilandelayo esichaza kahle indima ye-clathrin kuma-neutrophils ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni kwakho i-phagocytosis?
answer44: I-Clathrin iqinisa ubuso obubheke ngaphakathi kwe-plasma membrane, obugubha i-antigen
distractor44c: I-Clathrin iphawula i-antigen esiseleni esihlaselayo ukuze ithole i-phagocytosis ngama-neutrophils
question45: Amaseli e-mast akhiqiza izimpawu ezivuselela ukuvuvukala. Ama-neutrophils angamaseli egazi amhlophe e-phagocytic. Ama-monocyte uhlobo olukhulu kakhulu lwamaseli amhlophe egazi agubha amagciwane. Ngokusekelwe olwazini olunikeziwe, yiziphi izinhlobo zamaseli ezikhiqiza ama-endosome?

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwemetabolism | 6.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwemetabolism | 6.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Cishe yonke imisebenzi eyenziwa izinto eziphilayo idinga amandla. Amandla ayadingeka ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi onzima nokuzivocavoca. Abantu basebenzisa amandla amaningi ngenkathi becabanga ngisho nalapho belele. Eqinisweni, amangqamuzana aphilayo azo zonke izinto eziphilayo asebenzisa amandla njalo. Izakhamzimba namanye ama-molecule angeniswa, ahlanzwe (aphulwe), ahlanganiswe abe ama-molecule amasha, aguqulwe uma kudingeka, athuthwe azungeze iseli, futhi, kwezinye izimo, asatshalaliswe kuyo yonke into ephilayo. Isibonelo, amaprotheni amakhulu akha imisipha akhiwe ngenkuthalo ngama-molecule amancane. Ama-carbohydrate ayinkimbinkimbi ahlukaniswa abe ushukela olula osetshenziswa yiseli ukuze abe namandla. Njengoba nje amandla edingeka ekwakheni nasekubhidlizeni isakhiwo, amandla ayadingeka kokubili ukwakheka nokudiliza ama-molecule. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-molecule okubonisa izimpawu njengama-hormone nama-neurotransmitter athuthwa ngenkuthalo phakathi kwamangqamuzana. Amabhaktheriya namagciwane abangela izifo agwinywa futhi aphulwe ngamaseli. Amaseli kumele futhi athumele imfucuza kanye nobuthi ukuze ahlale ephilile. Amaseli amaningi ayabhukuda noma ashukumise izinto ezizungezile ngokunyakaza okushayayo kwezitho zamaseli njenge-cilia kanye ne-flagella.

 Zonke izinqubo zamaseli ezibalwe ngenhla zidinga ukuhlinzekwa kwamandla okuqhubekayo. La mandla avela kuphi, futhi ngaluphi uhlobo,? Amangqamuzana aphilayo athola kanjani amandla futhi awasebenzisa kanjani? Lesi sahluko sizoxoxa ngezinhlobo ezahlukene zamandla kanye nemithetho yemvelo elawula ukudluliswa kwamandla.

 Indlela ama-enzyme anciphisa ngayo amandla okusebenza adingekayo ukuqala ukusabela kwamakhemikhali emzimbeni kuzoxoxwa ngakho kulesi sahluko. Ama-enzyme abalulekile empilweni; ngaphandle kwawo ukusabela kwamakhemikhali okudingekayo ukuze kuphile bekungeke kwenzeke ngokushesha ngokwanele ukuze into ephilayo iphile. Isibonelo, kumuntu ontula enye yama-enzyme adingekayo ukuphula uhlobo lwe-carbohydrate olwaziwa ngokuthi i-mucopolysaccharide, imikhiqizo engcolile iqoqana emaseli futhi ibangele ukulimala kobuchopho okuqhubekayo. Lesi sifo esibulalayo sezakhi zofuzo sibizwa ngokuthi i-Sanfilippo Syndrome type B noma i-Mucopolysaccharidosis III. Ngaphambilini, ososayensi sebethole indlela yokufaka esikhundleni se-enzyme engekho ebuchosheni bamagundane.
question1: Yini edingwa cishe yiyo yonke imisebenzi yeselula?
answer1: Amandla
question2: Yikuphi kwezinqubo zamaseli ezilandelayo okudinga amandla?
question3: I-Metabolism ihlanganisa yikuphi okulandelayo?
answer3: Kokubili ukuwohloka kwama-molecule kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwama-molecule amasha
question4: Kungani ama-enzyme ebalulekile empilweni?
answer4: Zehlisa amandla okusebenza kokusabela kwamakhemikhali ukuze ukusabela kwenzeke ngokushesha ngokwanele ukuze kuqhubeke nokuphila
question5: Kwenzekani ku-Sanfilippo Syndrome uhlobo B (Mucopolysaccharidosis III)?
answer5: I-enzyme engekho ivimbela ukuwohloka kwe-mucopolysaccharide, okubangela ukuthi imfucuza iqoqeke futhi ilimaze ubuchopho ngokuqhubekayo
distractor5a: I-enzyme enephutha ivimbela ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP ku-mitochondria
distractor5b: Iphrotheni yolwelwesi olungekho ivimbela ukumuncwa kweglucose
distractor5c: Ukuguquka kwesimo kubangela ukuthi amangqamuzana abomvu egazi aqhume emanzini ahlanzekile

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka kwe-Metabolism | 6.1 Amandla kanye nokwakheka kwe-Metabolism | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6.1 Amandla kanye neMetabolism | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo, kusukela kumaseli alula kuya ezindaweni eziyinkimbinkimbi, zidinga amandla amahhala ukuze ziqhube izinqubo zamaseli njengokukhula nokuzala.

 Izinto eziphilayo ziye zathuthukisa amasu ahlukahlukene okubamba, ukugcina, ukuguqula, nokudlulisa amandla amahhala. I-metabolism yeseli ibhekisela ekusabeleni kwamakhemikhali okwenzeka ngaphakathi kwayo. Ezinye izindlela zokwenza umzimba zihilela ukuhlukaniswa kwama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi abe alula ngokukhululwa kwamandla (i-catabolism), kanti ezinye izindlela zokwenza umzimba zidinga amandla ukwakha ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi (i-anabolism). Isibonelo esiyinhloko salezi zindlela ukuhlanganiswa nokuqhekeka kwe-glucose.

 Okuqukethwe okuvezwe kulesi sigaba kusekela izinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 1 kanye no-Big Idea 2 wohlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum olungezansi. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® zihlanganisa okuqukethwe koLwazi Olubalulekile nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa. Lezi zinhloso zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho kwelebhu okusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa ye-AP®.

 I-Big Idea 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.B
Izinto eziphilayo zixhunyaniswe yimigqa yozalo oluvela kubazali abafanayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.B.1 Izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezinqubo eziningi ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezavela futhi zasakazeka kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo namuhla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.14 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubuza imibuzo yesayensi ekhomba ngokunembile izakhiwo ezibalulekile zezinqubo zokuphila ezihlanganyelwe, eziyinhloko ezinikeza ukuqonda ngomlando wokuphila eMhlabeni.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.B.1 Izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezinqubo eziningi ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezavela futhi zasakazeka kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo namuhla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesizinda (izizinda) ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuhlala njalo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza izibonelo ezithile zezinqubo zezinto eziphilayo ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezabiwe yizo zonke izizinda noma ngaphakathi kwesizinda esisodwa sokuphila, nokuthi lezi zinqubo kanye nezici ezigciniwe ezabiwe, ezigciniwe zisekela kanjani umqondo wozalo oluvamile lwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.1 Umfundi angathethelela izimangalo ngobufakazi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.16 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuthethelela isitatimende sesayensi sokuthi izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezinqubo eziningi ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezavela futhi zasakazwa kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo namuhla.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka amandla amahhala njalo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obukhiqizwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa kanjani amandla amahhala ngokusekelwe kudatha yobufakazi yokuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka amandla njalo ukuze zilondoloze ukuhleleka, zikhule futhi zizale.
Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Kwesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[I-APLO 2.1][I-APLO 2.3][I-APLO 4.3][I-APLO 4.15][I-APLO 4.17][I-APLO 2.21]

 Ososayensi basebenzisa igama elithi bioenergetics ukuxoxa ngomqondo wokugeleza kwamandla (Isithombe 6.2) ngezinhlelo eziphilayo, njengamaseli. Izinqubo zamaseli ezifana nokwakhiwa nokudilizwa kwama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi zenzeka ngokusabela kwamakhemikhali okuhamba kancane. Ezinye zalezi zindlela zamakhemikhali ziyazenzekela futhi zikhulula amandla, kanti ezinye zidinga amandla ukuze ziqhubeke. Njengoba nje izinto eziphilayo kumele zidle ukudla njalo ukuze zigcwalise lokho okusetshenzisiwe, amaseli kumele akhiqize amandla amaningi njalo ukuze agcwalise lawo asetshenziswa yizindlela eziningi zamakhemikhali ezidinga amandla ezenzeka njalo. Zonke izindlela zamakhemikhali ezenzeka ngaphakathi kwamaseli, kufaka phakathi lezo ezisebenzisa amandla kanye nalezo ezikhulula amandla, ziyi-metabolism yeseli

answer5: Umqondo wokugeleza kwamandla ezinhlotsheni eziphilayo, njengamaseli
distractor5a: Ukuhamba kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo ngezinhlelo eziphilayo

answer6: Ezinye izimpendulo zamakhemikhali ziyazenzekela futhi zikhipha amandla, kanti ezinye zidinga amandla ukuze ziqhubeke
distractor6a: Zonke izimpendulo zamakhemikhali zidinga amandla ukuze ziqhubeke
distractor6c: Ukusabela okubandakanya i-ATP kuphela okwenzeka ngokuzenzakalelayo
question7: Kungani amangqamuzana kumele aqhubeke ekhiqiza amandla engeziwe?
answer7: Ukugcwalisa lokho okusetshenziswa yimiphumela eminingi yamakhemikhali edinga amandla eyenzeka njalo
question8: Iyini i-metabolism yeseli?
answer8: Zonke izimpendulo zamakhemikhali ezenzeka ngaphakathi kwamaseli, okuhlanganisa lezo ezisebenzisa amandla kanye nalezo ezikhipha amandla

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 6.1 Amandla Nokwakheka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ukwakheka Kwezinto Eziphilayo Zama-carbohydrate
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6.1 Amandla kanye neMetabolism | IMetabolism yama-carbohydrate
chapterContent:
Ukuguqulwa kukashukela (i-carbohydrate elula) kuyisibonelo esivamile sezinqubo eziningi zamaseli ezisebenzisa futhi zikhiqize amandla. Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa ushukela njengomthombo omkhulu wamandla, ngoba ama-molecule kashukela anamandla amaningi agcinwe ngaphakathi kwezibopho zawo. Ukuwohloka kwe-glucose, ushukela olula, kuchazwa yi-equation:

 C6⁢H12⁢O6+6O2→6⁢CO2+6H2⁢O+amandla
Ama-carbohydrate adliwayo avela ezintweni eziphilayo ezenza i-photosynthesis njengezitshalo (Isithombe 6.3). Ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis, izitshalo zisebenzisa amandla okukhanya kwelanga ukuguqula igesi ye-carbon dioxide (CO2) ibe ama-molecule kashukela, njenge-glucose (C6H12O6). Ngenxa yokuthi le nqubo ihilela ukuhlanganiswa kwe-molecule enkulu, egcina amandla, idinga ukufakwa kwamandla ukuze kuqhubeke. Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-glucose kuchazwa yi-equation (qaphela ukuthi kuphambene ne-equation yangaphambilini):

 6CO2+6H2⁢O+amandla→C6⁢H12⁢O6+6O2
Ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwamakhemikhali kwe-photosynthesis, amandla anikezwa ngesimo se-molecule enamandla kakhulu ebizwa ngokuthi i-ATP, noma i-adenosine triphosphate, okuyimali yamandla eyinhloko yawo wonke amaseli. Njengoba nje idola lisetshenziswa njengohlobo lwemali ukuthenga izimpahla, amaseli asebenzisa ama-molecule e-ATP njengohlobo lwemali yamandla ukwenza umsebenzi osheshayo. Ushukela (i-glucose) ugcinwa njengesitashi noma i-glycogen. Ama-polymer agcina amandla afana nalawa ahlukaniswa abe yi-glucose ukuze anikeze ama-molecule e-ATP.

 Amandla elanga ayadingeka ukuze kuhlanganiswe i-molecule ye-glucose ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwe-photosynthesis. Ku-photosynthesis, amandla okukhanya avela elangeni aguqulwa ekuqaleni abe amandla amakhemikhali agcinwa okwesikhashana kuma-molecule athwala amandla i-ATP ne-NADPH (i-nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate). Amandla agcinwe ku-ATP naku-NADPH abese esetshenziswa kamuva ku-photosynthesis ukwakha i-molecule eyodwa ye-glucose kusuka kuma-molecule ayisithupha e-CO2. Le nqubo ifana nokudla isidlo sasekuseni ekuseni ukuze uthole amandla omzimba wakho angasetshenziswa kamuva ngosuku. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezinhle, amandla avela kuma-molecule angu-18 e-ATP ayadingeka ukuze kuhlanganiswe i-molecule eyodwa ye-glucose ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwe-photosynthesis. Ama-molecule e-glucose angahlanganiswa futhi aguqulwe abe ezinye izinhlobo zikashukela. Lapho ushukela udliwa, ama-molecule e-glucose agcina engene esitokisini ngasinye esiphilayo sezinto eziphilayo. Ngaphakathi kweseli, i-molecule ngayinye kashukela ihlukaniswa ngochungechunge oluyinkimbinkimbi lokusabela kwamakhemikhali. Umgomo walezi zindlela zokusabela ukuqoqa amandla agcinwe ngaphakathi kwama-molecule kashukela. Amandla avuniwe asetshenziselwa ukwenza ama-molecule e-ATP anamandla aphezulu, angasetshenziswa ukwenza umsebenzi, anikeze amandla ukusabela kwamakhemikhali amaningi esitokisini. Inani lamandla adingekayo ukwenza i-molecule eyodwa ye-glucose kusuka kuma-molecule ayisithupha e-carbon dioxide ama-molecule angu-18 e-ATP nama-molecule angu-12 e-NADPH (ngalinye lawo lilingana ngamandla nama-molecule amathathu e-ATP), noma inani eliphelele lama-molecule angu-54 e-ATP adingekayo ukuze kuhlanganiswe i-molecule eyodwa ye-glucose. Le nqubo iyindlela eyisisekelo nephumelelayo yamaseli yokukhiqiza amandla ama-molecule awadingayo.
question1: Kungani izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa ushukela njengomthombo omkhulu wamandla?
answer1: Ama-molecule kashukela anamandla amaningi agcinwe ngaphakathi kwezibopho zawo
distractor1b: Ama-molecule kashukela aqukethe umoya-mpilo odingwa amaseli

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwemetabolism | 6.1 Amandla Nokwakheka Kwemetabolism | Izindlela Zokwakheka Kwemetabolism
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6.1 Amandla kanye neMetabolism | Izindlela zeMetabolism
chapterContent:
Izinqubo zokwenza nokuphula ama-molecule kashukela zibonisa izinhlobo ezimbili zezindlela ze-metabolic. Indlela ye-metabolic iwuchungechunge lwezindlela ze-biochemical ezixhumene eziguqula i-molecule noma ama-molecule e-substrate, isinyathelo ngesinyathelo, ngochungechunge lwezindlela ze-metabolic intermediates, ekugcineni ziveza umkhiqizo wokugcina noma imikhiqizo. Endabeni ye-metabolism kashukela, indlela yokuqala ye-metabolic yahlanganisa ushukela kusuka kuma-molecule amancane, kanti enye indlela yahlukanisa ushukela ibe ama-molecule amancane. Lezi zinqubo ezimbili eziphikisanayo—eyokuqala edinga amandla kanye neyesibili ekhiqiza amandla—zibizwa ngokuthi izindlela ze-anabolic (ukwakha) kanye nezindlela ze-catabolic (ukubhidliza), ngokulandelana. Ngenxa yalokho, i-metabolism yakhiwa ukwakha (i-anabolism) kanye nokudilizwa (i-catabolism).

 Ukuxhumana Kokuziphendukela Kwemvelo
Ukuguquka Kwezindlela Ze-Metabolism
Kunokuningi ebunzimeni be-metabolism kunokuqonda izindlela ze-metabolic zodwa. Ubunzima be-metabolic buyahlukahluka kusuka kokwemvelo kuya kokwemvelo. I-Photosynthesis iyindlela eyinhloko lapho izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis ezifana nezitshalo (iningi le-photosynthesis yomhlaba wonke lenziwa yi-planktonic algae) zivuna amandla elanga bese ziwaguqula abe ama-carbohydrate. Umkhiqizo ophumayo we-photosynthesis umoya-mpilo, odingwa amanye amangqamuzana ukuze enze ukuphefumula kwamaseli. Ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaseli, umoya-mpilo uyasiza ekuqhekekeni kwe-carbon com amakhilogremu, njengama-carbohydrate. Phakathi kwemikhiqizo yalokhu ku-catabolism kukhona i-CO2 ne-ATP. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amanye ama-eukaryote enza izinqubo ze-catabolic ngaphandle komoya-mpilo (ukuvutshelwa); okungukuthi, enza noma asebenzisa i-anaerobic metabolism.

 Izinto eziphilayo cishe zashintsha i-anaerobic metabolism ukuze zisinde (izinto eziphilayo zaba khona cishe eminyakeni eyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-3.8 edlule, lapho umkhathi wawuntula umoya-mpilo). Naphezu komehluko phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nobunzima be-metabolism, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi wonke amagatsha okuphila anezinye zezindlela ezifanayo ze-metabolic, okuphakamisa ukuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zavela kukhokho ofanayo wasendulo (Isithombe 6.4). Ubufakazi bubonisa ukuthi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindlela zahlukana, zengeza ama-enzyme akhethekile ukuvumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zivumelane kangcono nendawo yazo, ngaleyo ndlela zandisa amathuba azo okusinda. Kodwa-ke, isimiso esiyisisekelo sisalokhu sithi zonke izinto eziphilayo kumele zivune amandla endaweni yazo futhi ziwaguqulele ku-ATP ukuze zenze imisebenzi yamaseli.

 Izindlela ze-Anabolic zidinga ukufaka amandla ukuze kwakhiwe ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi kusuka kwalula. Ukuhlanganisa ushukela kusuka ku-CO2 kuyisibonelo esisodwa. Ezinye izibonelo ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni amakhulu kusuka kumabhulokhi okwakha ama-amino acid, kanye nokwakheka kwezintambo ezintsha ze-DNA kusuka kumabhulokhi okwakha i-nucleic acid. Lezi zinqubo ze-biosynthetic zibalulekile empilweni yeseli, zenzeka njalo, futhi zidinga amandla anikezwa yi-ATP namanye ama-molecule anamandla aphezulu njenge-NADH (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) kanye ne-NADPH (Isithombe 6.5).

 I-ATP iyi-molecule ebalulekile ukuthi amaseli abe nokunikezwa okwanele ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ukuqhekeka koshukela kubonisa ukuthi i-molecule eyodwa ye-glucose ingagcina kanjani amandla anele ukwenza i-ATP eningi, ama-molecule angu-36 kuya kwangu-38. Lena yindlela ye-catabolic. Izindlela ze-catabolic zihilela ukuwohloka (noma ukuqhekeka) kwama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi abe alula. Amandla ama-molecule agcinwe ezibophweni zama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi akhishwa ezindleleni ze-catabolic futhi avunwe ngendlela yokuthi angasetshenziswa ukukhiqiza i-ATP. Amanye ama-molecule agcina amandla, njengamafutha, nawo ahlukaniswa ngokusebenzisa ukusabela okufanayo kwe-catabolic ukuze kukhishwe amandla futhi kwenziwe i-ATP (Isithombe 6.5).

 Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kwezindlela ze-metabolic akwenzeki ngokuzenzakalelayo. Isinyathelo ngasinye sokusabela senziwa lula, noma siqaliswe, yiprotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-enzyme. Ama-enzyme abalulekile ekuqalisweni kwazo zonke izinhlobo zokusabela kwezinto eziphilayo—lezo ezidinga amandla kanye nalezo ezikhipha amandla

question15: Bheka uMfanekiso 6.4. Siyazi ukuthi umkhathi wakuqala wawuntula umoya-mpilo. Yisiphi isimangalo esingenziwa kangcono ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi kanye nokuqonda kwakho ukuthi uMhlaba wavela kanjani?
answer15: I-oksijini iwumkhiqizo we-photosynthesis, ngakho-ke kwakunomoya-mpilo omncane kakhulu emkhathini kwaze kwaba yilapho izinto eziphilayo ezikhiqiza i-photosynthesis zishintsha.

distractor15b: I-oksijini iwumkhiqizo ophuma ekuvuthweni, ngakho-ke kwakunomoya-mpilo omncane emkhathini kwaze kwaba yilapho kuvela ama-prokaryotes.
distractor15c: I-oxygen iwumphumela wokuphefumula kwe-aerobic, ngakho-ke kwakunomoya-mpilo omncane kakhulu emkhathini kwaze kwaba yilapho izilwane zishintsha.

chapterContent:
Nakuba amangqamuzana nezinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla amahhala ukuze ziphile, azikwazi ukudala amandla ngokuzenzekelayo, njengoba kushiwo eMthethweni Wokulondolozwa Kwamandla. Amandla atholakala ngezindlela ezahlukene. Isibonelo, izinto ezihambayo zinamandla e-kinetic, kanti izinto ezingahambiyo zinamandla angase abe khona. Amandla amakhemikhali kuma-molecule, njenge-glucose, angamandla angase abe khona ngoba lapho izibopho ziphuka ekuphenduleni kwamakhemikhali, amandla amahhala ayakhishwa. Amandla amahhala ayisilinganiso samandla atholakalayo ukuze enze umsebenzi. Amandla amahhala esistimu ayashintsha ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwamandla njengokusabela kwamakhemikhali, futhi lolu shintsho lubizwa ngokuthi amandla amahhala e-ΔG noma e-Gibbs. I-ΔG yokusabela ingaba yimbi noma ibe yinhle, kuye ngokuthi ukusabela kukhipha amandla (i-exergonic) noma kudinga ukufaka amandla (i-endergonic). Zonke izimpendulo zidinga ukufaka amandla okubizwa ngokuthi amandla okusebenza ukuze kufinyelelwe esimweni sokuguquka lapho zizoqhubeka khona. (Kwesinye isigaba, sizohlola ukuthi ama-enzyme asheshisa kanjani ukusabela kwamakhemikhali ngokunciphisa izithiyo zamandla okusebenza.)

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni imiqondo yokusekela kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yohlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka njalo amandla amahhala.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obukhiqizwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa kanjani amandla amahhala ngokusekelwe kudatha yobufakazi yokuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla angenawo njalo ukuze zilondoloze ukuhleleka, ukukhula, nokuzala.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga amandla angenawo njalo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angathethelela izimangalo ngobufakazi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.2 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuthethelela isimangalo sesayensi sokuthi amandla angenawo ayadingeka ukuze izinhlelo eziphilayo zilondoloze ukuhleleka, ukukhula noma ukuzala, kodwa ukuthi amasu amaningi akhona ezinhlelweni eziphilayo ezahlukene.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Kwesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[I-APLO 2.5]

 Amandla achazwa njengekhono lokwenza umsebenzi. Njengoba usufundile, amandla akhona ngezindlela ezahlukene. Isibonelo, amandla kagesi, amandla okukhanya, kanye namandla okushisa konke kuyizinhlobo ezahlukene zamandla. Nakuba lezi zonke kuyizinhlobo zamandla ezijwayelekile umuntu angazibona noma azizwe, kukhona olunye uhlobo lwamandla olungabonakali kangako. Lawa mandla ahlotshaniswa nento elula njengento ebanjwe ngaphezu komhlaba. Ukuze siqonde indlela amandla ageleza ngayo angene futhi aphume ngayo ezinhlelweni zezinto eziphilayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda kabanzi ngezinhlobo ezahlukene zamandla ezikhona emhlabeni ongokoqobo.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwemetabolism | 6.2 Amandla Angaba Khona, Angakhi, Akhululekile, kanye Nokusebenza | Izinhlobo Zamandla
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6.2 Amandla Angaba Khona, Angakhi, Akhululekile, kanye Nokusebenza | Izinhlobo Zamandla
chapterContent:
Uma into inyakaza, kunamandla ahambisana naleyo nto. Esibonelweni sendiza endizeni, kunamandla amaningi ahambisana nokunyakaza kwendiza. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinto ezihambayo ziyakwazi ukwenza ushintsho, noma ukwenza umsebenzi. Cabanga ngebhola eliphahlazekayo. Ngisho nebhola eliphahlazekayo elihamba kancane lingenza umonakalo omkhulu kwezinye izinto. Kodwa-ke, ibhola eliphahlazekayo elingashukumi alikwazi ukwenza umsebenzi. Amandla ahambisana nezinto ezihambayo abizwa ngokuthi amandla e-kinetic. Inhlamvu egijimayo, umuntu ohambayo, ukunyakaza okusheshayo kwama-molecule emoyeni (okukhiqiza ukushisa), kanye nemisebe kagesi njengokukhanya konke kunamandla e-kinetic.

 Manje kuthiwani uma lelo bhola elifanayo eliphahlazekayo elinganyakazi liphakanyiswa izitezi ezimbili ngaphezu kwemoto ene-crane? Uma ibhola eliphahlazekayo elilengayo lingashukumi, ingabe kukhona amandla ahambisana nalo? Impendulo inguyebo. Ibhola eliphahlazekayo elilengayo linamandla ahambisana nalo ahluke kakhulu kumandla e-kinetic ezinto ezihambayo. Lolu hlobo lwamandla luvela eqinisweni lokuthi kukhona ithuba lokuthi ibhola eliphahlazekayo lenze umsebenzi. Uma ikhishwa, empeleni izosebenza. Ngenxa yokuthi lolu hlobo lwamandla lubhekisela emandleni okwenza umsebenzi, lubizwa ngokuthi amandla angase abe khona. Izinto zidlulisela amandla azo phakathi kwe-kinetic kanye namandla angase abe khona ngale ndlela elandelayo: Njengoba ibhola eliphahlazekayo lilenga lingashukumi, linamandla angase abe khona angu-0 kinetic kanye namaphesenti ayi-100. Uma selikhishwe, amandla alo e-kinetic aqala ukwanda ngoba lakha isivinini ngenxa yamandla adonsela phansi. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, njengoba lisondela emhlabathini, lilahlekelwa amandla angase abe khona. Endaweni ethile phakathi nekwindla linamaphesenti angama-50 kinetic kanye namaphesenti angama-50 amandla angase abe khona. Ngaphambi nje kokuba lifike phansi, ibhola selicishe lilahlekelwe amandla alo angase abe khona futhi linamandla angase abe khona acishe abe maningi kakhulu e-kinetic. Ezinye izibonelo zamandla angase abe khona zifaka phakathi amandla amanzi abanjwe ngemuva kwedamu (Isithombe 6.6), noma umuntu oseduze nokuphuma endizeni.

 Amandla angase abe khona awahlotshaniswa nje kuphela nendawo yezinto (njengengane ehleli egatsheni lesihlahla), kodwa futhi nesakhiwo sezinto. Isiphethu emhlabathini sinamandla angase abe khona uma sicindezelwe; kanjalo nebhande lerabha elidonswayo liqinile. Ukuba khona kwamangqamuzana aphilayo kuncike kakhulu emandleni angase abe khona esakhiwo. Ezingeni lamakhemikhali, izibopho ezibamba ama-athomu ama-molecule ndawonye zinamandla angase abe khona. Khumbula ukuthi izindlela zamaseli ezisebenzisa i-anabolic zidinga amandla ukuze kwakhiwe ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi avela kwezilula, futhi izindlela ze-catabolic zikhipha amandla lapho ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi ephulwa. Iqiniso lokuthi amandla angakhishwa ngokuqhekeka kwezibopho ezithile zamakhemikhali lisho ukuthi lezo zibopho zinamandla angase abe khona. Eqinisweni, kukhona amandla angase abe khona agcinwe ngaphakathi kwezibopho zawo wonke ama-molecule okudla esiwadlayo, ekugcineni asetshenziswa ukuze asetshenziswe. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi lezi zibopho zingakhipha amandla lapho ziphukile. Uhlobo lwamandla angase abe khona ngaphakathi kwezibopho zamakhemikhali, futhi akhishwa lapho lezo zibopho ziphukile, lubizwa ngokuthi amandla amakhemikhali (Isithombe 6.7). Amandla amakhemikhali anesibopho sokuhlinzeka amangqamuzana aphilayo ngamandla avela ekudleni. Ukukhululwa kwamandla kulethwa ngokuphula izibopho zama-molecule ngaphakathi kwama-molecule kaphethiloli
question1: Yini ebizwa ngokuthi amandla ahlotshaniswa nezinto ezihambayo?
answer1: Amandla e-Kinetic
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okunamandla e-kinetic?
answer2: Inhlamvu egijima ngesivinini esikhulu, umuntu ohambayo, ukunyakaza okusheshayo kwama-molecule emoyeni (okukhiqiza ukushisa), kanye nemisebe kagesi njengokukhanya konke kunamandla e-kinetic
distractor2a: Izinto eziphilayo ezihambayo kuphela ezinamandla okuhamba
question3: Ngenxa yokuthi lolu hlobo lwamandla lubhekisela emandleni okwenza umsebenzi, lubizwa ngokuthini?

answer4: Ine-kinetic engu-0 kanye namandla angamaphesenti ayi-100
distractor4a: Ine-kinetic yamaphesenti ayi-100 kanye namandla angase abe ngu-0
distractor4b: Ine-kinetic engu-50% kanye namandla angase abe ngu-50%.
distractor4c: Ayinawo amandla e-kinetic noma amandla angase abe khona
question5: Uma ibhola elibhidlikayo selikhululiwe, kwenzekani ngamandla alo okuhamba kanye namandla angase abe khona?
answer5: Amandla ayo e-kinetic aqala ukwanda ngoba yakha isivinini ngenxa yamandla adonsela phansi. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, njengoba isondela emhlabathini, ilahlekelwa amandla angase abe khona
distractor5a: Amandla ayo e-kinetic kanye namandla angase abe khona ayanda
distractor5b: Amandla ayo e-kinetic kanye namandla angase abe khona ayancipha
distractor5c: Amandla ayo e-kinetic ayancipha ngenkathi amandla ayo angaba khona enyuka
question6: Ezinye izibonelo zamandla angaba khona zifaka phakathi ini?
answer6: Amandla amanzi abanjwe ngemuva kwedamu, noma umuntu ozobe esezophuma endizeni esibhakabhakeni
distractor6a: Imoto ehambayo kanye nenhlamvu egijima ngesivinini esikhulu
question7: Amandla angase abe khona awahlotshaniswa nje kuphela nendawo yezinto, kodwa futhi ahlotshaniswa nani?
answer7: Isakhiwo sezinto
question8: Yini enamandla angaba khona uma icindezelwe?
answer8: Isiphethu phansi
question9: Izindlela zamaseli e-Anabolic zidinga amandla ukuze zenzeni?
answer9: Hlanganisa ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi kusuka kwalula
question10: Izindlela ze-Catabolic zikhipha amandla uma kwenzekani?
answer10: Ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi ayahlukaniswa
question11: Lisho ukuthini iqiniso lokuthi amandla angakhishwa ngokuqhekeka kwezibopho ezithile zamakhemikhali?
answer11: Lezo zibopho zinamandla angase abe khona
question12: Yini ekugcineni esetshenziswayo ukuze isetshenziswe kuma-molecule okudla esiwadlayo?
answer12: Amandla angaba khona agcinwe ngaphakathi kwezibopho zawo
question13: Uhlobo lwamandla angaba khona olukhona ngaphakathi kwezibopho zamakhemikhali, futhi olukhishwa lapho lezo zibopho ziphukile, lubizwa ngokuthini?

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. I-Metabolism | 6.2 Amandla Angaba Khona, Anga-Kinetic, Amahhala, kanye Nokusebenza | Amandla Amahhala
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6.2 Amandla Angaba Khona, Awe-Kinetic, Amahhala, kanye Nokusebenza | Amandla Amahhala
chapterContent:
Ngemva kokufunda ukuthi ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kukhulula amandla lapho izibopho zokugcina amandla ziphukile, umbuzo olandelayo obalulekile uthi amandla ahlotshaniswa nokusabela kwamakhemikhali alinganiswa futhi aboniswa kanjani? Amandla akhishwa kukusabela okukodwa angafaniswa kanjani nalawo okusabela okunye? Kusetshenziswa isilinganiso samandla akhululekile ukulinganisa lokhu kudluliselwa kwamandla. Amandla amahhala abizwa ngokuthi amandla amahhala e-Gibbs (afingqiwe ngohlamvu u-G) ngemuva kukaJosiah Willard Gibbs, usosayensi owasungula isilinganiso. Ngokomthetho wesibili we-thermodynamics, konke ukudluliselwa kwamandla kuhilela ukulahlekelwa yinani elithile lamandla ngendlela engasetshenziswa njengokushisa, okuholela ku-entropy. Amandla amahhala e-Gibbs abhekisela ngqo kumandla ahlotshaniswa nokusabela kwamakhemikhali okutholakala ngemva kokubalwa kwe-entropy. Ngamanye amazwi, amandla amahhala e-Gibbs angamandla asebenzisekayo, noma amandla atholakalayo ukwenza umsebenzi.

 Yonke impendulo yamakhemikhali ihilela ushintsho kumandla amahhala, olubizwa nge-delta G (∆G). Ushintsho kumandla amahhala lungabalwa kunoma yiluphi uhlelo oludlula kushintsho olunjalo, njengokusabela kwamakhemikhali. Ukuze ubale i-∆G, susa inani lamandla alahlekile ku-entropy (ebizwa ngokuthi i-∆S) ekushintsheni kwamandla okuphelele kwesistimu. Lolu shintsho lwamandla oluphelele ohlelweni lubizwa ngokuthi i-enthalpy futhi luchazwa ngokuthi i-∆H. Ifomula yokubala i-∆G yilena elandelayo, lapho uphawu u-T lubhekisela ekushiseni okuphelele ku-Kelvin (amadigri Celsius + 273):

 Δ⁢G=Δ⁢H−T⁢ΔS
Ushintsho lwamandla amahhala olujwayelekile lwempendulo yamakhemikhali luvezwa njengenani lamandla nge-mole ngayinye yomkhiqizo wokusabela (kungaba ngama-kilojoule noma ama-kilocalories, kJ/mol noma kcal/mol; 1 kJ = 0.239 kcal) ngaphansi kwezimo ze-pH ezijwayelekile, izinga lokushisa, kanye nengcindezi. Izimo ze-pH ezijwayelekile, izinga lokushisa, kanye nengcindezi ngokuvamile zibalwa ku-pH 7.0 ezinhlelweni zezinto eziphilayo, ama-degree Celsius angu-25, kanye nama-kilopascal ayi-100 (ingcindezi ye-atm eyi-1), ngokulandelana. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izimo zeseli ziyahlukahluka kakhulu kulezi zimo ezijwayelekile, ngakho-ke amanani ajwayelekile e-∆G abaliwe okusabela kwezinto eziphilayo azohluka ngaphakathi kweseli.

 Ukusabela Kwe-Endergonic kanye Nokusabela Kwe-Exergonic
Uma amandla ekhishwa ngesikhathi sokusabela kwamakhemikhali, khona-ke inani elivela ku-equation engenhla lizoba inombolo engemihle. Ngamanye amazwi, ukusabela okukhipha amandla kune-∆G < 0. I-∆G engemihle isho nokuthi imikhiqizo yokusabela inamandla amancane akhululekile kune-reactants, ngoba ikhiphe amandla athile amahhala ngesikhathi sokusabela. Ukusabela okune-∆G engemihle futhi ngenxa yalokho kukhipha amandla amahhala kubizwa ngokuthi ukusabela kwe-exergonic. Cabanga: i-exergonic isho ukuthi amandla ayaphuma ohlelweni. Lokhu kusabela kubizwa nangokuthi ukusabela okuzenzakalelayo, ngoba kungenzeka ngaphandle kokufakwa kwamandla ohlelweni. Ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izimpendulo zamakhemikhali ezizenzakalelayo nezikhulula amandla amahhala kuwusizo kakhulu kososayensi bezinto eziphilayo, ngoba lezi zimpendulo zingase zisetshenziswe ukwenza umsebenzi ngaphakathi kweseli. Umehluko obalulekile kumele udwetshwe phakathi kwegama elithi ngokuzenzekelayo kanye nomqondo wokusabela kwamakhemikhali okwenzeka ngokushesha. Ngokuphambene nokusetshenziswa kwansuku zonke kwaleli gama, ukusabela okuzenzakalelayo akuyona into eyenzeka ngokuzumayo noma ngokushesha. Ukugqwala kwensimbi kuyisibonelo sokusabela okuzenzakalelayo okwenzeka kancane kancane, kancane kancane, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

 Uma ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kudinga ukufaka amandla esikhundleni sokukhulula amandla, khona-ke i-∆G yaleyo mpendulo izoba yinani elihle. Kulesi simo, imikhiqizo inamandla akhululekile kakhulu kunezisabela. Ngakho-ke, imikhiqizo yalezi zimpendulo ingacatshangwa njengama-molecule agcina amandla. Lokhu kusabela kwamakhemikhali kubizwa ngokuthi ukusabela kwe-endergonic, futhi akuzenzakaleli. Ukusabela kwe-endergonic ngeke kwenzeke kodwa ngaphandle kokwengezwa kwamandla amahhala.

 Ake siphinde sibheke isibonelo sokwenziwa nokuwohloka kwe-molecule yokudla, i-glucose. Khumbula ukuthi ukwakhiwa kwama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi, njengoshukela, kusuka kwalula kuyinqubo ye-anabolic futhi kudinga amandla. Ngakho-ke, ukusabela kwamakhemikhali okuhilelekile ezinqubweni ze-anabolic kuyimiphumela ye-endergonic. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, inqubo ye-catabolic yokuphula ushukela ube ama-molecule alula ikhipha amandla ochungechungeni lwemiphumela ye-exergonic. Njengesibonelo sokugqwala ngenhla, ukuwohloka koshukela kuhilela ukusabela okuzenzakalelayo, kodwa lokhu kusabela akwenzeki ngokushesha. Isithombe 6.8 sibonisa ezinye izibonelo zokusabela kwe-endergonic kanye ne-exergonic. Izigaba zakamuva zizohlinzeka ngolwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nokuthi yini enye edingekayo ukuze ngisho nokusabela okuzenzakalelayo kwenzeke kahle kakhulu.

 Umqondo obalulekile esifundweni se-metabolism kanye namandla yilowo wokulingana kwamakhemikhali. Ukusabela okuningi kwamakhemikhali kuyabuyiselwa emuva. Kungaqhubeka kuzo zombili izinhlangothi, kukhulule amandla endaweni yawo ngakolunye uhlangothi, futhi kudonswe endaweni ngakolunye uhlangothi (Isithombe 6.9). Kunjalo nangokusabela kwamakhemikhali okuhilelekile ekusetshenzisweni kwamangqamuzana, njengokuwohloka nokwakhiwa kwamaprotheni angene futhi avele kuma-amino acid ngamanye, ngokulandelana. Ama-reactants ngaphakathi kwesistimu evaliwe azobhekana nokusabela kwamakhemikhali kuzo zombili izinhlangothi kuze kube yilapho kufinyelelwa esimweni sokulingana. Lesi simo sokulingana singesinye samandla amahhala aphansi kakhulu kanye nesimo se-entropy ephezulu. Amandla kumele afakwe ohlelweni ukuze kusunduzwe ama-reactants kanye nemikhiqizo kude nesimo sokulingana. Noma yiziphi i-reactants noma imikhiqizo kumele zengezwe, zisuswe, noma zishintshwe. Uma iseli belilihlelo elivaliwe, ukusabela kwalo kwamakhemikhali bekuzofinyelela ukulingana, futhi belingafa ngoba bekungeke kube namandla amahhala anele asele ukwenza umsebenzi odingekayo ukuze kulondolozwe impilo. Eseli eliphilayo, ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kuhlala kuhamba kuya ekulinganeni, kodwa akukaze kufinyelelwe kulo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi iseli eliphilayo liyisistimu evulekile. Izinto ziyangena futhi ziphume, iseli liphinda lisebenzise imikhiqizo yokusabela kwamakhemikhali athile kwezinye izindlela, futhi ukulingana kwamakhemikhali akufinyelelwa. Ngale ndlela, izinto eziphilayo zisempini eqhubekayo edinga amandla, ekhuphukayo ngokumelene nokulingana kanye ne-entropy. Lokhu kunikezwa kwamandla okuqhubekayo ekugcineni kuvela elangeni, elisetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza izakhamzimba enkambisweni ye-photosynthesis

answer7: Njengenani lamandla nge-mole ngayinye yomkhiqizo wokusabela (kungaba ngama-kilojoule noma ama-kilocalories, i-kJ/mol noma i-kcal/mol)
question8: Ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile zebhayoloji, iyiphi i-pH evame ukusetshenziswa lapho kubalwa amanani ajwayelekile e-∆G?

question9: Uma amandla ekhishwa ngesikhathi sokusabela kwamakhemikhali, liyini inani le-∆G?

answer17: Bangaqhubeka ngazo zombili izindlela, bakhiphe amandla endaweni yabo ngakolunye uhlangothi, futhi bawamunce endaweni ezungezile ngakolunye uhlangothi.
question18: Kuyini ukulingana kwamakhemikhali?

distractor18b: Isimo lapho yonke imizwa iyeka khona unomphela

answer19: Ukusabela kwayo kwamakhemikhali kuzofinyelela ukulingana, futhi bekungeke kube namandla anele amahhala asele ukwenza umsebenzi odingekayo ukuze kulondolozwe impilo.
distractor19c: Izinga lokushisa layo lizoba phansi kakhulu
question20: Kungani amangqamuzana aphilayo engafinyeleli ukulingana kwamakhemikhali?
answer20: Ngoba iseli eliphilayo liyisistimu evulekile. Izinto ziyangena futhi ziphume, iseli liphinda lisebenzise imikhiqizo yokusabela kwamakhemikhali athile libe yiminye imikhuba, futhi ukulingana kwamakhemikhali akufinyelelwa.
distractor20b: Ngoba amangqamuzana aqukethe ukusabela okusebenzayo kuphela
question21: Lokhu kutholakala kwamandla okuqhubekayo ekugcineni kuvela kuphi?
answer21: Ukukhanya kwelanga, okusetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza izakhamzimba enkambisweni ye-photosynthesis
question22: Bheka uMfanekiso 6.8. Hlola inqubo ngayinye eboniswe ngokobudlelwano phakathi kohlobo lokusabela nokuthi amandla agcinwa noma akhishwa. Nquma ngayinye ukuthi inqubo i-endergonic noma i-exergonic, nokuthi i-enthalpy kanye ne-entropy ziyanda noma ziyancipha.
answer22: (a) Ukubola kwenqwaba yomquba kuyashesha, i-enthalpy iyancipha kanti i-entropy iyancipha. (b) Umntwana okhula eqandeni uyinqubo ye-endergonic, i-enthalpy iyanda futhi i-entropy iyancipha. (c) Ubuciko besihlabathi obubhujiswayo buyanda, i-enthalpy iyanda futhi i-entropy iyanda. (d) Ibhola eligingqika liyehla liyinqubo ye-endergonic, i-enthalpy iyancipha futhi i-entropy iyanda.
distractor22a: (a) Ukubola kwenqwaba yomquba kuyinto engapheli, i-enthalpy iyanda futhi i-entropy iyancipha. (b) Umntwana okhula eqandeni uyinqubo ye-endergonic, i-enthalpy iyancipha futhi i-entropy iyancipha. (c) Ubuciko besihlabathi obubhujiswayo buyinqubo engapheli, akukho shintsho ku-enthalpy futhi i-entropy iyancipha. (d) Ibhola eligingqika liyehla liyinqubo engapheli, i-enthalpy iyancipha futhi i-entropy iyancipha.
distractor22b: (a) Ukubola kwenqwaba yomquba kuyaphela, i-enthalpy iyancipha futhi i-entropy iyancipha. (b) Umntwana okhula eqandeni uyinqubo yokuphelelwa amandla, i-enthalpy iyancipha futhi i-entropy iyanda. (c) Ubuciko besihlabathi obubhujiswayo buphela amandla, i-enthalpy iyanda futhi i-entropy iyanda. (d) Ibhola eligingqika egqumeni liyinqubo yokuphelelwa amandla, i-enthalpy iyancipha futhi i-entropy iyancipha.
distractor22c: (a) Ukubola kwenqwaba yomquba kuyashesha, i-enthalpy iyanda kanye ne-entropy iyanda. (b) Umntwana okhula eqandeni uyinqubo ye-endergonic, i-enthalpy iyancipha kanye ne-entropy iyancipha. (c) Ubuciko besihlabathi obubhujiswayo buyi-exergonic, akukho shintsho ku-enthalpy kanye ne-entropy iyanda. (d) Ibhola eligingqika egqumeni liyinqubo ye-exergonic, i-enthalpy iyancipha futhi akukho shintsho ku-entropy

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. I-Metabolism | 6.2 Amandla Angaba Khona, Anga-Kinetic, Amahhala, kanye Nokusebenza | Amandla Okusebenza
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6.2 Amandla Angenzeka, Awe-Kinetic, Amahhala, kanye Nokusebenza | Amandla Okusebenza
chapterContent:
Kukhona omunye umqondo obalulekile okumele ucatshangelwe mayelana nokusabela kwe-endergonic kanye ne-exergonic. Ngisho nokusabela kwe-exergonic kudinga inani elincane lokufakwa kwamandla ukuze kuqalwe ngaphambi kokuba kuqhubeke nezinyathelo zabo zokukhulula amandla. Lokhu kusabela kunokukhululwa kwamandla, kodwa kusadinga amandla athile ekuqaleni. Leli nani elincane lokufakwa kwamandla okudingekayo kuzo zonke izimpendulo zamakhemikhali ukuthi zenzeke libizwa ngokuthi amandla okusebenza (noma amandla amahhala okusebenza) futhi lifushaniswe ngokuthi i-EA (Isithombe 6.10).

 Kungani ukusabela kwe-∆G okukhipha amandla, okungekuhle kungadinga amandla athile ukuze kuqhubeke? Isizathu sisezinyathelweni ezenzeka ngesikhathi sokusabela kwamakhemikhali. Ngesikhathi sokusabela kwamakhemikhali, izibopho ezithile zamakhemikhali ziyaphuka bese kwakheka ezintsha. Isibonelo, lapho i-molecule ye-glucose iphukile, izibopho phakathi kwama-athomu e-carbon e-molecule ziyaphuka. Njengoba lezi kuyizibopho zokugcina amandla, zikhipha amandla lapho ziphukile. Kodwa-ke, ukuze zingene esimweni esivumela izibopho ukuba ziqhekeke, i-molecule kumele iguqulwe kancane. Kudingeka ukufaka amandla amancane ukuze kufezwe lesi simo esiphambene. Lesi simo esiphambene sibizwa ngokuthi isimo sokuguquka, futhi siyisimo samandla aphezulu, esingazinzile. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, ama-molecule e-reactant awahlali isikhathi eside esimweni sawo sokuguquka, kodwa aqhubekela phambili ngokushesha ezinyathelweni ezilandelayo zokusabela kwamakhemikhali. I-free energy dia grams ikhombisa amaphrofayili wamandla okusabela okuthile. Ukuthi ukusabela kuyasebenza noma ku-endergonic kunquma ukuthi imikhiqizo ekumdwebo izoba khona esimweni samandla esiphansi noma esiphezulu kune-reactants kanye nemikhiqizo. Kodwa-ke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi lesi silinganiso sinjani, isimo sokuguquka kokusabela sikhona esimweni samandla esiphezulu kune-reactants, ngakho-ke, i-EA ihlala ilungile.

 Amandla okusebenza adingekayo yi-reactant yamakhemikhali avelaphi? Umthombo wamandla okusebenza adingekayo ukusunduza ukusabela phambili ngokuvamile amandla okushisa avela endaweni ezungezile. Amandla okushisa (amandla esibopho aphelele e-reactants noma imikhiqizo ekusabela kwamakhemikhali) asheshisa ukunyakaza kwama-molecule, andise imvamisa namandla ahlangana ngawo; futhi ahambisa ama-athomu nezibopho ngaphakathi kwe-molecule kancane, ezisiza ukuthi zifinyelele esimweni sazo sokuguquka. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, ukushisa uhlelo kuzokwenza ukuthi ama-reactant amakhemikhali ngaphakathi kwalolo hlelo asabele kaningi. Ukwandisa ingcindezi ohlelweni kunomphumela ofanayo. Uma ama-reactant esemunce amandla okushisa anele avela endaweni ezungezile ukuze afinyelele isimo sokuguquka, ukusabela kuzoqhubeka.

 Amandla okusebenza kokusabela okuthile anquma izinga okuzoqhubeka ngalo. Uma amandla okusebenza ephezulu, ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kuzoba kancane. Isibonelo sokugqwala kwensimbi sibonisa ukusabela okuhamba kancane ngokwemvelo. Lokhu kusabela kwenzeka kancane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngenxa ye-EA yayo ephezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukushiswa kwamafutha amaningi, okuyinto enzima kakhulu, kuzokwenzeka ngesivinini esingelutho ngaphandle kokuthi amandla awo okusebenza anqotshwe ukushisa okwanele okuvela ku-spark. Nokho, uma eseqala ukusha, ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kukhipha ukushisa okwanele ukuqhubeka nenqubo yokushisa, kunikeze amandla okusebenza kuma-molecule kaphethiloli azungezile. Njengalezi zenzo ezingaphandle kwamaseli, amandla okusebenza kwezimpendulo eziningi zamaseli aphezulu kakhulu ukuthi amandla okushisa anganqotshwa ngamanani asebenzayo. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuze ukusabela okubalulekile kwamaseli kwenzeke ngamazinga aqaphelekayo (inani lokusabela ngesikhathi ngasinye), amandla awo okusebenza kumele ehliswe (Isithombe 6.10); lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-catalysis. Lokhu kuyinto enhle kakhulu maqondana namaseli aphilayo. Ama-macromolecule abalulekile, njengeprotheni, i-DNA, ne-RNA, agcina amandla amaningi, futhi ukuwohloka kwawo kuyinto engavamile. Uma amazinga okushisa kwamaseli ewodwa enikeza amandla okushisa anele ukuze lokhu kusabela okungavamile kunqobe izithiyo zawo zokuqalisa ukusebenza, izingxenye ezibalulekile zeseli bezizoqhekeka.
question1: Ngisho nokusabela kwe-exergonic kudingani ngaphambi kokuba baqhubeke nezinyathelo zabo zokukhulula amandla?
answer1: Inani elincane lamandla okufanele balisebenzise ngaphambi kokuba baqhubeke nezinyathelo zabo zokukhipha amandla
question2: Yini ebizwa ngokuthi inani elincane lamandla adingekayo ukuze kwenzeke zonke izimpendulo zamakhemikhali?
answer2: Amandla okusebenza (noma amandla amahhala okusebenza), okufingqiwe ngokuthi i-EA
question3: Kungani ukusabela kwe-∆G okudedela amandla, okungekuhle empeleni kudinga amandla athile ukuze kuqhubeke?
answer3: Ngoba i-molecule kumele ilethwe esimweni sokuguquka ngaphambi kokuba izibopho zayo ziphuke
distractor3b: Ngoba amandla awakwazi ukukhululwa ezibophweni zamakhemikhali
distractor3c: Ngoba i-entropy kumele yehle kuqala ibe yi-zero
question4: Iyini isimo sokuguquka?
answer4: Isimo esinamandla aphezulu, esingazinzile lapho i-molecule iphambukile khona ngaphambi kokuba ukusabela kuqhubeke
distractor4a: Isimo sokuzinza kwamandla aphansi ngemva kokuba ukusabela sekuqediwe
question5: Kungani ama-molecule asabelayo engapheli isikhathi eside esimweni sawo sokuguquka?
answer5: Ngoba kuyisimo esinamandla aphezulu, esingazinzile, ngakho-ke baqhubekela phambili ngokushesha ezinyathelweni ezilandelayo zokusabela kwamakhemikhali
distractor5b: Ngoba ziba imikhiqizo ngokushesha ngaphandle kwesimo esiphakathi
question6: Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukusabela ku-exergonic noma i-endergonic, yini eyiqiniso njalo nge-EA?
answer6: I-EA ihlala inethemba
question7: Amandla okusebenza adingwa yizici zamakhemikhali avame ukuvela kuphi?
answer7: Amandla okushisa avela endaweni ezungezile
question8: Amandla okushisa asiza kanjani ukusabela kwamakhemikhali?
answer8: Kusheshisa ukunyakaza kwama-molecule, kwandisa imvamisa namandla ashayisana ngawo, futhi kuwasize afinyelele isimo sawo sokuguquka
question9: Ukushisa uhlelo kunamuphi umphumela kuma-reactants amakhemikhali?
answer9: Kubangela ukuthi ama-reactant amakhemikhali ngaphakathi kwalolo hlelo asabele kaningi
question10: Ukwandisa ingcindezi ohlelweni kunamuphi umphumela?
answer10: Inomphumela ofanayo nokushisa, okusiza ama-reactant ukuthi afinyelele esimweni sokuguquka
distractor10b: Kwenza konke ukusabela kube yinto engapheli
question11: Yini enquma izinga lapho ukusabela okuthile kuzoqhubeka khona?
question12: Amandla okusebenza athinta kanjani izinga lokusabela kwamakhemikhali?
answer12: Uma amandla okusebenza ephezulu, ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kuhamba kancane
distractor12a: Uma amandla okusebenza ephezulu, kulapho ukusabela kushesha khona
question13: Kungani insimbi igqwala kancane?
question14: Kungani amafutha amaningi edinga inhlansi ngaphambi kokuba ashise?
answer14: Ngoba amandla abo okusebenza kumele anqotshwe ukushisa okwanele
question15: Uma amafutha eqala ukusha, kungani ukusha kuqhubeka?
answer15: Ngoba ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kukhulula ukushisa okwanele ukuqhubeka nenqubo yokushisa, okunikeza amandla okusebenza kwama-molecule kaphethiloli azungezile.
question16: Kungani amandla okusebenza kweningi lezimpendulo zamaselula ehliswa?
answer16: Ngakho-ke ukusabela okubalulekile kwamaseli kungenzeka ngamanani aphakeme kakhulu
distractor16a: Ukuze wenze ukusabela kudinga i-ATP eyengeziwe
question17: Kubizwa ngokuthini ukwehla kwamandla okusebenza?
answer17: I-Catalysis
question18: Kungani kubalulekile ukuthi amazinga okushisa eseli ewodwa angakwazi ukunqoba izithiyo zokuqalisa ukusebenza kweningi lezimpendulo ze-exergonic?
answer18: Ngaphandle kwalokho, ama-macromolecule abalulekile njengeprotheni, i-DNA, ne-RNA angahlakazeka
question19: Yimaphi amazwi kanye nobufakazi obusekelayo obuveza ngokunembile ukuzinza kanye namandla ezimo zesikhashana?

question20: Bheka uMfanekiso 6.10. Ushintsho lwamandla amahhala e-Gibbs (Δ⁢G) luhluke kanjani phakathi kokusabela kwe-catalyzed ne-uncatalyzed?

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. I-Metabolism | 6.3 Imithetho ye-Thermodynamics | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6.3 Imithetho yeThermodynamics | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ekufundeni amandla, ososayensi basebenzisa igama elithi uhlelo ukubhekisela endabeni kanye nendawo ezungezile ehilelekile ekudlulisweni kwamandla, njenge-ecosystem. Ngisho namaseli angawodwa ayizinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo futhi zonke izinhlelo zidinga amandla ukuze kugcinwe ukuhleleka. Uma uhlelo luhlelekile, i-entropy yalo iyancipha. I-Entropy iyisilinganiso sokuphazamiseka kwesistimu. (Cabanga ngekamelo lakho lokulala njengohlelo. NgeSonto kusihlwa, uphonsa izingubo ezingcolile ebhasikidini lokuwasha izingubo, ubeke izincwadi emashalofini, bese ubuyisela izitsha ezingcolile ekhishini. Ukuhlanza ikamelo lakho kudinga ukufaka amandla. Kwenzekani kancane kancane njengoba isonto liqhubeka? Uqagele: i-entropy.) Zonke izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zilalela imithetho yekhemistri kanye nefiziksi, kufaka phakathi imithetho ye-thermodynamics echaza izakhiwo nezinqubo zokudluliselwa kwamandla ezinhlelweni. Umthetho wokuqala uthi inani eliphelele lamandla endaweni yonke lihlala njalo; amandla awakwazi ukudalwa noma ukubhujiswa, kodwa angaguqulwa futhi adluliselwe. Umthetho wesibili uthi ukudluliselwa kwamandla ngakunye kuhilela ukulahlekelwa amandla ngendlela engasetshenziswa, njengamandla okushisa, okuholela ohlelweni oluphazamisekile kakhulu (isb., ikamelo lakho lokulala phakathi nesonto). Ngakho-ke, akukho ukudluliselwa kwamandla okusebenza kahle ngokuphelele. (Sizohlola ukuthi amandla amahhala agcinwa kanjani, adluliselwa kanjani, futhi asetshenziswe kanjani ngokuningiliziwe lapho sifunda nge-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli.)

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni, imiqondo yokusekela kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso enkulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kabusha kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka njalo amandla amahhala.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa kanjani amandla amahhala ngokusekelwe kudatha yobufakazi yokuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga ukufakwa kwamandla okuqhubekayo ukuze zilondoloze ukuhleleka, ukukhula, nokuzala.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Kwesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:

 I-Thermodynamics ibhekisela ekutadisheni kwamandla nokudluliselwa kwamandla okubandakanya izinto ezibonakalayo. Izinto kanye nendawo yazo ehambisana necala elithile lokudluliswa kwamandla kuhlukaniswa njengohlelo, futhi konke okungaphandle kwalolo hlelo kubizwa ngokuthi indawo ezungezile. Isibonelo, uma kushiswa imbiza yamanzi esitovini, uhlelo luhlanganisa isitofu, imbiza, namanzi. Amandla adluliselwa ngaphakathi kohlelo (phakathi kwesitofu, imbiza, namanzi). Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zezinhlelo: ezivuliwe nezivaliwe. Uhlelo oluvulekile yilolo lapho amandla nezinto zingadluliselwa khona phakathi kohlelo nendawo ezizungezile. Uhlelo lwesitofu luvulekile ngoba ukushisa kungalahleka emoyeni. Uhlelo oluvaliwe yilolo olungadlulisela amandla kodwa lungabalulekile endaweni ezizungezile.

 Izinto eziphilayo ziyizinhlelo ezivulekile. Amandla ashintshaniswa phakathi kwazo nendawo ezizungezile, njengoba zidla ama-molecule agcina amandla futhi zikhulula amandla endaweni ezungezile ngokwenza umsebenzi. Njengazo zonke izinto emhlabeni wezinto ezibonakalayo, amandla angaphansi kwemithetho yefiziksi. Imithetho ye-thermodynamics ilawula ukudluliselwa kwamandla kuzo zonke izinhlelo endaweni yonke naphakathi kwazo.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 6.3 Imithetho Ye-Thermodynamics | Umthetho Wokuqala We-Thermodynamics
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6.3 Imithetho yeThermodynamics | Umthetho Wokuqala weThermodynamics
chapterContent:
Umthetho wokuqala we-thermodynamics ubhekene nenani eliphelele lamandla endaweni yonke. Uthi leli nani eliphelele lamandla aliguquki. Ngamanye amazwi, bekulokhu kukhona, futhi kuzohlala kukhona, inani elifanayo lamandla endaweni yonke. Amandla akhona ngezindlela eziningi ezahlukene. Ngokomthetho wokuqala we-thermodynamics, amandla angadluliselwa kusuka endaweni kuya endaweni noma aguqulwe abe izinhlobo ezahlukene, kodwa awakwazi ukudalwa noma ukubhujiswa. Ukudluliselwa nokuguqulwa kwamandla kwenzeka nxazonke zethu ngaso sonke isikhathi. Amabhalbhu okukhanya aguqula amandla kagesi abe amandla okukhanya. Izitofu zegesi ziguqula amandla amakhemikhali kusuka kugesi yemvelo abe amandla okushisa. Izitshalo zenza enye yezinguquko zamandla eziwusizo kakhulu ngokwemvelo emhlabeni: lokho kuguqula amandla okukhanya kwelanga abe amandla amakhemikhali agcinwe ngaphakathi kwama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 6.2. Ezinye izibonelo zokuguqulwa kwamandla ziboniswe kuMfanekiso 6.11.

 Inselele yazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ukuthola amandla ezindaweni ezizungezile ngezindlela ezingazidlulisela noma ziguqule zibe amandla asebenzisekayo ukuze zenze umsebenzi. Amaseli aphilayo aguqukele ekuhlangabezaneni nale nselele kahle kakhulu. Amandla amakhemikhali agcinwe ngaphakathi kwama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo njengoshukela namafutha aguqulwa ngochungechunge lwezindlela zokusabela kwamakhemikhali eseli abe amandla ngaphakathi kwama-molecule e-ATP. Amandla kuma-molecule e-ATP afinyeleleka kalula ukuze enze umsebenzi. Izibonelo zezinhlobo zomsebenzi okudingeka amangqamuzana azenze zifaka phakathi ukwakha ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi, ukuthutha izinto, ukunika amandla ukunyakaza kokushaya kwe-cilia noma i-flagella, ukubopha imicu yemisipha ukuze kudalwe ukunyakaza, kanye nokuzala kabusha.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 6.3 Imithetho Ye-Thermodynamics | Umthetho Wesibili We-Thermodynamics
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6.3 Imithetho yeThermodynamics | Umthetho Wesibili weThermodynamics
chapterContent:
Imisebenzi eyinhloko yeseli eliphilayo yokuthola, ukuguqula, nokusebenzisa amandla ukwenza umsebenzi ingase ibonakale ilula. Kodwa-ke, umthetho wesibili we-thermodynamics uchaza ukuthi kungani le misebenzi inzima kunalokho ebonakala. Akukho noyedwa ekudlulisweni kwamandla esixoxe ngakho, kanye nakho konke ukudluliselwa kwamandla kanye nokuguqulwa endaweni yonke, okusebenza kahle ngokuphelele. Kuwo wonke ukudluliselwa kwamandla, inani elithile lamandla lilahleka ngendlela engasetshenziswa. Ezimweni eziningi, lolu hlobo lwamandla okushisa. Ngokwe-thermodynamic, amandla okushisa achazwa njengamandla adluliselwa kusuka ohlelweni olulodwa kuya kolunye olungasebenzi. Isibonelo, lapho indiza indiza emoyeni, amanye amandla endizeni endizayo alahleka njengamandla okushisa ngenxa yokungqubuzana nomoya ozungezile. Lokhu kungqubuzana empeleni kushisa umoya ngokwandisa ijubane lama-molecule omoya okwesikhashana. Ngokufanayo, amanye amandla alahleka njengamandla okushisa ngesikhathi sokusabela kwe-metabolic yamaseli. Lokhu kuhle ezidalweni ezinegazi elifudumele njengathi, ngoba amandla okushisa asiza ukugcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba wethu. Empeleni, akukho ukudluliselwa kwamandla okusebenza kahle ngokuphelele, ngoba amanye amandla alahleka ngendlela engasetshenziswa.

 Umqondo obalulekile ezinhlelweni zomzimba yilowo wokuhleleka kanye nokuphazamiseka (okwaziwa nangokuthi ukungahleleki). Uma amandla amaningi elahleka uhlelo ezindaweni ezizungezile, uhlelo lungahleleki futhi lungahleleki. Ososayensi babhekisela esilinganisweni sokungahleleki noma ukuphazamiseka ngaphakathi kohlelo njenge-entropy. I-entropy ephezulu isho ukuphazamiseka okuphezulu kanye namandla aphansi (Isithombe 6.12). Ukuze uqonde kangcono i-entropy, cabanga ngekamelo lokulala lomfundi. Uma kungekho mandla noma umsebenzi ofakiwe kulo, igumbi lizosheshe libe yihlane. Lizoba khona esimweni esiphazamisekile kakhulu, isimo se-entropy ephezulu. Amandla kumele afakwe ohlelweni, ngesimo somfundi enza umsebenzi futhi ebeka konke kude, ukuze abuyisele igumbi esimweni sokuhlanzeka nokuhleleka. Lesi simo singese-entropy ephansi. Ngokufanayo, imoto noma indlu kumele igcinwe njalo nomsebenzi ukuze igcinwe esimweni esihlelekile. Uma ishiywe yodwa, i-entropy yendlu noma yemoto iyanda kancane kancane ngokugqwala nokuwohloka. Ama-molecule kanye nokusabela kwamakhemikhali nakho kunezilinganiso ezahlukene ze-entropy. Isibonelo, njengoba ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kufinyelela esimweni sokulingana, i-entropy iyanda, futhi njengoba ama-molecule eqoqweni eliphezulu endaweni eyodwa esakazeka futhi esakazeka, i-entropy nayo iyanda.

 Zonke izinhlelo zomzimba zingacatshangwa ngale ndlela: Izinto eziphilayo zihlelekile kakhulu, zidinga ukufakwa kwamandla okuqhubekayo ukuze zigcinwe esimweni se-entropy ephansi. Njengoba izinhlelo eziphilayo zithatha ama-molecule agcina amandla futhi ziwaguqula ngokusebenzisa ukusabela kwamakhemikhali, zilahlekelwa amandla athile asebenzisekayo kule nqubo, ngoba akukho ukusabela okusebenza kahle ngokuphelele. Ziphinde zikhiqize imfucuza kanye nemikhiqizo engaphansi kweyodwa engeyona imithombo yamandla ewusizo. Le nqubo ikhulisa i-entropy yendawo ezungezile uhlelo. Njengoba konke ukudluliselwa kwamandla kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwamandla athile asebenzisekayo, umthetho wesibili we-thermodynamics uthi konke ukudluliselwa kwamandla noma ukuguqulwa kwamandla kwandisa i-entropy yendawo yonke. Ngisho noma izinto eziphilayo zihlelekile kakhulu futhi zigcina isimo se-entropy ephansi, i-entropy yendawo yonke iyonke ikhula njalo ngenxa yokulahlekelwa kwamandla asebenzisekayo ngokudluliselwa kwamandla ngakunye okwenzekayo. Empeleni, izinto eziphilayo zisempini eqhubekayo ekhuphukayo ngokumelene nalokhu kwanda okuqhubekayo kwe-entropy yendawo yonke
