chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6.4 ATP: I-Adenosine Triphosphate | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
I-Adenosine triphosphate noma i-ATP iyimali yamandla” noma umthwali weseli. Uma amaseli edinga ukufakelwa kwamandla, asebenzisa i-ATP. I-molecule ye-nucleotide ye-ATP iqukethe ushukela we-carbon emihlanu, i-nitrogenous base adenine, kanye namaqembu amathathu e-phosphate. (Ungayididanisi i-ATP nama-nucleotide e-DNA ne-RNA, yize zinokufana kwesakhiwo.) Izibopho ezixhuma i-phosphate zinokuqukethwe kwamandla aphezulu, futhi amandla akhishwa ku-hydrolysis ye-ATP kuya ku-ADP + Pi (i-Adenosine Diphosphate + phosphate) asetshenziselwa ukwenza umsebenzi weseli, njengokunciphisa imisipha noma ukupompa i-solute ngaphesheya kwe-membrane yeseli ekuthuthweni okusebenzayo. Amaseli asebenzisa i-ATP ngokuhlanganisa ukusabela kwe-exergonic kwe-ATP hydrolysis nokusabela kwe-endergonic, lapho i-ATP inikela iqembu layo le-phosphate kwenye i-molecule ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-phosphorylation. I-molecule ye-phosphorylated isesimweni samandla aphezulu futhi ayizinzile kangako kunesimo sayo se-unphosphorylated futhi amandla akhululekile akhishwa kuma-substrates ukuze enze umsebenzi phakathi nale nqubo. I-Phosphorylation iyisibonelo sokudluliselwa kwamandla phakathi kwama-molecule.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso enkulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka njalo amandla amahhala.

 Isayensi Yokuzijwayeza
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa kanjani amandla amahhala ngokusekelwe kudatha yobufakazi yokuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla angena njalo ukuze zilondoloze ukuhleleka, ukukhula, nokuzala.

 I-Science Practices Assessment Ancillary iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[APLO 2.2][APLO 4.14][APLO 2.7][APLO 2.35]

 Ngisho nokusabela okuphumayo, okukhulula amandla kudinga inani elincane lamandla okusebenza ukuze kuqhubeke. Kodwa-ke, cabanga ngokusabela okuphumayo, okudinga amandla amaningi kakhulu, ngoba imikhiqizo yabo inamandla amaningi akhululekile kunezisabela zawo. Ngaphakathi kweseli, amandla okunika amandla ukusabela okunjalo avelaphi? Impendulo ilele kumolekyuli enikeza amandla ebizwa ngokuthi i-adenosine triphosphate, noma i-ATP. I-ATP iyimolekyuli encane, elula kakhulu (Isithombe 6.13), kodwa ngaphakathi kwezinye ze izibopho zayo, iqukethe amandla okuqhuma okusheshayo kwamandla angasetshenziswa ukwenza umsebenzi weseli. Le molekyuli ingacatshangwa njengohlobo lwemali oluyinhloko lwamaseli ngendlela efanayo nemali eyimali abantu abayishintshanisa ngayo ngezinto abazidingayo. I-ATP isetshenziselwa ukunika amandla iningi lezimpendulo zamaseli ezidinga amandla.

 Njengoba igama layo lisikisela, i-adenosine triphosphate yakhiwe yi-adenosine eboshwe emaqenjini amathathu e-phosphate (Isithombe 6.13). I-Adenosine iyi-nucleoside equkethe i-nitrogenous base adenine kanye noshukela we-carbon five, i-ribose. Amaqembu amathathu e-phosphate, ngokulandelana kwawo aseduze kakhulu noshukela we-ribose, abhalwe ngokuthi i-alpha, i-beta, kanye ne-gamma. Ndawonye, la maqembu amakhemikhali akha indawo yamandla. Kodwa-ke, akuzona zonke izibopho ngaphakathi kwale molekyuli ezikhona esimweni samandla aphezulu kakhulu. Zombili izibopho ezixhumanisa ama-phosphate ziyizibopho zamandla aphezulu ngokulinganayo (izibopho ze-phosphoanhydride) okuthi, uma ziphukile, ngesikhathi sezimpendulo zamakhemikhali zingakhipha amandla anele okunika amandla izimpendulo nezinqubo ezahlukahlukene zamaseli. Lokhu izibopho zamandla aphezulu yizibopho eziphakathi kwamaqembu e-phosphate yesibili neyesithathu (noma i-beta ne-gamma) kanye naphakathi kwamaqembu e-phosphate yokuqala neyesibili. Isizathu sokuthi lezi zibopho zibhekwa njengezinamandla aphezulu” kungenxa yokuthi imikhiqizo ye-hydrolysis—i-adenosine diphosphate (ADP) kanye neqembu elilodwa le-phosphate elingaphili (Pi)—linamandla aphansi kakhulu akhululekile kunezi-reactants: i-ATP kanye ne-molecule yamanzi. Ngamanye amazwi, i-ATP i-hydrolyzed ibe yi-ADP kulokhu okulandelayo:

 I-ATP+H2⁢O→I-ADP+Pi+freeenergy
Njengezindlela eziningi zokusabela kwamakhemikhali, i-hydrolysis ye-ATP kuya ku-ADP iyaguqulwa. Ukusabela okuphambene kuvuselela i-ATP kusuka ku-ADP + Pi. Ngempela, amaseli athembele ekuvuseleleni i-ATP njengoba nje abantu bethembele ekuvuseleleni imali esetshenzisiwe ngohlobo oluthile lwemali engenayo. Njengoba i-ATP hydrolysis ikhipha amandla, ukuvuselelwa kwe-ATP kumele kudinge ukufakwa kwamandla amahhala. Ukwakheka kwe-ATP kuvezwa kulesi sibalo:

 ADP+Pi+free energy→I-ATP+H2O
Kusele imibuzo emibili evelele mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwe-ATP njengomthombo wamandla. Kungakanani ngempela amandla akhululekile akhishwa nge-hydrolysis ye-ATP, futhi lawo mandla amahhala asetshenziswa kanjani ukwenza umsebenzi weseli? I-∆G ebalwe ye-hydrolysis ye-mole eyodwa ye-ATP ibe yi-ADP ne-Pi ingu-−7.3 kcal/mole (−30.5 kJ/mol). Njengoba lokhu kubalwa kuyiqiniso ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile, kulindeleke ukuthi kube nenani elihlukile ngaphansi kwezimo zeseli. Eqinisweni, i-∆G ye-hydrolysis ye-mole eyodwa ye-ATP esitokisini esiphilayo cishe iphindwe kabili kunenani ezimweni ezijwayelekile: -14 kcal/mol (−57 kJ/mol).

 I-ATP iyi-molecule engazinzile kakhulu. Ngaphandle kokuthi isetshenziswe ngokushesha ukwenza umsebenzi, i-ATP ihlukana ngokuzenzakalelayo ibe yi-ADP + Pi, futhi amandla amahhala akhishwa phakathi nale nqubo alahleka njengokushisa. Umbuzo wesibili obuzwa ngenhla, okungukuthi, amandla akhishwa yi-ATP hydrolysis asetshenziswa kanjani ukwenza umsebenzi ngaphakathi kweseli, kuncike isu elibizwa ngokuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwamandla. Amaseli ahlanganisa ukusabela kwe-exergonic kwe-ATP hydrolysis nokusabela kwe-endergonic, okuvumela ukuthi kuqhubeke. Isibonelo esisodwa sokuhlanganiswa kwamandla kusetshenziswa i-ATP sihilela iphampu ye-ion ye-transmembrane ebaluleke kakhulu ekusebenzeni kweseli. Le phampu ye-sodium-potassium (iphampu ye-Na+/K+) ikhipha i-sodium esitokisini kanye ne-potassium esitokisini (Isithombe 6.14). Iphesenti elikhulu le-ATP yeseli lisetshenziswa ekunikezeni amandla le phampu, ngoba izinqubo zeseli ziletha i-sodium eningi esitokisini kanye ne-potassium esitokisini. Iphampu isebenza njalo ukuze kuqiniswe amazinga eseli e-sodium ne-potassium. Ukuze iphampu iguqule umjikelezo owodwa (ukuthumela ama-ion amathathu e-Na+ nokungenisa ama-ion amabili e-K+, i-molecule eyodwa ye-ATP kumele i-hydrolyzed. Lapho i-ATP i-hydrolyzed, i-gamma phosphate yayo ayimane nje intante, kodwa empeleni idluliselwa kuphrotheni yephampu. Le nqubo yeqembu le-phosphate elibopha i-molecule ibizwa ngokuthi i-phosphorylation. Njengasezimweni eziningi ze-ATP hydrolysis, i-phosphate evela ku-ATP idluliselwa kwenye i-molecule. Esimweni se-phosphorylated, ipompo ye-Na+/K+ inamandla akhululekile futhi ivuselelwa ukuthi ishintshe ukwakheka. Lolu shintsho luyivumela ukuthi ikhulule i-Na+ ngaphandle kweseli. Ibe isibopha i-K+ yangaphandle, okuthi, ngolunye ushintsho lokwakheka, ibangele ukuthi i-phosphate isuke epompo. Lokhu kukhululwa kwe-phosphate kubangela ukuthi i-K+ ikhishwe ngaphakathi kweseli. Empeleni, amandla akhishwa ku-hydrolysis ye-ATP ahlanganiswe namandla adingekayo ukunika amandla ipompo nokuthutha ama-ion e-Na+ ne-K+. Nalapha futhi, i-hydrolysis ye-ATP ikhipha amandla asetshenziselwa i-phosphorylation yelinye imolekyuli, okudala i-intermediate engazinzile enika amandla ushintsho lokwakheka. Ngale ndlela, i-ATP yenza umsebenzi weselula isebenzisa lolu hlobo oluyisisekelo lokuhlangana kwamandla nge-phosphorylation.

 Ngokuvamile ngesikhathi sokusabela kwe-metabolic yamaseli, njengokwenziwa nokuwohloka kwezakhamzimba, amamolekyuli athile kumele ashintshwe kancane ekubumbeni kwawo ukuze abe yizingxenye zesinyathelo esilandelayo ochungechungeni lokusabela. Isibonelo esisodwa singesikhathi sezinyathelo zokuqala zokuphefumula kwamaseli, lapho imolekyuli yeglucose kashukela iphulwa enkambisweni ye-glycolysis. Esigabeni sokuqala sale nqubo, i-ATP iyadingeka ukuze kufakwe i-phosphorylation ye-glucose, okudala i-intermediate enamandla aphezulu kodwa engazinzile. Lokhu kusabela kwe-phosphorylation kunika amandla ushintsho lokwakheka oluvumela i-molecule ye-glucose efakwe i-phosphorylated ukuthi iguqulwe ibe yi-fructose kashukela efakwe i-phosphorylated. I-Fructose iyindawo edingekayo ukuze i-glycolysis iqhubekele phambili. Lapha, ukusabela kwe-exergonic kwe-ATP hydrolysis kuhlanganiswa nokusabela kwe-endergonic kokuguqula i-glucose ibe yindawo ehlanganisiwe ye-phosphorylated endleleni. Nalapha futhi, amandla akhishwa ngokuphula isibopho se-phosphate ngaphakathi kwe-ATP asetshenziselwa i-phosphorylation yelinye i-molecule, okudala indawo ehlanganisiwe engazinzile futhi enika amandla ushintsho olubalulekile lokwakheka.

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | Ama-enzyme angu-6.5 | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukusabela okuningi kwamakhemikhali emaseli kwenzeka ngokuzenzakalelayo, kodwa kwenzeka kancane kakhulu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zeseli. Isibonelo, ithisipuni le-sucrose (ushukela wetafula), i-disaccharide, engilazini yetiye elibandayo kuzothatha isikhathi ukuhlukana kube ama-monosaccharide amabili, i-glucose ne-fructose; noma kunjalo, uma ufaka inani elincane le-enzyme sucrase etiyeni, i-sucrose iyaphuka cishe ngokushesha. I-Sucrase iyisibonelo se-enzyme, uhlobo lwe-catalyst yezinto eziphilayo. Ama-enzyme angama-macromolecule—ngokuvamile amaprotheni—asheshisa ukusabela kwamakhemikhali ngokunciphisa izithiyo zamandla okusebenza. Ama-enzyme aqondile kakhulu ngokusabela akwenza kube nzima; ngoba angama-polypeptide, ama-enzyme angaba nezimo ezahlukahlukene ezibangelwa ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamaqembu e-amino acid R. Ingxenye eyodwa ye-enzyme, indawo esebenzayo, ixhumana ne-substrate ngemodeli yokufaneleka ebangelwa ukusebenzisana. Ukubopha kwe-substrate kushintsha ukuma kwe-enzyme ukuze kube lula ukusabela kwamakhemikhali ngezindlela eziningana ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuhlanganisa ama-substrate ndawonye ngendlela efanele. Ngemva kokuphela kokusabela, umkhiqizo (imikhiqizo) uyakhululwa, futhi indawo esebenzayo ibuyela esimweni sayo sokuqala.

 Umsebenzi we-enzyme, ngaleyo ndlela izinga lokusabela okubangelwa yi-enzyme, kulawulwa yizimo zemvelo, okuhlanganisa inani le-substrate, izinga lokushisa, i-pH, kanye nokuba khona kwama-coenzyme, ama-cofactor, ama-activator, kanye nama-inhibitor. Ama-inhibitor, ama-coenzyme, kanye nama-cofactor angasebenza ngokuncintisana ngokubopha endaweni esebenzayo ye-enzyme, noma ngokungancintisani ngokubopha endaweni ye-allosteric ye-enzyme. Indawo ye-allosteric iyingxenye ehlukile ye-enzyme engabopha kuma-molecule angewona ama-substrate. Ama-enzyme asebenza kahle kakhulu ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele eziqondene ne-enzyme. Isibonelo, i-trypsin, i-enzyme emathunjini amancane omuntu, isebenza kahle kakhulu ku-pH 8, kanti i-pepsin esiswini isebenza kahle kakhulu ngaphansi kwezimo ze-acidic. Ngezinye izikhathi izici zemvelo, ikakhulukazi i-pH ephansi kanye namazinga okushisa aphezulu, zishintsha ukuma kwendawo esebenzayo; uma isimo singenakubuyiswa, i-enzyme iyashintsha. Indlela evame kakhulu yokulawulwa kwama-enzyme ezindleleni ze-metabolic iwukuvimbela impendulo.

 Izici ezahlukahlukene, njengokuvinjelwa kwempendulo, zingawulawula kanjani umsebenzi we-enzyme?

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Into esiza ukusabela kwamakhemikhali ukuthi kwenzeke iyisisusa, futhi ama-molecule akhethekile avuselela ukusabela kwamakhemikhali abizwa ngokuthi ama-enzyme. Cishe wonke ama-enzyme angamaprotheni, akhiwe ngamaketanga ama-amino acid, futhi enza umsebenzi obalulekile wokunciphisa amandla okusebenza kokusabela kwamakhemikhali ngaphakathi kweseli. Ama-enzyme enza lokhu ngokubopha kuma-molecule asabelayo, futhi awabambe ngendlela yokuthi enze izinqubo zokwaphula izibopho zamakhemikhali kanye nokwakha izibopho zenzeke kalula. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi ama-enzyme awashintshi i-∆G yokusabela. Ngamanye amazwi, azishintshi ukuthi ukusabela ku-exergonic (okuzenzekelayo) noma i-endergonic. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi azishintshi amandla amahhala e-reactants noma imikhiqizo. Zinciphisa kuphela amandla okusebenza adingekayo ukuze kufinyelelwe esimweni sokuguquka (Isithombe 6.15)

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwemetabolism | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Indawo Esebenzayo Yama-Enzyme kanye Nokucaciswa Kwe-Substrate
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Indawo Esebenzayo Yama-Enzyme kanye Nokucaciswa Kwe-Substrate
chapterContent:
Ama-reactant amakhemikhali lapho i-enzyme ibopha khona yi-substrates ye-enzyme. Kungase kube ne-substrates eyodwa noma ngaphezulu, kuye ngokuthi i-chemical reaction ethile iyasebenza kanjani. Kwezinye izindlela, i-single-reactant substrate ihlukaniswa ibe yimikhiqizo eminingi. Kwezinye, ama-substrates amabili angahlangana ukuze adale i-molecule eyodwa enkulu. Ama-reactant amabili angangena futhi ekusabeleni, womabili aguqulwe, bese eshiya ukusabela njengemikhiqizo emibili. Indawo ngaphakathi kwe-enzyme lapho i-substrate ibopha khona ibizwa ngokuthi indawo esebenzayo ye-enzyme. Indawo esebenzayo yilapho isenzo "senzeka khona, uma singasho kanjalo. Njengoba ama-enzyme engamaphrotheni, kukhona inhlanganisela eyingqayizivele yama-amino acid residues (abizwa nangokuthi ama-side chains, noma amaqembu e-R) ngaphakathi kwendawo esebenzayo. I-residue ngayinye ichazwa yizakhiwo ezahlukene. Izinsalela zingaba zikhulu noma zibe zincane, zibe ne-acid encane noma zibe yi-basic, zi-hydrophilic noma zi-hydrophobic, zishajeke kahle noma zingabi ne-negative, noma zingathathi hlangothi. Inhlanganisela eyingqayizivele yama-amino acid residues, izikhundla zazo, ukulandelana, izakhiwo, kanye nezakhiwo, idala indawo ethile yamakhemikhali ngaphakathi kwendawo esebenzayo. Le ndawo ethile ifanele ukubopha, noma ngabe isikhashana, ku-substrate ethile yamakhemikhali (noma ama-substrate). Ngenxa yalokhu kufana kwe-jigsaw puzzle phakathi kwe-enzyme nama-substrate ayo (avumelana nezimo ukuze athole ukulingana okuhle phakathi kwesimo sokuguquka nendawo esebenzayo), ama-enzyme aziwa ngokuqondene kwawo. Ukulingana okungcono kakhulu"kuvela ekubunjweni nasekukhangweni kweqembu le-amino acid functional ku-substrate. Kukhona i-enzyme ehambisana ngqo ne-substrate ngayinye futhi, ngakho-ke, ku-reaction ngayinye yamakhemikhali; nokho, kukhona nokuguquguquka.

 Iqiniso lokuthi izindawo ezisebenzayo zifaneleka kahle kakhulu ukuhlinzeka ngezimo ezithile zemvelo lisho nokuthi zithonywa yimvelo yendawo. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi ukwandisa izinga lokushisa lemvelo ngokuvamile kwandisa amazinga okusabela, okubangelwa yi-enzyme noma okunye. Kodwa-ke, ukwandisa noma ukunciphisa izinga lokushisa ngaphandle kobubanzi obuhle kungathinta izibopho zamakhemikhali ngaphakathi kwendawo esebenzayo ngendlela yokuthi azifaneleki kangako ukubopha ama-substrate. Amazinga okushisa aphezulu ekugcineni azobangela ama-enzyme, njengamanye ama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo, ukuba aguquguquke, inqubo eshintsha izakhiwo zemvelo zento. Ngokufanayo, i-pH yendawo ingathinta nomsebenzi we-enzyme. Izinsalela ze-amino acid zendawo esebenzayo zinezakhiwo zazo ze-acidic noma eziyisisekelo ezifanele kakhulu i-catalysis. Lezi zinsalela zizwela izinguquko ku-pH ezingaphazamisa indlela ama-molecule e-substrate abopha ngayo. Ama-enzyme afaneleka ukusebenza kangcono ngaphakathi kobubanzi be-pH ethile, futhi, njengasezingeni lokushisa, amanani e-pH adlulele (aqinile noma ayisisekelo) emvelo angabangela ama-enzyme ukuba aguquguquke.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwemetabolism | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Indawo Esebenzayo Yama-Enzyme kanye Nokucaciswa Kwe-Substrate | Ukufaneleka Okubangelwayo kanye Nomsebenzi We-Enzyme
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Indawo Esebenzayo Yama-Enzyme kanye Nokucaciswa Kwe-Substrate | Ukufaneleka Okubangelwayo kanye Nomsebenzi We-Enzyme
chapterContent:
Iminyaka eminingi, ososayensi babecabanga ukuthi ukubopha i-enzyme-substrate kwenzeka ngendlela elula yokukhiya nokhiye. Lo modeli wagomela ngokuthi i-enzyme ne-substrate kuhlangana kahle ngesinyathelo esisodwa esisheshayo. Kodwa-ke, ucwaningo lwamanje lusekela umbono ocwengekile kakhulu obizwa ngokuthi i-induced fit (Isithombe 6.16). Imodeli ye-induced-fit ikhula phezu kwemodeli ye-lock-and-key ngokuchaza ukusebenzisana okunamandla phakathi kwe-enzyme ne-substrate. Njengoba i-enzyme ne-substrate kuhlangana, ukusebenzisana kwazo kubangela ushintsho oluncane esakhiweni se-enzyme oluqinisekisa ilungiselelo elihle lokubopha phakathi kwe-enzyme nesimo sokuguquka kwe-substrate. Lokhu kubopha okuhle kukhulisa ikhono le-enzyme lokuvuselela ukusabela kwayo.

 Lapho i-enzyme ibopha i-substrate yayo, kwakheka i-enzyme-substrate complex. Le complex yehlisa amandla okusebenza kwe-reaction futhi ikhuthaza ukuqhubekela phambili kwayo okusheshayo ngenye yezindlela eziningi. Ezingeni eliyisisekelo, ama-enzyme akhuthaza ukusabela kwamakhemikhali okubandakanya i-substrate engaphezu kweyodwa ngokuletha i-substrate ndawonye ngendlela efanele. Isifunda esifanele (ama-athomu nezibopho) ze-molecule eyodwa sixhunyaniswe nesifunda esifanele senye i-molecule lapho kumele asabele. Enye indlela ama-enzyme akhuthaza ngayo ukusabela kwama-substrate awo ukudala indawo efanele ngaphakathi kwendawo esebenzayo ukuze kwenzeke ukusabela. Ukusabela okuthile kwamakhemikhali kungaqhubeka kahle endaweni ene-acid encane noma engekho endaweni ephansi. Izakhiwo zamakhemikhali ezivela ekuhlelweni okuthile kwama-amino acid residues ngaphakathi kwendawo esebenzayo zakha indawo ephelele yama-substrate athile e-enzyme ukuze asabele.

 Ufundile ukuthi amandla okusebenza adingekayo ekuphenduleni okuningi afaka amandla ahilelekile ekuphatheni noma ekuguquleni kancane izibopho zamakhemikhali ukuze ziphuke kalula futhi zivumele abanye ukuthi baguquke. Isenzo se-enzyme singasiza kule nqubo. I-enzyme-substrate complex inganciphisa amandla okusebenza ngokuguqulela ama-molecule e-substrate ngendlela yokuthi kube lula ukuphuka kwezibopho, kusize ukufinyelela isimo sokuguquka. Okokugcina, ama-enzyme anganciphisa namandla okusebenza ngokubamba iqhaza ekuphenduleni kwamakhemikhali uqobo. Ama-amino acid residues anganikeza ama-ion athile noma amaqembu amakhemikhali empeleni akha izibopho ze-covalent nama-molecule e-substrate njengesinyathelo esidingekayo senqubo yokusabela. Kulezi zimo, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi i-enzyme izohlala ibuyela esimweni sayo sokuqala ekupheleni kwe ukusabela. Esinye sezimpawu eziphawulekayo zama-enzyme ukuthi ahlala engashintshi ngenxa yokusabela akwenzayo. Ngemva kokuba i-enzyme isiqedile ukuvuselela ukusabela, ikhipha umkhiqizo/imikhiqizo yayo

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwemetabolism | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Ukulawulwa Kokwakheka Kwemetabolism Ngokulawulwa Kwe-Enzyme
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Ukulawulwa kweMetabolism Ngokulawulwa kwe-Enzyme
chapterContent:
Kungabonakala kungcono ukuba nesimo lapho wonke ama-enzyme afakwe ku-genome yesidalwa ayekhona ngobuningi futhi esebenza kahle ngaphansi kwazo zonke izimo zamaseli, kuwo wonke amaseli, ngaso sonke isikhathi. Eqinisweni, lokhu akunjalo neze. Izindlela ezahlukahlukene ziqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu akwenzeki. Izidingo nezimo zamaseli ziyahlukahluka kusuka kuseli kuya kuseli, futhi ziyashintsha ngaphakathi kwamaseli ngamanye ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ama-enzyme adingekayo kanye nezidingo zamandla zamaseli esiswini zihlukile kunezo zamaseli okugcina amafutha, amaseli esikhumba, amaseli egazi, namaseli ezinzwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iseli lokugaya ukudla lisebenza kanzima kakhulu ukucubungula nokuphula izakhamzimba ngesikhathi esilandela ukudla uma kuqhathaniswa namahora amaningi ngemva kokudla. Njengoba lezi zidingo nezimo zamaseli ziyahlukahluka, kanjalo namanani kanye nokusebenza kwama-enzyme ahlukene.

 Njengoba amazinga okusabela kwamakhemikhali elawulwa amandla okusebenza, futhi ama-enzyme ehla futhi enquma amandla okusebenza ekusabela kwamakhemikhali, amanani ahlobene kanye nokusebenza kwezinhlobonhlobo zama-enzyme ngaphakathi kweseli ekugcineni kunquma ukuthi yiziphi izimpendulo ezizoqhubeka nokuthi yiziphi izilinganiso. Lokhu kunqunywa kulawulwa ngokuqinile. Ezindaweni ezithile zamaseli, umsebenzi wama-enzyme ulawulwa ngokwengxenye yizici zemvelo, njenge-pH kanye nokushisa. Kunezinye izindlela lapho amaseli alawula khona umsebenzi wama-enzyme futhi anqume amazinga lapho kuzokwenzeka khona ukusabela okuhlukahlukene kwamakhemikhali.

answer1: Ngoba izidingo nezimo zamaseli ziyahlukahluka kusuka kuseli kuya kuseli, futhi ziyashintsha ngaphakathi kwamaseli ngamanye ngokuhamba kwesikhathi

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwe-Metabolism | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Ukulawulwa Kwe-Metabolism Ngokulawulwa Kwe-Enzyme | Ukulawulwa Kwe-Enzyme Ngama-Molecule
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Ukulawulwa kwe-Metabolism Ngokulawulwa kwama-Enzyme | Ukulawulwa kwama-Enzyme ngama-Molecule
chapterContent:
Ama-enzyme angalawulwa ngezindlela ezikhuthaza noma ezinciphisa umsebenzi wawo. Kunezinhlobo eziningi ezahlukene zama-molecule ezivimbela noma ezikhuthaza umsebenzi we-enzyme, futhi kunezindlela ezahlukahlukene zokwenza kanjalo. Kwezinye izimo zokuvinjelwa kwama-enzyme, isibonelo, i-molecule ye-inhibitor ifana ngokwanele ne-substrate engakwazi ukubopha endaweni esebenzayo futhi imane ivimbele i-substrate ekubopheni. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, i-enzyme ivinjelwa ngokuvinjelwa okuncintisanayo, ngoba i-molecule ye-inhibitor incintisana ne-substrate yokubopha indawo esebenzayo (Isithombe 6.17). Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ekuvinjelweni okungekhona ukuncintisana, i-molecule ye-inhibitor ibopha kwi-enzyme endaweni engeyona indawo esebenzayo, ebizwa ngokuthi i-allosteric site, kodwa isakwazi ukuvimbela ukubopha kwe-substrate endaweni esebenzayo. Amanye ama-molecule e-inhibitor abopha kuma-enzyme endaweni lapho ukubopha kwawo kubangela ushintsho lokwakheka olunciphisa umsebenzi we-enzyme njengoba kungasakhuthazi ngempumelelo ukuguqulwa kwe-substrate ibe umkhiqizo.

 Amanye ama-molecule e-inhibitor abopha kuma-enzyme endaweni lapho ukubopha kwawo kubangela ushintsho lokwakheka olunciphisa ukusondelana kwe-enzyme ye-substrate yayo. Lolu hlobo lokuvimbela lubizwa ngokuthi i-allosteric inhibition (Isithombe 6.18). Ama-enzyme amaningi alawulwa yi-allosteric akhiwe ngama-polypeptide angaphezu kweyodwa, okusho ukuthi ane-subunit yamaprotheni angaphezu kweyodwa. Lapho i-allosteric inhibitor ibopha ku-enzyme, zonke izindawo ezisebenzayo kuma-subunit amaprotheni zishintshwa kancane kangangokuthi zibopha ama-substrate azo ngokusebenza okuncane. Kukhona ama-activator e-allosteric kanye nama-inhibitor. Ama-activator e-allosteric abopha ezindaweni eziku-enzyme kude nendawo esebenzayo, okubangela ushintsho lokwakheka okwandisa ukuhambisana kwesayithi(s) elisebenzayo le-enzyme kuma-substrate(s) ayo.

 Ama-enzyme amaningi awasebenzi kahle, noma angasebenzi nhlobo, ngaphandle kokuthi aboshwe kwamanye ama-molecule athile angewona amaprotheni, kungaba okwesikhashana ngezibopho ze-ionic noma ze-hydrogen noma unomphela ngezibopho ze-covalent eziqinile. Izinhlobo ezimbili zama-molecule asizayo ama-cofactor nama-coenzyme. Ukubopha kula ma-molecule kukhuthaza ukwakheka nokusebenza okuhle kwama-enzyme awo. Ama-cofactor angama-ion angaphili njenge-iron (Fe++) kanye ne-magnesium (Mg++). Isibonelo esisodwa se-enzyme edinga i-ion yensimbi njenge-cofactor yi-enzyme eyakha ama-molecule e-DNA, i-DNA polymerase, edinga i-ion ye-zinc eboshiwe (i-Zn++) ukuze isebenze. Ama-Coenzymes angama-molecule asizayo e-organic, anesakhiwo se-athomu esiyisisekelo esakhiwe yi-carbon ne-hydrogen, okudingekayo ukuze kusebenze ama-enzyme. Imithombo evame kakhulu yama-coenzymes amavithamini okudla (Isithombe 6.20). Amanye amavithamini angama-precursor kuma-coenzyme kanti amanye asebenza ngqo njengama-coenzyme. I-Vitamin C iyi-coenzyme yama-enzyme amaningi ahlanganyela ekwakheni ingxenye ebalulekile yezicubu ezixhumanisayo, i-collagen. Isinyathelo esibalulekile ekuqhekekeni kwe-glucose ukuze kukhiqizwe amandla yi-catalysis yi-multi-enzyme complex ebizwa ngokuthi i-pyruvate dehydrogenase. I-Pyruvate dehydrogenase iyinhlanganisela yama-enzyme amaningana adinga i-cofactor eyodwa (i-magnesium ion) kanye nama-coenzyme amahlanu ahlukene e-organic ukuze kukhuthazwe ukusabela kwayo kwamakhemikhali. Ngakho-ke, umsebenzi wama-enzyme, ngokwengxenye, ulawulwa yinqwaba yama-cofactor nama-coenzyme ahlukahlukene, anikezwa ngokuyinhloko ukudla kwezinto eziphilayo eziningi.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukuguqulwa Kwemetabolism | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Ukulawulwa Kwemetabolism Ngokulawulwa Kwe-Enzyme | Ukutholakala Kwezidakamizwa Ngokufuna Ama-Inhibitors Ama-Enzyme Ayinhloko Ezindleleni Ezithile
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Ukulawulwa Kwe-Metabolism Ngokulawulwa Kwe-Enzyme | Ukutholakala Kwezidakamizwa Ngokufuna Ama-Inhibitors Ama-Enzyme Ayinhloko Ezindleleni Ezithile
chapterContent:
Ama-enzyme ayizingxenye ezibalulekile zezindlela ze-metabolic. Ukuqonda ukuthi ama-enzyme asebenza kanjani nokuthi angalawulwa kanjani kuyisimiso esiyinhloko ngemuva kokuthuthukiswa kwemithi eminingi yemithi (Isithombe 6.19) emakethe namuhla. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo ezisebenza kulo mkhakha zibambisana nabanye ososayensi, ngokuvamile osokhemisi, ukuklama imithi.

 Cabanga ngama-statin isibonelo—okuyigama elinikezwe isigaba semithi ehlisa amazinga e-cholesterol. Lawa ma-com amakhilogremu empeleni ayizivimbeli ze-enzyme i-HMG-CoA reductase. I-HMG-CoA reductase yi-enzyme ehlanganisa i-cholesterol kusuka kuma-lipid emzimbeni. Ngokuvimbela le enzyme, amazinga e-cholesterol akhiqizwa emzimbeni angancishiswa. Ngokufanayo, i-acetaminophen iyisithibi se-enzyme i-cyclooxygenase. Nakuba isebenza kahle ekuhlinzekeni impumuzo emkhunjini nasekuvuvukeni (ubuhlungu), indlela esebenza ngayo ayikaqondakali ngokuphelele.

 Imithi ithuthukiswa kanjani? Enye yezinselele zokuqala ekuthuthukisweni kwemithi ukuhlonza i-molecule ethile umuthi ohloselwe ukuyihlasela. Uma kwenzeka ama-statin, i-HMG-CoA reductase iyona esetshenziswa kakhulu. Izidakamizwa zitholakala ngocwaningo olunzulu elabhorethri. Ukuthola i-target kuphela akwanele; ososayensi kudingeka bazi nokuthi i-target isebenza kanjani ngaphakathi kweseli nokuthi yiziphi izindlela zokusabela ezingalungile uma kwenzeka isifo. Uma i-target nendlela isitholakele, inqubo yangempela yokuklama izidakamizwa iqala. Phakathi nalesi sigaba, osokhemisi kanye nososayensi bezinto eziphilayo basebenzisana ukuklama nokuhlanganisa ama-molecule angavimba noma asebenze ukusabela okuthile. Kodwa-ke, lokhu kumane kuyisiqalo: kokubili uma futhi lapho uhlobo lomuthi luphumelela ekwenzeni umsebenzi walo, khona-ke kufanele luhlolwe kaningi kusukela ekuhlolweni kwe-in vitro kuya ekuhlolweni kwezokwelapha ngaphambi kokuba luthole imvume ye-FDA ukuze lube semakethe.

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Ukulawulwa kwe-Metabolism Ngokulawulwa kwe-Enzyme | Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Enzyme
chapterContent: Kumaseli e-eukaryotic, ama-molecule afana nama-enzyme avame ukuhlukaniswa abe ama-organelle ahlukene. Lokhu kuvumela elinye izinga lokulawulwa komsebenzi wama-enzyme. Ama-enzyme adingekayo kuphela ezinqubweni ezithile zamaseli angagcinwa ngokwehlukana kanye nezingxenye zawo, okuvumela ukusabela kwamakhemikhali okusebenzayo kakhudlwana. Izibonelo zalolu hlobo lokulawulwa kwama-enzyme ngokusekelwe endaweni kanye nokusondelana zifaka phakathi ama-enzyme ahilelekile ezigabeni zokugcina zokuphefumula kwamaseli, okwenzeka kuphela kwi-mitochondria, kanye nama-enzyme ahilelekile ekugayweni kwemfucumfucu yamaseli nezinto zakwamanye amazwe, ezitholakala ngaphakathi kwe-lysosomes.
question1: Kuphi lapho ama-molecule anjenge-enzyme avame ukuhlukaniswa khona kumaseli e-eukaryotic?

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwemetabolism | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Ukulawulwa Kokwakheka Kwemetabolism Ngokulawulwa Kwe-Enzyme | Ukuvinjelwa Kwempendulo Ezindleleni Zokwakheka Kwemetabolism
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | Ama-Enzyme angu-6.5 | Ukulawulwa kwe-Metabolism Ngokulawulwa kwe-Enzyme | Ukuvinjelwa kwempendulo ezindleleni ze-Metabolism
chapterContent:
Ama-molecule angalawula ukusebenza kwama-enzyme ngezindlela eziningi. Nokho, umbuzo omkhulu usasele: Ayini lawa ma-molecule futhi avelaphi? Amanye angama-cofactor nama-coenzyme, ama-ion, nama-molecule e-organic, njengoba ufundile. Yimaphi amanye ama-molecule esitokisini ahlinzeka ngokulawulwa kwama-enzyme, njengokuguqulwa kwe-allosteric, kanye nokuvimbela okuncintisanayo nokungekhona okuncintisanayo? Impendulo iwukuthi izinhlobo eziningi zama-molecule zingenza lezi zindima. Amanye ala ma-molecule afaka izidakamizwa zemithi nezingezona ezemithi, ubuthi, kanye nobuthi obuvela emvelweni. Mhlawumbe imithombo efanele kakhulu yama-molecule alawula ama-enzyme, maqondana nokusetshenziswa kwamaseli, yimikhiqizo yokusabela kwamaseli ngokwawo. Ngendlela ephumelela kakhulu nenhle, amaseli aguqukele ekusebenziseni imikhiqizo yokusabela kwawo ukuze kuvinjelwe impendulo yomsebenzi wama-enzyme. Ukuvimbela impendulo kuhilela ukusetshenziswa komkhiqizo wokusabela ukulawula ukukhiqizwa kwawo okuqhubekayo (Isithombe 6.21). Iseli lisabela ebuningini bemikhiqizo ethile ngokunciphisa ukukhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokusabela kwe-anabolic noma kwe-catabolic. Imikhiqizo yokusabela enjalo ingavimbela ama-enzyme avuselele ukukhiqizwa kwawo ngezindlela ezichazwe ngenhla.

 Ukukhiqizwa kwama-amino acid kanye nama-nucleotide kulawulwa ngokuvinjelwa kwempendulo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-ATP iwumlawuli we-allosteric wama-enzyme athile ahilelekile ekuqhekekeni kwe-catabolic kashukela, inqubo ekhiqiza i-ATP. Ngale ndlela, lapho i-ATP iningi, iseli lingavimbela ukukhiqizwa kwalo okuqhubekayo. Khumbula ukuthi i-ATP iyi-molecule engazinzile engazihlukanisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ibe yi-ADP. Uma i-ATP eningi kakhulu ikhona esitokisini, iningi layo lingaphela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-ADP isebenza njengomlawuli we-allosteric omuhle (i-activator ye-allosteric) kwamanye ama-enzyme afanayo avinjelwe yi-ATP. Ngakho-ke, lapho amazinga ahlobene e-ADP ephezulu uma kuqhathaniswa ne-ATP, iseli liqala ukukhiqiza i-ATP eyengeziwe nge-catabolism kashukela.
question1: Yiziphi ezinye zemithombo yama-molecule alawula ama-enzyme?
answer1: Imithi yezokwelapha nengeyona imithi, ubuthi, ubuthi obuvela endaweni ezungezile, kanye nemikhiqizo yokusabela kwe-metabolic yamaseli ngokwawo

distractor3a: Ukusetshenziswa kwe-ATP ukuze kusebenze unomphela wonke ama-enzyme
distractor3c: Ukusetshenziswa kwemikhiqizo ukwandisa yonke impendulo ye-metabolic

answer4: Ngokunciphisa ijubane lokukhiqiza ngesikhathi sokusabela kwe-anabolic noma kwe-catabolic
question5: Imikhiqizo yokusabela ingavimbela kanjani ama-enzyme akhuthaze ukukhiqizwa kwawo?

answer6: Ukukhiqizwa kwama-amino acid nama-nucleotide
question7: Iyiphi indima edlalwa yi-ATP ekuqhekekeni kukashukela nge-catabolic?
answer7: I-ATP iwumlawuli we-allosteric wama-enzyme athile ahilelekile ekuqhekekeni kwe-catabolic kashukela, inqubo ekhiqiza i-ATP
distractor7a: I-ATP ivimbela ngokuncintisana yonke i-enzyme ku-glycolysis

answer8: Ngoba i-ATP iyi-molecule engazinzile engahlukana ngokuzenzakalelayo ibe yi-ADP

question9: Bekungenzekani uma i-ATP eningi kakhulu ikhona esitokisini?
answer9: Okuningi kwakho kuzophela
question10: Iyiphi indima edlalwa yi-ADP ekulawulweni kwama-enzyme?
answer10: I-ADP isebenza njengomlawuli we-allosteric omuhle (i-activator ye-allosteric) kwamanye ama-enzyme afanayo avinjelwe yi-ATP
question11: Kwenzekani uma amazinga e-ADP ephezulu uma kuqhathaniswa ne-ATP?
answer11: Iseli liqala ukukhiqiza i-ATP eyengeziwe ngokusebenzisa i-catabolism kashukela

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwemetabolism | 6.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 6. Ukwakheka Kwemetabolism | 6.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
6.1 Amandla kanye neMetabolism
Amaseli enza imisebenzi yokuphila ngokusebenzisa ukusabela kwamakhemikhali ahlukahlukene. I-metabolism yeseli ibhekisela ekuphenduleni kwamakhemikhali okwenzeka ngaphakathi kwayo. Kunezindlela zokusabela kwamakhemikhali ezihilela ukuhlukaniswa kwamakhemikhali ayinkimbinkimbi abe lula, njengokuqhekeka kwama-macromolecule amakhulu. Le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-catabolism, futhi ukusabela okunjalo kuhlotshaniswa nokukhululwa kwamandla. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-anabolism ibhekisela ezinqubweni ze-metabolic ezakha ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi avela kulawo alula, njengokwenziwa kwama-macromolecule. Izinqubo ze-anabolic zidinga amandla. Ukwakheka kwe-glucose kanye nokuqhekeka kwe-glucose kuyizibonelo zezindlela ze-anabolic kanye ne-catabolic, ngokulandelana.

 6.2 Amandla Angakhona, Angakhona, Akhululekile, kanye Nokusebenza
Amandla eza ngezindlela eziningi ezahlukene. Izinto ezihambayo zenza umsebenzi womzimba, kanti amandla e-kinetic angamandla ezinto ezihambayo. Izinto ezingahambi zingase zibe namandla okwenza umsebenzi, futhi ngaleyo ndlela, zibe namandla angakhona. Ama-molecule nawo anamandla angase abe khona ngoba ukuqhekeka kwezibopho zama-molecule kunamandla okukhipha amandla. Amaseli aphilayo ancike ekuqoqweni kwamandla angase abe khona ezibophweni zama-molecule ukuze enze umsebenzi. Amandla amahhala ayisilinganiso samandla atholakalayo ukuze enze umsebenzi. Amandla amahhala esistimu ayashintsha ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwamandla njengokusabela kwamakhemikhali, futhi lolu shintsho lubizwa ngokuthi ∆G.

 I-∆G yokusabela ingaba yimbi noma ibe yimbi, okusho ukuthi ukusabela kukhipha amandla noma kudla amandla, ngokulandelana. Ukusabela okune-∆G engemihle ekhipha amandla kubizwa ngokuthi ukusabela kwe-exergonic. Okwe-∆G enhle edinga ukufakwa kwamandla kubizwa ngokuthi ukusabela kwe-endergonic. Ukusabela kwe-Exergonic kuthiwa kwenzeka ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba imikhiqizo yabo inamandla amancane kune-reactants yayo. Imikhiqizo yokusabela kwe-endergonic inesimo samandla esiphezulu kune-reactants, ngakho-ke lokhu kuyi-reactions engenzi lutho. Kodwa-ke, konke ukusabela (kufaka phakathi ukusabela okuzenzakalelayo –∆G) kudinga ukufakwa kokuqala kwamandla ukuze kufinyelelwe esimweni sokuguquka, lapho kuzoqhubeka khona. Lokhu kufakwa kokuqala kwamandla kubizwa ngokuthi amandla okusebenza.

 6.3 Imithetho yeThermodynamics
Ekufundeni amandla, ososayensi basebenzisa igama elithi uhlelo” ukubhekisela endabeni kanye nendawo ezungezile ehilelekile ekudlulisweni kwamandla. Konke okungaphandle kwesistimu kubizwa ngokuthi indawo ezungezile. Amaseli angawodwa ayizinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo. Izinhlelo zingacatshangwa njengezinohlelo oluthile. Kudinga amandla ukwenza uhlelo luhleleke kakhudlwana. Lapho uhlelo luhleleke kakhudlwana, i-entropy yalo iyancipha. I-Entropy iyisilinganiso sokuphazamiseka kwesistimu. Njengoba uhlelo luba nokuphazamiseka kakhudlwana, amandla alo aphansi futhi i-entropy yalo iba phezulu.

 Uchungechunge lwemithetho, olubizwa ngokuthi imithetho ye-thermodynamics, luchaza izakhiwo nezinqubo zokudluliselwa kwamandla. Umthetho wokuqala uthi inani eliphelele lamandla endaweni yonke lihlala njalo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi amandla awakwazi ukudalwa noma ukubhujiswa, adluliselwa noma aguqulwe kuphela. Umthetho wesibili we-thermodynamics uthi ukudluliselwa kwamandla ngakunye kuhilela ukulahlekelwa amandla ngendlela engasetshenziswa, njengamandla okushisa, okuholela ohlelweni oluphazamiseke kakhudlwana. Ngamanye amazwi, akukho ukudluliselwa kwamandla okusebenza kahle ngokuphelele futhi kuthambekele ekuphazamisekeni.

 6.4 ATP: I-Adenosine Triphosphate
I-ATP iyi-molecule eyinhloko enikeza amandla amaseli aphilayo. I-ATP yakhiwe yi-nucleotide, ushukela we-carbon emihlanu, kanye namaqembu amathathu e-phosphate. Izibopho ezixhumanisa ama-phosphate (izibopho ze-phosphoanhydride) zinokuqukethwe kwamandla aphezulu. Amandla akhishwa ku-hydrolysis ye-ATP abe yi-ADP + Pi asetshenziselwa ukwenza umsebenzi wamaseli. Amaseli asebenzisa i-ATP ukwenza umsebenzi ngokuhlanganisa ukusabela kwe-exergonic kwe-ATP hydrolysis nokusabela kwe-endergonic. I-ATP inikela ngeqembu layo le-phosphate kwenye i-molecule ngenqubo eyaziwa ngokuthi i-phosphorylation. I-molecule ye-phosphorylated isesimweni samandla aphezulu futhi ayizinzile kunesimo sayo se-unphosphorylated, futhi la mandla engeziwe avela ekufakweni kwe-phosphate avumela i-molecule ukuthi ibhekane nokusabela kwayo kwe-endergonic.

 6.5 Ama-Enzymes
Ama-Enzymes angama-catalyst amakhemikhali asheshisa ukusabela kwamakhemikhali emazingeni okushisa okuphila ngokunciphisa amandla awo okusebenza. Ama-Enzymes ngokuvamile amaprotheni aqukethe iketanga elilodwa noma ngaphezulu le-polypeptide. Ama-enzyme anendawo esebenzayo enikeza indawo yamakhemikhali ehlukile, eyakhiwe amaqembu athile e-amino acid R (izinsalela). Le ndawo eyingqayizivele ifaneleka ngokuphelele ukuguqula ama-reactant athile amakhemikhali aleyo enzyme, abizwa ngokuthi ama-substrate, abe ama-intermediate angazinzile abizwa ngokuthi izimo zokuguquka. Ama-enzyme nama-substrate kucatshangwa ukuthi abophana ngokulingana okubangelwa, okusho ukuthi ama-enzyme abhekana nokulungiswa okuncane kokwakheka lapho exhumana ne-substrate, okuholela ekubopheni okugcwele, okuhle kakhulu. Ama-enzyme abopha kuma-substrate futhi avuselele ukusabela ngezindlela ezine ezahlukene: ukuhlanganisa ama-substrate ndawonye ngendlela efanele, okuphazamisa izakhiwo zezibopho zama-substrate ukuze izibopho ziphuke kalula, ukuhlinzeka ngezimo zemvelo ezifanele kakhulu ukuze kwenzeke ukusabela, noma ukuhlanganyela ngqo ekusabeleni kwawo kwamakhemikhali ngokwakha izibopho ze-covalent ezidlulayo nama-substrate.

 Isenzo se-enzyme kumele silawulwe ukuze esitokisini esithile ngesikhathi esithile, ukusabela okufiselekayo kuyashukunyiswa futhi ukusabela okungafuneki akushukunyiswa. Ama-enzyme alawulwa yizimo zamaseli, njengokushisa kanye ne-pH. Alawulwa futhi ngendawo yawo ngaphakathi kweseli, ngezinye izikhathi ahlukaniswe ukuze akwazi kuphela kushukumisa ukusabela ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Ukuvinjelwa nokusebenza kwama-enzyme ngamanye ama-molecule kungenye yezindlela ezibalulekile ama-enzyme alawulwa ngazo. Ama-inhibitors angasebenza ngokuncintisana, ngaphandle kokuncintisana, noma ngokulingana; ama-inhibitors angancintisani ngokuvamile alingana ne-allosteric. Ama-activator angathuthukisa futhi umsebenzi wama-enzyme ngendlela efanayo. Indlela evame kakhulu lapho amaseli elawula ama-enzyme ezindleleni ze-metabolic iwukuvimbela impendulo. Ngesikhathi sokuvimbela impendulo, imikhiqizo yendlela ye-metabolic isebenza njengezithibi (ngokuvamile i-allosteric) ye-enzyme eyodwa noma ngaphezulu (ngokuvamile i-enzyme yokuqala ezinikele yendlela) ehilelekile endleleni ewakhiqizayo.

question43: Chaza ukuxhumana phakathi kokusabela kwamakhemikhali e-anabolic kanye ne-catabolic endleleni ye-metabolic
answer43: Ukusabela kwe-catabolic kukhiqiza amandla kanye ne-com elula amakhilogremu, kanti ukusabela kwe-anabolic kuhilela ukusetshenziswa kwamandla ukwenza i-com eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu amakhilogremu

distractor43c: Ukusabela kwe-catabolic kukhiqiza ama-molecule wamandla namanzi, kanti ekuphenduleni kwe-anabolic la mandla amahhala asetshenziswa yi-com elula amakhilogremu ukwenza amaprotheni nama-nucleic acid kuphela.
question44: Ingabe ukuvivinya umzimba kuhilela izinqubo ze-anabolic, izinqubo ze-catabolic, noma kokubili? Nikeza ubufakazi bempendulo yakho
answer44: Ukuvivinya umzimba kuhilela kokubili izinqubo ze-catabolic kanye ne-anabolic. I-glucose ihlukaniswa ibe yi-com elula amakhilogremu ngesikhathi somsebenzi womzimba ukuze inikeze amandla okwenza ama-molecule endleleni ye-anabolic. Lawo ma-molecule abe esesetshenziselwa ukunikeza amandla emisipha ukuze ifinyele.
distractor44a: Ukuvivinya umzimba kumane kuyinqubo yokwakheka komzimba. I-glucose ihlukaniswa ibe yi-com elula amakhilogremu ngesikhathi somsebenzi womzimba bese i-com elula amakhilogremu isetshenziselwa ukunikeza amandla emisipha ukuze inciphe.
distractor44b: Umsebenzi womzimba uhilela izinqubo ze-anabolic kuphela. I-glucose ihlukaniswa ibe yi-com elula amakhilogremu ngesikhathi somsebenzi womzimba bese i-com elula amakhilogremu isetshenziselwa ukunikeza amandla emisipha ukuze inciphe ngezindlela ze-anabolic.
distractor44c: Ukuvivinya umzimba kuhilela kokubili izinqubo ze-anabolic kanye ne-catabolic. I-cellulose ihlukaniswa ibe yi-com elula amakhilogremu ngesikhathi somsebenzi womzimba. I-com elula amakhilogremu ibe isisetshenziselwa ukunikeza amandla emisipha ukuze inciphe ngezindlela ze-anabolic.
question45: Yisiphi isitatimende esinikeza ubufakazi obunembile kakhulu bokusekela isimangalo sokuthi ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kudlala indima ekudlulisweni kwamandla?

question48: Chaza ngamazwi akho umehluko phakathi kokusabela okuzenzakalelayo kanye nokusabela okwenzeka ngokushesha
answer48: Ukusabela okuzenzakalelayo yilokho okukhipha amandla akhululekile futhi kuqhubekele esimweni esizinzile. Ukusabela okusheshayo kwenzeka ngokushesha ngokukhululwa kwamandla ngokuzumayo

distractor48b: Ukusabela okuzenzakalelayo yilokho okukhipha amandla akhululekile futhi kuqhubekele esimweni esizinzile. Ukusabela okusheshayo kwenzeka ngokushesha ngaphakathi kohlelo ngokuthatha amandla.

question49: Chaza indawo yesimo sokuguquka esikalini samandla aqondile, kusukela phansi kuya phezulu, uma kuqhathaniswa nendawo yama-reactants nemikhiqizo, kokubili ukusabela kwe-endergonic kanye ne-exergonic

distractor49b: Isimo sokuguquka kokusabela sikhona ezingeni lamandla aphansi kunezisabela. Amandla okusebenza ahlala engemihle kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukusabela kuyasebenza noma kuyasebenza.
distractor49c: Isimo sokuguquka kokusabela sikhona ezingeni lamandla aphakathi kunele-reactants. Amandla okusebenza ahlala enhle kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukusabela kuyasebenza noma ku-endergonic
question50: Cabanga ngepulazi lezintuthwane elinobuciko elinemihubhe kanye nezindlela ezidlula esihlabathini lapho kuhlala khona izintuthwane emphakathini omkhulu. Manje cabanga ukuthi ukuzamazama komhlaba kwanyakazisa umhlabathi kwabhidliza ipulazi lezintuthwane. answer50: Ipulazi lezintuthwane lisesimweni se-entropy ephezulu ngemva kokuzamazama komhlaba ngenxa yokwanda kwesiphithiphithi, futhi amandla kumele asetshenziswe ukuze kuncishiswe isistimu ye-entropy.
distractor50a: Ipulazi lezintuthwane lisesimweni se-entropy ephansi ngemva kokuzamazama komhlaba ngenxa yokwanda kwesiphithiphithi, futhi amandla kumele asetshenziswe ukuze kulethwe uhlelo ku-entropy ephezulu.
distractor50b: Ipulazi lezintuthwane lisesimweni se-entropy ephezulu ngaphambi kokuzamazama komhlaba ngenxa yokuphazamiseka okunciphile, futhi amandla akhishwa ohlelweni ngemva kokuzamazama komhlaba.
distractor50c: Ipulazi lezintuthwane lisesimweni se-entropy ephansi ngaphambi kokuzamazama komhlaba ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lokungahleliwe, futhi amandla anikezwa ohlelweni ngemva kokuzamazama komhlaba.
question51: Ukudluliselwa kwamandla kwenzeka njalo emisebenzini yansuku zonke. Cabanga ngezimo ezimbili: ukupheka esitofini nokushayela. Chaza ukuthi umthetho wesibili we-thermodynamics usebenza kanjani kulezi zimo.

distractor51b: Amandla anikezwa ohlelweni ahlala engaguquki ngesikhathi sokupheka futhi amandla engeziwe ayengezwa enjinini yemoto lapho uphethiloli uvutha
distractor51c: Amandla anikezwa ohlelweni lokupheka asiza ekwenzeni ukudla kanye namandla enjini yemoto alondolozwe lapho kushiswa uphethiloli.
question52: Bheka uMfanekiso 6.12. Chaza umfanekiso ukuze uchaze ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukuthi uhlelo lube sezingeni eliphezulu le-entropy, nokuthi leyo entropy ingancishiswa kanjani
answer52: Izinga eliphezulu le-entropy libhekisela esimweni esiphezulu sokuphazamiseka ohlelweni futhi lingancishiswa ngokufaka amandla ukuze kwehliswe i-entropy.
distractor52a: Izinga eliphezulu le-entropy libhekisela esimweni esiphezulu sokuvumelana ohlelweni futhi lingancishiswa ngokukhululwa kwamandla ukuze kwehliswe i-entropy.
distractor52b: Izinga eliphezulu le-entropy libhekisela ekuphazamisekeni okuphansi ohlelweni futhi lingancishiswa ngokufaka amandla ukuze kwandiswe i-entropy.
distractor52c: Izinga eliphezulu le-entropy libhekisela esimweni esiphezulu sokuphazamiseka ohlelweni futhi lingancishiswa ngokukhuphula izinga lokushisa ukuze kwehliswe i-entropy.
question53: Uma izinga lokushisa lomoya lehla futhi imvula iphenduka iqhwa, yimuphi umthetho we-thermodynamics ovezwayo?
question54: Bheka uMfanekiso 6.14. Ukuhlola umdwebo obonisiwe, i-ATP iwunikeza kanjani amandla ekusabeleni kwamakhemikhali?
answer54: I-ATP iyahlukana futhi amandla akhishwa ngokuphuka kwesibopho se-phosphate ngaphakathi kwe-ATP asetshenziselwa i-phosphorylation yelinye i-molecule. I-ATP hydrolysis iphinde inikeze amandla okusabela kokuxhumanisa amandla
distractor54a: I-ATP isebenzisa amandla ukuze inike amandla ukusabela okuphuthumayo ngokuyihambisa i-molecule ye-ATP. Amandla amahhala akhishwa ngenxa yokuqhekeka kwe-ATP asetshenziselwa ukwenza i-metabolism yemikhiqizo
distractor54b: I-ATP isebenzisa amandla ukuze inike amandla ukusabela kwe-endergonic ngokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni kwe-molecule ye-ATP. Amandla amahhala akhishwa ngenxa yokuwohloka kwe-ATP asetshenziselwa ukwenza i-metabolism yemikhiqizo
distractor54c: I-ATP isebenzisa amandla akhishwa yi-coupling reactions futhi lawo mandla asetshenziselwa ukunika amandla i-endergonic kanye ne-exergonic reactions
question55: Ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni kwakho amandla okusebenza kwe-EA, ingabe i-EA ye-hydrolysis ye-ATP iphansi noma iphezulu? Chaza isizathu sakho.
answer55: I-EA ye-ATP hydrolysis iphezulu ngoba amandla amaningi akhishwa
distractor55a: I-EA ye-ATP hydrolysis iphezulu ngoba inani elincane lamandla liyakhishwa
distractor55b: I-EA ye-ATP hydrolysis iphansi ngoba amandla amaningi akhishwa
distractor55c: I-EA ye-ATP hydrolysis iphakathi nendawo ngoba amandla amaningi akhishwa
question56: Kuyini i-phosphorylation njengoba kwenzeka ekuphenduleni kwamakhemikhali?
answer56: I-phosphorylation ibhekisela ekunamatheleni kweqembu le-phosphate kwenye i-molecule ukuze kube lula ukusabela kwamakhemikhali
distractor56a: I-Phosphorylation ukumuncwa kwe-molecule ye-phosphorus yi-molecule ye-ATP ukuze inike amandla ukusabela kwamakhemikhali
distractor56b: I-Phosphorylation ukukhishwa kwe-molecule yesithathu ye-phosphorous ye-ATP ngesikhathi se-hydrolysis
distractor56c: I-Phosphorylation ukuwohloka kwe-molecule ye-pyrophosphate enikeza ama-ion e-phosphate
question57: Uma ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kungenzeka ngaphandle kwe-enzyme, nikeza isizathu sokuchaza ukuthi kungani kubalulekile ukuba ne-enzyme yokuvuselela lokho kusabela
answer57: Ama-enzyme abalulekile ngoba aqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo efiselekayo kuphela ekhiqizwa yi-reaction
distractor57a: Ama-enzyme abalulekile ngoba aqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo yokusabela itholakala njalo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
distractor57b: Ama-enzyme abalulekile ngoba aqinisekisa ukuthi amandla ahlala elondolozwa futhi akukho ukulahlekelwa kwamandla okwenzekayo
distractor57c: Ama-enzyme abalulekile ngoba awashintshi ukuhlushwa kwemikhiqizo yokusabela
question58: Ukuvinjelwa kwempendulo ye-enzyme kuzuzisa kanjani iseli?
answer58: Ukuvinjelwa kokuphendula kusiza iseli ngokuvimbela ukukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo ngokushintsha ukucushwa kwama-enzyme. Lokhu kuzovimbela amaseli ekubeni yingozi
distractor58a: Ukuvinjelwa kokuphendula kusiza iseli ngokuvimbela ukukhiqizwa kwama-reactant ngokushintsha ukwakheka kwama-enzyme. Lokhu kuzovimbela amaseli ekubeni yingozi
distractor58b: Ukuvinjelwa kokuphendula kusiza iseli ngokuvimbela ukukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo ngokushintsha ukucushwa kwama-reactants. Lokhu kuzovimbela amaseli ekubeni yingozi
distractor58c: Ukuvinjelwa kokuphendula kusiza iseli ngokuvimbela ukukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo ngokunciphisa ama-reactant. Lokhu kuzovimbela amaseli ekubeni yingozi
question59: Uhlobo luni lokusabela oluvumela amakhemikhali ukuthi atholakale ukuze kukhule futhi kugcinwe isidalwa ngesikhathi esifanele?
question60: Ukuguqulwa kweseli kuyinqubo eyinkimbinkimbi esebenzisa izinhlobo eziningi zamakhemikhali ezinqubweni ezahlukahlukene. Yisiphi kulezi zitatimende ezilandelayo esinikeza ubufakazi obuhle kakhulu nobunembile balo mqondo?
distractor60a: Ukuntuleka kwe-glucose etholakalayo kuvimbela inqubo ye-photosynthesis
distractor60b: Ukulahlekelwa ama-carbohydrate atholakalayo kuvimbela i-mitosis yamaseli
question61: Yiziphi izincazelo ezimbili zokusabela kwamakhemikhali ezihambisanayo?
distractor61b: Ukwenziwa kwe-exergonic kanye nokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni
question62: Yisiphi isimiso esiyisisekelo esisekela umqondo wokuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zinezinqubo nezici ezifanayo eziyinhloko?
answer62: Zonke izinto eziphilayo kumele ziqoqe amandla endaweni yazo bese ziwaguqula abe yi-ATP ukuze zenze imisebenzi yamaseli
distractor62a: Izitshalo zikhiqiza amandla azo bese ziwadlulisela ezilwaneni
distractor62b: Izilwane ezidla uhlaza, izilwane ezidla inyama, kanye nezilwane ezidla yonke into ndawonye ukuze kusinde bonke
distractor62c: I-glucose ingumthombo oyinhloko wamandla kuyo yonke imisebenzi yamaseli
question63: Kuye kwamukelwa ukuthi ukuphila eMhlabeni kwaqala njengezinto eziphilayo ezilula ezineseli elilodwa, ezabe seziguquka zaba izinto eziphilayo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwaqhubeka kanjani nokukhiqiza izinhlobo eziningi kangaka zezinto eziphilayo ezivela kukhokho olula?
answer63: Ama-prokaryotes akhiqiza ama-protist, ahluma abe yi-fungi, izitshalo, nezilwane.
distractor63a: Ama-Prokaryotes akhiqiza isikhunta, bese kuba ama-protist abe esethela ezitshalweni nasezilwaneni.
distractor63b: AmaProtist aqala ukuvela, kwabe sekuba ama-prokaryotes, ahluma aba yi-fungi, izitshalo, nezilwane.
distractor63c: Ama-prokaryotes akhiqiza ama-protist, bese kuba yi-fungus, eyahluma yaba izitshalo nezilwane.
question64: Izitshalo zenza i-glucose ngendlela ebizwa ngokuthi i-photosynthesis. Inani lamandla athathwe ekukhanyeni lingachazwa njengenani lamandla aqukethe ama-molecule asetshenziswa ukwenza i-molecule eyodwa ye-glucose. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okubonisa kahle inani le-molecule ngayinye edingekayo?
answer64: Ama-molecule angu-18 e-ATP nama-molecule angu-12 e-NADPH
distractor64a: Ama-molecule angu-54 e-ATP nama-molecule angu-18 e-nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADPH)
distractor64b: Ama-molecule angu-24 e-ATP nama-molecule angu-18 e-NADPH
distractor64c: Ama-molecule ayi-12 e-ATP nama-molecule ayi-18 e-NADPH
question65: Iyini indlela ye-anabolic? Yikuphi kwalokhu okuyisibonelo sendlela ye-anabolic esetshenziswa amaseli ekusebenzeni kwawo kwe-metabolism?
answer65: Izindlela ze-Anabolic zakha ama-molecule amasha ngemikhiqizo yezindlela ze-catabolic. Isibonelo ukuxhumanisa kwama-nucleotide ukwakha i-molecule ye-mRNA
distractor65a: Izindlela ze-Anabolic zihilela ukuwohloka kwama-molecule ezakhamzimba abe yizinhlobo ezisebenzisekayo. Isibonelo ukuqoqwa kwama-amino acid kumaprotheni okudla.
distractor65b: Izindlela ze-Anabolic zihilela ukuwohloka kwama-molecule ezakhamzimba abe yizinhlobo ezisebenzisekayo. Isibonelo ukusetshenziswa kwe-glycogen yisibindi ukugcina amazinga kashukela egazini
distractor65c: Izindlela ze-Anabolic zakha ama-molecule amasha ngemikhiqizo yezindlela ze-catabolic. Isibonelo ukuhlukaniswa kwama-fatty acid kuma-triglycerides ukuze kwaneliswe izidingo zamandla.
question66: Uma i-glucose ihlukaniswa ngokuphefumula kwe-aerobic, inani le-ATP lingenziwa ngamandla akhishwe. Zingaki i-ATP ezingenzeka?
question67: Izitshalo kumele zibe nezinsiza ezanele zokuqedela imisebenzi yazo. Uma zingenakho ezikudingayo, kuba nezinguquko endleleni izinto eziphilayo ezisebenza ngayo. Qagela imiphumela endleleni izinto ezisebenza ngayo isitshalo esingenalo ilanga elanele.
answer67: I-Photosynthesis esitshalweni iyahamba kancane futhi kukhiqizwa i-glucose encane ukuze kusetshenziswe amandla
distractor67b: Isitshalo siyalala, siyeke kokubili i-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula, kuze kube yilapho ukukhanya kwelanga kubuya.
distractor67c: Isitshalo siqhakaza ngokushesha ukuze sizale ngesikhathi singakwazi
question68: Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kucatshangelwa ukuthi kulula kakhulu ukukubona ezitshalweni. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izitshalo ezingenawo amanzi zizobuna, njengoba amanzi angaphakathi kwamaseli esitshalo esiza ukusekela isisindo sesitshalo. Amaseli ezitshalo aphelelwa amanzi ngoba amaseli awo asebenzisa amanzi ukuze enze izinqubo ze-metabolic. Kwenzekani ku-metabolism yesitshalo esingenawo amanzi anele?
answer68: I-Photosynthesis iyavinjelwa, kukhiqizwa i-glucose encane, futhi amanzi asetshenziswa amaseli awathathelwa indawo.
distractor68a: Isitshalo sandisa ukuwohloka kwaso kwe-glucose ukuze sidale amanzi engeziwe ekupheleni kwenqubo.
distractor68b: Lesi sitshalo sizoyeka ukwenza i-photosynthesis isikhathi eside kuze kube yilapho sinamanzi anele okwenza lokho
distractor68c: Iseli lizoletha i-CO2 eyengeziwe, ukuze libuyisele ukuntuleka kwamanzi, okuvumela ukwenziwa kwe-glucose kuqhubeke
question69: Ama-enzyme alula ukusabela kwamakhemikhali okuholela ekushintsheni kwe-substrate. Sekela lesi simangalo ngesibonelo ngokuphendula lo mbuzo: Imodeli yokufaneleka ebangelwa ama-enzyme nama-substrate ichaza kanjani umsebenzi wawo?
answer69: Kokubili i-enzyme kanye ne-substrate kushintshashintsha okunamandla, okubangela isimo sokuguquka kwe-substrate
distractor69a: I-enzyme ibangela ushintsho ku-substrate kodwa ayishintshi ngokwayo ngesikhathi sokusabela
distractor69b: Ama-substrates anamathela ku-enzyme bese ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kuyaqhubeka
distractor69c: I-enzyme ishintsha isimo ukuze ivumelane ne-substrate okwenza kube nesimo sokuguquka
question70: Ama-enzyme inhibitors adlala indima ebalulekile ekulawuleni imisebenzi yama-enzyme, ewavumela ukuthi aqhubeke, noma awavimbele isikhathi esithile. Yimuphi umvimba othinta izinga lokuqala kodwa ongathinti izinga eliphezulu?

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Isitshalo samandla kagesi esikuMfanekiso 7.1 siguqula amandla kusuka kwesinye isimo siye kwesinye isimo esingasetshenziswa kalula. Lolu hlobo lwesitshalo esikhiqiza luqala ngamandla okushisa angaphansi komhlaba (ukushisa) bese luwaguqula abe amandla kagesi azothuthwa aye emakhaya nasemafektri. Njengesitshalo esikhiqizayo, izitshalo nezilwane nazo kumele zithathe amandla avela endaweni ezungezile bese ziwaguqula abe uhlobo olungasetshenziswa amaseli azo. Amandla angena emzimbeni wento ephilayo ngesimo esithile bese eguqulwa abe olunye uhlobo olunganika amandla imisebenzi yokuphila yento ephilayo. Enkambisweni ye-photosynthesis, izitshalo nabanye abakhiqizi be-photosynthesis bathatha amandla ngesimo sokukhanya (amandla elanga) bese bewaguqula abe amandla amakhemikhali, i-glucose, egcina la mandla ezibophweni zayo zamakhemikhali. Bese kuthi, uchungechunge lwezindlela ze-metabolic, ezibizwa ngokuthi ukuphefumula kwamaseli, zikhiphe amandla ezibophweni ze-carbon-carbon ze-glucose bese ziwaguqula abe uhlobo olungasetshenziswa yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo—kokubili abakhiqizi, njengezitshalo, nabathengi, njengezilwane.

 Cishe zonke izinto eziphilayo zenza i-glycolysis, ingxenye yokuqala yokuphefumula kwe-aerobic kanye ne-anaerobic. Enye yama-enzyme abalulekile e-glycolysis yi-pyruvate kinase. Ngaphandle kwale enzyme, into ephilayo izofa ngoba ayikwazi ukuguqula izakhamzimba zibe amandla ewadingayo ukuze iphile. Ososayensi basebenzise lelo thuba ngokuvimbela i-pyruvate kinase kwezinye izilokazane ezibulalayo, njengalezo ezibangela i-African Sleeping Sickness kanye nesifo i-Chagas.
question1: Isitshalo samandla kagesi esikuMfanekiso 7.1 siguqula amandla kusuka kwesinye isimo aye kwesinye isimo esingasetshenziswa kalula. Lolu hlobo lwesitshalo esikhiqiza amandla luqala ngamandla okushisa angaphansi komhlaba (ukushisa) bese luyiguqula ibe yiluphi uhlobo lwamandla oluzothuthwa luyiswe emakhaya nasemafektri?
answer1: Amandla kagesi
question2: Enkambisweni ye-photosynthesis, izitshalo nabanye abakhiqizi be-photosynthesis bathatha amandla ngayiphi indlela?
question3: Izitshalo ziguqula amandla okukhanya abe yiluphi uhlobo lwamandla ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis?
answer3: Amandla amakhemikhali, i-glucose, egcina la mandla ezibophweni zayo zamakhemikhali
question4: Yiziphi izindlela ze-metabolic ezikhipha amandla ezibophweni ze-carbon-carbon ze-glucose bese ziwaguqula abe uhlobo olungasetshenziswa yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo?
question5: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa amandla akhiqizwa ukuphefumula kwamangqamuzana?
answer5: Kokubili abakhiqizi, njengezitshalo, kanye nabathengi, njengezilwane
question6: Cishe zonke izinto eziphilayo zenza yiphi inqubo eyingxenye yokuqala yokuphefumula kwe-aerobic kanye ne-anaerobic?
answer6: I-glycolysis
question7: Enye yama-enzyme abalulekile e-glycolysis yi-enzyme enjani?
answer7: I-pyruvate kinase
question8: Kwenzekani emzimbeni ongenawo i-pyruvate kinase?
answer8: Izofa ngoba ayikwazi ukuguqula izakhamzimba zibe amandla ewadingayo ukuze iphile
question9: Ososayensi basebenzise ithuba lokuvimba i-pyruvate kinase kwezinye izilokazane ezibulalayo. Yiziphi izifo ezibalwe njengezibonelo?
answer9: Isifo Sokulala Sase-Afrika kanye nesifo se-Chagas

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Zokuphila | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Zokuphila | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njengoba sifundile ezahlukweni ezedlule, izinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla amahhala ukuze zinike amandla izinqubo zokuphila ezifana nokukhula, ukuzala, ukunyakaza, kanye nokuthutha okusebenzayo. I-ATP (adenosine triphosphate) isebenza njengemali yamandla yamaseli. Ivumela amaseli ukuthi agcine amandla futhi awadlulisele ngaphakathi kwamaseli ukuze anikeze amandla ezinqubo zamaseli ezifana nokukhula, ukunyakaza kanye nokuthutha okusebenzayo. I-molecule ye-ATP iqukethe ushukela we-ribose kanye nesisekelo se-adenine esine-phosphate ezintathu ezinamathiselwe. Ekufakweni kwe-hydrolysis ye-ATP, amandla amahhala anikezwa lapho iqembu le-phosphate noma amabili ehlukaniswa, futhi kukhiqizwa i-ADP (adenosine diphosphate) noma i-AMP (adenosine monophosphate). Amandla atholakala ekusetshenzisweni kwe-glucose asetshenziselwa ukuguqula i-ADP ibe yi-ATP ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaseli. Njengoba sihlola ukuphefumula kwamaseli, sizofunda ukuthi izindlela ezimbili i-ATP evuselelwa ngazo yiseli zibizwa ngokuthi i-phosphorylation yezinga le-substrate kanye ne-phosphorylation ye-oxidative.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye no-Big Idea 4 wohlaka lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology, njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso enkulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.2 Izinto eziphilayo zibamba futhi zigcine amandla amahhala ukuze zisetshenziswe ezinqubweni zezinto eziphilayo.

 Isayensi Yokuzijwayeza
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
3.1 Umfundi angabuza imibuzo yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.4 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo ukubuza imibuzo yesayensi mayelana nokuthi yiziphi izindlela nezici zesakhiwo ezivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zibambe, zigcine, futhi zisebenzise amandla amahhala.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.2 Izinto eziphilayo zibamba futhi zigcine amandla amahhala ukuze zisetshenziswe ezinqubweni zezinto eziphilayo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.5 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha izincazelo zezindlela nezici zesakhiwo zamaseli ezivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zibambe, zigcine, noma zisebenzise amandla amahhala.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Kwesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana nalezi zindinganiso ezilandelayo:
[APLO 2.5][APLO 2.16]

 Ukuguqulwa kwamandla ngaphakathi kweseli kuhilela izindlela eziningi zamakhemikhali ezihlanganisiwe. Iningi lalezi zindlela liyinhlanganisela yokusabela kwe-oxidation kanye nokunciphisa. Ukuxutshwa kwe-oxidation kanye nokunciphisa kwenzeka ngasikhathi sinye. Ukusabela kwe-oxidation kuhlubula i-electron kusuka ku-athomu ekwakhiweni, kanti ukungezwa kwale electron kwenye kwakhiweni kuyindlela yokunciphisa. Ngenxa yokuthi ukuxutshwa kwe-oxidation kanye nokunciphisa kuvame ukwenzeka ndawonye, lezi zindlela ezimbili zokusabela zibizwa ngokuthi ukusabela kokunciphisa i-oxidation, noma ukusabela kwe-redox
question1: Izinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla amahhala ukuze zinike amandla yiziphi izinqubo zokuphila?
answer1: Ukukhula, ukuzala, ukunyakaza, kanye nokuthuthwa okusebenzayo
question2: Yini esebenza njengemali yamandla yamaseli?
question3: Yini i-ATP evumela amaseli ukuba ayenze?
answer3: Gcina amandla bese uwadlulisela ngaphakathi kwamaseli ukuze anikeze amandla ezinqubo zamaseli njengokukhula, ukunyakaza kanye nokuthuthwa okusebenzayo
distractor3a: Gcina umoya-mpilo bese uwudlulisela ngaphakathi kwamaseli
question4: I-molecule ye-ATP yakhiwa yiziphi izingxenye?
answer4: Ushukela we-ribose kanye nesisekelo se-adenine esine-phosphates ezintathu ezinamathiselwe
distractor4a: Ushukela we-deoxyribose kanye ne-thymine enama-phosphate amathathu anamathiselwe
distractor4b: Ushukela we-ribose kanye ne-uracil enama-phosphate amabili anamathiselwe
question5: Ku-hydrolysis ye-ATP, amandla amahhala anikezwa uma kwenzekani?
answer5: Iqembu le-phosphate noma amabili ayahlukaniswa, bese kukhiqizwa i-ADP (adenosine diphosphate) noma i-AMP (adenosine monophosphate).
question6: Amandla atholakala ekugayweni kweglucose asetshenziswa ukuguqula yiliphi i-molecule libe yi-ATP ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaseli?
answer6: I-ADP
question7: Yiziphi izindlela ezimbili iseli elivuselela ngazo i-ATP?
answer7: I-phosphorylation yezinga le-substrate kanye ne-phosphorylation ye-oxidative
question8: Iningi lezindlela ezihilelekile ekuguqulweni kwamandla ngaphakathi kweseli ziyinhlanganisela yaziphi izinhlobo zokusabela?
answer8: Ukusabela kwe-oxidation kanye nokunciphisa
distractor8a: Ukusabela kwe-hydrolysis kanye nokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni
question9: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokusabela kwe-oxidation?
answer9: Ukusabela kwe-oxidation kuhlubula i-electron kusuka ku-athomu ekwakhiweni
distractor9a: Ukusabela kwe-oxidation kwenezela i-electron ku-athomu ekwakhiweni
distractor9b: Ukusabela kwe-oxidation kwenezela iqembu le-phosphate ku-ATP
distractor9c: Ukusabela kwe-oxidation kuguqula i-ATP ibe yi-glucose
question10: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokusabela kokunciphisa?
answer10: Ukungezwa kwale electron kwenye inhlanganisela kuyimpendulo yokunciphisa
distractor10a: Ukususwa kwe-electron kwenye inhlanganisela kuyindlela yokunciphisa
distractor10b: Ukususwa kweqembu le-phosphate ku-ATP kuyindlela yokunciphisa
distractor10c: Ukuguqulwa kwe-glucose ibe yi-ATP kuyindlela yokunciphisa
question11: Ngenxa yokuthi i-oxidation kanye nokunciphisa kuvame ukwenzeka ndawonye, lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zokusabela zibizwa ngokuthini?
answer11: Ukusabela kokunciphisa i-oxidation, noma ukusabela kwe-redox

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | Ama-electron Namandla
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | Ama-electron Namandla
chapterContent:
Ukususwa kwe-electron ku-molecule, okwenza i-oxidize, kuholela ekunciphiseni kwamandla angaba khona ku-compound e-oxidized. Kodwa-ke, i-electron (ngezinye izikhathi njengengxenye ye-athomu ye-hydrogen) ayihlali ingaboshiwe ku-cytoplasm yeseli. Kunalokho, i-electron idluliselwa ku-compound yesibili, kunciphisa i-compound yesibili. Ukushintsha kwe-electron kusuka ku-compound eyodwa kuya kwenye kususa amandla angaba khona ku-compound yokuqala (i-compound e-oxidized) futhi kwandisa amandla angaba khona e-compound yesibili (i-compound encishisiwe). Ukudluliselwa kwama-electron phakathi kwama-molecule kubalulekile ngoba iningi lamandla agcinwe kuma-athomu futhi asetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza imisebenzi yeseli lisesimweni sama-electron anamandla aphezulu. Ukudluliselwa kwamandla ngesimo sama-electron kuvumela iseli ukuthi lidlulise futhi lisebenzise amandla ngendlela eqhubekayo—ngamaphakeji amancane kunokuba kube ngokuqhuma okukodwa okubhubhisayo. Lesi sahluko sigxile ekukhishweni kwamandla ekudleni; uzobona ukuthi njengoba ulandela indlela yokudluliselwa, ulandela indlela yama-electron ahamba ngezindlela ze-metabolic.

 Abathwali be-Electron
Ezinhlelweni eziphilayo, uhlobo oluncane lwe-com amakhilogremu lusebenza njenge-electron shuttles: Zibopha futhi zithwale ama-electron anamandla aphezulu phakathi kwe-com amakhilogremu ezindleleni. Abathwali be-electron abayinhloko esizoxoxa ngabo bavela eqenjini lamavithamini e-B futhi bangama-nucleotide. Lawa ma-com amakhilogremu angancishiswa kalula (okungukuthi, amukela ama-electron) noma ancishiswe (alahlekelwa ama-electron). I-Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD) (Isithombe 7.2) itholakala ku-vitamin B3, i-niacin. I-NAD+ uhlobo lwe-molecule oluncishisiwe; i-NADH uhlobo oluncishisiwe lwe-molecule ngemva kokwamukela ama-electron amabili kanye ne-proton (okuhlangene okulingana ne-athomu ye-hydrogen ene-electron eyengeziwe).

 I-NAD+ ingamukela ama-electron avela ku-molecule we-organic ngokwe-equation ejwayelekile:

 Uma ama-electron engezwa ku-compound, ayancishiswa. I-compound encishiswa enye ibizwa ngokuthi i-reducing agent. Ku-equation engenhla, i-RH iyi-reducing agent, kanti i-NAD+ incishiswa ibe yi-NADH. Uma ama-electron esuswa ku-compound, ayancishiswa. I-compound encishiswa enye ibizwa ngokuthi i-oxidizing agent. Ku-equation engenhla, i-NAD+ iyi-oxidizing agent, kanti i-RH iyancishiswa ibe yi-R.

 Ngokufanayo, i-flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD) itholakala ku-vitamin B2, ebizwa nangokuthi i-riboflavin. Uhlobo lwayo oluncishisiwe yi-FADH2. Uhlobo lwesibili lwe-NAD, i-NADP, luqukethe iqembu le-phosphate elengeziwe. Kokubili i-NAD+ ne-FAD kusetshenziswa kakhulu ekukhipheni amandla kushukela, kanti i-NADP idlala indima ebalulekile ekuphenduleni kwe-anabolic kanye ne-photosynthesis
question1: Yini eba umphumela wokususwa kwe-electron ku-molecule, okwenza ibe yi-oxidizing?
answer1: Ukwehla kwamandla angaba khona ekwakhiweni okuhlanganisiwe
distractor1a: Ukwanda kwamandla angaba khona ekwakhiweni okuhlanganisiwe
question2: Kwenzekani ku-electron ngemva kokuba isusiwe ku-molecule?

question3: Ukushintsha kwe-electron kusuka kwenye i-compound kuya kwenye kunamuphi umphumela kuma-com amabili amakhilogremu?
answer3: Isusa amandla athile avela enkomishini yokuqala (i-compound e-oxidized) futhi yandisa amandla angase abe khona enkomishini yesibili (i-compound encishisiwe)
distractor3a: Kwandisa amandla angaba khona azo zombili i-com amakhilogremu
distractor3b: Kunciphisa amandla angaba khona azo zombili i-com amakhilogremu
distractor3c: Ayinawo umthelela emandleni angaba khona anoma iyiphi inhlanganisela
question4: Kungani kubalulekile ukudluliselwa kwama-electron phakathi kwama-molecule?
answer4: Iningi lamandla agcinwe kuma-athomu futhi asetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza imisebenzi yamaseli asesimweni sama-electron anamandla aphezulu
question5: Ukudluliselwa kwamandla ngesimo sama-electron kuvumela kanjani iseli ukuthi lidlulise futhi lisebenzise amandla?
answer5: Ngendlela eqhubekayo—ngamaphakethe amancane kunokuba kube ukuqhuma okukodwa okubhubhisayo
distractor5c: Kuphela ngokuguqula i-ATP ngqo ibe yi-glucose
question6: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-com amakhilogremu] olusebenza njengemishini yokuthutha ama-electron ezinhlelweni eziphilayo?
answer6: Uhlobo oluncane lwe-com amakhilogremu olubopha futhi luthwale ama-electron anamandla aphezulu phakathi kwe-com amakhilogremu ezindleleni
question7: Zitholakalaphi izithwali eziyinhloko zama-electron?
answer7: Iqembu lamavithamini B futhi livela kuma-nucleotide
question8: Yiziphi izithwali ze-electron eziyinhloko ezicatshangelwayo kulesi sigaba?
answer8: I-NAD ne-FAD
question9: Iyiphi i-vitamin etholakala ku-nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD)?
answer9: I-vitamin B3, i-niacin
question10: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-NAD oluyifomu le-molecule eli-oxidized?
answer10: I-NAD+
question11: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-NAD oluyifomu elincishisiwe le-molecule ngemva kokuba selamukele ama-electron amabili kanye ne-proton?
