answer17: I-vitamin B2, ebizwa nangokuthi i-riboflavin
question18: Iyini indlela encishisiwe ye-FAD?
answer18: I-FADH2
question19: Yini ehlukanisa i-NADP ne-NAD?
answer19: I-NADP iqukethe iqembu le-phosphate elengeziwe
question20: Yimiphi indima edlalwa yi-NAD+, FAD, kanye ne-NADP ekusetshenzisweni kwe-metabolism yamaseli?
answer20: Kokubili i-NAD+ ne-FAD kusetshenziswa kakhulu ekukhipheni amandla kushukela, futhi i-NADP idlala indima ebalulekile ekuphenduleni kwe-anabolic kanye ne-photosynthesis
distractor20a: Kokubili i-NAD+ ne-FAD kusetshenziswa kuphela ku-photosynthesis, kanti i-NADP isetshenziswa kuphela ku-glycolysis
distractor20b: I-NAD+, i-FAD, ne-NADP zisetshenziselwa kuphela i-ATP hydrolysis
distractor20c: I-NAD+, i-FAD, kanye ne-NADP zisebenza kuphela njengama-molecule esakhiwo emangqamuzaneni eseli

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-ATP Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-ATP Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo
chapterContent:
Iseli eliphilayo alikwazi ukugcina amandla amaningi akhululekile. Amandla amaningi akhululekile angaholela ekwandeni kokushisa esitokisini, okungabangela ukunyakaza okukhulu kokushisa okungalimaza bese kubhubhisa iseli. Kunalokho, iseli kumele likwazi ukuphatha lawo mandla ngendlela evumela iseli ukuthi ligcine amandla ngokuphephile futhi liwakhulule ukuze lisetshenziswe kuphela uma kudingeka. Amaseli aphilayo akufeza lokhu ngokusebenzisa i-compound adenosine triphosphate (ATP). I-ATP ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi uhlobo lwemali lwamandla” lweseli, futhi, njengohlobo lwemali, le nhlanganisela eguquguqukayo ingasetshenziswa ukugcwalisa noma yisiphi isidingo samandla seseli. Kanjani? Isebenza ngendlela efanayo nebhethri elishajekayo.

 Lapho i-ATP ihlakazeka, ngokuvamile ngokususwa kweqembu layo le-phosphate eliyi-terminal, amandla ayakhishwa. Amandla asetshenziswa ukwenza umsebenzi yiseli, ngokuvamile nge-phosphate ekhishwe ibopha kwenye i-molecule, iyisebenze. Isibonelo, emsebenzini womshini wokufinyeza kwemisipha, i-ATP inikeza amandla okuhambisa amaprotheni emisipha evuvukalayo. Khumbula umsebenzi wokuthutha osebenzayo wephampu ye-sodium-potassium kuma-membrane eseli. I-ATP ishintsha isakhiwo seprotheyini ehlanganisiwe esebenza njengephampu, ishintsha ukusondelana kwayo ne-sodium ne-potassium. Ngale ndlela, iseli lenza umsebenzi, lipompa ama-ion ngokumelene ne-gradient yawo ye-electrochemical
question1: Kungani iseli eliphilayo lingakwazi ukugcina amandla amaningi amahhala?
answer1: Amandla akhululekile ngokweqile angaholela ekwandeni kokushisa esitokisini, okungabangela ukunyakaza okukhulu kokushisa okungalimaza bese kubhubhisa iseli.
distractor1a: Amandla akhululekile ngokweqile angavimbela ukwakheka kwe-ATP
distractor1b: Amandla akhululekile ngokweqile angavimba ukwakheka kwamaprotheni
distractor1c: Amandla akhululekile ngokweqile angaguqulwa abe yi-glucose ngqo
question2: Iseli kufanele liphathe kanjani amandla?
answer2: Iseli kumele likwazi ukuphatha lawo mandla ngendlela evumela iseli ukuthi ligcine amandla ngokuphephile futhi liwakhulule ukuze asetshenziswe kuphela uma kudingeka.
distractor2a: Iseli kumele ligcine wonke amandla mahhala unomphela
distractor2b: Iseli kumele likhiphe wonke amandla ngokushesha njengokushisa
distractor2c: Iseli kumele liguqule wonke amandla abe yi-DNA
question3: Yisiphi isakhi esisetshenziswa amangqamuzana aphilayo ukugcina nokukhulula amandla ngokuphephile?
question4: I-ATP ivame ukubizwa ngokuthini?
question5: I-ATP ifana kanjani nebhethri elishajekayo?
answer5: Ingasetshenziswa ukugcwalisa noma yisiphi isidingo samandla seseli
question6: Amandla avame ukukhishwa nini ku-ATP?
answer6: Uma i-ATP ihlakazeka, ngokuvamile ngokususwa kweqembu layo lokugcina le-phosphate
question7: Amandla akhishwa yi-ATP asetshenziswa kanjani yiseli?
answer7: Amandla asetshenziswa yiseli ukwenza umsebenzi, ngokuvamile ngokubopha kwe-phosphate kwenye i-molecule, okuyenza isebenze.
question8: Uhlobo luni lomsebenzi wamaseli olunikezwa yi-ATP ngesikhathi sokufinyela kwemisipha?
answer8: I-ATP inikeza amandla okuhambisa amaprotheni emisipha egoqekayo
question9: I-ATP isiza kanjani ukunika amandla iphampu ye-sodium-potassium?
answer9: I-ATP ishintsha isakhiwo seprotheyini ehlanganisiwe esebenza njengephampu, ishintsha ukuhambisana kwayo ne-sodium ne-potassium
distractor9a: I-ATP idala ama-ion amasha e-sodium ne-potassium
distractor9c: I-ATP ithutha ngqo i-sodium ngaphandle kweprotheni
question10: Iseli lisebenza kanjani kusetshenziswa iphampu ye-sodium-potassium?
answer10: Iseli lenza umsebenzi, lipompa ama-ion ngokumelene ne-gradient yawo ye-electrochemical
distractor10a: Iseli lenza umsebenzi ngokuvumela ama-ion ukuthi asabalale ngokukhululeka phansi kwe-gradient yawo ye-electrochemical
distractor10b: Iseli lenza umsebenzi ngokuguqula ama-ion abe yi-ATP
distractor10c: Iseli lenza umsebenzi ngokugcina ama-ion ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-ATP Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi We-ATP
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-ATP Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi We-ATP
chapterContent:
Enhliziyweni ye-ATP kukhona i-molecule ye-adenosine monophosphate (AMP), eyakhiwa i-molecule ye-adenine exhunywe ku-molecule ye-ribose kanye neqembu elilodwa le-phosphate (Isithombe 7.3). Ukwengezwa kweqembu lesibili le-phosphate kule molekyuli eyinhloko kuphumela ekwakhekeni kwe-adenosine diphosphate (ADP); ukwengezwa kweqembu lesithathu le-phosphate kwakha i-adenosine triphosphate (ATP).

 Ukwengezwa kweqembu le-phosphate ku-molecule kudinga amandla. Amaqembu e-phosphate ashajwa kabi futhi ngaleyo ndlela ayaxoshana uma ehlelwe ngokulandelana, njengoba enjalo ku-ADP kanye ne-ATP. Lokhu kuxosha kwenza ama-molecule e-ADP kanye ne-ATP angazinzile ngokwemvelo. Ukukhululwa kweqembu elilodwa noma amabili e-phosphate ku-ATP, inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-dephosphorylation, kukhipha amandla
question1: Yimuphi umolekyuli osenhliziyweni ye-ATP?
answer1: I-adenosine monophosphate (AMP)
question2: Iyini i-adenosine monophosphate (AMP) eyenziwe ngayo?
answer2: I-molecule ye-adenine ehlanganiswe ne-molecule ye-ribose kanye neqembu elilodwa le-phosphate
distractor2a: I-molecule ye-adenine ehlanganiswe namaqembu amabili e-phosphate
distractor2b: I-molecule ye-ribose ehlanganiswe namaqembu amathathu e-phosphate
distractor2c: I-molecule ye-adenine ehlanganiswe ne-glucose kanye neqembu le-phosphate
question3: Yini ephumela ekufakweni kweqembu lesibili le-phosphate ku-AMP?
question4: Yini eba umphumela wokwengezwa kweqembu lesithathu le-phosphate ku-ADP?
question5: Yini edingekayo ukuze kufakwe iqembu le-phosphate ku-molecule?
question6: Kungani amaqembu e-phosphate ephikisana ku-ADP kanye ne-ATP?
answer6: Amaqembu e-phosphate ashajelwa kabi futhi ngaleyo ndlela ayaxoshana uma ehlelwe ngokulandelana
distractor6a: Amaqembu e-phosphate ashajelwe kahle futhi ayaxoshana
distractor6b: Amaqembu e-phosphate awakhethi ngogesi futhi ayaxoshana
distractor6c: Amaqembu e-phosphate ayaxoshana ngoba aqukethe i-ribose
question7: Kungani ama-molecule e-ADP ne-ATP engazinzile ngokwemvelo?
answer7: Ukuxokozela phakathi kwamaqembu abo e-phosphate ashajeke kabi kwenza ama-molecule e-ADP ne-ATP angazinzile ngokwemvelo
question8: Iyini inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi iqembu elilodwa noma amabili e-phosphate akhishwa ku-ATP?
answer8: Ukususwa kwe-phosphorylation
question9: Yini ekhishwayo uma iqembu elilodwa noma amabili e-phosphate esuswa ku-ATP?
answer9: Amandla

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-ATP Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | Amandla avela ku-ATP
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-ATP Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | Amandla avela ku-ATP
chapterContent:
I-Hydrolysis inqubo yokuqhekeza ama-macromolecule ayinkimbinkimbi phakathi. Ngesikhathi se-hydrolysis, amanzi ayahlukaniswa, noma ahlungwe, bese i-athomu ye-hydrogen (H+) ephumayo kanye neqembu le-hydroxyl (OH-) kwengezwa ku-molecule enkulu. I-hydrolysis ye-ATP ikhiqiza i-ADP, kanye ne-inorganic phosphate ion (Pi), kanye nokukhululwa kwamandla amahhala. Ukuze kuqhutshwe izinqubo zokuphila, i-ATP ihlukaniswa njalo ibe yi-ADP, futhi njengebhethri elishajekayo, i-ADP ivuselelwa njalo ibe yi-ATP ngokunamathiselwa kabusha kweqembu lesithathu le-phosphate. Amanzi, ahlukaniswe abe yi-athomu yawo ye-hydrogen kanye neqembu le-hydroxyl ngesikhathi se-ATP hydrolysis, avuselelwa kabusha lapho i-phosphate yesithathu ingezwa ku-molecule ye-ADP, okuguqula i-ATP.

 Ngokusobala, amandla kumele afakwe ohlelweni ukuze kuphinde kukhiqizwe i-ATP. Lawa mandla avelaphi? Cishe kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo emhlabeni, amandla avela ekusetshenzisweni kwe-glucose. Ngale ndlela, i-ATP iyisixhumanisi esiqondile phakathi kwesethi elinganiselwe yezindlela zokuzivocavoca ze-glucose catabolism kanye nenqwaba yezindlela zokuzivocavoca ezisebenza ngaphandle ezinika amandla amaseli aphilayo.
question1: Kuyini i-hydrolysis?
answer1: Inqubo yokuphula ama-macromolecule ayinkimbinkimbi
distractor1a: Inqubo yokuhlanganisa ama-molecule amancane abe ama-macromolecule
question2: Kwenzekani emanzini ngesikhathi se-hydrolysis?
answer2: Amanzi ayahlukaniswa, noma axutshwe, bese kuthi i-athomu ye-hydrogen (H+) ephumayo kanye neqembu le-hydroxyl (OH-) kwenezelwe ku-molecule enkulu.
distractor2a: Amanzi aguqulwa abe yi-oxygen kanye ne-ATP
distractor2c: Amanzi aguqulwa abe yi-carbon dioxide kanye negesi ye-hydrogen
question3: Yimiphi imikhiqizo ye-ATP hydrolysis?
answer3: I-ADP, kanye ne-ion ye-phosphate engakhiqizi (i-Pi), kanye nokukhululwa kwamandla amahhala
question4: I-ATP ihlukaniswa ibe yimaphi ama-molecule ukuze iqhube izinqubo zokuphila?
question5: Yini i-ADP evuselelwa njalo?
question6: I-ATP ivuselelwa kanjani kusukela ku-ADP?
answer6: Ngokunamathiselwa kabusha kweqembu lesithathu le-phosphate
question7: Kwenzekani emanzini aqhekeka ngesikhathi se-ATP hydrolysis?
answer7: Amanzi avuselelwa lapho i-phosphate yesithathu ingezwa ku-molecule ye-ADP, okuguqula i-ATP
question8: Yini edingekayo ukuze kuphinde kukhiqizwe i-ATP?
answer8: Amandla kumele afakwe ohlelweni
distractor8c: I-glucose kumele iguqulwe ngqo ibe yi-ATP
question9: Amandla okuvuselela i-ATP avelaphi cishe kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo emhlabeni?
answer9: I-metabolism ye-glucose
question10: I-ATP ihlobene kanjani ne-glucose catabolism kanye nomsebenzi wamaseli?
answer10: I-ATP iyisixhumanisi esiqondile phakathi kwesethi elinganiselwe yezindlela zokuzivocavoca ze-glucose catabolism kanye nenqwaba yezindlela zokuzivocavoca ezisebenza ngaphandle ezinika amandla amangqamuzana aphilayo.
distractor10a: I-ATP ithatha indawo ye-glucose ngqo kuzo zonke izindlela ze-metabolic
distractor10b: I-ATP ikhiqizwa kuphela ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis futhi ayisetshenziswa emsebenzini wamaseli
distractor10c: I-ATP ixhumanisa izindlela ze-anabolic ngqo nokukhiqizwa komoya-mpilo

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-ATP Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-Phosphorylation
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-ATP Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-Phosphorylation
chapterContent:
Khumbula ukuthi, kwezinye izindlela zokusabela kwamakhemikhali, ama-enzyme angase abophane nezingxenye eziningana ezisabelana komunye nomunye ku-enzyme, akhe i-complex ephakathi. I-complex ephakathi iyisakhiwo sesikhashana, futhi ivumela enye yezingxenye (njenge-ATP) kanye nama-reactant ukuthi asabelane kalula; ekuphenduleni okubandakanya i-ATP, i-ATP ingenye yezingxenye futhi i-ADP ingumkhiqizo. Ngesikhathi sokusabela kwamakhemikhali okungapheli, i-ATP yakha i-complex ephakathi ne-substrate kanye ne-enzyme ekuphenduleni. Le complex ephakathi ivumela i-ATP ukuthi idlulisele iqembu layo lesithathu le-phosphate, ngamandla ayo, ku-substrate, inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-phosphorylation. I-Phosphorylation ibhekisela ekufakweni kwe-phosphate (~P). Lokhu kuboniswa yi-reaction elandelayo ejwayelekile:

 A + enzyme + ATP→ ⁢[A − enzyme − ∼P]⁢ → B + enzyme + ADP + phosphate ion
Lapho i-complex ephakathi ihlukana, amandla asetshenziswa ukuguqula i-substrate futhi ayiguqule ibe umkhiqizo wokusabela. I-molecule ye-ADP kanye ne-ion ye-phosphate yamahhala kukhishwa endaweni futhi kuyatholakala ukuze kusetshenziswe kabusha ngokusebenzisa i-metabolism yamaseli

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-ATP Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-Substrate Phosphorylation
chapterContent: I-ATP ikhiqizwa ngezindlela ezimbili ngesikhathi sokuqhekeka kwe-glucose. Ama-molecule ambalwa e-ATP akhiqizwa (okungukuthi, avuselelwa kabusha kusuka ku-ADP) njengomphumela oqondile wokusabela kwamakhemikhali okwenzeka ezindleleni ze-catabolic. Iqembu le-phosphate lisuswa ku-reactant ephakathi endleleni, bese amandla amahhala okusabela asetshenziswa ukwengeza i-phosphate yesithathu ku-molecule ye-ADP etholakalayo, ekhiqiza i-ATP (Isithombe 7.4). Le ndlela eqondile kakhulu ye-phosphorylation ibizwa ngokuthi i-substrate-level phosphorylation

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-ATP Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-Oxidative Phosphorylation
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-ATP Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo | I-Oxidative Phosphorylation
chapterContent:
Iningi le-ATP elikhiqizwa ngesikhathi se-glucose catabolism, nokho, livela enkambisweni eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, i-chemiosmosis, eyenzeka ku-mitochondria (Isithombe 7.5) ngaphakathi kweseli le-eukaryotic noma ulwelwesi lwe-plasma lweseli le-prokaryotic. I-Chemiosmosis, inqubo yokukhiqizwa kwe-ATP ku-metabolism yamaseli, isetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza amaphesenti angama-90 e-ATP enziwa ngesikhathi se-glucose catabolism futhi futhi iyindlela esetshenziswa ekuphenduleni kokukhanya kwe-photosynthesis ukuze kusetshenziswe amandla okukhanya kwelanga. Ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP kusetshenziswa inqubo ye-chemiosmosis kubizwa ngokuthi i-oxidative phosphorylation ngenxa yokubandakanyeka komoya-mpilo enkambisweni.

 Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi
Udokotela Wezifo ze-Mitochondrial
Kwenzekani lapho ukusabela okubucayi kokuphefumula kwamaseli kungaqhubeki kahle? Izifo ze-Mitochondrial ziyizinkinga zofuzo ze-metabolism. Ukuphazamiseka kwe-Mitochondrial kungavela ekuguqukeni kwe-DNA yenuzi noma ye-mitochondrial, futhi kuphumela ekukhiqizweni kwamandla amancane kunavamile emaseli omzimba. Isibonelo, kusifo sikashukela sohlobo 2, ukusebenza kahle kwe-oxidation kwe-NADH kuyancishiswa, okuthinta i-oxidative phosphorylation kodwa hhayi ezinye izinyathelo zokuphefumula. Izimpawu zezifo ze-mitochondrial zingafaka ubuthakathaka bemisipha, ukuntuleka kokuxhumana, iziqephu ezifana nohlangothi, kanye nokulahlekelwa umbono nokuzwa. Iningi labantu abathintekile litholakala besebancane, yize kunezinye izifo eziqala kubantu abadala. Ukuhlonza nokwelapha izifo ze-mitochondrial kuyinkambu yezokwelapha ekhethekile. Ukulungiselela imfundo yalo msebenzi kudinga imfundo yasekolishi, kulandelwe yisikole sezokwelapha esinobungcweti kwezakhi zofuzo zezokwelapha. Izazi zezakhi zofuzo zezokwelapha zingaqinisekiswa yibhodi yi-American Board of Medical Genetics futhi ziqhubeke nokuzibandakanya nezinhlangano zobungcweti ezizinikele ekufundweni kwezifo ze-mitochondrial, njenge-Mitochondrial Medicine Society kanye ne-Society for Inherited Metabolic Disease.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.2 I-Glycolysis | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.2 I-Glycolysis | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Zonke izinto eziphilayo, kusukela kubhaktheriya olula kanye nemvubelo kuya ezitshalweni nezilwane eziyinkimbinkimbi, zenza uhlobo oluthile lokuphefumula kwamaseli ukuze zibambe futhi zinikeze amandla amahhala ezinqubo zamaseli. Nakuba ukuphefumula kwamaseli kanye ne-photosynthesis kwavela njengezinqubo ezizimele, namuhla kuncike komunye nomunye. Imikhiqizo ye-photosynthesis, ama-carbohydrate kanye negesi ye-oxygen, isetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaseli. Ngokufanayo, umkhiqizo olandelanayo wokuphefumula kwamaseli, igesi ye-CO2, isetshenziswa ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis. I-Glycolysis yindlela yokuqala esetshenziswa ekuqhekekeni kwe-glucose ukukhipha amandla amahhala. Esetshenziswa cishe yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo emhlabeni namuhla, i-glycolysis kungenzeka ukuthi yavela njengenye yezindlela zokuqala ze-metabolic. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi i-glycolysis yenzeka ku-cytoplasm yamaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic. (Khumbula ukuthi amaseli e-eukaryotic kuphela ane-mitochondria.)

 Njengazo zonke izindlela ze-metabolic, i-glycolysis yenzeka ngezinyathelo noma ngezigaba. Esigabeni sokuqala, indandatho ye-glucose eyisi-6-carbon ilungiselelwa ukuqhekeka (ukuhlukaniswa) ibe ama-molecule amabili e-carbon amathathu ngokutshala ama-molecule amabili e-ATP ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuhlukaniswa. (Ungakhathazeki; iseli lizophinde lithole ukutshalwa kwezimali kwe-ATP. Kufana nemakethe yamasheya: Kufanele utshale imali ukuze, ngethemba, wenze imali!) Njengoba i-glucose isetshenziswa kabanzi, ama-bond ahlelwa kabusha ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo eziqhutshwa yi-enzyme, futhi amandla amahhala ayakhishwa ukuze kwakhiwe i-ATP kusuka ku-ADP nama-molecule e-phosphate amahhala. Ukutholakala kwama-enzyme kungathinta izinga lokuguqulwa kwe-glucose. Ama-molecule amabili e-pyruvate ekugcineni akhiqizwa. Ama-electron anamandla aphezulu nama-athomu e-hydrogen adlulela ku-NAD+, okuwenza abe yi-NADH. Nakuba ama-molecule amabili e-ATP atshalwe ukuze aphazamise i-glucose ekuqaleni kwenqubo, ama-molecule amane e-ATP akhiwa yi-phosphorylation yezinga le-substrate, okuholela ekuzuzeni okunetha kwama-molecule amabili e-ATP nama-molecule amabili e-NADH eseli.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni imiqondo yokusekela kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 1 kanye ne-Big Idea 2 woHlaka Lwezifundo Zebhayoloji lwe-AP®, njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yeSayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.B
Izinto eziphilayo zixhunyaniswe yimigqa yozalo oluvela kubazali abafanayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.B.1 Izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezinqubo eziningi eziyinhloko ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezavela futhi zasakazeka kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo namuhla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ezizindeni nakuzo zonke izindawo ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuqhubekayo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza izibonelo ezithile zezinqubo zezinto eziphilayo ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezabiwe yizo zonke izizinda noma ngaphakathi kwesizinda esisodwa sokuphila, nokuthi lezi zinqubo nezinto ezigciniwe ezigciniwe ezihlanganyelwe zisekela kanjani umqondo wozalo oluvamile lwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.2 Izinto eziphilayo zibamba futhi zigcine amandla amahhala ukuze zisetshenziswe ezinqubweni zezinto eziphilayo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.
Umkhuba Wesayensi
3.1 Umfundi angabuza imibuzo yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.4 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo ukubuza imibuzo yesayensi mayelana nokuthi yiziphi izindlela nezici zesakhiwo ezivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zibambe, zigcine, futhi zisebenzise amandla amahhala.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.2 Izinto eziphilayo zibamba futhi zigcine amandla amahhala ukuze zisetshenziswe ezinqubweni zezinto eziphilayo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.5 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha izincazelo zezindlela nezici zesakhiwo zamaseli ezivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zibambe, zigcine, noma zisebenzise amandla amahhala.

 Ufundile ukuthi cishe wonke amandla asetshenziswa amangqamuzana aphilayo afika kuwo ngezibopho zikashukela, i-glucose. I-Glycolysis isinyathelo sokuqala ekuqhekekeni kwe-glucose ukukhipha amandla okusebenzisa i-metabolism yamaseli. Cishe zonke izinto eziphilayo zenza i-glycolysis njengengxenye ye-metabolism yazo. Inqubo ayisebenzi isebenzisa umoya-mpilo ngakho-ke ayinayo i-anaerobic. I-Glycolysis yenzeka ku-cytoplasm yamaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic. I-glucose ingena kumaseli e-heterotrophic ngezindlela ezimbili. Enye indlela iwukuhamba kwesibili okusebenzayo lapho ukuthutha kwenzeka khona ngokumelene ne-gradient yokuhlushwa kwe-glucose. Enye indlela isebenzisa iqembu lamaprotheni ahlanganisiwe abizwa ngokuthi amaprotheni e-GLUT, aziwa nangokuthi amaprotheni e-glucose transporter. Laba bathuthi basiza ekusakazweni kalula kwe-glucose.

 I-Glycolysis iqala ngesakhiwo esimise okwendandatho ye-carbon eziyisithupha se-molecule eyodwa ye-glucose futhi iphetha ngama-molecule amabili e-keto acid ye-carbon ezintathu ebizwa ngokuthi i-pyruvate. I-Glycolysis inezigaba ezimbili ezihlukene. Ingxenye yokuqala yendlela ye-glycolysis ibamba i-molecule ye-glucose esitokisini futhi isebenzisa amandla ukuyiguqula ukuze i-molecule kashukela ye-carbon eziyisithupha ihlukaniswe ngokulinganayo ibe ama-molecule amabili e-carbon amathathu. Ingxenye yesibili ye-glycolysis ikhipha amandla kuma-molecule bese iwagcina ngesimo se-ATP kanye ne-NADH, uhlobo oluncishisiwe lwe-NAD+

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.2 I-Glycolysis | Ingxenye Yokuqala Ye-Glycolysis (Izinyathelo Ezidinga Amandla)
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.2 I-Glycolysis | Ingxenye Yokuqala Ye-Glycolysis (Izinyathelo Ezidinga Amandla)
chapterContent:
Isinyathelo 1. Isinyathelo sokuqala ku-glycolysis (Isithombe 7.6) siqhutshwa yi-hexokinase, i-enzyme enezici ezibanzi ezikhuthaza i-phosphorylation kashukela we-carbon ayisithupha. I-Hexokinase i-phosphorylates i-glucose isebenzisa i-ATP njengomthombo we-phosphate, ikhiqiza i-glucose-6-phosphate, uhlobo lwe-glucose olusabela kakhulu. Lokhu kusabela kuvimbela i-molecule ye-glucose e-phosphorylated ukuthi iqhubeke nokusebenzisana namaprotheni e-GLUT, futhi ayisakwazi ukuphuma esitokisini ngoba i-phosphate eshajelwe kabi ngeke iyivumele ukuthi iwele ingaphakathi le-hydrophobic le-plasma membrane.

 Isinyathelo 2. Esinyathelweni sesibili se-glycolysis, i-isomerase iguqula i-glucose-6-phosphate ibe yinye yama-isomers ayo, i-fructose-6-phosphate. I-isomerase iyi-enzyme ekhuthaza ukuguqulwa kwe-molecule ibe yinye yama-isomers ayo. (Lolu shintsho oluvela ku-phosphoglucose lube yi-phosphofructose luvumela ukuhlukaniswa koshukela ekugcineni kube ama-molecule amabili e-carbon amathathu.).

 Isinyathelo 3. Isinyathelo sesithathu ukwakheka kwe-fructose-6-phosphate, okubangelwa yi-enzyme i-phosphofructokinase. I-molecule yesibili ye-ATP inikela nge-phosphate enamandla aphezulu ku-fructose-6-phosphate, ikhiqize i-fructose-1,6-bisphosphate. Kule ndlela, i-phosphofructokinase iyi-enzyme enciphisa izinga. Iyasebenza lapho ukuhlushwa kwe-ADP kuphezulu; ayisebenzi kakhulu lapho amazinga e-ADP ephansi futhi ukuhlushwa kwe-ATP kuphezulu. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona i-"ATP eyanele ohlelweni, indlela iyahamba kancane. Lolu uhlobo lokuvimbela umkhiqizo wokugcina, njengoba i-ATP ingumkhiqizo wokugcina we-glucose catabolism.

 Isinyathelo 4. Ama-phosphate anamandla aphezulu asanda kufakwa aqhubeka nokuphazamisa i-fructose-1,6-bisphosphate. Isinyathelo sesine ku-glycolysis sisebenzisa i-enzyme, i-aldolase, ukuhlukanisa i-fructose-1,6-bisphosphate ibe ama-isomers amabili e-carbon amathathu: i-dihydroxyacetone-phosphate kanye ne-glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate.

 Isinyathelo 5. Esinyathelweni sesihlanu, i-isomerase iguqula i-dihydroxyacetone-phosphate ibe yi-isomer yayo, i-glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate. Ngakho-ke, indlela izoqhubeka nama-molecule amabili e-glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate. Kuleli qophelo endleleni, kukhona ukutshalwa kwezimali kwamandla okuvela kuma-molecule amabili e-ATP ekuqhekekeni kwe-molecule eyodwa ye-glucose

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.2 I-Glycolysis | Ingxenye Yesibili Ye-Glycolysis (Izinyathelo Zokukhulula Amandla)
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.2 I-Glycolysis | Ingxenye Yesibili Ye-Glycolysis (Izinyathelo Zokukhulula Amandla)
chapterContent:
Kuze kube manje, i-glycolysis ilahlekise iseli ama-molecule amabili e-ATP futhi yakhiqiza ama-molecule amabili amancane kashukela we-carbon amathathu. Womabili la ma-molecule azoqhubeka engxenyeni yesibili yendlela, futhi kuzokhishwa amandla anele ukubuyisela ama-molecule amabili e-ATP asetshenziswa njengotshalomali lokuqala futhi akhiqize inzuzo yeseli yama-molecule amabili e-ATP engeziwe kanye nama-molecule amabili e-NADH anamandla aphezulu kakhulu.

 Isinyathelo 6. Isinyathelo sesithupha ku-glycolysis (Isithombe 7.7) sixosha ushukela (i-glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate), sikhipha ama-electron anamandla aphezulu, aqoqwa yi-electron carrier NAD+, sikhiqize i-NADH. Ushukela ube usufakwa i-phosphorylated ngokwengeza iqembu lesibili le-phosphate, likhiqize i-1,3-bisphosphoglycerate. Qaphela ukuthi iqembu lesibili le-phosphate alidingi elinye i-molecule ye-ATP.

 Nansi futhi into engaba khona evimbela le ndlela. Ukuqhubeka kokusabela kuncike ekutholakaleni kwefomu le-oxidized le-electron carrier, i-NAD+. Ngakho-ke, i-NADH kumele ihlale i-oxidized emuva ku-NAD+ ukuze kuqhutshekwe nalesi sinyathelo. Uma i-NAD+ ingatholakali, ingxenye yesibili ye-glycolysis iyehla noma iyeke. Uma i-oxygen itholakala ohlelweni, i-NADH izohlala i-oxidized kalula, nakuba ingaqondile, futhi ama-electron anamandla aphezulu avela ku-hydrogen akhishwe kule nqubo azosetshenziswa ukukhiqiza i-ATP. Endaweni engenawo umoya-mpilo, enye indlela (ukuvutshelwa) ingahlinzeka nge-oxidation ye-NADH ku-NAD+.

 Isinyathelo 7. Esinyathelweni sesikhombisa, esiqhutshwa yi-phosphoglycerate kinase (i-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-reverse reaction), i-1,3-bisphosphoglycerate inikela nge-phosphate enamandla aphezulu ku-ADP, yakha i-molecule eyodwa ye-ATP. (Lesi yisibonelo se-phosphorylation yezinga le-substrate.) Iqembu le-carbonyl ku-1,3-bisphosphoglycerate lihlala li-oxidized eqenjini le-carboxyl, bese kwakheka i-3-phosphoglycerate.

 Isinyathelo 8. Esigabeni sesishiyagalombili, iqembu elisele le-phosphate ku-3-phosphoglycerate lisuka ku-carbon yesithathu liye ku-carbon yesibili, likhiqize i-2-phosphoglycerate (i-isomer ye-3-phosphoglycerate). I-enzyme evuselela lesi sinyathelo yi-mutase (i-isomerase).

 Isinyathelo 9. I-Enolase ivuselela isinyathelo sesishiyagalolunye. Le enzyme ibangela ukuthi i-2-phosphoglycerate ilahlekelwe amanzi esakhiweni sayo; lokhu kuyindlela yokusabela kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwesibopho esiphindwe kabili esikhuphula amandla angaba khona kusibopho se-phosphate esisele futhi ikhiqize i-phosphoenolpyruvate (PEP).

 Isinyathelo 10. Isinyathelo sokugcina ku-glycolysis siqhutshwa yi-enzyme i-pyruvate kinase (i-enzyme kulokhu iqanjwe ngokusabela okuphambene kokuguqulwa kwe-pyruvate ibe yi-PEP) futhi iphumela ekukhiqizweni kwe-molecule yesibili ye-ATP nge-phosphorylation yezinga le-substrate kanye ne-compound pyruvic acid (noma uhlobo lwayo lukasawoti, i-pyruvate). Ama-enzyme amaningi ezindleleni ze-enzyme aqanjwe ngokusabela okuphambene, njengoba i-enzyme ingashukumisa kokubili ukusabela okuya phambili nokuya emuva (lokhu kungenzeka ukuthi kuchazwe ekuqaleni ngokusabela okuphambene okwenzeka ku-vitro, ngaphansi kwezimo ezingezona ezomzimba)

question23: Iyini indlela ejwayelekile yokuphefumula kwamaseli futhi yiziphi izindima ezidlalwa yi-oxygen ne-carbon dioxide kule nqubo?

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.2 I-Glycolysis | Imiphumela Ye-Glycolysis
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.2 I-Glycolysis | Imiphumela Ye-Glycolysis
chapterContent:
I-Glycolysis iqala nge-glucose futhi iphetha ngama-molecule amabili e-pyruvate, ama-molecule amane e-ATP kanye nama-molecule amabili e-NADH. Ama-molecule amabili e-ATP asetshenziswe engxenyeni yokuqala yendlela ukulungiselela indandatho ye-carbon eyisithupha ukuze ihlukaniswe, ngakho-ke iseli lithola inzuzo eningi yama-molecule amabili e-ATP kanye nama-molecule amabili e-NADH ukuze lisetshenziswe. Uma iseli lingakwazi ukugaya ama-molecule e-pyruvate ngokuqhubekayo, lizovuna ama-molecule amabili e-ATP kuphela ku-molecule eyodwa ye-glucose. Amaseli abomvu egazi asemancane avuthiwe awakwazi ukuphefumula nge-aerobic—inqubo lapho izinto eziphilayo ziguqula khona amandla lapho kukhona umoya-mpilo—futhi i-glycolysis iwumthombo wawo kuphela we-ATP. Uma i-glycolysis iphazamiseka, lawa maseli alahlekelwa ikhono lawo lokugcina amaphampu awo e-sodium-potassium, futhi ekugcineni, ayafa.

 Isinyathelo sokugcina ku-glycolysis ngeke senzeke uma i-pyruvate kinase, i-enzyme ekhuthaza ukwakheka kwe-pyruvate, ingatholakali ngobuningi obanele. Kulesi simo, yonke indlela ye-glycolysis izoqhubeka, kodwa ama-molecule amabili e-ATP kuphela azokwenziwa engxenyeni yesibili. Ngakho-ke, i-pyruvate kinase iyi-enzyme ekhawulela izinga le-glycolysis.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.3 Ukushiswa Kwe-Pyruvate Nomjikelezo We-Citric Acid | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.3 Ukushiswa Kwe-Pyruvate Nomjikelezo We-Citric Acid | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Esigabeni esilandelayo sokuphefumula kwamaseli—nalapho kukhona umoya-mpilo—i-pyruvate ekhiqizwa ku-glycolysis iguqulwa ibe yiqembu le-acetyl elixhunywe ku-molecule ethwala i-coenzyme A. I-acetyl CoA ephumelayo ivame ukulethwa isuka ku-cytoplasm iye ku-mitochondria, inqubo esebenzisa i-ATP ethile. Ku-mitochondria, i-acetyl CoA iyaqhubeka nomjikelezo we-citric acid. Umjikelezo we-citric acid (umjikelezo we-CAC noma we-TCA-tricarboxylic acid) waziwa nangokuthi umjikelezo we-Krebs. Ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa kwe-pyruvate ibe yiqembu le-acetyl, i-molecule ye-CO2 kanye nama-electron amabili anamandla aphezulu ayasuswa. Khumbula ukuthi i-glycolysis ikhiqiza ama-molecule amabili e-pyruvate, futhi ngalinye linganamathela ku-molecule ye-CoA bese lingena kumjikelezo we-citric acid. (Umthetho olula ukubala ama-carbon.” Ngenxa yokuthi izinto kanye namandla akukwazi ukudalwa noma ukubhujiswa, kumelwe silandise ngakho konke.) Ama-electron athathwa yi-NAD+, futhi i-NADH ithwala ama-electron iye endleleni yakamuva (uchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron oluchazwe ngezansi) ukuze kukhiqizwe i-ATP. I-molecule ye-glucose eyangena ekuqaleni ekuphefumuleni kwamaseli ku-glycolysis isiye yafakwa ngokuphelele oxidized. Amandla amakhemikhali angase abe khona agcinwe ngaphakathi kwama-molecule e-glucose adluliselwe ku-NADH noma asetshenziswe ukuhlanganisa ama-molecule e-ATP.

 Umjikelezo we-citric acid uyenzeka ku-mitochondrial matrix futhi uhilela uchungechunge lwe-redox kanye ne-decarboxylation reactions eziphinde zisuse ama-electron anamandla aphezulu futhi zikhiqize i-CO2. Lawa ma-electron athwalwa yi-NADH kanye ne-FADH2 kuchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron olutholakala ku-cristae ye-mitochondrion. (Akudingeki ukuthi ubambe ngekhanda izinyathelo zomjikelezo we-citric acid, kodwa uma unikezwe umdwebo womjikelezo, kufanele ukwazi ukuhumusha izinyathelo.) Phakathi nomjikelezo, i-ATP yenziwa kusuka ku-ADP kanye ne-phosphate engaphili nge-phosphorylation yezinga le-substrate.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.2 Izinto eziphilayo zibamba futhi zigcine amandla amahhala ukuze zisetshenziswe ezinqubweni zezinto eziphilayo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
3.1 Umfundi angabuza imibuzo yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.4 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo ukubuza imibuzo yesayensi mayelana nokuthi yiziphi izindlela kanye nezici zesakhiwo ezivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zibambe, zigcine, futhi zisebenzise amandla amahhala.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.2 Izinto eziphilayo zibamba futhi zigcine amandla amahhala ukuze zisetshenziswe ezinqubweni zezinto eziphilayo

6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

2.5 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha izincazelo zezindlela kanye nezici zesakhiwo samaseli ezivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zibambe, zigcine, noma zisebenzise amandla amahhala.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.2 Isakhiwo nomsebenzi wezingxenye ezingaphansi kweseli, kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo, kuhlinzeka ngezinqubo ezibalulekile zamaseli.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.6 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo ngokwekhwalithi ukuchaza ukuthi ukusebenzisana kwezakhiwo ezingaphansi kwamangqamuzana, ezinemisebenzi ekhethekile, kunikeza imisebenzi ebalulekile.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Isayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[APLO 2.1][APLO 2.5][APLO 2.16][APLO 2.17][APLO 2.18]

 Uma umoya-mpilo utholakala, ukuphefumula kwe-aerobic kuzoqhubeka. Kumaseli e-eukaryotic, ama-molecule e-pyruvate akhiqizwa ekupheleni kwe-glycolysis athuthwa aye kwi-mitochondria. Lapho, i-pyruvate izoguqulwa ibe yiqembu le-acetyl elizothathwa futhi lisebenze yi-compound ethwala ebizwa ngokuthi i-coenzyme A (CoA). I-compound ephumelayo ibizwa ngokuthi i-acetyl CoA. I-CoA yenziwe nge-vitamin B5, i-pantothenic acid. I-Acetyl CoA ingasetshenziswa ngezindlela ezahlukene yiseli, kodwa umsebenzi wayo oyinhloko ukuletha iqembu le-acetyl elivela ku-pyruvate esigabeni esilandelayo sendlela ekuguquguqukeni kwe-glucose.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.3 Ukushiswa Kwe-Pyruvate Nomjikelezo We-Citric Acid | Ukuhlukaniswa Kwe-Pyruvate
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.3 Ukushiswa Kwe-Pyruvate Nomjikelezo We-Citric Acid | Ukuhlukaniswa Kwe-Pyruvate
chapterContent:
Ukuze i-pyruvate, umkhiqizo we-glycolysis, ingene endleleni elandelayo, kumele ibhekane nezinguquko eziningana. Ukuguqulwa kuyinqubo yezinyathelo ezintathu (Isithombe 7.9).

 Isinyathelo 1. Iqembu le-carboxyl lisuswa ku-pyruvate, likhipha i-molecule ye-carbon dioxide endaweni ezungezile. Umphumela walesi sinyathelo iqembu le-hydroxyethyl elinamakhabhoni amabili eliboshwe ku-enzyme (i-pyruvate dehydrogenase). Leli yiqembu lokuqala lamakhabhoni ayisithupha avela ku-molecule ye-glucose yokuqala okufanele lisuswe. Lesi sinyathelo siqhubeka kabili (khumbula: kunezinhlayiya ezimbili ze-pyruvate ezikhiqizwa ekupheleni kwe-glycolysis) kuwo wonke ama-molecule we-glucose acutshungulwa; ngakho-ke, amakhabhoni amabili kwayisithupha azobe esesusiwe ekupheleni kwezinyathelo zombili.

 Isinyathelo 2. Iqembu le-hydroxyethyl li-oxidized libe yiqembu le-acetyl, futhi ama-electron athathwa yi-NAD+, akha i-NADH. Ama-electron anamandla aphezulu avela ku-NADH azosetshenziswa kamuva ukukhiqiza i-ATP.

 Isinyathelo 3. Iqembu le-acetyl eliboshwe yi-enzyme lidluliselwa ku-CoA, likhiqize i-molecule ye-acetyl CoA.

 Qaphela ukuthi phakathi nesigaba sesibili sokusebenza kwe-glucose, noma nini lapho i-athomu yekhabhoni isuswa, iboshelwa kuma-athomu amabili e-oxygen, ikhiqiza i-carbon dioxide, omunye wemikhiqizo yokugcina yokuphefumula kwamaseli.

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.3 Ukushiswa Kwe-Pyruvate Nomjikelezo We-Citric Acid | I-Acetyl CoA kuya ku-CO2
chapterContent: Uma kukhona umoya-mpilo, i-acetyl CoA iletha iqembu layo le-acetyl ku-molecule ye-carbon ezine, i-oxaloacetate, ukuze yakhe i-citrate, i-molecule ye-carbon eziyisithupha enamaqembu amathathu e-carboxyl; le ndlela izovuna amandla asele akhishwayo kulokho okwaqala njenge-molecule ye-glucose. Le ndlela eyodwa ibizwa ngamagama ahlukene: umjikelezo we-citric acid (wokuqala owakhiwe phakathi—i-citric acid, noma i-citrate—lapho i-acetate ihlangana ne-oxaloacetate), umjikelezo we-TCA (njengoba i-citric acid noma i-citrate kanye ne-isocitrate kungama-tricarboxylic acid), kanye nomjikelezo we-Krebs, ngemuva kukaHans Krebs, owaqala ukuhlonza izinyathelo endleleni ngawo-1930 emisipheni ye-pigeon flight.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.3 Ukushiswa Kwe-Pyruvate Nomjikelezo We-Citric Acid | Umjikelezo We-Citric Acid
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.3 Ukushiswa Kwe-Pyruvate Nomjikelezo We-Citric Acid | Umjikelezo We-Citric Acid
chapterContent: Njengokuguqulwa kwe-pyruvate ibe yi-acetyl CoA, umjikelezo we-citric acid wenzeka ku-matrix ye-mitochondria. Cishe wonke ama-enzyme omjikelezo we-citric acid ayancibilika, ngaphandle kwe-enzyme eyodwa i-succinate dehydrogenase, efakwe olwelwesini lwangaphakathi lwe-mitochondrion. Ngokungafani ne-glycolysis, umjikelezo we-citric acid uyindilinga evaliwe: Ingxenye yokugcina yendlela ivuselela i-compound esetshenziswe esinyathelweni sokuqala. Izinyathelo eziyisishiyagalombili zomjikelezo ziwuchungechunge lwe-redox, ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni, umswakama, kanye nokusabela kwe-decarboxylation okukhiqiza ama-molecule amabili e-carbon dioxide, i-GTP/ATP eyodwa, kanye nezinhlobo ezincishisiwe ze-NADH ne-FADH2 (Isithombe 7.10). Lokhu kubhekwa njengendlela ye-aerobic ngoba i-NADH ne-FADH2 ezikhiqizwayo kumele zidlulisele ama-electron azo endleleni elandelayo ohlelweni, ezosebenzisa umoya-mpilo. Uma lokhu kudluliswa kungenzeki, izinyathelo ze-oxidation zomjikelezo we-citric acid nazo azenzeki. Qaphela ukuthi umjikelezo we-citric acid ukhiqiza i-ATP encane kakhulu ngqo futhi awudli umoya-mpilo ngqo.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.3 Ukushiswa Kwe-Pyruvate Nomjikelezo We-Citric Acid | Umjikelezo We-Citric Acid | Izinyathelo Zomjikelezo We-Citric Acid
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.3 Ukushiswa Kwe-Pyruvate Nomjikelezo We-Citric Acid | Umjikelezo We-Citric Acid | Izinyathelo Zomjikelezo We-Citric Acid
chapterContent:
Isinyathelo 1. Ngaphambi kokuqala kwesinyathelo sokuqala, kwenzeka isigaba sokuguquka lapho i-pyruvic acid iguqulwa ibe yi-acetyl CoA. Bese, isinyathelo sokuqala somjikelezo siqala: Lesi yisinyathelo sokujiya, sihlanganisa iqembu le-acetyl elinekhabhoni ezimbili ne-molecule ye-oxaloacetate enekhabhoni ezine ukuze kwakhiwe i-molecule enekhabhoni eziyisithupha ye-citrate. I-CoA iboshelwe eqenjini le-sulfhydryl (-SH) futhi isakazeka ukuze ekugcineni ihlangane nelinye iqembu le-acetyl. Lesi sinyathelo asinakuguqulwa ngoba sisebenza kanzima kakhulu. Izinga lalokhu kusabela lilawulwa yimpendulo engemihle kanye nenani le-ATP elitholakalayo. Uma amazinga e-ATP enyuka, izinga lalokhu kusabela liyancipha. Uma i-ATP ingekho, izinga liyakhuphuka.

 Isinyathelo 2. Esigabeni sesibili, i-citrate ilahlekelwa yi-molecule eyodwa yamanzi futhi ithola enye njengoba i-citrate iguqulwa ibe yi-isomer yayo, i-isocitrate.

 Isinyathelo 3. Esigabeni sesithathu, i-isocitrate iyaqiniswa, ikhiqize i-molecule ye-carbon emihlanu, i-α-ketoglutarate, kanye ne-molecule ye-CO2 nama-electron amabili, anciphisa i-NAD+ ibe yi-NADH. Lesi sinyathelo silawulwa futhi yimpendulo engemihle evela ku-ATP kanye ne-NADH, kanye nomphumela omuhle we-ADP.

 Izinyathelo 3 kanye no-4. Izinyathelo zesithathu kanye nesine zombili ziyizinyathelo ze-oxidation kanye ne-decarboxylation, ezikhipha ama-electron anciphisa i-NAD+ ibe yi-NADH futhi zikhulule amaqembu e-carboxyl akha ama-molecule e-CO2. I-α-Ketoglutarate ingumkhiqizo wesinyathelo sesithathu, kanti iqembu le-succinyl lingumkhiqizo wesinyathelo sesine. I-CoA ibopha iqembu le-succinyl ukuze lakhe i-succinyl CoA. I-enzyme evuselela isinyathelo sesine ilawulwa ukuvinjelwa kwe-feedback ye-ATP, i-succinyl CoA, kanye ne-NADH.

 Isinyathelo 5. Esigabeni sesihlanu, iqembu le-carboxyl lithathelwa indawo yi-coenzyme A, bese kwakheka isibopho esinamandla aphezulu. Lawa mandla asetshenziswa ku-phosphorylation yezinga le-substrate (ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa kweqembu le-succinyl libe yi-succinate) ukuze kwakheke i-guanosine triphosphate (GTP) noma i-ATP. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili ze-enzyme, ezibizwa ngama-isoenzymes, kulesi sinyathelo, kuye ngohlobo lwezicubu zesilwane lapho zitholakala khona. Uhlobo olulodwa lutholakala ezicutshini ezisebenzisa inani elikhulu le-ATP, njengemisipha yenhliziyo neyamathambo. Lolu hlobo lukhiqiza i-ATP. Uhlobo lwesibili lwe-enzyme lutholakala ezicutshini ezinenani elikhulu lezindlela ze-anabolic, njengezicubu zesibindi. Lolu hlobo lukhiqiza i-GTP. I-GTP ilingana ngamandla ne-ATP; noma kunjalo, ukusetshenziswa kwayo kunqunyelwe kakhulu. Ikakhulukazi, ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni kusebenzisa kakhulu i-GTP.

 Isinyathelo 6. Isinyathelo sesithupha inqubo yokukhipha i-hydrogen eguqula i-succinate ibe yi-fumarate. Ama-athomu amabili e-hydrogen adluliselwa ku-FAD, akhiqiza i-FADH2. Amandla aqukethwe kuma-electron ala ma-athomu awanele ukunciphisa i-NAD+ kodwa anele ukunciphisa i-FAD. Ngokungafani ne-NADH, lesi sithwali sihlala sinamathele ku-enzyme futhi sidlulisela ama-electron ku-chain yokuthutha ama-electron ngqo. Le nqubo yenziwa ukuthi ikwazi ukwenzeka ngokutholakala kwe-enzyme evuselela lesi sinyathelo ngaphakathi kwe-membrane yangaphakathi ye-mitochondrion.

 Isinyathelo 7. Amanzi ayengezwa ku-fumarate ngesikhathi sesinyathelo sesikhombisa, bese kukhiqizwa i-malate. Isinyathelo sokugcina emjikelezweni we-citric acid sivuselela i-oxaloacetate ngokufaka i-oxidizing malate. Elinye i-molecule ye-NADH likhiqizwa kule nqubo.

chapterContent: Ama-athomu amabili ekhabhoni angena emjikelezweni we-citric acid avela eqenjini ngalinye le-acetyl, amelela ama-carbon amane kwayisithupha e-molecule eyodwa ye-glucose. Ama-molecule amabili e-carbon dioxide akhishwa ekuphendukeni ngakunye komjikelezo; noma kunjalo, lawa awaqukethe ama-athomu e-carbon asanda kufakwa. Ama-athomu amabili e-acetyl carbon azokhishwa ekugcineni ekuphendukeni kamuva komjikelezo; ngakho-ke, wonke ama-athomu ayisithupha ekhabhoni avela ku-molecule yokuqala ye-glucose ekugcineni afakwa ku-carbon dioxide. Ukuphenduka ngakunye komjikelezo kwakha ama-molecule amathathu e-NADH kanye ne-molecule eyodwa ye-FADH2. Laba bathwali bazoxhumana nengxenye yokugcina yokuphefumula kwe-aerobic ukuze bakhiqize ama-molecule e-ATP. I-GTP eyodwa noma i-ATP nayo yenziwa emjikelezweni ngamunye. Ama-com amaningi aphakathi amakhilogremu emjikelezweni we-citric acid angasetshenziswa ekwakhiweni kwama-amino acid angabalulekile; ngakho-ke, umjikelezo u-amphibolic (kokubili i-catabolic kanye ne-anabolic)

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.4 I-Oxidative Phosphorylation | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.4 I-Oxidative Phosphorylation | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
I-electron transport chain (ETC) yisigaba sokuphefumula kwe-aerobic esisebenzisa i-oxygen yamahhala njengokwamukela ama-electron okugcina ama-electron asusiwe ngesikhathi se-metabolism ye-glucose ku-glycolysis kanye nomjikelezo we-citric acid. I-ETC itholakala kulwelwesi lwe-mitochondrial cristae, indawo enezimbobo eziningi ezandisa indawo engaphezulu etholakalayo yokusabela kwamakhemikhali. Ama-electron athwalwa yi-NADH kanye ne-FADH2 alethwa kumaprotheni e-electron amukelayo afakwe kulwelwesi njengoba ehamba eya ku-electron amukelayo yokugcina, i-O2, akha amanzi. Ama-electron adlula ochungechungeni lwe-redox reactions, esebenzisa amandla amahhala ezindaweni ezintathu ukuthutha ama-ion e-hydrogen kulo lonke ulwelwesi. Le nqubo inegalelo ekwakhekeni kwe-H+ gradient esetshenziswa ku-chemiosmosis. Njengoba ama-proton eqhutshwa phansi kwe-gradient yawo yokuhlushwa nge-ATP synthase, i-ATP ikhiqizwa kusuka ku-ADP kanye ne-phosphate engaphili. Ngaphansi kwezimo ze-aerobic, izigaba zokuphefumula kwamaseli zingakhiqiza i-ATP engu-36-38.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 ye-AP® Biology Curriculum Framework, njengoba kuboniswe kuthebula. Njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni, imiqondo ehlanganiswe kulesi sigaba ihambisana nezinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe ku-Curriculum Framework ezinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

[I-APLO 2.5][I-APLO 2.15][I-APLO 2.18][I-APLO 2.22]

 Usanda kufunda ngezindlela ezimbili Zethula i-glucose catabolism—i-glycolysis kanye nomjikelezo we-citric acid—okhiqiza i-ATP. Iningi le-ATP elikhiqizwa ngesikhathi se-aerobic catabolism ye-glucose, nokho, alikhiqizwa ngqo kulezi zindlela. Kunalokho, litholakala enkambisweni eqala ngokuhambisa ama-electron ochungechungeni lwabathuthi be-electron abadlula ekuphenduleni kwe-redox. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi ama-ion e-hydrogen aqoqeke ngaphakathi kwesikhala esiphakathi kwe-membrane. Ngakho-ke, kwakheka i-gradient yokuhlushwa lapho ama-ion e-hydrogen esakazeka khona esikhaleni esiphakathi kwe-membrane aye ku-mitochondrial matrix ngokudlula ku-ATP synthase. Ugesi wama-ion e-hydrogen unika amandla isenzo se-catalytic se-ATP synthase, e-phosphorylates ADP, ekhiqiza i-ATP

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.4 I-Oxidative Phosphorylation | Uchungechunge Lokuthutha Lwe-Electron
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.4 I-Oxidative Phosphorylation | Uchungechunge Lokuthutha Lwe-Electron
chapterContent:
Uchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron (Isithombe 7.11) luyingxenye yokugcina yokuphefumula kwe-aerobic futhi luwukuphela kwengxenye ye-metabolism ye-glucose esebenzisa umoya-mpilo womkhathi. I-oksijini isakazeka njalo ezitshalweni; ezilwaneni, ingena emzimbeni ngesistimu yokuphefumula. Ukuthuthwa kwama-electron kuwuchungechunge lwezimpendulo ze-redox ezifana nomjaho wokudlulisa noma i-bucket brigade lapho ama-electron edluliswa ngokushesha kusuka kwesinye isakhi kuya kwesinye, kuya ekugcineni kochungechunge lapho ama-electron enciphisa khona umoya-mpilo wama-molecule, ekhiqiza amanzi. Kunezinhlobo ezine zama-complex ezakhiwe ngamaprotheni, abhalwe ukuthi I kuya ku-IV ku-Isithombe 7.11, futhi ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zinhlobo ezine zama-complex, kanye nezithwali zama-electron ezihambisanayo ezihambayo, ezihambisanayo, kubizwa ngokuthi uchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron. Uchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron lukhona ngamakhophi amaningi ku-membrane yangaphakathi ye-mitochondrial yama-eukaryotes kanye ne-plasma membrane yama-prokaryotes.

 I-Complex I
Okokuqala, ama-electron amabili athwalwa ku-complex yokuqala egibele i-NADH. Le complex, ebhalwe ukuthi I, yakhiwe yi-flavin mononucleotide (FMN) kanye ne-iron-sulfur (Fe-S)-equkethe iphrotheni. I-FMN, etholakala ku-vitamin B2, ebizwa nangokuthi i-riboflavin, ingenye yamaqembu amaningana okufakelwa noma izinto ezihambisanayo kuchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron. Iqembu lokufakelwa liyi-molecule engeyona iphrotheni edingekayo ekusebenzeni kwephrotheni. Amaqembu okufakelwa angama-molecule e-organic noma angaphili, angewona ama-peptide aboshwe kwiphrotheni eyenza kube lula ukusebenza kwayo; amaqembu okufakelwa afaka ama-co-enzyme, angamaqembu okufakelwa ama-enzyme. I-enzyme eku-complex I yi-NADH dehydrogenase futhi yakhiwe ngamaketanga angu-44 ahlukene e-polypeptide. I-Complex I ingapompa ama-ion amane e-hydrogen ngaphesheya kwe-membrane kusukela ku-matrix iye esikhaleni se-intermembrane, futhi ngale ndlela i-gradient ye-hydrogen ion isungulwa futhi igcinwe phakathi kwamagumbi amabili ahlukaniswe yi-membrane yangaphakathi ye-mitochondrial.

 Q kanye ne-Complex II
I-Complex II ithola ngqo i-FADH2, engadluli kwi-complex I. I-compound exhumanisa ama-complex okuqala nawesibili kweyesithathu yi-ubiquinone (Q). I-molecule ye-Q iyancibilika futhi ihamba ngokukhululekile enkabeni ye-hydrophobic ye-membrane. Uma isinciphile, (QH2), i-ubiquinone iletha ama-electron ayo enkombeni elandelayo ku-chain transport electron. I-Q ithola ama-electron atholakala ku-NADH avela ku-complex I, kanye nama-electron atholakala ku-FADH2 avela ku-complex II. Le enzyme kanye ne-FADH2 kwakha i-complex encane eletha ama-electron ngqo ku-chain transport electron, idlula i-complex yokuqala. Njengoba la ma-electron edlula futhi ngaleyo ndlela enganiki amandla i-proton pump ku-complex yokuqala, kwenziwa ama-molecule ambalwa e-ATP avela kuma-electron e-FADH2. Inani lama-molecule e-ATP atholakale ekugcineni lilingana ngqo nenani lama-proton adonswa ku-membrane yangaphakathi ye-mitochondrial.

 I-Complex III
I-complex yesithathu yakhiwe yi-cytochrome b, enye iphrotheni ye-Fe-S, isikhungo se-Rieske (isikhungo se-2Fe-2S), kanye namaprotheni e-cytochrome c; le complex ibizwa nangokuthi i-cytochrome oxidoreductase. Amaprotheni e-cytochrome aneqembu lokufakelwa le-heme. I-molecule ye-heme ifana ne-heme ku-hemoglobin, kodwa ithwala ama-electron, hhayi umoya-mpilo. Ngenxa yalokho, i-ion yensimbi engaphakathi kwayo iyancishiswa futhi i-oxidized njengoba idlula ama-electron, ishintshashintsha phakathi kwezimo ezahlukene ze-oxidation: i-Fe++ (encishisiwe) kanye ne-Fe+++ (e-oxidized). Ama-molecule e-heme kuma-cytochrome anezici ezihlukile kancane ngenxa yemiphumela yamaprotheni ahlukene awabopha, enikeza izici ezihlukile kancane ku-complex ngayinye. I-Complex III ipompa ama-proton ngokusebenzisa ulwelwesi futhi idlulisele ama-electron ayo ku-cytochrome c ukuze athuthwe aye ku-complex yesine yamaprotheni nama-enzyme (i-cytochrome c iyamukela ama-electron avela ku-Q; nokho, kuyilapho i-Q ithwala ama-electron amabili, i-cytochrome c ingamukela eyodwa kuphela ngesikhathi).

 I-Complex IV
I-complex yesine yakhiwe ngamaprotheni e-cytochrome c, a, kanye ne-a3. Le nhlanganisela iqukethe amaqembu amabili e-heme (elilodwa kuma-cytochrome amabili, i-a, ne-a3) kanye nama-ion amathathu ethusi (ipheya le-CuA kanye ne-CuB eyodwa ku-cytochrome a3). Ama-cytochrome abambe i-molecule ye-oxygen ngokuqinile phakathi kwama-ion ensimbi nethusi kuze kube yilapho i-oxygen isinciphile ngokuphelele. I-oxygen encishisiwe bese ithatha ama-ion amabili e-hydrogen kusuka endaweni ezungezile ukuze yenze amanzi (H2O). Ukususwa kwama-ion e-hydrogen ohlelweni kunegalelo ekukhuleni kwama-ion asetshenziswa enkambisweni ye-chemiosmosis.

answer17: I-oxygen encishisiwe ibe isithatha ama-ion amabili e-hydrogen kusuka endaweni ezungezile ukuze yenze amanzi (H2O)
distractor17b: I-oxygen encishisiwe ihlangana ne-carbon dioxide ukuze kwakhiwe i-glucose
question18: I-Complex IV inegalelo kanjani ku-chemiosmosis?
answer18: Ukususwa kwama-ion e-hydrogen ohlelweni kunegalelo ekukhuleni kwama-ion asetshenziswa enkambisweni ye-chemiosmosis.
distractor18a: Ihlanganisa ngqo i-ATP ngaphandle kwe-proton gradient
distractor18b: Ipompa i-carbon dioxide kuyo yonke i-membrane

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.4 I-Oxidative Phosphorylation | I-Chemiosmosis
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.4 I-Oxidative Phosphorylation | I-Chemiosmosis
chapterContent:
Ku-chemiosmosis, amandla amahhala avela ochungechungeni lwe-redox reactions olusanda kuchaziwe asetshenziselwa ukupompa ama-ion e-hydrogen (ama-proton) kulo lonke ulwelwesi. Ukusatshalaliswa okungalingani kwama-ion e-H+ kulo lonke ulwelwesi kusungula kokubili ukuhlushwa kanye ne-gradients kagesi (ngakho-ke, i-gradient ye-electrochemical), ngenxa yokushaja okuhle kwama-ion e-hydrogen kanye nokuhlangana kwawo kolunye uhlangothi lwelwelwesi.

 Uma ulwelwesi beluvulekele ukusabalala ngama-ion e-hydrogen, ama-ion angase asakazeke abuyele ku-matrix, eqhutshwa yi-gradient yawo ye-electrochemical. Khumbula ukuthi ama-ion amaningi awakwazi ukusabalala ezindaweni ezingezona i-polar zama-membrane e-phospholipid ngaphandle kosizo lweziteshi ze-ion. Ngokufanayo, ama-ion e-hydrogen esikhaleni se-matrix angadlula kuphela kulwelwesi lwangaphakathi lwe-mitochondrial ngeprotheni ye-membrane ehlanganisiwe ebizwa ngokuthi i-ATP synthase (Isithombe 7.12). Le phrotheni eyinkimbinkimbi isebenza njengejeneretha encane, ephendulwa ngamandla ama-ion e-hydrogen asakazeka kuyo, phansi ku-gradient yawo ye-electrochemical. Ukuphenduka kwezingxenye zalo mshini wama-molecule kwenza kube lula ukungezwa kwe-phosphate ku-ADP, kwakhiwe i-ATP, kusetshenziswa amandla angase abe yi-hydrogen ion gradient.

 I-Chemiosmosis (Isithombe 7.13) isetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza amaphesenti angama-90 e-ATP enziwa ngesikhathi se-aerobic glucose catabolism; futhi kuyindlela esetshenziswa ekuphenduleni kokukhanya kwe-photosynthesis ukusebenzisa amandla okukhanya kwelanga enkambisweni ye-photophosphorylation. Khumbula ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP kusetshenziswa inqubo ye-chemiosmosis ku-mitochondria kubizwa ngokuthi i-oxidative phosphorylation. Umphumela ojwayelekile walokhu kusabela ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP emandleni ama-electron asusiwe kuma-athomu e-hydrogen. Lawa ma-athomu ekuqaleni ayeyingxenye ye-molecule ye-glucose. Ekupheleni kwendlela, ama-electron asetshenziselwa ukunciphisa i-molecule ye-oxygen ibe ama-ion e-oxygen. Ama-electron engeziwe ku-oxygen adonsela ama-ion e-hydrogen (ama-proton) avela endaweni ezungezile, bese kwakheka amanzi.

question13: Bheka uMfanekiso 7.12. I-Dinitrophenol (DNP) iyi-uncoupler eyenza i-inner mitochondrial membrane leak protons (H+). Yasetshenziswa kwaze kwaba ngu-1938 njengomuthi wokwehlisa isisindo. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani lokhu kungaba umuthi osebenzayo wokwehlisa isisindo?
answer13: I-DNP isusa i-proton gradient ku-matrix, ivimbele ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP. Umzimba ube usukhulisa izinga lawo lokugaya ukudla, okuholela ekunciphiseni isisindo.
distractor13a: I-DNP yehlisa i-gradient ye-proton esikhaleni sangaphakathi se-mitochondrial, okuholela ekusetshenzisweni okusheshayo kwe-acetyl-CoA, okubangela ukwehla kwesisindo
distractor13b: I-DNP ivimba ukuhamba kwama-proton nge-ATP synthase, imise ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP. Amandla agciniwe ayanyamalala njengokushisa, okubangela ukwehla kwesisindo
distractor13c: I-DNP ihlukanisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP ngokwandisa i-proton gradient ku-matrix. Amandla agciniwe ayanyamalala njengokushisa, okubangela ukwehla kwesisindo.
question14: Bheka uMfanekiso 7.13. I-Cyanide ivimbela i-cytochrome c oxidase, ingxenye yochungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron. Uma kwenzeka ubuthi be-cyanide, ungalindela ukuthi i-pH yesikhala se-intermembrane ikhuphuke noma yehle? Imuphi umphumela i-cyanide engaba nawo ekwakhiweni kwe-ATP?

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.4 I-Oxidative Phosphorylation | I-ATP Yield
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.4 I-Oxidative Phosphorylation | I-ATP Yield
chapterContent:
Inani lama-molecule e-ATP akhiqizwa yi-catabolism ye-glucose liyahlukahluka. Isibonelo, inani lama-ion e-hydrogen angapompa ama-electron transport chain complex ngokusebenzisa i-membrane liyahlukahluka phakathi kwezinhlobo. Omunye umthombo wokwehluka uvela ekuthuthweni kwama-electron kuwo wonke ama-membrane e-mitochondria. (I-NADH ekhiqizwa yi-glycolysis ayikwazi ukungena kalula kwi-mitochondria.) Ngakho-ke, ama-electron athathwa ngaphakathi kwe-mitochondria yi-NAD+ noma i-FAD+. Njengoba ufundile ngaphambili, lawa ma-molecule e-FAD+ angathutha ama-ion ambalwa; ngenxa yalokho, ama-molecule e-ATP ambalwa akhiqizwa lapho i-FAD+ isebenza njengomthwali. I-NAD+ isetshenziswa njengomthuthi we-electron esibindini kanti i-FAD+ isebenza ebuchosheni.

 Esinye isici esithinta ukukhiqizwa kwama-molecule e-ATP akhiqizwa yi-glucose iqiniso lokuthi ama-com aphakathi amakhilogremu kulezi zindlela asetshenziselwa ezinye izinjongo. I-glucose catabolism ixhumana nezindlela ezakha noma eziphula zonke ezinye i-com amakhilogremu emaseli, futhi umphumela uba mubi kakhulu kunezimo ezinhle ezichazwe kuze kube manje. Isibonelo, ushukela ngaphandle kwe-glucose ufakwa endleleni ye-glycolytic ukuze kukhishwe amandla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ushukela we-carbon emihlanu owakha ama-nucleic acid wenziwa kusuka kuma-intermediate ku-glycolysis. Ama-amino acid athile angabalulekile angenziwa kusuka kuma-intermediate kokubili i-glycolysis kanye nomjikelezo we-citric acid. Ama-lipid, njenge-cholesterol kanye ne-triglycerides, nawo enziwa kusuka kuma-intermediate kulezi zindlela, futhi ama-amino acid kanye ne-triglycerides ahlukaniswa ukuze athole amandla ngalezi zindlela. Sekukonke, ezinhlelweni eziphilayo, lezi zindlela ze-glucose catabolism zikhipha cishe amaphesenti angu-34 wamandla aqukethwe ku-glucose.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.5 Ukuguqulwa Kwemetabolism Ngaphandle Kwe-Oksijini | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.5 Ukuguqulwa Kwemetabolism Ngaphandle Kwe-Oksijini | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, ngaphansi kwezimo ze-aerobic ukuphefumula kwamaseli kungakhiqiza ama-molecule e-ATP angu-36-38. Uma i-oxygen ingekho, i-ATP ikhiqizwa kuphela yi-phosphorylation yezinga le-substrate. Ngaphandle kwe-oxygen, izinto eziphilayo kumele zisebenzise enye i-electron acceptor. Izinto eziphilayo eziningi zizosebenzisa uhlobo oluthile lokubilisa ukuze kufezwe ukuvuselelwa kwe-NAD+ ukuqinisekisa ukuqhubeka kwe-glycolysis. Ekubilisweni kotshwala, i-pyruvate evela ku-glycolysis iguqulwa ibe yi-ethyl alcohol; ngesikhathi sokubiliswa kwe-lactic acid, i-pyruvate incishiswa ukuze yakhe i-lactate njengomkhiqizo wokugcina. Ngaphandle kokubilisa nokuphefumula kwe-anaerobic, besingeke sibe ne-yogurt noma isoso soy. Futhi amangqamuzana ethu emisipha ngeke acindezeleke ngenxa yokwakheka kwe-lactate lapho sizivocavoca ngamandla futhi i-oxygen iyivelakancane.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology, njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu weMikhuba Yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto ezidaliwe.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yomkhuba Wesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[APLO 2.21][APLO 2.24][APLO 4.14][APLO 4.26]

 Ekuphefumuleni kwe-aerobic, isamukeli sokugcina se-electron yi-molecule ye-oxygen, i-O2. Uma kwenzeka ukuphefumula kwe-aerobic, khona-ke i-ATP izokhiqizwa kusetshenziswa amandla ama-electron anamandla aphezulu athwalwa yi-NADH noma i-FADH2 ku-chain transport. Uma ukuphefumula kwe-aerobic kungenzeki, i-NADH kumele i-reoxidized ibe yi-NAD+ ukuze isetshenziswe kabusha njengesithwali se-electron ukuze indlela ye-glycolytic iqhubeke. Lokhu kwenziwa kanjani? Ezinye izinhlelo eziphilayo zisebenzisa i-molecule ye-organic njengesamukeli sokugcina se-electron. Izinqubo ezisebenzisa i-molecule ye-organic ukuvuselela i-NAD+ kusuka ku-NADH zibizwa ngokuthi ukubiliswa. Ngokuphambene nalokho, kwezinye izinhlelo eziphilayo, i-electron transport chain (ETC) isebenzisa i-molecule engaphili njengesamukeli sokugcina se-electron, okubizwa ngokuthi ukuphefumula kweseli ye-anaerobic. Zombili lezi zinqubo zivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi ziguqule amandla ukuze zisetshenziswe lapho kungekho umoya-mpilo.

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaselula | 7.5 Ukuguqulwa Kwemetabolism Ngaphandle Kwe-Oksijini | Ukuphefumula Kwamaselula Angena-Aerobic (Ukuvutshelwa Kwe-Lactic Acid, Ukuvutshelwa Kotshwala, Ezinye Izinhlobo Zokuvutshelwa)
chapterContent:
Ama-prokaryotes athile, kufaka phakathi ezinye izinhlobo zamabhaktheriya kanye ne-Archaea, asebenzisa ukuphefumula okungena-aerobic. Isibonelo, iqembu le-Archaea elibizwa ngokuthi ama-methanogens linciphisa i-carbon dioxide ibe yi-methane ukuze lixube i-NADH. Lawa ma-microorganisms atholakala enhlabathini nasezindleleni zokugaya zezilwane ezincelisayo, njengezinkomo nezimvu. Ngokufanayo, amabhaktheriya anciphisa i-sulfate kanye ne-Archaea, iningi lawo elinga-anaerobic (Isithombe 7.14), anciphisa i-sulfate ibe yi-hydrogen sulfide ukuze avuselele i-NAD+ kusuka ku-NADH.

 Ukuvutshelwa kwe-Lactic Acid
Indlela yokuvutshelwa esetshenziswa yizilwane kanye namabhaktheriya athile, njengalawo akuyogathi, ukuvutshelwa kwe-lactic acid (Isithombe 7.15). Lolu hlobo lokuvutshelwa lusetshenziswa njalo kumaseli egazi abomvu ezilwane ezincelisayo kanye nasemisipheni yamathambo engenawo umoya-mpilo owanele ukuvumela ukuphefumula kwe-aerobic kuqhubeke (okungukuthi, emisipheni esetshenziswa kuze kube sezingeni lokukhathala). Emisipheni, ukuqongelela kwe-lactic acid kumele kususwe ukujikeleza kwegazi kanye ne-lactate elethwe esibindini ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokuguqulwa kwe-metabolism. Ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kokubiliswa kwe-lactic acid yilena elandelayo:

 I-Pyruvicacid+NADH↔lacticacid+NAD+
I-enzyme esetshenziswa kulokhu kusabela yi-lactate dehydrogenase (LDH). Ukusabela kungaqhubeka kunoma iyiphi indlela, kodwa ukusabela kusuka kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla kuvinjelwa yizimo ze-acid. Ukuqongelela okunjalo kwe-lactic acid kwake kwacatshangwa ukuthi kubangela ukuqina kwemisipha, ukukhathala, kanye nobuhlungu, yize ucwaningo lwamuva nje luphikisana nalo mbono. Uma i-lactic acid isisusiwe emisipheni futhi isakazwa esibindini, ingaguqulwa ibe yi-pyruvic acid futhi iqhutshwe kabusha ibe amandla.

 Ukubiliswa Kotshwala
Enye inqubo ejwayelekile yokubiliswa ukubiliswa kotshwala (Isithombe 7.16) esikhiqiza i-ethanol, i-alcohol. Ukusabela kokuqala kwamakhemikhali kokubiliswa kotshwala okulandelayo (i-CO2 ayihlanganyeli ekusabeleni kwesibili):

 i-pyruvicacid+H+→CO2+acetaldehyde+NADH+H+→ethanol+NAD+
Ukusabela kokuqala kushukunyiswa yi-pyruvate decarboxylase, i-enzyme ye-cytoplasmic, ene-coenzyme ye-thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP, etholakala ku-vitamin B1 futhi ebizwa nangokuthi i-thiamine). Iqembu le-carboxyl lisuswa ku-pyruvic acid, likhipha i-carbon dioxide njengegesi. Ukulahleka kwe-carbon dioxide kunciphisa usayizi we-molecule nge-carbon eyodwa, okwenza i-acetaldehyde. Ukusabela kwesibili kushukunyiswa yi-alcohol dehydrogenase ukuze kuxutshwe i-NADH ibe yi-NAD+ futhi kuncishiswe i-acetaldehyde ibe yi-ethanol. Ukuvutshelwa kwe-pyruvic acid ngemvubelo kukhiqiza i-ethanol. Ukubekezelela i-ethanol yemvubelo kuyahlukahluka, kusukela cishe kumaphesenti ama-5 kuya kwangu-21, kuye ngokuthi uhlobo lwemvubelo lunjani kanye nezimo zemvelo.

 Ezinye Izinhlobo Zokuvutshelwa
Ezinye izindlela zokuvutshelwa zenzeka kumabhaktheriya. Ama-prokaryotes amaningi awana-aerobic ngokwesayensi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi zingashintsha phakathi kokuphefumula kwe-aerobic kanye nokuvutshelwa, kuye ngokuthi umoya-mpilo ukhona yini. Ama-prokaryotes athile, njenge-Clostridia, ayabopha ama-anaerobes. Ama-anaerobes abophekile aphila futhi akhule ngaphandle komoya-mpilo wama-molecule. Umoya-mpilo uyingozi kulawa ma-microorganisms futhi uyawabulala lapho evezwa. Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi izinhlobo eziningi zokuvutshelwa zikhiqiza igesi (okuhlukile yi-lactic acid fermentation, ezimweni eziningi, engaholeli ekukhiqizweni kwegesi). Ukukhiqizwa kwezinhlobo ezithile zegesi kusetshenziswa njengesibonakaliso sokuvutshelwa kwama-carbohydrate athile, okudlala indima ekuboneni amabhaktheriya elabhorethri. Izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokuvutshelwa zisetshenziswa izinto eziphilayo ezahlukahlukene ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala okwanele kwe-NAD+ kwesinyathelo sesithupha ku-glycolysis. Ngaphandle kwalezi zindlela, leso sinyathelo besingeke senzeke futhi akukho ATP ezovunwa kusukela ekuqhekekeni kwe-glucose.

chapterContent:
Ukuqhekeka kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwama-carbohydrate, amaprotheni, ama-lipid, nama-nucleic acid kuxhumene nezindlela ze-metabolic ze-glycolysis kanye nomjikelezo we-citric acid kodwa kungena ezindleleni ngamaphuzu ahlukene. Ngakho-ke, la ma-macromolecule angasetshenziswa njengemithombo yamandla amahhala.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology, njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Usufundile nge-catabolism ye-glucose, enikeza amandla kumaseli aphilayo. Kodwa izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa okungaphezu kwe-glucose yokudla. I-sandwich ye-turkey igcina kanjani njenge-ATP kumaseli akho? Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba zonke izindlela ze-catabolic zama-carbohydrate, amaprotheni, nama-lipid ekugcineni zixhuma ku-glycolysis kanye nezindlela zomjikelezo we-citric acid (bheka Umfanekiso 7.18). Izindlela ze-metabolic kufanele zicatshangelwe njengezinezimbobo—okungukuthi, izinto zingena zivela kwezinye izindlela, kanti izinto eziphakathi ziyaphuma ziye kwezinye izindlela. Lezi zindlela azizona izinhlelo ezivaliwe. Eziningi zezingxenye, izinto eziphakathi, kanye nemikhiqizo endleleni ethile ziyizinto ezisabela kwezinye izindlela

I-Glycogen, i-polymer ye-glucose, iyi-molecule yokugcina amandla ezilwaneni. Uma kukhona i-ATP eyanele, i-glucose eningi ifakwa ku-glycogen ukuze igcinwe. I-Glycogen yenziwa futhi igcinwe esibindini nasemisipheni. I-glycogen izofakwa ku-hydrolyzed ibe yi-glucose 1-phosphate monomers (G-1-P) uma amazinga kashukela egazini ehla. Ukuba khona kwe-glycogen njengomthombo we-glucose kuvumela i-ATP ukuthi ikhiqizwe isikhathi eside ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca. I-Glycogen ihlukaniswa ibe yi-G-1-P futhi iguqulwe ibe yi-G-6-P kuwo womabili amaseli emisipha nesibindi, futhi lo mkhiqizo ungena endleleni ye-glycolytic.

 I-Sucrose iyi-disaccharide ene-molecule ye-glucose kanye ne-molecule ye-fructose ehlanganiswe ndawonye ngokuxhumana kwe-glycosidic. I-Fructose ingenye yama-monosaccharides amathathu ekudleni, kanye ne-glucose ne-galactose (okuyingxenye yoshukela wobisi, i-disaccharide lactose), emuncwa ngqo egazini ngesikhathi sokugaya. I-catabolism ye-fructose, i-galactose, kanye ne-glucose ikhiqiza inani elifanayo lama-molecule e-ATP.

chapterContent: Amaprotheni aguqulwa abe yi-hydrolyzed yizinhlobo ezahlukene zama-enzyme emaseli. Isikhathi esiningi, ama-amino acid aphinde asetshenziswe ekuhlanganisweni kwamaprotheni amasha. Nokho, uma kukhona ama-amino acid amaningi, noma uma umzimba usesimweni sokulamba, amanye ama-amino acid azothunyelwa ezindleleni ze-glucose catabolism (Isithombe 7.17). I-amino acid ngayinye kumele isuswe iqembu layo lama-amino ngaphambi kokungena kulezi zindlela. Iqembu lama-amino liguqulwa libe yi-ammonia. Ezincelisayo, isibindi senza i-urea kusuka kuma-molecule amabili e-ammonia kanye ne-molecule ye-carbon dioxide. Ngakho-ke, i-urea ingumkhiqizo oyinhloko wemfucuza ezincelisayo, okhiqizwa yi-nitrogen evela kuma-amino acid, futhi ishiya umzimba emchameni.

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.6 Ukuxhumana Kwezindlela Zokusebenza Kwe-Carbohydrate, Amaprotheni, kanye Ne-Lipid | Ukuxhumana Kwe-Lipid kanye ne-Glucose Metabolisms
chapterContent:
Ama-lipid axhunywe ezindleleni ze-glucose yi-cholesterol kanye ne-triglycerides. I-cholesterol iyi-lipid enegalelo ekuguquguqukeni kwe-membrane yeseli futhi iyisandulela sama-hormone e-steroid. Ukwenziwa kwe-cholesterol kuqala ngamaqembu e-acetyl futhi kuqhubekela phambili ngendlela eyodwa kuphela. Le nqubo ayinakuguqulwa.

 Ama-Triglycerides ayindlela yokugcina amandla isikhathi eside ezilwaneni. Ama-Triglycerides enziwe nge-glycerol kanye nama-fatty acid amathathu. Izilwane zingenza iningi lama-fatty acid eziwadingayo. Ama-Triglycerides angenziwa futhi ahlukaniswe ngezingxenye zezindlela ze-glucose catabolism. I-Glycerol ingafakwa i-phosphorylated ibe yi-glycerol-3-phosphate, eqhubeka nge-glycolysis. Ama-fatty acid ahlanganiswa enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-beta-oxidation eyenzeka ku-matrix ye-mitochondria futhi iguqule izintambo zawo zama-fatty acid zibe amayunithi amabili e-carbon amaqembu e-acetyl. Amaqembu e-acetyl athathwa yi-CoA ukuze akhe i-acetyl CoA eqhubeka nomjikelezo we-citric acid

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.6 Ukuxhumana Kwezindlela Zokusebenza Kwe-Carbohydrate, Amaprotheni, kanye Ne-Lipid | Izindlela Zokwenziwa Kwe-Photosynthesis kanye Ne-Cellular Metabolism
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.6 Ukuxhumana Kwezindlela Zokusebenza Kwe-Carbohydrate, Amaprotheni, kanye Ne-Lipid | Izindlela Zokwenziwa Kwe-Photosynthesis kanye Ne-Cellular Metabolism
chapterContent:
Izinqubo ze-photosynthesis kanye ne-metabolism yamaseli ziqukethe izindlela eziningana eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu. Ngokuvamile kucatshangwa ukuthi amangqamuzana okuqala avele endaweni enamanzi—isobho” lezakhamzimba—mhlawumbe phezu kobumba oluthile olunezimbobo. Uma lawa maseli ezala ngempumelelo futhi izinombolo zawo zikhuphuka kancane kancane, kulandela ukuthi amangqamuzana ayezoqala ukuqeda izakhamzimba endaweni ayehlala kuyo njengoba eshintsha izakhamzimba zibe izingxenye zemizimba yawo. Lesi simo esicatshangelwayo sasiyoholela ekukhetheni kwemvelo okusiza lezo zinto eziphilayo ezazingaba khona ngokusebenzisa izakhamzimba ezazisele endaweni yazo nangokusebenzisa lezi zakhamzimba zibe izinto ezazingasinda kuzo. Ukukhetha kwakuzosiza lezo zinto eziphilayo ezazingakhipha inani eliphezulu kwezakhamzimba ezazifinyelela kuzo.

 Uhlobo lokuqala lwe-photosynthesis lwavela olwasebenzisa amandla elanga lusebenzisa amanzi njengomthombo wama-athomu e-hydrogen, kodwa le ndlela ayizange ikhiqize umoya-mpilo wamahhala (i-anoxygenic photosynthesis). (I-photosynthesis yasekuqaleni ayizange ikhiqize umoya-mpilo wamahhala ngoba ayizange isebenzise amanzi njengomthombo wama-ion e-hydrogen; esikhundleni salokho, yasebenzisa izinto ezifana ne-hydrogen sulfide futhi ngenxa yalokho yakhiqiza isulfure). Kucatshangwa ukuthi i-glycolysis yathuthuka ngalesi sikhathi futhi ingasebenzisa ushukela olula okhona kwakhiqizwa, kodwa lokhu kusabela akuzange kukwazi ukukhipha ngokugcwele amandla agcinwe kuma-carbohydrate. Ukuthuthukiswa kwe-glycolysis cishe kwangaphambi kokuvela kwe-photosynthesis, njengoba kwakufanelekela kahle ukukhipha amandla ezintweni eziqongelela ngokuzenzekelayo esobho sokuqala.” Uhlobo lwakamuva lwe-photosynthesis lwasebenzisa amanzi njengomthombo wama-electron ne-hydrogen, futhi lwakhiqiza umoya-mpilo wamahhala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhathi waba nomoya-mpilo, kodwa hhayi ngaphambi kokuba umoya-mpilo ukhiphe izinsimbi ezi-oxidized olwandle futhi wadala ungqimba lokugqwala odakeni, okuvumela isikhathi sokuvela kwama-photosynthesizers okuqala e-oxygen. Izinto eziphilayo zajwayela ukusebenzisa lesi simo esisha esavumela ukuphefumula kwe-aerobic njengoba sisazi ukuthi siguquke. Lapho inqubo ephelele ye-photosynthesis ye-oxygen ithuthuka futhi umkhathi waba nomoya-mpilo, amaseli ekugcineni akwazi ukusebenzisa umoya-mpilo okhishwa yi-photosynthesis ukukhipha amandla amaningi kakhulu kuma-molecule kashukela esebenzisa umjikelezo we-citric acid kanye ne-phosphorylation ye-oxidative.
question1: Kungani ukukhetha kwemvelo kungavuna izinto eziphilayo ezingasebenzisa izakhamzimba ezisele endaweni yazo?
answer1: Zingasinda ngokukhipha inani eliphezulu kwizakhamzimba ezilinganiselwe
question2: I-photosynthesis yokuqala ye-anoxygen yayihlukile ku-photosynthesis ye-oxygen ngoba:
answer2: Basebenzise izinto ezifana ne-hydrogen sulfide esikhundleni samanzi futhi abazange bakhiqize umoya-mpilo
question3: Kungani i-photosynthesis yokuqala ingakhiphanga umoya-mpilo wamahhala?
answer3: Ayizange isebenzise amanzi njengomthombo we-hydrogen; yasebenzisa i-com amakhilogremu njenge-hydrogen sulfide esikhundleni salokho.
question4: Ngokusho kokucabanga kokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwamanje, i-glycolysis cishe yavela ngaphambi kwe-photosynthesis ngoba:
answer4: Ingakhipha amandla kuma-molecule alula aqongelela esobho sasendulo
question5: Uhlobo lwakamuva lwe-photosynthesis lwakhiqiza umoya-mpilo wamahhala ngokusebenzisa:
question6: Njengoba umoya-mpilo uqongelela emkhathini woMhlaba, kuqala:
answer6: Izinsimbi ezifakwe i-oxidized olwandle, zakha izingqimba zokugqwala ezidakeni
question7: Ukufakwa komoya-mpilo emoyeni woMhlaba ekugcineni kwavumela ukuvela kwalokhu okulandelayo:
answer7: Ukuphefumula kwe-aerobic
question8: I-photosynthesis ye-oxygen inike amandla amangqamuzana ukukhipha amandla amaningi kushukela ngokusebenzisa:
answer8: Umjikelezo we-citric acid kanye ne-oxidative phosphorylation
question9: Ngokusho kwesigaba se-Evolution Connection, izindlela ze-metabolic zavela ngokulandelana okungakanani?
answer9: I-glycolysis → i-photosynthesis ye-anoxygenic → i-photosynthesis ye-oxygenic → umjikelezo we-citric acid kanye ne-phosphorylation ye-oxidative
distractor9a: I-anoxygenic photosynthesis → i-glycolysis → i-oxygenic photosynthesis → umjikelezo we-citric acid kanye ne-oxidative phosphorylation
distractor9b: I-anoxygenic photosynthesis → i-oxygenic photosynthesis → i-glycolysis → umjikelezo we-citric acid kanye ne-oxidative phosphorylation
distractor9c: I-glycolysis → umjikelezo we-citric acid kanye ne-oxidative phosphorylation → i-anoxygenic photosynthesis → i-oxygenic photosynthesis

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaselula | 7.7 Ukulawulwa Kokuphefumula Kwamaselula | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukuphefumula kwamaseli kulawulwa ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene. Isibonelo, ukungena kwe-glucose esitokisini kulawulwa amaprotheni okuthutha asiza i-glucose ukuthi idlule nge-membrane yeseli. Kodwa-ke, iningi lokulawula izinqubo zokuphefumula kufezwa ngokuvinjelwa kwempendulo engemihle kwama-enzyme athile aphendula ekugxilweni kwangaphakathi kweseli kwe-ATP, ADP, NAD+, kanye ne-FAD, njll.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology, njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yeSayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso Enkulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.C
Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphendula ukuze zilawule ukukhula nokuzala, kanye nokugcina i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.C.1 Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphendula ukuze zilondoloze izindawo zazo zangaphakathi futhi ziphendule ezinguqukweni zemvelo zangaphandle.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezizinda ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuhlala njalo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.16 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuxhumanisa indlela izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa ngayo impendulo engemihle ukuze zilondoloze izindawo zazo zangaphakathi.

 Ukuphefumula kwamaseli kumele kulawulwe ukuze kuhlinzekwe amandla alinganayo ngesimo se-ATP. Iseli kumele futhi likhiqize inani le-com ephakathi amakhilogremu esetshenziswa ku-anabolism kanye ne-catabolism yama-macromolecule. Ngaphandle kokulawula, ukusabela kwe-metabolic kungashesha ukuma njengoba ukusabela phambili nangemuva kufinyelela esimweni sokulingana. Izinsiza zingasetshenziswa ngokungafanele. Iseli alidingi inani eliphakeme le-ATP elingalenza ngaso sonke isikhathi: Ngezinye izikhathi, iseli lidinga ukuvimba ezinye zezindlela eziphakathi ukuze zikhiqize ama-amino acid, amaprotheni, i-glycogen, ama-lipid, kanye ne-nucleic acid. Ngamafuphi, iseli lidinga ukulawula i-metabolism yalo
