chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.7 Ukulawulwa Kokuphefumula Kwamaseli | Izindlela Zokulawula
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.7 Ukulawulwa Kokuphefumula Kwamaseli | Izindlela Zokulawula
chapterContent:
Kusetshenziswa izindlela ezahlukahlukene ukulawula ukuphefumula kwamaseli. Kukhona uhlobo oluthile lokulawula kuzo zonke izigaba ze-metabolism ye-glucose. Ukufinyelela kwe-glucose esitokisini kungalawulwa kusetshenziswa amaprotheni e-GLUT athwala i-glucose (Isithombe 7.19). Izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudlula kwe-GLUT protein control transmission ye-glucose kumaseli ezicubu ezithile.

 Ezinye izimpendulo zilawulwa ngokuba nama-enzyme amabili ahlukene—enye ngayinye ibhekisele ezindleleni ezimbili ze-reaction reversible. Izimpendulo eziqhutshwa yi-enzyme eyodwa kuphela zingaya e-equilibrium, zivimbele ukusabela. Ngokuphambene nalokho, uma ama-enzyme amabili ahlukene (nganye iqondene nesiqondiso esithile) edingeka e-reaction reversible, ithuba lokulawula izinga lokusabela liyakhula, futhi ukulingana akufinyelelwa.

 Inani lama-enzyme ahilelekile kuzo zonke izindlela—ikakhulukazi, i-enzyme evuselela ukusabela kokuqala okuzinikele kwendlela—ilawulwa ngokunamathisela i-molecule endaweni ye-allosteric kuphrotheni. Ama-molecule asetshenziswa kakhulu kuleli khono yi-nucleotides ATP, ADP, AMP, NAD+, kanye ne-NADH. Laba balawuli, ama-allosteric effectors, bangandisa noma banciphise umsebenzi we-enzyme, kuye ngezimo ezikhona. I-allosteric effector ishintsha isakhiwo se-steric se-enzyme, ngokuvamile ithinta ukucushwa kwendawo esebenzayo. Lokhu kuguqulwa kwesakhiwo seprotheyini (i-enzyme) kwandisa noma kunciphisa ukuhambisana kwayo ne-substrate yayo, ngomphumela wokwandisa noma ukunciphisa izinga lokusabela. Ukunamathela kubonisa i-enzyme. Lokhu kubopha kungandisa noma kunciphisa umsebenzi we-enzyme, kunikeze impendulo. Lolu hlobo lokulawula impendulo lusebenza uma nje ikhemikhali eliyithintayo linamathele ku-enzyme. Uma ukuhlushwa okuphelele kwekhemikhali kwehla, kuzosakazeka kude neprotheyini, futhi ukulawula kuphumule.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaselula | 7.7 Ukulawulwa Kokuphefumula Kwamaselula | Ukulawulwa Kwezindlela Zokusebenza Kwe-Catabolic
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaselula | 7.7 Ukulawulwa Kokuphefumula Kwamaselula | Ukulawulwa Kwezindlela Zokusebenza Kwe-Catabolic
chapterContent:
Ama-enzyme, amaprotheni, abathwali bama-electron, kanye namaphampu adlala indima ku-glycolysis, umjikelezo we-citric acid, kanye nochungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron kuvame ukushukumisa ukusabela okungaguquki. Ngamanye amazwi, uma kwenzeka ukusabela kokuqala, indlela izibophezele ekuqhubekeni nokusabela okusele. Ukuthi umsebenzi othile we-enzyme uyakhishwa yini kuncike ezidingweni zamandla zeseli (njengoba kuboniswa amazinga e-ATP, ADP, kanye ne-AMP).

 I-Glycolysis
Ukulawulwa kwe-glycolysis kuqala nge-enzyme yokuqala endleleni, i-hexokinase (Isithombe 7.20). Le enzyme ivuselela i-phosphorylation ye-glucose, esiza ukulungiselela i-compound ukuze iqhekeke esinyathelweni esilandelayo. Ukuba khona kwe-phosphate ene-negative charge ku-molecule kuvimbela noshukela ekuphumeni kweseli. Lapho i-hexokinase ivinjelwa, i-glucose iyasabalala iphume esitokisini futhi ayibi yi-substrate yezindlela zokuphefumula kuleyo zicubu. Umkhiqizo wokusabela kwe-hexokinase yi-glucose-6-phosphate, eqongelela lapho i-enzyme yakamuva, i-phosphofructokinase, ivinjelwa.

 I-Phosphofructokinase iyi-enzyme eyinhloko elawulwa ku-glycolysis. Amazinga aphezulu e-ATP, i-citrate, noma i-pH ephansi, ene-acidic eningi yehlisa umsebenzi we-enzyme. Ukwanda kokuhlushwa kwe-citrate kungenzeka ngenxa yokuvinjelwa komjikelezo we-citric acid. Ukuvutshelwa, ngokukhiqizwa kwayo kwama-organic acid njenge-lactic acid, kuvame ukubangela ukwanda kwe-acidity esitokisini; noma kunjalo, imikhiqizo yokuvutshelwa ayivame ukuqongelela emaseli.

 Isinyathelo sokugcina ku-glycolysis siqhutshwa yi-pyruvate kinase. I-pyruvate ekhiqizwayo ingaqhubeka nokuqunjelwa noma iguqulwe ibe yi-amino acid alanine. Uma kungadingeki amandla amaningi futhi i-alanine itholakala ngokwanele, i-enzyme iyavinjelwa. Umsebenzi we-enzyme uyanda lapho amazinga e-fructose-1,6-bisphosphate ekhuphuka. (Khumbula ukuthi i-fructose-1,6-bisphosphate iyingxenye ephakathi kwengxenye yokuqala ye-glycolysis.) Ukulawulwa kwe-pyruvate kinase kuhilela i-phosphorylation yi-kinase, okuholela ku-enzyme engasebenzi kahle. I-Dephosphorylation yi-phosphatase iyayivuselela. I-Pyruvate kinase nayo ilawulwa yi-ATP (umphumela omubi we-allosteric).

 Uma kudingeka amandla engeziwe, i-pyruvate eningi izoguqulwa ibe yi-acetyl CoA ngesenzo se-pyruvate dehydrogenase. Uma amaqembu e-acetyl noma i-NADH eqoqana, kunesidingo esincane sokusabela futhi izinga liyehla. I-Pyruvate dehydrogenase nayo ilawulwa yi-phosphorylation: I-kinase iyi-phosphorylates ukuze yakhe i-enzyme engasebenzi, kanti i-phosphatase iyayivuselela. I-kinase kanye ne-phosphatase nazo ziyalawulwa.

 I-Citric Acid Cycle
Umjikelezo we-citric acid ulawulwa ngama-enzyme avuselela ukusabela okwenza ama-molecule amabili okuqala e-NADH (Isithombe 7.10). Lawa ma-enzyme yi-isocitrate dehydrogenase kanye ne-α‐ketoglutarate dehydrogenase. Uma amazinga e-ATP ne-NADH anele etholakala, amazinga alokhu kusabela ayancipha. Uma kudingeka i-ATP eyengeziwe, njengoba kubonakala emazingeni e-ADP akhuphukayo, izinga liyakhuphuka. I-α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase izophinde ithintwe amazinga e-succinyl CoA—okuyi-intermediate elandelayo emjikelezweni—okubangela ukwehla komsebenzi. Ukwehla kwesilinganiso sokusebenza kwendlela kuleli phuzu akusho ukuthi kubi ngempela, njengoba amazinga akhuphukile e-α-ketoglutarate angasetshenziswa umjikelezo we-citric acid angasetshenziswa yiseli ukwenziwa kwe-amino acid (glutamate).

 I-Electron Transport Chain
Ama-enzyme athile e-electron transport chain awathinteki ukuvinjelwa kwempendulo, kodwa izinga lokuthuthwa kwe-electron endleleni lithintwe amazinga e-ADP ne-ATP. Ukusetshenziswa okukhulu kwe-ATP yiseli kuboniswa ukwakheka kwe-ADP. Njengoba ukusetshenziswa kwe-ATP kwehla, ukuhlushwa kwe-ADP kwehla, futhi manje, i-ATP iqala ukwakheka kuseli. Lolu shintsho ekuhlushweni okuhlobene kwe-ADP kuya ku-ATP lubangela iseli ukuthi linciphise ijubane lochungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.9 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 7. Ukuphefumula Kwamaseli | 7.9 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
7.1 Amandla Ezinhlelweni Eziphilayo
I-ATP isebenza njengohlobo lwemali lwamandla lwamaseli. Ivumela iseli ukugcina amandla isikhashana futhi liwathuthe ngaphakathi kweseli ukuze lisekele ukusabela kwamakhemikhali okungapheli. Isakhiwo se-ATP singese-nucleotide ye-RNA enama-phosphate amathathu anamathiselwe. Njengoba i-ATP isetshenziselwa amandla, iqembu le-phosphate noma amabili ayahlukaniswa, bese kukhiqizwa i-ADP noma i-AMP. Amandla atholakala ku-glucose catabolism asetshenziselwa ukuguqula i-ADP ibe yi-ATP. Uma i-ATP isetshenziswa ekusabeleni, i-phosphate yesithathu inamathiselwa okwesikhashana ku-substrate enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-phosphorylation. Izinqubo ezimbili zokuvuselelwa kwe-ATP ezisetshenziswa kanye ne-glucose catabolism yi-phosphorylation yezinga le-substrate kanye ne-phosphorylation ye-oxidative ngenqubo ye-chemiosmosis.

 7.2 I-Glycolysis
I-Glycolysis yindlela yokuqala esetshenziswa ekuqhekekeni kwe-glucose ukukhipha amandla. Cishe yayingenye yezindlela zokuqala ze-metabolic ukuvela futhi isetshenziswa cishe yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo emhlabeni. I-Glycolysis inezingxenye ezimbili: Ingxenye yokuqala ilungiselela indandatho ye-glucose ye-carbon eyisithupha ukuze ihlukaniswe ibe ushukela we-carbon ezintathu ezimbili. I-ATP itshalwa kule nqubo phakathi nale ngxenye ukuze inike amandla ukuhlukaniswa. Ingxenye yesibili ye-glycolysis ikhipha i-ATP nama-electron anamandla aphezulu kuma-athomu e-hydrogen bese iwanamathisela ku-NAD+. Ama-molecule amabili e-ATP atshalwa engxenyeni yokuqala kanti ama-molecule amane e-ATP akhiwa yi-substrate phosphorylation phakathi nengxenye yesibili. Lokhu kukhiqiza inzuzo eningi yama-molecule amabili e-ATP nama-NADH amabili eseli.

 7.3 Ukushiswa kwe-Pyruvate kanye ne-Citric Acid Cycle
Lapho kukhona umoya-mpilo, i-pyruvate iguqulwa ibe yiqembu le-acetyl elixhunywe ku-molecule ethwala i-coenzyme A. I-acetyl CoA ephumela ingangena ezindleleni eziningana, kodwa ngokuvamile, iqembu le-acetyl lihanjiswa kumjikelezo we-citric acid ukuze kuqhutshekwe ne-catabolism. Ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa kwe-pyruvate ibe yiqembu le-acetyl, i-molecule ye-carbon dioxide nama-electron amabili anamandla aphezulu ayasuswa. I-carbon dioxide ibangela ezimbili (ukuguqulwa kwama-molecule amabili e-pyruvate) zama-carbon ayisithupha e-molecule yokuqala ye-glucose. Ama-electron athathwa yi-NAD+, kanti i-NADH ithwala ama-electron iye endleleni yakamuva yokukhiqizwa kwe-ATP. Kuleli qophelo, i-molecule ye-glucose eyangena ekuphefumuleni kwamaseli ekuqaleni isifakwe i-oxidized ngokuphelele. Amandla amakhemikhali agciniwe ngaphakathi kwe-molecule ye-glucose adluliselwe kubathwali bama-electron noma asetshenziselwe ukuhlanganisa ama-ATP ambalwa.

 Umjikelezo we-citric acid uchungechunge lwe-redox kanye ne-decarboxylation reactions ezisusa ama-electron anamandla aphezulu kanye ne-carbon dioxide. Ama-electron agcinwe okwesikhashana kuma-molecule e-NADH kanye ne-FADH2 asetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza i-ATP endleleni elandelayo. I-molecule eyodwa ye-GTP noma i-ATP ikhiqizwa yi-phosphorylation yezinga le-substrate ekuphendukeni ngakunye komjikelezo. Akukho ukuqhathaniswa kwendlela ye-cyclic ne-linear.

 7.4 I-Oxidative Phosphorylation
Uchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron luyingxenye yokuphefumula kwe-aerobic esebenzisa umoya-mpilo okhululekile njengokwamukela ama-electron okugcina ama-electron asuswe ku-com ephakathi amakhilogremu ku-glucose catabolism. Uchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron luqukethe ama-complex amane amakhulu, ama-multiprotein afakwe kulwelwesi lwangaphakathi lwe-mitochondrial kanye nezithwali ezimbili ezincane ze-electron ezisakazekayo ezithutha ama-electron phakathi kwawo. Ama-electron adlula ochungechungeni lwe-redox reactions, kanye nenani elincane lamandla akhululekile asetshenziswa ezindaweni ezintathu ukuthutha ama-ion e-hydrogen ngaphesheya kwelwelwesi. Le nqubo inegalelo ekuthambekeni okusetshenziswa ku-chemiosmosis. Ama-electron adlula kuchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron alahlekelwa amandla kancane kancane, Ama-electron anamandla aphezulu anikelwa kuchungechunge yi-NADH noma i-FADH2 aqedela uchungechunge, njengoba ama-electron anamandla aphansi ehlisa ama-molecule e-oxygen futhi akhe amanzi. Izinga lamandla amahhala ama-electron lehla lisuka cishe ku-60 kcal/mol ku-NADH noma ku-45 kcal/mol ku-FADH2 liye cishe ku-0 kcal/mol emanzini. Imikhiqizo yokugcina yochungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron amanzi kanye ne-ATP. Inani eliphakathi amakhilogremu lomjikelezo we-citric acid lingaphambukiswa liye ku-anabolism yamanye ama-molecule e-biochemical, njenge-amino acids engabalulekile, ushukela, kanye nama-lipid. Lawa ma-molecule afanayo angasebenza njengemithombo yamandla yezindlela ze-glucose.

 7.5 I-Metabolism ngaphandle kwe-Oxygen
 Uma i-NADH ingenakukwazi uku-oxidized ngokuphefumula kwe-aerobic, kusetshenziswa enye i-electron acceptor. Iningi lezinto eziphilayo lizosebenzisa uhlobo oluthile lokubilisa ukuze kufezwe ukuvuselelwa kwe-NAD+, kuqinisekiswe ukuqhubeka kwe-glycolysis. Ukuvuselelwa kwe-NAD+ ekubilisweni akuphelezelwa ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP; ngakho-ke, amandla e-NADH okukhiqiza i-ATP kusetshenziswa uchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron awasetshenziswa.

 7.6 Ukuxhumana Kwezindlela Ze-Carbohydrate, Amaprotheni, kanye Ne-Lipid Metabolic
Ukuqhekeka kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwama-carbohydrate, amaprotheni, kanye nama-lipid kuxhuma nezindlela ze-glucose catabolism. Ushukela olula yi-galactose, i-fructose, i-glycogen, kanye ne-pentose. Lokhu kwenziwa nge-catabolized ngesikhathi se-glycolysis. Ama-amino acid avela kumaprotheni axhumana ne-glucose catabolism nge-pyruvate, i-acetyl CoA, kanye nezingxenye zomjikelezo we-citric acid. Ukwenziwa kwe-cholesterol kuqala ngamaqembu e-acetyl, kanti izingxenye ze-triglycerides zivela ku-glycerol-3-phosphate evela ku-glycolysis kanye namaqembu e-acetyl akhiqizwa ku-mitochondria evela ku-pyruvate.

 7.7 Ukulawulwa Kokuphefumula Kwamaseli
Ukuphefumula kwamaseli kulawulwa ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene. Ukungena kwe-glucose esitokisini kulawulwa ngamaprotheni okuthutha asiza ukudlula kwe-glucose nge-membrane yeseli. Iningi lokulawula izinqubo zokuphefumula kufezwa ngokulawulwa kwama-enzyme athile ezindleleni. Lolu uhlobo lokuphendula okungekuhle, okuvala ama-enzyme. Ama-enzyme asabela kaningi emazingeni e-nucleosides atholakalayo i-ATP, i-ADP, i-AMP, i-NAD+, kanye ne-FAD. Ezinye izinto eziphakathi kwendlela nazo zithinta ama-enzyme athile ezinhlelweni

question23: Yimaphi ama-enzyme alandelayo alawula kakhulu i-glycolysis?
question24: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungenzeki njengoba ukuhlushwa kwe-ATP kukhula uma kuqhathaniswa ne-ADP?
question25: Sebenzisa ukuqonda kwakho ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa kanjani amandla ukuze uphikisane ngokuthi kungani kuzuzisa noma kulimaza amaseli ukusebenzisa i-ATP kunokusebenzisa ngqo amandla agcinwe ezibophweni zama-carbohydrate ukuze anike amandla ukusabela kwamaseli.
answer25: I-ATP itholakala kalula ngesimo seyunithi eyodwa enikeza inani lamandla elihambisanayo nelifanele. Uma amaseli ethola amandla avela kuma-carbohydrate ahlukahlukene amakhilogremu, kuzodingeka ahlele ukusabela ngakunye kumthombo wamandla ngamunye.
distractor25a: Amandla e-ATP awakwazi ukwenza kusebenze impendulo yokucindezeleka encike ku-ROS kuyilapho ama-molecule okudla enesibopho sokwenza kusebenze i-ROS
distractor25b: I-ATP inamandla aphansi, kodwa ama-molecule okudla (ngesimo sama-carbohydrate) anamazinga aphezulu amandla angasetshenziswa amaseli
distractor25c: I-ATP itholakala kalula kumaseli, ngokungafani nama-carbohydrate amakhilogremu okumele aqale afakwe i-phosphorylated ukuze akhulule amandla awo
question26: Iyiphi indima edlalwa yi-NAD+ ekuphenduleni kwe-redox?
answer26: I-NAD+, i-oxidizing agent, ingamukela ama-electron nama-proton avela kuma-molecule e-organic bese yehliswa ibe yi-NADH
distractor26a: I-NAD+, i-ejenti yokunciphisa, inganikela ngama-electron nama-proton ayo kuma-molecule e-organic
distractor26b: I-NAD+, i-oxidizing agent, ingamukela ama-electron avela kuma-molecule e-organic bese yehliswa ibe yi-NADH2
distractor26c: I-NAD+, i-ejenti yokunciphisa, inganikela ngama-electron nama-proton ayo kuma-molecule angaphili
question27:
Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono indlela ama-electron adluliselwa ngayo kanye nendima yohlobo ngalunye. Khumbula ukuthi u-R umele i-molecule ye-hydrocarbon kanti u-RH umele i-molecule efanayo ene-hydrogen ethile ehlonziwe.

 RH + NAD+ → NADH + R
answer27: I-RH isebenza njenge-ejenti yokunciphisa futhi inikela ngama-electron ayo ku-ejenti yokuxoxisa i-NAD+, yakha i-NADH kanye ne-R
distractor27a: I-NAD+, i-oxidizing agent, inikela ngama-electron ayo ku-reducing agent RH, yakha i-R kanye ne-NADH
distractor27b: I-RH isebenza njenge-oxidizing agent futhi inikela ngama-electron ku-reducing agent NAD+, ikhiqiza i-NADH kanye ne-R
distractor27c: I-NAD+, i-ejenti yokunciphisa, yamukela ama-electron avela ku-ejenti yokuxoxisa i-RH, ekhiqiza i-NADH kanye ne-R
question28: Cishe zonke izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni zenza uhlobo oluthile lwe-glycolysis. Nikeza impikiswano enembile echaza ukuthi leli qiniso lisekela noma liphikisa kanjani isisho sokuthi i-glycolysis ingenye yezindlela ezindala kakhulu ze-metabolic.
answer28: Ukuze kube khona ezintweni eziningi ezahlukene eziphilayo, i-glycolysis cishe yayikhona kukhokho oyedwa kunokuba ivele izikhathi eziningi ezahlukene.
distractor28a: Ukuba khona kwe-glycolysis cishe kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo kubonisa ukuthi kuyindlela ethuthukisiwe nesanda kuthuthukiswa esetshenziswe kabanzi ngenxa yezinzuzo ezinikezayo.
distractor28b: I-Glycolysis ayikho ezintweni ezimbalwa eziphilayo eziphakeme, okuphikisana nesisho sokuthi ingenye yezindlela ezindala kakhulu ze-metabolic
distractor28c: I-Glycolysis ikhona kwezinye izinto eziphilayo futhi ayikho kwezinye. Lokhu kungahambisani akusekeli isisho sokuthi ingenye yezindlela ezindala kakhulu ze-metabolic
question29: Amaseli abomvu egazi (ama-RBC) awenzi ukuphefumula kwe-aerobic, kodwa enza i-glycolysis. Nikeza isizathu esidingekayo sokuchaza ukuthi kungani wonke amaseli edinga umthombo wamandla, futhi ubikezele ukuthi kuzokwenzekani uma i-glycolysis ivinjiwe kusampula yama-RBC
answer29: Amaseli adinga amandla ukuze enze imisebenzi ethile eyisisekelo. Ukuvimba i-glycolysis kuma-RBC kubangela ukungalingani emandleni e-membrane, okuholela ekufeni kwamaseli
distractor29a: Amaseli adinga amandla ukuze enze ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli. Ukuvimba i-glycolysis kuma-RBC kuphazamisa inqubo ye-mitosis, okuholela ekungaxhumani
distractor29b: Amaseli agcina ukungena nokuphuma kwezinto eziphilayo esebenzisa amandla. Ukuvimba i-glycolysis kuvimbela ukubopha kwe-CO2 kuma-RBC, okubangela ukufa kwamaseli
distractor29c: Amaseli adinga amandla ukuze aqaphele izifo ezihlaselayo. Ukuvimba i-glycolysis kuvimbela inqubo yalokho kuqaphela, okubangela ukuhlasela kwama-RBC yi-pathogen
question30: Uyini umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwendlela eyindilinga nendlela eqondile?
answer30: I-reactant kanye nomkhiqizo kuyafana endleleni eyindilinga kodwa kuhlukile endleleni eqondile
distractor30a: Izingxenye zendlela eyindilinga ziyaphela kanti lezo zendlela eqondile azipheli futhi zihlala zivuselelwa.
distractor30b: Izindlela eziyindilinga azifanelekeli izindlela ezihamba emanzini kanti izindlela eziqondile azifanelekeli izindlela eziya emanzini.
distractor30c: Izindlela ezijikelezayo ziqukethe ukusabela okukodwa kwamakhemikhali okuphindaphindiwe kuyilapho izindlela eziqondile zinezigameko eziningi
question31: Ukuphefumula kwamaseli kuphula i-glucose futhi kukhiphe i-carbon dioxide namanzi. Yiziphi izinyathelo ekugayweni kwe-pyruvate ezikhiqiza i-carbon dioxide?
answer31: Ukususwa kweqembu le-carboxyl ku-pyruvate kukhipha i-carbon dioxide. I-pyruvate dehydrogenase complex iyaqala ukusebenza
distractor31a: Ukususwa kweqembu le-acetyl ku-pyruvate kukhipha i-carbon dioxide. I-pyruvate decarboxylase complex iyaqala ukusebenza
distractor31b: Ukususwa kweqembu le-carbonyl ku-pyruvate kukhipha i-carbon dioxide. I-pyruvate dehydrogenase complex iyaqala ukusebenza
distractor31c: Ukususwa kwe-coenzyme A ku-pyruvate kukhipha i-carbon dioxide. I-pyruvate dehydrogenase complex iyaqala ukusebenza
question32: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezintathu ezifakiwe ekuqhekekeni kwe-pyruvate?
answer32: I-Pyruvate dehydrogenase isusa iqembu le-carboxyl ku-pyruvate, ikhiqize i-carbon dioxide. I-Dihydrolipoyl transacetylase i-oxidize iqembu le-hydroxyethyl eqenjini le-acetyl, ikhiqize i-NADH. Okokugcina, iqembu le-acetyl eliboshwe yi-enzyme lidluliselwa ku-CoA, likhiqize i-molecule ye-acetyl-CoA.
distractor32a: I-Pyruvate dehydrogenase i-oxidizes iqembu le-hydroxyethyl eqenjini le-acetyl, ikhiqize i-NADH. Iphinde isuse iqembu le-carboxyl ku-pyruvate, ikhiqize i-carbon dioxide. Okokugcina, i-dihydrolipoyl transacetylase idlulisela iqembu le-acetyl eliboshwe yi-enzyme ku-CoA, yakha i-molecule ye-acetyl-CoA.
distractor32b: I-Pyruvate dehydrogenase idlulisela iqembu le-acetyl eliboshwe yi-enzyme ku-CoA, yakha i-acetyl CoA molecule. Bese i-oxidize iqembu le-hydroxyethyl eqenjini le-acetyl, ikhiqize i-NADH. I-Dihydrolipoyl transacetylase isusa iqembu le-carboxyl ku-pyruvate, ikhiqize i-carbon dioxide.
distractor32c: I-Pyruvate dehydrogenase isusa iqembu le-carboxyl ku-pyruvate, ikhiqize i-carbon dioxide. I-Dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase idlulisela amaqembu e-acetyl aboshwe yi-enzyme ku-CoA, yakha i-acetyl-CoA molecule. Okokugcina, iqembu le-hydroxyethyl liyaxutshwa libe iqembu le-acetyl, likhiqize i-NADH
question33: Sebenzisa ukuqonda kwakho izingxenye ezahlukene zeketanga lokuthuthwa kwama-electron ukuze uhlole ukuthi izindima ze-ubiquinone ne-cytochrome c zihluke kanjani kwezezinye izingxenye.
answer33: I-CoQ kanye ne-cytochrome c ziyizithwali zama-electron ezihambayo, kuyilapho i-NADH dehydrogenase kanye ne-succinate dehydrogenase ziboshelwe kulwelwesi lwangaphakathi lwe-mitochondrial.
distractor33a: I-CoQ kanye ne-cytochrome c zibopha ama-electron ngokuhlanganyela, kuyilapho i-NADH dehydrogenase kanye ne-succinate dehydrogenase zibophana ne-membrane yangaphakathi ye-mitochondrial.
distractor33b: I-CoQ kanye ne-cytochrome c ziboshelwe kulwelwesi lwangaphakathi lwe-mitochondrial, kuyilapho i-NADH dehydrogenase kanye ne-succinate dehydrogenase kuyizinto ezithwala ama-electron ahambayo
distractor33c: I-CoQ kanye ne-cytochrome c zibopha ama-electron ngokuhlanganyela, kuyilapho i-NADH dehydrogenase kanye ne-succinate dehydrogenase kuyizinto ezithwala ama-electron ezihambayo
question34: Cabanga ukuthi inani lama-molecule e-ATP akhiwa ngokuphefumula kwamaseli liyahlukahluka. Thola isimangalo esibangela lo mehluko
answer34: Ukuthuthwa kwe-NADH kusuka ku-cytosol kuya ku-mitochondria kuyinqubo esebenzayo enciphisa inani lama-ATP akhiqizwayo
distractor34a: Ama-ATP akhiqizwayo asetshenziswa ngokushesha ekusabeleni kwe-anaplerotic okusetshenziselwa ukugcwalisa kabusha ama-intermediate.
distractor34b: Iningi lama-ATP akhiqizwayo lisetshenziswa ngokushesha ekufakweni kwe-phosphorylation kwezinye izinto amakhilogremu ezitholakala ezitshalweni.
distractor34c: Inani elikhulu lama-molecule e-ATP asetshenziswa ekususeni ubuthi ku-xenobiotic com amakhilogremu ekhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaseli.
question35: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuchaza kangcono i-complex IV ku-chain yokuthutha ama-electron?
answer35: I-Complex IV yakhiwe yi-molecule ye-oxygen ebanjwe phakathi kwama-ion e-cytochrome kanye ne-copper. Ama-electron ageleza ekugcineni afinyelela ku-oxygen, akhiqize amanzi
distractor35a: I-Complex IV iqukethe i-molecule ye-flavin mononucleotide kanye namaqoqo e-iron-sulfur. Ama-electron avela ku-NADH athuthwa lapha aye ku-coenzyme Q
distractor35b: I-Complex IV iqukethe i-cytochrome b, c, kanye ne-Fe-S. Lapha, umjikelezo we-proton motivation Q uyenzeka
distractor35c: I-Complex IV iqukethe i-enzyme eboshwe nge-membrane eyamukela ama-electron avela ku-FADH2 ukuze enze i-FAD. Le electron ibe isidluliselwa ku-ubiquinone
question36:
Bheka uMfanekiso 7.15.
Buyekeza inqubo yokubilisa, njengoba kuboniswe lapha ngokubilisa i-lactic acid. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo esiqhathanisa kangcono ukubilisa nokuphefumula okungena-aerobic futhi sigqamise ngokunembile umehluko wazo?
answer36: Ukubilisa kusebenzisa i-glycolysis kuphela futhi isamukeli sayo sokugcina sama-electron siyi-molecule ephilayo, kanti ukuphefumula kwe-anaerobic kusebenzisa i-glycolysis, umjikelezo we-citric acid, kanye ne-ETC kodwa ekugcineni kunikeza ama-electron kwenye i-molecule engaphili ngaphandle kwe-O2.
distractor36a: Ukubilisa kusebenzisa i-glycolysis, umjikelezo we-citric acid, kanye ne-ETC kodwa ekugcineni kunikeza ama-electron ku-molecule engaphili, kanti ukuphefumula okungena-aerobic kusebenzisa i-glycolysis kuphela futhi umamukeli wayo we-electron uyi-molecule ephilayo.
distractor36b: Ukubilisa kusebenzisa i-glycolysis, umjikelezo we-citric acid, kanye ne-ETC kodwa ekugcineni kunikeza ama-electron ku-molecule yezinto eziphilayo, kanti ukuphefumula okungena-aerobic kusebenzisa i-glycolysis kuphela kanti umamukeli wayo wokugcina wama-electron uyi-molecule engeyona into ephilayo.
distractor36c: Ukubilisa kusebenzisa i-glycolysis futhi isamukeli sayo sokugcina sama-electron siyi-molecule engaphili, kanti ukuphefumula kwe-anaerobic kusebenzisa i-glycolysis, umjikelezo we-citric acid, kanye ne-ETC kodwa ekugcineni kunikeza ama-electron kuma-molecule e-organic.
question37:
Yiluphi uhlobo lokuphefumula kwamaseli oluvezwe kulesi sibalo esilandelayo, futhi kungani?

 CO2 + H2 + NADH → CH4 + H2O + NAD+
answer37: Ukuphefumula okungena-aerobic, ngoba isamukeli sokugcina sama-electron asiyona into ephilayo
distractor37a: Ukuphefumula kwe-aerobic, ngoba umoya-mpilo uwukwamukela ama-electron kokugcina
distractor37b: Ukuphefumula okungena-aerobic, ngoba i-NADH inikela ngama-electron ayo ku-molecule ye-methane
distractor37c: Ukuphefumula okwenziwa nge-aerobic, ngoba amanzi akhiqizwa njengomkhiqizo
question38: Ungachaza izindlela ze-metabolic njengezokuchitha imali ngokwemvelo noma njengezongayo ngokwemvelo? Xoxa ngempendulo yakho ngokuchaza ukuthi kungani ukhethe yona.
answer38: Izindlela ze-metabolic ziyonga ngenxa yokuvinjelwa kwempendulo. Futhi, izindlela eziphakathi ezivela kwenye indlela zingasetshenziswa ezinye izindlela.
distractor38a: Izindlela ze-metabolic ziyachitha, njengoba zenza ukusabela kwe-catabolic kanye ne-anabolic okungahlelekile okuchitha amanye amandla agciniwe.
distractor38b: Izindlela ze-metabolic ziyonga ngenxa yokuba khona kwe-anaplerotic reactions ezigcwalisa ama-intermediates
distractor38c: Izindlela ze-metabolic ziyachitha, njengoba iningi lamandla akhiqizwayo lisetshenziswa ekugcineni indawo encishisiwe ye-cytosol
question39: Yenza isimangalo sokuhlonza ama-lipid axhunywe ezindleleni ze-glucose catabolism, bese usekela isimangalo sakho ngobufakazi bokuthi ama-lipid axhunywe kanjani kulezo zindlela.
answer39: I-cholesterol kanye ne-triglycerides kungaguqulwa kube yi-glycerol-3-phosphate eqhubeka nge-glycolysis
distractor39a: I-Glucagon kanye ne-glycogen kungaguqulwa kube yi-3-phosphoglyceraldehyde okuyi-intermediate ye-glycolysis
distractor39b: Ama-chylomicron nama-fatty acid aguqulwa abe yi-1,3-bisphosphoglycerate eqhubeka ne-glycolysis, yakha i-pyruvate
distractor39c: Ama-sphingolipids nama-triglycerides akha i-glucagon engafakwa ku-glycolysis
question40: Hlola futhi uqhathanise izitatimende ezingezansi, ngasinye sazo siphakamisa indlela ethile i-citrate evela kumjikelezo we-citric acid ethinta ngayo i-glycolysis. Yisiphi isitatimende esinikeza incazelo enembile yalomphumela?
answer40: I-Citrate kanye ne-ATP ziyizilawuli ezingezinhle ze-phosphofructokinase-1
distractor40b: I-Citrate kanye ne-ATP ziyizilawuli ezinhle ze-phosphofructokinase-1
question41: Bheka uMfanekiso 7.21. Qhathanisa izinhlobo ezimbili zezindlela zokuphendula, njengoba zifanekiswe esithombeni. Yenza isimangalo sokuchaza ukuthi kungani izindlela zokuphendula ezingezinhle zingase zibe zivame kakhulu kunezindlela zokuphendula ezinhle emaseli aphilayo.
answer41: Izindlela zokuphendula ezingezinhle zigcina i-homeostasis, kanti impendulo enhle ixosha uhlelo kude nokulingana
distractor41a: Izindlela zokuphendula kahle zigcina inani elilinganisiwe lezinto, kanti impendulo engemihle ivimbela ukuqongelela kwazo
distractor41b: Izindlela zokuphendula ezingezinhle ziyawuvala uhlelo, okwenza lungatholi ezinye izinto ezingafuneki. Impendulo enhle ilinganisa lokhu kuntuleka
distractor41c: Izindlela zokuphendula okuhle zibuyisela inani lezinto eziqukethwe kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zingakanani izinto eziqukethwe endaweni, kuyilapho impendulo engemihle ikhiqiza inani eliningi lezinto eziqukethwe kuyo.

question44: Kukuphi esitokisini lapho i-glycolysis yenzeka khona kuma-prokaryotes kanye nama-eukaryotes?
question45: Kutholakale uhlobo olusha lwe-obligate anaerobe, igciwane, elihlala ezindaweni ezishisayo nezine-asidi. Nakuba ezinye izindlela zingase zibe khona, iyiphi indlela ye-metabolic okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi ibe khona kulolu hlobo?
question46: Ufunde isimangalo sokuthi i-glycolysis iyindlela endala futhi elondolozwe kakhulu kunomjikelezo we-citric acid. Hlola izitatimende ezingezansi ukuze ukhethe ubufakazi obunikeza ukusekelwa okunamandla kwalesi simangalo.
answer46: I-Glycolysis itholakala kuzo zonke izizinda ezintathu zezinto eziphilayo. Iphinde ivele ezimweni ze-anaerobic kanye nase-cytosol
distractor46a: I-Glycolysis yenzeka ezimweni ezingena-aerobic, ingagaya i-cholesterol nama-fatty acid, futhi yenzeka ngisho nakuma-methanogens
distractor46b: Le ndlela yenzeka ku-cytosol, itholakala kuzo zonke izilwane nezitshalo, futhi ayidingi umoya-mpilo
distractor46c: Le ndlela yenzeka kuphela kwi-mitochondria. Iguquguquka kakhulu ngoba itholakala cishe kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo.
question47: Bheka uMfanekiso 7.22. Iyini iSakhiwo X kumfanekiso?
question48: Bheka uMfanekiso 7.22. Hlola inqubo emelelwe umdwebo. Qagela umphumela oqondile kakhulu wesakhiwo sokuvimba u-Z
answer48: I-NADH ngeke iguqulwe ibe yi-NAD+ futhi uchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron luzoma
distractor48a: I-Cytochrome c ngeke idlulise ama-electron kusuka ku-complex III kuya ku-complex IV
distractor48b: I-Ubiquinone ngeke idlulise ama-electron kusuka ku-complex III kuya ku-complex IV
distractor48c: Awekho ama-proton azopompelwa kulo lonke ulwelwesi
question49: Bheka uMfanekiso 7.22. Hlola umdwebo wochungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron. Ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni kwakho le ngxenye ye-metabolism ye-glucose, ama-electron ahamba eceleni kwe-membrane avelaphi, futhi ama-electron aphelelaphi?
answer49: Ama-electron akhishwa yi-NADH kanye ne-FADH2 bese ekugcineni amukelwa yi-oxygen ukuze akhe amanzi
distractor49a: Ama-electron anikezwa ngamanzi futhi ekugcineni amukelwe yi-NAD+ kanye ne-FAD+ ukukhiqiza izinhlobo zamandla i-NADH kanye ne-FADH2
distractor49b: Ama-electron anikezwa yi-NADH kanye ne-FADH2 futhi, ekugcineni, amukelwa yi-H2O
distractor49c: Ama-electron akhishwa yi-ubiquinone futhi ekugcineni amukelwa yi-H2O
question50:

question51: Usebenzisa ukuqonda kwakho amasu okusebenza kwe-metabolic ukuhlola umehluko wawo: Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo esisekela ngqo isimangalo sokuthi izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amasu ahlukene okusebenza kwe-metabolic ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zazo zamandla okukhula, ukuzala, kanye ne-homeostasis?
answer51: Izitshalo ngokuvamile zisebenzisa ama-molecule esitashi ukuze zigcine, kuyilapho izilwane zisebenzisa i-glycogen namafutha ukuze zigcine
distractor51a: Ngesikhathi sokubandayo, izilwane ezihlala echibini zingandisa inani lama-fatty acid angagcwele emangqamuzaneni amangqamuzana azo, kuyilapho ezinye izitshalo zenza amaprotheni alwa nokuqandisa ukuze avimbele ukwakheka kwekristalu yeqhwa ezicutshini zazo.
distractor51b: Amabhaktheriya awanayo i-intron, kuyilapho izakhi zofuzo eziningi ze-eukaryotic ziqukethe eziningana zalezi zilandelaniso ezingenelelayo
distractor51c: Izilwane ezidla inyama zinamazinyo amaningi akhethekile okuklebhula ukudla, kanti izilwane ezidla uhlaza zinamazinyo amaningi akhethekile okugaya ukudla.
question52:
Bheka uMfanekiso 7.10.
Buyekeza umdwebo womjikelezo we-citric acid. Hlola ukuthi umjikelezo we-citric acid uhlobana kanjani ne-glycolysis, i-oxidative phosphorylation, kanye ne-chemiosmosis. Yikuphi kokulandelayo okuchaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwalezi zinqubo?
answer52: I-Glycolysis ikhiqiza i-pyruvate, eguqulwa ibe yi-acetyl-CoA bese ingena emjikelezweni we-citric acid. Lo mjikelezo ukhiqiza i-NADH ne-FADH2, ezinikela ngama-electron ku-electron transport chain ukuze zipompe ama-proton futhi zikhiqize i-ATP nge-chemiosmosis. Ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP kusetshenziswa i-electron transport chain kanye ne-chemiosmosis kubizwa ngokuthi i-oxidative phosphorylation.
distractor52a: Umjikelezo we-citric acid ukhiqiza i-pyruvate, eguqula ibe yi-glucose ukuze ingene kwi-glycolysis. Le ndlela ikhiqiza i-NADH kanye ne-FADH2, ezifaka i-oxidative phosphorylation ukuze zikhiqize i-ATP nge-chemiosmosis.
distractor52b: Umjikelezo we-citric acid ukhiqiza i-NADH ne-FADH2, ezidlula ku-oxidative phosphorylation. Lokhu kukhiqiza i-ATP ngokupompa ama-proton nge-chemiosmosis. I-ATP ekhiqizwayo isetshenziswa kakhulu enkambisweni ye-glycolysis.
distractor52c: I-Glycolysis ikhiqiza i-pyruvate, engena ngqo emjikelezweni we-citric acid. Lo mjikelezo ukhiqiza imali yamandla edlula ochungechungeni lokuthuthwa kwama-electron ukuze ikhiqize amanzi kanye ne-ATP

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Zonke izinqubo zezinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla. Ukuze uthole la mandla, izinto eziningi eziphilayo zithola amandla agciniwe ngokudla, okungukuthi, ngokudla ezinye izinto eziphilayo. Kodwa amandla agciniwe ekudleni avelaphi? Cishe wonke la mandla angalandelelwa emuva ku-photosynthesis.

 Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthetic ziyisisekelo cishe sazo zonke izintambo zokudla emhlabeni. Isibonelo, i-Indian River Lagoon, ingxube yamanzi amasha nosawoti engamakhilomitha angu-156 ogwini olusempumalanga yeFlorida, incike otshanini bayo basolwandle ukuze iphile impilo yasolwandle. Ngeshwa, lapho izinhlobo ezithile ze-algal phytoplankton zikhula ngokweqile, zibhubhisa utshani basolwandle. Ososayensi benze ucwaningo lweminyaka engu-16 lwezimbali ze-algal bathola ukuthi izimo zezulu ezimbi kakhulu, njengesimo sezulu esibandayo kanye nemvula encane, zishintsha ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ezithile ze-phytoplankton okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi ziqhakaze, okuholela ekufeni kotshani basolwandle, ukwehla kwezinye izilwane zasolwandle, kanye noshintsho kusawoti. Bheka Umfanekiso 8.1
question1: Uyini umthombo wamandla agcinwe ekudleni okuningi okudliwa yizinto eziphilayo?
answer1: I-photosynthesis
question2: Kungani izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-photosynthesis zibhekwa njengesisekelo sezindawo eziningi zokudla?
answer2: Ziguqula amandla okukhanya abe amandla amakhemikhali asekela ezinye izinto eziphilayo
distractor2a: Zidla ezinye izinto eziphilayo futhi ziphinde zisebenzise izakhamzimba
distractor2b: Bakhiqiza i-ATP ngqo kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo
distractor2c: Zibolisa izinto eziphilayo ezifile zibe amaminerali
question3: Yisiphi isidalwa esingathinta ngqo amandla atholakala emazingeni aphezulu e-trophic uma inani laso lehla?
question4: Ososayensi baphawule ukuthi izinguquko esimweni sezulu zishintshe ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ze-phytoplankton eziqhakazile. Yisiphi isiphetho esisekelwa kangcono yilokhu okuphawuliwe?
answer4: Izimo zemvelo zingathinta isakhiwo se-ecosystem ngokushintsha inani labakhiqizi
distractor4a: Isimo sezulu sithinta izinhlobo zabathengi kuphela
distractor4b: I-Photosynthesis yenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi sezulu esibandayo
distractor4c: Izindawo zemvelo zasolwandle azizimele kubakhiqizi abayinhloko
question5: Ukukhula ngokweqile kwe-algae phytoplankton kungathinta kanjani kabi indawo yokuhlala emanzini?
answer5: Kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kotshani basolwandle futhi kunciphise inani lezinye izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle
question6: Yisiphi isici semvelo esatholakala sithonya ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ze-phytoplankton ezanda kakhulu?
answer6: Izinguquko ekushiseni nasemvuleni
question7: Kungani ukuncipha kotshani basolwandle kungase kunciphise inani lezilwane zasolwandle?
answer7: Utshani basolwandle busebenza njengomkhiqizi oyinhloko obalulekile osekela iwebhu yokudla
distractor7a: Utshani basolwandle bukhiqiza umoya-mpilo ngqo kuma-gill ezinhlanzi kuphela
distractor7c: Utshani basolwandle buphefumula ezinye izinto eziphilayo ngamaseli
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-photosynthesis nokuphefumula kwamaseli?
answer8: I-Photosynthesis igcina amandla kuma-molecule e-organic akhishwa ukuphefumula kwamaseli kamuva
distractor8a: Ukuphefumula kwamaseli kukhiqiza ukukhanya kwelanga okusetshenziswa ku-photosynthesis
distractor8b: I-Photosynthesis yenzeka kuphela ngemva kokuphefumula kwamaseli
question9: Kungani ososayensi benze ucwaningo lwesikhathi eside ngezimbali ze-algal?
answer9: Ukunquma ukuthi izimo zemvelo zithinta kanjani imiphakathi yabakhiqizi kanye nempilo yesistimu
distractor9c: Ukunquma ukuthi izinhlanzi zizalana ngokushesha kangakanani
question10: Yikuphi okuchaza kangcono ukuthi kungani i-photosynthesis ibalulekile cishe kuzo zonke izimiso zemvelo eMhlabeni?
answer10: Ibamba amandla elanga bese iwaguqula abe amandla amakhemikhali asekela ama-food webs
distractor10a: Ikhiqiza ngqo i-ATP yazo zonke izinto eziphilayo
distractor10b: Iguqula i-carbon dioxide ibe yi-oxygen ngaphandle kokusebenzisa ukukhanya

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.1 Ukubuka Konke kwe-Photosynthesis | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.1 Ukubuka Konke kwe-Photosynthesis | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njengoba sifundile eSahlukweni 7, zonke izinto eziphilayo, kusukela kubhaktheriya olula kuya ezitshalweni nezilwane eziyinkimbinkimbi, zidinga amandla amahhala ukuze zenze izinqubo zamaseli, njengokukhula nokuzala. Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amasu ahlukahlukene ukuze zibambe, zigcine, ziguqule, futhi zidlulise amandla amahhala, okuhlanganisa ne-photosynthesis. I-Photosynthesis ivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zithole amandla amakhulu amahhala avela elangeni futhi ziwaguqule abe amandla amakhemikhali kashukela. Nakuba zonke izinto eziphilayo zenza uhlobo oluthile lokuphefumula kwamaseli, izinto ezithile kuphela, ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-photoautotrophs, ezingenza i-photosynthesis. Izibonelo zama-photoautotrophs zifaka izitshalo, ulwelwe, amanye ama-eukaryotes e-unicellular, kanye ne-cyanobacteria. Zidinga ukuba khona kwe-chlorophyll, umbala okhethekile omunca amaza athile okukhanya okubonakalayo ukuze kusetshenziswe amandla amahhala avela elangeni. I-Photosynthesis inqubo lapho izingxenye zamanzi ne-carbon dioxide zisetshenziswa khona ukuhlanganisa ama-molecule e-carbohydrate nalapho imikhiqizo yemfucuza ye-oxygen ikhishwa khona emoyeni. Kuma-eukaryotes, ukusabela kwe-photosynthesis kwenzeka kuma-chloroplast; kuma-prokaryotes, njenge-cyanobacteria, ukusabela akutholakali kakhulu futhi kwenzeka ngaphakathi kwe-membranes naku-cytoplasm. (Izici zesakhiwo se-chloroplast ezihlanganyela ku-photosynthesis zizohlolwa ngokuningiliziwe kamuva ku-The Light-Dependent Reactions of Photosynthesis and Using Light Energy to Make Organic Molecules.) Nakuba i-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli kwavela njengezinqubo ezizimele—nge-photosynthesis edala umoya okhipha i-oxidation ekuqaleni komlando woMhlaba—namuhla kuncike komunye nomunye. Njengoba sifunde ku-Cellular Respiration, ukuphefumula kwamaseli e-aerobic kungena ekhonweni lokukhipha i-oxidation le-oxygen ukuze kwakhiwe i-organic com amakhilogremu esetshenziselwa ukunika amandla izinqubo zamaseli.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 1 kanye no-Big Idea 2 we-AP® Biology Curriculum Framework, njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe ku-Curriculum Framework zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka kanye nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.B
Izinto eziphilayo zixhunyaniswe yimigqa yokuzalwa okuvela kubazali abavamile.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.B.1 Ubufakazi besakhiwo nokusebenza busekela ukuhlobana kwazo zonke izizinda, lapho izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezinqubo eziningi eziyinhloko ezigciniwe.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.1 Umfundi angathethelela izimangalo ngobufakazi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza izibonelo ezithile zezinqubo eziyinhloko ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezabiwe yizo zonke izizinda noma ngaphakathi kwesizinda esisodwa sokuphila, nokuthi lezi zinqubo eziyinhloko ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezigciniwe zisekela kanjani umqondo wokuzalwa okuvamile kwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.2 Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amasu ahlukahlukene ukuze zibambe futhi zigcine amandla amahhala azosetshenziswa ezinqubweni zezinto eziphilayo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
3.1 Umfundi angabuza imibuzo yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.4 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo ukuze abuze imibuzo yesayensi mayelana nokuthi yiziphi izindlela nezici zesakhiwo ezivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zibambe, zigcine, futhi zisebenzise amandla amahhala.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.2 Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amasu ahlukahlukene ukuze zibambe futhi zigcine amandla amahhala azosetshenziswa ezinqubweni zezinto eziphilayo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.5 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha izincazelo zezindlela kanye nezici zesakhiwo samaseli ezivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zibambe, zigcine, noma zisebenzise amandla amahhala
question1: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezikwazi ukwenza i-photosynthesis?
answer1: Ama-photoautotroph
question2: Yisiphi isilwane esilandelayo esingeyona i-photoautotroph?
question3: Iyini indima eyinhloko ye-chlorophyll ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis?
answer3: Ukumunca amaza athile okukhanya okubonakalayo futhi kubambe amandla amahhala elangeni
question4: Yiziphi izinto ezisetshenziswa njengezinto ezisabelayo ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis?
question5: Yisiphi isithako esikhishwa njengomkhiqizo ongcolile we-photosynthesis?
question6: Kwenzeka kuphi ukusabela kwe-photosynthesis kumaseli e-eukaryotic?
answer6: Ama-chloroplast
question7: I-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli e-aerobic kuncike kanjani komunye nomunye?
answer7: I-Photosynthesis ikhiqiza umoya-mpilo noshukela osetshenziswa ekuphefumuleni kwamangqamuzana, kuyilapho ukuphefumula kubuyisela i-carbon dioxide namanzi asetshenziswa ku-photosynthesis
distractor7a: I-Photosynthesis incike ku-ATP ekhiqizwa kuphela ngesikhathi se-glycolysis
distractor7c: Lezi zinqubo ezimbili zenzeka ngokuzimela futhi azishintshisani ngezinto
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esisekela kangcono isimangalo sokuthi i-photosynthesis iyinqubo yezinto eziphilayo egciniwe?
answer8: Kwenziwa izinto eziphilayo ezivela ezindaweni eziningi zokuphila, okuhlanganisa izitshalo, ulwelwe, kanye ne-cyanobacteria
question9: Ukusabela kwe-photosynthesis kuhluke kanjani phakathi kwama-eukaryotes nama-prokaryotes?
answer9: Kuma-eukaryotes atholakala kuma-chloroplast, kanti kuma-prokaryotes atholakala ngaphakathi kwe-membrane kanye ne-cytoplasm.
question10: Kungani i-photosynthesis ibhekwa njengesu elibalulekile lokubamba amandla amahhala?
answer10: Iguqula amandla elanga abe amandla amakhemikhali agcinwe kuma-carbohydrate angasetshenziswa izinto eziphilayo
distractor10b: Igcina umoya-mpilo njengomthombo wamandla oyinhloko wamaseli
distractor10c: Iguqula i-carbon dioxide ngqo ibe yi-ATP

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.1 Ukubuka Konke Kwe-Photosynthesis | Ukubaluleka Kwe-Photosynthesis
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.1 Ukubuka Konke Kwe-Photosynthesis | Ukubaluleka Kwe-Photosynthesis
chapterContent:
I-Photosynthesis ibalulekile cishe kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo emhlabeni; kokubili izitshalo nezilwane zithembele kuyo. Yiyona kuphela inqubo yezinto eziphilayo engabamba amandla avela esikhaleni sangaphandle (ilanga) bese iwaguqula abe yi-chemical com amakhilogremu (ama-carbohydrate) esetshenziswa yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo ukunika amandla i-metabolism yazo. Ngamafuphi, amandla okukhanya kwelanga ayabanjwa futhi asetshenziswe ukunika amandla ama-electron, amandla awo abe esegcinwa ezibophweni ze-covalent zama-molecule kashukela. Zihlala isikhathi esingakanani lezo zibopho ze-covalent? Amandla akhishwa namuhla ngokushiswa kwemikhiqizo yamalahle ne-petroleum amelela amandla okukhanya kwelanga abanjwe futhi agcinwe yi-photosynthesis cishe eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingu-200 edlule.

 Izitshalo, ulwelwe, kanye neqembu lamagciwane abizwa ngokuthi i-cyanobacteria yizo kuphela izinto eziphilayo ezikwazi ukwenza i-photosynthesis (Isithombe 8.2). Ngenxa yokuthi basebenzisa ukukhanya ukukhiqiza ukudla kwabo, babizwa ngokuthi ama-photoautotrophs (ngokoqobo, okuziphakelayo kusetshenziswa ukukhanya). Ezinye izinto eziphilayo, njengezilwane, isikhunta, kanye namanye amabhaktheriya amaningi, zibizwa ngokuthi ama-heterotrophs (amanye ama-feeder”), ngoba kumele bathembele kushukela okhiqizwa izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis ngezidingo zabo zamandla. Iqembu lesithathu elithakazelisayo kakhulu lamabhaktheriya lenza ushukela, hhayi ngokusebenzisa amandla okukhanya kwelanga, kodwa ngokukhipha amandla kumakhemikhali angaphili amakhilogremu; ngakho-ke, abizwa ngokuthi ama-chemoautotrophs.

 Ukubaluleka kwe-photosynthesis akukhona nje ukuthi ingabamba amandla okukhanya kwelanga. I-lizard ezikhipha ilanga ngosuku olubandayo ingasebenzisa amandla elanga ukufudumala. I-Photosynthesis ibalulekile ngoba yavela njengendlela yokugcina amandla emisebeni yelanga (ingxenye yesithombe) njengamandla ezibophweni ze-carbon-carbon zama-molecule e-carbohydrate (ingxenye ye-synthesis). Lawo ma-carbohydrate angumthombo wamandla ama-heterotrophs asebenzisa wona ukunika amandla ukwenziwa kwe-ATP ngokuphefumula. Ngakho-ke, i-photosynthesis inika amandla amaphesenti angama-99 ezindawo zemvelo zoMhlaba. Lapho isilwane esidla inyamazane esihamba phambili, njengempisi, sidla inyamazane (Isithombe 8.3), impisi isuke isiphelile endleleni yamandla eyasuka ekusabeleni kwenuzi ebusweni belanga, yaya ekukhanyeni, yaya ku-photosynthesis, yaya ezitshalweni, yaya enyameni, futhi ekugcineni yaya empisini.
question1: Kungani i-photosynthesis ibhekwa njengebalulekile cishe kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni?
answer1: Ibamba amandla elanga futhi iwagcine njengamandla amakhemikhali kuma-carbohydrate asetshenziswa izinto eziphilayo
distractor1a: Iguqula i-ATP ngqo ibe yi-glucose yazo zonke izinto eziphilayo
distractor1b: Ikhiqiza umoya-mpilo osebenza njengomthombo wamandla oyinhloko wamaseli
distractor1c: Ivumela ama-heterotrophs ukuthi akhiqize ukudla kwawo ngokukhanya kwelanga
question2: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezihlukaniswa njenge-photoautotrophs?
question3: Kungani izilwane zibhekwa njenge-heterotrophs?
answer3: Zithembele kuma-molecule e-organic akhiqizwa yizinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthetic ukuze zithole amandla
distractor3a: Zibamba ukukhanya kwelanga ngqo zisebenzisa i-chlorophyll
distractor3c: Zithola amandla ngokuyinhloko kusuka ku-inorganic com amakhilogremu
question4: Ama-chemoautotroph ahluke kanjani kuma-photoautotroph?
answer4: Ama-chemoautotrophs asebenzisa amandla avela kumakhemikhali angaphili amakhilogremu esikhundleni sokukhanya kwelanga ukuze akhiqize ushukela
distractor4a: Ama-chemoautotroph athola amandla ngokudla ezinye izinto eziphilayo
distractor4b: Ama-chemoautotroph adinga i-chlorophyll ukuze amunce ukukhanya
question5: Kungani i-photosynthesis ingagcina amandla izigidi zeminyaka?
answer5: Amandla elanga abanjwe agcinwa ezibophweni eziqinile ze-covalent ngaphakathi kwama-molecule e-carbohydrate
distractor5a: Amandla ahlala evaleleke ngaphakathi kwama-molecule e-chlorophyll unomphela
distractor5b: Ama-molecule e-ATP akhiqizwa yi-photosynthesis ahlala eqinile izigidi zeminyaka
distractor5c: I-carbon dioxide igcina amandla elanga unomphela emoyeni
question6: Uyini umthombo omkhulu wamandla atholakala kumalahle nakuphethiloli?
answer6: Ukukhanya kwelanga okubanjwe yi-photosynthesis eminyakeni eyizigidi edlule
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani isibankwa esihlala elangeni singenzi i-photosynthesis?
answer7: I-lizard isebenzisa ukukhanya kwelanga ukuze ifudumale, kuyilapho i-photosynthesis igcina amandla okukhanya kuma-molecule ama-carbohydrate
distractor7a: Isibankwa asinayo i-mitochondria edingekayo ukuze kwenziwe i-photosynthesis
distractor7b: Isibankwa siguqula ukukhanya kwelanga kube yi-ATP ngqo
distractor7c: I-lizard isebenzisa ukukhanya kwelanga ukukhiqiza umoya-mpilo
question8: Cishe yiphesenti elingakanani lezinto eziphilayo zomhlaba ezisebenza nge-photosynthesis?
answer8: Amaphesenti angu-99
question9: Impisi idla inyamazane edla utshani. Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono imvelaphi yamandla asetshenziswa yimpisi?
answer9: Amandla avela elangeni elithathwe yizitshalo nge-photosynthesis
distractor9a: Amandla avela emangqamuzaneni emisipha ngesikhathi se-glycolysis
distractor9b: Amandla avela ku-oxygen ekhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokuphefumula
question10: Yisiphi isisho esihlukanisa kangcono i-photosynthesis ekuphefumuleni kwamangqamuzana?
answer10: I-Photosynthesis igcina amandla elanga kuma-carbohydrate, kuyilapho ukuphefumula kwamaseli kukhipha lawo mandla agciniwe ukuze kukhiqizwe i-ATP
distractor10a: I-Photosynthesis ikhiqiza i-ATP yokugcina isikhathi eside, kuyilapho ukuphefumula kugcina i-ATP ku-glucose
distractor10b: I-Photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kokubili kugcina amandla kuma-molecule e-oxygen
distractor10c: I-Photosynthesis ikhipha amandla avela kuma-carbohydrate, kuyilapho ukuphefumula kudonsa ukukhanya kwelanga

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.1 Ukubuka Konke kwe-Photosynthesis | Izakhiwo Eziyinhloko kanye Nesifinyezo se-Photosynthesis
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.1 Ukubuka Konke kwe-Photosynthesis | Izakhiwo Eziyinhloko kanye Nesifinyezo se-Photosynthesis
chapterContent:
I-Photosynthesis inqubo enezinyathelo eziningi edinga ukukhanya kwelanga, i-carbon dioxide (enamandla aphansi), kanye namanzi njengezinto ezisetshenziswayo (Isithombe 8.4). Ngemva kokuba inqubo isiqediwe, ikhipha umoya-mpilo futhi ikhiqize i-glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate (G3P), ama-molecule alula e-carbohydrate (anamandla aphezulu) angaguqulwa abe yi-glucose, i-sucrose, noma amanye ama-molecule amaningi kashukela. Lawa ma-molecule kashukela aqukethe amandla kanye ne-carbon enikwe amandla edingwa yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo ukuze ziphile.

 Isithombe 8.5 sibonisa i-chemical equation ye-photosynthesis. Nakuba i-equation ibukeka ilula, izinyathelo eziningi ezenzeka ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis empeleni ziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu. Ngaphambi kokufunda imininingwane yokuthi ama-photoautotrophs aguqula kanjani ukukhanya kwelanga kube ukudla, kubalulekile ukujwayelana nezakhiwo ezihilelekile.

 Ezitshalweni, i-photosynthesis ngokuvamile yenzeka emaqabunga, aqukethe izingqimba eziningana zamaseli. Inqubo ye-photosynthesis yenzeka engxenyeni ephakathi ebizwa ngokuthi i-mesophyll. Ukushintshana kwegesi kwe-carbon dioxide kanye nomoya-mpilo kwenzeka ngezimbobo ezincane, ezilawulwayo ezibizwa ngokuthi i-stomata (eyodwa: i-stoma), ezidlala indima ekulawulweni kokushintshana kwegesi kanye nokulinganisela kwamanzi. I-stomata ivame ukutholakala ngaphansi kweqabunga, okusiza ukunciphisa ukulahleka kwamanzi. I-stoma ngayinye izungezwe amaseli okuvikela alawula ukuvulwa nokuvalwa kwe-stomata ngokuvuvukala noma ukuncipha ngenxa yezinguquko ze-osmotic.

 Kuzo zonke i-eukaryotes ze-autotrophic, i-photosynthesis yenzeka ngaphakathi kwe-organelle ebizwa ngokuthi i-chloroplast. Ezitshalweni, amaseli aqukethe i-chloroplast akhona ku-mesophyll. Ama-chloroplast ane-membrane enhlobonhlobo ephindwe kabili (eyakhiwe i-membrane yangaphandle kanye ne-membrane yangaphakathi). Ngaphakathi kwe-chloroplast kunezakhiwo ezihlanganisiwe, ezimise okwe-disc ezibizwa ngokuthi i-thylakoids. Okufakwe ku-membrane ye-thylakoid kukhona i-chlorophyll, i-pigment (i-molecule emunca ukukhanya) ebhekene nokusebenzisana kokuqala phakathi kokukhanya nezinto zezitshalo, kanye namaprotheni amaningi akha uchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron. I-membrane ye-thylakoid ihlanganisa isikhala sangaphakathi esibizwa ngokuthi i-thylakoid lumen. Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 8.6, inqwaba yama-thylakoids ibizwa ngokuthi i-granum, kanti isikhala esigcwele uketshezi esizungeze i-granum sibizwa ngokuthi i-stroma noma umbhede” (akufanele kudidaniswe ne-stoma noma umlomo,” umgodi osesigabeni seqabunga)
question1: Yimaphi ama-molecule ayizinto eziyisisekelo ezidingekayo ukuze kwenziwe i-photosynthesis?
answer1: Amanzi kanye ne-carbon dioxide
question2: Yimuphi umolekyuli okhiqizwa ngqo yi-photosynthesis ngaphambi kokuba uguqulwe ube yi-glucose noma i-sucrose?
question3: Iyiphi ingxenye yeqabunga lesitshalo lapho iningi le-photosynthesis lenzeka khona?
question4: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-stomata?
answer4: Ukulawula ukushintshaniswa kwegesi kanye nokulinganisela kwamanzi
question5: Kungani ama-stomata evame ukutholakala ngaphansi kwamaqabunga?
question6: Uyini umsebenzi wamaseli onogada?
answer6: Zilawula ukuvulwa nokuvalwa kwe-stomata ngokushintsha i-turgor yazo
question7: Ikuphi i-chlorophyll ngaphakathi kwe-chloroplast?
answer7: Ihlanganiswe kulwelwesi lwe-thylakoid
question8: Ibizwa ngokuthini indawo egcwele uketshezi ezungeze i-grana ngaphakathi kwe-chloroplast?
answer8: I-stroma
question9: I-granum ichazwa kangcono ngokuthi yikuphi okulandelayo?
answer9: Inqwaba yama-thylakoid
question10: Bheka Umfanekiso 8.6. Ngosuku olushisayo nolomile, izitshalo ziyavala ama-stomata azo ukuze zilondoloze amanzi. Lokhu kuzoba namuphi umthelela ku-photosynthesis?
answer10: Izinga le-photosynthesis lizovinjelwa njengoba izinga le-carbon dioxide lehla
distractor10a: Izinga le-photosynthesis lizovinjelwa njengoba izinga lomoya-mpilo lincipha
distractor10b: Izinga le-photosynthesis lizokhula njengoba izinga le-carbon dioxide likhula
distractor10c: Izinga le-photosynthesis lizokhula njengoba izinga lomoya-mpilo likhula

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.1 Ukubuka Konke kwe-Photosynthesis | Izingxenye Ezimbili ze-Photosynthesis
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.1 Ukubuka Konke kwe-Photosynthesis | Izingxenye Ezimbili ze-Photosynthesis
chapterContent: I-Photosynthesis yenzeka ngezigaba ezimbili ezilandelanayo: ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kanye nokusabela okuzimele kokukhanya. Ekwenzeni okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni, amandla avela elangeni amuncwa yi-chlorophyll futhi lawo mandla aguqulwa abe amandla amakhemikhali agciniwe. Ekwenzeni okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni, amandla amakhemikhali aqoqwe ngesikhathi sokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni aqhuba ukuhlanganiswa kwama-molecule kashukela avela ku-carbon dioxide. Ngakho-ke, nakuba ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kungasebenzisi ukukhanya njenge-reactant, kudinga imikhiqizo yokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni ukuze isebenze. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-enzyme amaningana okusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni avuselelwa ukukhanya. Ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kusebenzisa ama-molecule athile ukugcina amandla okwesikhashana: Lawa abizwa ngokuthi abathwali bamandla. Abathwali bamandla abahambisa amandla kusuka ekuphenduleni okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kuya ekuphenduleni okuzimele kokukhanya bangacatshangwa njengabagcwele ngoba bacebile ngamandla. Ngemva kokukhululwa kwamandla, abathwali bamandla abangenalutho babuyela ekuphenduleni okuncike ekukhanyeni ukuze bathole amandla engeziwe. Isithombe 8.7 sibonisa izingxenye ezingaphakathi kwe-chloroplast lapho ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kanye nokuzimele kokukhanya kwenzeka khona.
question1: I-Photosynthesis yenzeka ngezigaba ezimbili ezinkulu. Yisiphi isigaba esibamba ngqo amandla avela elangeni?
answer1: Ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wezimpendulo ezixhomeke ekukhanyeni?
answer2: Ukuguqula amandla okukhanya abe amandla amakhemikhali agciniwe
distractor2a: Ukukhiqiza i-glucose ngqo kusuka ku-carbon dioxide
question3: Yimaphi ama-molecule akhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni adingekayo ngomjikelezo kaCalvin?
question4: Nakuba umjikelezo kaCalvin ungadingi ukukhanya ngqo, kungani uncike ekuphenduleni okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni?
answer4: Kudinga i-ATP ne-NADPH ezikhiqizwa ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni
distractor4a: Kudinga umoya-mpilo okhishwa yizimpendulo ezixhomeke ekukhanyeni
distractor4b: Kudinga ama-molecule e-chlorophyll akhiqizwa yizimpendulo ezixhomeke ekukhanyeni
distractor4c: Kudinga i-glucose ekhiqizwa yimiphumela exhomeke ekukhanyeni
question5: Uyini umthombo oyinhloko wekhabhoni osetshenziselwa ukwakha ushukela ngesikhathi somjikelezo kaCalvin?
question6: Kwenzekani ku-ATP kanye ne-NADPH ngemva kokukhipha amandla azo ngesikhathi somjikelezo weCalvin?
answer6: Zibuya njenge-ADP kanye ne-NADP+ ekusabeleni okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni ukuze ziphinde zinikwe amandla
question7: Kungani i-ATP ne-NADPH zivame ukuchazwa njengezithwali zamandla?
answer7: Zigcina futhi zidlulise amandla okwesikhashana kusuka ekuphenduleni okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kuya emjikelezweni kaCalvin
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kanye nomjikelezo kaCalvin?
answer8: Imikhiqizo yesigaba esisodwa iba yi-reactants yesinye, ehlanganisa izigaba ezimbili ze-photosynthesis
distractor8a: Zombili lezi zigaba zikhiqiza i-glucose ngokuzimela elangeni
distractor8b: Zombili izigaba zidinga umoya-mpilo njenge-reactant yazo eyinhloko
distractor8c: Umjikelezo kaCalvin unikeza ukukhanya kwelanga ezimpendulweni ezixhomeke ekukhanyeni
question9: Ama-enzyme amaningana omjikelezo kaCalvin asebenza ngokukhanya. Lokhu kubonisani?
answer9: Ukusabela okungenakho ukukhanya kulawulwa ngokungaqondile ukukhanya
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 8.7. Chaza ukuthi ukusabela kokukhanya kanye nokusabela okuzimele kokukhanya (umjikelezo kaCalvin) we-photosynthesis kuncike kanjani komunye nomunye
answer10: Ukusabela kokukhanya kukhiqiza i-ATP ne-NADPH, ezisetshenziswa emjikelezweni kaCalvin
distractor10a: Ukusabela kokukhanya kukhiqiza i-NADP+ kanye ne-ADP, ezisetshenziswa emjikelezweni kaCalvin
distractor10b: Ukusabela kokukhanya kusebenzisa i-NADPH ne-ATP, ezikhiqizwa umjikelezo kaCalvin
distractor10c: Ukusabela kokukhanya kukhiqiza i-NADPH kuphela, ekhiqizwa umjikelezo kaCalvin

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.1 Ukubuka Konke kwe-Photosynthesis | I-Photosynthesis eSitolo Sokudla
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.1 Ukubuka Konke kwe-Photosynthesis | I-Photosynthesis eSitolo Sokudla
chapterContent:
Izitolo ezinkulu zokudla e-United States zihlelwe ngeminyango, njengobisi, inyama, umkhiqizo, isinkwa, okusanhlamvu, njalo njalo. Isigaba ngasinye (Isithombe 8.8) siqukethe amakhulu, uma kungezona izinkulungwane, emikhiqizo ehlukene amakhasimende angayithenga futhi ayidle.

 Nakuba kunezinhlobonhlobo ezinkulu, into ngayinye ixhumanisa ne-photosynthesis. Inyama nobisi kuxhumanisa, ngoba izilwane zondliwa ukudla okusekelwe ezitshalweni. Izinkwa, okusanhlamvu, nama-pasta kuvela kakhulu ezinhlamvini ezinesitashi, okuyizimbewu zezitshalo ezincike ku-photosynthesis. Kuthiwani ngama-dessert neziphuzo? Yonke le mikhiqizo iqukethe ushukela—i-sucrose ingumkhiqizo wesitshalo, i-disaccharide, i-molecule yama-carbohydrate, eyakhiwe ngqo ku-photosynthesis. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinto eziningi azibonakali kahle ukuthi zivela ezitshalweni: Isibonelo, izimpahla zephepha ngokuvamile ziyimikhiqizo yezitshalo, kanti amapulasitiki amaningi (agcwele njengemikhiqizo kanye nokupakishwa) atholakala ku-algae. Cishe zonke izinongo kanye nokunambitheka kusigaba sezinongo kwakhiqizwa yisitshalo njengeqabunga, impande, igxolo, imbali, izithelo, noma isiqu. Ekugcineni, i-photosynthesis ixhuma ekudleni ngakunye nakukudla ngakunye umuntu akudlayo
question1: Kungani imikhiqizo yezitolo zokudla njengesinkwa, okusanhlamvu, kanye ne-pasta ixhomeke ku-photosynthesis ekugcineni?
answer1: Zenziwa ngokuyinhloko ngezitshalo ezikhiqiza ama-carbohydrate nge-photosynthesis
distractor1a: Zithola amandla ngqo elangeni ngemva kokuvuna
question2: Kungani inyama nemikhiqizo yobisi ekugcineni kuhlotshaniswa ne-photosynthesis?
answer2: Izilwane ezizikhiqizayo zithola amandla ngokudla izitshalo noma izinto eziphilayo ezithembele ezitshalweni
distractor2c: Izilwane zikhiqiza i-glucose ngaphandle kokudla ukudla
question3: I-sucrose etholakala ekudleni okuningi ichazwa kangcono ngokuthi:
answer3: I-disaccharide ekhiqizwa yisitshalo eyakhiwe ngama-carbohydrate atholakala kwi-photosynthesis
question4: Yimuphi kule mikhiqizo elandelayo ongathintwa kalula yi-photosynthesis?
question5: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani i-photosynthesis ibalulekile cishe kuzo zonke iziteshi zokudla?
answer5: Iguqula ukukhanya kwelanga kube amandla amakhemikhali asekela cishe zonke izinto eziphilayo
distractor5a: Ikhiqiza ngqo i-ATP yazo zonke izinto eziphilayo
distractor5c: Ivumela izilwane ukuthi zikhiqize i-glucose elangeni
question6: Imikhiqizo yephepha ekugcineni ixhunywe ku-photosynthesis ngoba:
answer6: Iphepha likhiqizwa ngokuyinhloko ngezinto zezitshalo
distractor6c: Iphepha likhiqizwa ngqo kusuka ku-carbon dioxide esemoyeni
question7: Yiliphi iqembu lezinto eziphilayo elinikeza umthombo wokuqala wamandla amakhemikhali ezindaweni eziningi zemvelo?
answer7: Ama-photoautotroph
question8: Impisi ithola amandla ngokudla inyamazane edla izitshalo. Umthombo wokuqala wamandla yilokhu:
answer8: Ukukhanya kwelanga okubanjwe ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis
question9: Kungani izinongo nezinongo nazo zihlobene ne-photosynthesis?
answer9: Zikhiqizwa ezicutshini zezitshalo ezifana namaqabunga, izimpande, amagxolo, izimbali, izithelo, noma iziqu
question10: Izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-photosynthesis zingabekwa kuphi kunethiwekhi yokudla ngaphakathi kwezindawo eziningi zemvelo?
answer10: Esisekelweni

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Kwe-Photosynthesis Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Kwe-Photosynthesis Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
I-Photosynthesis inezigaba ezimbili: ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kanye nokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni noma umjikelezo kaCalvin. Ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kwenzeka lapho ukukhanya kutholakala. Isibalo esiphelele se-photosynthesis sibonisa ukuthi ingabe kuyi-redox reaction; i-carbon dioxide iyancishiswa futhi amanzi aya-oxidized ukuze kukhiqizwe umoya-mpilo:

 Amandla + ⁢6CO2⁢ + ⁢H2O → ⁢C6⁢H12⁢O6⁢ + ⁢6O2
Ukusabela okuncike ekukhanyeni kwenzeka ezingxeni ze-thylakoid zama-chloroplast, kanti umjikelezo kaCalvin uyenzeka ku-stroma yama-chloroplast. Ezingxeni ze-thylakoid kukhona ama-photosystem amabili (PS I kanye ne-PS II), okuyizinhlanganisela zama-pigment abamba amandla elanga. Ama-chlorophyll a kanye no-b amunca amaza okukhanya aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, kanye nabomvu avela ku-spectrum yokukhanya ebonakalayo futhi abonise okuluhlaza. Ama-carotenoid pigments amunca ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka-oluhlaza futhi abonise ukukhanya okuphuzi kuya ko-orenji. Izici zemvelo ezifana nobude bosuku kanye nokushisa kuthonya ama-pigments avelele ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka. Nakuba lezi zinhlelo ezimbili ze-photosystem zisebenza ngesikhathi esisodwa, kulula ukuzihlola ngokwehlukana. Ake siqale nge-photosystem II.

 I-photon yokukhanya ishaya ama-antenna pigments e-PS II ukuze iqalise i-photosynthesis. Endleleni engeyona i-cyclic, i-PS II ibamba ama-photon ezingeni lamandla eliphakeme kancane kune-PS I. (Khumbula ukuthi ubude obufushane bokukhanya buthwala amandla engeziwe.) Amandla amuncwayo aya esikhungweni sokusabela se-antenna pigment equkethe i-chlorophyll a futhi akhuphula ama-electron e-chlorophyll a ezingeni lamandla eliphezulu. Ama-electron amukelwa yiprotheni eyinhloko yokwamukela ama-electron bese edluliselwa kuchungechunge lokuthutha ama-electron nalo olufakwe ku-membrane ye-thylakoid. Amandla amuncwa ku-PS II anele ukuxubha (ukuhlukanisa) amanzi, akhiphe umoya-mpilo emkhathini; ama-electron akhishwe ekuxubeni kwamanzi athatha indawo yama-electron akhushulwe kusuka ku-chlorophyll yesikhungo sokusabela. Njengoba ama-electron avela esikhungweni sokusabela i-chlorophyll edlula ochungechungeni lwamaprotheni athwala ama-electron, ama-ion e-hydrogen (H+) adonswa phezu kwe-membrane nge-chemiosmosis angene ngaphakathi kwe-thylakoid. (Uma lokhu kuzwakala kujwayelekile, kufanele. Sifunde i-chemiosmosis ekuhloleni kwethu ukuphefumula kwamaseli ku-Cellular Respiration.) Lesi senzo sakha ukuhlushwa okuphezulu kwama-ion e-H+, futhi njengoba egeleza nge-ATP synthase, kwakheka ama-molecule e-ATP. Lawa ma-molecule e-ATP azosetshenziswa ukuhlinzeka ngamandla wamahhala wokwenziwa kwama-carbohydrate emjikelezweni weCalvin, isigaba sesibili se-photosynthesis. Uchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron luxhumanisa i-PS II ne-PS I. Njengezehlakalo ezenzeka ku-PS II, lolu hlelo lwesibili lwe-photosystem lumunca i-photon yesibili yokukhanya, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwe-molecule ye-NADPH evela ku-NADP+. Amandla athwalwa ku-NADPH nawo asetshenziselwa ukunika amandla ukusabela kwamakhemikhali komjikelezo weCalvin.

Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nemikhuba yesayensi eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kweziyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile

 Umkhuba Wesayensi

Umkhuba Wesayensi

4.A.2 Ama-chloroplast angama-organelle akhethekile abamba amandla nge-photosynthesis.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.6 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo ngokwekhwalithi ukuchaza ukuthi ukusebenzisana kwezakhiwo ezingaphansi kwamangqamuzana, ezinemisebenzi ekhethekile, kunikeza imisebenzi ebalulekile.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Kwesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[I-APLO 2.5][I-APLO 2.16][I-APLO 2.18][I-APLO 1.9][I-APLO 1.32][I-APLO 4.14][I-APLO 2.2][I-APLO 2.3][I-APLO 2.23][I-APLO 1.15][I-APLO 1.29]

 Ukukhanya kungasetshenziswa kanjani ukwenza ukudla? Uma umuntu evula isibani, amandla kagesi aba amandla okukhanya. Njengazo zonke ezinye izinhlobo zamandla e-kinetic, ukukhanya kungahamba, kushintshe isimo, futhi kuhlanganiswe ukwenza umsebenzi. Endabeni ye-photosynthesis, amandla okukhanya aguqulwa abe amandla amakhemikhali, asetshenziswa ama-photoautotrophs ukwakha ama-molecule e-carbohydrate (Isithombe 8.9). Kodwa-ke, ama-autotrophs asebenzisa kuphela izingxenye ezimbalwa ezithile zokukhanya kwelanga
question1: Kwenzeka kuphi ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kwe-photosynthesis kumaseli e-eukaryotic?
answer1: Ulwelwesi lwe-thylakoid lwama-chloroplast

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Kwe-Photosynthesis Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni | Ayini Amandla Okukhanya?
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Kwe-Photosynthesis Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni | Ayini Amandla Okukhanya?
chapterContent:
Ilanga likhipha inani elikhulu kakhulu lemisebe kagesi (amandla elanga). Abantu bangabona ingxenye encane kuphela yala mandla, okuyiyona ngxenye ebizwa ngokuthi ukukhanya okubonakalayo. Indlela amandla elanga ahamba ngayo ichazwa njengamagagasi. Ososayensi banganquma inani lamandla egagasi ngokulinganisa ubude bawo, ibanga eliphakathi kwamaphuzu alandelanayo wegagasi. Igagasi elilodwa lilinganiswa kusukela kumaphuzu amabili alandelanayo, njengokusuka eqongeni kuya eqongeni noma ukusuka eqongeni kuya eqongeni (Isithombe 8.10).

 Ukukhanya okubonakalayo kwakha uhlobo olulodwa kuphela lwezinhlobo eziningi zemisebe kagesi ekhishwa elangeni nakwezinye izinkanyezi. Ososayensi bahlukanisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zamandla akhanyayo avela elangeni ngaphakathi kwe-spectrum kagesi. I-spectrum kagesi iwububanzi bawo wonke amaza angenzeka emisebeni (Isithombe 8.11). Umehluko phakathi kwamaza okukhanya uhlobene nenani lamandla athwalwa yiwo.

 Uhlobo ngalunye lwemisebe kagesi luhamba kubude obuthile. Uma ubude be-wavelength (noma uma bubonakala bunwebeka kakhulu kumdwebo), kulapho amandla amancane athwalwa khona. Amagagasi amafushane, aqinile athwala amandla amaningi. Lokhu kungase kubonakale kungenangqondo, kodwa cabanga ngakho ngokunyakaza kwentambo esindayo. Akudingi mzamo omkhulu ngomuntu ukuhambisa intambo emagagasini amade, abanzi. Ukwenza intambo ihambe Ngamafuphi, amaza aqinile, umuntu kuzodingeka asebenzise amandla amaningi kakhulu.

 I-electromagnetic spectrum (Isithombe 8.11) ikhombisa izinhlobo eziningana zemisebe kagesi evela elangeni, okuhlanganisa imisebe ye-X kanye nemisebe ye-ultraviolet (UV). Amaza anamandla aphezulu angangena ezicutshini futhi alimaze amangqamuzana kanye ne-DNA, echaza ukuthi kungani imisebe ye-X kanye nemisebe ye-UV ingaba yingozi ezintweni eziphilayo.
question1: Iyiphi ingxenye ye-electromagnetic spectrum esetshenziswa ku-photosynthesis?
answer1: Ukukhanya okubonakalayo
question2: Kuyini ubude be-wavelength?
answer2: Ibanga eliphakathi kwamaphuzu amabili alandelanayo wegagasi
question3: Ubude be-wavelength buhlobene kanjani nenani lamandla athwalwa yimisebe kagesi?
answer3: Ama-wavelength amafushane athwala amandla amaningi kune-wavelength ende
distractor3a: Ama-wavelength amade athwala amandla amaningi kune-wavelength emfushane
distractor3b: Zonke izingqimba zamaza ziphethe inani elifanayo lamandla
question4: Kungani imisebe ye-ultraviolet (UV) ingalimaza amangqamuzana aphilayo?
answer4: Inobude be-wavelength obufushane ngakho-ke ithwala amandla amaningi
question5: Yiluphi uhlobo lwemisebe kagesi oluphethe inani elikhulu lamandla?
distractor5c: Ukukhanya okubonakalayo kuhlala kuthwala amandla amaningi
question6: Kungani ukukhanya okubonakalayo kubalulekile ezitshalweni?
answer6: Inikeza amandla okukhanya asetshenziswa ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis
question7: I-spectrum ye-electromagnetic ichazwa kangcono kanje:
answer7: Ububanzi obuphelele bayo yonke imisebe kagesi engaba khona
distractor7c: Ingxenye yokukhanya kwelanga esetshenziswa izitshalo kuphela
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle imisebe ye-X nokukhanya okubonakalayo?
answer8: Ama-X-ray ane-wavelength emfushane futhi athwala amandla amaningi kunokukhanya okubonakalayo
distractor8a: Ukukhanya okubonakalayo kune-wavelength emfushane futhi kuthwala amandla amaningi kune-X-ray
distractor8c: Ukukhanya okubonakalayo kungena ezicutshini ngempumelelo kakhulu kune-X-ray
question9: Kungani ukukhiqiza amaza amafushane, aqinile entanjeni kudinga umzamo omkhulu kunokukhiqiza amaza amade, abanzi?
answer9: Ama-wavelength amafushane amelela amaza anamandla aphezulu
distractor9b: Amandla wamagagasi ancike kuphela ekuphakameni kwamagagasi
distractor9c: Isifaniso sentambo sibonisa isivinini samagagasi kunokuba amandla
question10: Kungani imisebe ye-X kanye nemisebe ye-ultraviolet ingaba yingozi ezintweni eziphilayo?
answer10: Amagagasi azo anamandla aphezulu angangena ezicutshini futhi alimaze amaseli kanye ne-DNA

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Kwe-Photosynthesis Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni | Ukumuncwa Kokukhanya
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Kwe-Photosynthesis Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni | Ukumuncwa Kokukhanya
chapterContent:
Amandla okukhanya aqala inqubo ye-photosynthesis lapho ama-pigment amunca ukukhanya. Ama-pigment e-organic, kungaba yi-retina yomuntu noma i-chloroplast thylakoid, anezinga elincane lamazinga amandla angawamunca. Amazinga amandla aphansi kunalawo amelwe ukukhanya okubomvu awanele ukuphakamisa i-electron ye-orbital ibe sesimweni esihlala njalo, esijabulisayo (i-quantum). Amazinga amandla aphezulu kunalawo akhanya okwesibhakabhaka azodabula ama-molecule ngokwawo, okubizwa ngokuthi i-bleaching. Ngakho-ke ama-pigment e-retina angabona kuphela ukukhanya okungu-700 nm kuya ku-400 nm, okubizwa ngokuthi ukukhanya okubonakalayo. Ngezizathu ezifanayo, ama-molecule e-pigment ezitshalo amunca ukukhanya kuphela ebangeni lama-wavelength angu-700 nm kuya ku-400 nm; izazi ze-physiology zezitshalo zibhekisela kulolu hlu lwezitshalo njengemisebe esebenzayo ye-photosynthetically.

 Ukukhanya okubonakalayo okubonwa ngabantu njengokukhanya okumhlophe empeleni kukhona e-rainbow yemibala. Izinto ezithile, njenge-prism noma ithonsi lamanzi, zisakaza ukukhanya okumhlophe ukuze zembule imibala esweni lomuntu. Ingxenye yokukhanya okubonakalayo ye-spectrum ye-electromagnetic ikhombisa uthingo lwemibala, kanye ne-violet ne-blue ene-wavelength emfushane, ngakho-ke amandla aphezulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi lwe-spectrum kuya kokubomvu, ama-wavelength amade futhi anamandla aphansi (Isithombe 8.12)

answer2: Ama-wavelength athile kuphela aqukethe amandla anele okuvusa ama-electron ngaphandle kokulimaza ama-molecule e-pigment

distractor2b: Ama-pigment amunca kahle wonke amaza obubanzi bamaza
distractor2c: Ukukhanya okubonakalayo akunamandla anele okuvusa ama-electron

question5: Kungani ukukhanya okunama-wavelength amafushane kunoluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kungalimaza ama-molecule e-pigment?
answer5: Iqukethe amandla anele ukuqhekeza ama-molecule ngokomzimba

answer6: Ingxube yazo zonke izingqimba zobude besikhathi ezibonakalayo
distractor6b: Amaza okukhanya abomvu naluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kuphela
question7: Kwenzekani uma ukukhanya okumhlophe kudlula ku-prism?
answer7: Ihlakazeke ngemibala yayo yezingxenye
distractor7c: Ubude bayo be-wavelength buba yinto efanayo
question8: Yikuphi ukukhanya okubonakalayo okunamandla aphezulu kakhulu?
answer8: Ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
question9: Yikuphi ukukhanya okubonakalayo okunobude obude kakhulu be-wavelength?
answer9: Ukukhanya okubomvu
question10: Kungani izazi ze-physiology zezitshalo zibhekisela kuma-wavelength aphakathi kuka-400 nm no-700 nm njengemisebe esebenzayo ye-photosynthetically (PAR)?
answer10: Lawa maza angamuncwa yi-pigment ye-photosynthesis ukuze kuqhutshwe i-photosynthesis
distractor10b: Yiwona kuphela amaza okukhanya akhishwa yiLanga

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Kwe-Photosynthesis Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni | Ukuqonda Amabala
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Kwe-Photosynthesis Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni | Ukuqonda Amabala
chapterContent:
Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-pigment, futhi ngayinye imunca ama-wavelength athile (imibala) yokukhanya okubonakalayo. Ama-pigment abonakalisa noma adlulisa ama-wavelength angakwazi ukuwamunca, okwenza avele ngombala ohambisanayo.

 Ama-chlorophyll nama-carotenoid yizigaba ezimbili ezinkulu zama-pigment e-photosynthetic atholakala ezitshalweni kanye nase-algae; ikilasi ngalinye linezinhlobo eziningi zama-molecule e-pigment. Kunezinhlobo ezinhlanu ezinkulu zama-chlorophyll: a, b, c kanye no-d kanye ne-molecule ehlobene etholakala kuma-prokaryotes abizwa ngokuthi i-bacteriochlorophyll. I-chlorophyll a kanye ne-chlorophyll b zitholakala kuma-chloroplast ezitshalo aphezulu futhi kuzoba yingqikithi yengxoxo elandelayo.

 Ngezinhlobo eziningi ezahlukene, ama-carotenoid ayiqembu elikhulu kakhulu lama-pigment. Ama-carotenoid atholakala ezithelweni—njengobomvu betamatisi (i-lycopene), ophuzi bembewu yommbila (i-zeaxanthin), noma i-orenji yekhasi le-orenji (i-β-carotene)—asetshenziswa njengezikhangiso zokuheha abasabalalisi bembewu. Ku-photosynthesis, ama-carotenoid asebenza njenge-photosynthetic pigments ezingama-molecule asebenza kahle kakhulu ekulahleni amandla amaningi. Uma iqabunga livezwa elangeni eligcwele, ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kuyadingeka ukuze kucutshungulwe inani elikhulu lamandla; uma lawo mandla engaphathwa kahle, angenza umonakalo omkhulu. Ngakho-ke, ama-carotenoid amaningi ahlala kulwelwesi lwe-thylakoid, amunca amandla amaningi, futhi ahlakaze lawo mandla ngokuphephile njengokushisa.

 Uhlobo ngalunye lwe-pigment lungabonakala ngephethini ethile yamaza okukhanya elimunca ekukhanyeni okubonakalayo, okuyi-absorption spectrum. Igrafu ekuFigure 8.13 ikhombisa ama-absorption spectra e-chlorophyll a, chlorophyll b, kanye nohlobo lwe-carotenoid pigment ebizwa ngokuthi i-β-carotene (emunca ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nokuluhlaza). Qaphela ukuthi i-pigment ngayinye inesethi ehlukile yeziqongo kanye nezindawo zokudonsa, iveza iphethini ethile yokumunca. I-Chlorophyll a imunca amaza okukhanya avela kunoma yiliphi icala le-spectrum ebonakalayo (eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nokubomvu), kodwa hhayi eluhlaza. Ngenxa yokuthi oluhlaza luyabonakaliswa noma ludluliselwa, i-chlorophyll ibonakala iluhlaza. Ama-Carotenoid amunca endaweni eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka enobude obufushane, futhi abonise ubude obude bobude bokukhanya obuphuzi, obomvu, no-orenji.

 Izinto eziphilayo eziningi ezisebenzisa i-photosynthesis zinengxube yezinhlayiya; uma ziyisebenzisa, izinto eziphilayo zingamunca amandla avela kububanzi bobude bokukhanya. Akuzona zonke izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-photosynthesis ezinokufinyelela okugcwele elangeni. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo zikhula ngaphansi kwamanzi lapho ukukhanya kwehla khona futhi kushintsha ngokujula. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo zikhula zincintisana nokukhanya. Izitshalo ezisesitezi sehlathi kumele zikwazi ukumunca noma yikuphi ukukhanya okuvelayo, ngoba izihlahla ezinde zimunca iningi lokukhanya kwelanga futhi zisakaze imisebe yelanga esele (Isithombe 8.14).

 Lapho zifunda izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-photosynthesis, ososayensi banganquma izinhlobo zezinhlayiya ezikhona ngokukhiqiza ama-spectra okumunca. Ithuluzi elibizwa ngokuthi i-spectrophotometer lingahlukanisa ukuthi yimaphi ama-wavelength okukhanya into engayimunca. I-Spectrophoto amamitha ilinganisa ukukhanya okudlulisiwe bese ibala ukumunca kusuka kuyo. Ngokukhipha imibala emaqabunga bese ubeka lawa masampula ku-spectrophotometer, ososayensi bangabona ukuthi yimaphi amaza okukhanya angamuncwa yizinto eziphilayo. Izindlela ezengeziwe zokuhlonza imibala yezitshalo zifaka phakathi izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-chromatography ezihlukanisa imibala ngokuhambisana kwazo nezigaba eziqinile nezihambayo.

answer1: Zibonakalisa noma zidlulise amaza okukhanya ezingawamunci

answer6: Iphethini ethile yamaza obubanzi amuncwa yi-pigment
question7: Kungani imibala engeziwe iwusizo kakhulu ezitshalweni ezikhula phansi emahlathini emvula?
answer7: Zivumela isitshalo ukuthi simunce ububanzi obubanzi bokukhanya okulinganiselwe okufinyelela phansi kwehlathi.

answer8: I-spectrophotometer
