answer9: I-chromatography
question10: Kungani ama-carotenoid eveza imibala ephuzi, e-orenji, nebomvu?
answer10: Zimunca ikakhulukazi ubude be-wavelength obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nobuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngenkathi zibonisa ubude be-wavelength obude
distractor10c: Baguqula ukukhanya okuluhlaza kube ukukhanya okuphuzi

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni Kwe-Photosynthesis | Indlela Ukusabela Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni Okusebenza Ngayo
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni Kwe-Photosynthesis | Indlela Ukusabela Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni Okusebenza Ngayo
chapterContent:
Umsebenzi ojwayelekile wokusabela okuncike ekukhanyeni ukuguqula amandla elanga abe amandla amakhemikhali ngesimo se-NADPH ne-ATP. La mandla amakhemikhali asekela ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni futhi akhuthaza ukuhlanganiswa kwama-molecule kashukela. Ukusabela okuncike ekukhanyeni kuboniswe ku-Figure 8.15. Ama-protein complex nama-molecule e-pigment asebenza ndawonye ukukhiqiza i-NADPH ne-ATP.

 Isinyathelo sangempela esiguqula amandla okukhanya abe amandla amakhemikhali senzeka endaweni eyinkimbinkimbi yama-protein amaningi ebizwa ngokuthi i-photosystem, izinhlobo ezimbili zazo ezitholakala zifakwe ku-membrane ye-thylakoid, i-photosystem II (PSII) kanye ne-photosystem I (PSI) (Figure 8.16). Ama-complex amabili ayahluka ngokusekelwe kulokho akhiqiza khona i-oxidize (okungukuthi, umthombo wokunikezwa kwama-electron anamandla aphansi) kanye nalokho akunciphisayo (indawo lapho aletha khona ama-electron awo anamandla).

 Zombili izinhlelo ze-photosystem zinesakhiwo esifanayo esiyisisekelo; inani lama-pigment e-antenna lapho ama-molecule e-chlorophyll aboshwe khona azungeze isikhungo sokusabela lapho kwenzeka khona i-photochemistry. Uhlelo ngalunye lwe-photosystem lusetshenzwa yi-complex yokuvuna ukukhanya, edlulisa amandla avela elangeni aye esikhungweni sokusabela; luqukethe ama-pigment amaningi e-antenna aqukethe ingxube yama-molecule angu-300-400 e-chlorophyll a kanye ne-b kanye nezinye i-pigment ezifana nama-carotenoid. Ukumuncwa kwe-photon eyodwa noma inani elihlukile noma iphakethe lokukhanya yinoma iyiphi i-chlorophyll kusunduza leyo molecule ibe sesimweni sokujabula. Ngamafuphi, amandla okukhanya manje abanjwe ama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo kodwa awagcinwanga nganoma iyiphi indlela ewusizo okwamanje. Amandla adluliselwa kusuka ku-chlorophyll kuya ku-chlorophyll kuze kube yilapho ekugcineni (ngemuva kwengxenye yesigidi yomzuzwana), ethunyelwa esikhungweni sokusabela. Kuze kube manje, amandla kuphela adluliselwe phakathi kwama-molecule, hhayi ama-electron.

 Isikhungo sokusabela siqukethe i-chlorophyll engumbhangqwana wama-molecule anesici esikhethekile. Lawo ma-chlorophyll amabili angadlula ku-oxidation lapho evuswa; empeleni angayeka i-electron enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-photoact. Kukulesi sinyathelo esikhungweni sokusabela, lesi sinyathelo ku-photosynthesis, lapho amandla okukhanya eguqulwa abe yi-electron ejabule. Zonke izinyathelo ezilandelayo zihilela ukufaka leyo electron ku-NADPH yokuthwala amandla ukuze ihanjiswe kumjikelezo weCalvin lapho i-electron ifakwa ku-carbon ukuze igcinwe isikhathi eside ngesimo se-carbohydrate. I-PSII ne-PSI yizingxenye ezimbili ezinkulu ze-electron ye-photosynthetic uchungechunge lokuhamba, oluhlanganisa ne-cytochrome complex. I-cytochrome complex, i-enzyme eyakhiwe yi-protein complexes ezimbili, idlulisela ama-electron kusuka ku-carrier molecule plastoquinone (Pq) kuya ku-protein plastocyanin (Pc), ngaleyo ndlela ivumela kokubili ukudluliselwa kwama-proton kuwo wonke ulwelwesi lwe-thylakoid kanye nokudluliselwa kwama-electron kusuka ku-PSII kuya ku-PSI.

 Isikhungo sokusabela se-PSII (esibizwa nge-P680) siletha ama-electron aso anamandla aphezulu, ngalinye ngesikhathi, ku-primary electron acceptor, kanye nangochungechunge lokuhamba lwama-electron (Pq kuya ku-cytochrome complex kuya ku-plastocyanine) kuya ku-PSI. I-P680’s electron engekho ithathelwa indawo ngokukhipha i-electron enamandla aphansi emanzini; ngakho-ke, amanzi ayahlukaniswa futhi i-PSII incishiswa kabusha ngemva kwe-photoact ngayinye. Ukuhlukanisa i-molecule eyodwa ye-H2O kukhipha ama-electron amabili, ama-athomu amabili e-hydrogen, kanye ne-athomu eyodwa ye-oxygen. Ukuhlukanisa ama-molecule amabili kuyadingeka ukwakha i-molecule eyodwa ye-diatomic O2 gas. Cishe amaphesenti ayi-10 omoya-mpilo asetshenziswa yi-mitochondria eqabungeni ukusekela i-phosphorylation ye-oxidative. Okusele kuphuma emoyeni lapho kusetshenziswa khona izinto eziphilayo ze-aerobic ukusekela ukuphefumula.

 Njengoba ama-electron ehamba phakathi kwamaprotheni ahlala phakathi kwe-PSII ne-PSI, alahlekelwa amandla. Lawo mandla asetshenziselwa ukuhambisa ama-athomu e-hydrogen esuka ohlangothini lwe-stromal lwe-membrane aye ku-thylakoid lumen. Lawo ma-athomu e-hydrogen, kanye nalawo akhiqizwa ngokuhlukana kwamanzi, aqoqana ku-thylakoid lumen futhi azosetshenziswa ukukhiqiza i-ATP esinyathelweni esilandelayo. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-electron alahlekelwe amandla ngaphambi kokufika kwawo ku-PSI, kumele aphinde anikwe amandla yi-PSI, ngakho-ke, elinye i-photon limuncwa yi-antenna ye-PSI. Lawo mandla adluliselwa esikhungweni sokusabela se-PSI (esibizwa nge-P700). I-P700 iya-oxidized futhi ithumela i-electron enamandla aphezulu ku-NADP+ ukuze yakhe i-NADPH. Ngakho-ke, i-PSII ibamba amandla ukudala ama-proton gradients ukwenza i-ATP, kanti i-PSI ibamba amandla ukunciphisa i-NADP+ ibe yi-NADPH. Lezi zinhlelo ezimbili ze-photosystem zisebenza ngokubambisana, ngokwengxenye, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kwe I-NADPH izolingana cishe nokukhiqizwa kwe-ATP. Kukhona ezinye izindlela zokulungisa leso silinganiso ukuze sivumelane ncamashi nezidingo zamandla ezishintsha njalo ze-chloroplast.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni Kwe-Photosynthesis | Ukukhiqiza Isithwali Samandla: I-ATP
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.2 Ukusabela Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni Kwe-Photosynthesis | Ukukhiqiza Isithwali Samandla: I-ATP
chapterContent:
Njengasesikhaleni esiphakathi kwe-mitochondria ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaseli, ukuqongelela kwama-ion e-hydrogen ngaphakathi kwe-lumen ye-thylakoid kudala i-gradient yokuhlushwa. Ukusabalala okungenamsebenzi kwama-ion e-hydrogen kusuka ekuhlushweni okuphezulu (ku-lumen ye-thylakoid) kuya ekuhlushweni okuphansi (ku-stroma) kuhlanganiswa ukudala i-ATP, njengasekuchushweni kokuthutha kwama-electron kokuphefumula kwamaseli. Ama-ion akha amandla ngenxa yokusabalala futhi ngoba wonke anokushaja okufanayo kukagesi, okuxoshanayo.

 Ukuze akhulule la mandla, ama-ion e-hydrogen azodlula kunoma yimuphi umgodi, njengokungathi amanzi ageleza ngembobo edamini. Ku-thylakoid, lowo mgodi uwukudlula ngesiteshi seprotheyini esikhethekile esibizwa ngokuthi i-ATP synthase. Amandla akhishwa yi-hydrogen ion stream avumela i-ATP synthase ukuthi inamathisele iqembu lesithathu le-phosphate ku-ADP, elakha i-molecule ye-ATP (Isithombe 8.16). Ukugeleza kwama-ion e-hydrogen nge-ATP synthase kubizwa ngokuthi i-chemiosmosis ngoba ama-ion asuka endaweni ephezulu aye endaweni ephansi ngesakhiwo esingangenisi amanzi kancane.
question1: Yini edala i-gradient yokuhlushwa kwe-hydrogen ion esetshenziswa ukukhiqiza i-ATP ngesikhathi sokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni?
answer1: Ama-ion e-hydrogen aqoqana ngaphakathi kwe-lumen ye-thylakoid njengoba ama-electron ehamba ngeketanga lokuthuthwa kwama-electron e-photosynthetic
distractor1a: Ama-ion e-hydrogen aqoqana ku-stroma ngesikhathi somjikelezo kaCalvin
distractor1b: I-carbon dioxide ifakwa ngenkuthalo ku-lumen ye-thylakoid
distractor1c: I-ATP synthase ipompa ama-ion e-hydrogen ku-lumen ye-thylakoid
question2: I-ATP ikhiqizwa kanjani ngesikhathi sokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni?
answer2: Ama-ion e-hydrogen ageleza nge-ATP synthase, enikeza amandla okufaka i-phosphorylate ADP ku-ATP
distractor2a: I-ATP ikhiqizwa lapho amanzi ehlukaniswa abe yi-hydrogen ne-oxygen
question3: Kuyini i-chemiosmosis?
answer3: Ukuhamba kwama-ion e-hydrogen phansi kwe-gradient yawo yokuhlushwa nge-ATP synthase ukuze kukhiqizwe i-ATP
question4: Kuphi uhlangothi lapho ama-ion e-hydrogen ahamba khona nge-ATP synthase ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis?
question5: Kungani ama-ion e-hydrogen equkethe amandla angaba khona ngaphakathi kwe-lumen ye-thylakoid?
answer5: Zigcwele endaweni eyodwa futhi ziyaxoshana ngoba zonke ziphethe amandla amahle
question6: Yiliphi iphrotheni elihlanganisa ngqo i-ATP ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis?
answer6: I-ATP synthase
question7: Yini enikeza amandla asheshayo asetshenziswa yi-ATP synthase ukwakha i-ATP?
answer7: Ukugeleza kwama-ion e-hydrogen phansi kwe-gradient yawo ye-electrochemical
question8: Indlela yokukhiqizwa kwe-ATP ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis ifana kakhulu nenqubo yokuphefumula kwamaseli?
answer8: I-chemiosmosis ngesikhathi se-phosphorylation ye-oxidative
question9: Kungani i-membrane ye-thylakoid ibalulekile ekukhiqizweni kwe-ATP?
answer9: Igcina i-gradient ye-hydrogen ion edingekayo ye-chemiosmosis
question10: Bheka Umfanekiso 8.17. Uma i-stomata ivaliwe, bekuzokwenzekani emazingeni e-oxygen (O2) kanye ne-carbon dioxide (CO2) eqabungeni le-photosynthesizing?
answer10: Amazinga e-O2 azokwanda futhi amazinga e-CO2 azokwehla
distractor10a: Amazinga e-CO2 azokwanda kanti amazinga e-O2 azokwehla
distractor10b: Amazinga e-O2 kanye ne-CO2 azokwehla kokubili
distractor10c: Amazinga e-O2 kanye ne-CO2 azokhuphuka womabili

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Amandla amahhala agcinwe ku-ATP kanye ne-NADPH akhiqizwa ekuphenduleni okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni asetshenziselwa ukunika amandla ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni noma umjikelezo kaCalvin, okungenzeka kokubili emini nasebusuku. Emjikelezweni kaCalvin, i-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-ribulose biphosphate carboxylase (RuBisCO2), ivuselela ukusabela nge-CO2 kanye nenye i-molecule ebizwa ngokuthi i-ribulose biphosphate (RuBP) evuselelwa kusukela emjikelezweni kaCalvin wangaphambilini. Ngemva kochungechunge lwezimpendulo zamakhemikhali, ikhabhoni evela ku-carbon dioxide emkhathini iqiniswa ibe ama-carbohydrate, ikakhulukazi i-molecule ye-carbon ezintathu ebizwa ngokuthi i-glyceraldehydes-3-phosphate (G3P). (Futhi, bala ama-carbon njengoba sihlola umjikelezo weCalvin.) Ngemva kokushintshana kathathu komjikelezo, i-molecule ye-carbon ezintathu ye-G3P ishiya umjikelezo ukuze ibe yingxenye ye-molecule ye-carbohydrate. Ama-molecule asele e-G3P ahlala emjikelezweni ukuze avuselelwe abe yi-RuBP, ekulungele ukusabela nge-CO2 engenayo. Ngamanye amazwi, iseli likhiqiza inqwaba ye-G3P ukuze ihlanganiswe ibe ama-molecule e-organic, kufaka phakathi ama-carbohydrate. Isinyathelo ngasinye somjikelezo weCalvin siqhutshwa ama-enzyme athile. (Akudingeki ukuthi ukhumbule ngekhanda ukusabela komjikelezo weCalvin; noma kunjalo, uma unikezwe umdwebo womjikelezo, kufanele ukwazi ukuwuchaza.) Ezinye izitshalo zashintsha izinguquko zamakhemikhali ukuze zibambe i-CO2 ngempumelelo uma izimo zemvelo zikhawulela ukutholakala kwayo. Isibonelo, uma kushisa ngaphandle, izitshalo zivame ukugcina ama-stomata azo evaliwe ukuvimbela ukulahleka kwamanzi ngokweqile; lapho izinga lokushisa langaphandle liphola, ama-stomata ayavuleka futhi izitshalo ziyamukela. I-CO2 futhi isebenzise uhlelo olusebenza kahle kakhulu ukuyondla ngomjikelezo kaCalvin.

 Njengoba sihlole ku-Overview of Photosynthesis, i-photosynthesis yakha isixhumanisi samandla nokuphefumula kwamaseli. Izitshalo zidinga kokubili i-photosynthesis nokuphefumula ukuze ziqhube izinqubo ze-metabolic phakathi nezikhathi zokukhanya nezimnyama. Ngakho-ke, amaseli ezitshalo aqukethe ama-chloroplast kanye nama-mitochondria.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni, imiqondo yokusekela kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Ze-AP® Biology, njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2

question1: Iyini indima eyinhloko ye-ATP ne-NADPH ekhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni?
answer1: Zinikeza amandla kanye namandla okunciphisa adingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe umjikelezo weCalvin
distractor1a: Zikhiqiza i-oxygen ngqo kusuka ku-carbon dioxide
distractor1c: Bahlukanisa ama-molecule amanzi ngesikhathi somjikelezo kaCalvin
question2: Yimuphi i-enzyme ekhuthaza ukufakwa kwe-carbon dioxide ngesikhathi somjikelezo kaCalvin?
question3: Yimuphi umolekyuli ohlangana ne-carbon dioxide ekuqaleni komjikelezo kaCalvin?
question4: Kusho ukuthini ukulungiswa kwekhabhoni?

question5: Ngemva kokushintshana kathathu komjikelezo kaCalvin, yiliphi i-molecule eliphuma kulo mjikelezo wokwenziwa kwama-carbohydrate?
question6: Kwenzekani kuma-molecule amaningi e-G3P akhiqizwa ngesikhathi somjikelezo kaCalvin?
answer6: Zisetshenziselwa ukuvuselela i-RuBP ukuze umjikelezo uqhubeke
question7: Kungani ezinye izitshalo ziye zashintsha izinguquko ezithuthukisa ukubanjwa kwe-carbon dioxide?

question8: Kungani amangqamuzana ezitshalo aqukethe kokubili ama-chloroplast kanye nama-mitochondria?
answer8: Izitshalo zenza kokubili i-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zazo zamandla
distractor8a: Ama-chloroplast akhiqiza i-ATP ebusuku kuphela, kuyilapho ama-mitochondria esebenza emini kuphela
distractor8b: Ama-Mitochondria enza i-photosynthesis kanti ama-chloroplast enza ukuphefumula kwamaseli
distractor8c: Zombili i-organelles zenza izinqubo ezifanayo ze-metabolic
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kanye nomjikelezo kaCalvin?
answer9: Ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kunikeza i-ATP ne-NADPH, ezisetshenziswa umjikelezo kaCalvin ukukhiqiza ama-carbohydrate
distractor9a: Umjikelezo kaCalvin ukhiqiza i-ATP ne-NADPH ezinika amandla ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni
distractor9b: Lezi zindlela ezimbili zenzeka ngokuzimela futhi azishintshisani ngama-molecule
distractor9c: Umjikelezo kaCalvin ukhipha umoya-mpilo ngqo njengomkhiqizo wawo oyinhloko
question10: Kungani i-RuBP ivuselelwa njalo ngesikhathi somjikelezo kaCalvin?
answer10: Kungumamukeli we-carbon dioxide odingekayo kumjikelezo ngamunye omusha wokulungiswa kwe-carbon
distractor10a: Iguqulwa ibe umoya-mpilo ngesikhathi somjikelezo ngamunye
distractor10c: Ithutha i-ATP kusuka ku-chloroplast iye ku-cytoplasm

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Umjikelezo KaCalvin
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Umjikelezo KaCalvin
chapterContent:
Ngemva kokuba amandla avela elangeni eguqulwe abe amandla amakhemikhali futhi agcinwe okwesikhashana kuma-molecule e-ATP ne-NADPH, iseli liba nophethiloli odingekayo ukwakha ama-molecule e-carbohydrate ukuze kugcinwe amandla isikhathi eside. Imikhiqizo yokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni, i-ATP ne-NADPH, inesikhathi sokuphila esifinyelela ezigidini zemizuzwana, kanti imikhiqizo yokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni (ama-carbohydrate nezinye izinhlobo zekhabhoni encishisiwe) ingaphila amakhulu ezigidi zeminyaka. Ama-molecule e-carbohydrate enziwe azoba nomgogodla wama-athomu ekhabhoni. Ivelaphi ikhabhoni? Ivela ku-carbon dioxide, igesi engumkhiqizo ongcolile wokuphefumula kuma-microbes, isikhunta, izitshalo, nezilwane.

 Ezitshalweni, i-carbon dioxide (CO2) ingena emaqabungeni nge-stomata, lapho isakazeka khona amabanga amafushane ngezikhala eziphakathi kwamaseli kuze kube yilapho ifika kumaseli e-mesophyll. Uma isisemaseli e-mesophyll, i-CO2 isakazeka ku-stroma ye-chloroplast—indawo yokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kwe-photosynthesis. Lokhu kusabela empeleni kunamagama amaningana ahlobene nakho. Elinye igama, umjikelezo kaCalvin, liqanjwe ngendoda eyawuthola, futhi ngoba lokhu kusabela kusebenza njengomjikelezo. Abanye bawubiza ngokuthi umjikelezo kaCalvin-Benson ukuze bafake igama lomunye usosayensi ohilelekile ekutholakaleni kwawo. Igama elidala kakhulu ukusabela okumnyama, ngoba ukukhanya akudingeki ngqo (Isithombe 8.18). Kodwa-ke, igama elithi ukusabela okumnyama lingadukisa ngoba lisho ngokungalungile ukuthi ukusabela kwenzeka ebusuku kuphela noma kuzimele ekukhanyeni, yingakho ososayensi abaningi nabafundisi bengasakusebenzisi.

 Ukusabela okuzimele ekukhanyeni komjikelezo kaCalvin kungahlelwa ngezigaba ezintathu eziyisisekelo: ukulungiswa, ukunciphisa, kanye nokuvuselelwa.
question1: Avelaphi ama-athomu e-carbon akha ama-carbohydrate ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis?
answer1: Ikhabhoni dayoksayidi (CO2)
question2: Kwenzeka kuphi ukusabela okungenakukhanya (umjikelezo kaCalvin)?
question3: I-carbon dioxide ingena ngaziphi izakhiwo eqabungeni lesitshalo?
question4: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani ama-carbohydrate ebhekwa njengama-molecule okugcina amandla esikhathi eside?
answer4: Zigcina amandla athathwe ekukhanyeni kwelanga ezibophweni eziqinile zekhabhoni-khabhoni ezingahlala isikhathi eside kakhulu
question5: Kungani igama elithi ukusabela okumnyama libhekwa njengeliphelelwe yisikhathi?
answer5: Umjikelezo kaCalvin awudingi ukukhanya ngqo, kodwa uncike ku-ATP kanye ne-NADPH ezikhiqizwa ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni
distractor5a: Umjikelezo kaCalvin wenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi sasemini
distractor5c: Umjikelezo kaCalvin udinga ubumnyama obuphelele ukuze usebenze
question6: Umjikelezo kaCalvin uqanjwe ngaye usosayensi onjani?
answer6: UMelvin Calvin
question7: Yiziphi izigaba ezintathu ezinkulu zomjikelezo kaCalvin?
answer7: Ukulungiswa, ukunciphisa, kanye nokuvuselelwa
question8: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko womjikelezo kaCalvin?
answer8: Ukuguqula i-carbon dioxide ibe ama-molecule e-carbohydrate kusetshenziswa i-ATP ne-NADPH
question9: Ngemva kokungena eqabungeni nge-stomata, i-carbon dioxide isakazeka kuphi ngaphambi kokufika ku-chloroplast?
answer9: Ngokusebenzisa izikhala eziphakathi kwamaseli kuya kumaseli e-mesophyll
question10: Kungani i-ATP ne-NADPH zibhekwa njengezithwali zamandla zesikhashana uma kuqhathaniswa nama-carbohydrate?
answer10: I-ATP ne-NADPH zingama-molecule ahlala isikhathi esifushane asetshenziswa ngokushesha, kanti ama-carbohydrate agcina amandla ukuze asetshenziswe isikhathi eside
distractor10a: I-ATP ne-NADPH ziqukethe amandla amancane kune-oxygen
distractor10b: I-ATP ne-NADPH azikwazi ukudlulisela amandla kwamanye ama-molecule
distractor10c: Ama-carbohydrate akhiqizwa kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaseli

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-Molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Umjikelezo KaCalvin | Isigaba 1: Ukuqina
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-Molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Umjikelezo KaCalvin | Isigaba 1: Ukuqina
chapterContent:
Ku-stroma, ngaphezu kwe-CO2, kunezinye izingxenye ezimbili ezikhona ukuze kuqalwe ukusabela okungenakukhanya: i-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase (RuBisCO), kanye nama-molecule amathathu e-ribulose bisphosphate (RuBP), njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 8.19. I-RuBP inama-athomu amahlanu e-carbon, ahambisana nama-phosphate amabili.

 I-RuBisCO ikhuthaza ukusabela phakathi kwe-CO2 ne-RuBP. Ku-molecule ngayinye ye-CO2 ephendula ne-RuBP eyodwa, ama-molecule amabili efomu le-compound (3-PGA). I-PGA inama-carbon amathathu kanye ne-phosphate eyodwa. Ukujika ngakunye komjikelezo kuhilela i-RuBP eyodwa kuphela kanye ne-carbon dioxide eyodwa futhi kwakha ama-molecule amabili e-3-PGA. Inani lama-athomu e-carbon lihlala lifana, njengoba ama-athomu ehamba ayokwakha izibopho ezintsha ngesikhathi sokusabela (ama-athomu ama-3 avela ku-3CO2 + ama-athomu ayi-15 avela ku-3RuBP = ama-athomu ayi-18 kuma-athomu ama-3 e-3-PGA). Le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi ukulungiswa kwekhabhoni, ngoba i-CO2 igxilile” kusukela efomini engaphili ibe ama-molecule e-organic
question1: Yimuphi i-enzyme ekhuthaza ukulungiswa kwekhabhoni ngesikhathi somjikelezo kaCalvin?
answer1: I-ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase (RuBisCO)
question2: Yimuphi umolekyuli owamukela i-carbon dioxide ngesikhathi sesigaba sokulungiswa kwe-carbon emjikelezweni kaCalvin?
question3: Zingaki ama-athomu e-carbon akhona ku-molecule eyodwa ye-RuBP?
question4: Kuma-molecule ngayinye e-carbon dioxide aqinisiwe ngesikhathi somjikelezo kaCalvin, mangaki ama-molecule e-3-phosphoglycerate (3-PGA) akhiqizwayo?
question5: Kuyini ukulungiswa kwekhabhoni?
answer5: Ukufakwa kwe-carbon dioxide engaphili kuma-molecule e-organic
question6: Kungani inani lama-athomu ekhabhoni lilondolozwa ngesikhathi sokufakwa kwekhabhoni?
answer6: Ama-athomu e-carbon ahlelwa kabusha abe ama-molecule amasha ngaphandle kokudalwa noma ukubhujiswa
distractor6c: Amanzi ahlinzeka ngama-athomu amasha ekhabhoni ngesikhathi sokulungiswa
question7: Kuphi lapho ukufakwa kwekhabhoni kwenzeka khona kumaseli ezitshalo?
answer7: I-stroma ye-chloroplast
question8: Yimuphi umolekyuli ongumkhiqizo wokuqala ozinzile owakhiwa ngemva kokufakwa kwekhabhoni?
answer8: I-3-phosphoglycerate (3-PGA)
question9: Mangaki ama-molecule e-RuBP ahlanganyela lapho ama-molecule amathathu e-carbon dioxide engena emjikelezweni weCalvin?
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 8.19. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo esiyiqiniso?
answer10: Ku-photosynthesis, amanzi kanye ne-carbon dioxide kuyizinto ezisabelayo. I-G3P kanye nomoya-mpilo kuyimikhiqizo
distractor10a: Ku-photosynthesis, umoya-mpilo, i-carbon dioxide, i-ATP kanye ne-NADPH kuyizinto ezisabelayo. I-G3P namanzi kuyimikhiqizo
distractor10b: Ku-photosynthesis, i-chlorophyll, amanzi kanye ne-carbon dioxide kuyizinto ezisabelayo. I-G3P kanye nomoya-mpilo kuyimikhiqizo
distractor10c: Ku-photosynthesis, amanzi, i-carbon dioxide, i-ATP kanye ne-NADPH kuyizinto ezisabelayo. I-RuBP kanye nomoya-mpilo kuyimikhiqizo

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-Molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Umjikelezo KaCalvin | Isigaba 2: Ukunciphisa
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-Molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Umjikelezo KaCalvin | Isigaba 2: Ukunciphisa
chapterContent: I-ATP ne-NADPH zisetshenziselwa ukuguqula ama-molecule ayisithupha e-3-PGA abe ama-molecule ayisithupha ekhemikhali ebizwa ngokuthi i-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P). Lokho kuyindlela yokunciphisa ngoba kuhilela ukuzuza kwama-electron nge-3-PGA. Khumbula ukuthi ukunciphisa kuwukuzuza kwe-electron nge-athomu noma i-molecule. Kusetshenziswa ama-molecule ayisithupha e-ATP ne-NADPH. Kwi-ATP, amandla akhishwa ngokulahlekelwa yi-athomu ye-phosphate yokugcina, iguqulwe ibe yi-ADP; kwi-NADPH, kokubili amandla kanye ne-athomu ye-hydrogen kuyalahleka, kuguqulwe kube yi-NADP+. Womabili la ma-molecule abuyela ekuphenduleni okuncike ekukhanyeni okuseduze ukuze asetshenziswe futhi aphinde anikwe amandla.
question1: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yesigaba sokunciphisa somjikelezo kaCalvin?
answer1: Ukuguqula i-3-phosphoglycerate (3-PGA) ibe yi-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P)
question2: Yimaphi ama-molecule amabili anikeza amandla kanye namandla okunciphisa adingekayo ngesikhathi sokunciphisa?
question3: Mangaki ama-molecule e-G3P akhiqizwa kuma-molecule ayisithupha e-3-PGA ngesikhathi sesigaba sokunciphisa?
question4: Kungani lesi sigaba sibizwa ngokuthi isigaba sokunciphisa?
distractor4a: I-G3P ilahlekelwa ama-electron ukuze ibe yi-3-PGA
question5: Kwenzekani ku-ATP ngesikhathi sokunciphisa?
answer5: Ilahlekelwa yiqembu le-phosphate bese iba yi-ADP
distractor5a: Ithola iqembu le-phosphate bese iba yi-AMP
question6: Kwenzekani ku-NADPH ngesikhathi sokunciphisa?
answer6: Inikela ngama-electron kanye ne-hydrogen, ibe yi-NADP+
question7: I-ADP ne-NADP+ zisetshenziswa kuphi kabusha ngemva kwesigaba sokunciphisa?
answer7: Ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni
question8: Yimuphi umolekyuli okhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokunciphisa osebenza njengesandulela sokwenziwa kwama-carbohydrate?
answer8: I-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P)
question9: Zingaki izinhlayiya ze-ATP ne-NADPH ezidingekayo ukuguqula izinhlayiya eziyisithupha ze-3-PGA zibe izinhlayiya eziyisithupha ze-G3P?
answer9: 6 ATP kanye 6 NADPH
question10: Kungani i-ATP ne-NADPH kufanele zivuselelwe njalo ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis?
answer10: Zidliwa ngesikhathi somjikelezo kaCalvin futhi kumele zigcwaliswe yizimpendulo ezixhomeke ekukhanyeni
distractor10b: Ziguqulwa zibe umoya-mpilo ngesikhathi somjikelezo kaCalvin

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-Molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Umjikelezo KaCalvin | Isigaba 3: Ukuvuselelwa
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-Molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Umjikelezo KaCalvin | Isigaba 3: Ukuvuselelwa
chapterContent: Ngokuthakazelisayo, kulesi sigaba, i-molecule eyodwa kuphela ye-G3P ephuma emjikelezweni weCalvin bese ithunyelwa kwi-cytoplasm ukuze ifake isandla ekwakhekeni kwamanye ama-com amakhilogremu adingwa yisitshalo. Ngenxa yokuthi i-G3P ethunyelwa ngaphandle kwe-chloroplast inama-athomu amathathu e-carbon, kuthatha ukujika okuthathu” komjikelezo weCalvin ukulungisa ikhabhoni eyanele yokuthumela i-G3P eyodwa. Kodwa ukujika ngakunye kwenza ama-G3P amabili, ngakho-ke ukujika okuthathu kwenza ama-G3P ayisithupha. Elinye liyathunyelwa ngaphandle kanti ama-molecule amahlanu asele e-G3P ahlala emjikelezweni futhi asetshenziselwa ukuvuselela i-RuBP, okwenza uhlelo lulungiselele i-CO2 eyengeziwe ukuthi ilungiswe. Ama-molecule amathathu e-ATP asetshenziswa kulezi zindlela zokuvuselela kabusha.
question1: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yesigaba sokuvuselelwa komjikelezo kaCalvin?
answer1: Ukuvuselela i-ribulose bisphosphate (RuBP) ukuze kwenzeke olunye umjikelezo wokulungiswa kwekhabhoni
distractor1c: Ukuhlukanisa ama-molecule amanzi abe yi-hydrogen kanye ne-oxygen
question2: Ngemva kokujikeleza kathathu komjikelezo kaCalvin, zingaki ama-molecule e-G3P akhiqizwayo?
question3: Mangaki ama-molecule e-G3P ashiya umjikelezo weCalvin ngemva kokujika kathathu?
question4: Kwenzekani kuma-molecule amahlanu asele e-G3P ngemva kokuba i-G3P eyodwa iphume emjikelezweni we-Calvin?
question5: Kungani kudingeka ukujika kathathu komjikelezo weCalvin ngaphambi kokuba i-molecule eyodwa ye-G3P ithunyelwe kwamanye amazwe?
answer5: Ama-turn amathathu alungisa ama-molecule amathathu e-carbon dioxide, akhiqiza ikhabhoni eyanele ukuze i-G3P eyodwa ihambe kanti amanye aphinde akhiqize i-RuBP
distractor5a: Kudingeka ukujika kathathu ukuze kukhiqizwe i-ATP eyanele
distractor5b: I-RuBisCO isebenza kuphela njalo ngomjikelezo wesithathu
distractor5c: I-oksijini kumele iqoqeke ngaphambi kokuba i-G3P ithunyelwe kwamanye amazwe
question6: Mangaki ama-molecule e-ATP adliwa ngesikhathi sokuvuselelwa ngemva kokushintshana kathathu komjikelezo kaCalvin?
question7: Yimuphi umolekyuli ovuselelwe phakathi nalesi sigaba owamukela i-carbon dioxide emjikelezweni olandelayo?
answer7: I-ribulose bisphosphate (RuBP)
question8: Iyini ikusasa le-molecule ye-G3P eshiya umjikelezo kaCalvin?
answer8: Isiza ekwakhiweni kwama-carbohydrate namanye ama-molecule e-organic
question9: Kungani ukuvuselelwa kwe-RuBP kubalulekile emjikelezweni kaCalvin?
answer9: Ngaphandle kwe-RuBP, i-carbon dioxide ayikwazi ukulungiswa futhi umjikelezo awukwazi ukuqhubeka
distractor9a: I-RuBP iyadingeka ukuze kuhlukaniswe amanzi ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis
distractor9b: I-RuBP ithutha i-ATP iye kulwelwesi lwe-thylakoid

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Ukugeleza Kwamandla
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Ukugeleza Kwamandla
chapterContent:
Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi into ephilayo iyibhaktheriya, isitshalo, noma isilwane, zonke izinto eziphilayo zithola amandla ngokuphula ama-molecule e-carbohydrate. Kodwa uma izitshalo zenza ama-molecule e-carbohydrate, kungani zingadinga ukuwaphula, ikakhulukazi uma kuye kwabonakala ukuthi izinto eziphila ngegesi zikhipha njengomkhiqizo ongcolile” (CO2) zisebenza njengesisekelo sokwakheka kokudla okwengeziwe ku-photosynthesis? Khumbula, izinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla ukuze zenze imisebenzi yokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, into ephilayo ingenza ukudla kwayo noma idle enye into ephilayo—noma ngabe iyiphi indlela, ukudla kusadingeka kuphulwe. Okokugcina, enkambisweni yokuphula ukudla, ebizwa ngokuthi ukuphefumula kwamaseli, ama-heterotroph akhipha amandla adingekayo futhi akhiqize imfucuza” ngesimo segesi ye-CO2.

 Emvelweni, ayikho into efana nemfucuza. I-athomu ngayinye yezinto kanye namandla iyalondolozwa, iphinda isetshenziswe ngokuphindaphindiwe. Izinto ziyashintsha noma zisuka kolunye uhlobo lwe-molecule ziye kolunye, kodwa ama-athomu azo awanyamalali. (Isithombe 8.21 siyisibonelo esichazayo sale nqubo.)

 I-CO2 ayilona uhlobo lwemfucuza njengoba nje umoya-mpilo uchitha i-photosynthesis. Zombili ziyimikhiqizo yokusabela eqhubekela kwezinye izindlela zokusabela. I-Photosynthesis imunca amandla okukhanya ukuze yakhe ama-carbohydrate kuma-chloroplast, futhi ukuphefumula kwamaseli e-aerobic kukhipha amandla ngokusebenzisa umoya-mpilo ukuze kugaywe ama-carbohydrate ku-cytoplasm kanye ne-mitochondria. Zombili lezi zinqubo zisebenzisa amaketanga okuthutha ama-electron ukuze zibambe amandla adingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe ezinye izindlela zokusabela. Lezi zinqubo ezimbili zamandla, i-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli, zisebenza ngokuvumelana kwezinto eziphilayo, okujikelezayo ukuvumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zithole amandla asekela impilo avela ezigidini zamakhilomitha kude enkanyezini evuthayo abantu abayibiza ngokuthi ilanga.

 I-Photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwe-aerobic kuhlobene ngezindlela ezibalulekile. Ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis, izitshalo zithatha i-carbon dioxide namanzi. I-molecule yamanzi iyahlukaniswa, umoya-mpilo ukhishwa emoyeni, bese i-carbon dioxide isetshenziselwa ukwakha ama-carbohydrate. Ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwe-aerobic, izinto eziphilayo zithatha amanzi kanye nomoya-mpilo ukuze ziphefumule futhi zikhiqize i-carbon dioxide.
question1: Kungani izitshalo ziphefumula amaseli yize zikhiqiza ama-carbohydrate nge-photosynthesis?
answer1: Izitshalo kumele ziphule ama-carbohydrate ukuze zikhiphe amandla adingekayo ukuze kusebenze izinqubo zamaseli
distractor1b: Izitshalo zisebenzisa ukuphefumula kuphela ukukhiqiza umoya-mpilo
distractor1c: Izitshalo azikwazi ukugcina ama-carbohydrate ukuze zisetshenziswe kamuva
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wokuphefumula kwamaseli?
question3: Yisiphi isithako esikhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaseli esisebenza njenge-reactant ye-photosynthesis?
question4: Yimuphi umuthi okhishwa ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis odingekayo ukuze kuphefumulelwe amaseli e-aerobic?
question5: Yisiphi isimiso esichaza ukuthi kungani izinto zisetshenziswa kabusha njalo ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer5: Ama-athomu ayalondolozwa futhi ahlala ejikeleza phakathi kwama-molecule ahlukene
distractor5b: Ukuphefumula kubhubhisa ama-athomu e-carbon ngemva kokukhiqizwa kwe-ATP
distractor5c: Ama-athomu e-oxygen kuphela aphinde asetshenziswe ezinhlelweni eziphilayo
question6: I-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwe-aerobic kuhlobene kanjani?
answer6: Imikhiqizo yenqubo eyodwa isebenza njengezinto ezisabelayo kwenye, zakha umjikelezo webhayoloji
distractor6a: Zombili lezi zinqubo zenzeka kuphela kuma-chloroplast
distractor6b: Zombili lezi zinqubo zidla umoya-mpilo futhi zikhiphe i-carbon dioxide
distractor6c: Zombili lezi zinqubo zikhiqiza i-ATP nge-glycolysis yodwa
question7: Yimaphi ama-molecule athathwa yizitshalo ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis?
answer7: I-carbon dioxide namanzi
question8: Uyini umthombo wamandla agcinwe kuma-carbohydrate?
answer8: Ukukhanya kwelanga
question9: Kungani i-carbon dioxide ingabhekwa njengomkhiqizo wangempela wemfucuza emvelweni?
answer9: Isetshenziswa kabusha ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis ukukhiqiza ama-carbohydrate
distractor9c: Izitshalo ziwuguqula ngokushesha ube umoya-mpilo ngaphandle kwe-photosynthesis
question10: Umhlaba wawungenawo umoya-mpilo emkhathini wawo kuyo yonke ingxenye enkulu yomlando wawo, ngisho nangemva kokuba impilo eMhlabeni isiqalile. Nokho, wawune-carbon dioxide. Lokhu kusikiselani ngesikhathi izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-photosynthesis zavela, uma kuqhathaniswa nezinto eziphilayo ezingezona eze-photosynthesis, futhi ngani?
answer10: Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis zavela ngemva kwezinto eziphilayo ezingezona eze-photosynthesis, ngoba kwakungekho oxygen eyayikhona emkhathini lapho impilo iqala.
distractor10a: Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis zavela ngaphambi kwezinto eziphilayo ezingezona eze-photosynthesis, ngoba kwakungekho umoya-mpilo owawukhona emkhathini lapho impilo iqala.
distractor10b: Izinto eziphilayo ezingezona eze-photosynthesis zavela ngaphambi kwezinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis, ngoba kwakungekho oxygen emkhathini lapho kuqala ukuphila.
distractor10c: Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis zavela ngaphambi kwezinto eziphilayo ezingezona eze-photosynthesis, ngoba kwakungekho carbon dioxide emkhathini lapho kuqala ukuphila.
question11: Bheka uMfanekiso 8.20. Yisiphi isenzakalo esilandelayo esihlotshaniswa nokuthuthukiswa kwe-oxygenic photosynthesis?
answer11: Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis zaqala ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezimbili ze-photosynthesis esikhundleni seyodwa
distractor11a: Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis zaqala ukusebenzisa i-NADPH ne-ATP njengomthombo wamandla
distractor11b: Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis zavela kubhaktheriya oneseli elilodwa zaba izitshalo ezinamaseli amaningi
distractor11c: Izinto eziphilayo ze-photosynthesis zaqala ukusebenzisa ukusabela kokukhanya kanye nokusabela okumnyama

 uhlelo lwezithombe I
inhlanganisela ye-pigment kanye ne-protein ehlanganisiwe ezinhlayiyeni ze-thylakoid ezisebenzisa amandla okukhanya ukuthutha ama-electron kusuka ku-plastocyanin kuya ku-NADP+ (encishiswa ibe yi-NADPH enkambisweni)

 uhlelo lwezithombe II
inhlanganisela ye-protein kanye ne-pigment ehlanganisiwe ezinhlayiyeni ze-thylakoid ezithutha ama-electron kusuka emanzini kuya ochungechungeni lokuthuthwa kwama-electron; i-oxygen ingumkhiqizo we-PSII

 i-pigment
i-molecule ekwazi ukumunca amaza athile okukhanya futhi ibonise okunye (okubangela umbala wayo)

 isamukeli se-electron esiyinhloko
i-pigment noma enye i-molecule ephilayo esikhungweni sokuphendula esamukela i-electron enikwe amandla kusuka esikhungweni sokuphendula

 isikhungo sokusabela
inkimbinkimbi yama-molecule e-chlorophyll namanye ama-molecule e-organic ahlanganiswe eduze kwe-pair ekhethekile yama-molecule e-chlorophyll kanye ne-primary electron acceptor; ekwazi ukubhekana ne-oxidation kanye nokunciphisa

 ukunciphisa
ukutholakala kwama-electron nge-athomu noma i-molecule

 i-spectrophotometer
ithuluzi elingalinganisa ukukhanya okudlulisiwe futhi libale ukumuncwa

 i-stoma
ukuvulwa okulawula ukushintshaniswa kwegesi kanye nokuhwamuka kwamanzi phakathi kwamaqabunga nendawo ezungezile, ngokuvamile okutholakala ngaphansi kwamaqabunga

 i-stroma
isikhala esigcwele uketshezi esizungeze i-grana ngaphakathi kwe-chloroplast lapho kwenzeka khona ukusabela kwe-photosynthesis okungenakukhanya

 i-thylakoid
isakhiwo esinomumo we-disc, esiboshwe yi-membrane ngaphakathi kwe-chloroplast lapho kwenzeka khona ukusabela kwe-photosynthesis okuhambisana nokukhanya; izinqwaba zama-thylakoid zibizwa ngokuthi i-grana

 i-lumen ye-thylakoid
isikhala samanzi esiboshwe yi-membrane ye-thylakoid lapho ama-proton eqoqana khona ngesikhathi sokuthuthwa kwama-electron aqhutshwa ukukhanya

 ubude be-wavelength
ibanga phakathi kwamaphuzu alandelanayo esikhundla esilinganayo (ama-crests amabili noma ama-trough amabili) wegagasi emelelwaneni elinemifanekiso; ngokulingana okuphambene namandla emisebe

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | Isifinyezo Sesahluko 8.5
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 8. I-Photosynthesis | Isifinyezo Sesahluko 8.5
chapterContent:
8.1 Ukubuka Konke Nge-Photosynthesis
Inqubo ye-photosynthesis yashintsha impilo eMhlabeni. Ngokusebenzisa amandla avela elangeni, ukuvela kwe-photosynthesis kwavumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zifinyelele amandla amaningi kakhulu. Ngenxa ye-photosynthesis, izinto eziphilayo zathola amandla anele azenza zakha izakhiwo ezintsha futhi zafinyelela ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo okubonakalayo namuhla.

 Izinto eziphilayo ezithile kuphela, ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-photoautotrophs, ezingenza i-photosynthesis; zidinga ukuba khona kwe-chlorophyll, i-pigment ekhethekile emunca izingxenye ezithile ze-spectrum ebonakalayo futhi ingabamba amandla avela elangeni. I-Photosynthesis isebenzisa i-carbon dioxide namanzi ukuhlanganisa ama-molecule e-carbohydrate nokukhipha umoya-mpilo njengomkhiqizo ongcolile emkhathini. Ama-autotrophs e-Eukaryotic, njengezitshalo kanye ne-algae, anama-organelle abizwa ngokuthi ama-chloroplast lapho kwenzeka khona i-photosynthesis, futhi isitashi siyaqongelela. Kuma-prokaryotes, njenge-cyanobacteria, inqubo ayitholakali kalula futhi yenzeka ngaphakathi kwe-membrane egoqiwe, izandiso ze-plasma membrane, kanye ne-cytoplasm.

 8.2 Ukusabela Okuxhomeke Ekukhanyeni Kwe-Photosynthesis
Ama-pigment engxenye yokuqala ye-photosynthesis, ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni, amunca amandla avela elangeni. I-photon ishaya ama-pigment e-antenna e-photosystem II ukuze iqalise i-photosynthesis. Amandla aya esikhungweni sokusabela esiqukethe i-chlorophyll a bese eya ku-electron transport chain, epompa ama-ion e-hydrogen angene ngaphakathi kwe-thylakoid. Lesi senzo sakha ukugcwala okuphezulu kwama-ion. Ama-ion ageleza nge-ATP synthase nge-chemiosmosis ukuze akhe ama-molecule e-ATP, asetshenziselwa ukwakheka kwama-molecule kashukela esigabeni sesibili se-photosynthesis. I-Photosystem I imunca i-photon yesibili, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwe-molecule ye-NADPH, elinye amandla kanye nesithwali samandla esinciphisayo se-reactions ezimele ukukhanya.

 8.3 Ukusebenzisa Ukukhanya Ukwenza Ama-Molecule Ezinto Eziphilayo
Ukusebenzisa abathwali bamandla akhiwe ezinyathelweni zokuqala ze-photosynthesis, ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni, noma umjikelezo kaCalvin, kuthatha i-CO2 emvelweni. I-enzyme, i-RuBisCO, ivuselela ukusabela nge-CO2 kanye nenye i-molecule, i-RuBP. Ngemva kwemijikelezo emithathu, i-molecule ye-G3P enamakhabhoni amathathu ishiya umjikelezo ukuze ibe yingxenye ye-molecule yama-carbohydrate. Ama-molecule asele e-G3P ahlala emjikelezweni ukuze avuselelwe abe yi-RuBP, ezobe isilungele ukusabela nge-CO2 eyengeziwe. I-Photosynthesis yakha umjikelezo wamandla ngenqubo yokuphefumula kwamaseli. Izitshalo zidinga kokubili i-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula ukuze zikwazi ukusebenza kokubili ekukhanyeni nasebumnyameni, futhi zikwazi ukuguqula ama-metabolites abalulekile. Ngakho-ke, izitshalo ziqukethe ama-chloroplast kanye nama-mitochondria.
question1: Yiziphi izingxenye ezilandelayo ezingasetshenziswa yizitshalo kanye ne-cyanobacteria ukwenza i-photosynthesis?

answer2: Ama-chemoautotrophs akhipha amandla kumakhemikhali angaphili amakhilogremu

distractor2b: Ama-photoautotroph akhetha uhlangothi oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lwe-spectrum yokukhanya okubonakalayo
distractor2c: Ama-photoautotrophs enza i-glucose, kanti ama-chemoautotrophs enza i-galactose

distractor13c: Ibanga ukusuka emgqonyeni kuya esiqongweni segagasi

question15: Yikuphi ukulandelana kokuguqulwa kwama-molecule okulungile kumjikelezo kaCalvin?

answer16: Ukuguqulwa kwe-CO2 ibe yinhlanganisela yezinto eziphilayo

answer19: Amagciwane amathumbu

answer20: Ikhuthaza ukusabela phakathi kwe-CO2 ne-ribulose bisphosphate (RuBP)
distractor20b: Ivuselela ukusabela okuvuselela i-RuBP
question21: Uyini umkhiqizo womjikelezo kaCalvin?
answer21: I-glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate
answer22: I-ATP ne-NADPH ziyizinhlobo zamandla amakhemikhali akhiqizwa yimiphumela exhomeke ekukhanyeni ezosetshenziswa ekuphenduleni okuzimele kokukhanya okukhiqiza ushukela.
distractor22a: I-ATP ne-NADPH ziyizinhlobo zamandla amakhemikhali akhiqizwa yimiphumela yokukhanya ezimele, ukuze zisetshenziswe emiphumeleni exhomeke ekukhanyeni ekhiqiza ushukela.
distractor22b: I-ATP ne-NADPH ziyizinhlobo zamandla amakhemikhali akhiqizwa yimiphumela exhomeke ekukhanyeni ezosetshenziswa ekuphenduleni okuzimele kokukhanya okukhiqiza amaprotheni
distractor22c: I-ATP ne-NADPH ziyizinhlobo zamandla amakhemikhali akhiqizwa yimiphumela exhomeke ekukhanyeni ukuze isetshenziswe emiphumeleni ezimele yokukhanya esebenzisa ushukela njengezinto ezisabelayo.
question23: Thola izigaba ze-photosynthesis kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwalezo zigaba. Ukusebenzisa lolu lwazi, uyini umphumela ophelele wokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni ku-photosynthesis?
answer23: Ama-molecule e-NADPH ne-ATP akhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni futhi asetshenziselwa ukunika amandla ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni
distractor23a: Ama-molecule e-NADPH ne-ATP akhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokusabela okungenakukhanya futhi asetshenziselwa ukunika amandla ukusabela okungenakukhanya
distractor23b: Ushukela kanye ne-ATP kukhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni futhi kusetshenziselwa ukunika amandla ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni
distractor23c: I-Carbon dioxide kanye ne-NADPH kukhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokusabela okungenakukhanya futhi kusetshenziselwa ukunika amandla ukusabela okungenakukhanya
question24: Bheka uMfanekiso 8.22. Hlola umfanekiso we-photosynthesis equation. I-equation ihlobana kanjani ne-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli, futhi yikuphi ukuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinqubo ezimbili?
answer24: I-Photosynthesis isebenzisa amandla ukwakha ama-carbohydrate, kuyilapho ukuphefumula kwamaseli kugaya ama-carbohydrate
distractor24a: I-Photosynthesis isebenzisa amandla ukugaya ama-carbohydrate, kuyilapho ukuphefumula kwamaseli kwakha ama-carbohydrate
distractor24b: I-Photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli kusebenzisa i-carbon dioxide namanzi ukukhiqiza ama-carbohydrate
distractor24c: I-Photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli kokubili kuguqula ama-carbohydrate ukuze akhiqize i-carbon dioxide namanzi
question25: Amandla avela elangeni athuthwa kanjani ngaphakathi kwama-chloroplast? Sekela impendulo yakho ngemininingwane yezinqubo ezihilelekile
answer25: Uma ama-photon eshaya i-photosystem (PS) II, ama-pigment adlulisela amandla okukhanya ku-chlorophyll, ama-molecule avusa ama-electron, abese edluliselwa ku-chain transport electron. I-cytochrome complex idlulisela ama-proton ku-membrane ye-thylakoid futhi idlulise ama-electron kusuka ku-PS-II kuya ku-PS-I. Imikhiqizo yokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni isetshenziselwa ukunika amandla umjikelezo weCalvin ukukhiqiza i-glucose.
distractor25a: Uma ama-photon eshaya i-photosystem (PS) I, ama-pigment adlulisela amandla okukhanya ku-chlorophyll, ama-molecule avusa ama-electron, abese edluliselwa ku-chain transport chain. I-cytochrome complex ibe isidlulisela ama-proton ku-membrane ye-thylakoid bese idlulisela ama-electron kusuka ku-PS-II kuya ku-PS-I. Imikhiqizo yokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni isetshenziselwa ukunika amandla umjikelezo weCalvin ukukhiqiza i-glucose.
distractor25b: Uma ama-photon eshaya i-photosystem (PS) II, ama-pigment adlulisela amandla okukhanya ku-chlorophyll, ama-molecule avuselela ama-electron, abese edluliselwa ku-chain transport electron. I-cytochrome complex idlulisela ama-proton ku-membrane ye-thylakoid futhi idlulise ama-electron kusuka ku-PS-I kuya ku-PS-II. Imikhiqizo yokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni isetshenziselwa ukunika amandla umjikelezo weCalvin ukukhiqiza i-glucose.
distractor25c: Uma ama-photon eshaya i-photosystem (PS) II, ama-pigment adlulisela amandla okukhanya ku-chlorophyll, ama-molecule avusa ama-electron, abese edluliselwa ku-chain transport chain. I-cytochrome complex idlulisela ama-proton ku-membrane ye-thylakoid futhi idlulise ama-electron kusuka ku-PS II kuya ku-PS I. Imikhiqizo yokusabela okungenakukhanya isetshenziselwa ukunika amandla umjikelezo weCalvin ukukhiqiza i-glucose.
question26: Bheka uMfanekiso 8.11. Buyekeza izinhlobo eziningi zemisebe kagesi njengoba kuboniswe ku-spectrum ye-electromagnetic. Kungani amaza okukhanya kwe-X-ray kanye ne-ultraviolet (UV) kuyingozi ezicutshini eziphilayo?
answer26: Ngenxa yokuthi imisebe ye-UV kanye ne-X-ray kungamagagasi anamandla aphezulu, angena ezicutshini ngaleyo ndlela alimaze amangqamuzana
distractor26a: Ngenxa yokuthi imisebe ye-UV kanye ne-X-ray kungamagagasi amade, angena ezicutshini bese elimaza amaseli.
distractor26b: Ngenxa yokuthi imisebe ye-UV kanye ne-X-ray kungamagagasi anamandla amancane, awakwazi ukungena ezicutshini ngaleyo ndlela alimaze amangqamuzana
distractor26c: Ngenxa yokuthi imisebe ye-UV kanye ne-X-ray kungamagagasi aphansi, angangena ezicutshini ngaleyo ndlela alimaze amangqamuzana
question27: Uma isitshalo besizochayeka ekukhanyeni okubomvu kuphela, ingabe i-photosynthesis ibingaba khona?
distractor27b: I-Photosynthesis kungenzeka kuphela ngokukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
question28: Usebenzisa ukuqonda kwakho ukuthi izinqubo ze-photosynthesis zixhumene kanjani, khetha incazelo engcono kakhulu yendlela yokudlulisa ama-electron kusuka ku-photosynthesis II kuya ku-photosynthesis I ekuphenduleni okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni
answer28: Ngemva kokuhlukanisa amanzi ku-PS-II, ama-electron anamandla aphezulu alethwa ngeketanga lokuthuthwa kwama-electron e-chloroplast ku-PS-I
distractor28a: Ngemva kokuhlukanisa amanzi ku-PS-I, ama-electron anamandla aphezulu alethwa ngeketanga lokuthuthwa kwama-electron e-chloroplast aye ku-PS-II.
distractor28b: Ngemva kokusabela kwe-photosynthesis, imikhiqizo ekhishwe njenge-glucose isiza ekudlulisweni kwama-electron kusuka ku-PS-II kuya ku-PS-I
distractor28c: Ngemva kokuqedwa kokusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni, ama-electron adluliselwa kusuka ku-PS-II kuya ku-PS-I
question29: Ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni kwakho inqubo ye-photosynthesis, bikezela ukuthi kuzokwenzekani eqabungeni lesitshalo elilahlekelwa yi-CO2 ngokushesha okukhulu.
answer29: I-Photosynthesis eqabungeni izoncipha noma mhlawumbe iyeke
distractor29a: Lesi senzakalo ngeke sibe nomthelela esilinganisweni se-photosynthesis eqabungeni
distractor29c: I-Photosynthesis eqabungeni izoqala yehle bese ikhula
question30: Ikhabhoni, ngesimo se-CO2, kumele ithathwe emoyeni bese inamathiselwa ku-molecule ekhona ephilayo emjikelezweni we-Calvin. Ngakho-ke, ikhabhoni iboshelwe ku-molecule. Imikhiqizo yomjikelezo ivela kuphela ngenxa yekhabhoni eyengeziwe. Yimiphi imikhiqizo yomjikelezo we-Calvin futhi yini evuselelwa kabusha?
answer30: Umkhiqizo womjikelezo weCalvin yi-glyceraldehyde-3 phosphate kanti i-RuBP iyavuselelwa
distractor30a: Umkhiqizo womjikelezo weCalvin yi-glyceraldehyde-3 phosphate kanti i-RuBisCO ivuselelwa kabusha
distractor30b: Umkhiqizo womjikelezo kaCalvin uyi-molecule ye-3-PGA kanye ne-glyceraldehyde-3 phosphate evuselelwa kabusha
distractor30c: Umkhiqizo womjikelezo kaCalvin yi-glyceraldehyde-3 phosphate futhi umoya-mpilo uyavuselelwa
question31: Ukungatholakali kwamanzi ngokwanele kungenza izitshalo zingakwazi ukwenza i-photosynthesis zibe sengozini. Izitshalo zasehlane zikuvimbela kanjani ukulahleka kwamanzi okunjalo lapho zishiswa kakhulu?
answer31: Ngokusebenzisa i-CAM photosynthesis nangokuvula izikhala zamathumbu ebusuku
distractor31a: Ngokusebenzisa i-CAM photosynthesis kanye nokuvala izikhala zamathumbu ebusuku
distractor31b: Ngokusebenzisa i-CAM photosynthesis nangokugcina izikhala zamathumbu zivaliwe ngaso sonke isikhathi
distractor31c: Ngokugwema i-CAM photosynthesis nangokugcina izikhala zamathumbu zivaliwe ebusuku
question32: Izilwane ezidla inyama, njengezingonyama, zithembele ku-photosynthesis ukuze ziphile. Uma ucabangela izinto eziphilayo kanye nezinqubo ezihilelekile ekwenzeni i-photosynthesis, nikeza isizathu sokuchaza ukuthi kungani kunjalo.
answer32: Izisulu zamabhubesi ngokuvamile ziyizilwane ezidla uhlaza, ezincike kuma-autotrophs
distractor32a: Izisulu zamabhubesi ngokuvamile ziyizilwane ezidla uhlaza, ezincike kuma-heterotrophs
distractor32b: Izisulu zamabhubesi ngokuvamile ziyizilwane ezincane ezidla inyama, ezincike ezintweni eziphilayo ezingezona eze-photosynthetic
distractor32c: Izisulu zamabhubesi ngokuvamile ziyi-autotrophs, ezincike kwezinye i-autotrophs
question33: Bheka uMfanekiso 8.19. Chaza ukusabela komjikelezo kaCalvin njengoba kuboniswe esithombeni. Kungani kuthatha ukujika kathathu komjikelezo kaCalvin ukukhiqiza i-G3P, umkhiqizo wokuqala we-photosynthesis?
answer33: Kuthatha izikhathi ezintathu ukulungisa ikhabhoni eyanele ukuthumela i-molecule eyodwa ye-G3P
distractor33a: Kuthatha izikhathi ezintathu ukulungisa umoya-mpilo owanele ukuthumela i-molecule eyodwa ye-G3P
distractor33b: Kuthatha izikhathi ezintathu ukukhiqiza i-RuBisCO njengomkhiqizo wokugcina
distractor33c: Kuthatha izikhathi ezintathu ukukhiqiza i-ATP ne-NADPH ukuze kulungiswe i-G3P
question34: I-Photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli kutholakala kulo lonke izwe le-eukaryotic. Ziyahambisana ngoba ngayinye isebenzisa imikhiqizo yenye inqubo. Khumbula izingxenye nezinqubo ezihilelekile endleleni ngayinye. Yiziphi kulezi ezilandelayo ezihlanganyela izindlela ezimbili?
question35: Hlola umqondo wokuthi kukhona ukhokho olufanayo lwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo. Yibuphi ubufakazi obukhona bokuthi ukuvela kwe-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli kusekela lo mqondo?
answer35: Zonke izinto eziphilayo ziphefumula amaseli zisebenzisa umoya-mpilo kanye ne-glucose, okukhiqizwa yi-photosynthesis
distractor35a: Zonke izinto eziphilayo ziphefumula ngamaseli zisebenzisa i-carbon dioxide kanye ne-glucose, okukhiqizwa yi-photosynthesis
distractor35b: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zenza ukuphefumula kwamangqamuzana zisebenzisa umoya-mpilo kanye nama-lipid, akhiqizwa yi-photosynthesis
distractor35c: Zonke izinto eziphilayo ziphefumula ngamaseli zisebenzisa i-carbon dioxide nama-lipid, akhiqizwa yi-photosynthesis
question36: Bheka uMfanekiso 8.23. Faka ilebula efanele ezingxenyeni ezibonisiwe ze-chloroplast
answer36: A. ulwelwesi lwangaphandle, i-B. stroma, i-C. granum, i-D. thylakoid, i-E. ulwelwesi lwangaphakathi
distractor36a: A. stroma, B. ulwelwesi lwangaphandle, C. granum, D. thylakoid, E. ulwelwesi lwangaphakathi
distractor36b: A. ulwelwesi lwangaphandle, i-B. stroma, i-C. granum, i-D. ulwelwesi lwangaphakathi, i-E. thylakoid
distractor36c: A. stroma, B. ulwelwesi lwangaphandle, C. ulwelwesi lwangaphakathi, D. granum, E. thylakoid
question37: Qhathanisa futhi uqhathanise izakhiwo kanye nezindlela ezihilelekile kokubili ku-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli. Yiziphi izici kanye nokusabela kwamaseli okufanayo kuzo zombili izinqubo?
answer37: Zombili izinqubo ziqukethwe kuma-organelles ane-membrane ephindwe kabili, futhi zombili zisebenzisa inguqulo ye-cytochrome complex
distractor37a: Zombili izinqubo ziqukethwe kuma-organelles ane-membrane eyodwa, futhi zombili zisebenzisa inguqulo ye-cytochrome complex
distractor37b: Zombili lezi zinqubo ziqukethwe kuma-organelles ane-membrane ephindwe kabili, futhi akukho neyodwa esebenzisa inguqulo ye-cytochrome complex
distractor37c: Zombili lezi zinqubo ziqukethwe kuma-organelles ane-membrane eyodwa, futhi akukho neyodwa esebenzisa inguqulo ye-cytochrome complex
question38: Cabanga ngezinqubo ezihilelekile ku-photosynthesis kanye nezindawo lapho zenzeka khona. Khetha isitatimende esenza kube yisizathu esihle kakhulu sokuthi kungani ukusabela kwe-photosynthesis okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kwenzeka ku-thylakoid.
answer38: I-cytochrome complex idinga i-membrane ukuze i-chemiosmosis yenzeke
distractor38a: I-Photosystem I inamathele kulwelwesi, kodwa i-photosystem II ayinamathele kulwelwesi
distractor38b: Ukusabela okuxhomeke ekukhanyeni kuncike ekubeni khona kwe-carbon dioxide
question39: Izindlela ze-metabolic zikhiqiza futhi zisebenzisa amandla ukwenza ukusabela kwazo. Ukuze unikeze ubufakazi balesi simangalo, phendula okulandelayo: Umjikelezo kaCalvin usiza kanjani ukusebenzisa, ukugcina, nokusebenzisa amandla endleleni yawo?
answer39: Umjikelezo weCalvin usebenzisa amandla ngesimo se-ATP engu-6 kanye ne-NADPH engu-6 esetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza ama-molecule e-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (GA3P). Lawa agcina amandla athathwe ku-photosynthesis. Umjikelezo usebenzisa la mandla ukuvuselela i-RuBP.
distractor39a: Umjikelezo weCalvin usebenzisa amandla ngesimo se-ATP engu-6 kanye ne-NADPH engu-6 esetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza ama-molecule e-fructose 3-phosphate (F3P). Lawa agcina amandla athathwe ku-photosynthesis. Umjikelezo usebenzisa la mandla ukuvuselela i-RuBP.
distractor39b: Umjikelezo weCalvin usebenzisa amandla ngesimo se-ATP engu-3 kanye ne-NADPH engu-3 esetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza ama-molecule e-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (GA3P). Lawa agcina amandla athathwe ku-photosynthesis. Umjikelezo usebenzisa la mandla ukuvuselela i-RuBP.
distractor39c: Umjikelezo weCalvin usebenzisa amandla ngesimo se-ATP engu-6 kanye ne-NADPH engu-3 esetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza ama-molecule e-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (GA3P). Lawa agcina amandla athathwe ku-photosynthesis. Umjikelezo usebenzisa la mandla ukuvuselela i-RuBP.
question40: Ngokusekelwe kuMfanekiso 8.18, yini engabangela ukuthi isitshalo siphelelwe yi-NADP?
answer40: Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kungavimbela i-H+ kanye ne-NADP+ ekwakheni i-NADPH
question41: Cabanga ngobudlelwano phakathi kwezinga lokushisa kanye ne-photosynthesis. Njengoba amazinga okushisa enyuka, amagesi anjenge-CO2 asakazeka ngokushesha. Ngenxa yalokho, amaqabunga ezitshalo azolahlekelwa yi-CO2 ngesivinini esisheshayo kunokuvamile. Uma inani lokukhanya elifinyelela eqabungeni kanye nenani lamanzi atholakalayo kwanele, bikezela ukuthi lokhu kulahlekelwa yigesi kuzoyithinta kanjani i-photosynthesis eqabungeni.
answer41: Ukulahlekelwa amagesi, ikakhulukazi i-CO2, kuzothinta i-photosynthesis eqabungeni, njengoba umjikelezo weCalvin uzoncipha futhi mhlawumbe ume ngenxa yokunganeli kwekhabhoni ukuze ilungiswe ohlelweni.
distractor41a: Ukulahlekelwa amagesi, ikakhulukazi i-CO2, ngeke kuthinte i-photosynthesis eqabungeni, njengoba kusekhona amanzi nokukhanya okwanele okuzovumela umjikelezo weCalvin ukuthi uqhubeke kahle.
distractor41b: Ukulahlekelwa amagesi, ikakhulukazi i-CO2, kuzothinta i-photosynthesis eqabungeni, njengoba umjikelezo weCalvin uzosebenza ngokushesha ukuze ubuyisele ukulahleka
distractor41c: Ukulahlekelwa amagesi, ikakhulukazi i-CO2, ngeke kuthinte i-photosynthesis eqabungeni, njengoba izindawo zokugcina ze-CO2 eqabungeni zingasetshenziswa ngalezo zikhathi.
question42: Izingxenye ze-cytochrome complex ezihilelekile ku-photosynthesis zinikela kanjani eketangeni lokuthuthwa kwama-electron?
answer42: I-Plastoquinone ne-plastocyanine zenza ukusabela kwe-redox okuvumela i-electron ukuthi ihambe phansi kochungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron iye kwi-Photosystem I
distractor42a: I-Photosystem I ivusa i-electron njengoba ihambisa phansi kweketanga lokuthuthwa kwe-electron iye kwi-Photosystem II
distractor42b: I-ATP synthase isusa i-electron njengoba ihambisa phansi kweketanga lokuthuthwa kwama-electron iye ku-Photosystem I
distractor42c: I-RuBisCO ivuselela i-electron njengoba ihambisa phansi kweketanga lokuthuthwa kwe-electron iye kwi-Photosystem II
question43: Xoxa ngokuthi ama-membrane kuma-chloroplast anikela kanjani emisebenzini ebalulekile yama-organelle
answer43: I-membrane yangaphakathi iqukethe amakhemikhali adingekayo kuphela emjikelezweni weCalvin. I-membrane ye-thylakoid iqukethe izingxenye ze-reaction ezixhomeke ekukhanyeni, i-photosystems I kanye ne-II, kanye ne-enzyme i-NADP+ reductase.
distractor43a: I-membrane yangaphakathi iqukethe amakhemikhali adingekayo emjikelezweni weCalvin kanye nezingxenye ze-reaction ezincike ekukhanyeni. I-membrane ye-thylakoid iqukethe i-photosystems I kanye ne-II, kanye ne-enzyme i-NADP+ reductase.
distractor43b: I-membrane yangaphakathi iqukethe izingxenye ze-reaction ezixhomeke ekukhanyeni kanye ne-photosystems I kanye ne-II. I-membrane ye-thylakoid iqukethe amakhemikhali adingekayo emjikelezweni we-Calvin kanye ne-enzyme i-NADP+ reductase.
distractor43c: I-membrane yangaphakathi iqukethe amakhemikhali adingekayo emjikelezweni weCalvin, izingxenye ze-reaction ezixhomeke ekukhanyeni kanye ne-photosystems I kanye ne-II. I-membrane ye-thylakoid iqukethe i-enzyme i-NADP+ reductase
question44: Uma i-spectrum yokumuncwa kwama-pigment e-photosynthetic ibikhawulelwe engxenyeni eluhlaza ye-spectrum, yimuphi umbala noma ama-pigment abengathinteka kakhulu?
question45: Chaza ukudlula kwamandla avela ekukhanyeni kuze kube yilapho ebanjwa ku-primary electron acceptor
answer45: Ama-molecule e-chlorophyll kuma-photosystem ayavuselelwa futhi adlulisele amandla ku-primary electron acceptor lapho amandla asetshenziselwa ukuvusa ama-electron ekuqhekekeni kwamanzi.
distractor45a: I-Chlorophyll, ama-molecule asezinhlelweni ze-photosystem, ayavuselelwa futhi adlulisele amandla ku-primary electron acceptor lapho amandla asetshenziselwa khona ukuvusa ama-electron ekuqhekekeni kwamanzi.
distractor45b: Ama-molecule e-chlorophyll b kuma-photosystem ayavuselelwa futhi adlulisele amandla ku-primary electron acceptor lapho amandla asetshenziselwa ukuvusa ama-electron ekuqhekekeni kwamanzi.
distractor45c: Ama-molecule e-chlorophyll kuma-photosystem amunca ukukhanya futhi ajabule ku-primary electron acceptor lapho amandla asetshenziswa khona ukuvusa ama-electron ekuqhekekeni kwamanzi.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Cabanga ukuthi impilo ibiyoba njani ukube wena nabantu abakuzungezile beningakwazi ukuxhumana. Ubungeke ukwazi ukuveza izifiso zakho, futhi ubungeke ukwazi ukubuza imibuzo ukuze uthole okwengeziwe ngendawo yakho. Ukuhleleka komphakathi kuncike ekuxhumaneni phakathi kwabantu ngabanye; ngaphandle kokuxhumana, umphakathi ubuzoqhekeka.

 Njengabantu, kubalulekile ukuthi iseli lisebenzisane nendawo yalo. Lokhu kuyiqiniso kungakhathaliseki ukuthi liyisilwane esisodwa noma elinye lamaseli amaningi akha into enkulu. Ukuze aphendule ezintweni zangaphandle, amaseli athuthukise izindlela eziyinkimbinkimbi zokuxhumana ezingathola umlayezo, zidlulisele ulwazi kulo lonke ulwelwesi lwe-plasma, futhi zikhiqize izinguquko ngaphakathi kweseli ngokuphendula umlayezo. Ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi, amaseli athumela futhi amukele imiyalezo yamakhemikhali njalo ukuze axhumanise izenzo zezitho ezikude, izicubu, namaseli.

 Ngenkathi isidingo sokuxhumana kwamaseli ezintweni eziphilayo ezinkulu sibonakala sisobala, ngisho nezinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa ziyaxhumana. Amaseli emvubelo abonisana ukuze asize ekuzaleni. Ezinye izinhlobo zamabhaktheriya zihlela izenzo zazo ukuze zakhe izakhiwo ezinkulu ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-biofilms (Isithombe 9.18) noma zihlele ukukhiqizwa kobuthi ukuze kususwe izinto eziphilayo ezincintisanayo. Amandla amangqamuzana okuxhumana ngezibonakaliso zamakhemikhali aqala emaselini angawodwa futhi ayebalulekile ekuthuthukisweni kwezinto eziphilayo eziningi.

 Ukubonakaliswa kwamaseli kubalulekile ekusindeni kwezinto eziphilayo. Isibonelo, izimpawu zamakhemikhali zitshela amangqamuzana ukuthi kufanele enze nini ama-hormone njenge-insulin. Ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli nakho kuncike ezibonakalisweni zamakhemikhali. Lapho izimpawu zamakhemikhali zingasebenzi kahle, amangqamuzana angahlukana ngokungalawuleki, akhe izimila ezinomdlavuza. Ososayensi basanda kuthola indlela yokubonisa amaseli evikela amangqamuzana omdlavuza ekubulaweni amasosha omzimba. Ithemba ukusebenzisa lolu lwazi ukudala ukwelashwa okuqondiswe kule ndlela yokubonisa amaseli ukuze amangqamuzana omdlavuza azibhubhise. Bheka Isithombe 9.1
question1: Kungani ukuxhumana kwamaseli kubalulekile ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi?
answer1: Ivumela amaseli, izicubu, kanye nezitho zomzimba ukuthi zihlele imisebenzi yazo ngezibonakaliso zamakhemikhali
distractor1a: Ivumela amaseli ukuthi ahlangane unomphela abe yiseli elilodwa elikhulu
distractor1b: Ivumela amaseli ukuthi akhiqize i-ATP ngaphandle kwe-mitochondria
distractor1c: Kuvimbela amaseli ukuthi angakwazi ukuphefumula amaseli
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokuxhumana kwamaseli esidalwa esinamaseli alodwa?
distractor2a: Izimpande zezitshalo ezithutha amanzi ziye emaqabunga
question3: Amanye amabhaktheriya ayaxhumana ukuze:
answer3: Ukuxhumanisa ukwakheka kwe-biofilm kanye nokukhiqizwa kobuthi
question4: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani ukuhanjiswa kwesignali kwakubaluleka ngesikhathi sokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer4: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwamangqamuzana angawodwa kwakubalulekile ngaphambi kokuba izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi zivele
distractor4a: Ukudluliselwa kwezimpawu zeseli kwavela kuphela ngemva kokuba izilwane zivele
distractor4b: Izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi kuphela ezidinga ukuxhumana kwamakhemikhali
distractor4c: Ukudluliselwa kwezimpawu zeseli kwavela ngemva kokuvela kwesimiso sezinzwa
question5: Yimuphi umolekyuli okukhulunywe ngawo kulesi sigaba okhiqizwa ngenxa yokusabela ekudlulisweni kwezimpawu zamaseli?
question6: Ukuxhumana kweseli kuqala lapho iseli:
answer6: Ithola isignali evela endaweni yayo futhi idlulisele ulwazi kuyo yonke i-plasma membrane
question7: Kungani ukukhubazeka ekudlulisweni kwesignali yamaseli kungaba nomthelela emdlavuzeni?
answer7: Amaseli angahlukana ngokungalawuleki noma agweme ukubhujiswa yisimiso somzimba sokuzivikela
distractor7b: Amaseli alahlekelwa yiwo wonke amaprotheni e-membrane
question8: Ososayensi banethemba lokuthuthukisa ukwelashwa komdlavuza ngokuthi:
answer8: Ukuqondisa izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu ezivumela amangqamuzana omdlavuza ukuthi asinde
distractor8b: Ukuvimbela ukuphindaphindeka kwe-DNA kuzo zonke izicubu
question9: Yikuphi ukulandelana okuchaza kahle inqubo eyisisekelo yokubonisana kweseli?
answer9: Isignali iyamukelwa, idluliselwe ku-plasma membrane, futhi ikhiqize impendulo yeselula
distractor9a: Impendulo ivela ngaphambi kokuba isignali itholakale
distractor9b: I-plasma membrane ikhiqiza isignali ngemva kwempendulo
distractor9c: I-nucleus ithola isignali ngaphambi kokuba ifike ebusweni beseli
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esisekela kangcono isimangalo sokuthi ukuxhumana kwamaseli kuyinqubo egciniwe yezinto eziphilayo?
answer10: Zombili izinto eziphilayo ezinamangqamuzana amabili kanye nezinamangqamuzana amaningi zisebenzisa izimpawu zamakhemikhali ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi yamaseli
distractor10a: Izilwane kuphela ezisebenzisa izindlela zokubonisana ngamakhemikhali
distractor10c: Ukuxhumana kwamaseli kwenzeka kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo ezinezinhlelo zezinzwa

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.1 Ama-Molecule Okubonisana Nama-Receptor Eselula | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.1 Ama-Molecule Okubonisana Nama-Receptor Eselula | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njengoba nje uxhumana nabantu ofunda nabo ubuso nobuso, usebenzisa ifoni yakho, noma nge-imeyili, amaseli ayaxhumana ngokubonisana phakathi kwamangqamuzana nangaphakathi kwawo. Amaseli ayabona futhi aphendule ezinguqukweni emvelweni esebenzisa izindlela zokubonisana. Izindlela zokubonisana zivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zihlele imisebenzi yamaseli kanye nezinqubo ze-metabolic. Amaphutha kulezi zindlela angabangela izifo. Amaseli okubonisana akhipha ama-molecule abizwa ngokuthi ama-ligand abopha kumaseli aqondiwe futhi aqale uchungechunge lwezehlakalo ngaphakathi kweseli eliqondiwe. Isibonelo, lapho i-epinephrine ikhishwa, ibopha kumaseli aqondiwe, lawo maseli aphendula ngokuguqula i-glycogen ibe yi-glucose. Ukuxhumana kwamaseli kungenzeka emabangeni amafushane. Isibonelo, ama-neurotransmitters akhishwa ku-synapse ukuze adlulisele imiyalezo phakathi kwama-neurons Umfanekiso 9.3. Ukuhlangana kwezikhala kanye ne-plasmodesmata kuvumela ama-molecule amancane, kufaka phakathi ama-molecule okubonisana, ukuthi ageleze phakathi kwamaseli angomakhelwane. Ukuxhumana kwamaseli nakho kungenzeka emabangeni amade kusetshenziswa. Isibonelo, ama-hormone akhishwa kumaseli e-endocrine aya kumaseli aqondiwe ezinhlelweni eziningi zomzimba. I-ligand efana ne-hormone ehamba egazini yazi kanjani ukuthi "isifikile esithweni sayo esiqondiwe ukuze iqalise impendulo yeselula? Cishe zonke izindlela zokubonisana kwamaseli zihilela izigaba ezintathu: ukwamukela, ukudluliselwa kwesignali, kanye nokuphendula kwamaseli.

 Izindlela zokubonisana kwamaseli ziqala lapho i-ligand ibopha kwi-receptor, iphrotheni efakwe kulwelwesi lwe-plasma lweseli eliqondiwe noma elitholakala ku-cytoplasm yeseli. Ama-receptor aqondile kakhulu, futhi i-ligand ngayinye iqashelwa ngelinye. Lesi sigaba sendlela sibizwa ngokuthi i-reception. Ama-molecule angewona ama-polar, njenge-steroids, asakazeka kulo lonke ulwelwesi lweseli futhi abopha kuma-receptor angaphakathi. Ngokulandelayo, i-receptor-ligand complex ithuthela ku-nucleus futhi ixhumana ne-DNA yeselula. Lokhu kushintsha indlela i-gene evezwa ngayo. Ama-polar ligands, ngakolunye uhlangothi, asebenzisana nephrotheni ye-membrane receptor. Amanye ama-membrane receptors asebenza ngokushintsha ukwakheka ukuze ama-ion athile, njenge-Na+ ne-K+, adlule kulwelwesi lwe-plasma. Amanye ama-membrane receptors asebenzisana ne-G-protein ohlangothini lwe-cytoplasmic lwelwelwesi lwe-plasma, okubangela uchungechunge lwezimpendulo ngaphakathi iseli. Ukuphazamiseka kwale nqubo kuhlotshaniswa nezifo eziningana, okuhlanganisa nekholera.

 Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi iseli ngalinye linezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-receptor, okuvumela ukuthi liphendule ezinhlotsheni ezahlukahlukene ze-stimuli. Amanye ama-receptor angabopha ama-ligand amaningana ahlukene; isibonelo, ama-molecule/ama-receptor anephunga elimnandi ahlotshaniswa nomuzwa wokuhogela ezilwaneni. Uma i-molecule yesignali kanye ne-receptor kuhlangana, uchungechunge lwezehlakalo ezibizwa ngokuthi i-signal transduction luvame ukwandisa isignali ngaphakathi kweseli.

 Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zokuxhumana emhlabeni wamaseli aphilayo. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwamaseli kubizwa ngokuthi ukusayina kwe-intercellular, kanti ukuxhumana ngaphakathi kweseli kubizwa ngokuthi ukusayina kwe-intracellular. Indlela elula yokukhumbula umehluko ukuqonda imvelaphi yesiLatini yeziqalo: izindlela eziphakathi phakathi (isibonelo, imigqa ehlanganayo yileyo ewelanayo) kanye nezindlela eziphakathi ngaphakathi (njenge-intravenous).

 Izimpawu zamakhemikhali zikhishwa ngamaseli okubonisa ngesimo sama-molecule amancane, ngokuvamile aguquguqukayo noma ancibilikayo abizwa ngokuthi ama-ligands. I-ligand iyi-molecule ebopha enye i-molecule ethile, kwezinye izimo, eletha isignali kule nqubo. Ngakho-ke ama-ligand angacatshangwa njengama-molecule okubonisa. Ama-ligand asebenzisana namaprotheni kumaseli aqondiwe, okungamaseli athintwa yizibonakaliso zamakhemikhali; lawa maprotheni abizwa nangokuthi ama-receptor. answer9: Ukusebenzisana kwe-ligand-receptor eyodwa kungenza kusebenze ama-molecule amaningi okudlulisela izimpawu angaphansi komfula, kukhiqize impendulo enkulu yamaseli

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.1 Ama-Molecule Okubonisa Izimpawu kanye Nama-Receptor Eselula | Izinhlobo Zokubonisa Izimpawu | Ukubonisa Izimpawu ze-Paracrine
chapterContent:
Kunezinhlobo ezine zezibonakaliso zamakhemikhali ezitholakala ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi: ukubonakaliswa kwe-paracrine, ukubonakaliswa kwe-endocrine, ukubonakaliswa kwe-autocrine, kanye nokubonakaliswa okuqondile kuzo zonke izigcawu zegebe (Isithombe 9.2). Umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwezigaba ezahlukene zokubonakaliswa ibanga elihanjwa yisibonakaliso emzimbeni ukuze sifinyelele iseli eliqondiwe. Akuwona wonke amaseli athintwa yizibonakaliso ezifanayo.

 Ukubonakaliswa kwe-Paracrine
Izibonakaliso ezisebenza endaweni phakathi kwamaseli asondelene zibizwa ngokuthi izibonakaliso ze-paracrine. Izibonakaliso ze-Paracrine zihamba ngokusabalala nge-extracellular matrix. Lezi zinhlobo zezibonakaliso zivame ukuveza izimpendulo ezisheshayo ezihlala isikhathi esifushane kuphela. Ukuze kugcinwe impendulo isendaweni, ama-molecule e-paracrine ligand avame ukuwohloka ngokushesha ngama-enzyme noma asuswe amaseli angomakhelwane. Ukususa izimpawu kuzobuyisela kabusha i-gradient yokuhlushwa kwesibonakaliso, okuzivumela ukuthi zisabalale ngokushesha esikhaleni sangaphakathi kweseli uma zikhishwa futhi.

 Isibonelo esisodwa sokubonakaliswa kwe-paracrine ukudluliselwa kwezibonakaliso kuma-synapses phakathi kwamaseli ezinzwa. Iseli lemizwa lakhiwe umzimba weseli, izandiso eziningana ezimfushane, ezinamagatsha ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-dendrite athola izikhuthazo, kanye nesandiso eside esibizwa ngokuthi i-axon, esidlulisela izimpawu kwamanye amangqamuzana emizwa noma amangqamuzana emisipha. Ukuhlangana phakathi kwamangqamuzana emizwa lapho kwenzeka khona ukudluliselwa kwesignali kubizwa ngokuthi i-synapse. Isignali ye-synaptic iyisignali yamakhemikhali ehamba phakathi kwamangqamuzana emizwa. Izimpawu ngaphakathi kwamangqamuzana emizwa zisatshalaliswa yiziphazamiso zikagesi ezihamba ngokushesha. Lapho lezi ziphazamiso zifika ekugcineni kwe-axon, isignali iyaqhubeka iye ku-dendrite yeseli elilandelayo ngokukhishwa kwama-ligand amakhemikhali abizwa ngokuthi ama-neurotransmitters yiseli le-presynaptic (iseli elikhipha isignali). Ama-neurotransmitter athuthwa amabanga amancane kakhulu phakathi kwamangqamuzana emizwa, abizwa ngokuthi ama-synapses amakhemikhali (Isithombe 9.3). Ibanga elincane phakathi kwamangqamuzana emizwa livumela isignali ukuthi ihambe ngokushesha; lokhu kwenza impendulo esheshayo, njengokuthi, Susa isandla sakho esitofini!

 Lapho i-neurotransmitter ibopha i-receptor ebusweni beseli le-postsynaptic, amandla e-electrochemical weseli eliqondiwe ayashintsha, bese kuthi i-electrical impulse elandelayo iqaliswe. Ama-neurotransmitter akhishwa ku-synapse yamakhemikhali abhujiswa ngokushesha noma aphinde amuncwe yiseli elingaphambi kwe-synaptic ukuze iseli lemizwa elitholayo likwazi ukululama ngokushesha futhi lilungele ukusabela ngokushesha esignalini elandelayo ye-synaptic.
question1: Yini ehlukanisa ukusayinda kwe-paracrine kwezinye izinhlobo zokusayinda kweseli?
answer1: Izimpawu ze-paracrine zisebenza endaweni yakini kumaseli aseduze ahlosiwe ngokusabalalisa
distractor1b: Ukubonakaliswa kwe-paracrine kwenzeka kuphela ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus
distractor1c: Ukubonakaliswa kwe-paracrine kuthinta wonke amaseli emzimbeni ngokulinganayo
question2: Ama-molecule okubonisa i-paracrine avame ukuhamba kanjani aye kumaseli awo aqondiwe?
distractor2c: Ngama-vesicle angaphakathi kweseli ahlanganyelwe amaseli angomakhelwane
question3: Kungani izimpawu ze-paracrine zivame ukonakala noma zisuswe ngokushesha ngemva kokukhululwa?
answer3: Ukugcina impendulo isendaweni futhi kuvumele ukusetha kabusha ngokushesha indlela yokubonisana
distractor3c: Ukuyeka unomphela ukuxhumana phakathi kwamaseli angomakhelwane
question4: Yisiphi isibonelo esihle kakhulu sokubonisa i-paracrine kulokhu okulandelayo?
answer4: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwama-neurons kuyo yonke i-synapse yamakhemikhali
distractor4b: Ama-hormone e-steroid abopha ama-receptor angaphakathi kweseli kuwo wonke umzimba
question5: Uyini umsebenzi wama-dendrites ku-neuron?
question6: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-axon?
answer6: Ukudlulisa izimpawu kwamanye amangqamuzana ezinzwa noma amangqamuzana emisipha
question7: Ayini ama-neurotransmitter?
answer7: Ama-ligand amakhemikhali akhishwa amaseli angaphambi kwe-synaptic ukuze adlulisele izimpawu kuwo wonke ama-synapses
question8: Kwenzekani uma i-neurotransmitter ibopha kuma-receptors kuseli le-postsynaptic?
answer8: Amandla kagesi ayashintsha, okudala i-pulse entsha kagesi
question9: Kungani ama-neurotransmitter ewohloka ngokushesha noma emuncwa kabusha ngemva kokukhululwa?
answer9: Ukulungiselela i-synapse ukuze idlulisele ngokushesha izimpawu zesikhathi esizayo
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani ukuhanjiswa kwesignali ye-synaptic kukhiqiza izimpendulo ezisheshayo?
answer10: Ama-neurotransmitter asakazeka ibanga elifushane kakhulu phakathi kwamaseli angomakhelwane
distractor10a: Ama-neurotransmitter ajikeleza egazini ngaphambi kokufinyelela imigomo yawo
distractor10b: Ama-pulse kagesi ahamba kuphela ngoketshezi olungaphandle kwe-extracellular
distractor10c: Izimpawu zidlula ama-receptor bese zingena ngqo ku-nucleus

chapterContent:
Kunezinhlobo ezine zokubonisana kwamakhemikhali ezitholakala ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi: ukubonisana kwe-paracrine, ukubonisana kwe-endocrine, ukubonisana kwe-autocrine, kanye nokubonisana okuqondile kuzo zonke izigcawu zegebe (Isithombe 9.2). Umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwezigaba ezahlukene zokubonisana ibanga elihanjwa yisignali emzimbeni ukuze ifinyelele iseli eliqondiwe. Akuwona wonke amaseli athintwa yizibonakaliso ezifanayo.

 Izimpawu ezivela kumaseli akude zibizwa ngokuthi izibonakaliso ze-endocrine, futhi zivela kumaseli e-endocrine. (Emzimbeni, amaseli amaningi e-endocrine atholakala kuma-gland e-endocrine, njenge-thyroid gland, i-hypothalamus, kanye ne-pituitary gland.) Lezi zinhlobo zezibonakaliso zivame ukukhiqiza impendulo ehamba kancane kodwa zinomphumela ohlala isikhathi eside. Ama-ligand akhishwa ekuboniseni kwe-endocrine abizwa ngokuthi ama-hormone, ama-molecule okubonisana akhiqizwa engxenyeni eyodwa yomzimba kodwa athinta ezinye izifunda zomzimba kude.

 Ama-hormone ahamba amabanga amakhulu phakathi kwamaseli e-endocrine namaseli awo aqondiwe ngegazi, okuyindlela ehamba kancane yokuhamba emzimbeni wonke. Ngenxa yohlobo lwawo lokuthuthwa, ama-hormone ayancishiswa futhi akhona ngamanani aphansi uma esebenza kumaseli awo aqondiwe. Lokhu kuhlukile ekusayineni kwe-paracrine, lapho amazinga endawo ama-ligand angaba phezulu kakhulu.

Kunezinhlobo ezine zokubonisana kwamakhemikhali ezitholakala ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi: ukubonisana kwe-paracrine, ukubonisana kwe-endocrine, ukubonisana kwe-autocrine, kanye nokubonisana okuqondile kuzo zonke izigcawu zegebe (Isithombe 9.2). Umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwezigaba ezahlukene zokubonisana ibanga elihanjwa yisignali phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ukuze ifinyelele iseli eliqondiwe. Akuwona wonke amaseli athintwa yizibonakaliso ezifanayo.

 Izimpawu ze-Autocrine zikhiqizwa ngamaseli okubonisana angabopha ne-ligand ekhishwayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iseli lokubonisana kanye neseli eliqondiwe kungaba yiseli elifanayo noma elifanayo (isiqalo ngokuzenzakalela sisho ukuthi wena, isikhumbuzo sokuthi iseli lokubonisana lizithumela isignali). Lolu hlobo lokubonisana luvame ukwenzeka ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kokuqala kwezinto eziphilayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaseli akhula abe yizicubu ezifanele futhi athathe umsebenzi ofanele. Ukubonisana kwe-Autocrine kulawula nokuzwa ubuhlungu kanye nezimpendulo zokuvuvukala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma iseli lithelelekile ngegciwane, iseli lingazibonisa ukuthi lizofa ngokuhleliwe, libulale igciwane phakathi nenqubo. Kwezinye izimo, amaseli angomakhelwane ohlobo olufanayo nawo athonywa yi-ligand ekhishwe. Ekuthuthukisweni kombungu, le nqubo yokuvuselela iqembu lamaseli angomakhelwane ingasiza ekuqondiseni ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli afanayo ohlotsheni olufanayo lweseli, ngaleyo ndlela kuqinisekiswe umphumela ofanele wokukhula.
question1: Iyini isici esichazayo sokusayina kwe-autocrine?
answer1: Iseli elibonisayo lisabela ku-ligand eliyikhiphayo
distractor1c: I-molecule yesignali ithinta kuphela amaseli aqondiwe akude

answer2: Iseli lokubonisa lingasebenza njengeseli lalo eliqondiwe

answer4: Hlukanisa izicubu ezifanele kanye nezinhlobo zamaseli
question5: Iyiphi inqubo yomzimba elawulwa ngokwengxenye yi-autocrine signaling?
question6: Ukusayinwa kwe-autocrine kungasiza kanjani ekuvikeleni umzimba ekuthelelekeni ngegciwane?
answer6: Iseli elithelelekile lingazibonisa ukuthi lizofa ngendlela ehleliwe
distractor6a: Iseli libhubhisa ngokushesha wonke amaseli angomakhelwane
distractor6c: Iseli livimba unomphela wonke amaprotheni e-receptor
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono amaseli aqondiwe ekuboniseni i-autocrine?
answer7: Inhloso kungaba yiseli elifanayo elakhipha i-ligand noma amaseli aseduze ohlobo olufanayo
distractor7b: Amaseli emisipha kuphela angasebenza njengamaseli aqondiwe
question8: Kungani ukusayinwa kwe-autocrine kungaba wusizo ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kombungu?
answer8: Kusiza amaqembu amaseli angomakhelwane ukuthi ahlukanise uhlobo olufanayo lwamaseli akhethekile
distractor8b: Kubangela ukuthi wonke amaseli ombungu abe yi-neuron
question9: Yisiphi isimo esichaza kangcono izimpawu ze-autocrine?
answer9: Iseli likhipha i-molecule enika izimpawu ebopha ama-receptor ebusweni balo futhi ibangele impendulo
distractor9b: I-neurotransmitter inqamula i-synapse phakathi kwama-neurons amabili
distractor9c: I-molecule enika izimpawu isakazeka egazini iye esithweni esikude
question10: Uma kuqhathaniswa nokubonakaliswa kwe-endocrine, ukubonakaliswa kwe-autocrine kuthinta kakhulu:
answer10: Iseli lokubonisa ngokwalo noma amaseli aseduze ohlobo olufanayo
