chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.1 Ama-Molecule Okubonisa Izimpawu kanye Nama-Receptors Eselula | Izinhlobo Zokubonisa Izimpawu | Ukubonisa Izimpawu Okuqondile Kuyo Yonke Imingcele Yezikhala
chapterContent:
Kunezinhlobo ezine zokubonisana kwamakhemikhali ezitholakala ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi: ukubonisana kwe-paracrine, ukubonisana kwe-endocrine, ukubonisana kwe-autocrine, kanye nokubonisana okuqondile kuzo zonke izihlanganisi zegebe (Isithombe 9.2). Umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwezigaba ezahlukene zokubonisana ibanga elihanjwa yisignali emzimbeni ukuze ifinyelele iseli eliqondiwe. Akuwona wonke amaseli athintwa yizibonakaliso ezifanayo.

 Ukuhlangana kwegebe ezilwaneni kanye ne-plasmodesmata ezitshalweni kuyizixhumanisi phakathi kwe-plasma membranes yamaseli angomakhelwane. Lezi ziteshi ezigcwele uketshezi zivumela ama-molecule amancane okubonisana, abizwa ngokuthi ama-intracellular mediators, ukuba asakazeke phakathi kwamaseli amabili. Ama-molecule amancane, njenge-calcium ions (Ca2+), ayakwazi ukuhamba phakathi kwamaseli, kodwa ama-molecule amakhulu afana namaprotheni ne-DNA awakwazi ukungena ngeziteshi. Ukucaciswa kweziteshi kuqinisekisa ukuthi amaseli ahlala ezimele kodwa angadlulisela ngokushesha nangokulula izimpawu. Ukudluliselwa kwama-molecule okubonisana kudlulisa isimo samanje seseli esiseduze ngqo neseli eliqondiwe; lokhu kuvumela iqembu lamaseli ukuthi lihlele impendulo yalo esignalini okungenzeka ukuthi elilodwa lawo liyitholile. Ezitshalweni, ama-plasmodesmata atholakala yonke indawo, okwenza sonke isitshalo sibe inethiwekhi enkulu yokuxhumana
question1: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezivumela ukuxhumana okuqondile phakathi kwamaseli ezilwane angomakhelwane?
answer1: Izindawo zokuhlangana kwezikhala
question2: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezenza umsebenzi ofanayo wokuxhumana njengezindawo zokuhlangana kwezikhala ezitshalweni?
question3: Yini edlula ezingxeni zegebe kanye ne-plasmodesmata ukuze idlulise izimpawu?
answer3: Ama-molecule amancane okubonisana abizwa ngokuthi ama-intracellular mediators
question4: Yimaphi ama-molecule alandelayo angadlula kalula ezinhlanganweni zezikhala?
question5: Kungani amaprotheni ne-DNA zingakwazi ukudlula ezingxenyeni zezikhala?
question6: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yokubonisana ngqo ezindaweni zokuhlangana kwezikhala?
answer6: Amaseli angomakhelwane angahlela ngokushesha izimpendulo zawo
distractor6b: Amaseli ahlangana unomphela abe iseli elilodwa elikhulu
question7: Iziphambano zezikhala zisiza kanjani amaqembu amaseli ukuthi asabele esignalini?
answer7: Amaseli abelana ngama-molecule okubonisa ukuze amaseli angomakhelwane akwazi ukuphendula noma ngabe iseli elilodwa kuphela elithole isignali ekuqaleni
distractor7a: Iseli ngalinye kumele lizitholele ngokuzimela isignali yokuqala evela egazini
distractor7b: Iziphazamiso zezikhala zikhulisa ama-pulse kagesi abe ama-hormone
distractor7c: Iziphazamiso zezikhala zithutha i-DNA phakathi kwamaseli angomakhelwane
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani amaseli axhunywe yizigcawu ezihlala ezimele?
answer8: Iziteshi zivumela ngokukhetha ama-molecule amancane kuphela ukuthi adlule phakathi kwamaseli
distractor8a: Iziphambano zezikhala zivumela ukunyakaza okungenamkhawulo kwakho konke okuqukethwe kweselula
distractor8b: Iziteshi zithutha amaprotheni kanye ne-RNA kuphela
distractor8c: Iziphambano zezikhala zihlangana unomphela nezingxenyana ze-plasma eziseduze
question9: Kungani i-plasmodesmata ibaluleke kakhulu ezitshalweni?
answer9: Bakha inethiwekhi yokuxhumana ebanzi kulo lonke isitshalo
distractor9b: Zivumela ama-chloroplast ukuthi ahambe phakathi kwamaseli
distractor9c: Zithatha indawo yesidingo sezicubu zemithambo yegazi
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kangcono ukusayinwa okuqondile phakathi kwezikhala zokuhlangana nokusayinwa kwe-endocrine?
answer10: Ukubonakaliswa kwe-gap junction kusebenza ngqo phakathi kwamaseli angomakhelwane, kuyilapho ukubonakaliswa kwe-endocrine kusebenzisa ama-hormone ahamba ngegazi aye kumaseli aqondiwe akude.
distractor10a: Zombili zidinga ama-hormone ukuze ahambe egazini
distractor10c: Ukubonakaliswa kwe-gap junction kwenzeka njalo emabangeni amade kunokubonakaliswa kwe-endocrine

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.1 Ama-Molecule Okubonisa Izimpawu Nama-Receptors Eselula | Izinhlobo Zama-Receptors | Ama-Receptors Angaphakathi
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.1 Ama-Molecule Okubonisa Izimpawu Nama-Receptors Eselula | Izinhlobo Zama-Receptors | Ama-Receptors Angaphakathi
chapterContent:
Ama-receptors angama-molecule amaprotheni esiseleni esiqondiwe noma ebusweni baso ahlanganisa i-ligand. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zama-receptor, ama-receptor angaphakathi kanye nama-receptor angaphakathi kweseli.

 Ama-receptor angaphakathi
Ama-receptor angaphakathi, aziwa nangokuthi ama-receptor angaphakathi kweseli noma i-cytoplasmic, atholakala ku-cytoplasm yeseli futhi asabela kuma-molecule e-ligand e-hydrophobic akwazi ukuhamba ngaphesheya kwe-plasma membrane. Uma esengaphakathi kweseli, amaningi ala ma-molecule abopha kumaprotheni asebenza njengabalawuli bokwenziwa kwe-mRNA (ukubhalwa) ukuze axhumanise ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo. Ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo inqubo yeselula yokuguqula ulwazi kumaseli e-DNA lube uchungechunge lwama-amino acid, ekugcineni olwakha iphrotheni. Lapho i-ligand ibopha ku-receptor yangaphakathi, kuvela ushintsho lokwakheka oluveza indawo yokubopha i-DNA kuphrotheni. I-ligand-receptor complex ingena ku-nucleus, bese ibopha ezindaweni ezithile zokulawula ze-chromosome DNA futhi ikhuthaze ukuqaliswa kokubhalwa (Isithombe 9.4). Ukubhalwa kabusha kuyinqubo yokukopisha ulwazi olusezingqamuzaneni i-DNA lube uhlobo olukhethekile lwe-RNA olubizwa ngokuthi i-messenger RNA (mRNA); ingqamuzana isebenzisa ulwazi oluku-mRNA (oluphuma luye ku-cytoplasm futhi luhlobane nama-ribosome) ukuxhumanisa ama-amino acid athile ngokulandelana okufanele, kukhiqizwe iphrotheni. Ama-receptor angaphakathi angathonya ngqo ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphandle kokudlulisela isignali kwamanye ama-receptor noma ama-messenger.
question1: Zitholakala kuphi izitho zangaphakathi?
answer1: Ku-cytoplasm yeseli eliqondiwe
question2: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-ligand okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi lubophe i-receptor yangaphakathi?
answer2: I-ligand ehlala emanzini engasabalala kulo lonke ulwelwesi lwe-plasma
distractor2b: I-hormone enkulu yamaprotheni ehlala ngaphandle kweseli
question3: Yini evame ukwenzeka ngokushesha ngemva kokuba i-ligand ibophe i-receptor yangaphakathi?
answer3: I-receptor idlula oshintshweni oluveza indawo ebopha i-DNA

answer5: Zilawula ngqo ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokubopha izindawo ezithile ze-DNA
question6: Ukubhala phansi inqubo yalokhu okulandelayo:
answer6: Ukukopisha ulwazi oluvela ku-DNA luye ku-RNA yesithunywa (mRNA)
question7: Iyini indima ye-messenger RNA (mRNA) ngemva kokubhalwa?
answer7: Ithwala ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kuma-ribosome, lapho amaprotheni enziwa khona
question8: Kungani ama-receptor angaphakathi engathonya ngqo ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer8: Ngoba i-ligand-receptor complex ibopha ngqo ezindaweni ezilawulayo ze-DNA
distractor8a: Ngoba ama-receptor angaphakathi ashintsha unomphela ukulandelana kwe-DNA
distractor8c: Ngoba ziguqula i-DNA ibe amaprotheni ngaphandle kokubhalwa phansi
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kangcono ama-receptor angaphakathi nama-receptor angaphezulu kweseli?
answer9: Ama-receptor angaphakathi abopha ama-ligand angena esitokisini futhi alawule ngokuqondile ukuqoshwa kwamagama, kuyilapho ama-receptor asebusweni beseli ethola izimpawu ngaphandle kweseli.
distractor9a: Zombili izinhlobo ze-receptor zitholakala kuphela ku-nucleus
distractor9b: Ama-receptor angaphakathi aphendula kuphela kuma-ion, kuyilapho ama-receptor angaphezulu kweseli ephendula kuphela kumaphrotheni
distractor9c: Ama-receptor angaphezulu kweseli ahlala engena ku-nucleus ngemva kokubopha i-ligand
question10: Yimaphi ama-molecule alandelayo abonisa ukuthi kungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi asebenze i-receptor yangaphakathi?
answer10: I-hormone ye-steroid

chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.1 Ama-Molecule Okubonisa Izimpawu Nama-Receptors Eselula | Izinhlobo Zama-Receptors | Ama-Receptors E-Cell-Surface (Isizinda Sangaphandle Kweseli, Ama-receptors Axhunywe Ngesiteshi Se-Ion, Ama-receptors Axhunywe Nge-G-protein, Ama-receptors Axhunywe Nge-Enzyme)
chapterContent:
Ama-receptor angama-molecule ephrotheni esiseleni esiqondiwe noma ebusweni baso ahlanganisa i-ligand. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zama-receptor, ama-receptor angaphakathi kanye nama-receptor asebusweni beseli.

 Ama-Receptors asebusweni beseli
Ama-receptor asebusweni beseli, aziwa nangokuthi ama-transmembrane receptors, angama-protein asebusweni beseli, ahlanganiswe ne-membrane-anchored (integral) ama-molecule e-ligand angaphandle. Lolu hlobo lwe-receptor ludlula i-plasma membrane futhi lwenze i-signal transduction, lapho i-extracellular signal iguqulwa ibe yi-intracellular signal. Ama-Ligand asebenzisana nama-receptor asebusweni beseli akudingeki angene esiseleni ayithintayo. Ama-receptor asebusweni beseli abizwa nangokuthi amaprotheni noma ama-marker athile eseli ngoba aqondene nezinhlobo zamaseli ngazinye.

 Ngenxa yokuthi amaprotheni ama-receptor asebusweni beseli ayisisekelo ekusebenzeni kweseli okuvamile, akufanele kumangaze ukuthi ukungasebenzi kahle kunoma yiliphi lala maphrotheni kungaba nemiphumela emibi kakhulu. Amaphutha ezakhiweni zamaphrotheni zama-molecule athile ama-receptor aboniswe ukuthi adlala indima ekucindezelekeni kwegazi (umfutho wegazi ophakeme), i-asthma, isifo senhliziyo, kanye nomdlavuza.

 I-receptor ngayinye yeseli-surface inezingxenye ezintathu eziyinhloko: isizinda sangaphandle esibopha i-ligand, isifunda esihlanganisa i-membrane e-hydrophobic, kanye nesizinda sangaphakathi kweseli. Isizinda esibopha i-ligand sibizwa nangokuthi isizinda esingaphandle. Ubukhulu nobubanzi besizinda ngasinye salezi zihluka kakhulu, kuye ngohlobo lwe-receptor.

 Ama-receptor eseli-surface ahilelekile ekudlulisweni kwesignali ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi. Kunezinhlobo ezintathu ezijwayelekile zama-receptor eseli-surface: ama-receptor axhunywe ngesiteshi se-ion, ama-receptor axhunywe nge-G-protein, kanye nama-receptor axhunywe nge-enzyme.

 Ama-receptor axhunywe ngesiteshi se-ion abopha i-ligand futhi avule isiteshi nge-membrane evumela ama-ion athile ukuthi adlule. Ukuze kwakheke isiteshi, lolu hlobo lwe-receptor yeseli-surface lunesifunda esibanzi esihlanganisa i-membrane. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nemisila ye-phospholipid fatty acid eyakha isikhungo se-plasma membrane, ama-amino acid amaningi esifundeni esihlanganisa i-membrane angokwemvelo ye-hydrophobic. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ama-amino acid angaphakathi kwesiteshi ahlala emanzini ukuze avumele ukudlula kwamanzi noma ama-ion. Lapho i-ligand ibopha esifundeni esingaphandle kwesiteshi, kuba noshintsho lwesakhiwo samaprotheni oluvumela ama-ion anjenge-sodium, i-calcium, i-magnesium, ne-hydrogen ukuthi adlule (Isithombe 9.5).

 Ama-receptor axhunywe yi-G-protein abopha i-ligand futhi asebenze iphrotheni ye-membrane ebizwa ngokuthi i-G-protein. I-G-protein esebenzayo bese ixhumana nesiteshi se-ion noma i-enzyme ku-membrane (Isithombe 9.6). Wonke ama-receptor axhunywe yi-G-protein anezizinda eziyisikhombisa ze-transmembrane, kodwa i-receptor ngayinye inesizinda sayo esithile se-extracellular kanye nendawo yokubopha i-G-protein.

 Ukubonisana kweseli kusetshenziswa ama-receptor axhunywe yi-G-protein kwenzeka njengochungechunge lwezehlakalo ezijikelezayo. Ngaphambi kokuba i-ligand ibophe, i-G-protein engasebenzi ingabopha endaweni ethile ku-receptor ethile yokubopha kwayo. Uma i-ligand ibopha kwi-receptor, ushintsho lwesimo oluvelayo luvuselela i-G-protein, ekhipha i-GDP bese ithatha i-GTP. Ama-subunit e-G-protein abe esehlukana abe yi-α subunit kanye ne-βγ subunit. Enye noma zombili lezi zingcezu ze-G-protein zingakwazi ukwenza amanye amaprotheni asebenze ngenxa yalokho. Ngemva kwesikhashana, i-GTP ku-α subunit esebenzayo ye-G-protein iyachithwa ibe yi-GDP bese i-βγ subunit iyekiswa ukusebenza. Ama-subunit aphinde ahlangane ukuze akhe i-G-protein engasebenzi bese umjikelezo uqala kabusha.

 Ama-receptor axhunywe yi-G-protein afundwe kabanzi futhi kufundwe okuningi ngezindima zawo ekugcineni impilo. Amabhaktheriya abangela izifo kubantu angakhipha ubuthi obuphazamisa umsebenzi we-receptor othize oxhunywe yi-G-protein, okuholela ezifweni ezifana ne-pertussis, i-botulism, kanye ne-cholera. Ku-cholera (Isithombe 9.7), isibonelo, igciwane elithwala amanzi i-Vibrio cholerae likhiqiza ubuthi, i-choleragen, obubopha emaseli amboze amathumbu amancane. Ubuthi bube sebungena kula maseli amathumbu, lapho buguqula khona i-G-protein elawula ukuvulwa komsele we-chloride futhi bubangele ukuthi ihlale isebenza njalo, okuholela ekulahlekelweni okukhulu koketshezi emzimbeni kanye nokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni okungaba yingozi ngenxa yalokho.

 Ama-receptor axhunywe yi-enzyme angama-receptor asebusweni bamaseli anezindawo zangaphakathi kweseli ezihlotshaniswa ne-enzyme. Kwezinye izimo, isizinda sangaphakathi kweseli se-receptor uqobo siyi-enzyme. Amanye ama-receptor axhunywe yi-enzyme anesizinda esincane sangaphakathi kweseli esisebenzisana ngqo ne-enzyme. Ama-receptor axhunywe yi-enzyme ngokuvamile anezindawo ezinkulu zangaphandle nangaphakathi kweseli, kodwa indawo ehlanganisa ulwelwesi iqukethe isifunda esisodwa se-alpha-helical se-peptide strand. Lapho i-ligand ibopha endaweni yangaphandle, isignali idluliselwa nge-membrane, ivuselele i-enzyme. Ukusebenza kwe-enzyme kuqalisa uchungechunge lwezehlakalo ngaphakathi kweseli ekugcineni okuholela empendulweni. Isibonelo esisodwa salolu hlobo lwe-receptor exhunywe yi-enzyme yi-tyrosine kinase receptor (Isithombe 9.8). I-kinase iyi-enzyme edlulisela amaqembu e-phosphate kusuka ku-ATP kuya kwenye iphrotheni. I-tyrosine kinase receptor idlulisela amaqembu e-phosphate kuma-molecule e-tyrosine (izinsalela ze-tyrosine). Okokuqala, ama-molecule okubonisa abopheka endaweni engaphandle kwama-receptor amabili e-tyrosine kinase aseduze. Ama-receptor amabili aseduze abe esehlangana ndawonye, noma anciphe. Ama-phosphate abe esengezwa kuma-residues e-tyrosine endaweni engaphakathi kweseli yama-receptor (i-phosphorylation). Ama-residues e-phosphorylated angabe esedlulisela isignali kusithunywa esilandelayo ngaphakathi kwe-cytoplasm.

 I-HER2 iyi-receptor tyrosine kinase. Kumaphesenti angama-20 amacala omdlavuza webele womuntu, i-HER2 isebenza unomphela, okuholela ekuhlukanisweni kwamaseli okungalawulwa. I-Lapatinib, umuthi osetshenziselwa ukwelapha umdlavuza webele, uvimbela i-HER2 receptor tyrosine kinase autophosphorylation, inqubo lapho i-receptor ifaka khona ama-phosphate kuyo. Lokhu kunciphisa ukukhula kwesimila ezigulini ngamaphesenti angu-50. Ngaphandle kwe-autophosphorylation, bikezela ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo ezilandelayo ezizovinjelwa yi-Lapatinib, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi zibhalwe phansi ekusetshenzisweni kwayo.

answer1: Kuyiprotheni ye-membrane ebalulekile ebopha ama-ligand angaphandle kweseli futhi iguqule amasignali angaphandle kweseli abe amasignali angaphakathi kweseli.
distractor1c: Ibopha kuphela ama-ligand angaphakathi kweseli ngemva kokungena ku-nucleus

question4: Yini evame ukwenzeka lapho i-ligand ibopha kwi-receptor exhunywe kusiteshi se-ion?
answer4: Ushintsho lwesimo luvula isiteshi, okuvumela ama-ion athile ukuthi awele ulwelwesi
distractor4c: I-receptor ikhipha i-ATP esikhaleni esingaphandle kweseli
question5: Yimaphi ama-ion okukhulunywe ngawo ngqo njengakwazi ukudlula eziteshini zama-ion ezine-ligand-gated?
answer5: Ama-ion e-sodium, calcium, magnesium, kanye ne-hydrogen
question6: Kwenzekani uma i-ligand isebenzisa i-receptor exhunywe yi-G-protein?
answer6: I-G-protein ishintshanisa i-GDP ne-GTP bese iyasebenza
distractor6b: I-ATP iguqulwa ibe yi-ADP ngaphakathi kwe-receptor
distractor6c: I-ligand ingena ku-nucleus bese ibopha i-DNA ye-chromosome
question7: Ngemva kokusebenza kwe-G-protein, yini ekugcineni eyibuyisela esimweni sayo sokungasebenzi?
answer7: I-GTP ku-α subunit i-hydrolyzed ibe yi-GDP
question8: Ubuthi bekholera buphazamisa kanjani ukuhanjiswa kwesignali okuvamile kwamangqamuzana?
answer8: Iguqula i-G-protein, okubangela ukuthi isiteshi se-chloride sihlale sisebenza njalo futhi kuholele ekulahlekelweni okukhulu koketshezi
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ama-receptor axhumene nama-enzyme?
answer9: Ukubopha i-ligand kuvuselela i-enzyme yangaphakathi kweseli noma isizinda esihlobene ne-enzyme, okuqalisa ukuqhuma kwesignali
distractor9c: Zivuselela amaprotheni e-G kodwa azikaze zibe nama-enzyme
question10: Kwenzekani uma ama-receptor e-tyrosine kinase esebenza?
answer10: Ama-receptor amabili anciphisa futhi afake i-phosphorylate tyrosine residues, aqala ukudluliselwa kwesignali ngaphakathi kweseli
distractor10a: Ama-receptor ahlukanisa ngokushesha futhi akhulule ama-ion e-calcium
question11: I-HER2 iyi-receptor tyrosine kinase. Kumaphesenti angama-20 ezigameko zomdlavuza webele kubantu, i-HER2 isebenza unomphela, okuholela ekuhlukanisweni kwamaseli okungalawulwa. I-Lapatinib, umuthi osetshenziselwa ukwelapha umdlavuza webele, uvimbela i-HER2 receptor tyrosine kinase autophosphorylation, inqubo lapho i-receptor ifaka khona ama-phosphates kuyo. Lokhu kunciphisa ukukhula kwesimila ezigulini ngamaphesenti angama-50. Ngaphandle kwe-autophosphorylation, bikezela ukuthi yiziphi kulezi zinyathelo ezilandelayo ezizovinjelwa yi-Lapatinib, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi zibhalwe phansi ekusetshenzisweni kwayo.
distractor11b: Umsebenzi we-phosphatase, i-dimerization, kanye nempendulo yamaseli engezansi
distractor11c: Ukubopha kwe-molecule yesiginali, ukuguquguquka, kanye nempendulo yamaseli engezansi

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.1 Ama-Molecule Okubonisa Izimpawu kanye Nama-Receptors Eselula | Ama-Molecule Okubonisa Izimpawu | Ama-Ligand Amancane Angangenisi Amanzi, Ama-Ligand Ancibilikayo Emanzini, Amanye Ama-Ligand
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.1 Ama-Molecule Okubonisa Izimpawu kanye Nama-Receptors Eselula | Ama-Molecule Okubonisa Izimpawu | Ama-Ligand Amancane Angangenisi Amanzi, Ama-Ligand Ancibilikayo Emanzini, Amanye Ama-Ligand
chapterContent:
Ekhiqizwa ngamaseli okubonisa kanye nokubopha okulandelayo kuma-receptor kumaseli aqondiwe, ama-ligand asebenza njengezibonakaliso zamakhemikhali ezihamba ziye kumaseli aqondiwe ukuze axhumanise izimpendulo. Izinhlobo zama-molecule asebenza njengama-ligand zihlukahlukene kakhulu futhi zisukela kumaprotheni amancane kuya kuma-ion amancane njenge-calcium (Ca2+).

 Ama-Ligand Amancane Angenamanzi
Ama-ligand amancane angenamanzi angasabalala ngqo nge-plasma membrane futhi asebenzisane nama-receptor angaphakathi. Amalungu abalulekile aleli klasi lama-ligand ama-hormone e-steroid. Ama-steroids ama-lipid ane-skeleton ye-hydrocarbon enezindandatho ezine ezihlanganisiwe; ama-steroid ahlukene anamaqembu ahlukene asebenzayo anamathele ku-carbon skeleton. Ama-hormone e-steroid afaka i-hormone yocansi yesifazane, i-estradiol, okuwuhlobo lwe-estrogen; i-hormone yocansi yesilisa, i-testosterone; kanye ne-cholesterol, okuyingxenye ebalulekile yesakhiwo se-membrane yezinto eziphilayo kanye nesandulela sama-hormone e-steriod (Isithombe 9.9). Amanye ama-hormone angenamanzi afaka ama-hormone e-thyroid kanye ne-vitamin D. Ukuze ancibilike egazini, ama-ligand angenamanzi kumele abophe amaprotheni athwala ngenkathi ethuthwa ngegazi.

 Ama-Ligand Ancibilikayo Emanzini
Ama-ligand ancibilikayo emanzini angama-polar ngakho-ke awakwazi ukudlula ku-plasma membrane ngaphandle kosizo; ngezinye izikhathi, makhulu kakhulu ukuthi angadlula ku-membrane nhlobo. Esikhundleni salokho, ama-ligand amaningi ancibilikayo emanzini abopha endaweni engaphandle kwama-receptors asebusweni bamaseli. Leli qembu lama-ligand lihlukahlukene kakhulu futhi lifaka ama-molecule amancane, ama-peptide, namaprotheni.

 Amanye ama-Ligand
I-Nitric oxide (NO) iyigesi esebenza njenge-ligand. Iyakwazi ukusabalalisa ngqo ku-plasma membrane, futhi enye yezindima zayo ukusebenzisana nama-receptors emisipha ebushelelezi futhi ibangele ukukhululeka kwezicubu. I-NO ine-half-life emfushane kakhulu ngakho-ke isebenza kuphela emabangeni amafushane. I-Nitroglycerin, ukwelashwa kwesifo senhliziyo, isebenza ngokubangela ukukhishwa kwe-NO, okubangela ukuthi imithambo yegazi ivuleke (ikhule), ngaleyo ndlela ibuyisele ukugeleza kwegazi enhliziyweni.
question1: Yiliphi uhlobo lwama-molecule esignaling olungasabalala ngqo nge-plasma membrane futhi lubophe ama-receptor angaphakathi kweseli?
answer1: Ama-ligand amancane angenawo umoya
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo se-hormone ye-steroid?
question3: Kungani ama-hormone e-steroid kumele abophe amaprotheni athwalayo ngenkathi ehamba egazini?
answer3: Ziyazonda amanzi futhi azincibiliki kalula egazini
distractor3a: Zinkulu kakhulu ukuthi zingasabalala nge-plasma yegazi
distractor3b: Amaprotheni okuthwala avuselela ama-hormone e-steroid ngaphambi kokubopha ama-receptor
question4: Kungani ama-ligand amaningi ancibilika emanzini ebopha kuma-receptor asebusweni beseli esikhundleni sama-receptor angaphakathi kweseli?
answer4: Ziyi-polar futhi azikwazi ukudlula ku-plasma membrane ngaphandle kosizo
question5: Yimaphi ama-molecule alandelayo asebenza njenge-gaseous signaling ligand?
question6: I-Nitroglycerin iqeda izimpawu zesifo senhliziyo ngoba ikhuthaza ukukhululwa kwanoma iyiphi i-molecule yokubonisa?
answer6: I-nitric oxide (NO)
question7: Iyini imiphumela eyinhloko ye-nitric oxide kumaseli emisipha abushelelezi?
answer7: Kubangela ukukhululeka kwemisipha ebushelelezi, okuholela ekuvulekeni kwemithambo yegazi
question8: Yisiphi isici esivumela i-nitric oxide ukuthi isebenze kuphela emabangeni amafushane?
answer8: Inesikhathi esifushane kakhulu sokuphila
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kangcono ama-ligand angenamanzi kanye nancibilikayo emanzini?
answer9: Ama-ligand angenawo umoya ngokuvamile abopha ama-receptor angaphakathi kweseli, kuyilapho ama-ligand ancibilikayo emanzini ngokuvamile abopha ama-receptor angaphandle kweseli
distractor9a: Ama-ligand angenawo umoya ahlanganisa iziteshi ze-ion kuphela, kuyilapho ama-ligand ancibilika emanzini ebopha ama-receptor enuzi
distractor9b: Zombili izinhlobo kumele ziqale zingene ku-nucleus ngaphambi kokubonisa izimpawu
distractor9c: Zombili izinhlobo zisabalala ngokukhululeka nge-plasma membrane
question10: Yiliphi kula ma-molecule alandelayo eliyingxenye ebalulekile ye-membrane kanye nesandulela sama-hormone e-steroid?
answer10: I-cholesterol

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.2 Ukusabalala Kwesignali | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.2 Ukusabalala Kwesignali | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwesignali, uchungechunge lwamaprotheni adluliselwa ngaphakathi kwe-cytoplasm yeseli eliqondiwe luvuselela amaprotheni aqondiwe, okuholela ekuphenduleni kweseli. Lawa ma-cascade ayinkimbinkimbi ngenxa yokusebenzisana phakathi kwamaprotheni. Umthelela obalulekile kuma-cascade okubonisana kweseli yi-phosphorylation yama-molecule ngama-enzyme aziwa ngokuthi ama-kinase. (I-phosphorylation yezinga le-substrate yafundwa lapho ufunda nge-glycolysis.) Ngokufaka iqembu le-phosphate, i-phosphorylation ishintsha izimo zamaprotheni. Lolu shintsho lwesimo luyawavuselela noma luwaqede amandla. Izithunywa zesibili, isibonelo, i-cAMP ne-Ca2+, zivame ukusetshenziswa ukudlulisa izimpawu ngaphakathi kweseli.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.D
Amaseli ayaxhumana ngokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa nokwamukela izimpawu zamakhemikhali.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.D.3 Izindlela zokudlulisela izimpawu zixhumanisa ukwamukelwa kwezimpawu nokuphendula kwamaseli.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.5 Umfundi angaphinda aveze izakhi ezibalulekile zezehlakalo zemvelo kuzo zonke izethulo eziningi kulesi sizinda.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.36 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza imodeli eveza izakhi ezibalulekile zezindlela zokudlulisela izimpawu lapho isignali iguqulwa khona ibe impendulo yeselula.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Isayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[I-APLO 3.33][I-APLO 3.4][I-APLO 4.22][I-APLO 2.5][I-APLO 3.32][I-APLO 3.38]

 Uma i-ligand ibopha kwi-receptor, isignali idluliselwa nge-membrane bese ingena kwi-cytoplasm. Ukuqhubeka kwesignali ngale ndlela kubizwa ngokuthi i-signal transduction. I-signal transduction kwenzeka kuphela ngama-receptor asebusweni beseli ngoba ama-receptor angaphakathi akwazi ukusebenzisana ngqo ne-DNA ku-nucleus ukuze aqalise ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni.

 Lapho i-ligand ibopha kwi-receptor yayo, kwenzeka izinguquko zesakhiwo ezithinta isizinda sangaphakathi kweseli se-receptor. Izinguquko zesakhiwo sesizinda esingaphandle kweseli lapho i-ligand ibopha zingasakazeka esifundeni se-membrane se-receptor futhi ziholele ekusebenzeni kwesizinda sangaphakathi kweseli noma amaprotheni ahlobene nayo. Kwezinye izimo, ukubopha kwe-ligand kubangela ukufinyela kwe-receptor, okusho ukuthi ama-receptor amabili ayabophana ukuze akhe i-complex ezinzile ebizwa ngokuthi i-dimer. I-dimer iyinhlanganisela yamakhemikhali eyakhiwa lapho ama-molecule amabili (ngokuvamile afanayo) ehlangana ndawonye. Ukubopha kwama-receptor ngale ndlela kwenza izizinda zawo zangaphakathi kweseli zikwazi ukuxhumana eduze futhi zisebenze ndawonye.
question1: Kuyini ukudluliselwa kwesignali?
answer1: Inqubo lapho isignali idluliselwa khona isuka ku-receptor esebusweni beseli iye ku-cytoplasm ukuze ikhiqize impendulo yeselula
distractor1a: Ukuhamba kwama-ligand egazini kuya kumaseli aqondiwe
distractor1b: Ukusabalala kwe-DNA kusuka ku-nucleus kuya ku-cytoplasm
question2: Kungani ukudluliselwa kwesignali kwenzeka kuphela ngama-receptor asebusweni beseli?
answer2: Ama-receptor angaphakathi angasebenzisana ngqo ne-DNA ku-nucleus ukuze alawule ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor2a: Ama-receptor angaphezulu kweseli awakwazi ukubopha ama-ligand ngqo
distractor2c: Ama-receptor angaphezulu kweseli awakwazi ukwenza amaprotheni angaphakathi kweseli asebenze
question3: Yimaphi ama-enzyme avame ukusabalalisa ukusayinwa kwangaphakathi kwamangqamuzana ngokufaka amaqembu e-phosphate kumaprotheni?
question4: Iyini imiphumela eyinhloko ye-phosphorylation ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwesignali?
answer4: Ishintsha isimo samaprotheni, iwavuselele noma iwaqede amandla
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okusebenza njengesithunywa sesibili ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwesignali?
question6: Yimuphi umbhangqwana owakhiwe ngokuphelele yizithunywa zesibili ezivamile?
answer6: I-cAMP kanye ne-Ca2+
question7: Yiluphi ushintsho lwesakhiwo oluvame ukwenzeka lapho i-ligand ibopha ama-receptor athile asebusweni bamaseli?
answer7: Ama-receptor amabili ayahlangana ukuze akhe i-dimer
distractor7c: I-ligand ingena ku-nucleus ngaphandle kokubandakanyeka kwe-receptor
question8: Kungani i-receptor dimerization ingathuthukisa ukudluliswa kwesignali?
answer8: Kusondeza izizinda zangaphakathi kweseli ngokwanele ukuze kusebenze omunye komunye
distractor8a: Ivumela ama-receptor ukuthi asakazeke nge-plasma membrane
question9: Izinguquko zesimo se-receptor zisiza kanjani ekudlulisweni kwesignali?
answer9: Ukubopha i-ligand kushintsha ukuma kwama-receptor, kusebenze isizinda sangaphakathi kweseli noma amaprotheni ahlobene nawo.
distractor9b: Zivula unomphela zonke iziteshi ze-ion ze-membrane
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono indlela izindlela zokudlulisela isignali ezikhulisa ngayo isignali yangaphandle?
answer10: I-receptor eyodwa esebenzayo iqala uchungechunge lwamaprotheni angaphakathi kweseli kanye nezithunywa zesibili, okwandisa kakhulu impendulo yamaseli
distractor10a: I-receptor ngayinye ibopha amakhulu ama-ligand ngesikhathi esisodwa
distractor10c: Ukwandiswa kwesignali kwenzeka kuphela ngemva kokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.2 Ukusabalala Kwesignali | Ukubopha Kuqala Indlela Yokubonisa
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.2 Ukusabalala Kwesignali | Ukubopha Kuqala Indlela Yokubonisa
chapterContent:
Ngemva kokuba i-ligand ibopha i-receptor esebusweni beseli, ukusebenza kwezingxenye zangaphakathi kweseli ye-receptor kuqalisa uchungechunge lwezehlakalo olubizwa ngokuthi indlela yokubonisa noma i-cascade yokubonisa. Endleleni yokubonisa, izithunywa zesibili, ama-enzyme, kanye namaprotheni asebenzayo asebenzisana namaprotheni athile, nawo asebenza ngokusabela kweketanga okuholela ekushintsheni kwendawo yeseli (Isithombe 9.10). Izehlakalo ezise-cascade zenzeka ngochungechunge, njengokugeleza komswakama emfuleni. Ukusebenzisana okwenzeka ngaphambi kwephuzu elithile kuchazwa njengezehlakalo ezikhuphukayo, kanti izehlakalo ngemuva kwalelo phuzu zibizwa ngokuthi izehlakalo eziphansi.

 Izindlela zokubonisa zingaba yinkimbinkimbi kakhulu ngokushesha ngoba amaprotheni amaningi eseli angathinta izehlakalo ezihlukene eziphansi, kuye ngezimo ezingaphakathi kweseli. Indlela eyodwa ingahlukana iye ezindaweni zokugcina ezihlukene ngokusekelwe ekusebenzisaneni phakathi kwezindlela ezimbili noma ngaphezulu zokubonisa, futhi ama-ligand afanayo avame ukusetshenziselwa ukuqala izimpawu ezihlukene ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zamaseli. Lokhu kuhlukahluka kokuphendula kungenxa yokwehluka kokubonakaliswa kwamaprotheni ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zamaseli. Esinye isici esiyinkimbinkimbi ukuhlanganiswa kwezimpawu zezindlela, lapho izimpawu ezivela kuma-receptor amabili noma ngaphezulu ahlukene eseli-surface zihlangana khona ukuze kusebenze impendulo efanayo esitokisini. Le nqubo ingaqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo eziningi zangaphandle ziyahlangatshezwa ngaphambi kokuba iseli lizibophezele empendulweni ethile.

 Imiphumela yezibonakaliso zangaphandle ingakhuliswa futhi ngama-cascade e-enzyme. Ekuqaleni kwesignali, i-ligand eyodwa ibopha kwi-receptor eyodwa. Kodwa-ke, ukusebenza kwe-enzyme exhunywe kwi-receptor kungenza kusebenze amakhophi amaningi engxenye ye-cascade yesignali, ekhulisa isignali.
question1: Yisiphi isenzakalo esilandela ngqo ukubopha kwe-ligand kwi-receptor yobuso beseli?
answer1: Ukusebenza kwezingxenye zangaphakathi kweseli zama-receptor kuqalisa indlela yokubonisana
distractor1a: I-ligand ingena ku-nucleus bese ibopha i-DNA
question2: Liyini elinye igama lendlela yokubonisa izimpawu?
question3: Yimaphi ama-molecule avame ukubamba iqhaza ezindleleni zokubonisana?
question4: Endleleni yokubonisa izimpawu, izenzakalo ezikhuphukayo yilezo
answer4: Kwenzeka ngaphambi kwephuzu elithile ku-cascade yesiginali
question5: Kungani i-ligand efanayo ingakhiqiza izimpendulo ezahlukene ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zamaseli?
answer5: Izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli ziveza amaprotheni ahlukene ahilelekile ezindleleni zokubonisana
distractor5a: I-ligand ngayinye ishintsha isakhiwo sayo ezicutshini ezahlukene
distractor5b: Izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli zinezigcawu ze-DNA ezahlukene ze-ATP
distractor5c: Ama-Ligand abopha ama-receptor kuphela ezigabeni ezithile zomjikelezo weseli
question6: Kuyini ukuhlanganiswa kwesignali?
answer6: Izimpawu ezivela kuma-receptor amabili noma ngaphezulu ziyahlangana ukuze kusebenze impendulo efanayo yeselula
distractor6b: I-receptor ibopha ama-ligand amabili ngesikhathi esisodwa
distractor6c: Ama-ligand amabili ahlangana unomphela ngaphambi kokubopha kwe-receptor
question7: Iyini inzuzo eyodwa yokuhlanganiswa kwesignali?
answer7: Ivumela iseli ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimo eziningi zangaphandle ziyahlangatshezwa ngaphambi kokuphendula
distractor7b: Kuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke i-ligand ikhiqiza impendulo efanayo
distractor7c: Isebenza unomphela zonke izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu
question8: Izimpawu zangaphandle kweseli zivame ukukhuliswa kanjani ngaphakathi kweseli?
answer8: I-enzyme exhunywe yi-receptor isebenzisa amakhophi amaningi ezingxenye zokubonisa ezingezansi komfula
distractor8a: I-ligand ngayinye ibopha ngokuphindaphindiwe i-receptor efanayo ngesikhathi esisodwa
distractor8b: I-receptor iyaziphinda kabili ngemva kokubopha i-ligand
distractor8c: I-ligand ikopishwa ibe ama-molecule amaningi afanayo
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani izindlela zokubonisana zivame ukuba yinkimbinkimbi kakhulu?
answer9: Amaprotheni angalawula imigomo eminingi engezansi, futhi izindlela ezahlukene zingahlangana futhi zisebenzisane
distractor9a: Indlela ngayinye yokubonisana iqukethe iphrotheni eyodwa kuphela
distractor9b: Yonke indlela yokuthumela izimpawu ikhiqiza impendulo efanayo yeselula
distractor9c: Ama-Ligand abopha wonke ama-receptor kahle ngokulinganayo
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukukhuliswa kwesignali ku-cascade yesignali?
answer10: Ukusebenzisana kwe-ligand-receptor eyodwa kungabangela ukusebenza kwama-molecule amaningi angaphansi komfula, okwandisa kakhulu amandla empendulo yamaseli
distractor10a: I-molecule ngayinye esezansi ivuselela i-receptor eyodwa kuphela engenhla
distractor10b: Ukwandiswa kwesignali kwenzeka kuphela ngemva kokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA
distractor10c: Ama-ligand amaningi kumele abophe i-receptor efanayo ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke noma yikuphi ukusabela

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.2 Ukusabalala Kwesignali | Izindlela Zokusayinisa Kwangaphakathi Kweseli | I-Phosphorylation
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.2 Ukusabalala Kwesignali | Izindlela Zokusayinisa Kwangaphakathi Kweseli | I-Phosphorylation
chapterContent:
Ukungeniswa kwendlela yokubonisa kuncike ekuguqulweni kwengxenye yeselula yi-enzyme. Kunezinguquko eziningi ze-enzyme ezingase zenzeke, futhi ziqashelwa ngokulandelana yingxenye elandelayo ezansi. Okulandelayo ezinye zezenzakalo ezivame kakhulu ekuboniseni kwangaphakathi kweseli.

 I-Phosphorylation
Enye yezinguquko zamakhemikhali ezivame kakhulu ezenzeka ezindleleni zokubonisana ukwengeza iqembu le-phosphate (PO4-3) ku-molecule efana neprotheni enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-phosphorylation. I-phosphate ingangezwa ku-nucleotide efana ne-GMP ukuze yakhe i-GDP noma i-GTP. Ama-phosphate avame ukungezwa kuma-serine, threonine, kanye nama-tyrosine residues amaprotheni, lapho athatha khona indawo yeqembu le-hydroxyl le-amino acid (Isithombe 9.11). Ukudluliselwa kwe-phosphate kwenziwa yi-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-kinase. Ama-kinase ahlukahlukene aqanjwa nge-substrate ayenza i-phosphorylate. I-Phosphorylation yama-serine nama-threonine residues ivame ukusebenza ngama-enzyme. I-phosphorylation yezinsalela ze-tyrosine ingathinta umsebenzi we-enzyme noma idale indawo yokubopha esebenzisana nezingxenye ezingezansi ku-cascade yesiginali. I-phosphorylation ingase isebenze noma ivale ama-enzyme, futhi ukuguqulwa kwe-phosphorylation, i-dephosphorylation yi-phosphatase, kuzoguqula umphumela.
question1: Kuyini i-phosphorylation?
answer1: Ukwengezwa kweqembu le-phosphate ku-molecule efana neprotheni
distractor1c: Ukudluliselwa kwama-electron kusuka ku-NADH kuya ku-oxygen
question2: Yimuphi i-enzyme ekhuthaza ukudluliselwa kweqembu le-phosphate ngesikhathi se-phosphorylation?
question3: Yimuphi i-enzyme eguqula i-phosphorylation?
question4: I-phosphorylation ivame ukuguqula uhlobo luni lwe-molecule yeselula ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwesignali?
question5: Yiziphi izinsalela ze-amino acid ezivame ukuphosphorylated ngesikhathi sokusayina kwangaphakathi kweseli?
question6: I-phosphorylation yezinsalela ze-serine ne-threonine ivame ukuba namuphi umphumela?
answer6: Ivuselela ama-enzyme
question7: Yimuphi umphumela obalulekile we-tyrosine phosphorylation?
answer7: Kungadala indawo yokubopha amaprotheni okubonisana angezansi
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle indima ye-phosphorylation ezindleleni zokubonisa izimpawu?
answer8: I-phosphorylation ingase isebenze noma ivimbele ama-enzyme kuye ngokuthi iphrotheni ehilelekile
question9: Yimuphi i-nucleotide engakhiwa yi-phosphorylation ye-GMP?
answer9: I-GDP noma i-GTP
question10: Kungani i-phosphorylation eguquguqukayo iyindlela ephumelelayo yokulawula ukudluliselwa kwesignali?
answer10: Ama-Kinase nama-phosphatase angashintsha ngokushesha amaprotheni okubonisana phakathi kwezimo ezisebenzayo nezingasebenzi
distractor10a: I-phosphorylation isebenza unomphela yonke iphrotheni yokubonisa
distractor10b: Ama-phosphatase kuphela alawula izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.2 Ukusabalala Kwesignali | Izindlela Zokusayina Kwangaphakathi Kweseli | Izithunywa Zesibili
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.2 Ukusabalala Kwesignali | Izindlela Zokusayina Kwangaphakathi Kweseli | Izithunywa Zesibili
chapterContent:
Ukungeniswa kwendlela yokubonisa kuncike ekuguqulweni kwengxenye yeselula yi-enzyme. Kunezinguquko eziningi ze-enzyme ezingase zenzeke, futhi ziqashelwa ngokulandelana yingxenye elandelayo ezansi. Okulandelayo ezinye zezenzakalo ezivame kakhulu ekuboniseni kwangaphakathi kweseli.

 Izithunywa Zesibili
Izithunywa zesibili zingama-molecule amancane asakaza isignali ngemva kokuba iqalwe ukubopha kwe-molecule yokubonisa ku-receptor. Lawa ma-molecule asiza ukusabalalisa isignali nge-cytoplasm ngokushintsha ukuziphatha kwamaprotheni athile eseli.

 I-calcium ion iyisithunywa sesibili esisetshenziswa kabanzi. Ukuhlushwa kwamahhala kwama-ion e-calcium (Ca2+) ngaphakathi kweseli kuphansi kakhulu ngoba amaphampu e-ion ku-membrane ye-plasma asebenzisa njalo i-adenosine-5-triphosphate (ATP) ukuyisusa. Ngezinjongo zokubonisa, i-Ca2+ igcinwa kuma-vesicle e-cytoplasmic, njenge-endoplasmic reticulum, noma efinyelelwa ngaphandle kweseli. Uma kwenzeka izimpawu, iziteshi ze-calcium ion ezine-ligand zivumela amazinga aphezulu e-Ca2+ akhona ngaphandle kweseli (noma ezindaweni zokugcina zangaphakathi kweseli) ukuthi agelezele kwi-cytoplasm, okuphakamisa ukugcwala kwe-cytoplasmic Ca2+. Impendulo yokwanda kwe-Ca2+ iyahlukahluka, kuye ngohlobo lweseli oluhilelekile. Isibonelo, kumaseli e-β e-pancreas, izimpawu ze-Ca2+ ziholela ekukhishweni kwe-insulin, futhi kumaseli emisipha, ukwanda kwe-Ca2+ kuholela ekuncipheni kwemisipha.

 Esinye isithunywa sesibili esisetshenziswa ezinhlotsheni eziningi ezahlukene zamaseli yi-cyclic AMP (cAMP). I-cyclic AMP yenziwa yi-enzyme i-adenylyl cyclase evela ku-ATP (Isithombe 9.12). Indima eyinhloko ye-cAMP kumaseli ukubopha nokusebenzisa i-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-cAMP-dependent kinase (A-kinase). I-A-kinase ilawula izindlela eziningi ezibalulekile ze-metabolic: I-phosphorylates serine kanye ne-threonine residues yamaphrotheni ayo aqondiwe, iwasebenzise enkambisweni. I-A-kinase itholakala ezinhlotsheni eziningi ezahlukene zamaseli, futhi amaprotheni aqondiwe kuhlobo ngalunye lweseli ahlukile. Umehluko udala ukwehluka kwezimpendulo ku-cAMP kumaseli ahlukene.

 Ekhona ngamanani amancane ku-plasma membrane, ama-inositol phospholipids angama-lipid angaguqulwa abe yizithunywa zesibili. Ngenxa yokuthi la ma-molecule ayizingxenye ze-membrane, atholakala eduze kwama-receptor aboshwe yi-membrane futhi angasebenzisana nawo kalula. I-Phosphatidylinositol (PI) iyi-phospholipid eyinhloko edlala indima ekusayineni kwamaseli. Ama-enzyme aziwa ngokuthi ama-kinases phosphorylate PI ukwakha i-PI-phosphate (PIP) kanye ne-PI-bisphosphate (PIP2).

 I-enzyme phospholipase C ihlukanisa i-PIP2 ukuze yakhe i-diacylglycerol (DAG) kanye ne-inositol triphosphate (IP3) (Isithombe 9.13). Le mikhiqizo yokuqhekeka kwe-PIP2 isebenza njengezithunywa zesibili. I-Diacylglycerol (DAG) ihlala ku-plasma membrane futhi ivuselela i-protein kinase C (PKC), bese i-phosphorylates serine kanye ne-threonine residues kumaprotheni ayo aqondiwe. I-IP3 isakazeka ku-cytoplasm futhi ibopha iziteshi ze-calcium ezivikelwe yi-ligand ku-endoplasmic reticulum ukuze ikhiphe i-Ca2+ eqhubeka nochungechunge lwesignali.
question1: Ziyini izithunywa zesibili?
answer1: Ama-molecule amancane asakaza isignali ngemva kokuba i-molecule esayinayo ibophezele ku-receptor yayo
question2: Kungani ukuhlushwa kwe-Ca2+ yamahhala ngokuvamile kuphansi kakhulu ku-cytoplasm?
answer2: Amaphampu e-ion asebenza nge-ATP asusa i-Ca2+ njalo ku-cytoplasm
distractor2c: I-Ca2+ ayikwazi ukungena kumaseli nganoma yiziphi iziteshi ze-membrane
question3: I-Ca2+ igcinwa kuphi ukuze isetshenziswe ekudluliseni kwangaphakathi kweseli?
question4: Kwenzekani lapho iziteshi ze-calcium ezivalwe nge-ligand zivuleka ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwesignali?
answer4: I-Ca2+ igeleza iye kwi-cytoplasm, ikhulisa ukuhlushwa kwayo
question5: Kumaseli e-pancreatic β, ukwanda kwe-cytoplasmic Ca2+ kuyimbangela eqondile kakhulu
question6: Yimuphi i-enzyme ehlanganisa i-cyclic AMP (cAMP) kusuka ku-ATP?
answer6: I-adenylyl cyclase
question7: Iyini indima eyinhloko ye-cAMP ekudlulisweni kwesignali?
answer7: Ivuselela i-kinase encike ku-cAMP (A-kinase)
question8: Yimuphi i-enzyme ehlukanisa i-PIP2 ibe yi-DAG kanye ne-IP3?
answer8: I-phospholipase C
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle izindima ze-DAG ne-IP3?
answer9: I-DAG ihlala ku-plasma membrane futhi isebenzisa i-protein kinase C, kuyilapho i-IP3 isakazeka ku-cytoplasm futhi ikhipha i-Ca2+ ku-endoplasmic reticulum.
distractor9a: I-DAG isakazeka iye ku-nucleus kuyilapho i-IP3 isebenzisa i-adenylyl cyclase
distractor9b: Kokubili i-DAG ne-IP3 kusebenze ngqo i-cAMP-dependent kinase
distractor9c: I-DAG kanye ne-IP3 ziguqulwa zibe yi-ATP ngaphambi kokuba ukusayinwa kuqhubeke
question10: Isithunywa sesibili esifanayo singakhiqiza kanjani izimpendulo ezahlukene ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zamaseli?
answer10: Izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli ziqukethe amaprotheni ahlukene aqondiwe asabela kumthunywa wesibili ofanayo
distractor10a: Izithunywa zesibili zishintsha unomphela ukulandelana kwe-DNA kuwo wonke amaseli
distractor10b: Isithunywa sesibili ngasinye sisebenza ohlotsheni olulodwa lweseli
distractor10c: Izithunywa zesibili zivuselela izindlela ezifanayo ze-metabolic kuzo zonke izinhlobo zamaseli

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukuqaliswa kwendlela yokubonisa izimpawu kuholela ekuphenduleni kweseli ezinguqukweni endaweni yangaphandle. Lokhu kusabela kungathatha izinhlobo eziningi ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukwakheka kwamaprotheni, ushintsho ekusetshenzisweni kweseli, ukuhlukaniswa nokukhula kweseli, noma ngisho nokufa kweseli. Njengoba sizohlola ngokuningiliziwe ezahlukweni ezizayo, ezinye izindlela zivuselela ama-enzyme asebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinto zokubhala ze-DNA ukukhuthaza ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo, ezinye zingabangela amangqamuzana ukuthi agcine amandla njenge-glycogen njengamafutha, noma kuholele ekutholakaleni kwamandla amahhala ngesimo se-glucose. Ukuhlukaniswa nokukhula kweseli cishe njalo kukhuthazwa izimpawu zangaphandle ezibizwa ngokuthi izici zokukhula; uma kungalawulwa, ukukhula kweseli kuholela kumdlavuza. Ukufa kweseli okuhleliwe, noma i-apoptosis, kususa amangqamuzana alimele noma angadingekile futhi kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukisweni, okuhlanganisa ukwakheka kweminwe nezinzwane. Ukuqedwa kwe-cascade yokubonisa izimpawu zeseli kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impendulo yesignali ifanelekile ngesikhathi kanye namandla. Ukuwohloka kwama-molecule okubonisa izimpawu kanye nokususwa kwe-phosphorylation kwama-intermediate path kuyizindlela ezimbili izimpawu eziqedwa ngazo ngaphakathi kwamaseli. Izimo lapho izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu zivinjiwe noma zinephutha zingaba yingozi, zivimbele, noma zivimbele; izibonelo zifaka phakathi isifo sikashukela, isifo senhliziyo, isifo sokuzivikela komzimba, ubuthi, imithi yokubulala izinzwa, kanye namaphilisi okulawula ukuzalwa.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 3 kanye no-Big Idea 2 woHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi olusekelwe ebholeni lokucwaninga, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.D
Amaseli axhumana ngokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa nokwamukela izimpawu zamakhemikhali.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.D.4 Izinguquko ezindleleni zokudlulisela izimpawu zingashintsha impendulo yeselula.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.5 Umfundi angaphinda aveze izakhi ezibalulekile zezehlakalo zemvelo kuzo zonke izethulo eziningi kulesi sizinda.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.36 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza imodeli eveza izakhi ezibalulekile zezindlela zokudlulisela isignali lapho isignali iguqulwa khona ibe impendulo yeselula.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.D.4 Izinguquko ezindleleni zokudlulisela isignali zingashintsha impendulo yeselula.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.1 Umfundi angathethelela izimangalo ngobufakazi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.37 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusekela izimangalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini besayensi bokuthi izinguquko ezindleleni zokudlulisela isignali zingashintsha impendulo yeselula.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.D.4 Izinguquko ezindleleni zokudlulisela isignali zingashintsha impendulo yeselula.
Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.39 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha incazelo yokuthi imithi ethile ithinta kanjani ukwamukelwa kwesignali, futhi ngenxa yalokho, izindlela zokudluliselwa kwesignali.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zebhayoloji zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.E
Izinqubo eziningi zebhayoloji ezihilelekile ekukhuleni, ekuzaleni nasekuhlanganiseni kwe-homeostasis enamandla zifaka phakathi ukulawulwa kwesikhathi kanye nokuxhumanisa.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.E.1 Isikhathi kanye nokuxhumanisa izehlakalo ezithile kuyadingeka ekuthuthukisweni okuvamile kwesidalwa, futhi lezi zehlakalo zilawulwa izindlela ezahlukahlukene.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
7.1 Umfundi angaxhumanisa izehlakalo namamodeli kuzo zonke izikali zendawo nezesikhathi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.34 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza indima yokufa kweseli okuhleliwe ekuthuthukisweni nasekuhlukaniseni, ukusetshenziswa kabusha kwama-molecule, kanye nokugcinwa kwe-homeostasis enamandla.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Isayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[APLO 3.33][APLO 3.35]

 Ngaphakathi kweseli, ama-ligand abopha kuma-receptor awo angaphakathi, okuwavumela ukuthi athinte ngqo i-DNA yeseli kanye nemishini ekhiqiza amaprotheni. Besebenzisa izindlela zokudlulisa isignali, ama-receptor ku-plasma membrane akhiqiza imiphumela eyahlukahlukene kuseli. Imiphumela yezindlela zokuthumela isignali ihlukahlukene kakhulu futhi incike ohlotsheni lweseli elihilelekile kanye nezimo zangaphandle nezangaphakathi. Isampula encane yezimpendulo ichazwe ngezansi.
question1: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungaba impendulo yeselula ekudlulisweni kwesignali?
answer1: Ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni
distractor1b: Ukwakheka kodonga lweseli kuwo wonke amaseli
question2: Iyiphi inqubo esusa amaseli alimele noma angadingekile ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa?
question3: Kungani ukufa kweseli okuhleliwe (i-apoptosis) kubalulekile ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa?
answer3: Isusa amangqamuzana angadingekile futhi isiza ekwakheni izicubu ezisakhula njengeminwe nezinzwane
distractor3b: Kukhiqiza izici zokukhula ezidingekayo ukuze kutholakale i-mitosis
question4: Yiziphi izimpawu zangaphandle ezivame ukukhuthaza ukuhlukana nokukhula kwamaseli?
question5: Kungani izindlela zokubonisana kwamaseli kufanele ziqedwe ngemva kokusebenza?
answer5: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impendulo yeselula inesikhathi esifanele kanye namandla afanele
question6: Iyiphi inqubo esiza ekuqedeni izindlela zokubonisana zangaphakathi kweseli?
answer6: Ukususwa kwe-phosphorylation kwamaprotheni okubonisa
question7: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungaqeda nendlela yokubonisa izimpawu?
answer7: Ukuwohloka kwama-molecule esignaling
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani ukusayinwa kwamaseli okungalawulwa kungaholela kumdlavuza?
answer8: Ukusebenza okuqhubekayo kokubonisa ukukhula kubangela ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okungalawulwa
distractor8a: Umdlavuza uvela kuphela uma i-apoptosis isanda
question9: Izinguquko ezindleleni zokudlulisela isignali zingathinta kanjani umzimba?
answer9: Zingashintsha izimpendulo ezivamile zamaseli futhi zibe nomthelela ezifweni ezifana nesifo sikashukela, isifo senhliziyo, noma izifo ezizimele
distractor9b: Zishintsha ukulandelana kwe-DNA kuwo wonke amaseli
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-receptors nezimpendulo zamaselula?
answer10: Impendulo yeseli incike ohlotsheni lweseli, i-receptor ehilelekile, kanye nezimo zangaphandle nezangaphakathi.
distractor10a: I-receptor ngayinye ihlala ikhiqiza impendulo efanayo kuwo wonke amaseli
distractor10b: Izimpendulo zeselula zincike kuphela ekugxilweni kwe-ligand
distractor10c: Ama-receptor angaphakathi ahlala edinga ukuhanjiswa kwesignali ngaphambi kokuthinta ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukuvezwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukuvezwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo
chapterContent:
Ezinye izindlela zokudlulisa isignali zilawula ukubhalwa kwe-RNA. Ezinye zilawula ukuhumusha kwamaprotheni avela ku-mRNA. Isibonelo seprotheyini elawula ukuhumusha ku-nucleus yi-MAP kinase ERK. I-ERK iyasebenza ku-cascade ye-phosphorylation lapho i-epidermal growth factor (EGF) ibopha i-EGF receptor (bheka Umfanekiso 9.10). Lapho i-phosphorylation, i-ERK ingena ku-nucleus bese ivuselela i-protein kinase, yona elawula ukuhumusha kwamaprotheni (Umfanekiso 9.14).

 Uhlobo lwesibili lweprotheyini i-PKC engasebenzisana nayo yiprotheyini esebenza njengesivimbeli. Isivimbeli yi-molecule ebopha iprotheyini futhi iyivimbele ekusebenzeni noma ekunciphiseni umsebenzi wayo. Kulokhu, isivimbeli yiprotheyini ebizwa ngokuthi i-Iκ-B, ebopha iphrotheyini elawulayo i-NF-κB. (Uphawu κ lumelela uhlamvu lwesiGreki u-kappa.) Uma i-Iκ-B iboshelwe ku-NF-κB, i-complex ayikwazi ukungena ku-nucleus yeseli, kodwa uma i-Iκ-B i-phosphorylated yi-PKC, ayisakwazi ukubopha i-NF-κB, futhi i-NF-κB (i-transcription factor) ingangena ku-nucleus futhi iqalise ukubhalwa kwe-RNA. Kulokhu, umphumela we-phosphorylation uwukuvimbela i-inhibitor ngaleyo ndlela kusebenze inqubo yokubhalwa.
question1: Ezinye izindlela zokudlulisa isignali zilawula ngqo yiphi inqubo yeselula?
answer1: Ukubhalwa kwe-RNA
question2: Yiliphi iphrotheni yokubonisa evuselelwa yi-phosphorylation cascade ngemva kokuba i-epidermal growth factor (EGF) ibophe i-receptor yayo?
question3: Ngemva kokusebenzisa, i-ERK ingena kuliphi igumbi leselula?
question4: Yini eyenziwa yi-ERK esebenzayo ngemva kokungena ku-nucleus?
answer4: Ivuselela i-protein kinase elawula ukuhumusha i-protein
question5: Uyini umsebenzi weprotheyini i-Iκ-B?
answer5: Ivimbela i-NF-κB ngokuyibopha futhi iyivimbele ukuthi ingangeni ku-nucleus
question6: Uhlobo luni lweprotheni i-NF-κB?
answer6: Isici sokubhala
question7: Kwenzekani uma i-PKC i-phosphorylates i-Iκ-B?
answer7: I-Iκ-B ayisakwazi ukubopha i-NF-κB, okuvumela i-NF-κB ukuthi ingene ku-nucleus
question8: I-phosphorylation iyenza kanjani isebenze i-transcription endleleni ye-NF-κB?
answer8: Ivimbela i-Iκ-B inhibitor, ivumela i-NF-κB ukuthi iqalise ukubhalwa kwe-RNA
distractor8a: I-phosphorylates ngqo i-RNA polymerase ukuze yenze i-DNA
distractor8b: Iyawohloza i-NF-κB ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukulotshwa
distractor8c: Ivimbela izinto zokubhala ukuthi zingangeni ku-nucleus
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle ukuthi i-phosphorylation ingaba nemiphumela ehlukene kuye ngeprotheni eqondiwe?
answer9: I-phosphorylation ingase isebenze ngqo iphrotheni eyodwa ngenkathi ingasebenzi enye iphrotheni esebenza njengomvimbeli
distractor9a: I-Phosphorylation ihlala isebenza kuwo wonke amaprotheni ayiguqulayo
distractor9b: I-phosphorylation ihlala ivimbela yonke iphrotheni eyiguqulayo
question10: Yikuphi ukulandelana okuchaza kahle indlela eyodwa yokubonisana elawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer10: I-EGF ibopha i-receptor yayo → I-ERK ivuselelwa yi-phosphorylation → I-ERK ingena ku-nucleus → i-protein kinase ivuselelwa ukulawula ukuhumusha kweprotheni
distractor10a: I-EGF ibopha i-receptor yayo → I-NF-κB yonakele → I-ERK iphuma ku-nucleus → Ukuhumusha kuyama
distractor10b: I-EGF ibopha i-receptor yayo → I-ATP ikhiqizwa ngqo → I-DNA iyaphindaphindwa
distractor10c: I-EGF ibopha i-receptor yayo → I-PKC ishiya iseli → I-RNA yonakele

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukwanda Kwe-Metabolism Yeseli
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukwanda Kwe-Metabolism Yeseli
chapterContent: Umphumela wenye indlela yokubonisa umthelela kumangqamuzana emisipha. Ukusebenza kwama-receptor e-β-adrenergic kumaseli emisipha yi-adrenaline kuholela ekwandeni kwe-AMP (cAMP) ejikelezayo ngaphakathi kweseli. Eyaziwa nangokuthi i-epinephrine, i-adrenaline iyi-hormone (ekhiqizwa yi-adrenal gland enamathele ezinso) elungiselela umzimba izimo eziphuthumayo zesikhashana. I-AMP ye-cyclic isebenzisa i-PKA (i-protein kinase A), ephinde isebenzise ama-enzyme amabili. I-enzyme yokuqala ikhuthaza ukuwohloka kwe-glycogen ngokusebenzisa i-glycogen phosphorylase kinase (GPK) ephakathi nendawo ephinde isebenze i-glycogen phosphorylase (GP) eguqula i-glycogen ibe yi-glucose. (Khumbula ukuthi umzimba wakho uguqula i-glucose eyengeziwe ibe yi-glycogen ukuze igcinwe isikhathi esifushane. Uma kudingeka amandla, i-glycogen iguqulwa ngokushesha ibe yi-glucose.) I-phosphorylation ye-enzyme yesibili, i-glycogen synthase (GS), ivimbela ikhono layo lokwenza i-glycogen kusuka ku-glucose. Ngale ndlela, iseli lemisipha lithola ichibi elilungele i-glucose ngokusebenzisa ukwakheka kwayo ngokuwohloka kwe-glycogen nangokuvimbela ukusetshenziswa kwe-glucose ukwakha i-glycogen, ngaleyo ndlela kuvinjelwe umjikelezo ongenamsebenzi wokuwohloka kwe-glycogen kanye nokwakheka kwayo. I-glucose itholakala ukuze isetshenziswe yiseli lemisipha ngenxa yokwanda okungazelelwe kwe-adrenaline—ukulwa noma ukubaleka”
question1: Yiliphi i-hormone elisebenzisa ama-receptor e-β-adrenergic kumaseli emisipha ngesikhathi sokulwa noma sokundiza?
answer1: I-adrenaline (i-epinephrine)
question2: Yisiphi isithunywa sesibili esikhula ngaphakathi kwamaseli emisipha ngemva kokusebenza kwe-β-adrenergic receptor?
question3: Iyiphi i-enzyme esebenza ngqo yi-cyclic AMP (cAMP) kule ndlela yokubonisa izimpawu?
question4: Yimuphi u-enzyme osebenza yi-protein kinase A (PKA) ukukhuthaza ukuwohloka kwe-glycogen?
question5: Yimuphi i-enzyme ekhuthaza ngqo ukuqhekeka kwe-glycogen ibe ushukela?
question6: Iyiphi ithonya i-phosphorylation enayo ku-glycogen synthase (GS)?
answer6: Ivimbela ukwakheka kwe-glycogen
question7: Kungani ukuwohloka kwe-glycogen kanye nokwakheka kwe-glycogen kulawulwa ngezindlela ezihlukile ngesikhathi sokulwa noma ukundiza?
answer7: Ukuvimbela umjikelezo ongenamsebenzi wokuwohloka kwe-glycogen kanye nokwakheka kwayo ngasikhathi sinye
question8: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yokuwohloka kwe-glycogen emaseli emisipha ngesikhathi sokwanda kwe-adrenaline?
answer8: Ihlinzeka ngokushesha nge-glucose yokukhiqizwa kwe-ATP
question9: Ikhiqizwa kuphi i-adrenaline (i-epinephrine)?
answer9: Indlala ye-adrenal enamathele ezinso
question10: Yiluphi uhlelo oluchaza kahle indlela yokubonisana eyandisa ukutholakala kwe-glucose kumaseli emisipha?
answer10: I-Adrenaline ibopha ama-receptor e-β-adrenergic → i-cAMP iyanda → I-PKA iyasebenza → i-glycogen phosphorylase kinase ivuselela i-glycogen phosphorylase kuyilapho i-glycogen synthase ivinjelwa
distractor10a: I-Adrenaline ibopha ama-receptor e-β-adrenergic → i-glycogen synthase iyasebenza → i-glycogen iyakhiwa
distractor10b: I-Adrenaline ibopha ama-receptor e-β-adrenergic → I-ATP iguqulwa ngqo ibe yi-glucose
distractor10c: I-Adrenaline ibopha ama-receptor e-β-adrenergic → i-cAMP iyancipha → i-glycogen phosphorylase iyavinjelwa

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukukhula Kweseli
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukukhula Kweseli
chapterContent: Izindlela zokubonisa amaseli nazo zidlala indima enkulu ekuhlukanisweni kwamaseli. Amaseli awavami ukuhlukana ngaphandle kokuthi ashukunyiswe yizibonakaliso ezivela kwamanye amaseli. Ama-ligand akhuthaza ukukhula kwamaseli abizwa ngokuthi izinto zokukhula. Izinto eziningi zokukhula zibopha kuma-receptor asebusweni bamaseli axhunywe kuma-tyrosine kinases. Lawa ma-receptor asebusweni bamaseli abizwa ngokuthi ama-receptor tyrosine kinases (ama-RTK). Ukusebenza kwama-RTK kuqala indlela yokubonisa ehlanganisa i-G-protein ebizwa ngokuthi i-RAS, evuselela indlela ye-MAP kinase echazwe ngaphambilini. I-enzyme i-MAP kinase ibe isivuselela ukuvezwa kwamaprotheni asebenzisana nezinye izingxenye zamaseli ukuqala ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli.
question1: Hlobo luni lwama-molecule okubonisa izimpawu avuselela ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okuvamile?
answer1: Izici zokukhula
question2: Ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile, amaseli avame ukuhlukana kuphela uma
question3: Izici eziningi zokukhula zibopha kuluphi uhlobo lwe-receptor?
question4: Ukusebenza kwe-receptor tyrosine kinases (RTKs) kuqala ngqo indlela yokubonisana ehilela yiphi i-G-protein?
question5: Yimuphi umzila wokubonisa osebenza ngaphansi kwe-RAS?
question6: Iyini indima eyinhloko ye-MAP kinase ekuboniseni ukukhula kwamaseli?
answer6: Kuvuselela ukuvezwa kwamaprotheni aqala ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
question7: Yiluphi uhlelo oluchaza kahle indlela yokubonisana eholela ekuhlukanisweni kweseli?
answer7: Isici sokukhula → i-receptor tyrosine kinase → i-RAS → i-MAP kinase → ukubonakaliswa kwamaprotheni okudingekayo ukuze kuhlukaniswe iseli
distractor7a: Isici sokukhula → i-MAP kinase → i-receptor tyrosine kinase → i-RAS → ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
distractor7b: Isici sokukhula → I-RAS → i-glycogen phosphorylase → i-MAP kinase → ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
distractor7c: Isici sokukhula → i-cAMP → i-ATP synthase → i-MAP kinase → ukuhlukaniswa kweseli
question8: Kungani izindlela zokubonisa izinto ezikhulisayo zilawulwa ngokuqinile ezintweni eziphilayo ezinempilo?
answer8: Ukusebenza okungalawulwa kungaholela ekuhlukanisweni kwamaseli okungalawulwa
distractor8b: Ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kwenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kombungu
distractor8c: I-MAP kinase imisa unomphela ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle indima yama-receptor tyrosine kinases ekuxhumaneni kwamaseli?
answer9: Bathola izibonakaliso ze-extracellular growth factor futhi baqalise ama-intracellular signaling cascades alawula ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
question10: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okusebenza unomphela iphrotheni ye-RAS cishe kuzoholela kumuphi umphumela?
answer10: Ukusebenza okuqhubekayo kwendlela ye-MAP kinase kanye nokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli ngokweqile
distractor10b: Ukwehluleka kwezinto zokukhula ukubopha ama-receptor tyrosine kinases

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginalini | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Isazi Sezinto Eziphilayo Zomdlavuza
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginalini | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Isazi Sezinto Eziphilayo Zomdlavuza
chapterContent:
Izazi zebhayoloji yomdlavuza zihlola imvelaphi yama-molecule yomdlavuza ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izindlela ezintsha zokuvimbela kanye namasu okwelapha azovimbela ukukhula kwezimila ngaphandle kokulimaza amangqamuzana ajwayelekile omzimba. Njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu zilawula ukukhula kwamaseli. Lezi zindlela zokubonisa izimpawu zilawulwa ngamaprotheni okubonisa izimpawu, nawo abonakaliswa yizakhi zofuzo. Ukuguquka kwalezi zakhi zofuzo kungabangela ukungasebenzi kahle kwamaprotheni okubonisa izimpawu. Lokhu kuvimbela iseli ekulawuleni umjikelezo walo weseli, okubangela ukuhlukana kwamaseli okungavinjelwe kanye nomdlavuza. Izakhi zofuzo ezilawula amaprotheni okubonisa izimpawu ziwuhlobo olulodwa lwe-oncogene, okuyizakhi zofuzo ezinamandla okubangela umdlavuza. Izakhi zofuzo ezifaka ikhodi ye-RAS yi-oncogene eyatholakala ekuqaleni lapho izinguquko kuprotheni ye-RAS zixhunyaniswe nomdlavuza. Izifundo ezengeziwe zikhombisile ukuthi amaphesenti angama-30 amaseli omdlavuza anokuguquka ku-gene ye-RAS okuholela ekukhuleni okungalawulwa. Uma kungashiywanga kuqashwe, ukuhlukana kwamaseli okungalawulwa kungaholela ekwakhekeni kwesimila kanye nokusabalala kwamangqamuzana, ukukhula kwamaseli omdlavuza ezindaweni ezintsha emzimbeni.

 Izazi zebhayoloji yomdlavuza zikwazile ukuhlonza ezinye i-oncogene eziningi ezifaka isandla ekuthuthukisweni komdlavuza. Isibonelo, i-HER2 iyi-receptor esebusweni bamaseli etholakala ngobuningi obukhulu kumaphesenti angama-20 omdlavuza webele kubantu. Izazi zebhayoloji yomdlavuza zaqaphela ukuthi ukuphindaphindwa kwezakhi zofuzo kwaholela ekukhuleni ngokweqile kwe-HER2 kumaphesenti angama-25 eziguli ezinomdlavuza webele futhi zakha umuthi obizwa ngokuthi i-Herceptin (trastuzumab). I-Herceptin iyi-antibody ye-monoclonal ehlose i-HER2 ukuze isuswe yisistimu yomzimba. Ukwelashwa kwe-Herceptin kusiza ukulawula ukudluliswa kwesignali nge-HER2. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-Herceptin kanye ne-chemotherapy kusize ukwandisa izinga lokusinda leziguli ezinomdlavuza webele osakazekile.
question1: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yezazi zezinto eziphilayo zomdlavuza?
answer1: Ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokuvimbela noma zokwelapha umdlavuza ngokuvimbela ukukhula kwesimila ngaphandle kokulimaza amaseli ajwayelekile
distractor1a: Ukususa wonke amaseli ahlukana ngokushesha emzimbeni
distractor1b: Ukwandisa izinga lokuhlukana kwamaseli ezicutshini ezinempilo
distractor1c: Ukuvimbela zonke izindlela zokubonisa ukuthi zingasebenzi
question2: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okulawula amaprotheni okubonisa kunganegalelo kanjani kumdlavuza?
answer2: Zingakhiqiza amaprotheni okudlulisa izimpawu angasebenzi kahle ahluleka ukulawula umjikelezo weseli, okuholela ekuhlukanisweni kweseli okungalawulwa
question3: Iyini i-oncogene?
distractor3a: Izakhi zofuzo ezivimbela ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor3c: I-gene esebenza kuphela ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kombungu
question4: I-RAS gene ihlukaniswa njenge-oncogene ngoba
answer4: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ku-RAS kungaholela ekukhuleni kwamaseli okungalawulwa
question5: Yini engenzeka uma ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okungalawulwa kuqhubeka kungalawulwa?
answer5: Amathumba angakheka futhi amangqamuzana omdlavuza angasakazeka ngokusabalala kwe-metastasis
question6: Kuyini ukusabalala kwe-metastasis?
answer6: Ukusabalala nokukhula kwamaseli omdlavuza ezindaweni ezintsha zomzimba
distractor6b: Ukuhamba okuvamile kwamaseli omzimba ngokusebenzisa igazi
question7: I-HER2 inegalelo kwezinye izinhlobo zomdlavuza webele ngoba
answer7: Ikhiqizwa ngokweqile ngenxa yokuphindaphindwa kwezakhi zofuzo, okuholela ekudlulisweni kwezimpawu zamaseli ngokweqile
question8: I-Herceptin (trastuzumab) isiza kanjani ekwelapheni umdlavuza webele one-HER2-positive?
answer8: Kuyi-antibody ye-monoclonal ehlose ukususwa yi-HER2 yisistimu yomzimba, okunciphisa ukusayinwa kwe-HER2
distractor8a: Ivimba unomphela ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuwo wonke amaseli
distractor8c: Iguqula i-HER2 gene ibuyele emuva ku-sequence yayo evamile
question9: I-HER2 ichazwa kangcono ngokuthi yiluphi uhlobo lweprotheni?
answer9: I-receptor yobuso beseli
question10: I-HER2 iyi-receptor tyrosine kinase. Kumaphesenti angama-20 ezigameko zomdlavuza webele kubantu, i-HER2 isebenza unomphela, okuholela ekuhlukanisweni kwamaseli okungalawulwa. I-Lapatinib, umuthi osetshenziselwa ukwelapha umdlavuza webele, uvimbela i-HER2 receptor tyrosine kinase autophosphorylation, inqubo lapho i-receptor ifaka khona ama-phosphates kuyo. Lokhu kunciphisa ukukhula kwesimila ezigulini ngamaphesenti angama-50. Ngaphandle kwe-autophosphorylation, bikezela ukuthi yiziphi kulezi zinyathelo ezilandelayo ezizovinjelwa yi-Lapatinib, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi zibhalwe phansi ekusetshenzisweni kwayo.
answer10: Impendulo yeselula engezansi
distractor10b: Umsebenzi we-phosphatase, i-dimerization, kanye nempendulo yamaseli engezansi
distractor10c: Ukubopha kwe-molecule yesiginali, ukuguquguquka, kanye nempendulo yamaseli engezansi

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukufa Kweseli
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukufa Kweseli
chapterContent:
Uma iseli lonakele, lingadingekile, noma lingaba yingozi emvelweni, iseli lingaqalisa indlela yokubangela ukufa kweseli okuhleliwe, noma i-apoptosis. I-Apoptosis ivumela iseli ukuthi life ngendlela elawulwayo evimbela ukukhishwa kwama-molecule angase alimaze ngaphakathi kweseli. Kunezindawo eziningi zokuhlola zangaphakathi eziqapha impilo yeseli; uma kubonakala ukungajwayelekile, iseli lingaqalisa ngokuzenzekelayo inqubo ye-apoptosis. Kodwa-ke, kwezinye izimo, njengokutheleleka ngegciwane noma ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okungalawulwa, ukuhlolwa nokulinganisela okuvamile kweseli kuyahluleka. Ukubonisana kwangaphandle nakho kungaqalisa i-apoptosis. Isibonelo, iningi lamaseli ezilwane ajwayelekile anama-receptor asebenzisana ne-extracellular matrix, inethiwekhi yama-glycoprotein ahlinzeka ngokusekelwa kwesakhiwo samaseli emvelweni. Ukubopha kwama-receptor eseli ku-extracellular matrix kuqala i-cascade yokubonisana ngaphakathi kweseli. Kodwa-ke, uma iseli lisuka ku-extracellular matrix, ukubonisana kuyaphela, bese iseli lidlula ku-apoptosis. Lolu hlelo lugcina amaseli ukuthi angahambi emzimbeni futhi ande ngaphandle kokulawulwa.

 Esinye isibonelo sokubonakaliswa kwangaphandle okuholela ekushabalaleni kweseli le-T kwenzeka ekuthuthukisweni kwamaseli e-T. Amaseli e-T angamaseli omzimba abopha kuma-macromolecule angaphandle kanye nezinhlayiya, futhi awahlose ukubhujiswa yisistimu yomzimba. Ngokuvamile, amaseli e-T awaqondisi amaprotheni awo (lawo ezinto eziphilayo zawo), inqubo engaholela ezifweni zokuzivikela komzimba. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ikhono lokuhlukanisa phakathi kwawo kanye nokungewona awo, amaseli e-T angakavuthwa ayahlolwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi abopheka yini kulokho okubizwa ngokuthi amaprotheni awo. Uma i-receptor yeseli le-T elingakavuthwa ibopha kuma-protein awo, iseli le-T liyahlolwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi libopheka yini kumaprotheni alo abizwa ngokuthi awodwa. Uma i-receptor yeseli le-T elingakavuthwa ibopha kuma-protein awo, iseli le-T liyahlolwa futhi lisuse iseli eliyingozi.

 I-Apoptosis nayo ibalulekile ekuthuthukisweni okuvamile kwe-embryological. Ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla, isibonelo, izigaba zokuqala zokukhula zifaka phakathi ukwakheka kwezicubu ezifana newebhu phakathi kweminwe nezinzwane ngazinye (Isithombe 9.15). Ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa okuvamile, la maseli angadingeki kumele asuswe, okuvumela iminwe nezinzwane ezihlukene ngokuphelele ukuthi zakheke. Indlela yokubonisana kwamaseli ibangela i-apoptosis, ebhubhisa amaseli phakathi kwezinombolo ezikhulayo.
question1: Kuyini i-apoptosis?
answer1: Ukufa kweseli okuhleliwe okuvumela iseli ukuthi life ngendlela elawulwayo ngaphandle kokukhipha okuqukethwe kweseli okuyingozi
distractor1b: Inqubo lapho amaseli eyeka khona ukuveza izimpawu unomphela
distractor1c: Uhlobo lokuphefumula kwamaseli okwenzeka ngesikhathi sokucindezeleka
question2: Yisiphi isimo okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi sibangele i-apoptosis?
answer2: Iseli liba yingozi kakhulu noma libe yingozi emzimbeni
distractor2b: Iseli eliphilile lingena esigabeni se-G1 somjikelezo weseli
distractor2c: Iseli landisa ukwakheka kwamaprotheni ngemva kokuthola isici sokukhula
question3: Amaseli ngokuvamile anquma kanjani ukuthi i-apoptosis kufanele yenzeke?
answer3: Izindawo zokuhlola zangaphakathi ziqapha iseli ukuze zithole ukukhubazeka futhi zingaqala i-apoptosis uma kutholakala izinkinga
distractor3a: I-nucleus ivuselela ngokungahleliwe i-apoptosis njalo ngomjikelezo weseli
distractor3c: I-membrane ye-plasma iyaqhuma ngokuzenzakalelayo ngemva kokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA
question4: Kungani ukusayina kwangaphandle kungaqalisa i-apoptosis?
answer4: Izimpawu zangaphandle zisiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaseli ayasinda kuphela uma esendaweni efanele futhi esebenza kahle
distractor4a: Izimpawu zangaphandle zivimbela ukwakheka kwamaprotheni unomphela
distractor4b: Izimpawu zangaphandle zigaya ngqo amaseli alimele
distractor4c: Izimpawu zangaphandle ziqeda isidingo sokudlulisa izimpawu ngaphakathi kweseli
question5: Iyiphi indima edlalwa yi-extracellular matrix ekulawuleni i-apoptosis?
answer5: Ukubopha ku-matrix yangaphandle kunikeza izimpawu zokusinda, futhi ukulahlekelwa kwalokhu kusebenzisana kungabangela i-apoptosis
distractor5a: Ikhiqiza ngqo i-ATP edingekayo ukuze amaseli asinde
question6: Kungani ama-T-cell angakavuthwa edlula ku-apoptosis uma ebopha ngokuqinile kuma-protein awo?
answer6: Ukuqeda amangqamuzana angaba yingozi angahlasela izicubu zomzimba futhi abangele izifo ezizimele
distractor6c: Ukuvumela amagciwane ukuthi athelele amangqamuzana omzimba
question7: I-Apoptosis ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kombungu ibalulekile ngoba
answer7: Kususa amangqamuzana angadingekile, njengalawo aphakathi kweminwe nezinzwane ezisakhula
distractor7b: Kudala imithambo yegazi emisha phakathi kwamadijithi
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani i-apoptosis iwusizo ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi?
answer8: Isusa amangqamuzana alimele, athelelekile, angadingekile, noma angaba yingozi ngenkathi inciphisa umonakalo ezicutshini ezizungezile
distractor8a: Ikhulisa ukuvuvukala ukuze iqashe amasosha omzimba
distractor8b: Kukhulisa amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuziphendukela kwemvelo
question9: Uma i-apoptosis yehluleka ukwenzeka emangqamuzaneni anomonakalo omkhulu we-DNA, yini okungenzeka ukuthi izoba umphumela?
answer9: Amaseli angajwayelekile angaqhubeka nokuhlukana, okwandisa ingozi yomdlavuza
distractor9a: Ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni kuzoma ngokushesha kuzo zonke izicubu
distractor9c: Amaseli aphilile ngeke akwazi ukuphefumula amaseli
question10: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okubonisa kahle ukubaluleka kwe-apoptosis ekugcineni i-homeostasis?
answer10: Ukususwa kwamaseli e-T asabela ngokwawo ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kwesistimu yomzimba
distractor10b: Ukuguqulwa kwe-glycogen ibe yi-glucose ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukuqedwa Kwe-Cascade Yesiginali
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.3 Impendulo Esiginali | Ukuqedwa Kwe-Cascade Yesiginali
chapterContent:
Ukubonakaliswa okungajwayelekile okuvame ukubonwa kumaseli esimila kuwubufakazi bokuthi ukuqedwa kwesignali ngesikhathi esifanele kungabaluleka njengokuqala kwesignali. Enye indlela yokumisa isignali ethile ukwehlisa i-ligand noma ukuyisusa ukuze ingasakwazi ukufinyelela i-receptor yayo. Esinye sezizathu ezenza ama-hormone angenawo umoya njenge-estrogen ne-testosterone abangele izehlakalo ezihlala isikhathi eside ukuthi abopha amaprotheni athwalayo. Lawa maprotheni avumela ama-molecule angancibiliki ukuba ancibilike egazini, kodwa futhi avikela ama-hormone ekuwohlokeni ngama-enzyme ajikelezayo.

 Ngaphakathi kweseli, ama-enzyme amaningi ahlukene aguqula ukuguqulwa kwamaseli okuvela kuma-cascade esignali. Isibonelo, ama-phosphatase ama-enzyme asusa iqembu le-phosphate elixhunywe kuma-protein yi-kinase enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-dephosphorylation. I-Cyclic AMP (cAMP) yonakaliswa ibe yi-AMP yi-phosphodiesterase, futhi ukukhululwa kwezitolo ze-calcium kuguqulwa amaphampu e-Ca2+ atholakala kuma-membrane angaphandle nangaphakathi eseli.
question1: Kungani ukuqedwa kwendlela yokubonisa kubaluleke njengokuqala kwayo?
answer1: Ukuqedwa kwesignali okufanele kuvimbela izimpendulo zamaseli ezinde noma ezingafanele ezingaba nomthelela ezifweni ezifana nomdlavuza
distractor1a: Ivumela ama-receptor ukuthi abopha ama-ligand unomphela
distractor1b: Iqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP kuyama ngemva kokubonisa
question2: Enye indlela yokuqeda indlela yokubonisa iwukuba
answer2: Nciphisa noma ususe i-ligand ukuze ingasakwazi ukubopha i-receptor yayo
question3: Kungani ama-hormone e-steroid njenge-estrogen ne-testosterone evame ukukhiqiza imiphumela ehlala isikhathi eside?
answer3: Zibopha amaprotheni abathwali abavikela ekuwohlokeni ngenkathi zijikeleza egazini
question4: Uyini umsebenzi we-phosphatases ekuphelisweni kwesignali?
answer4: Zisusa amaqembu e-phosphate kumaprotheni, ziguqula i-phosphorylation
question5: I-Dephosphorylation ichazwa kangcono ngokuthi
question6: I-cyclic AMP (cAMP) ivinjelwa kanjani ngesikhathi sokuphela kwesignali?
answer6: I-Phosphodiesterase iguqula i-cAMP ibe yi-AMP
distractor6c: I-ATP synthase iguqula i-cAMP ibe yi-GTP
question7: Isignali ye-calcium ion iphela kanjani ngemva kokubonisana kwangaphakathi kweseli?
answer7: Amaphampu e-Ca2+ athutha ama-ion e-calcium awabuyisele ezindaweni zokugcina noma aphume esitokisini
question8: Yimuphi u-enzyme oguqula ngqo isenzo sama-protein kinase?
answer8: I-Phosphatase
question9: Ukuguqulwa okuqeda umsebenzi we-phosphatase cishe kungabangela
answer9: Amaprotheni asele e-phosphorylated kanye nezindlela zokubonisa izimpawu ezihlala zisebenza isikhathi eside kunokujwayelekile
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono indlela amaseli agcina ngayo i-homeostasis ngemva kokuthola isignali?
answer10: Amaseli aqeda ngenkuthalo ukudlulisa izimpawu ngokususa ama-ligand, ukuguqula i-phosphorylation, ukwehlisa izithunywa zesibili, nokubuyisela amazinga e-ion
distractor10a: Amaseli avuselela unomphela izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu ngemva kokubopha i-ligand
distractor10b: Amaseli aqhubeka nokukhulisa amazinga esithunywa sesibili
distractor10c: Amaseli avimbela wonke ama-ligand ukuthi angangeni egazini

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.4 Ukubonisana Kwezinto Eziphilayo Ezineseli Elilodwa | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.4 Ukubonisana Kwezinto Eziphilayo Ezineseli Elilodwa | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukubonisana kweseli kuvumela amabhaktheriya ukuthi aphendule ezicini zemvelo, njengamazinga wezakhamzimba kanye nokuzwa kwe-quorum (ubuningi bamaseli). Imvubelo yi-eukaryotes (isikhunta), futhi izingxenye nezinqubo ezitholakala ezimpawini zemvubelo zifana nalezo zezimpawu ze-receptor ebusweni beseli ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi. Isibonelo, imvubelo ehlumayo ivame ukukhulula izici zokuhlangana ezibenza bakwazi ukuhlanganyela enkambisweni efana nokuzala ngokocansi.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso Enkulu 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zithola, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.D
Amaseli ayaxhumana ngokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa nokwamukela izimpawu zamakhemikhali.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.D.1 Izinqubo zokuxhumana kwamaseli zabelana ngezici ezifanayo ezibonisa umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo okwabiwe.

1.5 Umfundi angaphinda aveze izakhi ezibalulekile zezehlakalo zemvelo kuzo zonke izethulo eziningi kule ndawo.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Isayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
