 Ukubonisana kwangaphakathi kweseli kuvumela amabhaktheriya ukuthi aphendule ezicini zemvelo, njengamazinga ezakhamzimba. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa nazo zikhipha ama-molecule ukuze axhumane
question1: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle indima yokubonisana kwamaseli kumagciwane?
answer1: Ukubonisana kweseli kuvumela amabhaktheriya ukuthi abone futhi aphendule ezicini zemvelo njengokutholakala kwezakhamzimba kanye nobuningi bamaseli
distractor1a: Ukudluliselwa kwesignali kweseli kusetshenziselwa kuphela ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
distractor1b: Ukubonisana kwamaseli kwenzeka kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi
distractor1c: Ukudluliselwa kwesignali kweseli kusetshenziselwa kuphela i-photosynthesis
question2: Kuyini ukuzwa kwe-quorum?
answer2: Uhlobo lokubonisana kwamaseli lapho amabhaktheriya esabela khona ezinguqukweni zobuningi babantu
distractor2a: Inqubo lapho amabhaktheriya eshintsha khona i-DNA ngokusebenzisa i-conjugation
question3: Imvubelo ihlukaniswa njenge
question4: Kungani izindlela zokubonisana ngemvubelo zibalulekile ekutadisheni ukuxhumana kwamaseli?
answer4: Babelana ngezingxenye eziningi kanye nezindlela zokubonisana nama-eukaryotes amaningi
question5: Izici zokuzalanisa ezikhipha i-yeast zibalulekile kakhulu
answer5: Ukuxhumana namaseli ahambisanayo futhi kuqalise inqubo efana nokuzala ngokocansi
question6: Yikuphi ukubonwa okunikeza ubufakazi bokuthi ukuhanjiswa kwezimpawu zamaseli kunomsuka wasendulo wokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer6: Zombili izinto eziphilayo ezinamangqamuzana amabili kanye nezinamangqamuzana amaningi zisebenzisa izindlela ezifanayo zokubonisa izimpawu kanye nama-receptor
distractor6a: Izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi kuphela ezixhumanayo zisebenzisa izimpawu zamakhemikhali
question7: Amabhaktheriya avame ukusabela kanjani emazingeni okushintsha kwezakhamzimba?
answer7: Ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokubonisana zangaphakathi kwamangqamuzana ezishintsha imisebenzi yamaselula
distractor7c: Ngokuguqula ngqo zibe izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi
question8: Umcwaningi uthola uguquko oluvimbela igciwane ekutholeni ama-molecule azwa i-quorum. Yimuphi inqubo okungenzeka ukuthi iphazamiseke?
answer8: Amandla amabhaktheriya okuhlanganisa ukuziphatha kweqembu ngokusekelwe ekubuneni kwabantu
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esisekela kangcono umqondo we-AP Biology wokuthi ukuxhumana kwamaseli kubonisa okhokho abafanayo?
answer9: Izindlela ezifanayo zokubonisa izimpawu zitholakala kumabhaktheriya, imvubelo, izitshalo, kanye nezilwane naphezu kokungafani kwazo kokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor9a: Izilwane kuphela ezinazo izitho zokwamukela ama-molecule okubonisa izimpawu
distractor9b: Ukuxhumana kwamaseli kwavela ngokuzimela kuzo zonke izizukulwane
distractor9c: Izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi kuphela ezidinga izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu
question10: Kungani ukubonisana kuzuzisa ngisho nasezintweni eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa?
answer10: Ivumela amangqamuzana ukubona izinguquko zemvelo futhi ahlele izimpendulo ezifanele ezithuthukisa ukusinda nokuzala
distractor10b: Ivumela amaseli ukuthi amise ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo unomphela

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.4 Ukubonisana Ezinto Eziphilayo Ezineseli Elilodwa | Ukubonisana Emvubelo
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.4 Ukubonisana Ezinto Eziphilayo Ezineseli Elilodwa | Ukubonisana Emvubelo
chapterContent: Imvubelo yi-eukaryotes (isikhunta), futhi izingxenye nezinqubo ezitholakala ezimpawini zemvubelo zifana nezezimpawu ze-receptor ebusweni beseli ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi. Imvubelo ehlumayo (Isithombe 9.16) iyakwazi ukuhlanganyela enkambisweni efana nokuzala ngokocansi ehlanganisa amaseli amabili e-haploid (amaseli anesigamu senani elijwayelekile lama-chromosome) ahlanganayo ukwakha iseli le-diploid (iseli elinamasethi amabili e-chromosome ngayinye, okuyilokho okuqukethwe amaseli omzimba ajwayelekile). Ukuze kutholakale elinye iseli lemvubelo le-haploid elilungele ukuhlangana, imvubelo ehlumayo ikhipha i-molecule esignaling ebizwa ngokuthi i-mating factor. Lapho i-mating factor ibopha kuma-receptor ebusweni beseli kwamanye amaseli emvubelo aseduze, ayayeka imijikelezo yawo evamile yokukhula futhi aqale i-cascade yesignaling yeseli ehlanganisa ama-protein kinase kanye namaprotheni e-GTP-binding afana nama-G-protein.
question1: Imvubelo ihlukaniswa njenge
answer1: Isikhunta se-eukaryotic
question2: Imvubelo ehlumayo isebenzisa ama-molecule okubonisa izimpawu abizwa ngokuthi izinto zokuzalanisa ukuze
answer2: Thola amaseli e-haploid ahambisanayo bese uqala ukuhlangana
question3: Iyini inombolo ye-chromosome yeseli yemvubelo ye-haploid?
question4: Yini ekhiqizwayo uma amaseli amabili emvubelo e-haploid ahambisanayo ehlangana ngempumelelo?
answer4: Iseli le-diploid eliqukethe amasethi amabili ama-chromosome
question5: Amaseli emvubelo angomakhelwane ayibona kanjani into yokuhlangana?
answer5: Isici sokuhlangana sibopha kuma-receptor athile asebusweni beseli
distractor5b: Isici sokuhlangana singena ngeziteshi ze-ion ngaphandle kwama-receptors
question6: Kwenzekani ngemva kokuba iseli lemvubelo lithole isici sokuhlangana?
answer6: Iyeka umjikelezo wayo wokukhula ojwayelekile futhi ivuselele uchungechunge lwezimpawu
question7: Yimaphi ama-molecule ahileleke ngqo endleleni yokubonisana kwe-yeast mating?
answer7: Ama-protein kinase kanye namaprotheni ahlanganisa i-GTP
question8: Indlela yokubonisa esetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kwemvubelo inikeza ubufakazi bokuthi
answer8: Ama-eukaryote aneseli elilodwa kanye nama-multicellular abelana ngezindlela zokubonisa ezilondolozwe ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor8a: Imvubelo yavela ngokuzimela kuzo zonke ezinye i-eukaryotes
distractor8b: Izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi kuphela ezisebenzisa ama-protein kinase
question9: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela amaseli emvubelo ekukhiqizeni ama-receptor asebenzayo e-mating-factor. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer9: Amaseli azohluleka ukubona abalingani bokuhlangana abafanelanayo futhi ukusebenza kahle kokuhlangana kuzoncipha
question10: Kungani imvubelo ivame ukusetshenziswa ukutadisha ukusayinwa kwamaseli ku-AP Biology kanye nocwaningo lwezokwelapha?
answer10: Izindlela zayo zokudlulisela imiyalezo zifana kakhulu nalezo ezitholakala kuma-eukaryotes amaningi, okwenza kube yisibonelo esihle kakhulu sezinto eziphilayo

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.4 Ukubonisana Ezinto Eziphilayo Ezineseli Elilodwa | Ukubonisana Emabhaktheriya
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | 9.4 Ukubonisana Ezinto Eziphilayo Ezineseli Elilodwa | Ukubonisana Emabhaktheriya
chapterContent:
Ukubonisa izimpawu kuma-bacteria kwenza ama-bacteria akwazi ukuqapha izimo zangaphandle, aqinisekise ukuthi kunezakhamzimba ezanele, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi izimo eziyingozi ziyagwenywa. Nokho, kunezimo lapho ama-bacteria exhumana.

 Ubufakazi bokuqala bokuxhumana kwama-bacteria babonwa ku-bacterium enobudlelwano bokubambisana ne-Hawaiian bobtail squid. Lapho inani labantu bama-bacteria lifinyelela ezingeni elithile, ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile kuyaqalwa, futhi ama-bacteria akhiqiza amaprotheni e-bioluminescent akhipha ukukhanya. Ngenxa yokuthi inani lamaseli akhona endaweni (ubuningi bamaseli) liyisici esinqumayo sokubonisa izimpawu, ukubonisa izimpawu kwama-bacteria kwabizwa ngokuthi i-quorum sensing. Kwezepolitiki nasebhizinisini, i-quorum yinani elincane lamalungu adingekayo ukuze abekhona ukuze avote ngendaba ethile.

 Ukubona i-Quorum kusebenzisa ama-autoinducer njengama-molecule okubonisa izimpawu. Ama-Autoinducer angama-molecule okubonisa izimpawu akhishwa ama-bacteria ukuze axhumane namanye ama-bacteria ohlobo olufanayo. Ama-autoinducer akhishwayo angaba ama-molecule amancane, angenawo umoya njenge-acyl-homoserine lactone (AHL) noma ama-molecule amakhulu asekelwe kuma-peptide; Uhlobo ngalunye lwe-molecule lunendlela ehlukile yokusebenza. Lapho i-AHL ingena kubhaktheriya okuqondiwe, ibopha ezintweni zokubhala, ezibe sezishintsha noma zivale ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo (Isithombe 9.17). Ama-peptide autoinducers avuselela izindlela zokubonisa eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu ezifaka ama-bacterial kinase. Izinguquko kubhaktheriya ngemva kokuchayeka kuma-autoinducers zingaba ziningi kakhulu. Ibhaktheriya elibangela izifo i-Pseudomonas aeruginosa linama-gene ahlukene angu-616 asabela kuma-autoinducers.

 Ezinye izinhlobo zamabhaktheriya ezisebenzisa i-quorum sensing zakha ama-biofilms, amakholoni ayinkimbinkimbi amabhaktheriya (ngokuvamile aqukethe izinhlobo eziningana) ashintshana ngezibonakaliso zamakhemikhali ukuze axhumanise ukukhishwa kobuthi obuzohlasela umninimzi. Ama-biofilms amabhaktheriya (Isithombe 9.18) ngezinye izikhathi angatholakala emishinini yezokwelapha; lapho ama-biofilms ehlasela izimila ezifana nezinsimbi zokushintsha i-hip noma idolo noma ama-pacemaker enhliziyo, angabangela izifo ezisongela ukuphila.

 Amandla amabhaktheriya athile okwakha ama-biofilms aguqukile ngenxa yokukhetha kwama-gene avumela ukuxhumana kwamaseli namaseli kunikeza inzuzo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Uma amakoloni amabhaktheriya akha ama-biofilms, adala izithiyo ezivimbela ubuthi nemithi yokulwa namagciwane ukuthi ingaphazamisi abantu abahlala ku-biofilm. Ngenxa yalokho, la maqembu abantu anamathuba amaningi okusinda, ngisho nalapho kukhona ama-antibacterial agents. Lokhu kuvame ukusho ukuthi amabhaktheriya ahlala ku-biofilms anempilo ephezulu kunamabhaktheriya ahlala ewodwa.

 Ucwaningo ngemininingwane yokuzwa kwe-quorum luholele ekuthuthukisweni kwamabhaktheriya akhulayo ngezinjongo zezimboni. Okutholakele muva nje kusikisela ukuthi kungenzeka ukusebenzisa izindlela zokubonisana kwamabhaktheriya ukulawula ukukhula kwamabhaktheriya; le nqubo ingathatha indawo noma ingeze ama-antibiotic angasasebenzi ezimweni ezithile.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wokubonisa izimpawu kumagciwane?
answer1: Ukuqapha izimo zemvelo, ukutholakala kwezakhamzimba, kanye nokuxhumana namanye amagciwane uma kudingeka
question2: Kuyini ukuzwa kwe-quorum?
answer2: Uhlobo lokuxhumana kwamagciwane lapho ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kushintsha khona ngenxa yobuningi babantu
question3: Yimaphi ama-molecule asetshenziswa amabhaktheriya njengama-molecule okubonisa ngesikhathi sokuzwa kwe-quorum?
question4: Ama-autoinducer e-acyl-homoserine lactone (AHL) alawula kanjani ukuziphatha kwamagciwane?
answer4: Zifaka amabhaktheriya aqondiwe futhi zibophe izici zokubhala ezilawula ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
question5: Iyini i-biofilm?
answer5: Ikholoni eyinkimbinkimbi yamabhaktheriya exhumana ngezibonakaliso zamakhemikhali futhi iqondisa ukuziphatha kweqembu
distractor5a: Ungqimba lwamaseli ebhaktheriya afile azungeze ikoloni
question6: Kungani ama-biofilm ebhaktheriya angaba yingozi kakhulu ezindaweni zezokwelapha?
answer6: Zivikela amabhaktheriya kuma-antibiotic kanye nokuzivikela komzimba, okuvumela ukutheleleka okuqhubekayo ukuba kukhule
question7: Ukuzwa kwe-quorum kunikeza kanjani inzuzo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer7: Ivumela amabhaktheriya ukuthi axhumanise izindlela zokuziphatha ezithuthukisa ukusinda, njengokwakheka kwe-biofilm kanye nokukhiqizwa kobuthi
distractor7c: Kuvimbela ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ukuthi kungenzeki
question8: Abacwaningi bakha umuthi ovimba ama-autoinducer amagciwane ukuthi angabophi ama-receptor awo. Yimuphi inqubo yamagciwane okungenzeka ukuthi iphazamiseke?
answer8: Ukuzwa kwe-quorum okuhlelekile kanye nokwakheka kwe-biofilm
question9: Kungani amabhaktheriya ahlala kuma-biofilms evame ukuba ngcono kunamabhaktheriya aphila ngokukhululeka?
answer9: I-biofilm ivikela umphakathi wamagciwane ebuthi, ama-antibiotic, kanye nezinye izingcindezi zemvelo
distractor9c: Amabhaktheriya e-biofilm ahlukana kanye kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphila kwawo
question10: Ukuqonda ukuqonda i-quorum kungaba nomthelela kanjani kwezokwelapha?
answer10: Ngokuthuthukisa izindlela zokwelapha eziphazamisa ukuxhumana kwamagciwane futhi zinciphise ukutheleleka ngaphandle kokuthembela kuphela kuma-antibiotic endabuko
distractor10c: Ngokuvimbela konke ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo zamagciwane
question11: Bheka Umfanekiso 9.18. I-V. fischeri ephila ngokukhululeka ayikhanyi. Kungani?
answer11: Amandla okukhanyisa awazuzisi amabhaktheriya aphilayo mahhala, ngakho amabhaktheriya aphilayo mahhala awakhiqizi i-luciferase
distractor11a: I-squid inikeza izakhamzimba ezithile ezivumela amabhaktheriya ukuba akhanye
distractor11b: I-squid ikhiqiza i-enzyme ye-luciferase ekhanyayo, ngakho-ke amabhaktheriya ahlala ngaphandle kwe-squid awakhanyi.
distractor11c: I-Luciferase inobuthi kuma-free-living bacteria, ngakho-ke ama-free-living bacteria awakhiqizi le enzyme

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kwamaseli | 9.4 Ukubonisana Ezinto Eziphilayo Ezineseli Elilodwa | Ukuxhumana Kwamaseli Emvubelo
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kwamaseli | 9.4 Ukubonisana Ezinto Eziphilayo Ezineseli Elilodwa | Ukuxhumana Kwamaseli Emvubelo
chapterContent:
Ukuphila kokuqala emhlabeni wethu kwakuqukethe izinto eziphilayo ze-prokaryotic ezineseli elilodwa ezazinokuxhumana okulinganiselwe. Nakuba ezinye izimpawu zangaphandle zenzeka phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa, iningi lokubonisana ngaphakathi kwamabhaktheriya nemvubelo lithinta kuphela amanye amalungu ohlobo olufanayo. Ukuvela kokuxhumana kwamangqamuzana kuyisidingo esikhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwezinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi, futhi lokhu kusungulwa kucatshangwa ukuthi kudinge iminyaka ecishe ibe yizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-2.5 ukuze kuvele ezinhlotsheni zokuphila kwasekuqaleni.

 Imvubelo yi-eukaryotes eneseli elilodwa, ngakho-ke ine-nucleus kanye ne-organelles enezici zezinhlobo zokuphila eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu. Ukuqhathaniswa kwama-genome emvubelo, izibungu ze-nematode, izimpukane zezithelo, kanye nabantu kubonisa ukuvela kwezinhlelo zokubonisana eziyinkimbinkimbi ezivumela ukusebenza kwangaphakathi okusebenzayo okugcina abantu nezinye izinhlobo zokuphila eziyinkimbinkimbi zisebenza kahle.

 Ama-kinase ayingxenye enkulu yokuxhumana kwamangqamuzana, futhi izifundo zala ma-enzyme zibonisa ukuxhumana okuguquguqukayo kwezinhlobo ezahlukene. Imvubelo inezinhlobo ezingu-130 zama-kinase. Izinto eziphilayo eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu njengezinambuzane ze-nematode kanye nezimpukane zezithelo zinama-kinase angu-454 kanye no-239, ngokulandelana. Ezinhlotsheni ezingu-130 zama-kinase kumvubelo, ezingu-97 zingaphansi kwemindeni engu-55 yama-kinase atholakala kwezinye izinto eziphilayo ze-eukaryotic. Ukuntuleka okusobala okubonakalayo kumvubelo ukungabikho ngokuphelele kwama-tyrosine kinase. Kucatshangwa ukuthi i-phosphorylation yezinsalela ze-tyrosine iyadingeka ukulawula imisebenzi eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu yentuthuko, ukuhlukanisa, kanye nokuxhumana kwamaseli okusetshenziswa ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi.

 Ngenxa yokuthi imvubelo iqukethe izinhlobo eziningi zamaprotheni okubonisa izimpawu njengabantu, lezi zinto eziphilayo zilungele ukufunda ama-cascade okubonisa izimpawu. Imvubelo yanda ngokushesha futhi iyizinto eziphilayo ezilula kakhulu kunabantu noma ezinye izilwane eziningi. Ngakho-ke, ama-cascade okubonisa izimpawu nawo alula futhi kulula ukuwafunda, yize equkethe okufanayo nokubonisa izimpawu komuntu.
question1: Kungani ukuthuthuka kokuxhumana kwamaseli kwakubalulekile ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi?
answer1: Amaseli kumele ahlele imisebenzi yawo ngokusebenzisa izimpawu ukuze asebenze ndawonye njengesidalwa esinamangqamuzana amaningi
distractor1a: Kwavumela amangqamuzana ukuthi aqede ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
question2: Kungani imvubelo ibhekwa njengezinto eziphilayo eziyisibonelo ezibalulekile zokufunda ukudluliselwa kwezimpawu zamaseli?
answer2: Ziqukethe amaprotheni okudlulisela izimpawu afana nalawo atholakala kubantu kodwa zinezindlela ezilula zokudlulisela izimpawu futhi zizala ngokushesha
distractor2c: Zinezindlela zokuthumela izimpawu eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunabantu
question3: Imvubelo ihlukaniswa njenge
question4: Yisiphi isici samaseli emvubelo esenza afane kakhulu namaseli abantu kunamabhaktheriya?
question5: Yiliphi uhlobo lwama-enzyme oluyingxenye ebalulekile yezindlela zokuxhumana zamaselula?
question6: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-kinase olungekho kwimvubelo?
answer6: Ama-Tyrosine kinase
question7: Kungani kucatshangwa ukuthi ama-tyrosine kinase avele kamuva kuma-eukaryotes?
answer7: Zihlotshaniswa nezinqubo eziyinkimbinkimbi zokuthuthukiswa, ukuhlukanisa, kanye nokuxhumana kwezinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi
distractor7b: Zavela ngaphambi kwayo yonke eminye imindeni ye-kinase
question8: Yibuphi ubufakazi obusekela ukulondolozwa kwemvelo kwezindlela zokubonisana kwamaseli?
answer8: Imindeni eminingi ye-kinase yabelwana phakathi kwemvubelo, izibungu, izimpukane, kanye nabantu
distractor8b: Imvubelo nabantu banamaprotheni okubonisana angahlobene nhlobo
distractor8c: Ama-Kinase aguquke ngokuzimela kuzo zonke izinhlobo
question9: Usosayensi ufunda i-kinase esanda kutholakala kumvubelo futhi uthola ukuthi iphrotheni efanayo ikhona kubantu. Lokhu okuphawuliwe kusekela kakhulu umbono wokuthi
answer9: Izindlela eziningi zokubonisa izimpawu zilondolozwe ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo okuvela kokhokho abafanayo
distractor9b: Ama-kinase avela kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi
distractor9c: Ukusayinwa kweseli kwavela ngokuzimela kuzo zonke izinhlobo
question10: Kungani izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu ngokuvamile kulula ukuzifunda ngemvubelo kunabantu?
answer10: Izindlela zokubonisana ngemvubelo zilula ngenkathi zigcina izingxenye eziningi ezifanayo eziyisisekelo ezitholakala kubantu
distractor10a: Amaseli emvubelo awanawo amaprotheni okubonisa izimpawu
question11: Ngokusekelwe ku-Evolution Connection, yikuphi okulandelayo okuchaza kangcono ukuvela kwama-kinase?
answer11: Imindeni engaphansi kwamashumi amahlanu nanhlanu yama-kinase yavela ngaphambi kokuba imvubelo ihlukane namanye ama-eukaryotes, kodwa ama-tyrosine kinase avela ngemva kokuba imvubelo ihlukane.
distractor11a: Ama-tyrosine kinase avele ngaphambi kokuba imvubelo ihlukane namanye ama-eukaryotes, kodwa eminye imindeni engaphansi kwamashumi amahlanu nanhlanu yama-kinase yavela ngemva kokuba imvubelo ihlukane.
distractor11b: Zonke izi-kinase zavela ku-yeast, kodwa kamuva imvubelo yalahlekelwa yi-tyrosine kinase ngoba azizidingi.
distractor11c: Ukuvela kwama-tyrosine kinase ahilelekile ekuxhumaneni kwamaselula kwenzeka eminyakeni engaba yizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-2.5 eyedlule

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | Isifinyezo Sesahluko 9.6
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 9. Ukuxhumana Kweseli | Isifinyezo Sesahluko 9.6
chapterContent:
9.1 Ama-Molecule Okubonisa Amasignali kanye Nama-Cellular Receptors
Amaseli axhumana ngokubonisana phakathi nangaphakathi kweseli. Amaseli okubonisa akhipha ama-ligand abopha kumaseli aqondiwe futhi aqalise uchungechunge lwezehlakalo ngaphakathi kweseli eliqondiwe. Izigaba ezine zokubonisa amasignali ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi yi-paracrine signaling, i-endocrine signaling, i-autocrine signaling, kanye ne-direct signaling kuzo zonke izigcawu ze-gap. Ukubonisana kwe-paracrine kwenzeka emabangeni amafushane. Izimpawu ze-endocrine zithwalwa amabanga amade egazini ngama-hormone, kanti izimpawu ze-autocrine zamukelwa yiseli elifanayo elithumele isignali noma amanye amaseli aseduze ohlobo olufanayo. Izigcawu ze-gap zivumela ama-molecule amancane, kufaka phakathi ama-molecule okubonisa amasignali, ukuthi ageleze phakathi kwamaseli angomakhelwane.

 Ama-receptor angaphakathi atholakala ku-cytoplasm yeseli. Lapha, abopha ama-molecule e-ligand awela ulwelwesi lwe-plasma; lawa ma-receptor-ligand complexes athuthela ku-nucleus futhi axhumane ngqo ne-DNA yeselula. Ama-receptor e-cell-surface adlulisela isignali esuka ngaphandle kweseli iye ku-cytoplasm. Ama-receptor axhunywe ku-ion channel, uma eboshelwe kuma-ligand awo, akha imbobo nge-plasma membrane lapho ama-ion athile angadlula khona. Ama-receptor axhunywe ku-G-protein asebenzisana ne-G-protein ohlangothini lwe-cytoplasmic lwe-plasma membrane, ekhuthaza ukushintshaniswa kwe-GDP eboshwe nge-GTP futhi esebenzisana namanye ama-enzyme noma iziteshi ze-ion ukuze adlulise isignali. Ama-receptor axhunywe ku-enzyme adlulisa isignali esuka ngaphandle kweseli iye endaweni yangaphakathi kweseli ye-enzyme eboshwe ku-membrane. Ukubopha kwe-Ligand kubangela ukusebenza kwe-enzyme. Ama-ligand amancane e-hydrophobic (njenge-steroids) ayakwazi ukungena kwi-plasma membrane futhi abopha kuma-receptor angaphakathi. Ama-ligand e-hydrophilic ancibilikayo emanzini awakwazi ukudlula kwi-membrane; esikhundleni salokho, abopha kuma-receptor asebusweni beseli, adlulisela isignali ngaphakathi kweseli.

 9.2 Ukusabalala kwe-Signal
Ukubopha kwe-Ligand kwi-receptor kuvumela ukudluliselwa kwesignali ngeseli. Uchungechunge lwezehlakalo oludlulisela isignali ngeseli lubizwa ngokuthi indlela yokubonisa noma i-cascade. Izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu zivame ukuba yinkimbinkimbi kakhulu ngenxa yokusebenzisana phakathi kwamaprotheni ahlukene. Ingxenye enkulu yama-cascade okubonisa izimpawu zamaseli i-phosphorylation yama-molecule ngama-enzyme aziwa ngokuthi ama-kinase. I-phosphorylation inezela iqembu le-phosphate kuma-serine, i-threonine, kanye nama-tyrosine residues kuprotheni, ishintsha izimo zazo, futhi isebenze noma ivimbele iprotheni. Ama-molecule amancane njenge-nucleotide nawo angafakwa i-phosphorylation. Ama-messenger esibili angama-molecule amancane, angewona amaprotheni asetshenziselwa ukudlulisa isignali ngaphakathi kweseli. Ezinye izibonelo zezithunywa zesibili ama-ion e-calcium (Ca2+), i-cyclic AMP (cAMP), i-diacylglycerol (DAG), kanye ne-inositol triphosphate (IP3).

 9.3 Impendulo Esiginalini
Ukuqaliswa kwendlela yokubonisa izimpawu kuyindlela yokusabela ezicini zangaphandle. Le mpendulo ingathatha izinhlobo eziningi ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi ukwakheka kwamaprotheni, ushintsho ekusetshenzisweni kweseli, ukukhula kweseli, noma ngisho nokufa kweseli. Izindlela eziningi zithonya iseli ngokuqala ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo, futhi izindlela ezisetshenziswayo ziningi kakhulu. Ezinye izindlela zivuselela ama-enzyme asebenzisana nezinto zokubhala ze-DNA. Ezinye ziguqula amaprotheni futhi ziwashukumisele ukuba ashintshe indawo yawo esitokisini. Kuye ngesimo sento ephilayo, amangqamuzana angasabela ngokugcina amandla njenge-glycogen noma amafutha, noma awenze atholakale ngesimo se-glucose. Indlela yokudlulisela isignali ivumela amangqamuzana emisipha ukuthi aphendule ezidingweni ezisheshayo zamandla ngesimo se-glucose. Ukukhula kwamangqamuzana cishe njalo kukhuthazwa izimpawu zangaphandle ezibizwa ngokuthi izici zokukhula. Ukukhula kwamangqamuzana okungalawulwa kuholela kumdlavuza, futhi izinguquko ezakhiweni zofuzo ezifaka izingxenye zamaprotheni zezindlela zokubonisa zivame ukutholakala kumaseli esimila. Ukufa kwamangqamuzana okuhleliwe, noma i-apoptosis, kubalulekile ekususeni amangqamuzana alimele noma angadingekile. Ukusetshenziswa kokubonisana kwamangqamuzana ukuhlela ukuqedwa kweseli kuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-molecule ayingozi avela ku-cytoplasm awakhishwa ezikhaleni eziphakathi kwamangqamuzana, njengoba efa ngokungalawulwa, i-necrosis. I-Apoptosis iphinde iqinisekise ukuphinda kusetshenziswe kahle kwezingxenye zeseli elifile. Ukuphela kwe-cascade yokubonisana kwamangqamuzana kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze impendulo yesignali ifanele kokubili ngesikhathi kanye namandla. Ukuwohloka kwama-molecule esignaling kanye ne-dephosphorylation yama-intermediate e-phosphorylated endleleni yi-phosphatases kuyizindlela ezimbili zokuqeda amasignali ngaphakathi kweseli.

 9.4 Ukubonisana Ezintweni Ezineseli Elilodwa
I-Yeast kanye nezinto eziphilayo eziningi zinezindlela ezifanayo zokubonisana. I-Yeast isebenzisa ama-receptor e-cell-surface kanye nama-signal cascades ukuxhumana ngolwazi mayelana nokuhlangana namanye amaseli e-yeast. I-syllability molecule ekhishwa yi-yeast ibizwa ngokuthi i-mating factor.

 Ukubonisana kwamagciwane kubizwa ngokuthi i-quorum sensing. Ama-bacteria akhipha ama-signal molecule abizwa ngokuthi ama-autoinducers angama-molecule amancane, angama-hydrophobic noma amasignali asekelwe ku-peptide. Ama-hydrophobic autoinducers, njenge-AHL, abopha izinto zokubhala futhi athinte ngqo ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo. Ama-molecule asekelwe ku-peptide abopha ama-kinase futhi aqalise ama-signal cascades emaseli

question31: Bheka uMfanekiso 9.4. Buyekeza umsebenzi ohilelekile ku-molecule yokubonisana ebopha i-receptor yangaphakathi, njengoba kuboniswe emfanekisweni. Khomba incazelo engcono kakhulu yomehluko phakathi kwama-receptor angaphakathi nama-receptor asebusweni beseli
answer31: Ama-receptor angaphakathi abopha kuma-ligand angena emanzini futhi i-ligand-receptor complex ingena ngqo ku-nucleus, iqalise ukubhalwa nokuhumusha. Ama-receptor angaphezulu kweseli abopha kuma-ligand athanda amanzi futhi aqale umjikelezo wokubonisana othinta ngokungaqondile ukwenziwa kweprotheni esebenzayo.
distractor31a: Ama-receptor angaphakathi abopha kuma-ligand athanda amanzi futhi i-ligand-receptor complex ingena ngqo ku-nucleus, iqalise ukubhalwa nokuhumusha. Ama-receptor asebusweni beseli abopha kuma-ligand athanda amanzi futhi aqale umjikelezo wokubonisana othinta ngokungaqondile ukwenziwa kweprotheni esebenzayo.
distractor31b: Ama-receptor angaphakathi abopha kuma-ligand angenawo umoya futhi aqalise umjikelezo wokubonisana othinta ngokungaqondile ukwenziwa kwephrotheni esebenzayo. Ama-receptor angaphezulu kweseli abopha kuma-ligand athanda amanzi futhi i-ligand-receptor complex ingena ngqo ku-nucleus, iqalise ukubhalwa nokuhumusha.
distractor31c: Ama-receptor angaphakathi angamaphrotheni e-membrane ahlanganisiwe abopha kuma-ligand e-hydrophobic, aqala i-cascade yokubonisana, ethonya ngokungaqondile ukwenziwa kwephrotheni esebenzayo. question33: Izithunywa zesibili ezifanayo zisetshenziswa kumaseli amaningi ahlukene, kodwa impendulo kulezo zithunywa zesibili iyahluka kuseli ngalinye. Lokhu kungenzeka kanjani? Qhathanisa izincazelo ezingezansi bese ukhetha leyo esekela lesi simangalo sezimpendulo ezahlukahlukene.

question34: Cabanga ngezenzakalo ezixhumene ezihilelekile ekudlulisweni kwesignali ngaphakathi kweseli. Qagela ukuthi kuzokwenzekani uma isizinda sangaphakathi kweseli se-receptor-surface cell sishintshwa nesizinda sisuka kwenye i-receptor

question35: Bheka uMfanekiso 9.10. Hlaziya inqubo eboniswe esithombeni. Yisebenzise ukuchaza ukuthi ikhemikhali evimba ukubopha kwe-epidermal growth factor (EGF) kwi-EGF receptor, i-EGFR, ingaphazamisa kanjani ukuphindaphindeka kwamangqamuzana anomdlavuza akhipha i-EGFR ngokweqile.

question36: Hlaziya ukuxhumana phakathi kwezindlela zokubonisana kwamaseli nokukhula kwamaseli ukuze uphendule lo mbuzo olandelayo: I-extracellular matrix ilawula kanjani ukukhula kwamaseli?

question37: Bheka uMfanekiso 9.14. Izindlela zokudlulisa isignali zilawula imisebenzi eminingi yamaseli, kufaka phakathi i-MAP kinase cascade eboniswe lapha. Phakamisa isibonelo salowo nalowo mphumela olandelayo wesignali yeseli: ekubonakalisweni kwamaprotheni, imetabolism yamaseli, kanye nokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
answer37: Ukuvezwa kwamaprotheni: i-MAP-kinase cascade; i-metabolism yamaseli - ukubopha i-epinephrine (i-adrenaline) kwi-receptor exhunywe yi-G-protein; ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okukhuthazwa ukubopha kwe-EGF kwi-receptor yayo i-tyrosine kinase
distractor37a: Ukubonakaliswa kwamaprotheni: ukubopha kwe-epinephrine (i-adrenaline) kwi-receptor exhunywe yi-G-protein; imetabolism yamaseli: i-MAP-kinase cascade; ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli: okukhuthazwa ukubopha kwe-EGF kwi-receptor yayo i-tyrosine kinase

question38: Izindlela zokudlulisela isignali zilawula uhla lwezimpendulo kumaseli. Qagela izimo ezingaba khona zokungajwayelekile endleleni ye-MAPK okuholela ekwandeni kwamaseli okungalawulwa.
answer38: Iphrotheni ye-RAS ayikwazi ukuhlanganisa i-GTP yayo eboshiwe, ukulahlekelwa ukuguquka komsebenzi ku-I κ -B, ukuzuza kokuguquka komsebenzi kuzakhi zofuzo zendlela ye-MAPK kinase, i-cascade ye-phosphorylation engalawulwa
distractor38a: Ukuzuza kokuguqulwa komsebenzi kuphrotheni ye-RAS, ukuguquka ku-I κ -B, ukulahleka kokuguqulwa komsebenzi kuzakhi zofuzo zendlela ye-MAPK kinase, i-cascade ye-phosphorylation elawulwayo
distractor38b: Ukulahlekelwa kokuguqulwa komsebenzi kuphrotheni ye-RAS kanye nokuzuza kokuguqulwa komsebenzi kuphrotheni ye-RAF, i-I κ-B iboshwe unomphela ku-NF-κ B, i-cascade ye-phosphorylation elawulwayo
distractor38c: Ukwehla kwe-phosphorylation okungalawulwa, ukulahlekelwa kokuguquguquka komsebenzi ku-RAS kanye ne-RAF protein, ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo zendlela ye-MAPK kinase, ukwehla kwe-phosphorylation okulawulwayo
question39: Imvubelo ibhekwa njengemodeli enhle yokufunda ngokudlulisela izimpawu kubantu. Hlukanisa phakathi kwezinketho ezinikeziwe ukuze uphakamise izici zemvubelo ezisekela indima yazo njengemodeli.
answer39: Imvubelo iyi-eukaryotes. Iphila isikhathi esifushane, kulula ukuyikhulisa, futhi ifana nabantu ngezindlela ezithile zokulawula.
distractor39a: Imvubelo yi-prokaryotes. Zinomjikelezo wokuphila omfushane, zizala ngokushesha, futhi zifana nabantu ngezindlela ezithile zokulawula.
distractor39b: Imvubelo iyizinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi. Zinomjikelezo wokuphila obikezelwayo, kulula ukuzikhulisa, futhi zinikeza abantu umehluko ngezindlela ezithile zokulawula.
distractor39c: Imvubelo iyizinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa. Zinomjikelezo wokuphila oyinkimbinkimbi njengowabantu futhi zifana ngezindlela zokulawula
question40: Xhumanisa lokho okufundile mayelana nezindlela zokubonisa izimpawu ukuze unikeze umbono wokuthi kungani ukubonisa izimpawu kuhlukile phakathi kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo. Ngokukhethekile, kungani ukubonisa izimpawu ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunokukhuluma izimpawu ezintweni eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa?
answer40: Izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi zihlangana phakathi kwamangqamuzana akude; izinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa zixhumana kuphela namangqamuzana aseduze
distractor40a: Izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi zihlanganisa ama-receptor okubonisa izimpawu; izinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa zixhumana ngokuhlanganiswa kwe-plasma membrane namaseli aseduze.
distractor40b: Izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi zidinga isikhathi esiningi sokudluliselwa kwesignali kunezinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa, njengoba zibonisa ukuhlukaniswa
distractor40c: Izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi zidinga isikhathi esiningi sokudluliselwa kwesignali kunezinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa, njengoba zingenazo izigaba
question41: Ama-biofilms ayingozi enkulu ekwelashweni kwezifo ezithelelanayo namuhla ngoba kunzima ukuthola imithi engangena kwi-biofilm. Yiziphi izici umuthi ongaba nazo uma uhlose ukuvimbela amagciwane ekwakheni ama-biofilms kwasekuqaleni? Chaza impendulo yakho.
answer41: Umuthi uzovimba ukuzwa kwe-quorum ngokuvimbela ukukhiqizwa, ukukhululwa, noma ukubopha kwama-autoinducers, ngaleyo ndlela kuvimbele ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlanganisiwe okudingekayo ekwakhekeni kwe-biofilm.
distractor41a: Lo muthi uzokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwama-autoinducer ukuze amabhaktheriya angene esigabeni se-biofilm ngokushesha futhi kube lula ukuwaqeda.
distractor41b: Umuthi uzovuselela ama-bacterial kinase ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindlela zokubonisana ezikhuthaza ukwakheka kwe-biofilm
distractor41c: Lo muthi uzoqinisa i-extracellular matrix ye-biofilm ukuze ama-antibacterial agents akwazi ukuqoqana ngempumelelo enkulu.
question42: Usebenzisa isici sokuhlangana kwemvubelo njengesibonelo, sekela umbono wokuthi izindlela zokubonisana zavela ekuqaleni kokuvela futhi zilondolozwe kahle. Hlola izincazelo ezinikeziwe ukuze ukhethe lowo osekela kangcono umbono
answer42: Ukubonisa izimpawu kumvubelo kusebenzisa ama-receptor ahlanganiswe yi-G-protein ukuze kubonise izimpawu futhi kulondolozwe ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo, njengokubonisa izimpawu ze-insulin kubantu
distractor42a: Ukubonisa izimpawu kumvubelo kusebenzisa indlela ye-RTK futhi kulondolozwe ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo, njengokubonisa izimpawu ze-insulin kubantu
distractor42b: Ukubonisana kwimvubelo kusebenzisa indlela ye-endocrine futhi kulondolozwe ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo, njengokubonisana kwe-insulin kubantu
distractor42c: Isici sokuhlangana kwemvubelo sisebenzisa indlela yokubonisana ye-autocrine futhi silondolozwa ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo
question43: Lapho kugwinywa amagciwane, amangqamuzana amhlophe egazi akhipha isithunywa samakhemikhali egazini esibangela ukwakheka kwamaprotheni asabela ekuvuvukeni ngamangqamuzana esibindi. Kuyini lokhu okuyisibonelo salokhu?
question44: Ama-molecule awahambi phakathi kwamaseli e-endothelial kuma-capillary obuchopho. Ulwelwesi lwamaseli kumele luhlanganiswe yini?
question45: Izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi zisebenzisa izigaba ezine ezahlukene zokubonisana kwamakhemikhali. Hlaziya izincazelo ezilandelayo ukuze ukhethe inzuzo enikezwa yi-autocrine signaling
answer45: Ukubonisana kwe-Autocrine kusiza ukukhulisa isignali ngokubangela ukukhiqizwa okwengeziwe kokubonisana kusuka kuseli uqobo
distractor45a: Ukubonisana kwe-Autocrine kusiza amaseli ukuxhumana namaseli akude
distractor45c: Ukubonisana kwe-Autocrine kuqondene kuphela neseli eliyikhiqizile, okulinika indlela eqondile yokuthumela imiyalezo
question46: Uma ikhemikhali iyisithiyo se-enzyme i-adenylyl cyclase, yiziphi izinyathelo ezilandelayo endleleni yokubonisana ye-G-protein ezingavinjelwa?
question47: I-hormone ye-thyroid iyi-molecule yesignali encibilika ku-lipid ewela ulwelwesi lwawo wonke amaseli. Kungani iseli lingahluleka ukusabela ku-hormone ye-thyroid?
answer47: Ayikho i-receptor yangaphakathi kweseli ye-hormone ye-thyroid esitokisini
distractor47a: Uchungechunge lwe-MAPK oluholela ekusebenzeni kweseli alunawo amaphutha kumaseli aqondiwe
distractor47c: Isithunywa sesibili asiboni isignali evela ku-receptor
question48: Ubuthi obuvela ku-bungarotoxin yenyoka ye-krait bubopha ngokungenakulungiseka kuma-receptor e-acetylcholine, buphazamisa ukubopha kwe-acetylcholine ku-synapse. Ubikezela ukuthi umphumela wokubopha kwe-bungarotoxin kuseli le-post synaptic uzoba yini?
question49: Ku-autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome (ALPS), ama-lymphocyte aphindaphindeka ngesikhathi sokutheleleka ayaqhubeka emzimbeni futhi alimaze izicubu. Lesi sifo sibangelwa ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ze-FAS okuhlanganisa i-receptor ebusweni beseli. Yimuphi umzila wokubonisana oqalwa yi-receptor?
question50:
Beka izehlakalo ezilandelayo ngokulandelana kwazo:
i-protein kinase A iyasebenza
ukuqhekeka kwe-glycogen
i-epinephrine ibopha ku-receptor exhunywe yi-G-protein
I-G-protein ivuselela i-adenylyl cyclase
I-GTP ishintshwa nge-GDP ku-G-protein
I-ATP iguqulwa ibe yi-cAMP
question51: Iphrotheni ye-RAS iyiphrotheni ye-G exhunywe ekuphenduleni kuma-receptor tyrosine kinases (RTKs) aqala i-MAPK kinase cascade lapho i-GDP ikhishwa futhi i-GTP ilayishwa. Ukuguqulwa kwephrotheni ye-RAS, okuphazamisa umsebenzi wayo we-GTPase, kuvamile kumdlavuza. Hlola ukuxhumana phakathi kokungakwazi kwe-RAS ukwenza i-hydrolyze ye-GTP kanye nokwanda kwamaseli okungalawulwa. Khetha incazelo engcono kakhulu yalokhu kuxhumana ngezansi.
answer51: I-RAS, uma iboshelwe ku-GTP, isebenza unomphela ngisho noma ingekho i-ligand, futhi ayisalawuleki ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
distractor51a: I-RAS, uma iboshelwe ku-GTP, ayisebenzi unomphela ngisho nalapho kukhona i-ligand, futhi ayisakwazi ukulawula ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli.
distractor51b: I-RAS, uma iboshelwe ku-GTP, yakha i-dimer ngemva kokubopha ku-ligand, futhi ibangela ukuhlukana okungalawuleki, kodwa ihlala ingasebenzi uma i-ligand ingekho.
distractor51c: I-RAS, uma iboshelwe ku-GTP, ayikhi i-dimer ngemva kokubopha ku-ligand kodwa ivuselela ukusayinwa kwezansi futhi ibangele ukuhlukana kwamaseli okungalawulwa.
question52: Imithi evamile ebizwa ngokuthi ama-β-blockers ibopha kuma-receptor axhunywe yi-G-protein emisipheni yenhliziyo, ivimba i-adrenaline. Inikezwa iziguli ezinomfutho wegazi ophakeme. Ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni kwakho ama-receptor axhunywe yi-G-protein, ungakha umbono ngendlela asebenza ngayo? Hlola bese ukhetha ezinkethweni ezinikezwe ngezansi.
answer52: I-Adrenaline inomphumela okhuthazayo ekushayeni kwenhliziyo kanye nomfutho wegazi. Ama-β-blockers aphikisana ne-adrenaline futhi akhiqiza umphumela wokuvimbela
distractor52a: I-Adrenaline inomphumela wokuvuselela kanye nokuvimbela ukushaya kwenhliziyo kanye nomfutho wegazi. Ama-β-blockers abopha kuma-receptor axhunywe yi-G-protein futhi avuselela umphumela wokuvimbela we-adrenaline
distractor52b: I-Adrenaline inomphumela wokuvimbela ukushaya kwenhliziyo kanye nomfutho wegazi. Ama-β-blockers anomphumela wokubambisana kanye ne-adrenaline, okhiqiza umphumela wokuvimbela
distractor52c: I-Adrenaline inomphumela wokuvuselela kanye nokuvimbela ukushaya kwenhliziyo kanye nomfutho wegazi. Ama-β-blockers abopha kuma-receptor axhunywe yi-G-protein futhi angenelela emphumeleni wokuvimbela we-adrenaline.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Bheka uMfanekiso 10.1. Umuntu, kanye nazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezizala ngokocansi, uqala ukuphila njengeqanda elivundisiwe (umbungu) noma i-zygote. Izigidigidi zokuhlukana kwamaseli kwenzeka ngendlela elawulwayo ukuze kukhiqizwe umuntu oyinkimbinkimbi, onamangqamuzana amaningi. Ngamanye amazwi, lelo seli elilodwa lokuqala lingukhokho wawo wonke amanye amaseli emzimbeni. Uma isidalwa sesikhule ngokugcwele, ukuzala kwamaseli kusadingeka ukulungisa noma ukuvuselela izicubu. Isibonelo, amaseli amasha egazi nesikhumba akhiqizwa njalo. Zonke izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi zisebenzisa ukwahlukana kwamaseli ukuze kukhule, kugcinwe, futhi kulungiswe izicubu. Ukwahlukaniswa kwamaseli kulawulwa ngokuqinile, futhi ukwehluleka ngezikhathi ezithile kokulawula kungaba nemiphumela esongela impilo. Izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli elilodwa zisebenzisa ukwahlukana kwamaseli njengendlela yazo yokuzala.

 Akuwona wonke amaseli emzimbeni azala ukulungisa izicubu. Izicubu eziningi zemizwa, isibonelo, azikwazi ukuvuselelwa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abonakalise izinzwa zabo noma uhlelo lwezinzwa bavame ukushiywa bekhubazekile.

 Kodwa-ke, lokhu kungashintsha esikhathini esizayo; Ososayensi bathole umuthi omusha obizwa ngokuthi i-intracellular signal peptide (ISP), osiza amangqamuzana ezinzwa ukuthi aphinde akhule emagundwini. Usebenza ngokuvimbela i-enzyme ebangela izicubu ezibomvu emaseli ezinzwa ezilimele okuvumela uhlelo lwezinzwa ithuba lokuzilungisa.
question1: Kungani ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kubalulekile ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi?
answer1: Kwenza kube lula ukukhula, ukugcinwa kwezicubu, kanye nokulungiswa kwazo
distractor1a: Ivumela amaseli ukuthi agweme ukuguga unomphela
distractor1c: Ivumela amaseli ukukhiqiza i-ATP ngaphandle kwe-mitochondria
question2: Izinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa zizalana kanjani ngokuyinhloko?
question3: Iyini i-zygote?
answer3: Iqanda elivundisiwe eliveza wonke amaseli ento ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi
question4: Kungani ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kufanele kulawulwe ngokuqinile?
answer4: Ngoba ukwehluleka kwemithetho kungaholela ezimweni ezisongela ukuphila njengomdlavuza
distractor4a: Ngoba ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kudla yonke i-ATP yamaseli
distractor4b: Ngoba amangqamuzana e-embryonic kuphela akwazi ukuhlukanisa
distractor4c: Ngoba ukuhlukaniswa kweseli kushintsha unomphela inombolo ye-chromosome
question5: Yiluphi uhlobo lwezicubu olunamandla okuvuselela alinganiselwe kakhulu kubantu?
question6: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli ezintweni eziphilayo ezindala ezinamaseli amaningi?
answer6: Ukulungisa nokufaka esikhundleni amaseli alimele noma agugile
question7: Ososayensi bathole i-intracellular signal peptide (ISP) ngoba ingasiza ekufezeni ini?
answer7: Khuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwamangqamuzana ezinzwa alimele ngokunciphisa ukwakheka kwezibazi
distractor7c: Guqula amangqamuzana esikhumba abe amangqamuzana egazi
question8: Kungani ukulimala kwesimiso sezinzwa kuvame ukuholela ekukhubazekeni okungapheli?
answer8: Izicubu eziningi zemizwa azinamandla okuvuselela noma azinawo nhlobo amandla okuvuselela
distractor8c: Amangqamuzana ezinzwa ahlukana njalo futhi aphelelwe amandla
question9: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuphazamisa amaprotheni alawula ukuqhubekela phambili komjikelezo weseli. Yini okungenzeka ibe umphumela?
answer9: Ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okungalawulwa kungenzeka
distractor9b: Amaseli alahlekelwa unomphela yizinhlayiya zawo ze-plasma
distractor9c: Amaseli ayayeka ukukhiqiza amaprotheni kodwa ayaqhubeka nokuhlukana ngokujwayelekile
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani iseli ngalinye emzimbeni womuntu lingalandelelwa libuyele eqandeni elilodwa elivundisiwe?
answer10: Imijikelezo elandelanayo yokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-mitotic okulawulwayo ikhiqiza wonke amaseli e-somatic kusuka ku-zygote yokuqala
distractor10b: Amangqamuzana omzimba amasha avela kuphela kumaseli okuqala akhiwe ngemva kokuzalwa
distractor10c: Isitho ngasinye sikhula sisuka eqandeni elihlukile elivundisiwe

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.1 Ukwahlukaniswa Kwamaseli | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.1 Ukwahlukaniswa Kwamaseli | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Zonke izinto eziphilayo, kusukela kubhaktheriya kuya ezilwaneni eziyinkimbinkimbi, kumele zikwazi ukugcina, ukubuyisa, nokudlulisa ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo ukuze ziqhubeke nokuphila. Ezahlukweni ezilandelayo, sizohlola ukuthi ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo lweseli olufakwe ku-DNA, i-genome yalo, luphindaphindwa kanjani futhi ludluliselwe esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ukuze luqondise ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni, kunqunywe izici zesidalwa. Ama-Prokaryotes ane-chromosome eyodwa eyindilinga ye-DNA, kanti ama-eukaryotes anama-chromosome amaningi, aqondile akhiwe yi-chromatin (i-DNA ezungezwe iphrotheni ye-histone) ezungezwe ulwelwesi lwenuzi. Ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kuhilela kokubili i-mitosis, ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromosome, kanye ne-cytokinesis, ukuhlukaniswa kwe-cytoplasm. Amaseli e-somatic abantu aqukethe ama-chromosome angu-46—ama-chromosome angu-22 angama-autosomal kanye nama-chromosome amabili ocansi. Ngaphambi kwe-mitosis, i-chromosome ngayinye iyaphindaphindwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaseli endodakazi athola inani eliphelele lezinto ezizuzwe njengefa ezinikezwe abazali bobabili. Inani eliphelele lama-chromosome e-autosomal libizwa ngokuthi inombolo ye-diploid (2n). (Esahlukweni esilandelayo, sizofunda i-meiosis, uhlobo lwesibili lokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli ezintweni eziphilayo ezizalanayo ngokocansi.)

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology, njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso enkulu 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluzuzwayo luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwayo ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa.

 Isayensi Practice
6.5 Umfundi angahlola ezinye izincazelo zesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha izincazelo zesayensi ezisebenzisa izakhiwo kanye nezindlela ze-DNA ne-RNA ukusekela isimangalo sokuthi i-DNA, futhi kwezinye izimo, i-RNA iyimithombo eyinhloko yolwazi oluzuzwayo.

 Ukuqhubeka kokuphila kusuka kwelinye iseli kuya kwelinye kusekelwe ekuzalweni kwamaseli ngendlela yomjikelezo weseli. Umjikelezo weseli uwukulandelana okuhlelekile kwezehlakalo okuchaza izigaba zokuphila kweseli kusukela ekuhlukanisweni kweseli elilodwa lomzali kuya ekukhiqizweni kwamaseli amabili amasha endodakazi. Izindlela ezihilelekile emjikelezweni weseli zilawulwa kakhulu
question1: Yiziphi izinqubo ezimbili ezinkulu ezenzeka ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kumaseli e-eukaryotic?
answer1: I-Mitosis kanye ne-cytokinesis
question2: Kungani ama-chromosome kufanele aphindwe kabili ngaphambi kwe-mitosis?
answer2: Ngakho-ke iseli ngalinye lendodakazi lithola isethi ephelele yolwazi oluzuzwe njengefa
distractor2c: Ukuvumela ama-chromosome ukuthi ashiye i-nucleus unomphela
question3: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle ama-chromosome e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic?
answer3: Ama-prokaryotes ngokuvamile ane-chromosome eyodwa eyindilinga, kanti ama-eukaryotes anama-chromosome amaningi aqondile.
distractor3b: Ama-prokaryotes anama-chromosome aqondile, kanti ama-eukaryotes anama-chromosome ayindilinga.
question4: Amaseli e-somatic omuntu aqukethe ama-chromosome amangaki?
question5: Kusho ukuthini ngenombolo ye-chromosome ye-diploid (2n)?
answer5: Iseli liqukethe amasethi amabili aphelele ama-chromosome, elilodwa elizuzwe kumzali ngamunye
distractor5a: Iseli liqukethe isethi eyodwa ephelele yama-chromosome
distractor5c: Iseli liqukethe ama-chromatid angodadewabo aphindaphindiwe kuphela
question6: Yisiphi isakhiwo seseli esakhiwa yi-DNA esizungezwe amaprotheni e-histone?
answer6: I-Chromatin
question7: Iyiphi inqubo ehlukanisa ngqo i-cytoplasm ibe amaseli amabili endodakazi?
answer7: I-Cytokinesis
question8: Ukuqhubeka kokuphila kusuka kwelinye iseli kuya kwelinye kuncike kakhulu kuyiphi inqubo yezinto eziphilayo?
answer8: Umjikelezo weseli
question9: Ulwazi oluzuzwayo ludluliselwa kanjani kusuka kuseli elilodwa le-somatic kuya kumaseli alo endodakazi?
answer9: I-DNA iphindaphindwa ngaphambi kwe-mitosis, futhi ama-chromosome aphindaphindwayo asatshalaliswa ngokulinganayo kumaseli endodakazi
distractor9a: I-DNA ikhiqizwa ngemva kwe-cytokinesis futhi isatshalaliswa ngokungahleliwe
distractor9b: Ama-chromosome ahlukaniswa phakathi ngesikhathi se-mitosis ngaphambi kokusatshalaliswa
distractor9c: I-RNA iyaphindaphindwa futhi ithatha indawo ye-DNA ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
question10: Kungani izindlela ezilawula umjikelezo weseli zilawulwa kakhulu?
answer10: Ukuqinisekisa ukudluliswa okunembile kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okufanele
distractor10b: Ukwandisa amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.1 Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamaseli | I-DNA Yezakhi Zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.1 Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamaseli | I-DNA Yezakhi Zofuzo
chapterContent:
Ngaphambi kokuxoxa ngezinyathelo okumele iseli lizithathe ukuze liziphindaphinde, kudingeka ukuqonda okujulile ngesakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi wolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo lweseli. I-DNA yeseli, ehlanganiswe njenge-molecule ye-DNA enezintambo ezimbili, ibizwa ngokuthi i-genome yayo. Kuma-prokaryotes, i-genome yakhiwe yi-molecule eyodwa, enezintambo ezimbili ye-DNA ngesimo se-loop noma indilinga (Isithombe 10.2). Indawo esesiseleni equkethe lezi zinto zezakhi zofuzo ibizwa ngokuthi i-nucleoid. Amanye ama-prokaryotes nawo anezihibe ezincane ze-DNA ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-plasmid ezingabalulekile ekukhuleni okuvamile. Ama-bacteria angashintshana ngala ma-plasmid namanye ama-bacteria, ngezinye izikhathi athole izakhi zofuzo ezintsha ezizuzisayo umuntu ozitholayo angazifaka ku-DNA yawo ye-chromosome. Ukumelana nama-antibiotic kuyisici esisodwa esivame ukusabalala ngekoloni lamagciwane ngokushintshana kwe-plasmid.

 Kuma-eukaryotes, i-genome iqukethe ama-molecule e-DNA aqondile amaningana anezintambo ezimbili (Isithombe 10.3). Uhlobo ngalunye lwama-eukaryotes lunenombolo ephawulekayo yama-chromosome kuma-nuclei amaseli alo. Amaseli omzimba womuntu anama-chromosome angu-46, kuyilapho ama-gametes abantu (isidoda noma amaqanda) enama-chromosome angu-23 ngalinye. Iseli lomzimba elijwayelekile, noma iseli le-somatic, liqukethe amasethi amabili afanayo ama-chromosome, ukwakheka okwaziwa ngokuthi i-diploid. Uhlamvu u-n lusetshenziselwa ukumela isethi eyodwa yama-chromosome; ngakho-ke, isidalwa se-diploid sibizwa ngokuthi u-2n. Amaseli abantu aqukethe isethi eyodwa yama-chromosome abizwa ngokuthi ama-gametes, noma amaseli ocansi; lawa amaqanda nesidoda, futhi abizwa ngokuthi u-1n, noma i-haploid.

 Ama-chromosome amabili afanayo ku-diploid organism abizwa ngokuthi ama-chromosome angama-homologous (ulwazi olufanayo). Ama-chromosome angama-homologous anobude obufanayo futhi anezingxenye ezithile ze-nucleotide ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-gene endaweni efanayo, noma i-locus. Ama-gene, amayunithi asebenzayo ama-chromosome, anquma izici ezithile ngokufaka ikhodi yamaprotheni athile. Izici ziyizinguquko zalezo zici. Isibonelo, umbala wezinwele uyisici esinezici ezi-blonde, ezinsundu, noma ezimnyama.

 Ikhophi ngayinye yama-chromosome amabili angama-homologous ivela kumzali ohlukile; ngakho-ke, ama-gene ngokwawo awafani. Ukwehluka kwabantu ngaphakathi kohlobo oluthile kungenxa yokuhlanganiswa okuthile kwama-gene azuzwe kubazali bobabili. Ngisho nokulandelana okushintshiwe kancane kwama-nucleotide ngaphakathi kwe-gene kungabangela isici esihlukile. Isibonelo, kunezinhlobo ezintathu zama-gene ezingaba khona ku-chromosome yomuntu ezikhomba uhlobo lwegazi: ukulandelana A, ukulandelana B, kanye nokulandelana O. Ngenxa yokuthi wonke amaseli abantu angama-diploid anamakhophi amabili e-chromosome enquma uhlobo lwegazi, uhlobo lwegazi (isici) lunqunywa ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili ze-marker gene ezizuzwe njengefa. Kungenzeka ukuthi kube namakhophi amabili ochungechunge olufanayo lwezakhi zofuzo kuzo zombili i-chromosomes ezihambisanayo, eyodwa ngayinye (isibonelo, i-AA, i-BB, noma i-OO), noma uchungechunge oluhlukene olufana ne-AB.

 Ukwehluka okuncane kwezimpawu, njengohlobo lwegazi, umbala wamehlo, kanye nokuba sesimweni sokwahluka, kunegalelo ekwehlukeni kwemvelo okutholakala ngaphakathi kohlobo. Kodwa-ke, uma uchungechunge lonke lwe-DNA oluvela kunoma yimaphi ama-chromosomes ezihambisanayo zabantu luqhathaniswa, umehluko ungaphansi kwephesenti elilodwa. Ama-chromosome ocansi, u-X no-Y, ayisici esisodwa esihlukile emthethweni wokufana kwe-chromosome ezihambisanayo: Ngaphandle kwenani elincane le-homology elidingekayo ukuze kukhiqizwe ama-gametes ngokunembile, izakhi zofuzo ezitholakala kuma-chromosomes e-X no-Y zihlukile.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.1 Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamaseli | Isakhiwo se-Eukaryotic Chromosomal kanye nokuQonda
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.1 Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamaseli | Isakhiwo se-Eukaryotic Chromosomal kanye nokuQonda
chapterContent:
Uma i-DNA evela kuwo wonke ama-chromosome angu-46 ku-nucleus yeseli lomuntu ibekwe kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni, ibingalinganisa cishe amabili amamitha ; nokho, ububanzi bayo bungaba yi-nm ezimbili kuphela. Uma ubheka ukuthi ubukhulu beseli lomuntu elijwayelekile bungaba yi-10 μm (amaseli ayi-100,000 abekwe ndawonye alingana nemitha elilodwa), i-DNA kumele ihlanganiswe kahle ukuze ilingane ne-nucleus yeseli. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, kumele futhi itholakale kalula ukuze izakhi zofuzo zivezwe. Phakathi nezigaba ezithile zomjikelezo weseli, imicu emide ye-DNA ihlanganiswa ibe ama-chromosome aqinile. Kunezindlela eziningi ama-chromosome ahlanganiswa ngazo.

 Ezingeni lokuqala lokuhlanganiswa, ukunwebeka okufushane kwe-DNA double helix kugoqa umongo wamaprotheni ayisishiyagalombili e-histone ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile kulo lonke ubude be-chromosome (Isithombe 10.4). I-DNA-histone complex iyingxenye ye-chromatin. I-histone-DNA complex ngayinye efana nobhontshisi ibizwa ngokuthi i-nucleosome, kanti i-DNA exhumanisa ama-nucleosome ibizwa ngokuthi i-linker DNA. I-molecule ye-DNA kule fomu imfushane ngokuphindwe kasikhombisa kune-double helix engenawo ama-histone, kanti ubuhlalu bucishe bube ngu-10 nm ububanzi, ngokungafani nobubanzi obungu-2 nm be-DNA double helix. Izinga elilandelayo lokuxinana kwenzeka njengoba ama-nucleosome kanye ne-linker DNA phakathi kwawo ehlanganiswa ibe yi-chromatin fiber engu-30 nm. Lokhu kugoqa kufinyeza i-chromosome ukuze manje ibe mfushane ngokuphindwe ka-50 kunefomu elandisiwe. Ezingeni lesithathu lokupakisha, kusetshenziswa izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaprotheni ane-fibrous ukupakisha i-chromatin. Lawa maprotheni ane-fibrous aqinisekisa nokuthi i-chromosome ngayinye esitokisini esingahlukanisi ithatha indawo ethile ye-nucleus engahambisani neyanoma iyiphi enye i-chromosome (bheka isithombe esiphezulu kuMfanekiso 10.3).

 I-DNA iyaphindaphinda esigabeni se-S se-interphase. Ngemuva kokuphindaphinda, ama-chromosome akhiwa ama-chromatids amabili axhumene. Uma ehlangene ngokugcwele, ama-pair ama-chromosome ahlanganiswe ngendlela efanayo ahlanganiswa ngamaprotheni e-cohesin. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwama-chromatids angodade kuseduze kakhulu esifundeni esibizwa ngokuthi i-centromere. Ama-chromatids angodade ahlangene, anobubanzi obungaba ngu-1 μm, abonakala ngaphansi kwe-microscope ekhanyayo. Isifunda se-centromeric sifingqiwe kakhulu ngakho-ke sizovela njengendawo encishisiwe.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.2 Umjikelezo Weseli | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.2 Umjikelezo Weseli | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Umjikelezo weseli uchaza ukulandelana okuhlelekile kwemicimbi okulawulwa kakhulu. Kuma-eukaryotes, umjikelezo weseli uqukethe isikhathi eside sokulungiselela (i-interphase) esilandelwa yi-mitosis kanye ne-cytokinesis. I-Interphase ihlukaniswe ngezigaba ezintathu: I-Gap 1 (G1), ukwenziwa kwe-DNA (S), kanye ne-Gap 2 (G2). I-Interphase imele ingxenye yomjikelezo weseli phakathi kokuhlukaniswa kwe-nuclear. Phakathi nalesi sigaba, kwenziwa amalungiselelo okuhlukana okuhlanganisa ukukhula, ukuphindaphindwa kokuqukethwe okuningi kweseli, kanye nokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA. I-DNA yeseli iphindaphindwa ngesikhathi sesigaba se-S. (Sizofunda imininingwane yokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA esahlukweni mayelana nesakhiwo nomsebenzi we-DNA.) Ngemva kwesigaba se-G2 se-interphase, iseli liqala i-mitosis, inqubo yokuhlukaniswa okusebenzayo lapho ama-chromosome aphindaphindwayo (ama-chromatids) anamathela khona ku-spindle fibers, azivumelanise ne-equator yeseli, bese ehlukana.

 Ngemva kwe-mitosis, iseli lidlula i-cytokinesis, ukuhlukaniswa kweseli lomzali libe amaseli amabili endodakazi, aphelele ngokupheleliswa okugcwele kwezinto zofuzo. Emaseli ezilwaneni, amaseli endodakazi ahlukaniswa yindandatho ye-actin, kanti amaseli ezitshalo ahlukaniswa yipuleti leseli, elizokhula libe udonga olusha lweseli. Ngezinye izikhathi amaseli angena esigabeni se-Gap zero (G0), lapho engalungiseleli khona ukuhlukana; isigaba se-G0 singaba sesikhashana kuze kube yilapho siqaliswa isignali yangaphandle yokungena ku-G1, noma esihlala njalo, njengamaseli emisipha yenhliziyo avuthiwe namaseli ezinzwa.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology, njengoba kuboniswe ematafuleni. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umjikelezo weseli uchungechunge oluhlelekile lwezehlakalo ezihilela ukukhula kweseli kanye nokuhlukaniswa kweseli okukhiqiza amaseli amabili amasha amantombazane. Amaseli asendleleni eya ekuhlukanisweni kweseli aqhubeka ngochungechunge lwezigaba zokukhula ezihlelwe ngesikhathi esifanele futhi ezilawulwa ngokucophelela, ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA, kanye nokuhlukaniswa okukhiqiza amaseli amabili afanayo (ama-clone). Umjikelezo weseli unezigaba ezimbili ezinkulu: i-interphase kanye ne-mitotic phase (Isithombe 10.5). Ngesikhathi se-interphase, iseli liyakhula futhi i-DNA iyaphindaphindwa. Ngesikhathi se-mitotic phase, i-DNA ephindaphindwayo kanye nokuqukethwe kwe-cytoplasmic kuyahlukaniswa, bese iseli liyahlukana

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.2 Umjikelezo Weseli | Isigaba Esiphakathi | Isigaba se-G1 (Isikhala Sokuqala), Isigaba se-S (Ukwenziwa kwe-DNA), Isigaba se-G2 (Isikhala Sesibili)
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.2 Umjikelezo Weseli | Isigaba Esiphakathi | Isigaba se-G1 (Isikhala Sokuqala), Isigaba se-S (Ukwenziwa kwe-DNA), Isigaba se-G2 (Isikhala Sesibili)
chapterContent:
Ngesikhathi sokuhlanganisa izigaba, iseli lidlula ezinqubweni zokukhula ezijwayelekile ngenkathi lilungiselela nokuhlukaniswa kweseli. Ukuze iseli lisuke esigabeni sokuhlanganisa liye esigabeni se-mitotic, izimo eziningi zangaphakathi nezangaphandle kumele zihlangatshezwe. Izigaba ezintathu zesigaba sokuhlanganisa zibizwa ngokuthi i-G1, i-S, kanye ne-G2.

 Isigaba se-G1 (Isikhala Sokuqala)
Isigaba sokuqala sesigaba sokuhlanganisa sibizwa ngokuthi isigaba se-G1 (isikhala sokuqala) ngoba, kusukela esicini esincane, ushintsho oluncane luyabonakala. Kodwa-ke, ngesikhathi sesigaba se-G1, iseli lisebenza kahle ezingeni le-biochemical. Iseli liqoqa izakhi ze-DNA ye-chromosome kanye namaprotheni ahlobene kanye nokuqoqa amandla anele okugcina umsebenzi wokuphindaphinda i-chromosome ngayinye ku-nucleus.

 Isigaba se-S (Ukwenziwa kwe-DNA)
Kuyo yonke i-interphase, i-DNA yenuzi ihlala isesimweni se-chromatin esinciphile. Esigabeni se-S, ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kungaqhubeka ngezindlela eziholela ekwakhekeni kwama-molecule e-DNA afanayo—ama-chromatids angodade—anamathele ngokuqinile esifundeni se-centromeric. Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-centrosome kuqala ngesikhathi sesigaba se-S. Ama-centrosome amabili azodala i-mitotic spindle, ithuluzi eliqondisa ukunyakaza kwama-chromosome ngesikhathi se-mitosis. Enkabeni yeseli ngalinye lesilwane, ama-centrosome amaseli esilwane ahlotshaniswa nezinto ezimbili ezifana nenduku, ama-centrioles, asema-engeli afanele komunye nomunye. Ama-Centrioles asiza ukuhlela ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli. Ama-Centrioles awakho kuma-centrosome ezinye izinhlobo ze-eukaryotic, njengezitshalo kanye ne-fungi eningi.

 Isigaba se-G2 (Isikhala Sesibili)
Esigabeni se-G2, iseli ligcwalisa kabusha izitolo zalo zamandla futhi lenze amaprotheni adingekayo ekuphathweni kwama-chromosome. Amanye ama-organelle eseli ayaphindaphindwa, futhi i-cytoskeleton iyahlakazwa ukuze inikeze izinsiza zesigaba se-mitotic. Ukuphindaphindwa kwama-centrosome kuyaqedwa. Kungase kube nokwengezwa kokukhula kwamaseli i-G2. Amalungiselelo okugcina esigaba se-mitotic kumele aqedwe ngaphambi kokuba iseli likwazi ukungena esigabeni sokuqala se-mitosis.

answer7: Ukukopisha kwe-Centrosome
question8: Uyini umsebenzi wama-centrosome?
answer8: Zidala i-mitotic spindle eshukumisa ama-chromosome ngesikhathi se-mitosis
question9: Ayini ama-centrioles?
answer9: Izakhiwo ezifana nenduku ezihlotshaniswa nama-centrosome emaseli ezilwane ezisiza ukuhlela ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
question10: Yimaphi ama-eukaryote angenayo ama-centrioles kuma-centrosome awo?
answer10: Izitshalo kanye nesikhunta esiningi
question11: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sesigaba se-G2?
answer11: Iseli ligcwalisa amandla, lenze amaprotheni e-mitosis, liphindaphinde amanye ama-organelle, lihlukanise i-cytoskeleton, futhi liqedele ukuphindaphindwa kwe-centrosome
question12: Kungani i-cytoskeleton ihlakazwa ngesikhathi se-G2?
question13: Ngaphambi kokuba iseli lingene ku-mitosis, yini okumele yenzeke?
answer13: Amalungiselelo okugcina ngesikhathi se-G2 kumele aqedwe

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.2 Umjikelezo Weseli | Isigaba Se-Mitotic | I-Karyokinesis (i-Mitosis)
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.2 Umjikelezo Weseli | Isigaba Se-Mitotic | I-Karyokinesis (i-Mitosis)
chapterContent:
I-Karyokinesis, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-mitosis, ihlukaniswe uchungechunge lwezigaba—i-prophase, i-prometaphase, i-metaphase, i-anaphase, kanye ne-telophase—eziholela ekuhlukanisweni kwe-nucleus yeseli (Isithombe 10.7).

 Ngesikhathi se-prophase, isigaba sokuqala,” imvilophu yenuzi iqala ukuhlukana ibe ama-vesicle amancane, kanye nama-organelle e-membranous (njenge-Golgi complex noma i-Golgi apparatus, kanye ne-endoplasmic reticulum), ayahlukana futhi asakazeke aye emngceleni weseli. I-nucleolus iyanyamalala (iyahlakazeka). Ama-centrosome aqala ukuhamba aye ezingosini eziphambene zeseli. Ama-microtubules azokwakha i-mitotic spindle anda phakathi kwama-centrosome, awasunduze aqhelelane njengoba imicu ye-microtubule ikhula. Ama-chromatids angodade aqala ukugoqana kakhulu ngosizo lwamaprotheni e-condensin futhi abonakale ngaphansi kwe-microscope ekhanyayo.

 Ngesikhathi se-prometaphase, isigaba sokuqala sokushintsha,” izinqubo eziningi ezaqalwa ku-prophase ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Izinsalela ze-nuclear envelope fragment. I-mitotic spindle iyaqhubeka nokukhula njengoba ama-microtubules amaningi ehlangana futhi enwebeka kulo lonke ubude bendawo yangaphambili yenuzi. Ama-chromosome aba mancane futhi ahlukene. I-chromatid ngayinye eyisihlobo ithuthukisa isakhiwo seprotheni esibizwa ngokuthi i-kinetochore esifundeni se-centromeric (Isithombe 10.8). Amaprotheni e-kinetochore adonsela futhi abopha ama-microtubules e-mitotic spindle. Njengoba ama-microtubules e-spindle esukela kuma-centrosome, amanye ala ma-microtubules ahlangana futhi abopha ngokuqinile kuma-kinetochores. Uma i-mitotic fiber inamathela ku-chromosome, i-chromosome izoqondiswa kuze kube yilapho ama-kinetochores ama-chromatids eyisihlobo ebhekene nezinsika eziphambene. Ekugcineni, wonke ama-chromatids eyisihlobo azoxhunyaniswa ngama-kinetochores awo kuma-microtubules avela ezinsika eziphikisanayo. Ama-microtubules e-spindle angahlangani nama-chromosome abizwa ngokuthi ama-microtubules e-polar. Lawa ma-microtubules ahlangana phakathi kwezinsika ezimbili futhi anegalelo ekukhuleni kweseli. Ama-microtubules e-astral atholakala eduze kwezinsika, asiza ekuqondisweni kwe-spindle, futhi ayadingeka ekulawulweni kwe-mitosis.

 Ngesikhathi se-metaphase, isigaba sokushintsha,” wonke ama-chromosome aqondaniswe endizeni ebizwa ngokuthi i-metaphase plate, noma i-equatorial plane, phakathi kwezigxobo ezimbili zeseli. Ama-chromatids angodade asanamathelene ngokuqinile ngamaprotheni e-cohesin. Ngalesi sikhathi, ama-chromosome ancishisiwe kakhulu.

 Ngesikhathi se-anaphase, isigaba sokukhuphuka,” amaprotheni e-cohesin ayawohloka, kanti ama-chromatids angodade ayahlukana ku-centromere. I-chromatid ngayinye, manje ebizwa ngokuthi i-chromosome, idonswa ngokushesha iye ku-centrosome lapho kunamathele khona i-microtubule yayo. Iseli liba lide ngokubonakalayo (limise okweqanda) njengoba ama-microtubules aphansi eshelelana epuletini le-metaphase lapho ehlangana khona.

 Ngesikhathi se-telophase, isigaba sebanga,” ama-chromosome afinyelela ezinsikeni eziphambene bese eqala ukuwohloka (ukuvuleka), ephumula abe yisimo se-chromatin. Ama-mitotic spindles asuswa i-polymer abe ama-tubulin monomers azosetshenziselwa ukuhlanganisa izingxenye ze-cytoskeletal zeseli ngalinye lendodakazi. Ama-envelope enuzi akha nxazonke zama-chromosome, futhi ama-nucleosome avela ngaphakathi kwendawo yenuzi.
question1: Iyini isigaba se-mitotic?
answer1: Isigaba somjikelezo weseli lapho ama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe ahlukaniswa khona futhi asakazwe abe amaseli amabili afanayo, kulandele i-cytokinesis

question10: Ayini ama-microtubules e-astral?
answer10: Ama-microtubules atholakala eduze kwezinsika ezisiza ekuqondiseni i-spindle nokulawula i-mitosis
question11: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi se-metaphase?
answer11: Ama-chromosome ahambisana nepuleti le-metaphase maphakathi neseli
question12: Iyini ipuleti le-metaphase?
answer12: Indiza ecatshangelwayo phakathi kwezinsika ezimbili lapho ama-chromosome ehlangana khona ngesikhathi se-metaphase
distractor12b: Indawo lapho kuqala khona ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
distractor12c: Indawo lapho imicu ye-spindle iqala khona
question13: Kwenzekani kumaprotheni e-cohesin ngesikhathi se-anaphase?
answer13: Ziyawohloka, okuvumela ama-chromatid angodade ukuthi ahlukane

question16: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi se-telophase?
answer16: Ama-chromosome afinyelela ezinsikeni eziphambene, aqhekeke abe yi-chromatin, ashintshe ama-envelope enuzi, bese i-mitotic spindle iyahlukana.
question17: Kwenzekani ngemicu ye-spindle ngesikhathi se-telophase?
answer17: Zisuswa ku-polymer zibe ama-tubulin monomers angaphinde asetshenziswe yiseli
question18: Yikuphi kokulandelayo okuwukulandelana okufanele kwezehlakalo ku-mitosis?
answer18: I-kinetochore inamathela ku-mitotic spindle. Ama-chromatids angodade ayalandelana epuletini le-metaphase. Amaprotheni e-cohesin ayaqhekeka bese ama-chromatids angodade ayahlukana. Ukuguqulwa kwe-nucleus kanye nokuhlukana kweseli
distractor18a: Ama-chromatids angodade ayalandelana epuletini le-metaphase. I-kinetochore inamathela ku-mitotic spindle. Ukuguqulwa kwe-nucleus kanye nokuhlukana kweseli. Amaprotheni e-cohesin ayaqhekeka bese ama-chromatids angodade ehlukana.
distractor18b: I-kinetochore inamathela ku-mitotic spindle. Amaprotheni e-cohesin ayaqhekeka bese ama-chromatids angodadewabo ehlukana. Ama-chromatids angodadewabo alandelana epuletini le-metaphase. Ukuguqulwa kwe-nucleus kanye neseli kuyahlukana
distractor18c: I-kinetochore inamathela kumaphrotheni e-cohesin. Ama-chromatids angodade ayalandelana epuletini le-metaphase. I-kinetochore iyaphuka bese ama-chromatids angodade ayahlukana. Ukuguqulwa kwe-nucleus bese iseli liyahlukana
question19: Bheka uMfanekiso 10.6. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo esichaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-mitosis kanye nokuzala okungenabo ubulili?
answer19: I-Mitosis inqubo engabangela ukuzala okungenabo ubulili

distractor19c: Ukuzala okungenabo ubulili kuyinqubo engabangela i-mitosis

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.2 Umjikelezo Weseli | Isigaba Se-Mitotic | I-Cytokinesis
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.2 Umjikelezo Weseli | Isigaba Se-Mitotic | I-Cytokinesis
chapterContent:
I-Cytokinesis, noma ukunyakaza kweseli,” yisigaba sesibili esiyinhloko sesigaba se-mitotic, lapho ukuhlukaniswa kweseli kuqedwa khona ngokuhlukaniswa ngokomzimba kwezingxenye ze-cytoplasmic zibe amaseli amabili endodakazi. Ukuhlukana akuqediwe kuze kube yilapho izingxenye zeseli sezihlukaniswe futhi zahlukaniswa ngokuphelele kumaseli amabili endodakazi. Nakuba izigaba ze-mitosis zifana kuma-eukaryotes amaningi, inqubo ye-cytokinesis ihluke kakhulu kuma-eukaryotes anezindonga zeseli, njengamaseli ezitshalo.

 Emaselini afana namaseli ezilwane angenazo izindonga zeseli, i-cytokinesis iqala ngesikhathi se-anaphase yamuva. Indandatho ehlanganisiwe eyakhiwe yi-actin filaments yakha ngaphakathi nje kwe-plasma membrane epuletini le-metaphase langaphambili. Izintambo ze-actin zidonsa i-equator yeseli ngaphakathi, zakha i-fassure. Lo mfantu, noma i-crack,” ubizwa ngokuthi i-cleavage furrow. Umfantu uyajula njengoba indandatho ye-actin incipha, futhi ekugcineni i-membrane iqhekeka kabili (Isithombe 10.9).

 Kumaseli ezitshalo, udonga olusha lweseli kumele lwakheke phakathi kwamaseli endodakazi. Ngesikhathi sokuhlukana, idivayisi yeGolgi iqoqa ama-enzyme, amaprotheni esakhiwo, kanye nama-molecule e-glucose ngaphambi kokuqhekeka abe ama-vesicle futhi ahlakazeke kulo lonke iseli elihlukanisayo. Ngesikhathi se-telophase, la ma-vesicle e-Golgi athuthwa kuma-microtubules ukuze akhe i-phragmoplast (isakhiwo se-vesicular) epuletini le-metaphase. Lapho, ama-vesicle ayahlangana futhi ahlangane kusukela maphakathi kuya ezindongeni zeseli; lesi sakhiwo sibizwa ngokuthi ipuleti leseli. Njengoba ama-vesicle ehlangana kakhulu, ipuleti leseli liyakhula lize lihlangane nezindonga zeseli emngceleni weseli. Ama-enzyme asebenzisa i-glucose eqongelelene phakathi kwezingqimba ze-membrane ukwakha udonga olusha lweseli. Ama-membrane e-Golgi aba izingxenye ze-plasma membrane kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zodonga olusha lweseli (Isithombe 10.9)
question1: Kuyini i-cytokinesis?
answer1: Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-cytoplasm ehlukanisa iseli elilodwa libe amaseli amabili endodakazi
question2: Kunini lapho ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kubhekwa njengokuqediwe?

question3: I-cytokinesis ihluke kanjani phakathi kwamaseli ezilwane nezitshalo?
answer3: Amaseli ezilwane ahlukana ngokwakha umsele wokuqhekeka, kuyilapho amaseli ezitshalo akha ipuleti leseli elikhula libe udonga olusha lweseli
distractor3a: Amaseli ezilwane akha ipuleti lamaseli, kanti amaseli ezitshalo akha umsele oqhekekile
question4: I-cytokinesis iqala nini kumaseli ezilwane?

answer6: Idonsa ulwelwesi lwe-plasma ngaphakathi ukuze ihlukanise iseli
question7: Uyini umsele wokuqhekeka?
answer7: Ukugoba okwakhiwa njengoba ulwelwesi lwe-plasma ludonswa ngaphakathi ngesikhathi se-cytokinesis kumaseli ezilwane
distractor7a: Indawo lapho ama-chromosomes ehlangana khona ngesikhathi se-metaphase
distractor7c: Udonga olusha lweseli olwakhiwe emaseli ezitshalo
question8: Kungani amangqamuzana ezitshalo esebenzisa indlela ehlukile ye-cytokinesis kunamaseli ezilwane?
answer8: Ngoba izindonga zamaseli azo eziqinile zivimbela ulwelwesi lwe-plasma ukuthi lungene ngaphakathi

distractor8c: Ngoba amangqamuzana ezitshalo awabi ngaphansi kwe-mitosis
question9: Yini eqoqa izinto ezidingekayo ze-plant cytokinesis ngaphambi kwe-mitosis?
answer9: Idivayisi yeGolgi
question10: Iyini i-phragmoplast?
answer10: Isakhiwo se-vesicular esakhiwe yi-Golgi vesicles epuletini le-metaphase esidala ipuleti leseli
question11: Iyini ipuleti leseli?
answer11: Isakhiwo esakhiwe yi-Golgi vesicles ehlanganisiwe ekhula ibe udonga olusha lweseli phakathi kwamaseli endodakazi
distractor11a: Indiza lapho ama-chromosomes ehlangana khona ngesikhathi se-metaphase
question12: Ipuleti leseli likhula kanjani ngesikhathi se-plant cytokinesis?
answer12: Iyakhula kusukela enkabeni yeseli iye ngaphandle kuze kube yilapho ihlangana nezindonga zeseli ezikhona
distractor12b: Yakha ngasikhathi sinye kulo lonke udonga lweseli
question13: Yini esetshenziswa ama-enzyme ukwakha udonga olusha lweseli lesitshalo?
answer13: Ama-molecule e-glucose aqongelela phakathi kwezingqimba ze-membrane
question14: Yini ekugcineni eba yi-plasma membranes yamaseli amabili ezitshalo zendodakazi?

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.2 Umjikelezo Weseli | Isigaba se-G0
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.2 Umjikelezo Weseli | Isigaba se-G0
chapterContent: Akuwona wonke amaseli anamathela kuphethini yomjikelezo weseli yakudala lapho iseli lendodakazi elisakhiwe kabusha lingena khona manjalo ezigabeni zokulungiselela zesigaba esiphakathi, lilandelwa eduze yisigaba se-mitotic. Amaseli esigabeni se-G0 awalungiseleli ukuhlukana ngenkuthalo. Iseli lisesigabeni sokuthula (esingasebenzi) esenzeka lapho amaseli ephuma emjikelezweni weseli. Amanye amaseli angena ku-G0 okwesikhashana kuze kube yilapho isignali yangaphandle iqala ukuqala kwe-G1. Amanye amaseli angakaze ahlukane noma angavamile, njengemisipha yenhliziyo namaseli ezinzwa avuthiwe, ahlala ku-G0 unomphela.
question1: Iyini isigaba se-G0?
answer1: Isigaba sokuthula (esingasebenzi) lapho amaseli ephumile emjikelezweni weseli futhi engalungiseleli ngokuzikhandla ukwahlukana
distractor1a: Isigaba lapho kwenzeka khona ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
distractor1b: Isigaba lapho ama-chromatids odade ehlukana khona
question2: Isigaba se-G0 sihluke kanjani ku-G1?
answer2: Amaseli ku-G0 awalungiseleli ukuhlukana, kuyilapho amaseli ku-G1 elungiselela ngenkuthalo ukungena emjikelezweni weseli.
distractor2a: Amaseli aku-G0 aphindaphinda i-DNA ngenkuthalo, kuyilapho amaseli aku-G1 engaphindaphindi
distractor2b: Amaseli ku-G0 adlula ngokushesha ku-mitosis, kuyilapho amaseli ku-G1 ehlala engasebenzi
question3: Ingabe amaseli angashiya isigaba se-G0?
answer3: Yebo, amanye amaseli ahlala okwesikhashana ku-G0 kuze kube yilapho isignali yangaphandle ibangela ukungena ku-G1
distractor3a: Cha, wonke amaseli angena ku-G0 ahlala lapho unomphela
distractor3c: Amaseli ashiya i-G0 kuphela ngemva kokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
question4: Yini ebangela amanye amaseli ukuba ashiye isigaba se-G0?
question5: Yimaphi amaseli avame ukuhlala unomphela ku-G0?
answer5: Amaseli emisipha yenhliziyo avuthiwe kanye namaseli ezinzwa
distractor5b: Amaseli okuqala omnkantsha wamathambo namaseli esibindi
distractor5c: Amaseli e-embryonic stem kanye namaseli e-plant meristem
question6: Kungani amangqamuzana ezinzwa avuthiwe ngokuvamile ehlala ku-G0?
answer6: Ngoba akuvamile noma azikaze zihlukane ngemva kokufinyelela ekuvuthweni

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.3 Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.3 Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Isinyathelo ngasinye somjikelezo weseli siqashwe eduze yizibonakaliso zangaphandle kanye nezilawuli zangaphakathi ezibizwa ngokuthi izindawo zokuhlola. Kunezindawo ezintathu zokuhlola ezinkulu emjikelezweni weseli: esisodwa eduze kokuphela kwe-G1, esesibili ekuguqukeni kwe-G2/M, kanti esesithathu ngesikhathi se-metaphase. Amaprotheni e-Growth factor afika e-plasma membrane yeseli elihlukanisayo angabangela iseli ukuthi liqale ukuhlukana. Ama-Cyclins kanye nama-cyclin-dependent kinases (ama-Cdks) yizibonakaliso zangaphakathi zama-molecule ezilawula ukuguquka kweseli ezindaweni zokuhlola ezahlukahlukene. Ukudlula endaweni yokuhlola ye-G1 kuqinisekisa ukuthi iseli lilungele ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA esigabeni se-S se-interphase; ukudlula endaweni yokuhlola ye-G2 kubangela ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromatids ngesikhathi se-mitosis. Ama-molecule alawulayo amahle njenge-cyclins kanye nama-Cdks avumela umjikelezo weseli ukuthi uqhubekele esigabeni esilandelayo; ama-molecule alawulayo angalungile, njengama-protein acindezela isimila, aqapha izimo zamaseli futhi angamisa umjikelezo kuze kube yilapho kuhlangatshezwana nezidingo ezithile. Amaphutha ekulawulweni komjikelezo weseli angabangela umdlavuza, obonakala ngokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okungalawulwa.

 Inhloso enkulu 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluzuzwayo luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwayo ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa.

 Isayensi Yokuzijwayeza
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi kanye namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.7 Umfundi angenza izibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ezenzeka ngesikhathi somjikelezo weseli.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.2 Umfundi angachaza izethulo kanye namamodeli ezenzakalo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kanye nezinhlelo endaweni.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.8 Umfundi angachaza izehlakalo ezenzeka kumjikelezo weseli.

 Ubude bomjikelezo weseli buyahlukahluka kakhulu, ngisho nangaphakathi kwamaseli ento eyodwa. Kubantu, imvamisa yokuguquka kwamaseli isukela emahoreni ambalwa ekukhuleni kokuqala kombungu, kuya emahoreni amabili kuya kwayisihlanu amaseli e-epithelial, kanye nesikhathi sokuphila komuntu esichithwa ku-G0 ngamaseli akhethekile, njenge-cortical neurons noma amaseli emisipha yenhliziyo. Kukhona futhi nokwehluka esikhathini iseli elisichitha esigabeni ngasinye somjikelezo weseli. Lapho amaseli ezilwane ezincelisayo ahlukana ngokushesha ekhuliswa emasikweni (ngaphandle komzimba ngaphansi kwezimo zokukhula ezifanele), ubude bomjikelezo bungaba amahora angama-24. Ekuhlukaniseni ngokushesha amaseli abantu ngomjikelezo weseli wamahora angama-24, isigaba se-G1 sihlala cishe amahora ayisishiyagalolunye, isigaba se-S sihlala amahora ayi-10, isigaba se-G2 sihlala cishe amahora amane nesigamu, kanti isigaba se-M sihlala cishe isigamu sehora. Emibunguni yokuqala yezimpukane zezithelo, umjikelezo weseli uqedwa cishe ngemizuzu eyisishiyagalombili. Isikhathi semicimbi emjikelezweni weseli silawulwa izindlela ezingaphakathi nezangaphandle kweseli.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi wezindawo zokuhlola umjikelezo weseli?
answer1: Baqapha izimo zangaphakathi nezangaphandle ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iseli likulungele ngaphambi kokuqhubekela esigabeni esilandelayo somjikelezo weseli.

answer3: Ngasekupheleni kwe-G1, ekuguqukeni kwe-G2/M, kanye nangesikhathi se-metaphase

question5: Yimaphi ama-molecule asebenza njengabalawuli abahle bomjikelezo weseli?

question7: Yini eqinisekiswayo endaweni yokuhlola ye-G1?
answer7: Ukuthi iseli selikulungele ukuqala ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA ngesikhathi sesigaba se-S
question8: Yisiphi isenzakalo esiqala ngemva kokudlula ngempumelelo endaweni yokuhlola ye-G2?

question9: Iyini indima yama-molecule alawulayo angalungile njengeprotheyini yokucindezela isimila?
answer9: Baqapha izimo zamaseli futhi bangamisa umjikelezo wamaseli kuze kube yilapho izidingo zihlangatshezwana
question10: Yini engaba umphumela wamaphutha ekulawulweni komjikelezo weseli?
answer10: Umdlavuza ubonakala ngokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okungalawulwa

question11: Cishe umjikelezo weseli uthatha isikhathi esingakanani ekuhlukaniseni ngokushesha amaseli ezincelisayo ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele zokukhulisa?
