chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.3 Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli | Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli Ngemicimbi Yangaphandle
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.3 Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli | Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli Ngemicimbi Yangaphandle
chapterContent:
Kokubili ukuqala kanye nokuvinjelwa kokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kubangelwa yizehlakalo ezingaphandle kweseli lapho selizoqala inqubo yokuphindaphinda. Isenzakalo singaba lula njengokufa kweseli eliseduze noma ukukhukhuleka njengokukhishwa kwama-hormone akhuthaza ukukhula, njenge-hormone yokukhula komuntu (i-HGH). Ukuntuleka kwe-HGH kungavimbela ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli, okuholela ekubeni mfushane, kanti i-HGH eningi kakhulu ingaholela ekubeni yi-gigantism. Ukuminyana kwamaseli kungavimbela nokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli. Esinye isici esingaqala ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli ubukhulu beseli; njengoba iseli likhula, liba lingasebenzi kahle ngenxa yokwehla kwesilinganiso salo sobuso kuya komthamo. Isixazululo sale nkinga ukuhlukanisa.

 Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umlayezo uwumthombo muni, iseli lithola isignali, kanye nochungechunge lwezehlakalo ngaphakathi kweseli luvumela ukuthi liqhubekele phakathi kwesigaba. Ukuqhubekela phambili kusukela kuleli phuzu lokuqalisa, yonke ipharamitha edingekayo phakathi nesigaba ngasinye somjikelezo weseli kumele ihlangatshezwe noma umjikelezo awukwazi ukuqhubeka.
question1: Yini engabangela ukuqala noma ukuvinjelwa kokuhlukana kwamaseli?
answer1: Imicimbi engaphandle kweseli
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sesenzakalo sangaphandle esingakhuthaza ukuhlukana kwamaseli?
answer2: Ukukhishwa kwama-hormone akhuthaza ukukhula njenge-hormone yokukhula komuntu (HGH).
question3: Ukufa kweseli eliseduze kungawathinta kanjani amaseli azungezile?
answer3: Kungasebenza njengesignali yangaphandle evuselela amaseli angomakhelwane ukuba ahlukane.
distractor3a: Ivimba unomphela amaseli angomakhelwane ukuthi angahlukani.
distractor3b: Kubangela ngokushesha ukuthi amangqamuzana angomakhelwane angene ku-apoptosis.
distractor3c: Kubangela ukuthi amangqamuzana angomakhelwane angene ku-meiosis.
question4: Ukuntuleka kwe-hormone yokukhula komuntu (i-HGH) kungaba namuphi umphumela ekuhlukanisweni kwamaseli?
answer4: Kungavimbela ukuhlukana kwamangqamuzana, okubangela ukuba abe mfushane.
distractor4a: Kuvuselela ukuhlukana kwamaseli ngokweqile, okuholela ku-gigantism.
distractor4b: Kubangela i-apoptosis esheshayo kuwo wonke amaseli.
question5: Imuphi umphumela ongaba khona ngokweqile kwe-hormone yokukhula komuntu (HGH)?
answer5: Kungakhuthaza ukuhlukana nokukhula kwamaseli ngokweqile, okuholela ekukhuleni okukhulu.
question6: Ukuminyana kwamangqamuzana kuthinta kanjani ukuhlukana kwamangqamuzana?
answer6: Ukuminyana kuvimbela ukuhlukana kwamaseli.
distractor6a: Ukuminyana kwezakhi zofuzo kusheshisa ukuphindaphindeka kwe-DNA.
question7: Kungani ukwanda kosayizi weseli kungakhuthaza ukuhlukana kweseli?
answer7: Ngoba njengoba iseli likhula, isilinganiso salo sobuso nomthamo siyancipha, okwenza iseli lingasebenzi kahle.
distractor7a: Ngoba amangqamuzana amakhulu awakwazi ukuphindaphinda i-DNA.
distractor7b: Ngoba amangqamuzana amakhulu alahlekelwa ama-chromosome awo.
distractor7c: Ngoba amangqamuzana amakhulu awakwazi ukukhiqiza i-ATP.
question8: Ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kuyixazulula kanjani inkinga yokwehla kwesilinganiso sobuso kuya komthamo?
answer8: Ikhiqiza amaseli amancane anesilinganiso esiphezulu sobuso nobubanzi.
question9: Kwenzekani ngemva kokuba iseli lithole isignali yangaphandle ukuze lihlukane?
answer9: Uchungechunge lwezehlakalo zangaphakathi luvumela iseli ukuthi liqhubekele phakathi kwezigaba.
question10: Yini okumele yenzeke ngaphambi kokuba iseli liqhubeke nesigaba ngasinye somjikelezo weseli?
answer10: Zonke izimo ezidingekayo kanye nezindawo zokuhlola zaleso sigaba kumele zihlangatshezwe.
distractor10b: Kumelwe kube khona izici zokukhula zangaphandle kuphela.
distractor10c: Iseli kumele lihlale lihlukana kungakhathaliseki ukuthi izimo zinjani.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.3 Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli | Ukulawulwa Kwezindawo Zokuhlola Zangaphakathi | Indawo Yokuhlola ye-G1, Indawo Yokuhlola ye-G2, Indawo Yokuhlola ye-M
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.3 Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli | Ukulawulwa Kwezindawo Zokuhlola Zangaphakathi | Indawo Yokuhlola ye-G1, Indawo Yokuhlola ye-G2, Indawo Yokuhlola ye-M
chapterContent:
Kubalulekile ukuthi amangqamuzana ayindodakazi akhiqizwayo abe yizifanekiso ezifanayo zeseli lomzali. Amaphutha ekuphindaphindweni noma ekusabalalisweni kwama-chromosome aholela ekuguqukeni kwezakhi zofuzo okungadluliselwa phambili kuwo wonke amaseli amasha akhiqizwa kusuka kuseli elingavamile. Ukuvimbela iseli elisengozini ukuthi liqhubeke nokuhlukana, kunezindlela zokulawula zangaphakathi ezisebenza ezindaweni ezintathu eziyinhloko zokuhlola umjikelezo weseli. Indawo yokuhlola ingenye yamaphuzu amaningana emjikelezweni weseli le-eukaryotic lapho ukuqhubekela phambili kweseli esigabeni esilandelayo emjikelezweni kungamiswa khona kuze kube yilapho izimo zivuma. Lezi zindawo zokuhlola zenzeka ngasekupheleni kwe-G1, ekuguqukeni kwe-G2/M, kanye nangesikhathi se-metaphase (Isithombe 10.11).

 Indawo yokuhlola ye-G1
Indawo yokuhlola ye-G1 inquma ukuthi zonke izimo zivuma yini ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kweseli kuqhubeke. Indawo yokuhlola ye-G1, ebizwa nangokuthi indawo yokukhawulela (ku-yeast), yindawo lapho iseli lizibophezela khona enqubweni yokuhlukanisa iseli. Amathonya angaphandle, njengezici zokukhula, adlala indima enkulu ekuthwaleni iseli lidlule endaweni yokuhlola ye-G1. Ngaphezu kokugcinwa okwanele kanye nosayizi weseli, kukhona ukuhlolwa komonakalo we-DNA ye-genomic endaweni yokuhlola ye-G1. Iseli elingahlangabezani nazo zonke izidingo ngeke livunyelwe ukuqhubekela esigabeni se-S. Iseli lingamisa umjikelezo futhi lizame ukulungisa isimo esiyinkinga, noma iseli lingaqhubekela phambili ku-G0 futhi lilinde izimpawu ezengeziwe lapho izimo zithuthuka.

 Indawo yokuhlola ye-G2
Indawo yokuhlola ye-G2 ivimbela ukungena esigabeni se-mitotic uma izimo ezithile zingahlangabezani. Njengasendaweni yokuhlola ye-G1, usayizi weseli kanye nokugcinwa kwamaprotheni kuyahlolwa. Kodwa-ke, indima ebaluleke kakhulu yendawo yokuhlola ye-G2 ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke ama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe nokuthi i-DNA ephindaphindiwe ayonakali. Uma izindlela zokuhlola zithola izinkinga nge-DNA, umjikelezo weseli uyamiswa, futhi iseli lizama ukuqedela ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA noma ukulungisa i-DNA eyonakele.

 Indawo yokuhlola ye-M
Indawo yokuhlola ye-M yenzeka eduze kokuphela kwesigaba se-metaphase se-karyokinesis. Indawo yokuhlola i-M yaziwa nangokuthi indawo yokuhlola i-spindle, ngoba inquma ukuthi wonke ama-chromatids angodade anamathele kahle kuma-microtubules e-spindle. Ngenxa yokuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromatids angodade ngesikhathi se-anaphase kuyisinyathelo esingenakuguqulwa, umjikelezo ngeke uqhubeke kuze kube yilapho ama-kinetochores e-pair ngayinye yama-chromatids angodade enamathele ngokuqinile okungenani kuma-fibre amabili e-spindle avela ezingosini eziphambene zeseli.
question1: Kungani kudingeka izindawo zokuhlola umjikelezo weseli wangaphakathi?
answer1: Zivimbela amaseli anama-chromosome alimele noma aphindaphindwe ngendlela engafanele ukuthi aqhubeke nokuhlukana.
distractor1c: Baqinisekisa ukuthi amangqamuzana ahlala engena ku-meiosis.
question2: Iyini indawo yokuhlola umjikelezo weseli?
answer2: Indawo yokulawula lapho ukuqhubekela esigabeni esilandelayo kungamiswa khona kuze kube yilapho izimo zivuma.
distractor2a: Indawo lapho ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuqala khona njalo.
question3: Zikuphi izindawo ezintathu zokuhlola zangaphakathi ezinkulu ezitholakala kumjikelezo weseli?
answer3: Ngasekupheleni kwe-G1, ekuguqukeni kwe-G2/M, kanye nangesikhathi se-metaphase.
question4: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wendawo yokuhlola i-G1?
answer4: Ukunquma ukuthi izimo zilungele yini ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA nokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli.

question6: Yiziphi izici zangaphandle ezidlala indima enkulu ekuvumeleni iseli ukuthi lidlule endaweni yokuhlola ye-G1?
answer6: Izici zokukhula.
question7: Ngaphandle kwezici zokukhula, yini ehlolwa endaweni yokuhlola ye-G1?
answer7: Usayizi wamaseli, izinqolobane zamandla, kanye nomonakalo we-DNA.
question8: Yini engase yenzeke uma iseli lihluleka ukuhlola i-G1?
answer8: Ingase ime kancane ukuze ilungise inkinga noma ifake i-G0 kuze kube yilapho izimo zithuthuka.
question9: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wendawo yokuhlola i-G2?
answer9: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuqediwe nokuthi i-DNA ayonakali ngaphambi kwe-mitosis.
distractor9a: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-chromosome ayahambisana epuletini le-metaphase.
question10: Uma kutholakala umonakalo we-DNA endaweni yokuhlola ye-G2, kwenzekani?
answer10: Umjikelezo weseli uyamiswa ngenkathi iseli lizama ukulungisa noma ukuqedela ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA.
question11: Kwenzeka nini ukuhlola i-M?
question12: Iliphi elinye igama le-M checkpoint?
question13: Yini eqinisekiswa yi-M checkpoint?
answer13: Ukuthi wonke udade we-chromatid unamathele kahle kuma-microtubules e-spindle nge-kinetochore yawo.
question14: Kungani indawo yokuhlola i-M ibaluleke kakhulu?
answer14: Ngoba ukuhlukaniswa kwe-chromatid ngesikhathi se-anaphase akunakuphikiswa.
distractor14a: Ngoba ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuqala ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho.
distractor14c: Ngoba i-cytokinesis ayikwazi ukwenzeka ngemva kwalokho.
question15: Yisiphi isimo okumele sihlangatshezwe ngaphambi kokuba iseli lidlule endaweni yokuhlola i-M?
answer15: Ipheya ngalinye lama-chromatid angodade kumele linamathele ngokuqinile kuma-spindle fibers avela ezigxotsheni eziphambene.
distractor15a: I-chromosome ngayinye kumele ixhunywe ku-fibre eyodwa ye-spindle kuphela.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.3 Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli | Ama-Molecule Okulawula Umjikelezo Weseli | Ukulawulwa Okuhle Komjikelezo Weseli
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.3 Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli | Ama-Molecule Okulawula Umjikelezo Weseli | Ukulawulwa Okuhle Komjikelezo Weseli
chapterContent:
Ngaphezu kwezindawo zokuhlola ezilawulwa ngaphakathi, kunezinhlobo ezimbili zama-molecule angaphakathi kweseli alawula umjikelezo weseli. Lawa ma-molecule alawulayo akhuthaza inqubekela phambili yeseli iye esigabeni esilandelayo (ukulawulwa okuhle) noma amise umjikelezo (ukulawulwa okubi). Ama-molecule alawulayo angase asebenze ngokwawo, noma angathonya umsebenzi noma ukukhiqizwa kwamanye amaprotheni alawulayo. Ngakho-ke, ukwehluleka komlawuli oyedwa kungase kungabi namthelela emjikelezweni weseli, ikakhulukazi uma izindlela ezingaphezu kweyodwa zilawula isenzakalo esifanayo. Ngokuphambene nalokho, umphumela womlawuli ongasebenzi kahle noma ongasebenzi kahle ungaba banzi futhi mhlawumbe ubulale iseli uma kuthinteka izinqubo eziningi.

 Ukulawulwa Okuhle Komjikelezo Weseli
Amaqembu amabili amaprotheni, abizwa ngokuthi ama-cyclins kanye nama-cyclin-dependent kinases (ama-Cdks), anesibopho sokuthuthuka kweseli ezindaweni zokuhlola ezahlukahlukene. Amazinga amaprotheni amane e-cyclin ayashintshashintsha kulo lonke umjikelezo weseli ngendlela ebikezelwayo (Isithombe 10.12). Ukwanda kokuhlushwa kwamaprotheni e-cyclin kubangelwa yizimpawu zangaphandle nezangaphakathi. Ngemva kokuba iseli lithuthele esigabeni esilandelayo somjikelezo weseli, ama-cyclin ayesebenza esigabeni sangaphambilini ayawohloka.

 Ama-Cyclins alawula umjikelezo weseli kuphela uma eboshwe ngokuqinile kuma-Cdks. Ukuze asebenze ngokugcwele, i-Cdk/cyclin complex kumele futhi i-phosphorylated ezindaweni ezithile. Njengawo wonke ama-kinase, ama-Cdks angama-enzyme (ama-kinase) a-phosphorylate amanye amaprotheni. I-Phosphorylation isebenzisa iphrotheni ngokushintsha isimo sayo. Amaprotheni a-phosphorylated yi-Cdks ahilelekile ekuqhubekiseleni phambili iseli esigabeni esilandelayo. (Isithombe 10.13). Amazinga amaprotheni e-Cdk azinzile phakathi nomjikelezo weseli; noma kunjalo, amazinga e-cyclin ayashintshashintsha futhi anquma ukuthi ama-Cdk/cyclin complexes akheka nini. Ama-cyclins nama-Cdks ahlukene abopha ezindaweni ezithile emjikelezweni weseli futhi ngaleyo ndlela alawula izindawo zokuhlola ezahlukene.

 Njengoba ukushintshashintsha kwe-cyclin kwamazinga e-cyclin kusekelwe esikhathini somjikelezo weseli hhayi ezenzakalweni ezithile, ukulawulwa komjikelezo weseli kuvame ukwenzeka ngama-molecule e-Cdk kuphela noma ama-complex e-Cdk/cyclin. Ngaphandle kokuhlushwa okuthile kwama-complex e-cyclin/Cdk asebenza ngokugcwele, umjikelezo weseli awukwazi ukuqhubeka ezindaweni zokuhlola.

 Nakuba ama-cyclin kuyi-molecule eyinhloko elawulayo enquma umfutho wokuqhubekela phambili komjikelezo weseli, kunezinye izindlela eziningana ezilungisa intuthuko yomjikelezo ngemiphumela emibi, kunokuba ibe mihle. Lezi zindlela empeleni zivimba inqubekela phambili yomjikelezo weseli kuze kube yilapho izimo eziyinkinga zixazululwa. Ama-molecule avimbela ukusebenza okugcwele kwama-Cdks abizwa ngokuthi ama-Cdk inhibitors. Amaningi ala ma-molecule avimbelayo aqapha ngokuqondile noma ngokungaqondile umcimbi othile womjikelezo weseli. Ibhlokhi elibekwe kuma-Cdks ngama-molecule avimbelayo ngeke lisuswe kuze kube yilapho umcimbi othize oqaphayo ama-inhibitor usuqediwe.
question1: Yimaphi amaqembu amabili amakhulu ama-molecule angaphakathi kwamangqamuzana alawula umjikelezo weseli?
answer1: Abalawuli abahle abakhuthaza ukuqhubekela phambili kanye nabalawuli ababi abamisa umjikelezo.
question2: Ama-molecule alawulayo angawuthinta kanjani umjikelezo weseli?
answer2: Zingasebenza ngokuqondile noma zilawule umsebenzi noma ukukhiqizwa kwamanye amaprotheni alawulayo.
distractor2c: Zisebenza unomphela kuzo zonke izindawo zokuhlola.
question3: Yimaphi amaqembu amabili amaprotheni abangela ukuqhubekela phambili komjikelezo weseli?
question4: Amazinga e-cyclin protein ashintsha kanjani ngesikhathi somjikelezo weseli?
question5: Yini ebangela ukwanda kokuhlushwa kwe-cyclin?
question6: Kwenzekani kuma-cyclin ngemva kokuba iseli liqhubekele esigabeni esilandelayo?
answer6: Ama-cyclin asebenzayo esigabeni esidlule ayancipha.
question7: Ama-cyclin angakwazi nini ukulawula umjikelezo weseli?
answer7: Kuphela uma ziboshwe ngokuqinile kuma-cyclin-dependent kinases (Cdks).
question8: Ngaphandle kokubopha nge-cyclin, yini edingekayo ukuze i-Cdk/cyclin complex isebenze ngokugcwele?
answer8: I-Phosphorylation ezindaweni ezithile.
question9: Hlobo luni lwama-enzyme angama-cyclin-dependent kinases (Cdks)?
answer9: Ama-kinase aqukethe amanye amaprotheni abizwa ngokuthi i-phosphorylate.
question10: Uyini umphumela we-phosphorylation yi-Cdks kumaprotheni aqondiwe?
answer10: Kushintsha isimo sazo futhi kuzisebenze.
question11: Iyini indima eyinhloko yamaprotheni abizwa ngokuthi i-phosphorylated yi-Cdks?
answer11: Zisiza ekuqhubekiseleni phambili iseli esigabeni esilandelayo somjikelezo weseli.
question12: Amazinga e-Cdk protein aqhathaniswa kanjani namazinga e-cyclin ngesikhathi somjikelezo weseli?
answer12: Amazinga e-Cdk ahlala eqinile, kuyilapho amazinga e-cyclin eshintshashintsha.
distractor12b: Ama-Cyclins ahlala eqinile kuyilapho ama-Cdk eshintshashintsha.
question13: Yini enquma ukuthi ama-Cdk/cyclin complexes akheka nini?
question14: Kungani amabhayisikili nama-Cdk ahlukene elawula izindawo zokuhlola ezahlukene?
answer14: Zihlangana ndawonye ezindaweni ezithile emjikelezweni weseli.
distractor14a: Indawo ngayinye yokuhlola iqukethe ama-chromosome ahlukene.
distractor14b: I-cyclin ngayinye isebenza kuphela kumaseli ezitshalo.
question15: Kwenzekani uma kungekho ukuhlushwa okwanele kwama-cyclin/Cdk complexes asebenza ngokugcwele?
answer15: Umjikelezo weseli awukwazi ukuqhubeka ezindaweni zokuhlola.
question16: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wezindlela zokulawula ezingezinhle?
answer16: Zivimba ukuqhubeka komjikelezo weseli kuze kube yilapho izinkinga sezixazululiwe.
question17: Abizwa ngokuthini ama-molecule avimbela ukusebenza okugcwele kwama-Cdks?
answer17: Izithibi ze-Cdk.
question18: Yini eqashwa yizithibi eziningi ze-Cdk?
answer18: Imicimbi ethile yomjikelezo weseli.
question19: Kususwa nini ukuvinjelwa kwama-Cdks?
answer19: Ngemva kokuba umcimbi oqashwe ngokucophelela usuqediwe ngempumelelo.
distractor19c: Ngokushesha nje lapho kuqala ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.3 Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli | Ama-Molecule Okulawula Umjikelezo Weseli | Ukulawulwa Okubi Komjikelezo Weseli
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.3 Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli | Ama-Molecule Okulawula Umjikelezo Weseli | Ukulawulwa Okubi Komjikelezo Weseli
chapterContent:
Ngaphezu kwezindawo zokuhlola ezilawulwa ngaphakathi, kunezinhlobo ezimbili zama-molecule angaphakathi kweseli alawula umjikelezo weseli. Lawa ma-molecule alawulayo akhuthaza ukuqhubekela phambili kweseli esigabeni esilandelayo (ukulawulwa okuhle) noma amise umjikelezo (ukulawulwa okubi). Ama-molecule alawulayo angase asebenze ngokwawo, noma angathonya umsebenzi noma ukukhiqizwa kwamanye amaprotheni alawulayo. Ngakho-ke, ukwehluleka komlawuli oyedwa kungase kungabi namthelela emjikelezweni weseli, ikakhulukazi uma izindlela ezingaphezu kweyodwa zilawula umcimbi ofanayo. Ngokuphambene nalokho, umphumela womlawuli ongasebenzi kahle noma ongasebenzi kahle ungaba mkhulu futhi mhlawumbe ubulale iseli uma kuthinteka izinqubo eziningi.

 Ukulawulwa Okubi Komjikelezo Weseli
Iqembu lesibili lama-molecule alawula umjikelezo weseli abalawuli ababi. Abalawuli ababi bamisa umjikelezo weseli. Khumbula ukuthi ekulawulweni okuhle, ama-molecule asebenzayo abangela ukuthi umjikelezo uqhubeke.

 Ama-molecule alawulayo angaqondakali kahle yi-retinoblastoma protein (Rb), p53, kanye ne-p21. Amaprotheni e-retinoblastoma ayiqembu lama-protein acindezela isimila avamile emaseli amaningi. Iziqu ezingu-53 no-21 zibhekisela ezinhlwini zama-molecule ezisebenzayo zamaprotheni (p) kuma-kilodalton. Okuningi okwaziwayo mayelana nokulawulwa komjikelezo weseli kuvela ocwaningweni olwenziwe ngamaseli alahlekelwe ukulawula okulawulayo. Wonke lawa ma-protein amathathu okulawula atholakale onakele noma engasebenzi kumaseli ayeseqalile ukuphindaphinda ngokungalawuleki (aba nomdlavuza). Esimweni ngasinye, imbangela eyinhloko yentuthuko engahlolwanga ngomjikelezo weseli kwakuyikhophi enephutha yephrotheni yokulawula.

 I-Rb, i-p53, kanye ne-p21 zisebenza ikakhulukazi endaweni yokuhlola ye-G1. I-p53 iyiphrotheni enemisebenzi eminingi enomthelela omkhulu ekuzinikeleni kweseli ekuhlukaneni ngoba isebenza lapho kune-DNA eyonakele kumaseli adlula ezinqubweni zokulungiselela ngesikhathi se-G1. Uma kutholakala i-DNA eyonakele, i-p53 imisa umjikelezo weseli futhi iqashe ama-enzyme ukulungisa i-DNA. Uma i-DNA ingenakulungiseka, i-p53 ingabangela i-apoptosis, noma ukufa kweseli, ukuvimbela ukuphindaphindeka kwama-chromosome alimele. Njengoba amazinga e-p53 ekhuphuka, ukukhiqizwa kwe-p21 kuyaqala. I-p21 iphoqelela ukumiswa komjikelezo olawulwa yi-p53 ngokubopha nokuvimbela umsebenzi we-Cdk/cyclin complexes. Njengoba iseli livezwa ekucindezelekeni okwengeziwe, amazinga aphezulu e-p53 kanye ne-p21 ayaqoqana, okwenza kube lula ukuthi iseli lingene esigabeni se-S.

 I-Rb isebenzisa ithonya layo lokulawula kwamanye amaprotheni alawulayo amahle. Ngokuyinhloko, i-Rb iqapha usayizi weseli. Esimweni esisebenzayo, esingena-phosphorylated, i-Rb ibopha amaprotheni abizwa ngokuthi izinto zokubhala, ngokuvamile, i-E2F (Isithombe 10.14). Izici zokubhala zivula "izakhi zofuzo ezithile, okuvumela ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni afakwe yilelo zakhi zofuzo. Lapho i-Rb iboshelwe ku-E2F, ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni adingekayo ekuguqukeni kwe-G1/S kuyavinjelwa. Njengoba iseli landa ngobukhulu, i-Rb ifakwa kancane kancane kuze kube yilapho ingasebenzi. I-Rb ikhipha i-E2F, manje engavula i-gene ekhiqiza iphrotheni yokuguquka, futhi leli bhulokhi elithile liyasuswa. Ukuze iseli lidlule endaweni ngayinye yokuhlola, wonke ama-regulator amahle kumele avulwe,"futhi wonke ama-regulator amabi kumele acinywe.
question1: Iyini indima eyinhloko yabalawuli abangalungile bomjikelezo weseli?
answer1: Zimisa umjikelezo weseli kuze kube yilapho izimo zilungele ukuqhubekela phambili.
question2: Abalawuli ababi bahluke kanjani kubalawuli abahle?
answer2: Abalawuli abangalungile bamisa ukuqhubeka komjikelezo weseli, kuyilapho abalawuli abahle bekhuthaza ukuqhubeka.
distractor2a: Abalawuli abangalungile bavuselela ama-Cdk, kanti abalawuli abahle bayawavimbela.
distractor2b: Abalawuli abangalungile basebenza kuphela ngesikhathi se-mitosis.
distractor2c: Abalawuli abahle balungisa i-DNA, kanti abalawuli ababi baphinda i-DNA.
question3: Yimaphi amaprotheni amathathu alawulayo angalungile aqondakala kangcono?
distractor3a: I-Cyclin A, i-Cyclin B, kanye ne-Cyclin D.
question4: Hlobo luni lwamaprotheni ayi-retinoblastoma (Rb) amaprotheni?
question5: Zimele ini izinombolo eziku-p53 kanye ne-p21?
distractor5b: Izigaba zomjikelezo weseli lapho zisebenza khona.
question6: I-p53, i-p21, kanye ne-Rb zatholakala kanjani ekuqaleni?
answer6: Kutholakale ukuthi zonakele noma azisebenzi kahle emaseli omdlavuza ahlukana ngokungalawuleki.
question7: Kukuyiphi indawo yokuhlola lapho i-Rb, i-p53, kanye ne-p21 zisebenza khona ngokuyinhloko?
answer7: Indawo yokuhlola ye-G1.
question8: I-p53 isebenza nini ngesikhathi somjikelezo weseli?
answer8: Uma i-DNA eyonakele itholakala ngesikhathi se-G1.
question9: Iyini isenzo sokuqala se-p53 ngemva kokuthola i-DNA eyonakele?
answer9: Imisa umjikelezo weseli futhi iqashe ama-enzyme okulungisa i-DNA.
question10: Kwenzekani uma umonakalo we-DNA ungalungiseki?
answer10: I-p53 ingabangela i-apoptosis ukuvimbela ama-chromosome alimele ukuthi angaphindaphindeki.
question11: Imuphi umphumela ukwanda kwe-p53 okunawo ekukhiqizweni kwe-p21?
answer11: Amazinga aphezulu e-p53 akhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kwe-p21.
question12: I-p21 ikwenza kanjani ukuthi umjikelezo weseli uvalwe?
question13: Ukwanda kokucindezeleka kwamangqamuzana kuthinta kanjani amazinga e-p53 kanye ne-p21?
answer13: Amazinga abo ayanda, okwenza ukungena esigabeni se-S kube ncane amathuba.
distractor13a: Amazinga abo ayancipha, okusheshisa ukuphindaphindeka kwe-DNA.
question14: Yisiphi isici seseli uRb asiqaphayo ngokuyinhloko?
question15: Yini i-Rb esebenzayo, e-dephosphorylated ebopha kuyo?
question16: Kwenzekani uma i-Rb ibopha i-E2F?
answer16: Ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni adingekayo ekushintsheni kwe-G1/S kuyavinjelwa.
question17: Kwenzekani ku-Rb njengoba iseli likhula?
answer17: Kancane kancane iba yi-phosphorylated bese iba yinto engasebenzi.
question18: Kwenzekani ngemva kokuba i-Rb efakwe i-phosphorylated ikhiphe i-E2F?
answer18: I-E2F ivuselela izakhi zofuzo ezidingekayo ekushintsheni kwe-G1/S.
question19: Yisiphi isimo esidingekayo ukuze iseli lidlule endaweni yokuhlola?
answer19: Bonke abalawuli abahle kumele basebenze futhi bonke abalawuli ababi kumele bangasebenzi.
question20: Bheka uMfanekiso 10.14. Uyini umsebenzi wamaprotheni okucindezela isimila esimweni sawo sokuphumula, esingena-phosphorylated?
answer20: Zivimbela ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli.
distractor20b: Baqala umjikelezo weseli, ngaleyo ndlela bacindezela ukwakheka kwesimila.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.4 Umdlavuza Nomjikelezo Weseli | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.4 Umdlavuza Nomjikelezo Weseli | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Umdlavuza ubangelwa ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okungahlolwanga okubangelwa ukuwohloka kwezindlela ezilawula umjikelezo weseli. Ukulahlekelwa ukulawula kuqala ngoshintsho ochungechungeni lwe-DNA yesakhi sofuzo olusebenzisa ikhodi yelinye lama-molecule alawulayo. Imiyalelo enephutha iholela kuphrotheni engasebenzi ngendlela efanele. Esinye isizathu esitholakale yiprotheni ye-p53 (ebhalwe yi-gene ye-p53), umlawuli omkhulu endaweni yokuhlola ye-G1. Ngokuvamile, amaprotheni e-p53 aqapha i-DNA. Uma ethola amangqamuzana ane-DNA eyonakele, i-p53 izoqala izindlela zokulungisa noma ibhubhise amangqamuzana, ngaleyo ndlela icindezele ukwakheka kwesimila. Kodwa-ke, izinguquko ku-p53 zingabangela amaprotheni e-p53 angajwayelekile ahluleka ukuvimba ukuhlukaniswa kweseli uma i-DNA yeseli yonakele. Lokhu kuphumela enanini elandayo lezinguquko, okuholela kumaseli endodakazi angajwayelekile. Ekugcineni, zonke izindawo zokuhlola esitokisini azisebenzi, futhi amangqamuzana angajwayelekile angaminyanisa amangqamuzana ajwayelekile.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology, njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi olusekelwe ebholeni lokucwaninga, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso enkulu 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa.

 Isayensi Yokuzijwayeza
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi kanye namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.7 Umfundi angenza izibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ezenzeka ngesikhathi somjikelezo weseli.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Isayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[APLO 2.32][APLO 2.34][APLO 3.6][APLO 3.7][APLO 3.8][APLO 4.6][APLO 4.14][APLO 4.22]

 Umdlavuza uqukethe izifo eziningi ezahlukene ezibangelwa indlela evamile: ukukhula kweseli okungalawulwa. Naphezu kokuphindaphindeka kanye namazinga ahambisanayo okulawula umjikelezo weseli, amaphutha ayenzeka. Enye yezinqubo ezibalulekile eziqashwe yindlela yokuhlola umjikelezo weseli ukuphindaphindwa okufanele kwe-DNA ngesikhathi sesigaba se-S. Ngisho noma zonke izilawuli zomjikelezo weseli zisebenza ngokugcwele, iphesenti elincane lamaphutha okuphindaphinda (ukuguqulwa) lizodluliselwa kumaseli endodakazi. Uma izinguquko ku-DNA nucleotide sequence zenzeka engxenyeni yekhodi yesakhi sofuzo futhi zingalungiswa, kuvela ukuguquka kwesakhi sofuzo. Zonke izinhlobo zomdlavuza ziqala lapho ukuguquka kwesakhi sofuzo kubangela iphrotheni enephutha edlala indima ebalulekile ekuzalweni kweseli. Ushintsho esitokisini oluvela kuphrotheni engakhekile kahle lungaba luncane: mhlawumbe ukubambezeleka okuncane ekubopheni kwe-Cdk ku-cyclin noma iphrotheni ye-Rb ephuma ku-DNA yayo eqondiwe ngenkathi isafakwe i-phosphorylated. Noma kunjalo, ngisho namaphutha amancane angase avumele amaphutha alandelayo ukuba enzeke kalula. Ngokuphindaphindiwe, amaphutha amancane angalungiswanga adluliselwa kusuka kuseli lomzali kuya kumaseli endodakazi futhi akhuliswe njengoba isizukulwane ngasinye sikhiqiza amaprotheni amaningi angasebenzi kahle emonakalweni we-DNA ongalungiswanga. Ekugcineni, ijubane lomjikelezo weseli liyashesha njengoba ukusebenza kahle kwezindlela zokulawula nokulungisa kuncipha. Ukukhula okungalawulwa kwamaseli aguquliwe kudlula ukukhula kwamaseli ajwayelekile endaweni, futhi kungavela isimila (-oma)
question1: Iyini imbangela eyinhloko yomdlavuza?
answer1: Ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okungalawulwa okubangelwa ukuwohloka kokulawulwa komjikelezo weseli.
question2: Yini evame ukuqala ukulahlekelwa ukulawula umjikelezo weseli okuholela kumdlavuza?
answer2: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okubhalela iphrotheni elawula umjikelezo weseli.
question3: Uyini umsebenzi ojwayelekile weprotheyini ye-p53?
answer3: Ukuqapha umonakalo we-DNA kanye nokulungiswa kwe-trigger noma i-apoptosis uma kudingeka.
question4: Iyiphi indawo yokuhlola lapho i-p53 isebenza khona ngokuyinhloko?
question5: Yini engenzeka uma i-gene ye-p53 iguquguquka?
answer5: Amaseli alimele ayaqhubeka nokuhlukana esikhundleni sokulungiswa noma ukubhujiswa.
question6: Iyini imiphumela eyodwa yamaprotheni e-p53 anephutha?
answer6: Ukuqongelela okwandayo kwezinguquko kumaseli endodakazi.
question7: Kwenzekani ekugcineni njengoba izinguquko ziqoqana kumaprotheni alawulayo?
answer7: Izindawo zokuhlola umjikelezo weseli azisebenzi, okuvumela ukuhlukana okungalawuleki.
question8: Yisiphi isici esiyinhloko esihlanganyelwa yizo zonke izinhlobo zomdlavuza?
answer8: Ukukhula kwamaseli okungalawulwa.
question9: Iyiphi inqubo eqashwe eduze yizindlela zokuhlola umjikelezo weseli?
answer9: Ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA okunembile ngesikhathi sesigaba se-S.
question10: Ingabe izinguquko zisengenzeka ngisho nalapho ukulawulwa komjikelezo weseli kusebenza ngendlela evamile?
answer10: Yebo, iphesenti elincane lamaphutha okuphindaphinda lisadluliselwa kumaseli endodakazi.
question11: Kwenzeka nini ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer11: Uma kwenzeka ushintsho lokulandelana kwe-DNA olungalungiswanga ngaphakathi kwesifunda sokubhala ikhodi se-gene.
question12: Zonke izinhlobo zomdlavuza ziqala kanjani?
answer12: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kukhiqiza iphrotheni enephutha ehilelekile ekuzalweni kwamaseli.
question13: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sesici esincane esingaba nomthelela ekukhuleni komdlavuza?
answer13: Iphrotheni ye-Rb ephuma kwi-DNA yayo eqondiwe ngenkathi isafakwe i-phosphorylated.
question14: Kungani ngisho namaphutha amancane okulawula angagcina eholele kumdlavuza?
answer14: Ngoba amaphutha amancane ayaqoqana futhi adluliselwa kumaseli endodakazi ezizukulwaneni eziningi.
distractor14a: Ngoba zonke izinguquko zakha isimila ngokushesha.
question15: Kwenzekani njengoba izindlela zokulawula nokulungisa zingasasebenzi kahle?
answer15: Ijubane lomjikelezo weseli liyakhula futhi amaseli aguqukile akhula adlule amaseli ajwayelekile.
distractor15b: Ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA kuba kancane futhi kunembe kakhudlwana.
question16: Kuyini isimila?
answer16: Inqwaba yamaseli akhiqizwa lapho ukukhula okungalawulwa kwamaseli aguquliwe kudlula amaseli avamile.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.4 Umdlavuza Nomjikelezo Weseli | I-Proto-oncogenes
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.4 Umdlavuza Nomjikelezo Weseli | I-Proto-oncogenes
chapterContent:
Izakhi zofuzo ezibhala ikhodi yabalawuli bomjikelezo weseli abahle zibizwa ngokuthi ama-proto-oncogenes. Ama-proto-oncogenes ayizakhi zofuzo ezivamile, lapho ziguquliwe ngezindlela ezithile, ziba ama-oncogenes, izakhi zofuzo ezibangela iseli ukuba libe nomdlavuza. Cabanga ngalokho okungenzeka kumjikelezo weseli esitokisini esine-oncogene esanda kutholwa. Ezimweni eziningi, ukuguqulwa kochungechunge lwe-DNA kuzoholela ephrotheni engasebenzi kahle (noma engasebenzi kahle). Umphumela ulimaza iseli futhi cishe uzovimbela iseli ekuqedeni umjikelezo weseli; noma kunjalo, into ephilayo ayilinyazwa ngoba ukuguquka ngeke kuqhutshekwe phambili. Uma iseli lingakwazi ukuzala, ukuguquka akusabalali futhi umonakalo mncane. Ngezinye izikhathi, nokho, ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kubangela ushintsho olwandisa umsebenzi womlawuli omuhle. Isibonelo, ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okuvumela i-Cdk ukuthi isebenze ngaphandle kokubambisana ne-cyclin kungasunduza umjikelezo weseli udlule endaweni yokuhlola ngaphambi kokuba kuhlangatshezwane nazo zonke izimo ezidingekayo. Uma amangqamuzana endodakazi avelayo onakele kakhulu ukuba adlule ekuhlukanisweni kweseli okwengeziwe, ukuguquka ngeke kusabalali futhi akukho monakalo oyofika kuyo into ephilayo. Kodwa-ke, uma amaseli endodakazi angavamile ekwazi ukuhlukana okwengeziwe kwamaseli, izizukulwane ezilandelayo zamaseli cishe zizoqoqa izinguquko ezengeziwe, ezinye kungenzeka zibe yizakhi zofuzo ezengeziwe ezilawula umjikelezo weseli.

 Izakhi zofuzo ze-Cdk esibonelweni esingenhla zingenye yezakhi zofuzo eziningi ezibhekwa njenge-proto-oncogenes. Ngaphezu kwamaprotheni alawula umjikelezo weseli, noma yiliphi iphrotheni elithonya umjikelezo lingashintshwa ngendlela yokuthi linqobe izindawo zokuhlola umjikelezo weseli. I-oncogene yinoma yiliphi i-gene, lapho ishintshwa, eholela ekwandeni kwesilinganiso sokuqhubeka komjikelezo weseli.
question1: Ziyini i-proto-oncogenes?
answer1: Izakhi zofuzo ezijwayelekile ezibhala ikhodi yabalawuli bomjikelezo weseli abahle.
distractor1a: Izakhi zofuzo ezisebenzisa amaprotheni okucindezela umdlavuza kuphela.
distractor1c: Izakhi zofuzo zitholakala kuphela kumaseli omdlavuza.
question2: Iyini i-oncogene?
answer2: Izakhi zofuzo eziguquliwe ezikhulisa ukuqhubeka komjikelezo weseli futhi ezingabangela umdlavuza.
question3: Ama-proto-oncogenes ahlobene kanjani nama-oncogenes?
answer3: Ama-proto-oncogene angaba ama-oncogene ngemva kokuguquka okuthile.
question4: Yimuphi umphumela ovame kakhulu wokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ku-proto-oncogene?
answer4: Ikhiqiza iphrotheni engasebenzi kahle noma engasebenzi kahle.
question5: Kungani izinguquko eziningi ze-proto-oncogene zingalimazi umzimba?
answer5: Iseli elithintekile livame ukungaqhubeki nokuhlukana, ngakho-ke ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo akusabalali.
distractor5a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kulungiswa ngokushesha kuzo zonke izimo.
distractor5b: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kudluliselwa kuma-gametes kuphela.
distractor5c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuqinisa ukulawulwa kwendawo yokuhlola.
question6: Uhlobo luni lokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi lubangele umdlavuza?
answer6: Uguquko olwandisa umsebenzi womlawuli omuhle.
distractor6c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP.
question7: Yisiphi isibonelo esivela embhalweni esibonisa ukwakheka kwe-oncogene?
answer7: Ukuguqulwa okuvumela i-Cdk ukuthi isebenze ngaphandle kokubopha i-cyclin.
distractor7a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvimbela ukujiya kwe-chromosome.
distractor7b: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okubangela ukuthi ama-centrioles aphindeke kabili.
distractor7c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvimbela ukwakheka kwe-spindle fiber.
question8: Kungani ukusebenza kwe-Cdk ngaphandle kwe-cyclin kungaba yingozi?
answer8: Ingasunduza iseli endaweni yokuhlola ngaphambi kokuba kuhlangatshezwane nazo zonke izimo ezidingekayo.
question9: Uma amaseli endodakazi angajwayelekile engakwazi ukuhlukana ngokwengeziwe, uyini umphumela?
answer9: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo akusasazwa futhi kuncane noma akukho monakalo owenzeka emzimbeni.
distractor9a: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kusakazeka ngokushesha kuwo wonke umzimba.
question10: Kungani ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli endodakazi angavamile kuyingozi kakhulu?
answer10: Zingaqoqa izinguquko ezengeziwe ezizukulwaneni ezilandelanayo.
distractor10a: Bahlala belungisa i-DNA yabo ngendlela ephumelela kakhulu.
question11: Ngaphandle kwama-cyclins nama-Cdks, yimaphi amanye amaprotheni angaba yi-oncogenic uma eshintshwa?
answer11: Noma iyiphi iphrotheni ethonya ukuqhubekela phambili komjikelezo weseli.
question12: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono i-oncogene?
answer12: Izakhi zofuzo ezishintshiwe ezikhulisa izinga lokuqhubeka komjikelezo weseli.
distractor12c: Izakhi zofuzo ezikhuthaza i-apoptosis kuwo wonke amaseli.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.4 Umdlavuza Nomjikelezo Weseli | Izakhi Zofuzo Zokucindezela Ithumba
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.4 Umdlavuza Nomjikelezo Weseli | Izakhi Zofuzo Zokucindezela Ithumba
chapterContent:
Njenge-proto-oncogenes, amaprotheni amaningi okulawula umjikelezo weseli ongemuhle atholakale emaselini abe ngumdlavuza. Ama-gene okucindezela i-tumor ayizingxenye ze-DNA ezibhala amaprotheni okulawula i-negative, uhlobo lwabalawuli, lapho lusebenza, olungavimbela iseli ukuthi lingahlukaniswa ngokungalawuleki. Umsebenzi ohlangene wamaprotheni okuvikela i-tumor aqondakala kahle, i-Rb, i-p53, kanye ne-p21, ukubeka isithiyo ekuqhubekeni komjikelezo weseli kuze kube yilapho imicimbi ethile iqediwe. Iseli eliphethe uhlobo oluguquliwe lwe-negative regulator lingase lingakwazi ukumisa umjikelezo weseli uma kunenkinga. Ama-tumor suppressors afana namabhuleki emotweni: Amabhuleki angasebenzi kahle angabangela ingozi yemoto.

 Ama-gene e-p53 aguquliwe atholakale ngaphezu kwengxenye yawo wonke amangqamuzana omdlavuza womuntu. Lokhu kutholakala akumangazi uma kubhekwa izindima eziningi ezidlalwa yi-protein ye-p53 endaweni yokuhlola ye-G1. Iseli eline-p53 enephutha lingase lihluleke ukubona amaphutha akhona ku-DNA ye-genomic (Isithombe 10.15). Ngisho noma i-p53 esebenza kancane ikwazi ukukhomba izinguquko, ingase ingasakwazi ukukhombisa ama-enzyme okulungisa i-DNA adingekayo. Noma ngabe yikuphi, i-DNA eyonakele izohlala ingalungiswa. Kuleli qophelo, i-p53 esebenzayo izobona iseli lingasindiswa futhi libangele ukufa kweseli okuhleliwe (i-apoptosis). Nokho, inguqulo eyonakele ye-p53 etholakala kumaseli omdlavuza ayikwazi ukuqala i-apoptosis.

 Ukulahlekelwa umsebenzi we-p53 kuneminye imiphumela yomjikelezo weseli. I-p53 eguquliwe ingase ilahlekelwe amandla ayo okuqala ukukhiqizwa kwe-p21. Ngaphandle kwamazinga anele e-p21, akukho ukuvimba okusebenzayo ekusebenzeni kwe-Cdk. Empeleni, ngaphandle kwe-p53 esebenza ngokugcwele, indawo yokuhlola ye-G1 isengozini enkulu futhi iseli liqhubeka ngqo kusuka ku-G1 liye ku-S kungakhathaliseki izimo zangaphakathi nezangaphandle. Ekuqedeni lo mjikelezo weseli omfushane, kukhiqizwa amaseli amabili endodakazi azuze i-gene ye-p53 eguquliwe. Ngenxa yezimo ezingezinhle lapho iseli lomzali lizala khona, kungenzeka ukuthi amaseli endodakazi azobe esethole ezinye izinguquko ngaphezu kwezakhi zofuzo ezivimbela isimila ezinephutha. Amaseli afana nalawa maseli endodakazi aqoqa ngokushesha kokubili izakhi zofuzo ze-oncogene kanye nezakhi zofuzo ezivimbela isimila ezingasebenzi. Futhi, umphumela uba ukukhula kwesimila.
question1: Ziyini izakhi zofuzo ezivimbela umdlavuza?
answer1: Izakhi zofuzo ezibhala amaprotheni alawulayo angalungile avimbela ukuhlukana kwamaseli okungalawulwa.
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wamaprotheni okucindezela isimila?
answer2: Ukumisa umjikelezo weseli kuze kube yilapho imicimbi edingekayo yeselula iqediwe.
question3: Yimaphi amaprotheni aphakathi kwamaprotheni acindezela umdlavuza aqondakala kahle?
distractor3a: I-Cyclin A, i-Cyclin B, kanye ne-Cyclin D.
question4: Yini engenzeka uma iseli liphethe i-gene eguquliwe yokucindezela isimila?
answer4: Iseli lingase lihluleke ukumisa umjikelezo weseli uma kunezinkinga.
question5: Amaprotheni okucindezela isimila afana kakhulu nengxenyeni yemoto?
question6: Cishe yiliphi inani lamathumba abantu aqukethe izakhi zofuzo ze-p53 eziguquliwe?
answer6: Ngaphezu kwengxenye.
question7: Iyini imiphumela eyodwa yephrotheni ye-p53 enephutha?
answer7: Ingase yehluleke ukubona umonakalo we-DNA.
distractor7b: Kubangela ukuba ama-chromosome ahlukane kusenesikhathi kakhulu.
question8: Ngisho noma i-p53 esebenza kancane ithola umonakalo we-DNA, yini engase yehluleke ukuyenza?
answer8: Ama-enzyme okulungisa i-Signal DNA.
question9: Yini eyenziwa yi-p53 evamile, esebenzayo uma umonakalo we-DNA ungalungiseki?
answer9: Kubangela i-apoptosis.
question10: Kungani amangqamuzana omdlavuza ane-p53 enesici eqhubeka nokuhlukana?
answer10: I-p53 enephutha ayikwazi ukuqala i-apoptosis.
question11: I-p53 ivame ukuthonya kanjani i-p21?
question12: Kwenzekani uma amazinga e-p21 enganele?
question13: Uyini umphumela wokulahlekelwa umsebenzi ojwayelekile we-p53 endaweni yokuhlola ye-G1?
answer13: Indawo yokuhlola i-G1 iba sengozini enkulu.
question14: Ngaphandle kwe-p53 esebenzayo, iseli lithuthuka kanjani kulo lonke umjikelezo weseli?
answer14: Iqhubeka kusukela ku-G1 kuya ku-S kungakhathaliseki izimo zangaphakathi nezangaphandle.
question15: Yini ezuzwa yizingane zamantombazane ngemva kweseli elinokuhlukana kwe-p53 okuguquliwe?
question16: Kungani amaseli ane-p53 eguquliwe evame ukuqoqa ezinye izinguquko?
answer16: Ziyaqhubeka nokuhlukana naphezu komonakalo we-DNA kanye nokulawulwa kwezindawo zokuhlola okunephutha.
question17: Yikuphi ukuhlanganiswa kwezinguquko zofuzo ezivame ukuvela kumaseli esimila?
answer17: Ukuqongelela kwezakhi zofuzo ze-oncogene kanye nezakhi zofuzo ezingasebenzi kahle ezicindezela umdlavuza.
distractor17a: Izakhi zofuzo ezengeziwe zokucindezela umdlavuza kuphela.
distractor17c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela ku-RNA ye-ribosomal.
question18: Uyini umphumela ophelele wokuqongelela ama-oncogene kanye nezakhi zofuzo ezivimbela isimila ezinephutha?
answer18: Ukukhula kwesimila.
question19: Bheka Umfanekiso 10.15. I-Human papillomavirus ingabangela umdlavuza wesibeletho. Igciwane lifaka i-E6, iphrotheni ebopha i-p53. Ngokusekelwe kuleli qiniso nalokho okwaziyo nge-p53, ucabanga ukuthi ukubopha i-E6 kunamuphi umphumela emsebenzini we-p53?
answer19: Amamaki okubopha angu-E6 p53 okuwohloka.
question20: Ukwelapha umdlavuza kungachazwa njengokulwa nezinqubo zemvelo zebhayoloji. Chaza ukuthi lokhu kusho ukuthini maqondana nokwakheka kwesimila.
answer20: Umdlavuza wakheka lapho izivikelo zemvelo zivinjelwe futhi amangqamuzana ehlukana ngokungalawuleki.
distractor20a: Amaseli aguqukile adlula ku-apoptosis, okwenza amaseli ahlukane ngokungalawuleki.
distractor20b: Ukwelashwa komdlavuza kuzodinga ukuvimbela i-apoptosis okuyindlela yokuzivikela yemvelo.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.5 Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamaseli e-Prokaryotic | Ukuhlukana Kwebhanari
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.5 Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamaseli e-Prokaryotic | Ukuhlukana Kwebhanari
chapterContent:
Ama-Prokaryotes, njengebhaktheriya, asakazeka ngokuhlukana kwe-binary. Kuzinto eziphilayo ezi-unicellular, ukuhlukaniswa kweseli kuyindlela kuphela yokukhiqiza abantu abasha. Kumaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic, umphumela wokuzala kweseli umbhangqwana wamaseli endodakazi afana ngofuzo neseli lomzali. Kuzinto eziphilayo ezi-unicellular, amaseli endodakazi ngabantu ngabanye.

 Ukuze kufezwe umphumela wenzalo ehlanganisiwe, izinyathelo ezithile zibalulekile. I-DNA ye-genomic kumele iphindwe bese ibekwa kumaseli endodakazi; okuqukethwe yi-cytoplasmic kumele futhi kuhlukaniswe ukuze kunikezwe womabili amaseli amasha umshini wokusekela ukuphila. Kumaseli ebhaktheriya, i-genome iqukethe i-chromosome eyodwa, eyindilinga ye-DNA; ngakho-ke, inqubo yokuhlukaniswa kweseli yenziwa lula. I-Karyokinesis ayidingeki ngoba ayikho i-nucleus ngakho-ke asikho isidingo sokuqondisa ikhophi eyodwa yama-chromosome amaningi kuseli ngalinye lendodakazi. Lolu hlobo lokuhlukaniswa kweseli lubizwa ngokuthi i-binary (prokaryotic) fission.

 I-Binary Fission
Ngenxa yobulula obulinganiselwe bama-prokaryotes, inqubo yokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli, ebizwa ngokuthi i-binary fission, iyinqubo eyinkimbinkimbi futhi eshesha kakhulu kunokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kuma-eukaryotes. I-chromosome eyodwa, eyindilinga ye-DNA yama-bacteria ayivalelwe ku-nucleus, kodwa kunalokho ithatha indawo ethile, i-nucleoid, ngaphakathi kweseli (Isithombe 10.2). Nakuba i-DNA ye-nucleoid ihlotshaniswa namaprotheni asiza ekupakisheni i-molecule ibe usayizi omncane, awekho amaprotheni e-histone ngakho-ke awekho ama-nucleosome kuma-prokaryotes. Amaprotheni okupakisha ama-bacteria, nokho, ahlobene namaprotheni e-cohesin kanye ne-condensin ahilelekile ekuhlanganisweni kwama-chromosome ama-eukaryotes.

 I-chromosome yama-bacteria inamathele ku-plasma membrane cishe phakathi nendawo yeseli. Indawo yokuqala yokuphindaphinda, umsuka, iseduze nendawo yokubopha ye-chromosome ku-plasma membrane (Isithombe 10.16). Ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA ku-bidirectional, kuhamba kude nomsuka kuzo zombili izintambo ze-loop ngesikhathi esisodwa. Njengoba kwakheka imicu emisha emibili, iphuzu ngalinye elivela kulo liyasuka ekunamathiselweni kodonga lweseli liye emaphethelweni aphambene eseli. Njengoba iseli likhula, ulwelwesi olukhulayo lusiza ekuthuthweni kwama-chromosome. Ngemva kokuba ama-chromosome esesukile endaweni ephakathi yeseli elide, ukuhlukaniswa kwe-cytoplasm kuyaqala. Ukwakheka kwendandatho eyakhiwe amayunithi aphindaphindayo ephrotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-FtsZ kuqondisa ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwama-nucleoid. Ukwakheka kwendandatho ye-FtsZ kubangela ukuqongelela kwamanye amaprotheni asebenza ndawonye ukuqoqa izinto ezintsha zolwelwesi kanye nodonga lweseli endaweni. Kwakhiwa i-septum phakathi kwama-nucleoid, eqhubeka kancane kancane esuka emngceleni iye enkabeni yeseli. Lapho izindonga zeseli ezintsha sezikhona, amaseli endodakazi ayahlukana.
question1: Ama-prokaryotes azala kanjani?
answer1: Ngokuhlukana kwe-binary.
question2: Kuzinto eziphilayo ezi-single cell, iyini injongo yokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli?
question3: Uyini umphumela wokuzala kwamaseli kokubili kumaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic?
answer3: Amaseli amabili endodakazi afana ngofuzo neseli lomzali.
question4: Yimiphi imisebenzi emibili emikhulu okumele yenzeke ngaphambi kokuba kukhiqizwe amaseli endodakazi?
answer4: I-genome kumele iphindaphindwe futhi okuqukethwe yi-cytoplasm kumele kuhlukaniswe.
distractor4a: I-nucleus kumele incibilike futhi ama-chromosome kumele ahlangane.
distractor4c: Udonga lweseli kumele lunyamalale futhi luguquke.
question5: Kungani ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kulula kuma-bacteria kunakuma-eukaryotes?
answer5: Amabhaktheriya ane-chromosome eyodwa eyindilinga futhi awanawo i-nucleus.
question6: Kungani i-karyokinesis ingadingeki kuma-prokaryotes?
answer6: Ngoba ama-prokaryotes awanawo i-nucleus.
question7: Kuyini ukuhlukana kwe-binary?
answer7: Inqubo yokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-prokaryotic.
question8: Ikuphi i-chromosome yebhaktheriya?
answer8: Esifundeni se-nucleoid seseli.
question9: Yimaphi amaprotheni angekho kuma-chromosome e-prokaryotic?
answer9: Amaprotheni e-Histone.
question10: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezingekho kuma-prokaryotes ngoba ama-histone awekho?
answer10: Ama-Nucleosome.
question11: Kuyini okuyiqiniso ngamaprotheni ahlanganisa ama-chromosome ebhaktheriya?
answer11: Zihlobene namaprotheni e-cohesin kanye ne-condensin ama-eukaryotes.
question12: I-chromosome yebhaktheriya inamathele kuphi ngesikhathi sokuhlukana kwe-binary?
answer12: Ku-plasma membrane eduze nendawo ephakathi kweseli.
question13: Ikuphi imvelaphi yokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA?
answer13: Eduze kwendawo yokunamathisela i-chromosome ku-plasma membrane.
question14: Kuqhubeka kanjani ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA yebhaktheriya?
answer14: Kusukela ohlangothini lwesibili kusukela ekuqaleni kuzo zombili izintambo ngesikhathi esisodwa.
distractor14a: Kusuka ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela ukusuka emvelaphi.
question15: Njengoba ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuqhubeka, kwenzekani ezindaweni zokuqala?
question16: Yini esiza ukunyakaza kwama-chromosome ngesikhathi sokwandiswa kwamaseli ebhaktheriya?
question17: Yiliphi iphrotheni elakha indandatho eqala i-cytokinesis yebhaktheriya?
answer17: Ama-FtsZ.
question18: Yini ebangela ukwakheka kwendandatho ye-FtsZ?
answer18: Ukuqoqa amaprotheni akha izinto ezintsha ze-membrane kanye nodonga lweseli.
question19: Yisiphi isakhiwo esakha phakathi kwama-nucleoid amabili ngesikhathi sokuhlukana kwe-binary?
answer19: I-septum.
question20: Amangqamuzana ebhaktheriya endodakazi ahlukana nini?
answer20: Ngemva kokuba izindonga ze-septum kanye nezintsha sezibunjiwe.
distractor20b: Ngokushesha nje lapho indandatho ye-FtsZ isungulwa.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.5 Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamaseli e-Prokaryotic | Imishini Yesipinashi se-Mitotic
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.5 Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamaseli e-Prokaryotic | Imishini Yesipinashi se-Mitotic
chapterContent:
Isikhathi esinembile kanye nokwakheka kwe-mitotic spindle kubalulekile empumelelweni yokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-eukaryotic. Amaseli e-prokaryotic, ngakolunye uhlangothi, awahlangabezani ne-karyokinesis ngakho-ke awadingi i-mitotic spindle. Kodwa-ke, iphrotheni ye-FtsZ edlala indima ebaluleke kangaka ku-prokaryotic cytokinesis ifana kakhulu ne-tubulin ngokwesakhiwo nangokusebenza, isakhiwo sama-microtubules akha imicu ye-mitotic spindle edingekayo kuma-eukaryotes. Amaprotheni e-FtsZ angakha ama-filament, amasongo, nezinye izakhiwo ezinezilinganiso ezintathu ezifana nendlela i-tubulin eyakha ngayo ama-microtubules, ama-centrioles, kanye nezingxenye ezahlukahlukene ze-cytoskeletal. Ngaphezu kwalokho, zombili i-FtsZ kanye ne-tubulin zisebenzisa umthombo wamandla ofanayo, i-GTP (i-guanosine triphosphate), ukuze zihlanganise ngokushesha futhi zihlukanise izakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 I-FtsZ kanye ne-tubulin ziyizakhiwo ezifanayo ezithathwe emvelaphi evamile yokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Kulesi sibonelo, i-FtsZ iyiphrotheni yokhokho ku-tubulin (iphrotheni yesimanje). Nakuba womabili amaprotheni etholakala ezintweni eziphilayo ezikhona, umsebenzi we-tubulin ushintshile kakhulu kusukela ekuguqukeni kwawo kusuka emsuka wawo we-FtsZ prokaryotic. Ucwaningo lwezingxenye ze-mitotic assembly ezitholakala kuma-eukaryotes e-unicellular yanamuhla lwembula izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuxhumanisa kuma-genomes ayinkimbinkimbi afakwe ulwelwesi lwama-eukaryotes amaningi e-cellular.
question1: Kungani amaseli e-prokaryotic engadingi i-mitotic spindle?
answer1: Aziphathwa yi-karyokinesis ngoba azinayo i-nucleus.
distractor1a: Ama-chromosome abo mancane kakhulu ukuthi angadinga imicu ye-spindle.
question2: Yiliphi iphrotheni ye-prokaryotic efana ne-tubulin ngokwesakhiwo nangokusebenza?
question3: I-Tubulin iyisakhiwo sasiphi isakhiwo samaseli?
question4: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezingakhiwa amaprotheni e-FtsZ?
answer4: Ama-filaments, amasongo, nezinye izakhiwo ezinezilinganiso ezintathu.
question5: Yimuphi umthombo wamandla osetshenziswa yi-FtsZ kanye ne-tubulin?
question6: Yibuphi ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo obukhona phakathi kwe-FtsZ ne-tubulin?
answer6: Ziyiprotheni ezifanayo ezitholakala kuphrotheni evamile yokhokho.
question7: Yiliphi iphrotheni elibhekwa njengephrotheni yokhokho kulobu budlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer7: Ama-FtsZ.
question8: Kwenzekeni ku-tubulin selokhu yavela ku-FtsZ?
answer8: Imisebenzi yayo ithuthuke kakhulu futhi yahlukahluka kakhulu.
distractor8c: Itholakala kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi.
question9: Izinto zofuzo zihlelwe kanjani kuma-prokaryotes?
answer9: I-chromosome eyodwa eyindilinga ku-nucleoid.
question10: Ama-prokaryotes ahlukanisa kanjani amaseli endodakazi yawo?
answer10: Amaprotheni e-FtsZ ahlangana abe yindandatho ecindezela iseli kabili.
distractor10a: Ipuleti leseli lakha phakathi kwamaseli endodakazi.
question11: Abanye abaprothestani bahlukanisa kanjani izinto zabo zenuzi?
answer11: Ama-chromosome anamathela emvilophini yenuzi, ahlala ephilile ngenkathi i-spindle idlula kuyo.
distractor11a: Imvilophu yenuzi iyancibilika ngaphambi kokwakheka kwe-spindle.
question12: Ingabe abanye abaphrotheli banama-centrioles?
question13: Abanye abaculi bahluke kanjani kwabanye abaculi ngesikhathi se-mitosis?
answer13: Zakha i-mitotic spindle ngama-centrioles kuyilapho i-nuclear membrane ihlala ingashintshi.
distractor13c: Ama-chromosome abo awalokothi anamathele kuma-spindle fibers.
question14: Amaseli ezilwane ahlukanisa kanjani amaseli endodakazi ngesikhathi se-cytokinesis?
answer14: Ama-microfilament akha umsele oqhekekayo ocindezela iseli kabili.
distractor14a: Ipuleti leseli likhula phakathi kwamaseli endodakazi.
question15: Kwenzekani embotsheni yenuzi ngesikhathi se-mitosis kumaseli ezilwane?
question16: Yisiphi isakhiwo esakha i-mitotic spindle emaseli ezilwane?
question17: I-FtsZ iyiprotheyini ye-prokaryotic kanti i-tubulin iyiprotheyini ye-eukaryotic. Lawa maprotheni amabili abelana ngokufana okuningi kwesakhiwo nokusebenza futhi kukholakala ukuthi avele kuprotheyini efanayo yokhokho. Kodwa-ke, kukhona nomehluko obalulekile phakathi kwala maprotheni. Lawa maprotheni ahluke kanjani?
answer17: I-Tubulin ihlukanisa ama-chromosome, kodwa i-FtsZ ayihlukanisi.
distractor17a: Amaprotheni e-tubulin angahlakazeka ngokushesha, kodwa amaprotheni e-FtsZ awakwazi.

chapterName: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 2. Iseli | 10. Ukukhiqizwa Kwamaseli | 10.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
10.1 Ukuhlukaniswa Kweseli
Ama-Prokaryote ane-chromosome eyodwa eyindilinga eyakhiwe yi-DNA enezintambo ezimbili, kanti ama-eukaryote anama-chromosome amaningi, aqondile akhiwe yi-chromatin, wonke azungezwe ulwelwesi lwenuzi. Ama-chromosome angu-46 amaseli e-somatic omuntu akhiwe ngama-autosome angu-22 (ama-pair afanayo) kanye nama-chromosome amabili ocansi, angase afane noma angafanelani. Lesi yisimo se-2n noma se-diploid. Ama-gametes omuntu anama-chromosome angu-23 amele isethi eyodwa ephelele yama-chromosome; isethi yama-chromosome iphelele nenye yama-chromosome ocansi. Lesi yisimo se-n noma se-haploid. Ama-gene ayizingxenye ze-DNA ezikhomba iphrotheni ethile. Izici zesidalwa zinqunywa izakhi zofuzo ezizuzwe kumzali ngamunye. Ama-chromosome aphindwe kabili akhiwe ama-chromatids amabili odadewabo. Ama-chromosome ahlanganiswa kusetshenziswa izindlela ezahlukahlukene phakathi nezigaba ezithile zomjikelezo weseli. Amakilasi amaningana ephrotheni ahilelekile ekuhleleni nasekupakisheni i-DNA ye-chromosome esakhiweni esifingqiwe kakhulu. Inkimbinkimbi yokujiya ihlanganisa ama-chromosome, futhi isakhiwo esijiyile esiphumelayo siyadingeka ukuze kuhlukaniswe ama-chromosome ngesikhathi se-mitosis.

 10.2 Umjikelezo Weseli
Umjikelezo weseli uwuchungechunge oluhlelekile lwezenzakalo. Amaseli asendleleni eya ekuhlukanisweni kweseli aqhubeka ngochungechunge lwezigaba ezihlelwe ngesikhathi futhi ezilawulwa ngokucophelela. Kuma-eukaryotes, umjikelezo weseli uqukethe isikhathi eside sokulungiselela, esibizwa ngokuthi i-interphase. I-Interphase ihlukaniswe ngezigaba ze-G1, S, kanye ne-G2. Isigaba se-mitotic siqala nge-karyokinesis (mitosis), esakhiwa izigaba ezinhlanu: i-prophase, i-prometaphase, i-metaphase, i-anaphase, kanye ne-telophase. Isigaba sokugcina sesigaba se-mitotic yi-cytokinesis, lapho izingxenye ze-cytoplasmic zamaseli endodakazi zihlukaniswa khona ngendandatho ye-actin (amaseli ezilwane) noma ngokwakhiwa kwepuleti leseli (amaseli ezitshalo).

 10.3 Ukulawulwa Komjikelezo Weseli
Isinyathelo ngasinye somjikelezo weseli siqashwa yizilawuli zangaphakathi ezibizwa ngokuthi izindawo zokuhlola. Kunezindawo ezintathu zokuhlola ezinkulu emjikelezweni weseli: esisodwa eduze kokuphela kwe-G1, esesibili ekuguqukeni kwe-G2/M, kanti esesithathu ngesikhathi se-metaphase. Ama-molecule alawulayo amahle avumela umjikelezo weseli ukuthi uqhubekele esigabeni esilandelayo. Ama-molecule alawulayo angalungile aqapha izimo zamaseli futhi angamisa umjikelezo kuze kube yilapho kuhlangatshezwana nezidingo ezithile.

 10.4 Umdlavuza kanye noMjikelezo Weseli
Umdlavuza uwumphumela wokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okungahlolwanga okubangelwa ukuwohloka kwezindlela ezilawula umjikelezo weseli. Ukulahlekelwa ukulawula kuqala ngoshintsho kuhlelo lwe-DNA lwesakhi sofuzo oluqondisa enye yama-molecule alawulayo. Imiyalelo enephutha iholela kuphrotheni engasebenzi ngendlela efanele. Noma yikuphi ukuphazamiseka kohlelo lokuqapha kungavumela amanye amaphutha ukuthi adluliselwe kumaseli endodakazi. Ukuhlukaniswa ngakunye kweseli okulandelanayo kuzodala amaseli endodakazi anomonakalo oqongeleleke kakhulu. Ekugcineni, zonke izindawo zokuhlola azisebenzi, futhi amaseli azala ngokushesha agcwalisa amaseli ajwayelekile, okuholela esimila noma i-leukemia (umdlavuza wegazi).

 10.5 Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamaseli e-Prokaryotic
Kokubili ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic, i-DNA ye-genomic iyaphindaphindwa bese ikhophi ngayinye ibekwa kuseli lendodakazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okuqukethwe yi-cytoplasmic kuhlukaniswa ngokulinganayo futhi kusatshalaliswe kumaseli amasha. Kodwa-ke, kunezinhlobo eziningi ezahlukene phakathi kokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic. Ama-bacteria ane-chromosome eyodwa, eyindilinga ye-DNA kodwa ayinayo i-nucleus. Ngakho-ke, i-mitosis ayidingeki ekuhlukanisweni kwamaseli e-bacterial. I-cytokinesis yama-bacterial iqondiswa yindandatho eyakhiwe yiprotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-FtsZ. Ukukhula kwe-membrane kanye nezinto zodonga lwamaseli ezivela emngceleni wamaseli kuphumela ekwakhekeni kwe-septum ekugcineni eyakha izindonga zamaseli ezihlukene zamaseli endodakazi.

answer8: Ipuleti leseli
question9: Uyoba yini umphumela wokuvimba isigaba se-S se-interphase?
answer9: Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA bekungeke kwenzeke.
question10: Kukuziphi izindawo zokuhlola umjikelezo weseli lapho amandla angaphandle anethonya elikhulu khona?
answer10: Indawo yokuhlola ye-G1
question11: Uma indawo yokuhlola i-M ingasuswa, yisiphi isigaba se-mitosis esizovinjelwa?
question12: Yiliphi iphrotheni eliyisilawuli esihle esifaka amanye amaprotheni i-phosphorylates uma lisebenza?
question13: Yimuphi umolekyuli olawulayo ongemuhle ongabangela i-apoptosis uma imicimbi ebalulekile yomjikelezo weseli ingenzeki?
question14: Iyini imfuneko eyinhloko yokungena endaweni yokuhlola i-G2?
answer14: Kuye kwenzeka ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA okunembile nokuphelele.
distractor14c: Kuye kwaba nokunamathela okufanele kwe-mitotic spindle fibers kuma-kinetochores.
question15: Uzibiza ngokuthini izinguquko ohlelweni lwama-nucleotide engxenyeni ye-DNA ebhala iphrotheni?
question16: I-human papillomavirus ingabangela umdlavuza wesibeletho. Igciwane lifaka i-E6, iphrotheni ebopha i-p53. Ngokusekelwe kuleli qiniso nalokho okwaziyo nge-p53, ucabanga ukuthi ukubopha i-E6 kunamuphi umphumela emsebenzini we-p53?
question17: Ibizwa ngokuthini i-gene ebhala ikhodi yomlawuli womjikelezo weseli omuhle?
answer17: I-proto-oncogene
question18: Yiliphi i-molecule eliyi-Cdk inhibitor noma elilawulwa yi-p53?
answer18: Ikhasi 21
question19: Yiziphi izehlakalo zomjikelezo wamaseli e-eukaryotic ezingekho ku-binary fission?
answer19: I-karyokinesis
question20: Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana nokuhlukaniswa kwe-binary esingamanga?
answer20: I-mitotic spindle idonsela ama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe emaphethelweni ahlukile eseli kulandele ukwakheka kwe-septum namaseli amabili endodakazi.
distractor20a: Kuwo womabili amaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic, umphumela wokuzala kwamaseli umbhangqwana wamaseli endodakazi, afana ngofuzo neseli lomzali.
distractor20b: I-Karyokinesis ayidingeki kuma-prokaryotes ngoba ayikho i-nucleus.
distractor20c: Ukuphindaphinda kwe-chromosome ye-prokaryotic kuqala ekuqaleni kokuphindaphinda futhi kuqhubeke kuzo zombili izinhlangothi ngesikhathi esisodwa.
question21: Ukwakheka kwasiphi isakhiwo, esizogcina sakhe izindonga ezintsha zamaseli endodakazi, kuqondiswa yi-FtsZ?
answer21: I-septum
question22: Qhathanisa futhi uqhathanise iseli lomuntu elinomzimba ofana nowe-gamete yomuntu.
answer22: Amaseli e-somatic anama-chromosome angu-46 futhi angama-diploid, kanti ama-gametes anama-chromosome amaningi ayingxenye kunalawo atholakala kumaseli e-somatic.
distractor22a: Amaseli e-somatic anama-chromosome angu-23 futhi angama-diploid, kanti ama-gametes anama-chromosome ayingxenye yenani lawo akhona kumaseli e-somatic.
distractor22b: Amaseli e-somatic anama-chromosome angu-46 futhi angama-haploid, kanti ama-gametes anama-chromosome angu-23 futhi angama-diploid.
distractor22c: Amaseli e-somatic anama-chromosome angu-46 ane-chromosome eyodwa yobulili. Kuma-gametes, ama-chromosome angu-23 akhona nama-chromosome amabili obulili.
question23: Ama-chromosome e-Eukaryotic made ngokuphindwe kazinkulungwane kuneseli elivamile. Chaza ukuthi ama-chromosome angangena kanjani ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus ye-eukaryotic.
answer23: I-DNA ihlala izungeze amaprotheni ukuze yakhe ama-nucleosome.
distractor23a: Izinto zofuzo zihlala zisakazwa ku-nucleus, mitochondria, kanye ne-chloroplast.
distractor23b: I-genome ikhona esakhiweni esinomjikelezo, ngakho-ke ifanelana nosayizi we-nucleus.
distractor23c: Izinto zofuzo zihlala ziboshelwe embotsheni yenuzi, zakha izinto ezihlaselayo.
question24: Chaza kafushane izehlakalo ezenzeka esigabeni ngasinye se-interphase.
answer24: I-G1 - iseli likhula futhi lilungiselela izinto zesigaba sokwenziwa, i-S - ukuphindaphindwa kwezinto zofuzo, i-G2 - ukuphindaphindwa kwama-organelle kanye nokuqedwa kwe-cytoskeleton.
distractor24a: I-G1 - ukuphindaphindwa kwama-organelle, i-S - ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA, i-G2 - ukuhlolwa komonakalo we-DNA.
distractor24b: I-G1 - ukwenziwa kwe-DNA, i-S - ukwenziwa kwezinto zofuzo ze-organelle, i-G2 - ukuhlolwa komonakalo we-DNA.
distractor24c: I-G1 - ukulungiselela ukwenziwa kwe-DNA, i-S - ukuhlolwa komonakalo we-DNA, i-M - ukuhlukaniswa kweseli.
question25: Imithi yokwelapha ngamakhemikhali efana ne-vincristine kanye ne-colchicines iphazamisa i-mitosis ngokubopha ku-tubulin (iyunithi encane yama-microtubules) nokuphazamisa ukuhlanganiswa nokuhlukaniswa kwama-microtubule. Yisiphi isakhiwo se-mitotic le mithi ehlose ukusihlasela, futhi lokho kungaba namuphi umphumela ekuhlukanisweni kwamaseli?
answer25: Imithi ibopha i-tubulin, okuholela ephutheni ekuhlukanisweni kwama-chromosome. Lokhu kungaholela ekuqhekekeni kwama-chromosome.
distractor25a: Imithi ibopha i-tubulin futhi ivimbele ukwakheka kwe-metaphase plate. Lokhu kungavimba umjikelezo weseli.
distractor25b: Imithi ibopha i-tubulin, ngaleyo ndlela ivimbele ukuhlukana kwayo esigabeni se-S. Lokhu kuvimbela ukuhlukana kwamaseli.
distractor25c: Imithi ibopha i-spindle fiber futhi ivimbele ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromatins. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuhlukana ngokuzenzekelayo.
question26:
Bheka uMfanekiso 10.17. Amagrafu amabili akhombisa imiphumela yocwaningo ngomuthi womdlavuza. Igrafu yesobunxele ikhombisa iqembu lokulawula imiphumela, amangqamuzana omdlavuza angelashwanga. Igrafu yesokudla ikhombisa imiphumela yamangqamuzana aphathwe ngomuthi.

 Yini engathiwa ngalo muthi?
answer26: Umuthi uvimba umjikelezo weseli esigabeni se-G1.
distractor26b: Lo muthi ubangela ukuthi amaseli adlule esigabeni se-G1 kancane.
distractor26c: Lo muthi ubangela ukuthi amaseli adlule esigabeni se-G1 ngokushesha.
question27: Chaza izimo ezijwayelekile okumele zihlangatshezwe kuzo zonke izindawo ezintathu zokuhlola umjikelezo weseli.
answer27: Indawo yokuhlola i-G1 - Amandla agciniwe esigaba se-S, indawo yokuhlola i-G2 - ukuhlolwa kwe-DNA entsha, indawo yokuhlola i-M - ukunamathiselwa kwe-spindle ku-kinetochore.
distractor27a: Indawo yokuhlola ye-G1 - ukuhlolwa komonakalo we-DNA, i-G2 - ukuhlolwa kwe-DNA entsha, indawo yokuhlola ye-M - ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromatids angodadewabo ku-anaphase.
distractor27b: Indawo yokuhlola i-G1 - ukuhlolwa komonakalo we-DNA, indawo yokuhlola i-G2 - izinqolobane zamandla ze-DNA, indawo yokuhlola i-M - ukunamathiselwa kwe-spindle ku-kinetochore.
distractor27c: Indawo yokuhlola i-G1 - Amandla agciniwe esigaba se-S, indawo yokuhlola i-S - ukwenziwa kwe-DNA, indawo yokuhlola i-G2 - ukuhlolwa kwe-DNA entsha.
question28: Chaza izindima zabalawuli bomjikelezo weseli abahle uma kuqhathaniswa nabalawuli ababi.
answer28: Abalawuli abahle bakhuthaza umjikelezo weseli kodwa abalawuli ababi bavimba umjikelezo weseli kuze kube yilapho kwenzeka izenzakalo ezithile.
distractor28a: Abalawuli abahle bakhuthaza umjikelezo weseli kodwa abalawuli ababi baqala i-apoptosis.
distractor28b: Abalawuli abahle bavimba ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kumaseli anomdlavuza kodwa abalawuli ababi bakhuthaza kulawo maseli.
distractor28c: Abalawuli abahle babonisa izindlela ezinhle zokuphendula kodwa abalawuli ababi babonisa impendulo engemihle emjikelezweni weseli.
question29: Chaza okwenzeka endaweni yokuhlola i-M bese ubikezela ukuthi kuzokwenzekani uma indawo yokuhlola i-M yehluleka.
answer29: Indawo yokuhlola i-M ihlola ukunamathela okufanele kwama-chromatids angodadewabo futhi uma yehluleka, khona-ke amaseli angase angahlangani nama-chromosome.
distractor29a: Indawo yokuhlola i-M ihlola ukuthi i-DNA yonakele yini futhi ikhuthaza ukulungiswa kwayo. Uma yehluleka, khona-ke amadodakazi agcina ene-DNA eyonakele.
distractor29b: Indawo yokuhlola i-M iqinisekisa ukuphindaphindwa okufanele kwe-DNA futhi uma yehluleka, amaseli angase angahlangani nama-chromosome.
distractor29c: Indawo yokuhlola i-M iqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izingxenye ezidingekayo ekuhlukanisweni kweseli ziyatholakala futhi uma yehluleka, umjikelezo weseli uzovinjelwa.
question30: Bhala izindlela zokulawula ezingase zilahleke kuseli elikhiqiza i-p53 enephutha.
answer30: Ikhwalithi ye-DNA, okubangela i-apoptosis, kanye nokuqasha ama-enzyme okulungisa
distractor30a: Ukuhlolwa kwe-DNA eyonakele, ukuqasha ama-enzyme okulungisa, kanye nokubopha i-spindle ku-kinetochore
distractor30b: Ikhwalithi ye-DNA, ukubopha i-spindle ku-kinetochore, kanye nokuhlolwa kokulungiswa kwe-DNA
distractor30c: Okubangela i-apoptosis, ukuqoqa ama-enzyme okulungisa, kanye nokubopha kahle kwe-spindle ku-kinetochore
question31: I-p53 ingabangela i-apoptosis uma izehlakalo ezithile zomjikelezo weseli zingaphumeleli. Lo mphumela wokulawula uzuzisa kanjani into ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi?
answer31: I-apoptosis ivimbela ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni anephutha, angakhiqizwa ngenxa yomonakalo we-DNA.
distractor31a: I-apoptosis isiza ekulawuleni ukusetshenziswa kwamandla ngamaseli engeziwe.
distractor31b: Inqubo ye-apoptosis imisa ukuhlasela kwamagciwane kwamanye amaseli.
distractor31c: Amaseli ayafa ngenxa yokukhiqizwa kwezinhlobo ze-oxygen ezisabelayo ezikhiqizwayo, ezingalimaza umzimba.
question32: Qamba izinqubo ezifanayo phakathi kwe-eukaryotic cell division kanye ne-binary fission.
answer32: Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA, ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe, kanye nokuhlukaniswa kokuqukethwe kwe-cytoplasmic
distractor32a: Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA, ukuhlukaniswa kwama-organelle eseli, ukuhlukaniswa kokuqukethwe kwe-cytoplasmic
distractor32b: Ukwakheka kwe-septum, ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA, ukuhlukaniswa kokuqukethwe kwe-cytoplasmic
distractor32c: Ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe, ukwakheka kwe-septum, ukuhlukaniswa kwama-organelle eseli
question33: Ukwakheka kwasiphi isakhiwo, esizogcina sakhe izindonga ezintsha zamaseli endodakazi, kuqondiswa yi-FtsZ?
question34: Bheka uMfanekiso 10.18. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo esingenakunqunywa kusuka ku-karyotype ebonisiwe?
question35: Xoxa ngendlela ukuhlelwa kwezinto zofuzo kuma-eukaryotes okuhluke ngayo kuma-prokaryotes.
answer35: I-DNA ye-Eukaryotic itholakala izungeze ama-histone ukuze yakhe ama-nucleosome, aqhubeka ehlangana futhi ekugcineni akhe ama-chromosome aqondile. I-genome ye-prokaryotic itholakala njenge-loop kanye nama-eukaryotes njengesakhiwo esiqondile esinezintambo ezimbili.
distractor35a: I-DNA kuzo zombili izinto eziphilayo izungezwe ama-nucleosome ngesakhiwo esihlangene. Ama-eukaryote abonisa isakhiwo se-loop kanti ama-prokaryote abonisa i-genome eqondile enezintambo ezimbili.
distractor35b: Izinto zofuzo zibonisa isakhiwo se-heterochromatin esinomugqa. Ama-prokaryotes abonisa izihibe eziningi, kanti ama-eukaryotes abonisa i-chromatin ehlanganisiwe.
distractor35c: Kuzo zombili izinto eziphilayo izinto zofuzo zigoqwe ngama-histone. Ama-prokaryotes anesakhiwo esijiyile kuma-nucleoid, kodwa ama-eukaryotes anesakhiwo esiqondile esinezintambo ezimbili.
question36: Bheka uMfanekiso 10.18. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana nesakhiwo 1 ku-karyotype esingelona iqiniso?
answer36: Izingxenye ezimbili zesakhiwo 1 zizoba nezakhi zofuzo ezindaweni ezahlukene.
distractor36b: Izingxenye ezimbili zesakhiwo 1 zivela kubazali abahlukene.
distractor36c: Izingxenye ezimbili zesakhiwo 1 zizoba nochungechunge oluhlukile kancane lwama-nucleotide.
question37: Bheka uMfanekiso 10.19. Ngokusekelwe ku-karyotype enikeziwe, ukungahlukaniswa kwe-chromosome okubangela i-Down syndrome kubangelwa yini?
question38: Chaza ukulandelana komjikelezo weseli le-mitotic wepheya elilodwa le-chromosome elihlukaniswa ngokwejwayelekile le-mitotic.

question40: Bheka uMfanekiso 10.20. Ocwaningweni lokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli, abacwaningi bahlukanisa amaseli abantu nge-thymidine ngendlela efanayo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi amaseli aboshelwe emngceleni we-G1. Amaseli abe esebekwa endaweni engenawo i-thymidine, ekhipha ibhlogo, bese amaseli eqala ukuhlukana futhi. Kusukela ngeSample A bese kuphetha ngeSample D, okuqukethwe yi-DNA yamaseli kulinganiswa ngezikhathi ezahlukene ngemva kokuba i-thymidine isusiwe. Imiphumela yamasampula amane (A-D) iboniswe kugrafu. Chaza okwenzekayo ngokwemijikelezo yamaseli kanye nokuqukethwe kwe-DNA kusampula B.
distractor40c: Amaseli abonisa indlela yokuhlukanisa amaseli e-semiconservative.
question41: I-Li-Fraumeni syndrome (LFS1) iyisifo esingavamile esidluliselwa ngofuzo esiholela ekuthambekeleni komdlavuza. Lesi sifo esidluliselwa ngofuzo sihlotshaniswa nokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ezicindezela isimila esifaka i-transcription factor p53. I-p53 isebenza endaweni yokuhlola i-G1. question43:
Bheka uMfanekiso 10.22. Le grafu ikhombisa ukubonakaliswa kweprotheyini ye-p53 kanye nephesenti labasindile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kubantu ababenomdlavuza we-prostate. Umugqa oluhlaza ukhombisa abantu abaneprotheyini ye-p53 esebenza kahle. Umugqa oluhlaza ukhombisa abantu abaneprotheyini ye-p53 engasebenzi kahle.

 Yisiphi isiphetho esingasithola kule grafu?
answer43: Ukuba neprotheyini ye-p53 esebenzayo kunciphisa amathuba okuba nomdlavuza ophindaphindayo futhi kwandisa ukusinda.
